# Superpipeline vibes sweep — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** The web app matches the approved Design-canvas mockups pixel for pixel — all four vibes (Daylight, Paper, Studio = Annual report, Quiet), light and dark, desktop 1440 and phone 390 — built from vibekit 0.1.0 components and enforced by a pixel-diff test against the 80 committed references.

**Architecture:** A dev-only import route seeds one fixture world (tenant `tnt_vibes`, clock 2026-10-11 13:51 Asia/Kolkata) into D1 and every board Durable Object. A Playwright harness renders each reference and the app in the same Chromium with byte-identical Fontsource fonts, compares them with pixelmatch (≤ 0.5%, no 8×8 block over 40%, exact size), and writes a side-by-side report. It lands first against today's app with an allow-list that only shrinks: each screen task ports its reference CSS verbatim (`scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs`), builds the screen from pure, unit-tested view models and vibekit components behind the `layouts.ts` registry, and deletes its allow-list keys. API rulings from the screen specs land as explicit, tested API tasks before the screens that need them.

**Tech Stack:** SvelteKit 2.66 SPA (adapter-static, `ssr = false`), Svelte 5.56 runes, Vite 8, Tailwind 4.3, TypeScript 6, `@superjackfruit/vibekit` 0.1.0 (vendored tarball), bits-ui; Cloudflare Workers API (`apps/api`, Board Durable Object, D1) + zod contract (`packages/contract`); vitest 4 (+ jsdom, @testing-library/svelte, `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`); Playwright 1.61 + `@axe-core/playwright`; pixelmatch 7 + pngjs 7; Fontsource; pnpm 11.5.2, Node 22.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-vibes-sweep-design.md` (this repo). Binding inputs, all in `docs/superpowers/specs/vibes-sweep/`: `screens/shell-and-board.md`, `screens/card.md` (+ `card.parts/`), `screens/operate-list-pages.md`, `screens/dialogs.md`, `screens/fixtures-and-harness.md`, `mockup-corrections.md` (overrides the screen specs), `vibekit-components.md`; references `apps/web/e2e/reference/mockups/*.html` + `manifest.json`. Implementation notes distilled from those inputs (corrections applied, every exact string and formula in one place per screen group) are committed beside this plan in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-vibes-sweep-notes/`; a task that cites a note section is citing the binding spec through it.

## Global Constraints

- **Every merge to Forge `main` deploys to production** (push mirror → GitHub Actions `test` + `e2e` + `pixel` → `deploy`, which also runs `db:migrate`). Never deploy or migrate by hand. Each task leaves the app working and every existing test green, or changes a test in the same task with the reason stated.
- **Branches:** one per phase from Forge `origin/main` — `feat/vibes-sweep-a` (Tasks 1–10), `-b` (11–18), `-c` (19–29), `-d` (30–36), `-e` (37–42). Push to `origin` (Forge). The operator merges on Forge.
- **SvelteKit SPA, Svelte 5 runes** (`$state`, `$derived`, `$props`, `$effect`, snippets); no legacy `export let`, no stores beyond the existing `app`/`appearance` singletons.
- **The vibe switch lives only in `apps/web/src/lib/layouts.ts`** (extended per vibe: shell, phone shell, board, phone board, drawer, phone card, card page, card states, operate, list, projects, workspace, settings, spend). Components below a layout never ask which vibe is on.
- **vibekit 0.1.0** is vendored at `apps/web/vendor/vibekit-0.1.0.tgz` (replacing 0.0.1); its CSS is imported as `@superjackfruit/vibekit/fonts.css` + `@superjackfruit/vibekit/vibekit.css`; shared UI uses its components (`vibekit-components.md` names). **Superpipeline's default accent is Gold**: `<html data-product="superpipeline">`, vibekit's `accents.css` tokens `--vk-color-accent*` keyed by `data-accent`, the choice in the appearance cookie (vibekit `withAccent`/`accentFor`).
- **API changes go through `apps/api` + `packages/contract`, each with tests** (Tasks 2, 6–10, 40). No other task edits `apps/api` or `packages/contract`.
- **Out of scope: the agent-drafted new card** (dialogs D-1: drafts endpoints, `draft.ready`, MCP `draft_card`, "Draft brief"). The composer ships without drafting; its pixel test removes the draft region from the reference (`refPatch`); `docs/follow-ups/agent-drafted-new-card.md` records the rest.
- **One fixture world** (`mockup-corrections.md` ruling 1): clock `2026-10-11T08:21:00Z`, zone `Asia/Kolkata` (13:51 local, sun phase noon, Studio "midday"), no per-screen or per-vibe seeds (Board settings alone freezes at 08:19Z to show "Rule saved · 2 min ago"); card 4605 is live and stopped in Reproduce; Developer Experience has 7 live cards, 4 need you; stage key `test`; faces seeded from agent names; card ids end in the mockup hex; short id = last 4 hex.
- **No local host or agent names in shipped code** (`apps/web/src`, `apps/api/src`, `packages/`). Fixture data under `apps/web/e2e/` and the dev-only routes (`/v1/dev/fixture`, `/dev/*`) may name agents.
- **No secrets in fixtures:** the snapshot files under `apps/web/e2e/pixel/fixture/source/` are scrubbed before commit (`scripts/pixel/scrub-snapshots.mjs`) and `snapshots.test.ts` fails on token- or email-shaped strings and production tenant ids. The fixture person's address is `rakesh@vibes-fixture.invalid`.
- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.2 AA — text 4.5:1, parts 3:1; 44px targets (`--vk-target-min`, `.vk-hit` where drawn smaller); visible focus; reduced motion wins; keyboard for everything; the signal colour only where a person is needed now ("needs you"); count badges `background: var(--vk-color-signal-text); color: var(--vk-color-primary-fg)`; destructive = ink outline plus a verb and an object (no danger colour); buttons stay on one line; agent text verbatim on desktop, `sentenceCase` on phones (C-06). axe (`e2e/vibes.spec.ts`) and every existing e2e spec stay green.
- **Colour from tokens only:** no new `#hex`/`rgb(` in `.svelte` or `app.css` (`no-raw-colour.test.ts`); ported reference CSS keeps its `var(--vk-*)` values.
- **Fonts are self-hosted Fontsource**, never Google Fonts, on both sides of the pixel test.
- **Pixel pass rule:** pixelmatch threshold `0.1`, `includeAA: false`; ratio ≤ `0.005` of unmasked pixels; no 8×8 block with more than 40% differing; size equal to the manifest's `w × h`. Masks only with an id from `MASK_IDS` (`live-dot`, `C-08`, `token-secret` remain at the end).
- **Keep existing accessible names** that e2e depends on (`New card`, `Dispatch`, `Card title`, `Approve`, `Request changes`, `Reject`, `Resume`, `Edit card`, `Archive card`, `Delete card`, `Comment`, `View raw JSON`, …) unless a reference renames one; then the task updates the e2e spec in the same commit and says so.
- **Test first, revert-proof every guard:** after a test passes, revert the guarded line once and watch it go red.
- **References are the truth; fix the code, never the reference.** The reference HTML files, `manifest.json`, `CORRECTIONS.md`, the comparison thresholds (`compare.ts`), the mask ids (`masks.ts` `MASK_IDS`) and growth of the allow-list (`expected-failures.ts`) are locked by `apps/web/e2e/pixel/references.lock` (Task 5): `references-lock.test.ts` fails when any of them drifts from the lock, and the CI step `check-lock-change.mjs` fails when the lock changes in a range with no `Reference-Change: <why>` commit trailer. Only a task whose stated purpose includes such a change (Task 5 creates the lock; the reference-correction steps named in Tasks 14, 21, 28 and 38 and any task adding a mask id) runs `node apps/web/scripts/pixel/lock-references.mjs` and adds the trailer. Removing allow-list keys needs no lock change.
- **Reference changes are explicit tasks' steps only** (Tasks 5, 14, 21, 28, 38): each edits the committed reference AND the same text in the editable canvas source `/Users/rakeshgangwar/SuperJackfruit/vibekit/design/mockups/project/<file>.dc.html` (one commit in each repo, the vibekit one referenced in the Superpipeline commit's `Reference-Change:` trailer), so canvas and git stay in step; the patched-reference table in the spec lists every one.
- **Implementer and reviewer models.** Each task names its model (`**Model:**`) and its reviewer's (`**Review:**`): `opus` for the dev fixture route (Task 2), the pixel harness core and font routing (Tasks 4–5), the card-model refactor (Task 19) and the reconnect / silent-renewal flow (Task 40); `sonnet` for everything else (screens with verbatim CSS, API field additions, docs, small fixes). Reviewers never go below `sonnet`. The final whole-branch review runs on `opus`.
- **Commands** (from the repo root): web unit file `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web exec vitest run <file>`; web unit `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test`; web typecheck `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web typecheck`; e2e `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web e2e`; pixel `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel [-g "<artboard>"]`; API `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/api test`; all `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`.
- **Commits** end with:
  ```
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
  Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01XwhK8QQtRh5hPEfqY5Arp8
  ```

## Review Focus

1. **A viewer outside India.** The suite only ever runs in Asia/Kolkata at 13:51. Expected: "Today, 12:48", "Thu 8 Oct, 19:41" and the Studio "The board at 13:51" render in the viewer's own zone; Operate's activity times stay UTC by design; day boundaries ("Today" vs "Yesterday") follow the viewer's midnight, not IST's. Pinned in Task 19 (`when.ts` tests in `America/Los_Angeles` and `UTC`).
2. **A fresh card nobody has worked.** Every fixture card that needs you has runs. Expected: a card with no runs shows no "attempt 0", no "Unclaimed · undefined ran attempt 0", no empty attempts table header, in every vibe — the facts and chips simply omit those parts. Pinned in Task 19 (model tests) and the parity test.
3. **An agent deleted after it worked a card.** `lastAgentId` / `delegateAgentId` / `queuedByAgentId` can name an agent the workspace no longer has. Expected: the name reads "an agent" (never a raw `agt_…` id), the face falls back to a neutral seed, nothing throws. Pinned in Task 14 (`buildBoardModel` test) and Task 19.
4. **Long names on a phone.** Fixture titles are long but board and agent names are short. Expected: a 90-character board name and a 40-character agent name truncate with an ellipsis in every phone shell and tab bar; the page never scrolls sideways at 390px. Pinned in Task 13 (e2e at 390 × 844).
5. **The session expires while a note is half-typed.** Expected: silent renewal first; if it fails, the "Sign in again to keep going" dialog keeps the open card, its drawer and the typed resume note, and after signing in the person lands back on the same card with the note still there. Pinned in Task 40 (e2e).

### Harness (Tasks 4–5) — `apps/web/e2e/pixel/`
- Registry `screens.ts`: `export interface Screen { artboard: string; vibe: Vibe; route: string; strength?: 'strong'|'subtle'|'off'; lightTheme?: 'light'|'sun'; steps?: (page: Page) => Promise<void>; hold?: string[]; fulfil?: Record<string, { status: number; json: unknown }>; parts?: Part[]; masks?: MaskSpec[]; refPatch?: (page: Page) => Promise<void> }` and `export interface Part { name: string; ref: string; app: string }`.
  `SCREENS` has exactly one entry per artboard (80). A screen task that changes its screen's steps,
  parts, masks or refPatch edits its entry in `screens.ts` and shows the edited entry as code.
- `parts` = compare element screenshots instead of the full page (dialogs: `[{ name: 'dialog', ref: 'section.dlg', app: 'section.dlg' }]`; the app uses the reference class names, so `ref` and `app` are usually the same selector). Element sizes must match exactly.
- Shell checks: `SHELL_CHECKS: Screen[]` — for each vibe, the board artboard with `parts` = that
  vibe's shell elements; keys end `#shell`. Allow-listed until Tasks 11–13.
- Allow-list `expected-failures.ts`: `export const EXPECTED_FAILURES: ReadonlySet<string>` of keys
  `` `${artboard}·${theme}` `` (and `` `${artboard}#shell·${theme}` ``). An allow-listed screen that
  passes FAILS the run ("remove it from expected-failures.ts"). Screen tasks delete their keys.
- Masks: `MaskSpec` from `masks.ts`; allowed ids live in `MASK_IDS` (`live-dot`, `C-08`, `D-1`,
  `dialog-backdrop`, `token-secret`). A task needing a new id adds it to `MASK_IDS` with its reason.
- Light cookie theme is `light` except `lightTheme: 'sun'` (Appearance dialog).
- Run one screen: `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel -g "<artboard>"`. Report:
  `apps/web/test-results/pixel/index.html`.
- Reference corrections: when a committed reference contradicts a ruling (e.g. an old placeholder),
  the task edits the reference HTML text in place AND appends a row to
  `apps/web/e2e/reference/mockups/CORRECTIONS.md` (`| file | selector | was | now | ruling |`).

### App hooks (Task 3)
- `document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'` when the store has loaded board, agents, members,
  labels, projects and no request is in flight (dev builds only); any page that loads other data
  (dev galleries, workspace) calls `app.markBusy(promise)` so ready waits for it.
- `window.__spDev = { refresh: () => app.refresh() }` in dev builds.
- localStorage overrides `superpipeline.devTenant`, `superpipeline.devUser` (dev builds only).
- Dev-only routes gated by `import { dev } from '$app/environment'` (404 otherwise): `/dev/card-states`
  (Task 20, extended by 25–27), `/dev/workspace-review` (Task 34).

## Rulings on gaps the inputs left open

The screen specs and corrections leave these open or contradict each other; the plan decides them as follows (each task applies them; changing one is a spec change).
- Card-States: compared FULL-PAGE against the dev gallery route `/dev/card-states` (one route renders
  the whole artboard: h1, explainer, six cells). No panels mode. The gallery builds six `CardModel`s
  with `surface: 'gallery'` from snapshots it fetches (`CardSource`); cell E's gate gets the 409 from a
  harness `fulfil` of `**/gates/gate_fx_p4/resolve` with the API-1 body
  `{ error: { code: 'GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED', message: 'gate is already resolved', decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' } }`
  and steps that click inside cell E; cell F holds `**/cards/card_05823a57e8224605/attempts` and `…/activities`.
  The gate model keeps a local `needNote` error and a server alert independently (Quiet/Studio E show both).
- Workspace-Other: compared FULL-PAGE against `/dev/workspace-review` (the five panels in reference order, resume form open on the 1dfc row with the drawn text). No panels mode.
- Drawer backdrop masks (C-08), rectangles: Daylight `{x:0,y:0,w:760,h:<artboard h>}`, Paper two rects `{x:0,w:330}` and `{x:1110,w:330}`, Studio `{x:0,w:500}`, Quiet `{x:0,w:320}`.
- "Sent back": derived client-side — `attempt.outcome === 'completed' && attempt.completion?.ok === false` → "sent back"; seed `failure_reason='repro and observed missing'` on run 1 (Task 3).
- "Show more": first-paragraph rule — a long spec value is stored as `shown + "\n\n" + continuation`; the UI shows the first paragraph and a "Show more" toggle iff more paragraphs exist. Task 3 seeds the five clamped 4605 values that way.
- `humanizeKey`: split camelCase, capitalise the first word, lower-case the rest; the card's own `spec.fieldLabels` (fixture data) overrides keys whose label is not mechanical (`messageMelissa` → "Message Melissa"), so no names ship in code.
- Card page references still carrying the old resume placeholder (CardPage-Daylight/Paper/Studio):
  reference correction to the shipped sentence "For example: what you checked, and what the agent should look at next." (log in CORRECTIONS.md).
- Required-evidence heading: per surface as the references print it (drawer "Acceptance criteria", page/phone "Things to prove", except where a reference prints otherwise — follow the reference).
- Quiet card page below 640px renders the phone layout (§7.7 wins).
- 4605 `needsHuman.summary` is seeded ("No fresh DM event to trace; needs one per agent."); the Studio
  phone board row that prints the fallback gets a reference correction to the summary.
- Asked-by/queuer face mood is a per-surface constant: desktop `working`, phone `resting` (O-2).
- `claimedCount` counts cards whose `delegateAgentId` is the agent and state not completed/rejected,
  not archived; the stopped DX cards have no delegate, so every agent reads 0 (matches the reference).
- Token box on Workspace-Agents: mask id `token-secret` over `.tokbox` (the token is random).
- Settings: the screen entry gets `clock: '2026-10-11T08:19:00Z'` plus steps (edit the Reproduce rule twice, then `page.clock.fastForward('02:00')`); `Screen` therefore has `clock?: string` (default `2026-10-11T08:21:00Z`).
- Appearance dialog: light cookie `<vibe>.sun.<strength>.0` (`lightTheme: 'sun'`); dark = `refPatch`
  that checks the "Dark" segment of the `Light or dark` radiogroup (aria-checked/data-state) and sets its
  hint to `Always dark: a lamp-lit room, not black.`; app cookie `<vibe>.dark.<strength>.0`.
- New card: `refPatch` removes `.nc-draftrow` and `.nc-brief-tag` from the reference (D-1 out of scope);
  steps fill the form by hand. The composer shows no draft button.
- Palette agent ranking (O-11): agents that alone own a stage, current board first in stage order, then
  the other boards in switcher order; then the rest by name. DX gives error-eric, tester-tim, then
  Production Releases' devops-dave, vulnerability-victor (verify against the reference; if it disagrees,
  follow the reference and state the rule you used).
- Board switcher reference defect (ink outline on "Rename" instead of "Delete board…"): reference
  correction; the app puts the ink outline on the destructive control.
- Dialog comparison: `parts` = `section.dlg` (+ `.bs-trigger` for the switcher); the app's dialog uses the
  same classes and the same box size and position. After steps, blur the active element.

### Task 2: The fixture import route (API, dev only)

**Model:** opus · **Review:** opus

The fixture world needs historical timestamps in D1 **and** in every board Durable Object. The public
API stamps `Date.now()` on every write and cannot reach DO SQLite from SQL, so one dev-only route writes
both from a `World` JSON (`fixtures-and-harness.md` §A.9). It is double-gated: the Worker answers 404
unless `DEV_AUTH === 'true' && FIXTURE_IMPORT === 'true'`, and the DO refuses unless its own env says
`FIXTURE_IMPORT === 'true'`. `FIXTURE_IMPORT` never appears in `wrangler.jsonc`.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/api/src/dev/fixture.ts`
- Create: `apps/api/src/dev/fixture-types.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/index.ts` (route before the `/auth/` and `/hub/` blocks, right after `/health`)
- Modify: `apps/api/src/board/board-do.ts` (`importFixture` RPC + `BoardStub.importFixture`)
- Modify: `apps/api/src/env.ts` (`FIXTURE_IMPORT?: string`)
- Modify: `apps/api/src/auth/resolve.ts` (DEV_AUTH branch: `?user=` fallback and `users.name`)
- Modify: `apps/api/package.json` (`dev:pixel` script)
- Modify: `apps/api/vitest.config.ts` (`FIXTURE_IMPORT: 'true'` binding)
- Test: `apps/api/test/dev-fixture.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `POST /v1/dev/fixture` body `FixtureWorld` → `200 {"ok":true,"boards":number,"cards":number}`.
- Produces: `BoardStub.importFixture(board: FixtureBoard): Promise<{ ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; code: 'FIXTURE_IMPORT_DISABLED' | 'UNKNOWN_COLUMN'; detail?: string }>`.
- Produces (types, `apps/api/src/dev/fixture-types.ts`, mirrored by `apps/web/e2e/pixel/fixture/types.ts` in Task 3):

Add the method to `class BoardDO` (next to `init`):

```ts
  /**
   * Replace every row of this board with a fixture (fixtures-and-harness.md §A.9.3). Dev only and
   * gated here as well as at the route. Writes rows exactly as given — historical timestamps
   * included — emits nothing and schedules no alarm, so the stale sweep never runs on a fixture.
   */
  async importFixture(board: import('../dev/fixture-types').FixtureBoard): Promise<
    { ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; code: 'FIXTURE_IMPORT_DISABLED' | 'UNKNOWN_COLUMN'; detail?: string }
  > {
    if (this.env.FIXTURE_IMPORT !== 'true') return { ok: false, code: 'FIXTURE_IMPORT_DISABLED' };
    const TABLES = ['meta', 'cards', 'runs', 'activities', 'events', 'usage_records', 'notifications', 'gates', 'approval_subjects',
      'approval_delivery_events', 'elicitations', 'card_references', 'card_links', 'card_comments', 'schedules', 'profiles',
      'push_configs', 'push_deliveries', 'run_reports', 'webhook_deliveries'] as const;
    const columns = (t: string) => new Set((this.sql.exec(`PRAGMA table_info(${t})`).toArray() as Array<{ name: string }>).map((r) => r.name));
    const insert = (table: string, rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>) => {
      const known = columns(table);
      for (const row of rows) {
        const keys = Object.keys(row);
        const bad = keys.find((k) => !known.has(k));
        if (bad) throw new FixtureColumnError(`${table}.${bad}`);
        this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO ${table} (${keys.join(', ')}) VALUES (${keys.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`, ...keys.map((k) => row[k] as SqlStorageValue));
      }
    };
    try {
      this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(() => {
        for (const t of TABLES) this.sql.exec(`DELETE FROM ${t}`);
        insert('meta', Object.entries(board.meta).map(([k, v]) => ({ k, v })));
        insert('cards', board.cards);
        insert('runs', board.runs);
        insert('activities', board.activities);
        insert('events', [...board.events].sort((a, b) => a.ts.localeCompare(b.ts)).map((e) => ({ type: e.type, payload_json: JSON.stringify(e.payload), ts: e.ts })));
        insert('notifications', [...board.notifications].sort((a, b) => a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at)));
        insert('gates', board.gates);
        insert('approval_subjects', board.approvalSubjects.map(({ canonical_bytes_b64, ...rest }) => ({
          ...rest, canonical_bytes: Uint8Array.from(atob(canonical_bytes_b64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)),
        })));
        insert('elicitations', board.elicitations);
        insert('card_references', board.references);
        insert('card_links', board.links);
        insert('card_comments', board.comments);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof FixtureColumnError) return { ok: false, code: 'UNKNOWN_COLUMN', detail: e.message };
      throw e;
    }
    await this.ctx.storage.deleteAlarm();
    return { ok: true, cards: board.cards.length };
  }
```

And, at module level near the other small error classes (top of the file, after imports):

```ts
class FixtureColumnError extends Error {}
```

(`approval_subjects.canonical_bytes` is a BLOB; `sql.exec` binds a `Uint8Array` as one. If `SqlStorageValue` does not admit `Uint8Array` in the installed workers-types, bind `.buffer` — an `ArrayBuffer` — instead.)

```ts
// apps/api/src/dev/fixture.ts
import type { Env } from '../env';
import { boardStub } from '../board/stub';
import type { FixtureWorld } from './fixture-types';

/** Null unless this is the dev fixture route AND both flags are on — then the caller 404s as usual. */
export async function handleDevFixture(request: Request, env: Env, path: string): Promise<Response | null> {
  if (path !== '/v1/dev/fixture') return null;
  if (env.DEV_AUTH !== 'true' || env.FIXTURE_IMPORT !== 'true') return null;
  if (request.method !== 'POST') return new Response('method not allowed', { status: 405 });
  const w = (await request.json()) as FixtureWorld;
  const t = w.tenant.id;
  const db = env.DB;
  const boardIds = (await db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM boards WHERE tenant_id = ?`).bind(t).all<{ id: string }>()).results.map((r) => r.id);
  const del = [
    `DELETE FROM agent_card_queues WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM agent_tokens WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM capability_implications WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM capabilities WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM labels WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM project_rollups WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM milestones WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM projects WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM card_links_external WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM agents WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM boards WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM memberships WHERE tenant_id = ?`,
    `DELETE FROM tenants WHERE id = ?`,
  ].map((s) => db.prepare(s).bind(t));
  const ins: D1PreparedStatement[] = [
    db.prepare(`DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?`).bind(w.user.id),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO tenants (id, slug, name, forge_host, external_id, external_source, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .bind(t, w.tenant.slug, w.tenant.name, w.tenant.forgeHost, w.tenant.externalId, w.tenant.externalSource, w.tenant.createdAt),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?)`).bind(w.user.id, w.user.email, w.user.name, w.user.createdAt),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO memberships (id, tenant_id, user_id, role, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(w.membership.id, t, w.user.id, w.membership.role, w.membership.createdAt),
    ...w.boards.map((b) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO boards (id, tenant_id, name, stages_json, created_by, created_by_agent_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?,?)`)
      .bind(b.id, t, b.name, JSON.stringify(b.stages), b.createdBy, b.createdAt, b.updatedAt)),
    ...w.agents.flatMap((a) => [
      db.prepare(`INSERT INTO agents (id, tenant_id, name, icon_url, capabilities_json, connection_json, concurrency, status, external_id, external_source, owner_user_id, may_queue_to_json, queue_ceiling_per_hour, board_ceiling_per_day, created_at)
                  VALUES (?,?,?,NULL,?,'["rest"]',1,'offline',?,'agentpod',?,?,20,3,?)`)
        .bind(a.id, t, a.name, JSON.stringify(a.capabilities), a.externalId, a.ownerUserId, a.mayQueueTo ? JSON.stringify(a.mayQueueTo) : null, a.createdAt),
      ...Array.from({ length: a.tokens }, (_, i) => {
        const id = `tok_fx_${a.name.replace(/-/g, '_')}_${i + 1}`;
        const at = new Date(Date.parse('2026-09-02T00:00:00Z') + (i + 1) * 60_000).toISOString();
        return db.prepare(`INSERT INTO agent_tokens (id, tenant_id, agent_id, token_hash, scopes_json, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
          .bind(id, t, a.id, `fixture-${id}`, '["claim","run"]', at);
      }),
    ]),
    ...w.capabilities.map((c) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO capabilities (id, tenant_id, key, name, description, tags_json, examples_json, input_modes_json, output_modes_json, origin, created_by, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,'[]','[]','[]','[]',?,?,?)`)
      .bind(`cap_fx_${c.key}`, t, c.key, c.key, c.description, c.origin, w.user.id, c.createdAt)),
    ...w.implications.map((i) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO capability_implications (tenant_id, implies_from, implies_to, created_at, created_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .bind(t, i.from, i.to, i.createdAt, w.user.id)),
    ...w.labels.map((l) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO labels (id, tenant_id, name, colour, origin, created_by, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,NULL,?)`)
      .bind(l.id, t, l.name, l.colour, l.origin, l.createdAt)),
    ...w.projects.map((p) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO projects (id, tenant_id, name, description, target_date, state, health, lead_user_id, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .bind(p.id, t, p.name, p.description, p.targetDate, p.state, p.health, p.leadUserId, p.createdAt)),
    ...w.milestones.map((m) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO milestones (id, project_id, tenant_id, name, target_date, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .bind(m.id, m.projectId, t, m.name, m.targetDate, m.sortOrder, m.createdAt)),
    ...w.externalLinks.map((x) => db.prepare(`INSERT INTO card_links_external (tenant_id, from_board_id, from_card_id, to_board_id, to_card_id, kind, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .bind(t, x.fromBoardId, x.fromCardId, x.toBoardId, x.toCardId, x.kind, x.createdAt)),
  ];
  await db.batch([...del, ...ins]);
  // Boards that were in the tenant before but are not in this world: empty their DOs too.
  const empty = { meta: {}, cards: [], runs: [], activities: [], events: [], notifications: [], gates: [], approvalSubjects: [], elicitations: [], references: [], links: [], comments: [] };
  for (const id of boardIds.filter((id) => !w.dos[id])) await boardStub(env, t, id).importFixture(empty);
  let cards = 0;
  for (const b of w.boards) {
    const fb = w.dos[b.id] ?? empty;
    const meta = { boardId: b.id, tenantId: t, name: b.name, stages: JSON.stringify(b.stages), ...fb.meta };
    const r = await boardStub(env, t, b.id).importFixture({ ...fb, meta });
    if (!r.ok) return Response.json({ error: r.code, detail: r.detail }, { status: r.code === 'UNKNOWN_COLUMN' ? 400 : 403 });
    cards += r.cards;
  }
  return Response.json({ ok: true, boards: w.boards.length, cards });
}
```

### Task 3: The fixture world, the scrubbed snapshots and the app's dev hooks

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

One world (`mockup-corrections.md` ruling 1, Part 4): clock 2026-10-11T08:21:00Z in Asia/Kolkata,
card 4605 live and stopped in Reproduce, Developer Experience with 7 live cards of which 4 need you,
stage key `test`, faces seeded from agent names, card ids ending in the mockup hex. It is typed test

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/scrub-snapshots.mjs — make captured board snapshots safe to commit.
// Rewrites, in place: token-shaped strings → "[scrubbed-token]", email addresses (not git@ ssh
// remotes, not Matrix ids like @agent_x:host) → "<local>@fixture.invalid", every tnt_<hex> → tnt_vibes.
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const dir = process.argv[2] ?? new URL('../../e2e/pixel/fixture/source', import.meta.url).pathname;
for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.json'))) {
  const p = join(dir, f);
  const before = readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
  const after = before
    .replace(/\b(sk-[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}|spa_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{8,}|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?)/g, '[scrubbed-token]')
    .replace(/(Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,}/gi, '$1[scrubbed-token]')
    .replace(/(?<![\w/:])([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@([A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+)/g, (m, local, host) =>
      local === 'git' || /\.(invalid|example)$/.test(host) ? m : `${local}@fixture.invalid`)
    .replace(/tnt_(?!vibes)[0-9a-f]{12,}/g, 'tnt_vibes');
  if (after !== before) { writeFileSync(p, after); console.log('scrubbed', f); }
}
```

text changed: the only rewrites are in reference metadata, run notes and the fake key. If a rewritten

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/fixture/snapshots.ts — read bulky fields (spec, queuedGrant, references, stages) from the scrubbed captures.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

export interface SnapshotCard { id: string; title: string; spec: unknown; queuedGrant: string[] | null; contextId: string; createdAt: string }
export interface SnapshotRef { id: string; cardId: string; url: string; title: string | null; subtitle: string | null; provider: string; sourceType: string; externalId: string | null; metadata: unknown; syncState: string; lastSyncedAt: string | null; addedBy: string; runId: string | null; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string | null }
export interface Snapshot { boardId: string; name: string; stages: Array<Record<string, unknown>>; cards: SnapshotCard[]; references: SnapshotRef[] }

const cache = new Map<string, Snapshot>();
export function snapshot(boardId: string): Snapshot {
  let s = cache.get(boardId);
  if (!s) { s = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'source', `after_${boardId}.json`), 'utf8')) as Snapshot; cache.set(boardId, s); }
  return s;
}
export function snapshotCard(boardId: string, productionId: string): SnapshotCard {
  const c = snapshot(boardId).cards.find((x) => x.id === productionId);
  if (!c) throw new Error(`snapshot ${boardId} has no card ${productionId}`);
  return c;
}
/** Reference rows for one card, re-keyed to the fixture card id, as DO `card_references` rows. */
export function snapshotRefs(boardId: string, productionId: string, fixtureId: string): Array<Record<string, string | null>> {
  return snapshot(boardId).references.filter((r) => r.cardId === productionId).map((r) => ({
    id: r.id, card_id: fixtureId, url: r.url, title: r.title, subtitle: r.subtitle, provider: r.provider, source_type: r.sourceType,
    external_id: r.externalId, metadata_json: r.metadata == null ? null : JSON.stringify(r.metadata), sync_state: r.syncState,
    last_synced_at: r.lastSyncedAt, added_by: r.addedBy, created_at: r.createdAt, updated_at: r.updatedAt, run_id: r.runId,
  }));
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/fixture/seed.ts
import type { APIRequestContext } from '@playwright/test';
import { BASE_WORLD } from './world';

export const API = 'http://localhost:8787';
export const FIXTURE_TENANT = 'tnt_vibes';
export const FIXTURE_USER = 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4';
let seeded = false;

/** One world: seeded once per run, and again only after a screen that writes (resolve, resume) asks for it. */
export async function seedWorld(request: APIRequestContext, opts: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
  if (seeded && !opts.force) return;
  const res = await request.post(`${API}/v1/dev/fixture`, { data: BASE_WORLD, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  if (!res.ok()) throw new Error(`fixture import failed: ${res.status()} ${await res.text()}`);
  seeded = true;
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/stores/app.svelte.ts` — in the class:

```ts
  #busy = 0;
  /** Track a load that the pixel suite must wait for (dev galleries, workspace tabs). */
  async markBusy<T>(p: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    this.#busy++;
    try { return await p; } finally { this.#busy--; this.noteLoaded(); }
  }
  /** Dev builds: `<html data-ready="true">` once the board and its catalog are in and nothing is pending. */
  noteLoaded(): void {
    if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return;
    const ready = this.#busy === 0 && (this.authState !== 'ready' || this.board !== null || this.needsBoard);
    document.documentElement.dataset.ready = String(ready);
  }
```

Call `this.noteLoaded()` at the end of `openBoard()` (after the `Promise.allSettled` for agents/members/labels/projects), at the end of `init()`, and after `refresh()`. Wrap those three bodies' async work in `this.markBusy(…)` so a load in progress holds `ready` false. After the class definition (module end, dev only):

```ts
if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  (window as unknown as { __spDev: { refresh: () => Promise<void> } }).__spDev = { refresh: () => app.refresh() };
}
```

### Task 4: Pixel comparator, reference loader and font routing

**Model:** opus · **Review:** opus

The pure half of the harness, unit-tested in vitest before any browser runs: Fontsource files served
under the mockup family names (both sides rasterise identical bytes), the reference loader with its
dark derivation, and the comparator (pixelmatch threshold 0.1, ≤ 0.5% ratio, no 8×8 block over 40%,
exact size). Code follows `fixtures-and-harness.md` §B.3/§B.5/§B.9, changed for the corrected
reference set: every artboard is one fixed-vibe file `SP-<Screen>-<Vibe>.html` (80), so the
`@<vibe>` lookup and `missing-reference` go away (corrections WC-7, Part 3); a dark reference is the
light file with `data-theme` swapped and the audited patches applied, unless an explicit
`<Artboard>.dark.html` export exists beside it.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/fonts.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/reference.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/compare.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/report.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/masks.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/compare.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/reference.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/fonts.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/masks.test.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs`, `apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.test.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/scripts/pixel/recv.mjs`
- Modify: `apps/web/vitest.config.ts` (include `e2e/pixel/**/*.test.ts` and `scripts/**/*.test.ts`, node environment)

- Produces: `REF_DIR`, `MANIFEST: Record<string,{w:number;h:number;title:string}>`, `type RefSource = { file: string; derivedDark: boolean }`, `resolveReference(artboard: string, theme: Theme): RefSource | null`, `deriveDark(html: string): string`, `renderReference(page, src, artboard, opts?: { parts?: Array<{ name: string; ref: string }>; masks?: MaskSpec[]; refPatch?: (page: Page) => Promise<void> }): Promise<{ shots: Buffer[]; masks: Mask[]; partMasks: Mask[][] }>` (one shot per part with its part-relative masks, or one full-page shot with page masks), `waitForFonts(page)`, `assertFamiliesLoaded(page, families)` (reference.ts).
- Produces: `type Mask = { id: string; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; why: string }`, `type MaskSpec = { id: string; why: string; selector: string; side?: 'ref' | 'app' | 'both'; pad?: number } | (Mask & { selector?: undefined })`, `resolveMasks(page, specs, side): Promise<Mask[]>`, `masksForPart(masks, box): Mask[]`, `MASK_IDS: Record<string, string>` (masks.ts).
- Produces: `compare(ref: Buffer, app: Buffer, masks?: Mask[]): Result`, constants `PIXEL_THRESHOLD=0.1`, `MAX_RATIO=0.005`, `WARN_RATIO=0.001`, `BLOCK=8`, `BLOCK_BREAK=0.4` (compare.ts).
- Produces: `record(row: Row, result?: Result)`, `writeReport()`, `OUT` (report.ts).
- Produces: `node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs <Artboard> --prefix <p1,p2,…> [--root <selector>] [--out <file>]` — prints (or writes) every CSS rule from the reference's `<style>` blocks whose selector mentions a class starting with one of the prefixes, with the canvas' `:where(.backdrop)`/`:where(.fg)` wrappers kept as written, `@media` blocks kept around their rules, `.sc-*` canvas rules dropped. Screen tasks use it to port CSS verbatim.

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/compare.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { PNG } from 'pngjs';
import { compare } from './compare';

function png(w: number, h: number, paint: (x: number, y: number) => [number, number, number]): Buffer {
  const p = new PNG({ width: w, height: h });
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const [r, g, b] = paint(x, y); const i = (y * w + x) * 4;
    p.data[i] = r; p.data[i + 1] = g; p.data[i + 2] = b; p.data[i + 3] = 255;
  }
  return PNG.sync.write(p);
}
const white = () => [255, 255, 255] as [number, number, number];
// A "text row": black bars 2px tall every 6px, like a line of glyph stems.
const row = (dy: number) => (x: number, y: number) => (((y - dy) % 6 + 6) % 6 < 2 && x % 3 !== 0 ? [0, 0, 0] : [255, 255, 255]) as [number, number, number];

describe('compare', () => {
  it('identical images pass with ratio 0', () => {
    const a = png(64, 64, row(0));
    const r = compare(a, a);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', ratio: 0, brokenBlocks: 0, sizeMismatch: null });
  });
  it('a text row moved by 1px fails on broken blocks even under the ratio budget', () => {
    const big = (dy: number) => (x: number, y: number) => (y < 16 ? row(dy)(x, y) : white());
    const r = compare(png(400, 400, big(0)), png(400, 400, big(1)));
    expect(r.ratio).toBeLessThan(0.05);
    expect(r.brokenBlocks).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(r.status).toBe('fail');
  });
  it('a page 8px taller fails as a size mismatch', () => {
    const r = compare(png(64, 64, white), png(64, 72, white));
    expect(r.sizeMismatch).toEqual({ ref: [64, 64], app: [64, 72] });
    expect(r.status).toBe('fail');
  });
  it('refuses a mask that cites no conflict id', () => {
    const a = png(16, 16, white);
    expect(() => compare(a, a, [{ id: '', x: 0, y: 0, w: 4, h: 4, why: 'x' }])).toThrow(/conflict id/);
  });
  it('a difference inside a mask passes', () => {
    const a = png(64, 64, white);
    const b = png(64, 64, (x, y) => (x < 16 && y < 16 ? [0, 0, 0] : [255, 255, 255]));
    expect(compare(a, b).status).toBe('fail');
    expect(compare(a, b, [{ id: 'live-dot', x: 0, y: 0, w: 16, h: 16, why: 'test' }]).status).toBe('pass');
  });
  it('warns between 0.1% and 0.5%', () => {
    const a = png(100, 100, white);
    const b = png(100, 100, (x, y) => ((x * 7 + y * 13) % 400 === 0 ? [0, 0, 0] : [255, 255, 255]));
    const r = compare(a, b);
    expect(r.ratio).toBeGreaterThan(0.001);
    expect(r.ratio).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.005);
    expect(r.status).toBe('warn');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/masks.ts
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';

export interface Mask { id: string; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; why: string }
export type MaskSpec =
  | { id: string; why: string; selector: string; side?: 'ref' | 'app' | 'both'; pad?: number }
  | (Mask & { selector?: undefined });

/**
 * Every id a mask may cite. A mask hides pixels from the comparison, so each one is a claim that
 * the hidden region is not the app's fault. C-nn ids are open conflicts in fixtures-and-harness.md
 * §A.8 (masks.test.ts checks the spec still lists them); the rest are dynamic regions or scope cuts.
 */
export const MASK_IDS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  'live-dot': 'The Live dot pulses unless reduced motion stops it; a missed rule must not fail a screen (F §B.5).',
  'C-08': 'Card drawer backdrop: the board behind the drawer is compared on the board screens, not here (F §A.8 C-08).',
  'D-1': 'Agent-drafted new card is out of scope; the composer ships without drafting (dialogs D-1, plan Global Constraints).',
  'dialog-backdrop': 'The scrimmed screen behind a dialog is compared on its own screen; dialogs compare the dialog (DLG §0.5).',
  'token-secret': 'A freshly issued agent token is random; the box that shows it cannot match a fixed reference (operate-list-pages WA-G4).',
};

/** Masks relative to one compared element (parts mode): keep the parts of each rect inside `box`. */
export function masksForPart(masks: Mask[], box: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }): Mask[] {
  const out: Mask[] = [];
  for (const m of masks) {
    const x0 = Math.max(m.x, box.x), y0 = Math.max(m.y, box.y);
    const x1 = Math.min(m.x + m.w, box.x + box.width), y1 = Math.min(m.y + m.h, box.y + box.height);
    if (x1 > x0 && y1 > y0) out.push({ ...m, x: Math.floor(x0 - box.x), y: Math.floor(y0 - box.y), w: Math.ceil(x1 - x0), h: Math.ceil(y1 - y0) });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Resolve selector masks to rectangles on the page that is open now (reference or app). */
export async function resolveMasks(page: Page, specs: MaskSpec[], side: 'ref' | 'app'): Promise<Mask[]> {
  const out: Mask[] = [];
  for (const s of specs) {
    if (!MASK_IDS[s.id]) throw new Error(`mask id ${s.id} is not in MASK_IDS`);
    if (s.selector === undefined) { out.push(s); continue; }
    if (s.side && s.side !== 'both' && s.side !== side) continue;
    const boxes = await page.locator(s.selector).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => {
      const r = e.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: r.left + scrollX, y: r.top + scrollY, w: r.width, h: r.height };
    }));
    const pad = s.pad ?? 0;
    for (const b of boxes) out.push({ id: s.id, why: s.why, x: Math.floor(b.x - pad), y: Math.floor(b.y - pad), w: Math.ceil(b.w + 2 * pad), h: Math.ceil(b.h + 2 * pad) });
  }
  return out;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Write `reference.ts`** — the §B.9 `reference.ts` block with these changes (write the whole file):

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/reference.ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FAMILIES, pkgDir, referenceFontCss } from './fonts';
import { masksForPart, resolveMasks, type Mask, type MaskSpec } from './masks';

export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';
export const REF_DIR = resolve(__dirname, '../reference/mockups');
export const MANIFEST: Record<string, { w: number; h: number; title: string }> = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(REF_DIR, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8'));
const MOON = '<path d="M20 14.5A8 8 0 0 1 9.5 4 8 8 0 1 0 20 14.5z"></path>';

export type RefSource = { file: string; derivedDark: boolean };

/** One fixed-vibe file per artboard; dark is an explicit `<artboard>.dark.html` or the light file swapped. */
export function resolveReference(artboard: string, theme: Theme): RefSource | null {
  const light = join(REF_DIR, `${artboard}.html`);
  if (!existsSync(light)) return null;
  if (theme === 'light') return { file: light, derivedDark: false };
  const dark = join(REF_DIR, `${artboard}.dark.html`);
  return existsSync(dark) ? { file: dark, derivedDark: false } : { file: light, derivedDark: true };
}

export function deriveDark(html: string): string {
  return html.replace(/data-theme="light"/g, 'data-theme="dark"');
}

const stripGoogleFonts = (html: string) => html.replace(/<link[^>]+fonts\.(googleapis|gstatic)\.com[^>]*>/g, '');

/** The audited theme branches (F §B.3.3): the sun/moon icon, "Dark theme" pressed, the Appearance theme radio. */
async function applyDarkPatches(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate((moon) => {
    for (const b of document.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[aria-label="Appearance"], [aria-label^="Appearance:"]')) {
      const svg = b.querySelector('svg');
      if (svg && b.closest('.dy-app, .dy-rail, .dp-bar, .dy-top')) svg.innerHTML = moon;
    }
    for (const b of document.querySelectorAll('button')) {
      if (b.textContent?.trim() === 'Dark theme' && b.hasAttribute('aria-pressed')) b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    }
    // SP-Dlg-Appearance-*: the canvas resolved the theme control at export (dark checks "Dark" and
    // changes its hint), so a swapped light file must be patched the same way (notes `dialogs.md` §1).
    const group = document.querySelector('[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Light or dark"]');
    if (group) {
      for (const b of group.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="radio"]')) {
        const on = b.textContent?.trim() === 'Dark';
        b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on));
        b.setAttribute('data-state', on ? 'checked' : 'unchecked');
      }
      const hint = group.parentElement?.querySelector('.ap-hint');
      if (hint) hint.textContent = 'Always dark: a lamp-lit room, not black.';
    }
  }, MOON);
}

export async function installPixelOrigin(page: Page, html: string): Promise<void> {
  const fontCss = referenceFontCss();
  await page.route('https://fonts.googleapis.com/**', (r) => r.abort());
  await page.route('https://fonts.gstatic.com/**', (r) => r.abort());
  await page.route('http://pixel.local/**', async (route) => {
    const url = new URL(route.request().url());
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/ref/')) return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/html', body: html });
    if (url.pathname === '/fonts.css') return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/css', body: fontCss });
    const m = /^\/fontsource\/(@[^/]+\/[^/]+|[^@/][^/]*)\/files\/(.+)$/.exec(url.pathname);
    if (m) return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'font/woff2', body: readFileSync(join(pkgDir(m[1]!), 'files', m[2]!)) });
    return route.fulfill({ status: 404, body: '' });
  });
}

export async function waitForFonts(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(async (families) => {
    await document.fonts.ready;
    const used = new Set<string>();
    for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('*')) used.add(getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily.split(',')[0]!.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, ''));
    await Promise.all([...used].filter((f) => families.includes(f) || /Variable$/.test(f)).flatMap((f) => [
      document.fonts.load(`400 16px "${f}"`), document.fonts.load(`700 16px "${f}"`), document.fonts.load(`italic 400 16px "${f}"`),
    ]));
    await document.fonts.ready;
  }, FAMILIES);
}

export async function assertFamiliesLoaded(page: Page, families: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const missing = await page.evaluate((fs) => fs.filter((f) => !document.fonts.check(`16px "${f}"`)), families);
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`fonts not loaded: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
}

const STABILISE = '*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;caret-color:transparent!important}::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}';

export async function renderReference(
  page: Page, src: RefSource, artboard: string,
  opts: { parts?: Array<{ name: string; ref: string }>; masks?: MaskSpec[]; refPatch?: (page: Page) => Promise<void> } = {},
): Promise<{ shots: Buffer[]; masks: Mask[]; partMasks: Mask[][] }> {
  const { w, h } = MANIFEST[artboard]!;
  let html = stripGoogleFonts(readFileSync(src.file, 'utf8'));
  if (src.derivedDark) html = deriveDark(html);
  html = html.replace('</head>', `<link rel="stylesheet" href="http://pixel.local/fonts.css"><style>${STABILISE}</style></head>`);
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: w, height: h });
  await installPixelOrigin(page, html);
  await page.goto(`http://pixel.local/ref/${artboard}.html`);
  if (src.derivedDark) await applyDarkPatches(page);
  if (opts.refPatch) await opts.refPatch(page);
  await waitForFonts(page);
  const masks = await resolveMasks(page, opts.masks ?? [], 'ref');
  if (opts.parts?.length) {
    const shots: Buffer[] = [];
    const partMasks: Mask[][] = [];
    for (const p of opts.parts) {
      const el = page.locator(p.ref).first();
      const box = await el.evaluate((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + scrollX, y: r.top + scrollY, width: r.width, height: r.height }; });
      shots.push(await el.screenshot({ animations: 'disabled' }));
      partMasks.push(masksForPart(masks, box));
    }
    return { shots, masks: [], partMasks };
  }
  return { shots: [await page.screenshot({ clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: w, height: h }, animations: 'disabled' })], masks, partMasks: [] };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Write `extract-css.mjs`**

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs — port a reference's CSS verbatim, by class prefix.
// Usage: node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Board-Daylight --prefix dy-,vk-sky [--out src/lib/styles/vibes/daylight/shell.css]
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const [artboard, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (k) => { const i = rest.indexOf(k); return i > -1 ? rest[i + 1] : undefined; };
const prefixes = (arg('--prefix') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
if (!artboard || prefixes.length === 0) { console.error('usage: extract-css.mjs <Artboard> --prefix a-,b- [--out file]'); process.exit(2); }
const html = readFileSync(join(here, '../../e2e/reference/mockups', `${artboard}.html`), 'utf8');
const css = [...html.matchAll(/<style[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/g)].map((m) => m[1]).join('\n');

/** Split top-level CSS into [prelude, body] blocks, keeping @media/@supports/@container groups. */
function blocks(src) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, start = 0, open = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const c = src[i];
    if (c === '/' && src[i + 1] === '*') { const e = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2); i = e < 0 ? src.length : e + 1; continue; }
    if (c === '{') { if (depth === 0) open = i; depth++; }
    else if (c === '}') { depth--; if (depth === 0) { out.push([src.slice(start, open).trim(), src.slice(open + 1, i)]); start = i + 1; } }
  }
  return out;
}
const wanted = (sel) => !/\.sc-/.test(sel) && prefixes.some((p) => new RegExp(`\\.${p.replace(/[-]/g, '\\-')}`).test(sel));

const kept = [];
for (const [prelude, body] of blocks(css)) {
  if (/^@(media|supports|container)/.test(prelude)) {
    const inner = blocks(body).filter(([s]) => wanted(s)).map(([s, b]) => `  ${s} {${b}}`);
    if (inner.length) kept.push(`${prelude} {\n${inner.join('\n')}\n}`);
  } else if (/^@keyframes/.test(prelude)) {
    if (prefixes.some((p) => prelude.includes(p))) kept.push(`${prelude} {${body}}`);
  } else if (wanted(prelude)) kept.push(`${prelude} {${body}}`);
}
const text = `/* Ported verbatim from e2e/reference/mockups/${artboard}.html (prefixes ${prefixes.join(', ')}) by scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs. */\n${kept.join('\n')}\n`;
const out = arg('--out');
if (out) writeFileSync(out, text); else process.stdout.write(text);
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Write `recv.mjs`** (§B.7 receiver: listens on :8977, writes `<name>.html` from a POSTed DOM into the directory given as argv[2])

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/recv.mjs <dir> — receive a canvas export: POST /?name=<Artboard>[.dark] with the DOM as the body.
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const dir = process.argv[2];
if (!dir) { console.error('usage: recv.mjs <dir>'); process.exit(2); }
createServer((req, res) => {
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return res.end();
  const name = new URL(req.url, 'http://x').searchParams.get('name') ?? '';
  if (!/^SP-[A-Za-z0-9-]+(\.dark)?$/.test(name)) { res.statusCode = 400; return res.end('bad name'); }
  let body = ''; req.on('data', (c) => (body += c)); req.on('end', () => {
    writeFileSync(join(dir, `${name}.html`), `<!doctype html>\n${body}`); res.end('ok'); console.log('wrote', name);
  });
}).listen(8977, () => console.log('listening on :8977'));
```

### Task 5: The pixel runner, the 80-screen registry, the allow-list and the CI job

**Model:** opus · **Review:** opus

The harness now runs end to end: seed the world, render each reference and the app in the same
Chromium at the artboard size, compare, report. It runs against today's app, so almost every screen
fails; those failures are recorded in `expected-failures.ts`. That file is a ratchet: an allow-listed
screen that passes fails the run ("remove it from expected-failures.ts"), so the list can only shrink,
and each screen task deletes its own keys. The CI job enforces from day one.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/screens.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/app.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/pixel.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/expected-failures.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/playwright.pixel.config.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/screens.test.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/scripts/pixel/record-expected-failures.mjs`
- Create: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/references.lock`, `apps/web/scripts/pixel/lock-references.mjs`, `apps/web/scripts/pixel/check-lock-change.mjs`, `apps/web/e2e/pixel/references-lock.test.ts`
- Modify: `apps/web/package.json` (scripts `test:pixel`, `test:pixel:report`)
- Modify: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (job `pixel`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 3 (`seedWorld`, `FIXTURE_TENANT`, `FIXTURE_USER`, `NOW`, `data-ready`), Task 4 (`resolveReference`, `renderReference`, `compare`, `resolveMasks`, `record`, `writeReport`, `MANIFEST`).
- Produces: `type Vibe`, `type Theme`, `interface Part { name: string; ref: string; app: string }`, `interface Screen` (below), `SCREENS: Screen[]` (80, one per artboard), `SHELL_CHECKS: Screen[]` (8: `SP-Board-<V>#shell`, `SP-Phone-Board-<V>#shell`; their `parts` are filled by Tasks 11–13), `screenKey(s: Screen, theme: Theme): string` (`` `${artboard}·${theme}` ``, shell checks `` `${artboard}#shell·${theme}` ``), `EXPECTED_FAILURES: ReadonlySet<string>`, `renderApp(browser, screen, theme): Promise<{ shots: Buffer[]; masks: Mask[] }>`, `DEFAULT_CLOCK = '2026-10-11T08:21:00.000Z'`.
- Produces: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/references.lock` (hashes of every reference HTML, `manifest.json` and `CORRECTIONS.md`; the comparison thresholds; the `MASK_IDS` keys; the allow-list as recorded), its updater `node apps/web/scripts/pixel/lock-references.mjs` and the CI guard `node apps/web/scripts/pixel/check-lock-change.mjs <base>`. A task may run the updater only when its stated purpose includes changing a reference, the manifest, a threshold, a mask id or adding to the allow-list, and its commit then carries the trailer `Reference-Change: <why>`.

```ts
      steps: async (p) => { await p.getByRole('button', { name: /Change board/ }).first().click(); await blur(p); } },
    { artboard: `SP-Dlg-Reconnect-${V}`, vibe: v, route: C4605, strength: off(v), parts: dialog },
  ];
}

export const SCREENS: Screen[] = [];
export const SHELL_CHECKS: Screen[] = [];
for (const [v, V] of VIBES) {
  SCREENS.push(...forVibe(v, V, (a) => MANIFEST[a]?.h ?? 4000));
  SHELL_CHECKS.push(
    { artboard: `SP-Board-${V}`, vibe: v, route: v === 'quiet' ? '/b/brd_f47143722126442c' : DX, strength: off(v), parts: [], masks: [LIVE] },
    { artboard: `SP-Phone-Board-${V}`, vibe: v, route: DX, strength: off(v), parts: [], masks: [LIVE] },
  );
}

export const screenKey = (s: Screen, theme: Theme): string =>
  `${s.artboard}${SHELL_CHECKS.includes(s) ? '#shell' : ''}·${theme}`;
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `app.ts` (the app renderer)**

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/app.ts
import type { Browser, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MANIFEST, waitForFonts } from './reference';
import { masksForPart, resolveMasks, type Mask } from './masks';
import { FIXTURE_TENANT, FIXTURE_USER } from './fixture/seed';
import { DEFAULT_CLOCK, type Screen, type Theme } from './screens';

const STABILISE = '*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;caret-color:transparent!important}::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}';

export async function renderApp(browser: Browser, screen: Screen, theme: Theme): Promise<{ shots: Buffer[]; masks: Mask[]; partMasks: Mask[][] }> {
  const { w, h } = MANIFEST[screen.artboard]!;
  const strength = screen.strength ?? (screen.vibe === 'quiet' ? 'off' : 'strong');
  const themeWord = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : screen.lightTheme ?? 'light';
  const context = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: w, height: Math.min(h, 1200) }, deviceScaleFactor: 1, timezoneId: 'Asia/Kolkata', locale: 'en-GB',
    reducedMotion: 'reduce', colorScheme: theme, baseURL: 'http://localhost:5173',
  });
  await context.addCookies([{ name: 'vk_appearance', value: `${screen.vibe}.${themeWord}.${strength}.0`, url: 'http://localhost:5173' }]);
  const boardId = /\/b\/([^/?]+)/.exec(screen.route)?.[1] ?? 'brd_134a0ddb6d434478';
  await context.addInitScript(([t, u, b]) => {
    localStorage.setItem('superpipeline.devTenant', t);
    localStorage.setItem('superpipeline.devUser', u);
    localStorage.setItem('superpipeline.boardId', b);
  }, [FIXTURE_TENANT, FIXTURE_USER, boardId] as const);
  const page: Page = await context.newPage();
  const clock = new Date(screen.clock ?? DEFAULT_CLOCK);
  await page.clock.install({ time: clock });
  await page.clock.pauseAt(clock);
  for (const glob of screen.hold ?? []) await page.route(glob, () => new Promise<void>(() => {}));
  for (const [glob, r] of Object.entries(screen.fulfil ?? {})) await page.route(glob, (route) => route.fulfill({ status: r.status, json: r.json }));
  await page.route('https://hub.agentpod.dev/**', (r) => r.abort());
  await page.route('https://app.superlibrary.dev/**', (r) => r.abort());
  try {
    await page.goto(screen.route);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true', undefined, { timeout: 20_000 });
    // The Live indicator is part of the shell: wait until the feed says it is connected.
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-live]') || !!document.querySelector('[data-live="on"]'), undefined, { timeout: 10_000 });
    await waitForFonts(page);
    if (screen.steps) { await screen.steps(page); await page.clock.runFor(1000); }
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: STABILISE });
    await page.evaluate(() => new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))));
    const masks = await resolveMasks(page, screen.masks ?? [], 'app');
    if (screen.parts?.length) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: w, height: h });
      const shots: Buffer[] = [];
      const partMasks: Mask[][] = [];
      for (const p of screen.parts) {
        const el = page.locator(p.app).first();
        const box = await el.evaluate((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + scrollX, y: r.top + scrollY, width: r.width, height: r.height }; });
        shots.push(await el.screenshot({ animations: 'disabled' }));
        partMasks.push(masksForPart(masks, box));
      }
      return { shots, masks: [], partMasks };
    }
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: w, height: h });
    return { shots: [await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled' })], masks, partMasks: [] };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

(The viewport starts at most 1200 tall so `vh`-sized layouts behave as on a screen; the full-page
shot is taken after resizing to the artboard height, which is what the references were exported at.
`hold`ed requests keep `data-ready` false by design, so for screens with `hold` the app's own loading
UI must still set `data-ready` once the held part is the only thing pending — Tasks 20/32 do that via
`app.markBusy` excluding the held fetches.)

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `pixel.spec.ts` and `expected-failures.ts`**

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/pixel.spec.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { SCREENS, SHELL_CHECKS, screenKey, type Screen, type Theme } from './screens';
import { MANIFEST, renderReference, resolveReference } from './reference';
import { renderApp } from './app';
import { compare, type Result } from './compare';
import { record, writeReport } from './report';
import { seedWorld } from './fixture/seed';
import { EXPECTED_FAILURES } from './expected-failures';

const THEMES: Theme[] = ['light', 'dark'];
let dirty = false;
test.afterAll(() => writeReport());

for (const screen of [...SCREENS, ...SHELL_CHECKS] as Screen[]) {
  if (!MANIFEST[screen.artboard]) throw new Error(`not in manifest: ${screen.artboard}`);
  for (const theme of THEMES) {
    const key = screenKey(screen, theme);
    test(key, async ({ page, request, browser }) => {
      await seedWorld(request, { force: dirty });
      dirty = !!screen.writes;
      const src = resolveReference(screen.artboard, theme);
      if (!src) throw new Error(`no reference for ${screen.artboard}`);
      const ref = await renderReference(page, src, screen.artboard, { parts: screen.parts, masks: screen.masks, refPatch: screen.refPatch });
      const app = await renderApp(browser, screen, theme);
      const results: Result[] = ref.shots.map((r, i) => compare(r, app.shots[i]!, screen.parts?.length ? [...(ref.partMasks[i] ?? []), ...(app.partMasks[i] ?? [])] : [...ref.masks, ...app.masks]));
      const worst = results.find((r) => r.status === 'fail') ?? results.find((r) => r.status === 'warn') ?? results[0]!;
      const allowed = EXPECTED_FAILURES.has(key);
      record({ artboard: screen.artboard + (SHELL_CHECKS.includes(screen) ? '#shell' : ''), vibe: screen.vibe, theme,
        status: worst.status === 'fail' && allowed ? 'expected-fail' : worst.status, ratio: worst.ratio, brokenBlocks: worst.brokenBlocks,
        sizeMismatch: worst.sizeMismatch, masks: (screen.masks ?? []).map((m) => m.id) }, worst);
      const failed = results.some((r) => r.status === 'fail');
      if (allowed) expect(failed, `${key} passes now: remove it from apps/web/e2e/pixel/expected-failures.ts`).toBe(true);
      else expect(failed, `${key}: ratio ${(worst.ratio * 100).toFixed(3)}%, ${worst.brokenBlocks} broken blocks${worst.sizeMismatch ? `, size ${worst.sizeMismatch.ref.join('×')} vs ${worst.sizeMismatch.app.join('×')}` : ''} (report: test-results/pixel/index.html)`).toBe(false);
    });
  }
}
```

```js
const rows = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../../test-results/pixel/results.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
const keys = rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'fail' || r.status === 'expected-fail').map((r) => `${r.artboard}·${r.theme}`).sort();
writeFileSync(new URL('../../e2e/pixel/expected-failures.ts', import.meta.url),
`/**
 * Screens that do not match their reference yet. A ratchet: an entry that starts passing fails the
 * run until it is deleted here. Each screen task deletes its own keys; Task 41 deletes this file.
 */
export const EXPECTED_FAILURES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
${keys.map((k) => `  '${k}',`).join('\n')}
]);
`);
console.log(`${keys.length} expected failures written`);
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/references-lock.test.ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { BLOCK, BLOCK_BREAK, MAX_RATIO, PIXEL_THRESHOLD, WARN_RATIO } from './compare';
import { MASK_IDS } from './masks';
import { REF_DIR } from './reference';

const lock = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'references.lock'), 'utf8')) as {
  files: Record<string, string>; thresholds: Record<string, number>; maskIds: string[]; allowList: string[];
};
const sha = (p: string) => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(p)).digest('hex');

describe('references.lock — references, thresholds and masks change only on purpose', () => {
  it('every reference file, the manifest and CORRECTIONS.md hash as locked', () => {
    const now = Object.fromEntries(readdirSync(REF_DIR).filter((f) => /\.(html|json|md)$/.test(f)).sort().map((f) => [f, sha(join(REF_DIR, f))]));
    expect(now, 'a reference changed: fix the app instead, or (only in a task whose purpose is a reference change) run scripts/pixel/lock-references.mjs').toEqual(lock.files);
  });
  it('the comparison thresholds are the locked ones', () => {
    expect({ PIXEL_THRESHOLD, MAX_RATIO, WARN_RATIO, BLOCK, BLOCK_BREAK }).toEqual(lock.thresholds);
  });
  it('the mask ids are the locked ones', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(MASK_IDS).sort()).toEqual(lock.maskIds);
  });
  it('the allow-list only shrinks', async () => {
    const mod = await import('./expected-failures').catch(() => null);
    const keys = mod ? [...mod.EXPECTED_FAILURES] : [];
    for (const k of keys) expect(lock.allowList, `${k} was added to the allow-list`).toContain(k);
  });
});
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/lock-references.mjs — rewrite references.lock from the working tree.
// Run ONLY in a task whose stated purpose is to change a reference, the manifest, CORRECTIONS.md, a
// threshold, a mask id or to grow the allow-list; that commit carries a `Reference-Change: <why>` trailer.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const here = new URL('../../e2e/pixel/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const refDir = join(here, '../reference/mockups');
const sha = (p) => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(p)).digest('hex');
const files = Object.fromEntries(readdirSync(refDir).filter((f) => /\.(html|json|md)$/.test(f)).sort().map((f) => [f, sha(join(refDir, f))]));
const num = (name) => Number(new RegExp(`export const ${name} = ([0-9.]+)`).exec(readFileSync(join(here, 'compare.ts'), 'utf8'))[1]);
const thresholds = Object.fromEntries(['PIXEL_THRESHOLD', 'MAX_RATIO', 'WARN_RATIO', 'BLOCK', 'BLOCK_BREAK'].map((n) => [n, num(n)]));
const maskIds = [...readFileSync(join(here, 'masks.ts'), 'utf8').matchAll(/^  '([^']+)':/gm)].map((m) => m[1]).sort();
const ef = join(here, 'expected-failures.ts');
const allowList = existsSync(ef) ? [...readFileSync(ef, 'utf8').matchAll(/^  '([^']+)',/gm)].map((m) => m[1]).sort() : [];
writeFileSync(join(here, 'references.lock'), JSON.stringify({ files, thresholds, maskIds, allowList }, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(`locked ${Object.keys(files).length} files, ${maskIds.length} mask ids, ${allowList.length} allow-listed`);
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/check-lock-change.mjs <base> — CI: references.lock may change only in a
// range whose commits say why (`Reference-Change:` trailer). Pairs with references-lock.test.ts, which
// fails when a protected file changes without the lock.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
const base = process.argv[2] ?? 'origin/main';
const git = (...a) => execFileSync('git', a, { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
const changed = git('diff', '--name-only', `${base}...HEAD`).split('\n');
if (!changed.includes('apps/web/e2e/pixel/references.lock')) process.exit(0);
const bodies = git('log', '--format=%B%x00', `${base}..HEAD`);
if (/^Reference-Change: .+/m.test(bodies)) { console.log('references.lock changed with a stated reason'); process.exit(0); }
console.error('references.lock changed but no commit in the range carries a "Reference-Change: <why>" trailer.\n' +
  'Fix the app to match the reference; references, thresholds and masks change only in tasks whose purpose is to change them.');
process.exit(1);
```

### Task 6: API — what a card says about who last worked it, who granted it, and why it stopped

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Every "(b) add an API field" ruling about cards lands here, with its fixture rows: `lastAgentId`
(shell-and-board G2 / operate-list-pages LI-G3: the agent of the card's most recent run, because
`delegateAgentId` is null on a stopped card), `queuedGrantOwner` (card API-3: whose dispatch grant the
queue ran on), `stageSince` (card API-6: when the card entered its current stage), and the agent-written
stop summary `needsHuman.summary` (shell-and-board G3; written by the block verb). The web `Card`,
`NeedsHuman` and `Attempt` types catch up with fields the API already serves (`createdAt`, attempt
`startedAt`/`endedAt`/`completion`, card API-7/API-8).

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/api/src/board/board-do.ts` (`CardNeedsHuman.summary`, `CardView` + `rowToCard` + `allCards` batch, `cards.queued_grant_owner` and `cards.stage_since` columns + trigger, `createCard`/move record `queued_grant_owner`, `block` stores `summary`)
- Modify: `apps/api/src/mcp/tools.ts` (`superpipeline_block` optional `summary`), `apps/api/src/index.ts` (REST run action `block` passes `summary`; card create/move pass the grant owner)
- Modify: `packages/contract/src/entities.ts` (`Card`: `lastAgentId`, `queuedGrantOwner`, `stageSince` optional/nullable)
- Modify: `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts` (`Card`, `NeedsHuman`, `Attempt` types)
- Modify: `apps/web/e2e/pixel/fixture/world.ts` (fixture rows for the new columns)
- Test: `apps/api/test/card-provenance-fields.test.ts`, `packages/contract/test/entities.test.ts` (extend)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces (API JSON on every card in `GET /v1/boards/:id`, `GET …/cards/:id`, PATCH responses, `/v1/stale` rows): `lastAgentId: string | null`, `queuedGrantOwner: string | null`, `stageSince: string`, `needsHuman?: { reason; detail?; failureCount?; elicitationId?; summary?: string }`.
- Produces (web types): `Card.lastAgentId`, `Card.queuedGrantOwner`, `Card.stageSince`, `Card.createdAt: string`, `NeedsHuman.summary?: string`, `Attempt.startedAt: string`, `Attempt.endedAt: string | null`, `Attempt.completion: { ok?: boolean; missing?: string[] } | null`.
- Produces (MCP/REST): `superpipeline_block { …, summary?: string }` (≤ 120 chars), REST `POST …/runs/:runId/block { reason, summary? }`.

```ts
// apps/api/test/card-provenance-fields.test.ts
import { env, runInDurableObject } from 'cloudflare:test';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { BoardDO, BoardInit } from '../src/board/board-do';

const STAGES: BoardInit['stages'] = [
  { key: 'reported', name: 'Reported', order: 0, ownerKind: 'human' },
  { key: 'reproduce', name: 'Reproduce', order: 1, ownerKind: 'capability', owner: 'diagnostics' },
];
const stub = (n: string) => env.BOARD_DO.get(env.BOARD_DO.idFromName(n)) as unknown as DurableObjectStub<BoardDO>;

describe('card provenance fields', () => {
  it('lastAgentId is the agent of the most recent run, and survives the run ending', async () => {
    await runInDurableObject(stub('prov-1'), async (b: BoardDO) => {
      await b.init({ id: 'brd_p', tenantId: 'tnt_p', name: 'P', stages: STAGES });
      const c = await b.createCard({ title: 'T', ownerUserId: 'usr_p' });
      if (!c.ok) throw new Error('card');
      expect((await b.getCardView(c.value.id)).ok && (await b.getCardView(c.value.id) as { value: { lastAgentId: unknown } }).value.lastAgentId).toBeNull();
      await b.moveCard({ cardId: c.value.id, toStageKey: 'reproduce', movedBy: 'usr_p' });
      const claim = await b.claimNext({ agentId: 'agt_eric', capabilities: ['diagnostics'] });
      if (!claim.ok || !claim.value) throw new Error('claim');
      await b.block({ runId: claim.value.runId, leaseEpoch: claim.value.leaseEpoch, agentId: 'agt_eric', reason: 'not reproduced', summary: 'Needs one fresh DM per agent.' });
      const snap = await b.getState();
      const card = snap.cards.find((x) => x.id === c.value.id)!;
      expect(card.delegateAgentId).toBeNull();
      expect(card.lastAgentId).toBe('agt_eric');
      expect(card.needsHuman).toEqual({ reason: 'blocked', detail: 'not reproduced', summary: 'Needs one fresh DM per agent.' });
    });
  });

  it('stageSince moves on a stage change only; stateSince moves on either', async () => {
    await runInDurableObject(stub('prov-2'), async (b: BoardDO, state) => {
      await b.init({ id: 'brd_q', tenantId: 'tnt_q', name: 'Q', stages: STAGES });
      const c = await b.createCard({ title: 'T', ownerUserId: 'usr_q' });
      if (!c.ok) throw new Error('card');
      state.storage.sql.exec(`UPDATE cards SET updated_at = '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z', created_at = '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z', stage_since = '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z', state_since = '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' WHERE id = ?`, c.value.id);
      state.storage.sql.exec(`UPDATE cards SET state = 'input-required', updated_at = '2026-10-02T00:00:00Z' WHERE id = ?`, c.value.id);
      let v = (await b.getState()).cards.find((x) => x.id === c.value.id)!;
      expect(v.stateSince).toBe('2026-10-02T00:00:00Z');
      expect(v.stageSince).toBe('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z');
      state.storage.sql.exec(`UPDATE cards SET current_stage_key = 'reproduce', updated_at = '2026-10-03T00:00:00Z' WHERE id = ?`, c.value.id);
      v = (await b.getState()).cards.find((x) => x.id === c.value.id)!;
      expect(v.stageSince).toBe('2026-10-03T00:00:00Z');
    });
  });

  it('queuedGrantOwner records whose grant a queue ran on, and is null when nobody said', async () => {
```

Web `api.ts`:

```ts
export interface GateConflict { decidedBy: string; decidedAt: string; via: 'matrix' | 'web' | 'api' }
/** The 409 a gate answers when someone else decided it first — null for any other response. */
export async function parseGateConflict(res: Response): Promise<GateConflict | null> {
  if (res.status !== 409) return null;
  try {
    const e = ((await res.clone().json()) as { error?: Record<string, unknown> }).error;
    if (e?.code !== 'GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED') return null;
    const via = e.via === 'matrix' || e.via === 'web' ? e.via : 'api';
    return { decidedBy: String(e.decidedBy ?? ''), decidedAt: String(e.decidedAt ?? ''), via };
  } catch { return null; }
}
```

and `GateOption` gains `description?: string;`.

```ts
  /** Cards each agent holds on this board right now (claimed) and of those, works now (working). */
  async agentLoad(): Promise<Record<string, { claimed: number; working: number }>> {
    const out: Record<string, { claimed: number; working: number }> = {};
    for (const r of this.sql.exec(
      `SELECT delegate_agent_id AS a, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'working' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w
         FROM cards WHERE delegate_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND state NOT IN ('completed', 'rejected', 'canceled')
        GROUP BY delegate_agent_id`).toArray()) {
      out[r.a as string] = { claimed: Number(r.n), working: Number(r.w) };
    }
    return out;
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

```ts
// packages/contract/src/attention.ts
/**
 * Does this card need a person now? The one rule behind every "need you" count — the board list,
 * the switcher, the shell badge and the attention lists — so no two surfaces can disagree.
 */
export interface NeedsYouContext {
  stages: Array<{ key: string; ownerKind?: string; gate?: string }>;
  pendingGateCardIds: Set<string>;
  pendingQuestionCardIds: Set<string>;
  staleAfterHours: number;
  nowMs: number;
}
export function needsYou(
  card: { id?: string; state: string; archivedAt: string | null; overBudget?: boolean; currentStageKey: string; stateSince: string },
  ctx: NeedsYouContext,
): boolean {
  if (card.archivedAt) return false;
  if (card.id && (ctx.pendingGateCardIds.has(card.id) || ctx.pendingQuestionCardIds.has(card.id))) return true;
  if (card.state === 'input-required' || card.state === 'failed' || card.overBudget) return true;
  if (card.state !== 'submitted') return false;
  const stage = ctx.stages.find((s) => s.key === card.currentStageKey);
  const nobodyWorksIt = stage?.ownerKind === 'human' && stage.gate !== 'approval';
  const ageHours = (ctx.nowMs - Date.parse(card.stateSince)) / 3_600_000;
  return nobodyWorksIt && ageHours >= ctx.staleAfterHours;
}
```

Web `itemsFromBoard`: decide inclusion with `needsYou(c, ctx)` built from the snapshot (`pendingGateCardIds` from `board.gates`, questions from `board.elicitations`, `staleAfterHours` from `board.stale.afterHours`), then build the item exactly as today. `attention.test.ts` keeps passing unchanged — if a case changes, the shared rule is wrong, not the test.

DO RPC: `async summaryCounts(): Promise<{ cardCount: number; needsYouCount: number }>` — builds the context from its own stages/gates/elicitations/stale settings and `Date.now()`, counts non-archived cards and `needsYou`. `GET /v1/boards`: fan out with `Promise.allSettled`, `{ id, name, cardCount, needsYouCount, lastActivityAt: updated_at }`, zeros for a board that did not answer. `listBoards` returns `updated_at`. Every card create/move/patch/archive route calls `touchBoard(env.DB, tenantId, boardId, new Date().toISOString())` after a successful DO write (one `UPDATE boards SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?`).

`POST …/cards`: accept `stageKey` (must be one of the board's stage keys, else `400 { error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_STAGE' } }`), `labelIds` (each must be a tenant label, else `UNKNOWN_LABEL`), `projectId` (string or null); the DO `createCard` input gains `stageKey?`, `labels?`, `projectId?` (it already writes `project_id`; it writes `current_stage_key = stageKey ?? first stage` and `labels`).

Web: `BoardSummary` gains the three fields; `createCard(boardId, body)` forwards them; `app.dispatchCard` passes them through (callers unchanged).
