```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/words.ts
/**
 * Words for numbers and lists, shared by every screen. Pure, so each sentence a screen builds
 * from them is unit-tested with the fixture's values.
 */
export const NUM_WORDS = ['no', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine', 'ten'] as const;

/** 'no', 'one' … 'ten'; digits past ten. `cap` upper-cases the first letter. */
export function numWord(n: number, cap = false): string {
  const w = Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 10 ? NUM_WORDS[n]! : String(n);
  return cap ? w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1) : w;
}

/** `1 card`, `7 cards`. */
export function plural(n: number, one: string, many: string): string {
  return `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
}

/** Phones show an agent's words as a sentence: first letter up, an end mark added when missing. */
export function sentenceCase(s: string): string {
  const t = s.trim();
  if (t === '') return t;
  const up = t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
  return /[.!?…]$/.test(up) ? up : `${up}.`;
}

const MIN_FIRST = 40;
/** Index of the first ". " at or past character 40, or -1. */
function firstBoundary(s: string): number {
  let i = s.indexOf('. ');
  while (i !== -1 && i < MIN_FIRST) i = s.indexOf('. ', i + 1);
  return i;
}

/** The text up to and including its first full stop past forty characters; all of it when there is none. */
export function firstSentence(s: string): string {
  const i = firstBoundary(s);
  return i === -1 ? s : s.slice(0, i + 1);
}

/** What `firstSentence` left out, or null. */
export function remainder(s: string): string | null {
  const i = firstBoundary(s);
  if (i === -1) return null;
  const rest = s.slice(i + 2).trim();
  return rest === '' ? null : rest;
}

export function lcFirst(s: string): string {
  return s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1);
}

/** "a", "a and b", "a, b and c". */
export function joinAnd(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length === 0) return '';
  if (names.length === 1) return names[0]!;
  return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${names[names.length - 1]}`;
}
```

```ts
import { plural } from './words';

/** Long age: `under an hour`, `1 hour`, `33 hours` below two days, then `2 days`. */
export function ageWords(hours: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || hours < 1) return 'under an hour';
  if (hours < 48) return plural(Math.floor(hours), 'hour', 'hours');
  return plural(Math.floor(hours / 24), 'day', 'days');
}

/** `ageWords`, or a dash when the age is unknown. */
export function ageLong(hours: number | null): string {
  return hours === null ? '—' : ageWords(hours);
}

/** Tile age: open `33h` / `2d`; a done card counts whole days, at least `1d`; unknown is a dash. */
export function ageShort(hours: number | null, done = false): string {
  if (hours === null || !Number.isFinite(hours)) return '—';
  if (done) return `${Math.max(1, Math.floor(hours / 24))}d`;
  if (hours < 1) return 'just now';
  if (hours < 48) return `${Math.floor(hours)}h`;
  return `${Math.floor(hours / 24)}d`;
}

/**
 * Past tense. Open cards count hours below two days ("33 hours ago"), as `ageWords` does; a done
 * card finished between one and two days ago says "yesterday".
 */
export function agoWords(hours: number | null, done = false): string {
  if (hours === null || !Number.isFinite(hours)) return '—';
  if (hours < 1) return 'just now';
  if (hours < 24) return `${plural(Math.floor(hours), 'hour', 'hours')} ago`;
  if (hours < 48 && !done) return `${Math.floor(hours)} hours ago`;
  const d = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return d === 1 ? 'yesterday' : `${d} days ago`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/viewport.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

type Listener = (e: { matches: boolean }) => void;
function stubMatchMedia(matching: Record<string, boolean>) {
  const listeners = new Map<string, Listener[]>();
  window.matchMedia = vi.fn((query: string) => ({
    matches: matching[query] ?? false,
    media: query,
    addEventListener: (_: string, fn: Listener) => listeners.set(query, [...(listeners.get(query) ?? []), fn]),
    removeEventListener: () => {},
  })) as never;
  return (query: string, matches: boolean) => listeners.get(query)?.forEach((fn) => fn({ matches }));
}

afterEach(() => vi.resetModules());

describe('viewport', () => {
  it('reads the phone and narrow breakpoints and follows changes', async () => {
    const fire = stubMatchMedia({ '(max-width: 899.98px)': true, '(max-width: 639.98px)': false });
    const { viewport, PHONE_QUERY, NARROW_QUERY } = await import('./viewport.svelte');
    expect([PHONE_QUERY, NARROW_QUERY]).toEqual(['(max-width: 899.98px)', '(max-width: 639.98px)']);
    expect(viewport.phone).toBe(true);
    expect(viewport.narrow).toBe(false);
    fire(NARROW_QUERY, true);
    fire(PHONE_QUERY, false);
    expect(viewport.narrow).toBe(true);
    expect(viewport.phone).toBe(false);
  });
  it('is desktop when matchMedia is missing', async () => {
    // @ts-expect-error jsdom without matchMedia
    delete window.matchMedia;
    const { viewport } = await import('./viewport.svelte');
    expect(viewport.phone).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/viewport.svelte.ts
/**
 * The two widths that change layout. Below 900px the shell and the board use their phone forms;
 * below 640px the card does. vibekit's own AppShell breaks at 640px for everything; Superpipeline
 * keeps 900 for the shell (shell-and-board X-6), so the two are named apart.
 */
export const PHONE_QUERY = '(max-width: 899.98px)';
export const NARROW_QUERY = '(max-width: 639.98px)';

function watch(query: string, set: (matches: boolean) => void): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return;
  const mq = window.matchMedia(query);
  set(mq.matches);
  mq.addEventListener('change', (e) => set(e.matches));
}

class ViewportStore {
  phone = $state(false);
  narrow = $state(false);
  constructor() {
    watch(PHONE_QUERY, (m) => (this.phone = m));
    watch(NARROW_QUERY, (m) => (this.narrow = m));
  }
}

export const viewport = new ViewportStore();
```

```ts
/** The filter shape `AppStore.filters` holds (`CardFilters` in app.svelte.ts). */
export interface FilterShape {
  states: string[];
  owners: string[];
  minPriority: number | null;
  needsReview: boolean;
  live: boolean;
  overBudget: boolean;
  labels: string[];
  showArchived: boolean;
  projectId: string | null;
}

export function noFilters(): FilterShape {
  return { states: [], owners: [], minPriority: null, needsReview: false, live: false, overBudget: false, labels: [], showArchived: false, projectId: null };
}

/** How many filters are on, each counted once: the "Filter cards · none on / 2 on" figure. */
export function activeFilterCount(f: FilterShape): number {
  return [
    f.states.length > 0, f.owners.length > 0, f.minPriority !== null, f.needsReview, f.live, f.overBudget,
    f.labels.length > 0, f.showArchived, f.projectId !== null,
  ].filter(Boolean).length;
}
```

```ts
  /** Read the workspace's attention now. A failed read keeps the last answer. */
  async loadAttention(): Promise<void> {
    this.#attentionLoadedAt = Date.now();
    try {
      this.attention = (await listAttention()).cards;
    } catch {
      /* best-effort: a count that is a little stale beats one that vanishes */
    }
  }

  /**
   * Load the attention now when the last load is over a second old, otherwise once, a second
   * after it. A burst of feed events costs two reads, not one per event.
   */
  scheduleAttention(): Promise<void> | void {
    const wait = this.#attentionLoadedAt + ATTENTION_COALESCE_MS - Date.now();
    if (wait <= 0) return this.loadAttention();
    if (this.#attentionTimer !== undefined) return;
    this.#attentionTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.#attentionTimer = undefined;
      void this.loadAttention();
    }, wait);
  }
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/shortcuts.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { CHORD_MS, createChordReader, isTypingTarget } from './shortcuts';

const k = (key: string, mods: Partial<{ metaKey: boolean; ctrlKey: boolean; altKey: boolean }> = {}) => ({ key, metaKey: false, ctrlKey: false, altKey: false, ...mods });

describe('shell shortcuts', () => {
  it('G then P, O or W within a second goes to Plan, Operate or Workspace', () => {
    const r = createChordReader();
    expect(r.read(k('g'), 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.read(k('o'), 400)).toBe('operate');
    expect(r.read(k('g'), 1000)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.read(k('P'), 1000 + CHORD_MS)).toBe('plan');
    expect(r.read(k('g'), 5000)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.read(k('w'), 5100)).toBe('workspace');
  });
  it('a late second key is a key of its own', () => {
    const r = createChordReader();
    r.read(k('g'), 0);
    expect(r.read(k('p'), CHORD_MS + 1)).toBeNull();
    r.read(k('g'), 10_000);
    expect(r.read(k('n'), 10_000 + CHORD_MS + 1)).toBe('compose');
  });
  it('N composes and F filters; modifiers never fire anything', () => {
    const r = createChordReader();
    expect(r.read(k('n'), 0)).toBe('compose');
    expect(r.read(k('f'), 0)).toBe('filter');
    expect(r.read(k('n', { metaKey: true }), 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.read(k('f', { ctrlKey: true }), 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.read(k('n', { altKey: true }), 0)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('typing in a field is never a shortcut; a read-only field or a checkbox is not typing', () => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    const ro = Object.assign(document.createElement('input'), { readOnly: true });
    const box = Object.assign(document.createElement('input'), { type: 'checkbox' });
    const area = document.createElement('textarea');
    const editable = document.createElement('div');
    editable.contentEditable = 'true';
    document.body.append(editable);
    expect([isTypingTarget(input), isTypingTarget(area), isTypingTarget(editable)]).toEqual([true, true, true]);
    expect([isTypingTarget(ro), isTypingTarget(box), isTypingTarget(document.body), isTypingTarget(null)]).toEqual([false, false, false, false]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/types.ts
import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';

export type ShellHere = 'plan' | 'operate' | 'workspace';
/** The Studio eyebrow word: "Superpipeline · board". */
export type ShellSection = 'board' | 'list' | 'projects' | 'operate' | 'card' | 'workspace' | 'settings' | 'spend';
export type ShellView = 'board' | 'list' | 'projects';

export interface ShellProps {
  here: ShellHere;
  section: ShellSection;
  /** Board-scoped pages pass the board name; workspace pages pass null (no switcher). */
  boardName: string | null;
  /** Plan pages pass the active view; every other page passes null: no view switch, no Filter. */
  view: ShellView | null;
  /** The sub-bar note, verbatim ("Showing all 7 cards"). null hides it. */
  showing: string | null;
  /** Paper's masthead note ("Showing all 7 cards · 4 wait on you · 1 shipped"). */
  paperShowing?: string;
  /** Paper phone dateline suffix ("7 cards"). */
  editionCount?: string;
  /** Studio sub-bar right text ("The board at 13:51 · midday · Sunday 11 October"). */
  studioSubRight?: string | null;
  /** Studio status line; null or absent hides the footer. */
  status?: ShellStatus | null;
  /** Page tools drawn in the sub-bar right after the Filter control (Task 31's List puts Group by there). */
  subTools?: Snippet;
  /** Daylight: drawn inside the sky under the sub-bar (the board's greeting band). */
  sky?: Snippet;
  children: Snippet;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/shell-words.ts
/**
 * Every global value a shell prints, as pure functions of plain data. `shellModel` feeds them the
 * store; the tests feed them the fixture world. Times read in the browser's zone unless a test
 * passes one (the harness runs in Asia/Kolkata, so 08:21Z prints 13:51).
 */
import { greeting, type Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { Card, User } from '$lib/api';
import { plural } from '$lib/words';

export interface StatusItem { text: string; signal?: boolean }
export interface ShellStatus { items: StatusItem[]; right: string[] }
export const STATUS_RIGHT: readonly string[] = ['⌘K commands', 'N new card'];
export const PROJECTS_NOTE = 'Projects group cards across boards. Filters don’t apply here.';
export const PAPER_PHASE: Record<Phase, string> = {
  dawn: 'at first light', morning: 'in the morning light', noon: 'in full daylight', golden: 'in the golden hour', dusk: 'at dusk', night: 'after dark',
};

export const TERMINAL_STATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['completed', 'canceled', 'rejected']);
export const isTerminal = (c: Pick<Card, 'state'>): boolean => TERMINAL_STATES.has(c.state);

const dayMonth = (d: Date, timeZone?: string) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', timeZone }).format(d);
export const hhmm = (d: Date, timeZone?: string) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23', timeZone }).format(d);

/** Paper's dateline: "Sunday 11 October · in full daylight". */
export function dateline(now: Date, phase: Phase, timeZone?: string): string {
  return `${dayMonth(now, timeZone)} · ${PAPER_PHASE[phase]}`;
}

export function userNameOf(user: Pick<User, 'name' | 'login'> | null | undefined): string {
  return user?.name?.trim() || user?.login?.trim() || 'You';
}
export function initialsOf(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase()).join('') || '·';
}
export function firstNameOf(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? '';
}

export function filterSummary(active: number): string {
  return active === 0 ? 'none on' : `${active} on`;
}

export function showingLine(shown: number, total: number, filtersOn: boolean): string {
  if (!filtersOn) {
    if (total === 0) return 'No cards on this board';
    return total === 1 ? 'Showing the only card' : `Showing all ${total} cards`;
  }
  return `Showing ${shown} of ${plural(total, 'card', 'cards')}`;
}

export function paperShowingLine(showing: string, needs: number, shipped: number): string {
  return [showing, needs > 0 ? `${needs} wait on you` : null, shipped > 0 ? `${shipped} shipped` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
}

export function studioSubRight(syncedAt: Date | null, phase: Phase, timeZone?: string): string | null {
  if (!syncedAt) return null;
  return `The board at ${hhmm(syncedAt, timeZone)} · ${greeting(phase, 'studio').toLowerCase()} · ${dayMonth(syncedAt, timeZone)}`;
}

/** Each vibe's rendering of the Operate count; null when nothing needs you (no count, no colour). */
export interface OperateCount { n: string; comma: string; paren: string; needYou: string; aria: string; tip: string; quiet: string }
export function operateCount(n: number): OperateCount | null {
  if (n <= 0) return null;
  return { n: String(n), comma: `, ${n} need you`, paren: `(${n})`, needYou: ' need you', aria: `Operate, ${n} need you`, tip: `Operate · ${n} need you`, quiet: `(${n} need you)` };
}

export function needsPart(n: number): StatusItem | null {
  return n > 0 ? { text: `${n} need you`, signal: true } : null;
}

/** A Studio status line: the page's items, then "synced HH:MM"; the keys on the right. */
export function statusLine(lead: ReadonlyArray<string | StatusItem | null>, syncedAt: Date | null, opts: { right?: readonly string[]; timeZone?: string } = {}): ShellStatus {
  const items = lead.filter((x): x is string | StatusItem => x !== null).map((x) => (typeof x === 'string' ? { text: x } : x));
  if (syncedAt) items.push({ text: `synced ${hhmm(syncedAt, opts.timeZone)}` });
  return { items, right: [...(opts.right ?? STATUS_RIGHT)] };
}

export interface BoardCounts { all: number; needs: number; blocked: number; shipped: number }
/** Non-archived cards; blocked = not waiting on you, not finished, held by an open blocker. */
export function boardCounts(cards: readonly Card[], needIds: ReadonlySet<string>): BoardCounts {
  const live = cards.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt);
  return {
    all: live.length,
    needs: live.filter((c) => needIds.has(c.id)).length,
    blocked: live.filter((c) => !needIds.has(c.id) && !isTerminal(c) && c.blockedBy.length > 0).length,
    shipped: live.filter((c) => c.state === 'completed').length,
  };
}
export function boardStatus(c: BoardCounts, syncedAt: Date | null, timeZone?: string): ShellStatus {
  return statusLine([plural(c.all, 'card', 'cards'), needsPart(c.needs), c.blocked > 0 ? `${c.blocked} blocked` : null, c.shipped > 0 ? `${c.shipped} shipped` : null], syncedAt, { timeZone });
}

/** Distinct projects among the board's non-archived cards (Studio "Projects 3"). */
export function projectCountOf(cards: readonly Card[]): number {
  return new Set(cards.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt && c.projectId).map((c) => c.projectId)).size;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/crew.ts
/**
 * The agents a board involves, in the order the board reads (shell-and-board §3.3): the agents of
 * cards waiting on you (`lastAgentId`, since a stopped card has no delegate), then those working,
 * then whoever queued the work. Daylight's rail draws the first three faces and counts them all.
 */
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, BoardSnapshot } from '$lib/api';
import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';
import { joinAnd, plural } from '$lib/words';
import { isTerminal } from './shell-words';

export interface CrewMember { id: string; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood; role: 'needs' | 'working' | 'queuer' }

export function crewOf(board: Pick<BoardSnapshot, 'cards'>, agents: AgentSummary[], needIds: ReadonlySet<string>): CrewMember[] {
  const live = board.cards
    .filter((c) => !c.archivedAt && !isTerminal(c))
    .sort((a, b) => Number(needIds.has(b.id)) - Number(needIds.has(a.id)) || a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
  const out = new Map<string, CrewMember>();
  const add = (id: string | null | undefined, role: CrewMember['role'], mood: Mood) => {
    if (!id || out.has(id)) return;
    out.set(id, { id, name: displayAgent(id, agents), iconUrl: agents.find((a) => a.id === id)?.iconUrl ?? null, mood, role });
  };
  for (const c of live) if (needIds.has(c.id)) add(c.lastAgentId, 'needs', 'needs');
  for (const c of live) if (c.state === 'working') add(c.delegateAgentId ?? c.lastAgentId, 'working', 'working');
  for (const c of live) add(c.queuedByAgentId, 'queuer', 'resting');
  return [...out.values()];
}

const named = (crew: CrewMember[], role: CrewMember['role']) => crew.filter((m) => m.role === role).map((m) => m.name);

export function crewCount(crew: CrewMember[]): string {
  return plural(crew.length, 'agent', 'agents');
}
export function crewLine(crew: CrewMember[]): string {
  const needs = named(crew, 'needs').length;
  if (needs > 0) return `${needs} ${needs === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} on you`;
  const working = named(crew, 'working').length;
  return working > 0 ? `${working} at work` : 'resting';
}
export function crewTitle(crew: CrewMember[]): string {
  const n = named(crew, 'needs');
  const w = named(crew, 'working');
  const q = named(crew, 'queuer');
  return [
    n.length ? `${joinAnd(n)} ${n.length === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} on you` : null,
    w.length ? `${joinAnd(w)} ${w.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} at work` : null,
    q.length ? `${joinAnd(q)} ${q.length === 1 ? 'queues' : 'queue'} the work` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join('; ');
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/shortcuts.ts
/**
 * The shell's keys: G P / G O / G W go to Plan, Operate and Workspace; N composes; F filters.
 * ⌘K stays with the command palette, which already owns it. Never while a person is typing.
 */
export type ShellAction = 'plan' | 'operate' | 'workspace' | 'compose' | 'filter';
export const CHORD_MS = 1000;

export function isTypingTarget(t: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  if (!(t instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  if (t.isContentEditable || t.contentEditable === 'true') return true;
  if (t instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || t instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return true;
  if (t instanceof HTMLInputElement) return !t.readOnly && !['button', 'checkbox', 'radio', 'submit', 'reset', 'range', 'color', 'file'].includes(t.type);
  return false;
}

export interface KeyLike { key: string; metaKey: boolean; ctrlKey: boolean; altKey: boolean }

export function createChordReader() {
  let gAt: number | null = null;
  return {
    read(e: KeyLike, now: number): ShellAction | null {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) {
        gAt = null;
        return null;
      }
      const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (gAt !== null && now - gAt <= CHORD_MS) {
        gAt = null;
        return key === 'p' ? 'plan' : key === 'o' ? 'operate' : key === 'w' ? 'workspace' : null;
      }
      gAt = null;
      if (key === 'g') {
        gAt = now;
        return null;
      }
      return key === 'n' ? 'compose' : key === 'f' ? 'filter' : null;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, render } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import Icon from './Icon.svelte';
import { ICONS, type IconName } from './icons';

afterEach(cleanup);

describe('Icon', () => {
  it('draws every registered name, hidden from assistive tech', () => {
    for (const name of Object.keys(ICONS) as IconName[]) {
      const { container } = render(Icon, { name, size: 18 });
      const svg = container.querySelector('svg')!;
      expect(svg.getAttribute('aria-hidden'), name).toBe('true');
      expect(svg.getAttribute('width'), name).toBe('18');
      expect(svg.children.length, name).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      cleanup();
    }
  });
  it('fills when asked and goes bare for the phone stylesheet', () => {
    const { container } = render(Icon, { name: 'plan', filled: true });
    expect(container.querySelector('svg')!.getAttribute('fill')).toBe('currentColor');
    cleanup();
    const bare = render(Icon, { name: 'plan-phone', bare: true });
    const svg = bare.container.querySelector('svg')!;
    expect(svg.getAttribute('class')).toBe('ico');
    expect(svg.hasAttribute('width')).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/shell-model.svelte.ts
/**
 * Every global value a shell shows, as reactive getters over the store and the appearance, and the
 * actions every shell's controls call. Shells read this; pages pass only what is theirs
 * (`ShellProps`).
 */
import type { Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
import { activeFilterCount } from '$lib/stores/card-filters';
import { plural } from '$lib/words';
import { signOut } from './account';
import { crewCount, crewLine, crewOf, crewTitle, type CrewMember } from './crew';
import {
  boardCounts, boardStatus, dateline, filterSummary, firstNameOf, initialsOf, operateCount, paperShowingLine, projectCountOf,
  showingLine, statusLine, studioSubRight, userNameOf, type OperateCount, type ShellStatus, type StatusItem,
} from './shell-words';
import type { ShellView } from './types';

const liveCards = () => (app.board?.cards ?? []).filter((c) => !c.archivedAt);
const needIds = () => new Set(app.needsYou().map((i) => i.cardId));

export const shellModel = {
  get attentionCount(): number { return app.attention.length; },
  get operateCount(): OperateCount | null { return operateCount(app.attention.length); },
  get connected(): boolean { return app.connected; },
  get userName(): string { return userNameOf(app.user); },
  get initials(): string { return initialsOf(userNameOf(app.user)); },
  get firstName(): string { return firstNameOf(userNameOf(app.user)); },
  get crew(): CrewMember[] { return app.board ? crewOf(app.board, app.agents, needIds()) : []; },
  get crewCount(): string { return crewCount(this.crew); },
  get crewLine(): string { return crewLine(this.crew); },
  get crewTitle(): string { return crewTitle(this.crew); },
  get dark(): boolean { return appearance.theme === 'dark'; },
  get phase(): Phase { return appearance.phase; },
  get dateline(): string { return dateline(new Date(), appearance.phase); },
  /** This board's cards waiting on a person. */
  get needsCount(): number { return app.needsYou().length; },
  /** This board's non-archived cards. */
  get liveCount(): number { return liveCards().length; },
  /** Non-archived cards the filters let through (Studio "List 7"). */
  get listCount(): number { return app.filteredCards().filter((c) => !c.archivedAt).length; },
  get projectCount(): number { return projectCountOf(liveCards()); },
  get filterSummary(): string { return filterSummary(activeFilterCount(app.filters)); },
  get showing(): string { return showingLine(this.listCount, this.liveCount, activeFilterCount(app.filters) > 0); },
  get paperShowing(): string { return paperShowingLine(this.showing, this.needsCount, liveCards().filter((c) => c.state === 'completed').length); },
  get editionCount(): string { return plural(this.liveCount, 'card', 'cards'); },
  get studioSubRight(): string | null { return studioSubRight(app.syncedAt, appearance.phase); },
  get boardStatus(): ShellStatus { return boardStatus(boardCounts(app.board?.cards ?? [], needIds()), app.syncedAt); },
  pageStatus(lead: ReadonlyArray<string | StatusItem | null>, right?: readonly string[]): ShellStatus { return statusLine(lead, app.syncedAt, { right }); },
  get homeHref(): string { return app.boardId ? `/b/${app.boardId}` : '/'; },
  get planHref(): string { return app.boardId ? `/b/${app.boardId}` : '/'; },
  get operateHref(): string { return app.boardId ? `/b/${app.boardId}/operate` : '/'; },
  workspaceHref: '/workspace/agents',
  openSearch(): void { app.cmdkOpen = true; },
  compose(): void { app.requestCompose(); },
  setView(v: ShellView): void { app.setView(v); },
  openFilter(): void { app.filterOpen = true; },
  openBoardSwitcher(): void { app.boardSwitcherOpen = true; },
  openAppearance(): void { appearance.pickerOpen = true; },
  toggleTheme(): void { appearance.toggleTheme(); },
  signOut(): void { void signOut(); },
};
```

- [ ] **Step 20: Write AppShell, the stopgap phone frame and SHELL_LAYOUTS**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/AppShell.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The frame every page renders inside. It picks the vibe's shell, desktop or phone
   * (`SHELL_LAYOUTS`, the one vibe switch), and owns what is the same in every vibe: the
   * composer, the board switcher, the filter dialog and the shell's keys.
   */
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { viewport } from '$lib/viewport.svelte';
  import { SHELL_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import FilterDialog from '$lib/components/plan/FilterDialog.svelte';
  import BoardSwitcher from './BoardSwitcher.svelte';
  import ComposeSheet from './ComposeSheet.svelte';
  import { createChordReader, isTypingTarget } from './shortcuts';
  import { shellModel } from './shell-model.svelte';
  import type { ShellProps } from './types';

  let props: ShellProps = $props();
  const Shell = $derived(SHELL_LAYOUTS[appearance.value.vibe][viewport.phone ? 'phone' : 'desktop']);

  let composing = $state(false);
  // The palette asks for the composer by bumping a counter. Remember the value at mount, so a
  // page that mounts after an earlier request does not open the composer again.
  let seen = untrack(() => app.composeRequest);
  $effect(() => {
    const r = app.composeRequest;
    if (r === seen) return;
    seen = r;
    composing = true;
  });

  const chords = createChordReader();
  function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.defaultPrevented || isTypingTarget(e.target)) return;
    if (composing || app.filterOpen || app.boardSwitcherOpen || app.cmdkOpen || app.openCardId || appearance.pickerOpen) return;
    const action = chords.read(e, Date.now());
    if (action === 'plan') void goto(shellModel.planHref);
    else if (action === 'operate') void goto(shellModel.operateHref);
    else if (action === 'workspace') void goto(shellModel.workspaceHref);
    else if (action === 'compose' && app.boardId) composing = true;
    else if (action === 'filter' && props.view && props.view !== 'projects') app.filterOpen = true;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  }
</script>

<svelte:window onkeydown={onKeydown} />

<Shell {...props} />
<ComposeSheet open={composing} onClose={() => (composing = false)} />
<BoardSwitcher />
<FilterDialog />
```

```svelte
  import { page } from '$app/state';

  import { plural } from '$lib/words';

  import ProjectView from './ProjectView.svelte';

  const VIEWS: readonly View[] = ['board', 'list', 'projects'];

    const v = page.url.searchParams.get('view');

  });

  const summaries = $derived(app.board ? summarize(app.board, app.filteredCards(), { agents: app.agents, members: app.members, labels: app.labelById(), nowMs: Date.now() }) : []);
  const stageList = $derived(app.board ? stageSummaries(app.board, app.filteredCards(), app.agents) : []);

      : shellModel.boardStatus,
  );
</script>
```

```ts
/** The nav's box and the page's sideways scroll, measured in the page. */
async function frame(page: Page) {
  return page.evaluate(() => {
    const nav = [...document.querySelectorAll('nav[aria-label="Main"]')].map((n) => n.getBoundingClientRect()).find((r) => r.height > 0)!;

  });
}
```

The allow-list keys were deleted in Step 23. Run `pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel -g "SP-Board-Daylight#shell"`. Expected: PASS (both themes, all six parts).

If a part fails, open `apps/web/test-results/pixel/index.html` and fix the app, never the reference. Two causes are common:
- A part's size differs. Diff the app's markup against the reference element tree; the class names and nesting must be identical.
- The font or spacing differs only inside a `button`, `summary` or `h1`. Tailwind's preflight (`@layer base`) resets a UA default the reference relies on. Restore the reference's computed value as a named rule at the end of `daylight.css`, for example `.dy-acct > summary { font: inherit; }`. Keep a one-line comment saying which preflight reset it undoes.

### Task 12: Paper, Studio and Quiet desktop shells, and the Annual base

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

This task builds the other three desktop frames from their board references. Paper is a masthead with no rail (`header.mh`, SP-Board-Paper). Studio is the Annual-report frame: an ink rail, a ruled masthead, a sub-bar and a status line (`div.ar.bd`, SP-Board-Studio). Quiet is a plain text navigation (`header.qn`, SP-Board-Quiet). `lib/styles/annual.css` lands too: the Studio base every later Studio screen restyles its content with. So do two `extract-css.mjs` flags (`--exclude` and `--scope`), and `YouMenu`, the account menu Studio's square opens and the phones reuse in Task 13. Pixel: `SP-Board-Paper#shell`, `SP-Board-Studio#shell` and `SP-Board-Quiet#shell` turn green, as defined in Task 11. Rulings applied:
- per-section frame differences from the references: Paper `h1` only on the board, `p.mh-title--sm` elsewhere, and an empty ruled `.mh-tabs` on Settings and Spend; Studio has no `.ar-sub` off Plan and no switcher on Workspace; Quiet has one row on Workspace;
- the theme control is a pressed toggle labelled "Dark theme";
- signal colour only on the count.

  - `extract-css.mjs --scope '<selector>'` prefixes every selector with the scope. A leading `[data-theme…]`, `[data-vibe…]`, `[data-time…]` or `[data-phase…]` stays in front of it.
  - `YouMenu.svelte` takes props `{ open?: boolean (bindable); anchor: HTMLElement | null; placement: 'rail' | 'phone' }`.
  - `SHELL_LAYOUTS.{paper,studio,quiet}.desktop`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the flags to `extract-css.mjs`**

Replace `apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs` with this version. It is Task 4's script plus `--exclude`, `--scope`, a selector-list splitter and a `REF_DIR` override. Prefixes are now regex-escaped, so a prefix like `ar.bd` matches literally.

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs — port a reference's CSS verbatim, by class prefix.
// Usage: node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Board-Daylight --prefix dy-,vk-sky [--exclude a-,b-] [--scope '<selector>'] [--out file.css]
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REF = process.env.REF_DIR ?? join(here, '../../e2e/reference/mockups');
const [artboard, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (k) => { const i = rest.indexOf(k); return i > -1 ? rest[i + 1] : undefined; };
const list = (k) => (arg(k) ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const prefixes = list('--prefix');
const excludes = list('--exclude');
const scope = arg('--scope');
if (!artboard || prefixes.length === 0) { console.error('usage: extract-css.mjs <Artboard> --prefix a-,b- [--exclude c-] [--scope sel] [--out file]'); process.exit(2); }
const html = readFileSync(join(REF, `${artboard}.html`), 'utf8');
const css = [...html.matchAll(/<style[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/g)].map((m) => m[1]).join('\n');

/** Split top-level CSS into [prelude, body] blocks, keeping @media/@supports/@container groups. */
function blocks(src) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, start = 0, open = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const c = src[i];
    if (c === '/' && src[i + 1] === '*') { const e = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2); i = e < 0 ? src.length : e + 1; continue; }
    if (c === '{') { if (depth === 0) open = i; depth++; }
    else if (c === '}') { depth--; if (depth === 0) { out.push([src.slice(start, open).trim(), src.slice(open + 1, i)]); start = i + 1; } }
  }
  return out;
}
const re = (p) => new RegExp(`\\.${p.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\-]/g, '\\$&')}`);
const wanted = (sel) => !/\.sc-/.test(sel) && prefixes.some((p) => re(p).test(sel)) && !excludes.some((p) => re(p).test(sel));

/** Comma-split a selector list, ignoring commas inside :is()/:where()/attribute brackets. */
function splitList(sel) {
  const parts = []; let depth = 0, last = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
    const c = sel[i];
    if (c === '(' || c === '[') depth++;
    else if (c === ')' || c === ']') depth--;
    else if (c === ',' && depth === 0) { parts.push(sel.slice(last, i).trim()); last = i + 1; }
  }
  parts.push(sel.slice(last).trim());
  return parts;
}
/** Put `scope` in front of every selector; a leading [data-theme…]/[data-vibe…] (set on <html>) stays in front of it. */
function scoped(prelude) {
  if (!scope) return prelude;
  const sel = prelude.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').trim();
  return splitList(sel).map((s) => {
    const m = s.match(/^((?:\[data-(?:theme|vibe|time|phase)[^\]]*\])+)\s+(.+)$/);
    return m ? `${m[1]} ${scope} ${m[2]}` : `${scope} ${s}`;
  }).join(', ');
}

const kept = [];
for (const [prelude, body] of blocks(css)) {
  if (/^@(media|supports|container)/.test(prelude)) {
    const inner = blocks(body).filter(([s]) => wanted(s)).map(([s, b]) => `  ${scoped(s)} {${b}}`);
    if (inner.length) kept.push(`${prelude} {\n${inner.join('\n')}\n}`);
  } else if (/^@keyframes/.test(prelude)) {
    if (prefixes.some((p) => prelude.includes(p))) kept.push(`${prelude} {${body}}`);
  } else if (wanted(prelude)) kept.push(`${scoped(prelude)} {${body}}`);
}
const flags = [`prefixes ${prefixes.join(', ')}`, excludes.length ? `excluding ${excludes.join(', ')}` : '', scope ? `scoped to ${scope}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('; ');
const text = `/* Ported verbatim from e2e/reference/mockups/${artboard}.html (${flags}) by scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs. */\n${kept.join('\n')}\n`;
const out = arg('--out');
if (out) writeFileSync(out, text); else process.stdout.write(text);
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write YouMenu**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/YouMenu.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The account menu for the frames whose account control is a single button: Studio's square
   * and every phone's "You" (G15, not drawn). Who is signed in, Appearance, Dark theme, Sign out.
   */
  import '$lib/styles/shell/you-menu.css';
  import { shellModel as m } from './shell-model.svelte';

  let { open = $bindable(false), anchor, placement }: { open?: boolean; anchor: HTMLElement | null; placement: 'rail' | 'phone' } = $props();

  let box = $state<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const items = () => [...(box?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role^="menuitem"]') ?? [])];

  $effect(() => {
    if (open) queueMicrotask(() => items()[0]?.focus());
  });

  function close(refocus: boolean): void {
    open = false;
    if (refocus) anchor?.focus();
  }
  function run(fn: () => void): void {
    close(false);
    fn();
  }
  function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const list = items();
    const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(true); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); list[(i + 1) % list.length]?.focus(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); list[(i - 1 + list.length) % list.length]?.focus(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') close(false);
  }
</script>

<svelte:window onpointerdown={(e) => { if (open && box && !box.contains(e.target as Node) && !anchor?.contains(e.target as Node)) close(false); }} />

{#if open}
  <div class="you-menu you-menu--{placement}" role="menu" aria-label="Account" tabindex="-1" bind:this={box} onkeydown={onKey}>
    <p class="you-menu__who"><b>{m.userName}</b>Signed in</p>
    <button type="button" role="menuitem" onclick={() => run(m.openAppearance)}>Appearance</button>
    <button type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked={m.dark} onclick={() => run(m.toggleTheme)}>Dark theme</button>
    <button type="button" role="menuitem" onclick={() => run(m.signOut)}>Sign out</button>
  </div>
{/if}
```

```svelte
  import { shellModel as m } from './shell-model.svelte';
  import { VIEWS, type ShellProps } from './types';

  let { here, section, boardName, view, showing, paperShowing, subTools, children }: ShellProps = $props();

  let acct = $state<HTMLDetailsElement | null>(null);
  const count = $derived(m.operateCount);
  // The board name is the page's h1 only on the board itself; the card drawer and every other
  // page carry their own heading.
  const titleIsH1 = $derived(section === 'board' && !app.openCardId);
  const note = $derived(paperShowing ?? showing);

  function closeAccount(refocus: boolean): void {
    if (!acct?.open) return;
    acct.open = false;
    if (refocus) acct.querySelector('summary')?.focus();
  }
</script>

<svelte:window
  onkeydown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && acct?.open) { e.stopPropagation(); closeAccount(true); } }}
  onpointerdown={(e) => { if (acct?.open && !acct.contains(e.target as Node)) closeAccount(false); }}
/>

<div class="sh-paper" style="background: var(--vk-color-bg); color: var(--vk-color-text); font-family: var(--vk-font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; min-height: 100vh;">
  <header class="mh">
    <div class="mh-top">
      <a class="mh-name" href={m.homeHref} aria-label="Superpipeline home">Superpipeline</a>
      <p class="mh-date">{m.dateline}</p>
      <div class="mh-quiet">
        <button class="mh-q" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick={m.openAppearance}>Appearance</button>
        <button class="mh-q" type="button" aria-pressed={m.dark} onclick={m.toggleTheme}>Dark theme</button>
        <details class="mh-acct" bind:this={acct}>
          <summary class="mh-q" aria-haspopup="menu">{m.userName}<Icon name="chev" size={14} /></summary>
          <div class="mh-menu" role="menu"><p>Signed in as {m.userName}</p><button type="button" role="menuitem" onclick={m.signOut}>Sign out</button></div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-sections">
      <nav aria-label="Superpipeline" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;">
        <a class="mh-sec" href={m.planHref} aria-current={here === 'plan' ? 'page' : undefined}>Plan</a>
        <a class="mh-sec" href={m.operateHref} aria-current={here === 'operate' ? 'page' : undefined}>Operate{#if count} <span class="n">{count.paren}</span><span class="vk-visually-hidden">{count.needYou}</span>{/if}</a>
        <a class="mh-sec" href={m.workspaceHref} aria-current={here === 'workspace' ? 'page' : undefined}>Workspace</a>
      </nav>
      <span class="mh-live" role="status" title={m.connected ? 'Live: changes arrive as they happen' : 'Reconnecting…'} data-live={m.connected ? 'on' : 'off'}><span class="mh-livedot" aria-hidden="true"></span>{#if m.connected}<b>Live</b> · changes appear as they happen{:else}<b>Reconnecting…</b>{/if}</span>
    </div>
    {#if boardName !== null}
      <div class="mh-ed">
        {#if titleIsH1}<h1 class="mh-title">{boardName}</h1>{:else}<p class="mh-title" class:mh-title--sm={section !== 'board'}>{boardName}</p>{/if}
        <button class="mh-change" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Change board, now {boardName}" onclick={m.openBoardSwitcher}>Change board</button>
        <div class="mh-acts">
          {#if view && view !== 'projects'}
            <button class="mh-btn" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick={m.openFilter}><Icon name="filter-paper" size={16} />Filter cards <span class="cnt">· {m.filterSummary}</span></button>
          {/if}
          {@render subTools?.()}
          <button class="mh-btn" type="button" aria-label="Search cards, agents and actions" onclick={m.openSearch}><Icon name="search" size={16} />Search<span class="mh-kbd">⌘K</span></button>
          <button class="mh-btn mh-btn--write" type="button" onclick={m.compose}><Icon name="pen" size={16} />Write a new card</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}
    {#if view}
      <div class="mh-tabs">
        <div role="group" aria-label="View">
          {#each VIEWS as [v, label] (v)}<button class="mh-tab" type="button" aria-pressed={view === v} onclick={() => m.setView(v)}>{label}</button>{/each}
        </div>
        {#if note}<span class="mh-showing">{note}</span>{/if}
      </div>
    {:else if section === 'settings' || section === 'spend'}
      <div class="mh-tabs" style="border-bottom-width: 1px; border-bottom-style: solid;"></div>
    {/if}
  </header>
  {@render children()}
</div>
```

The Operate link's text must be `Operate` followed by one space and the count spans. Keep `Operate{#if count} <span` exactly as written, so that no space is left behind when nothing needs you.

### Task 13: The four phone shells

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Below 900px, each vibe gets its own phone frame: a header that scrolls away and a bottom bar that sticks. Daylight puts its top bar on a sky and floats its bar. Paper has a small masthead and a double rule. Studio has an ink bar. Quiet has plain text and a 2px rule. All four share a phone base stylesheet (the references' `.r` base as `.ph-root`), and every "You" opens `YouMenu` (Task 12). The stopgap `PhoneShellLegacy` and `BottomNav` are deleted, and their test assertions move to the four phone shells. The phone boards have no shell artboard of their own, so this task adds a `#shell` check to `SHELL_CHECKS` for each `SP-Phone-Board-<Vibe>`. Each check compares the phone header and the tab bar, and all four turn green. Rulings applied:
- 390px roots become `width: 100%` (§6);
- the Daylight sky uses the phase's tokens in light and `dusk` in dark;
- tab-bar counts use `--vk-color-signal-text`;
- phone labels and accessible names come from the references ("Switch board: …", "Search cards, agents and actions (⌘K)").

- Create: `apps/web/src/lib/styles/phone-base.css`
- Create (ported): `apps/web/src/lib/styles/shell/phone-daylight.css`, `apps/web/src/lib/styles/shell/phone-paper.css`, `apps/web/src/lib/styles/shell/phone-studio.css`, `apps/web/src/lib/styles/shell/phone-quiet.css`

- Delete: `apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/BottomNav.svelte`, `apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/BottomNav.svelte.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/phone/PhoneShellLegacy.svelte`

```ts
  it('You opens a menu that names who is signed in and signs out', async () => {
    render(Shell, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^You/ }));
    const menu = screen.getByRole('menu');
    expect(within(menu).getByText('Ada Lovelace')).toBeTruthy();
    await fireEvent.click(within(menu).getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out' }));
    expect(logout).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('You opens a menu that switches the theme and offers Appearance', async () => {
    render(Shell, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^You/ }));
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitemcheckbox', { name: 'Dark theme' }));
    expect(appearance.theme).toBe('light');
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^You/ }));
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Appearance' }));
    expect(appearance.pickerOpen).toBe(true);
    appearance.pickerOpen = false;
  });
  it('the board control opens the switcher; search opens the palette', async () => {
    render(Shell, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Developer Experience|Change board/ }));
    expect(app.boardSwitcherOpen).toBe(true);
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Search cards, agents and actions (⌘K)' }));
    expect(app.cmdkOpen).toBe(true);
    app.cmdkOpen = false;
  });
  it('the view switch and Filter are there on Plan, and gone elsewhere', () => {
    render(Shell, props());
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Board' }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Filter' })).toBeTruthy();
    cleanup();
    render(Shell, props({ here: 'operate', section: 'operate', view: null, showing: null }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('group', { name: 'View' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Filter' })).toBeNull();
  });
  it('no count when nothing needs you', () => {
    app.attention = [];
    render(Shell, props());
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /^Operate/ }).textContent!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()).toBe('Operate');
  });
});

describe('each phone’s count', () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Port the phone stylesheets**

Write the phone base by hand. These are lines 3–16 of the phone references' `<style data-dc-tpl>` block, identical in Daylight, Paper and Quiet. Three changes are made:
- `.r` becomes `.ph-root`;
- `width: 390px` becomes `width: 100%`, and the root gains `min-height: 100dvh`, so the bar meets the screen's foot on a short page;
- each helper class is scoped under `.ph-root` instead of being global.

```css
/* apps/web/src/lib/styles/phone-base.css
   Ported from e2e/reference/mockups/SP-Phone-Board-Daylight.html (lines 3–16, the same in the Paper
   and Quiet phone references). Deltas: .r → .ph-root; width:390px → width:100%; + min-height:100dvh;
   helpers scoped to .ph-root so they never reach a desktop page. */
.ph-root { width: 100%; min-height: 100dvh; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--vk-color-bg); color: var(--vk-color-text); font-family: var(--vk-font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ph-root *, .ph-root *::before, .ph-root *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.ph-root h1, .ph-root h2, .ph-root h3, .ph-root h4, .ph-root p, .ph-root ul, .ph-root ol, .ph-root dl, .ph-root dd, .ph-root figure { margin: 0; }
.ph-root ul, .ph-root ol { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
:where(.ph-root button, .ph-root select, .ph-root textarea, .ph-root input) { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.ph-root a { color: var(--vk-color-text); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.ph-root .wrap { overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0; }
.ph-root .mono { font-family: var(--vk-font-mono); }
.ph-root .muted { color: var(--vk-color-muted); }
.ph-root .ico { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.ph-root .ib { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: var(--vk-radius-sm); cursor: pointer; color: var(--vk-color-text); padding: 0; }
.ph-root .face { flex: none; display: inline-flex; line-height: 0; }
.ph-root .face svg { border-radius: 50%; }
.ph-root .sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
```

Then run from the repo root:

```bash
S=apps/web/src/lib/styles/shell
X="node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs"
$X SP-Phone-Board-Daylight --prefix pd-top,pd-search,pd-sub,pd-live,sw,nc,vt,fb,nav,greet,sun --scope '.ph-root[data-shell="daylight-phone"]' --out $S/phone-daylight.css
$X SP-Phone-Board-Paper --prefix pm,nav --scope '.ph-root[data-shell="paper-phone"]' --out $S/phone-paper.css
$X SP-Phone-Board-Studio --prefix ph,pb-sub --out $S/phone-studio.css
$X SP-Phone-Board-Quiet --prefix pq --scope '.ph-root[data-shell="quiet-phone"]' --out $S/phone-quiet.css
# The Daylight phone mockup paints its sky with the noon tokens; the app paints the phase's (the
# .greet is also a .vk-sky, whose [data-phase] rule sets --vk-sky-top/-bottom/-text/-sun).
perl -pi -e 's/--vk-sky-noon-/--vk-sky-/g' $S/phone-daylight.css
# Studio's 390px root becomes the full width, with the bar at the screen's foot on a short page.
perl -pi -e 's/\.ar\.ph \{ width: 390px;/.ar.ph { width: 100%; min-height: 100dvh;/' $S/phone-studio.css
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the shared "You" tab**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/phone/YouTab.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * A phone tab bar's "You": an <a> styled by the bar's own `a` rules (as drawn), acting as the
   * button that opens the account menu.
   */
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import YouMenu from '../YouMenu.svelte';

  let { children }: { children: Snippet } = $props();
  let open = $state(false);
  let el = $state<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null);
</script>

<a
  href="#you"
  role="button"
  aria-haspopup="menu"
  aria-expanded={open}
  bind:this={el}
  onclick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); open = !open; }}
  onkeydown={(e) => { if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open = !open; } }}
>{@render children()}</a>
<YouMenu bind:open anchor={el} placement="phone" />
```

`YouMenu` is fixed-position, so it sits outside the grid without taking a cell. Because it renders nothing when closed, the bar keeps its four columns.

```svelte
<script lang="ts">

<div class="ph-root" data-shell="daylight-phone">

  {@render children()}

    <a href={m.planHref} aria-current={here === 'plan' ? 'page' : undefined}><Icon name="plan-phone" bare /><span>Plan</span></a>
    <a href={m.operateHref} aria-current={here === 'operate' ? 'page' : undefined}><Icon name="operate" bare /><span>Operate</span>{#if count}<span class="cnt" aria-hidden="true">{count.n}</span><span class="sr">{count.comma}</span>{/if}</a>

</div>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/board-words.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DX, DX_IDS, NOW_MS, boardCtx } from '$lib/test/fixture-boards';
import { buildBoardModel } from './board-model';
import { daysOverdue, dlCols, dueLong, dueShort, greetingLine, needsAction, peekEyebrow, personInitials, stripLabel, stripOwner, tileAction, tileWho } from './board-words';

const m = buildBoardModel(DX, DX.cards, boardCtx());
const by = (id: string) => m.cards.find((s) => s.id === id)!;
const stage = (key: string) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)!;

describe('dates', () => {
  it('prints due dates the way the boards do', () => {
    expect(dueShort('2026-10-06')).toBe('6 Oct');
    expect(dueLong('2026-10-06')).toBe('6 October');
    expect(dueLong('2026-10-05')).toBe('5 October');
  });
  it('counts whole days overdue', () => expect(daysOverdue('2026-10-06', NOW_MS)).toBe(5));
});

describe('Daylight words', () => {
  it('greets with the needs count', () => {
    expect(greetingLine('noon', 'Rakesh', 4)).toBe('Good afternoon, Rakesh. 4 cards want you.');
    expect(greetingLine('noon', 'Rakesh', 1)).toBe('Good afternoon, Rakesh. 1 card wants you.');
    expect(greetingLine('noon', 'Rakesh', 0)).toBe('Good afternoon, Rakesh. Nothing needs you.');
  });
  it('initials are the first letters of the first two words', () => {
    expect(personInitials('Rakesh Gangwar')).toBe('RG');
    expect(personInitials('sam')).toBe('S');
  });
  it('the peek eyebrow', () => expect(peekEyebrow(by(DX_IDS.c58f8))).toBe('Peek · Failing test · 33h in this stage'));
  it('who is on each tile', () => {
    expect(tileWho(by(DX_IDS.c63ac))).toEqual({ kind: 'person', name: 'Rakesh Gangwar', initials: 'RG', text: 'With you', note: '· no agent works this stage' });
    expect(tileWho(by(DX_IDS.c4605))).toEqual({ kind: 'agent', name: 'error-eric', mood: 'needs', note: '· needs you' });
    expect(tileWho(by(DX_IDS.cf83f))).toEqual({ kind: 'plain', text: 'Unclaimed · starts when unblocked' });
    expect(tileWho(by(DX_IDS.c9ed9))).toEqual({ kind: 'done', text: 'Shipped' });
  });
  it('the one action a tile offers', () => {
    expect(tileAction(by(DX_IDS.c63ac))).toEqual({ label: 'Move to another stage', does: 'move' });
    expect(tileAction(by(DX_IDS.c58f8))).toEqual({ label: 'Resume', does: 'open' });
    expect(tileAction(by(DX_IDS.cf83f))).toBeNull();
    expect(tileAction(by(DX_IDS.c9ed9))).toBeNull();
    expect(needsAction('question')).toEqual({ label: 'Answer', does: 'open' });
    expect(needsAction('review')).toEqual({ label: 'Review', does: 'open' });
  });
  it('the grid: the fullest lane is wider, empty stages collapse to 60px', () => {
    expect(dlCols(m.stages, {})).toBe('minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 60px 60px minmax(0, 1fr)');
    expect(dlCols(m.stages, { integrate: true })).toBe('minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 60px minmax(0, 1fr)');
  });
  it('strips', () => {
    expect(stripLabel(stage('integrate'))).toBe('Integrate, no cards. integration or api or testing · 3 agents. Expand stage');
    expect(stripLabel(stage('signed-off'))).toBe('Signed off, no cards. a person · approval, approval gate. Expand stage');
    expect(stripOwner(stage('integrate'))).toBe('3 agents');
    expect(stripOwner(stage('signed-off'))).toBe('a person');
    expect(stripOwner(stage('reproduce'))).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';

const { store } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ store: { openCard: vi.fn(), moveCard: vi.fn(async () => {}), error: '' } }));

const s = (id: string) => m.cards.find((c) => c.id === id)!;
const props = (id: string, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({ s: s(id), stages: m.stageDefs, peekOpen: false, firstNeeds: false, onPeek: vi.fn(), onPeekClose: vi.fn(), ...over });

beforeEach(() => store.openCard.mockClear());
afterEach(cleanup);

describe('DlTile', () => {
  it('names its title for the keyboard and opens the card on Enter', async () => {
    render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c58f8));
    const title = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'AgentPod: connector interface and generic effects ledger, state machine and executor, in Failing test. Enter to open, M to move, Alt with left or right arrow to move between stages.' });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(title, { key: 'Enter' });
    expect(store.openCard).toHaveBeenCalledWith(DX_IDS.c58f8);
  });
  it('63ac: priority for screen readers, three chips and "+1", asked-by, overdue, the move action', async () => {
    const { container } = render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c63ac));
    expect(container.querySelector('article')!.className).toMatch(/\bp1\b/);
    expect(container.querySelector('article')!.className).toMatch(/\bneeds\b/);
    expect(screen.getByText('Priority 1').className).toBe('vk-visually-hidden');
    expect(screen.getByText('+1').getAttribute('title')).toBe('1 more label');
    expect(screen.getByText('asked by super-chotu').closest('.dl-asked')!.getAttribute('title')).toBe('Queued by super-chotu, not by you');
    expect(screen.getByText('Overdue · due 6 Oct')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('With you')).toBeTruthy();
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Move to another stage' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('menu')).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('1dfc has no priority and no chips row at all', () => {
    const { container } = render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c1dfc));
    expect(container.querySelector('.dl-chips')).toBeNull();
    expect(container.querySelector('.dl-ref')!.textContent).toBe('test(api): pin manual delivery reminder');
  });
  it('a blocked queued card says it is unclaimed and offers no action', () => {
    const { container } = render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c481f));
    expect(screen.getByText('Blocked').closest('.dl-chip')!.getAttribute('title')).toBe('Blocked by another card. This card will not be claimed');
    expect(screen.getByText('Unclaimed · starts when unblocked')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(container.querySelector('.dl-act')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('tells the board where the eye is, and shows the peek when asked', async () => {
    const onPeek = vi.fn();
    const { container, rerender } = render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c58f8, { onPeek }));
    await fireEvent.pointerEnter(container.querySelector('article')!);
    expect(onPeek).toHaveBeenCalledWith(DX_IDS.c58f8);
    await rerender(props(DX_IDS.c58f8, { onPeek, peekOpen: true }));
    const peek = screen.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Peek' });
    expect(peek.textContent).toContain('Peek · Failing test · 33h in this stage');
    expect(peek.textContent).toContain('tester-tim · I’ve stopped and need you');
    expect(container.querySelector('article')!.className).toMatch(/\bfocused\b/);
  });
  it('the first needs tile is the jump target', () => {
    render(DlTile, props(DX_IDS.c63ac, { firstNeeds: true }));
    expect(document.getElementById('first-needs')!.textContent).toBe('Fix the highest-severity blocker found in the clean-room journey');
  });
});
```

Add the import and append the two functions (the existing `stageOwner`, `requirement` and `CAVEAT` stay as they are):

```ts
import { plural } from '../../words';

/** One declarer by name, several as a count ("2 agents"). */
function holders(names: string[]): string {
  return names.length === 1 ? names[0]! : plural(names.length, 'agent', 'agents');
}

/** Who works a stage, as the desktop boards print it: "testing · tester-tim", "code · 2 agents", "a person · approval". */
export function ownerLong(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind !== 'capability' || o.label === 'no capability set') return o.label;
  if (o.undeclared) return `${o.label} · nobody declares it`;
  return `${o.label} · ${holders(o.declaredBy)}`;
}

/**
 * The phone form: one capability keeps its holder ("diagnostics · error-eric"), a multi-capability
 * stage shows only its primary capability ("integration"), a gate says who decides. Quiet phone
 * passes `sep = ': '`.
 */
export function ownerShort(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[], sep = ' · '): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind === 'human') return stage.gate === 'approval' ? `gate${sep}approval by a person` : 'a person';
  if (o.kind === 'agent') return o.label;
  const { caps } = requirement(stage);
  if (caps.length !== 1) return stage.owner ?? o.label;
  return `${caps[0]}${sep}${o.undeclared ? 'nobody' : holders(o.declaredBy)}`;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `board-model.ts`**

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/board-model.ts
/**
 * The board, once, for every layout (spec SB §2). PlanView builds it from the snapshot and the
 * filtered cards; a layout never re-derives what is here, so the four vibes cannot disagree about
 * which card needs you, which comes first, or what a stage is called.
 */
import type { BoardSnapshot, Card, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import type { AttentionItem } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { stageSummaries, summarize, type AgentRef, type CardSummary, type StageSummary, type SummaryContext, type Urgency } from './card-summary';

export interface Me { id: string; name: string; initials: string }
export interface BoardContext extends SummaryContext { me: Me | null; spend7d: number | null }

/** One small square per card, in the Studio multiples and the share bar. */
export type Unit = 'needs' | 'blocked' | 'queued' | 'working' | 'done' | 'off';
const UNIT_ORDER: readonly Unit[] = ['needs', 'blocked', 'queued', 'working', 'done', 'off'];
export type BoardStage = StageSummary & { units: Unit[] };

export interface BoardModel {
  boardId: string;
  boardName: string;
  /** Non-archived, filtered cards, in the API's order. */
  cards: CardSummary[];
  /** People needed first (plan ruling X-1). */
  ordered: CardSummary[];
  stages: BoardStage[];
  /** The board's stage definitions, in order (what CardMoveMenu takes). */
  stageDefs: Stage[];
  needs: CardSummary[];
  working: CardSummary[];
  queued: CardSummary[];
  done: CardSummary[];
  closed: CardSummary[];
  counts: { all: number; needs: number; working: number; queued: number; queuedBlocked: number; done: number; closed: number; overdue: number; overBudget: number; blocked: number };
  spend7d: number | null;
  /** The clock the model was built at (ages, "five days overdue"). */
  nowMs: number;
  attention: AttentionItem[];
  /** The agents of the needs cards, once each, in `ordered` order (Daylight "Holding cards"). */
  holders: AgentRef[];
  fn: { spend: number };
}

const RANK: Record<Urgency, number> = { needs: 0, working: 1, queued: 2, done: 3, closed: 4 };

/** Needs first, then working, queued, done, closed; inside each group the oldest card first. */
export function orderForBoard(cards: CardSummary[]): CardSummary[] {
  return [...cards].sort((a, b) => RANK[a.urgency] - RANK[b.urgency] || Date.parse(a.createdAt) - Date.parse(b.createdAt) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

export function unitOf(s: CardSummary): Unit {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') return 'needs';
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return s.blocked ? 'blocked' : 'queued';
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return 'working';
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return 'done';
  return 'off';
}

export function buildBoardModel(board: BoardSnapshot, filteredCards: Card[], ctx: BoardContext): BoardModel {
  const live = filteredCards.filter((c) => c.archivedAt === null);
  const cards = summarize(board, live, ctx);

  // Footnotes: each needs card its own number; each other group one shared number; spend last.
  const sorted = orderForBoard(cards);
  const fnOf = new Map<string, number>();
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of sorted) if (s.urgency === 'needs') fnOf.set(s.id, ++n);
  const shared: CardSummary[][] = [
    sorted.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'working'),
    sorted.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'queued' && s.blocked),
    sorted.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'queued' && !s.blocked),
    sorted.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'done'),
    sorted.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'closed'),
  ];
  for (const g of shared) if (g.length) { n += 1; for (const s of g) fnOf.set(s.id, n); }

  const ordered = sorted.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, ix: i + 1, fnNumber: fnOf.get(s.id) ?? 0 }));
  const byId = new Map(ordered.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const inApiOrder = cards.map((s) => byId.get(s.id)!);
  const group = (u: Urgency) => ordered.filter((s) => s.urgency === u);

  const stages: BoardStage[] = stageSummaries(board, live, ctx.agents).map((st) => ({
    ...st,
    units: ordered.filter((s) => s.stageKey === st.key).map(unitOf).sort((a, b) => UNIT_ORDER.indexOf(a) - UNIT_ORDER.indexOf(b)),
  }));

  const needs = group('needs');
  const holders: AgentRef[] = [];
  for (const s of needs) if (s.lastAgent && !holders.some((h) => h.id === s.lastAgent!.id)) holders.push(s.lastAgent);

  const queued = group('queued');
  return {
    boardId: board.boardId ?? '',
    boardName: board.name ?? '',
    cards: inApiOrder,
    ordered,
    stages,
    stageDefs: [...board.stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order),
    needs,
    working: group('working'),
    queued,
    done: group('done'),
    closed: group('closed'),
    counts: {
      all: ordered.length,
      needs: needs.length,
      working: group('working').length,
      queued: queued.length,
      queuedBlocked: queued.filter((s) => s.blocked).length,
      done: group('done').length,
      closed: group('closed').length,
      overdue: ordered.filter((s) => s.overdue).length,
      overBudget: ordered.filter((s) => s.overBudget).length,
      blocked: ordered.filter((s) => s.blocked).length,
    },
    spend7d: ctx.spend7d,
    nowMs: ctx.nowMs,
    attention: ordered.flatMap((s) => (s.attention ? [s.attention] : [])),
    holders,
    fn: { spend: n + 1 },
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `board-words.ts`** (Daylight words now; Tasks 15, 17 and 18 append their own sections to this file)

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/board-words.ts
/**
 * The boards' own words, as pure functions of the model. Every string here is printed verbatim by a
 * reference artboard; the unit tests hold the exact strings.
 */
import { greeting, type Mood, type Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AttentionKind } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { plural } from '$lib/words';
import type { CardSummary, StageSummary } from './card-summary';

export const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'] as const;
const parts = (d: string) => d.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number) as [number, number, number];
/** '2026-10-06' → '6 Oct'. A due date is a calendar day, never shifted by a time zone. */
export const dueShort = (d: string): string => `${parts(d)[2]} ${MONTHS[parts(d)[1] - 1]!.slice(0, 3)}`;
/** '2026-10-06' → '6 October'. */
export const dueLong = (d: string): string => `${parts(d)[2]} ${MONTHS[parts(d)[1] - 1]}`;
/** Whole days from the due day to today (the same UTC "today" `overdue()` uses). */
export function daysOverdue(due: string, nowMs: number): number {
  const today = Date.parse(new Date(nowMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  return Math.max(0, Math.round((today - Date.parse(due.slice(0, 10))) / 86_400_000));
}
/** "Rakesh Gangwar" → "RG". */
export function personInitials(name: string): string {
  return name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).map((w) => w[0]!.toUpperCase()).join('');
}

// ── Daylight ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function greetingLine(phase: Phase, firstName: string, needs: number): string {
  const hello = greeting(phase, 'daylight').replace(/[.?]$/, '');
  const tail = needs === 0 ? 'Nothing needs you.' : `${needs} ${needs === 1 ? 'card wants' : 'cards want'} you.`;
  return `${hello}, ${firstName}. ${tail}`;
}

/** What the agent says in the peek bubble, after its name. */
export const KIND_SAYS: Partial<Record<AttentionKind, string>> = {
  blocked: 'I’ve stopped and need you',
  'repeated-failure': 'I keep failing and need you',
  question: 'I have a question',
  review: 'please review my work',
  'no-owner': 'nobody works this stage',
};
export const isStopped = (k: AttentionKind | null): boolean => k === 'blocked' || k === 'repeated-failure';
export const peekEyebrow = (s: CardSummary): string => `Peek · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageShort} in this stage`;
export const moreLabelsTitle = (n: number): string => `${n} more ${n === 1 ? 'label' : 'labels'}`;

export type TileWho =
  | { kind: 'person'; name: string; initials: string; text: string; note: string }
  | { kind: 'agent'; name: string; mood: Mood; note: string }
  | { kind: 'plain'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'done'; text: string };

/** The `.dl-who` line of a tile (SB §3.3). */
export function tileWho(s: CardSummary): TileWho {
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { kind: 'done', text: s.stageName };
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return { kind: 'plain', text: 'Closed' };
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return { kind: 'plain', text: s.blocked ? 'Unclaimed · starts when unblocked' : 'Unclaimed · waiting to be picked up' };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') {
    const a = s.delegate ?? s.lastAgent;
    return a ? { kind: 'agent', name: a.name, mood: 'working', note: '· working' } : { kind: 'plain', text: 'Working' };
  }
  const a = s.lastAgent ?? s.delegate;
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner' || !a) {
    return { kind: 'person', name: s.owner.name, initials: s.owner.initials, text: s.owner.isMe ? 'With you' : `With ${s.owner.name}`, note: s.kind === 'no-owner' ? '· no agent works this stage' : '· needs you' };
  }
  return { kind: 'agent', name: a.name, mood: 'needs', note: '· needs you' };
}

export interface CardAction { label: string; does: 'move' | 'open' }
/** The one thing a needs card asks of you. Resume, Answer and Review open the card. */
export function needsAction(kind: AttentionKind | null): CardAction | null {
  if (kind === null) return null;
  if (kind === 'no-owner') return { label: 'Move to another stage', does: 'move' };
  if (isStopped(kind)) return { label: 'Resume', does: 'open' };
  if (kind === 'question') return { label: 'Answer', does: 'open' };
  if (kind === 'review') return { label: 'Review', does: 'open' };
  return { label: 'Open', does: 'open' };
}
export const tileAction = (s: CardSummary): CardAction | null => (s.urgency === 'needs' ? needsAction(s.kind) : null);

/** `.dl-board` columns: an empty collapsed stage is 60px; the fullest lane (when more than one card) is 1.15fr. */
export function dlCols(stages: Array<Pick<StageSummary, 'key' | 'count'>>, expanded: Record<string, boolean>): string {
  const max = Math.max(0, ...stages.map((s) => s.count));
  return stages
    .map((s) => (s.count === 0 && !expanded[s.key] ? '60px' : max > 1 && s.count === max ? 'minmax(0, 1.15fr)' : 'minmax(0, 1fr)'))
    .join(' ');
}
export const stripLabel = (s: StageSummary): string => `${s.name}, no cards. ${s.ownerLong}${s.gate ? ', approval gate' : ''}. Expand stage`;
/** The vertical owner word on a strip; null when the single declaring agent's face stands in for it. */
export function stripOwner(s: StageSummary): string | null {
  if (s.owner.kind === 'human') return 'a person';
  if (s.owner.kind === 'agent') return s.owner.label;
  if (s.declaredBy.length === 1) return null;
  return s.declaredBy.length === 0 ? 'nobody' : plural(s.declaredBy.length, 'agent', 'agents');
}
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** One Daylight card tile (SB §3.3 Tiles). The title's ::after covers the tile, so the whole tile opens the card. */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { cardDraggable } from '$lib/dnd';

  import Initials from '$lib/components/parts/Initials.svelte';
  import CardMoveMenu from '../CardMoveMenu.svelte';
  import { cardKeys, openLabel } from '../open-label';
  import { refLabel } from '../ref-chip';
  import { dueShort, moreLabelsTitle, tileAction, tileWho } from '../board-words';
  import type { CardSummary } from '../card-summary';
  import DlPeek from './DlPeek.svelte';

  let { s, stages, peekOpen, firstNeeds, onPeek, onPeekClose }: {
    s: CardSummary; stages: Stage[]; peekOpen: boolean; firstNeeds: boolean; onPeek: (id: string) => void; onPeekClose: () => void;
  } = $props();

  let moveOpen = $state(false);
  let menu = $state<ReturnType<typeof CardMoveMenu>>();
  const who = $derived(tileWho(s));
  const action = $derived(tileAction(s));
  const chips = $derived(s.priority > 0 || s.labels.length > 0 || s.moreLabels > 0 || s.blocked !== null);
  function act(): void {
    if (action?.does === 'move') moveOpen = true;
    else app.openCard(s.id);
  }
</script>

<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_static_element_interactions -- pointerenter and focusin only tell the board where the eye is; the title button inside is the control -->

>

      class="dl-title"

    >{s.title}</button>
  </h3>
  <button class="dl-move" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={moveOpen} aria-label="Move {s.title} to another stage" onclick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); moveOpen = !moveOpen; }}><Icon name="move" size={16} strokeWidth={1.8} />Move</button>
  <CardMoveMenu bind:this={menu} bind:open={moveOpen} card={s.card} {stages} bare />
  {#if chips}

      {#each s.labels as l (l.id)}<span class="dl-chip">{l.name}</span>{/each}

    {:else if who.kind === 'agent'}

    {:else if who.kind === 'done'}

    {/if}

</article>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/layouts/BoardDaylight.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Daylight desktop board: lanes under the sky, empty stages as strips, the peek from 1440px (SB §3). */
  import '../daylight/daylight.css';
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { MediaQuery } from 'svelte/reactivity';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { dlCols } from '../board-words';
  import DlLane from '../daylight/DlLane.svelte';
  import DlStrip from '../daylight/DlStrip.svelte';
  import type { BoardLayoutProps } from './types';

  let { model }: BoardLayoutProps = $props();

  const wide = new MediaQuery('min-width: 1440px');
  let expanded = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  let peekId = $state<string | null>(null);
  /** The title focus goes back to after a close must not reopen the peek it just closed. */
  let quietFor: string | null = null;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  function onPeek(id: string): void {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (id === quietFor) { quietFor = null; return; }
    if (!wide.current) return;
    timer = setTimeout(() => (peekId = id), 300);
  }
  function closePeek(): void {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    const id = peekId;
    peekId = null;
    if (!id) return;
    const title = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-title-for]')].find((el) => el.dataset.titleFor === id);
    if (title && document.activeElement !== title) { quietFor = id; title.focus(); }
  }
  onDestroy(() => clearTimeout(timer));

  const cols = $derived(dlCols(model.stages, expanded));
  const firstNeedsId = $derived(model.needs[0]?.id ?? null);
  const peekLane = $derived(model.cards.find((s) => s.id === peekId)?.stageKey ?? null);
</script>

<svelte:window onkeydown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && peekId && !e.defaultPrevented && !app.openCardId) closePeek(); }} />

<section class="dl-board" aria-label="{model.boardName} stages" style="grid-template-columns: {cols}">
  {#each model.stages as stage (stage.key)}
    {@const cards = model.ordered.filter((s) => s.stageKey === stage.key)}
    {#if cards.length === 0 && !expanded[stage.key]}
      <DlStrip {stage} onExpand={() => (expanded[stage.key] = true)} />
    {:else}
      <DlLane
        {stage}
        {cards}
        stages={model.stageDefs}
        {peekId}
        {firstNeedsId}
        {onPeek}
        onPeekClose={closePeek}
        style={peekLane === stage.key ? 'z-index: 5;' : undefined}
        onCollapse={cards.length === 0 ? () => (expanded[stage.key] = false) : undefined}
      />
    {/if}
  {/each}
</section>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/PlanView.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Plan: the open board as a board, a list or its projects, inside the shell. */
  import { getUsage } from '$lib/api';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { viewport } from '$lib/viewport.svelte';
  import { BOARD_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import AppShell from '$lib/components/shell/AppShell.svelte';
  import { shellModel } from '$lib/components/shell/shell-model.svelte';
  import { buildBoardModel } from '$lib/components/board/board-model';
  import DlGreeting from '$lib/components/board/daylight/DlGreeting.svelte';
  import ListView from './ListView.svelte';
  import ProjectView from './ProjectView.svelte';

  const vibe = $derived(appearance.value.vibe);

  /** The week's spend, for the Studio figures; fetched once per board. */
  let spend7d = $state<number | null>(null);
  $effect(() => {
    const id = app.board?.boardId;
    if (!id) return;
    let live = true;
    app.markBusy(getUsage(id, '7d').then((u) => { if (live) spend7d = u.totalCostUsd; }, () => { if (live) spend7d = null; }));
    return () => { live = false; };
  });

  const me = $derived(app.user ? { id: app.user.userId, name: shellModel.userName, initials: shellModel.initials } : null);
  const model = $derived(
    app.board ? buildBoardModel(app.board, app.filteredCards(), { agents: app.agents, members: app.members, labels: app.labelById(), nowMs: Date.now(), me, spend7d }) : null,
  );
  const greet = $derived(vibe === 'daylight' && app.view === 'board' && !viewport.phone && model !== null && model.counts.all > 0);
</script>

{#snippet dlSky()}{#if model}<DlGreeting {model} phase={appearance.phase} firstName={shellModel.firstName} />{/if}{/snippet}

<AppShell
  here="plan"
  section={app.view}
  boardName={app.board?.name ?? null}
  view={app.view}
  showing={shellModel.showing}
  paperShowing={shellModel.paperShowing}
  editionCount={shellModel.editionCount}
  studioSubRight={shellModel.studioSubRight}
  status={shellModel.status}
  sky={greet ? dlSky : undefined}
>
  {#if model && app.view === 'board'}
    {@const Board = BOARD_LAYOUTS[vibe][viewport.phone ? 'phone' : 'desktop']}
    <Board {model} {vibe} phase={appearance.phase} onCompose={() => app.requestCompose()} />
  {:else if app.view === 'list'}
    <ListView />
  {:else if app.view === 'projects'}
    <ProjectView />
  {/if}
</AppShell>
```
