```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

// Daylight's peek (Board-Daylight §3.4): from 1440px, pointing at or focusing a tile opens a peek
// beside it after 300 ms; Esc or "Close peek" shuts it and puts focus back on the title.

const BOARD_KEY = 'superpipeline.boardId';
const API = 'http://localhost:8787';
const TENANT = { 'X-Tenant-Id': 'tnt_dev', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
const STAGES = [
  { key: 'backlog', name: 'Backlog', order: 0 },
  { key: 'done', name: 'Done', order: 1 },
];

test.beforeEach(async ({ page, request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name: 'E2E board', stages: STAGES } });
  const boardId = (await res.json()).boardId as string;
  await page.addInitScript(([key, id]) => window.localStorage.setItem(key, id), [BOARD_KEY, boardId]);
});

async function compose(page: Page, title: string) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New card' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Card title').fill(title);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dispatch' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-card-id]', { hasText: title })).toBeVisible();
}
const titleOf = (page: Page, t: string) => page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(`^${t}, in `) });
const peek = (page: Page) => page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Peek' });

test('at 1440px pointing at a tile opens its peek, and the peek opens the card', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  await page.goto('/');
  await compose(page, 'First peek card');
  await compose(page, 'Second peek card');
  await titleOf(page, 'Second peek card').hover();
  await expect(peek(page).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Second peek card' })).toBeVisible();
  await titleOf(page, 'First peek card').hover();
  await expect(peek(page).getByRole('heading', { name: 'First peek card' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(peek(page)).toHaveCount(1);
  await peek(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Open card to read it all' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog').getByText('First peek card').first()).toBeVisible();
});

test('focus opens the peek; Esc closes it, keeps focus on the title and does not reopen', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  await page.goto('/');
  await compose(page, 'Focus peek card');
  await titleOf(page, 'Focus peek card').focus();
  await expect(peek(page).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Focus peek card' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(peek(page)).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(titleOf(page, 'Focus peek card')).toBeFocused();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  await expect(peek(page)).toHaveCount(0);
});

test('Close peek closes it', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  await page.goto('/');
  await compose(page, 'Closable peek card');
  await titleOf(page, 'Closable peek card').hover();
  await peek(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close peek' }).click();
  await expect(peek(page)).toHaveCount(0);
});

test('below 1440px there is no peek', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
  await page.goto('/');
  await compose(page, 'Narrow card');
  await titleOf(page, 'Narrow card').hover();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  await expect(peek(page)).toHaveCount(0);
});
```

```ts
// ── Paper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface PaperKicker { text: string; live: boolean; none: string | null }
/** Column 1's kicker: the only signal-coloured heading on the page, and only while something waits. */
export const paperKicker = (needs: number): PaperKicker =>
  needs === 0 ? { text: 'Waiting on you', live: false, none: 'Nothing waits on you.' } : { text: `Waiting on you · ${plural(needs, 'letter', 'letters')}`, live: true, none: null };
/** Any other column kicker: "Coming up · 2", or the bare label and a line saying it is empty. */
export const paperSection = (label: string, n: number, none: string): { text: string; none: string | null } =>
  n === 0 ? { text: label, none } : { text: `${label} · ${n}`, none: null };
/** What a lead story quotes: the agent's words verbatim, or the instruction for an unowned stage. */
export const paperQuote = (s: CardSummary): string | null => (s.urgency === 'needs' ? s.stopReason : null);

export type PaperBy =
  | { mark: 'person'; name: string; initials: string; em: string; rest: string }
  | { mark: 'agent'; name: string; mood: Mood; em: string; rest: string }
  | { mark: 'check'; em: string; rest: string }
  | { mark: 'none'; em: string; rest: string };

export function paperBy(s: CardSummary, terminalName: string): PaperBy {
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { mark: 'check', em: terminalName, rest: `· ${s.stageName}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return { mark: 'none', em: 'Closed', rest: `· ${s.stageName}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return { mark: 'none', em: 'Unclaimed', rest: `· ${s.stageName} · ${s.blocked ? 'starts when unblocked' : 'waiting to be picked up'}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') {
    const a = s.delegate ?? s.lastAgent;
    return a ? { mark: 'agent', name: a.name, mood: 'working', em: a.name, rest: `· ${s.stageName} · working` } : { mark: 'none', em: 'Working', rest: `· ${s.stageName}` };
  }
  const a = s.lastAgent ?? s.delegate;
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner' || !a) {
    return { mark: 'person', name: s.owner.name, initials: s.owner.initials, em: s.owner.isMe ? 'With you' : `With ${s.owner.name}`, rest: `· ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageShort}` };
  }
  const tries = s.attemptCount <= 1 ? 'attempt 1' : `${s.attemptCount} attempts`;
  return { mark: 'agent', name: a.name, mood: 'needs', em: a.name, rest: `· ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageShort} · ${tries}` };
}

export interface PaperFact { text: string; cls?: 'ref' | 'due'; icon?: 'blocked' }
/** `.pp-facts`, in the reference's order: priority, labels, reference, blocked, asked by, due. */
export function paperFacts(s: CardSummary): PaperFact[] {
  const out: PaperFact[] = [];
  if (s.priority > 0) out.push({ text: `P${s.priority}` });
  if (s.labelsAll > 0) {
    const names = s.labels.map((l) => l.name);
    if (s.moreLabels > 0) names.push(`+${s.moreLabels}`);
    out.push({ text: names.join(' · ') });
  }
  if (s.firstRef) out.push({ text: s.firstRef.title ?? s.firstRef.url, cls: 'ref' });
  if (s.blocked) out.push({ text: 'Blocked', icon: 'blocked' });
  if (s.queuedBy) out.push({ text: `asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}` });
  if (s.dueAt) out.push(s.overdue ? { text: `Overdue · due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}`, cls: 'due' } : { text: `Due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}` });
  return out;
}
/** The signal-washed reply button of a lead story. */
export function paperReply(s: CardSummary): CardAction | null {
  if (s.urgency !== 'needs') return null;
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { label: 'Move to a stage someone works', does: 'move' };
  return needsAction(s.kind);
}
/** One stage of the pipeline strip: its count, then blocked, the gate, and who works it. */
export function pipelineParts(st: BoardStage): { n: string; extra: string[] } {
  const extra: string[] = [];
  if (st.blocked > 0) extra.push(`${st.blocked} blocked`);
  if (st.gate) extra.push('approval gate');
  extra.push(st.ownerLong);
  return { n: st.count === 0 ? 'empty' : plural(st.count, 'card', 'cards'), extra };
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/paper/PaperStory.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** One story on the Paper board (SB §4.1). A lead story quotes its agent; the quote clamps at 3 lines. */
  import './paper.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import Initials from '$lib/components/parts/Initials.svelte';
  import CardMoveMenu from '../CardMoveMenu.svelte';
  import { cardKeys, openLabel } from '../open-label';
  import { paperBy, paperFacts, paperQuote, paperReply } from '../board-words';
  import type { CardSummary } from '../card-summary';

  let { s, size, stages, terminalName, boardId }: { s: CardSummary; size: 'lead' | 'small'; stages: Stage[]; terminalName: string; boardId: string } = $props();

  let moveOpen = $state(false);
  let menu = $state<ReturnType<typeof CardMoveMenu>>();
  const quote = $derived(paperQuote(s));
  const by = $derived(paperBy(s, terminalName));
  const facts = $derived(paperFacts(s));
  const reply = $derived(paperReply(s));
  const href = $derived(`/b/${boardId}/c/${s.id}`);

  // "Read the rest" exists only when the quote really overflows its three lines.
  let quoteEl = $state<HTMLElement>();
  let measured = $state(false);
  let clamped = $state(false);
  let expanded = $state(false);
  $effect(() => {
    if (!quoteEl || measured) return;
    clamped = quoteEl.scrollHeight > quoteEl.clientHeight + 1;
    measured = true;
  });

  /** A plain click opens the drawer here; a modified click keeps the link's own behaviour (new tab). */
  function open(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    app.openCard(s.id);
  }
  function doReply(): void {
    if (reply?.does === 'move') moveOpen = true;
    else app.openCard(s.id);
  }
</script>

<article class="pp-story pp-{size}" data-card-id={s.id}>
  <h3><a {href} aria-label={openLabel({ title: s.title, stageName: s.stageName })} onclick={open} onkeydown={(e) => cardKeys(e, { open: () => app.openCard(s.id), toggleMove: () => (moveOpen = !moveOpen), step: (d) => menu?.step(d) })}>{s.title}</a></h3>
  {#if quote}
    <blockquote bind:this={quoteEl} class="pp-quote" class:pp-clamp={!expanded && (!measured || clamped)} style="margin: 0px;">“{quote}”</blockquote>
    {#if clamped}<button class="pp-more" type="button" aria-expanded={expanded} onclick={() => (expanded = !expanded)}>{expanded ? 'Show less' : 'Read the rest'}</button>{/if}
  {/if}
  <div class="pp-by">
    {#if by.mark === 'person'}<Initials text={by.initials} label={by.name} size={24} fontSize={9} />
    {:else if by.mark === 'agent'}<Face id={by.name} label={by.name} mood={by.mood} size={24} />
    {:else if by.mark === 'check'}<Icon name="check" size={18} strokeWidth={1.8} />{/if}
    <em>{by.em}</em>{by.rest}
  </div>
  {#if facts.length > 0}
    <div class="pp-facts">
      {#each facts as f, i (i)}<span class={f.cls}>{#if f.icon}<Icon name={f.icon} size={13} strokeWidth={1.8} />{/if}{f.text}</span>{/each}
    </div>
  {/if}
  <div class="pp-acts">
    {#if reply}<button class="pp-btn reply" type="button" onclick={doReply}>{reply.label}</button>{/if}
    <a class="pp-btn" {href} aria-label="Open {s.title}" onclick={open}>Open<Icon name="arrow" size={16} strokeWidth={1.8} /></a>
    <button class="pp-btn ghost" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={moveOpen} aria-label="Move {s.title} to another stage" onclick={() => (moveOpen = !moveOpen)}><Icon name="move" size={16} strokeWidth={1.8} />Move</button>
  </div>
  <CardMoveMenu bind:this={menu} bind:open={moveOpen} card={s.card} {stages} bare />
</article>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/layouts/BoardPaper.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Paper desktop board: the front page (SB §4.1). The masthead and its h1 are the shell's. */
  import '../paper/paper.css';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import { paperKicker, paperSection } from '../board-words';
  import PaperPipeline from '../paper/PaperPipeline.svelte';
  import PaperStory from '../paper/PaperStory.svelte';
  import type { BoardLayoutProps } from './types';

  let { model, onCompose }: BoardLayoutProps = $props();

  const terminal = $derived(model.stages[model.stages.length - 1]?.name ?? 'Done');
  const wait = $derived(paperKicker(model.counts.needs));
  const progress = $derived(paperSection('In progress', model.working.length, 'Nothing in progress.'));
  const coming = $derived(paperSection('Coming up', model.queued.length, 'Nothing is coming up.'));
  const shipped = $derived(paperSection(terminal, model.done.length, `Nothing in ${terminal} yet.`));
  const closed = $derived(paperSection('Closed', model.closed.length, 'No card has been closed.'));
</script>

<main class="pp">
  <div class="pp-cols">
    <section class="pp-col" aria-labelledby="pp-wait">
      <h2 class="pp-kicker" class:live={wait.live} id="pp-wait">{wait.text}</h2>
      {#if wait.none}<p class="pp-none">{wait.none}</p>{/if}
      {#each model.needs as s (s.id)}<PaperStory {s} size="lead" stages={model.stageDefs} terminalName={terminal} boardId={model.boardId} />{/each}
    </section>
    <section class="pp-col" aria-label="In progress and coming up">
      <h2 class="pp-kicker">{progress.text}</h2>
      {#if progress.none}<p class="pp-none">{progress.none}</p>{/if}
      {#each model.working as s (s.id)}<PaperStory {s} size="small" stages={model.stageDefs} terminalName={terminal} boardId={model.boardId} />{/each}
      <h2 class="pp-kicker">{coming.text}</h2>
      {#if coming.none}<p class="pp-none">{coming.none}</p>{/if}
      {#each model.queued as s (s.id)}<PaperStory {s} size="small" stages={model.stageDefs} terminalName={terminal} boardId={model.boardId} />{/each}
    </section>
    <section class="pp-col" aria-label="{terminal} and closed">
      <h2 class="pp-kicker">{shipped.text}</h2>
      {#if shipped.none}<p class="pp-none">{shipped.none}</p>{/if}
      {#each model.done as s (s.id)}<PaperStory {s} size="small" stages={model.stageDefs} terminalName={terminal} boardId={model.boardId} />{/each}
      <h2 class="pp-kicker" style="margin-top: 26px;">{closed.text}</h2>
      {#if closed.none}<p class="pp-none">{closed.none}</p>{/if}
      {#each model.closed as s (s.id)}<PaperStory {s} size="small" stages={model.stageDefs} terminalName={terminal} boardId={model.boardId} />{/each}
      <div class="pp-write">
        <h3>Write a new card</h3>
        <p>Describe it in a sentence; an agent drafts the brief.</p>
        <button class="pp-btn" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={onCompose}><Icon name="plus" size={16} strokeWidth={1.8} />New card</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
  <PaperPipeline stages={model.stages} />
</main>
```

```ts
    expect(panelHeading(0)).toEqual({ kick: 'Needs you now · 0', h2: 'Nothing is waiting for a decision', p: null });
  });
  it('panel text and actions', () => {
    expect(m.needs.map(panelText)).toEqual([
      'No agent works this stage and no review is asked for here, so it will sit forever. Move it to a stage someone works.',
      'Stopped. Needs a writable Forge URL for agentpod.',
      'Stopped. Missing commit ×2.',
      'Stopped. No fresh DM event to trace; needs one per agent.',
    ]);
    expect(m.needs.map((s) => panelAction(s).label)).toEqual(['Move it', 'Read why and resume', 'Read why and resume', 'Read why and resume']);
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/studio/studio-prose.ts
/**
 * The Studio board's report prose (SB §4.2), pure functions of the board model. The hero sentence,
 * the notes and the multiples share one footnote numbering, set by `buildBoardModel`.
 */
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { firstSentence, joinAnd, lcFirst, numWord, plural } from '$lib/words';
import type { BoardModel, BoardStage, Unit } from '../board-model';
import { daysOverdue, dueLong, dueShort, isStopped, needsAction, type CardAction } from '../board-words';
import type { CardSummary } from '../card-summary';

export const pad2 = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
export const fmtUsd = (n: number | null): string => (n === null ? '—' : `$${n.toFixed(2)}`);
const cap = (s: string): string => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
const terminalOf = (m: BoardModel): string => m.stages[m.stages.length - 1]?.name ?? 'Done';

export type Quick = 'all' | 'needs' | 'working' | 'queued' | 'done';
export function quickFilters(m: BoardModel): Array<{ key: Quick; label: string; n: number; sig: boolean }> {
  return [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All', n: m.counts.all, sig: false },
    { key: 'needs', label: 'Need you', n: m.counts.needs, sig: true },
    { key: 'working', label: 'Working', n: m.counts.working, sig: false },
    { key: 'queued', label: 'Queued', n: m.counts.queued, sig: false },
    { key: 'done', label: 'Done', n: m.counts.done, sig: false },
  ];
}
export const quickMatch = (s: CardSummary, q: Quick): boolean => q === 'all' || s.urgency === q;

export function heroH1(m: BoardModel): { sr: string | null; text: string } {
  const { all, needs } = m.counts;
  if (needs === 0) return { sr: null, text: `None of the ${all} ${all === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} is waiting on a person` };
  return { sr: `${needs} `, text: `of ${all} ${all === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} ${needs === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} waiting on a person` };
}

export interface Clause { text: string; fn: number }
function needsClause(s: CardSummary, nowMs: number): string {
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') {
    if (!s.overdue || !s.dueAt) return 'one sits in a stage nobody works';
    const d = daysOverdue(s.dueAt, nowMs);
    return `one sits in a stage nobody works and is ${numWord(d)} ${d === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} overdue`;
  }
  if (isStopped(s.kind)) return s.attemptCount <= 1 ? `one stopped in ${s.stageName} on its first try` : `one stopped in ${s.stageName} after ${numWord(s.attemptCount)} tries`;
  if (s.kind === 'question') return `one asks a question in ${s.stageName}`;
  if (s.kind === 'review') return `one waits for your review in ${s.stageName}`;
  return `one waits on you in ${s.stageName}`;
}
/** The hero paragraph, one clause per footnote. Each clause carries its own leading space. */
export function heroSentence(m: BoardModel): Clause[] {
  const out: Clause[] = m.needs.map((s, i, all) => ({
    text: `${i === 0 ? cap(needsClause(s, m.nowMs)) : ` ${needsClause(s, m.nowMs)}`}${i === all.length - 1 ? '.' : ';'}`,
    fn: s.fnNumber,
  }));
  const qb = m.queued.filter((s) => s.blocked);
  const more = m.needs.length > 0 ? ' more' : '';
  const tail: Clause[] = [];
  if (qb.length) tail.push({ text: `${numWord(qb.length, true)}${more} ${qb.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} queued behind a blocker`, fn: qb[0]!.fnNumber });
  if (m.done.length) tail.push({ text: `${numWord(m.done.length)} ${m.done.length === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} shipped`, fn: m.done[0]!.fnNumber });
  const lead = out.length ? ' ' : '';
  if (tail.length === 2) {
    out.push({ text: `${lead}${cap(tail[0]!.text)},`, fn: tail[0]!.fn }, { text: ` and ${tail[1]!.text}.`, fn: tail[1]!.fn });
  } else if (tail.length === 1) {
    out.push({ text: `${lead}${cap(tail[0]!.text)}.`, fn: tail[0]!.fn });
  }
  return out;
}

export interface Figure { value: string; label: string; sig: boolean; zero: boolean; fn: number | null }
export function studioFigures(m: BoardModel): Figure[] {
  const c = m.counts;
  return [
    { value: String(c.all), label: 'Cards', sig: false, zero: c.all === 0, fn: null },
    { value: String(c.needs), label: 'Need you', sig: c.needs > 0, zero: c.needs === 0, fn: null },
    { value: String(c.working), label: 'Working', sig: false, zero: c.working === 0, fn: null },
    { value: fmtUsd(m.spend7d), label: 'Spend this week', sig: false, zero: !m.spend7d, fn: m.fn.spend },
    { value: String(c.overBudget), label: 'Over budget', sig: false, zero: c.overBudget === 0, fn: null },
    { value: String(c.overdue), label: 'Overdue', sig: false, zero: c.overdue === 0, fn: null },
  ];
}

export interface Multiple { stage: BoardStage; href: string; band: string; zero: boolean; units: Unit[]; gate: string | null; note: { text: string; fn: number | null }; aria: string }
export function multiplesNote(st: BoardStage, cards: CardSummary[]): { text: string; fn: number | null } {
  if (cards.length === 0) return { text: 'Empty', fn: null };
  if (cards.every((s) => s.urgency === 'done')) return { text: 'Done', fn: cards[0]!.fnNumber };
  const needs = cards.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'needs');
  if (cards.length === 1 && needs.length === 1) {
    const s = needs[0]!;
    if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { text: s.overdue && s.dueAt ? `Overdue since ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}` : 'Waiting on you', fn: s.fnNumber };
    if (isStopped(s.kind)) return { text: s.attemptCount > 1 ? `Stopped after ${s.attemptCount} tries` : 'Stopped on its first try', fn: s.fnNumber };
    return { text: 'Waiting on you', fn: s.fnNumber };
  }
  const count = (f: (s: CardSummary) => boolean) => cards.filter(f).length;
  const parts = [
    [count((s) => s.urgency === 'queued' && !!s.blocked), 'blocked'],
    [needs.length, 'stopped'],
    [count((s) => s.urgency === 'working'), 'working'],
    [count((s) => s.urgency === 'queued' && !s.blocked), 'queued'],
    [count((s) => s.urgency === 'done'), 'done'],
  ] as const;
  return { text: parts.filter(([n]) => n > 0).map(([n, w]) => `${n} ${w}`).join(', '), fn: (needs[0] ?? cards[0]!).fnNumber };
}
const UNIT_WORD: Record<Unit, string> = { needs: 'waiting on you', blocked: 'blocked', queued: 'queued', working: 'working', done: 'done', off: 'closed' };
function multiplesWho(st: BoardStage): string {
  if (st.gate) return 'Approval gate, a person';
  if (st.owner.kind === 'human') return st.terminal ? 'A person' : 'Worked by a person';
  if (st.declaredBy.length === 1) return `Worked by ${st.declaredBy[0]}`;
  return cap(st.ownerLong.replace(' · ', ', '));
}
/** Reproduces the reference's seven labels (X-5): one state is named bare, several are counted. */
export function multiplesAria(st: BoardStage): string {
  const kinds = [...new Set(st.units)];
  const state = kinds.length === 0 ? '' : kinds.length === 1 ? `, ${UNIT_WORD[kinds[0]!]}` : kinds.map((k) => `, ${st.units.filter((u) => u === k).length} ${UNIT_WORD[k]}`).join('');
  return `Stage ${st.index}, ${st.name}: ${plural(st.count, 'card', 'cards')}${state}. ${multiplesWho(st)}`;
}
export function multiples(m: BoardModel): Multiple[] {
  return m.stages.map((st) => ({
    stage: st,
    href: `#stage-${st.index}`,
    band: `c${Math.min(st.index, 7)}`,
    zero: st.count === 0,
    units: st.units,
    gate: st.gate ? 'Gate · approval' : null,
    note: multiplesNote(st, m.ordered.filter((s) => s.stageKey === st.key)),
    aria: multiplesAria(st),
  }));
}

export const rampAria = (s: CardSummary, stageNames: string[]): string =>
  `Stage ${s.stageIndex + 1} of ${s.stageCount}: ${s.stageName}${s.urgency === 'needs' && isStopped(s.kind) ? ', stopped' : ''}. Stages: ${stageNames.join(', ')}`;

export interface Share { cols: string; aria: string; parts: Array<{ n: number; label: string; signal: boolean; bar: Unit }> }
export function shareBar(m: BoardModel): Share {
  const allBlocked = m.queued.length > 0 && m.queued.every((s) => s.blocked);
  const segs = [
    { n: m.counts.needs, label: 'waiting on you', aria: 'waiting on you', signal: true, bar: 'needs' as Unit },
    { n: m.counts.queued, label: allBlocked ? 'queued, blocked' : 'queued', aria: allBlocked ? 'queued and blocked' : 'queued', signal: false, bar: (allBlocked ? 'blocked' : 'queued') as Unit },
    { n: m.counts.working, label: 'working', aria: 'working', signal: false, bar: 'working' as Unit },
    { n: m.counts.done, label: 'done', aria: 'done', signal: false, bar: 'done' as Unit },
    { n: m.counts.closed, label: 'closed', aria: 'closed', signal: false, bar: 'off' as Unit },
  ].filter((s) => s.n > 0);
  return {
    cols: segs.map((s) => `${s.n}fr`).join(' '),
    aria: segs.map((s) => `${s.n} ${s.aria}`).join(', '),
    parts: segs.map(({ n, label, signal, bar }) => ({ n, label, signal, bar })),
  };
}

export type NotePart = string | { i: string };
export const noteText = (parts: NotePart[]): string => parts.map((p) => (typeof p === 'string' ? p : `<i>${p.i}</i>`)).join('');
const lineOf = (s: CardSummary): string => s.summaryLine ?? firstSentence(s.stopReason ?? '');
function needsNote(s: CardSummary): NotePart[] {
  const ix = pad2(s.ix);
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') {
    const whose = s.owner.isMe ? 'yours' : `${s.owner.name}’s`;
    return [`Card ${ix} is ${whose}, in ${s.stageName}.`, ...(s.dueAt ? [' It was due on ', { i: dueLong(s.dueAt) }, '.'] : []), ' No agent works this stage and no review is asked for here, so it will sit until it is moved.'];
  }
  if (isStopped(s.kind)) {
    if (s.attemptCount <= 1) return [`Card ${ix} stopped on ${s.lastAgent?.name ?? 'its agent'}’s first try, ${s.ageLong} ago: it ${lcFirst(lineOf(s))}`];
    return [`Card ${ix} stopped in ${s.stageName} after ${numWord(s.attemptCount)} tries: ${lcFirst(lineOf(s))}`];
  }
  if (s.kind === 'question') return [`Card ${ix} asks a question in ${s.stageName}: ${s.stopReason ?? ''}`];
  if (s.kind === 'review') return [`Card ${ix} waits for your review in ${s.stageName}.`];
  return [`Card ${ix} waits on you in ${s.stageName}.`];
}
function groupNote(cs: CardSummary[], one: (ix: string, stage: string) => string, many: (ixs: string, stage: string) => string): NotePart[] {
  const stages = joinAnd([...new Set(cs.map((s) => s.stageName))]);
  return [cs.length === 1 ? one(pad2(cs[0]!.ix), stages) : many(joinAnd(cs.map((s) => pad2(s.ix))), stages)];
}
export function studioNotes(m: BoardModel): Array<{ n: number; parts: NotePart[] }> {
  const out = m.needs.map((s) => ({ n: s.fnNumber, parts: needsNote(s) }));
  const titles = (cs: CardSummary[]) => `${cs.map((s) => s.title).join('; ')}.`;
  const groups: Array<[CardSummary[], (cs: CardSummary[]) => NotePart[]]> = [
    [m.working, (cs) => groupNote(cs, (ix) => `Card ${ix} is being worked on now.`, (ixs) => `Cards ${ixs} are being worked on now.`)],
    [m.queued.filter((s) => s.blocked), (cs) => groupNote(cs,
      (ix, st) => `Card ${ix} is queued in ${st} behind another card. Nobody has claimed it; it starts on its own when unblocked.`,
      (ixs, st) => `Cards ${ixs} are queued in ${st} behind another card. Nobody has claimed them; each starts on its own when unblocked.`)],
    [m.queued.filter((s) => !s.blocked), (cs) => groupNote(cs,
      (ix, st) => `Card ${ix} is queued in ${st}, waiting for an agent to claim it.`,
      (ixs, st) => `Cards ${ixs} are queued in ${st}, waiting for an agent to claim them.`)],
    [m.done, (cs) => [`${terminalOf(m)}, nothing to do: `, { i: titles(cs) }]],
    [m.closed, (cs) => ['Closed, nothing to do: ', { i: titles(cs) }]],
  ];
  for (const [cs, note] of groups) if (cs.length) out.push({ n: cs[0]!.fnNumber, parts: note(cs) });
  const spend: NotePart[] =
    m.spend7d === null ? ['Spend this week could not be read.']
    : m.spend7d === 0 ? ['No card has spent anything yet: every card’s cost reads ', { i: '—' }, '.']
    : [`The board spent ${fmtUsd(m.spend7d)} this week.`];
  out.push({ n: m.fn.spend, parts: spend });
  return out;
}

export function panelHeading(n: number): { kick: string; h2: string; p: string | null } {
  if (n === 0) return { kick: 'Needs you now · 0', h2: 'Nothing is waiting for a decision', p: null };
  return { kick: `Needs you now · ${n}`, h2: `${numWord(n, true)} ${n === 1 ? 'card is' : 'cards are'} waiting for a decision`, p: 'Each one says what it needs. Answer here, or open the card for the whole story.' };
}
export function panelText(s: CardSummary): string {
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return s.stopReason ?? '';
  if (isStopped(s.kind)) return `Stopped. ${lineOf(s)}`;
  return s.stopReason ?? 'Waiting on you.';
}
export function panelAction(s: CardSummary): CardAction {
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { label: 'Move it', does: 'move' };
  if (isStopped(s.kind)) return { label: 'Read why and resume', does: 'open' };
  return needsAction(s.kind) ?? { label: 'Open', does: 'open' };
}

export function rowState(s: CardSummary): { label: string; unit: Unit; needs: boolean } {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') return { label: 'Waiting on you', unit: 'needs', needs: true };
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return s.blocked ? { label: 'Queued · blocked', unit: 'blocked', needs: false } : { label: 'Queued', unit: 'queued', needs: false };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return { label: 'Working', unit: 'working', needs: false };
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { label: 'Done', unit: 'done', needs: false };
  return { label: 'Closed', unit: 'off', needs: false };
}
export type RowAgent =
  | { kind: 'person'; name: string; initials: string; text: string; me: boolean }
  | { kind: 'agent'; name: string; mood: Mood }
  | { kind: 'text'; text: string };
export function rowAgent(s: CardSummary): RowAgent {
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { kind: 'text', text: s.stageName };
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return { kind: 'text', text: 'Closed' };
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return { kind: 'text', text: 'Unclaimed' };
  const a = s.urgency === 'working' ? (s.delegate ?? s.lastAgent) : (s.lastAgent ?? s.delegate);
  if (a && s.kind !== 'no-owner') return { kind: 'agent', name: a.name, mood: s.urgency === 'working' ? 'working' : 'needs' };
  return { kind: 'person', name: s.owner.name, initials: s.owner.initials, text: s.owner.isMe ? 'You' : s.owner.name, me: s.owner.isMe };
}
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import type { Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import FaceSvg from '$lib/components/parts/FaceSvg.svelte';
  import CardMoveMenu from '../CardMoveMenu.svelte';
  import type { CardSummary } from '../card-summary';
  import { pad2, panelAction, panelHeading, panelText, rowAgent } from './studio-prose';

  let { cards, stages, boardId }: { cards: CardSummary[]; stages: Stage[]; boardId: string } = $props();
  const head = $derived(panelHeading(cards.length));
  let moving = $state<string | null>(null);
  function open(e: MouseEvent, id: string): void {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    app.openCard(id);
  }
</script>

<aside class="bd-panel" aria-labelledby="bd-nd-h">
  <header>
    <span class="kick">{head.kick}</span>
    <h2 id="bd-nd-h">{head.h2}</h2>
    {#if head.p}<p>{head.p}</p>{/if}
  </header>
  {#each cards as s (s.id)}
    {@const who = rowAgent(s)}
    {@const act = panelAction(s)}
    <article class="bd-need" aria-labelledby="nd-{pad2(s.ix)}" data-card-id={s.id}>
      <div class="row"><span class="mono">{pad2(s.ix)}</span><span class="kick">Waiting on you</span><span class="mono age">{s.ageShort}</span></div>
      <h3 id="nd-{pad2(s.ix)}">{s.title}</h3>
      <div class="by">{#if who.kind === 'agent'}<FaceSvg name={who.name} mood={who.mood} size={20} /><b>{who.name}</b>{:else if who.kind === 'person'}<span class="ar-ini" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: 8px;">{who.initials}</span><b>{who.text}</b>{/if}<span class="stg"><span class="chip c{Math.min(s.stageIndex + 1, 7)}"></span>{s.stageName}</span><span class="mono">{s.stageIndex + 1}/{s.stageCount}</span></div>
      <p class="serif" style="font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.45;">{panelText(s)}</p>
      <div class="acts">
        {#if act.does === 'move'}
          <button class="ar-btn" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" onclick={() => (moving = moving === s.id ? null : s.id)}><Icon name="move" size={15} strokeWidth={1.75} />{act.label}</button><a class="ar-btn2" href="/b/{boardId}/c/{s.id}" onclick={(e) => open(e, s.id)}>Open</a>
        {:else}
          <button class="ar-btn" type="button" onclick={() => app.openCard(s.id)}>{act.label}</button>
        {/if}
      </div>
      <CardMoveMenu card={s.card} {stages} bare open={moving === s.id} />
    </article>
  {/each}
  <dl class="bd-keys" aria-label="Keyboard">
    <dt><span class="kbd">⌘K</span></dt><dd>Search or run a command</dd>
    <dt><span class="kbd">N</span></dt><dd>New card</dd>
    <dt><span class="kbd">F</span></dt><dd>Filter cards</dd>
    <dt><span class="kbd">M</span></dt><dd>Move the selected card</dd>
  </dl>
</aside>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/layouts/BoardStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Studio desktop board: the annual report (SB §4.2). The status line and the sub row are the shell's. */
  import '../studio/studio-board.css';
  import StudioHero from '../studio/StudioHero.svelte';
  import StudioNeedsPanel from '../studio/StudioNeedsPanel.svelte';
  import StudioRow from '../studio/StudioRow.svelte';
  import { multiples, quickFilters, quickMatch, shareBar, studioFigures, studioNotes, type Quick } from '../studio/studio-prose';
  import type { BoardLayoutProps } from './types';

  let { model }: BoardLayoutProps = $props();
  let quick = $state<Quick>('all');
  let sel = $state<number | null>(null);
  let tbody = $state<HTMLElement>();

  const rows = $derived(model.ordered.filter((s) => quickMatch(s, quick)));
  const panel = $derived(model.needs.filter((s) => quickMatch(s, quick)));
  const stageNames = $derived(model.stages.map((s) => s.name));
  const terminal = $derived(model.stages[model.stages.length - 1]?.name ?? 'Done');
  const share = $derived(shareBar(model));
  /** The first row of each stage carries `id="stage-{n}"`, the multiples' link target. */
  const anchors = $derived(new Map(model.stages.flatMap((st) => { const r = rows.find((x) => x.stageKey === st.key); return r ? [[r.id, `stage-${st.index}`] as const] : []; })));

  function rowKeys(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key !== 'ArrowDown' && e.key !== 'ArrowUp') return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1, (sel ?? -1) + (e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1)));
    sel = next;
    tbody?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.ttl')[next]?.focus();
  }
  function toStage(e: MouseEvent, href: string): void {
    e.preventDefault();
    const row = document.getElementById(href.slice(1));
    row?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    row?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ttl')?.focus();
  }
</script>

<div class="bd-grid">
  <main class="bd-main">
    <div class="bd-qf" role="group" aria-label="Quick filter">
      <span class="kick lb">Show</span>
      {#each quickFilters(model) as q (q.key)}
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={quick === q.key} class:sig={q.sig} onclick={() => { quick = q.key; sel = null; }}>{q.label} <b>{q.n}</b></button>
      {/each}
    </div>

    <StudioHero {model} />

    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="bd-fig-h">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="bd-fig-h">The board in figures</h2><span class="r">this week</span></div>
      <div class="ar-figs">
        {#each studioFigures(model) as f (f.label)}<div class:sig={f.sig}><b class:z={f.zero}>{f.value}</b><span>{f.label}{#if f.fn}<sup class="fn">{f.fn}</sup>{/if}</span></div>{/each}
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="bd-sm-h">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">02</span><h2 id="bd-sm-h">Where the cards are, stage by stage</h2><span class="r">1 square = 1 card · stages darken towards {terminal}</span></div>
      <div class="ar-sm">
        {#each multiples(model) as x (x.stage.key)}
          <a class="ar-mul" class:z={x.zero} href={x.href} aria-label={x.aria} onclick={(e) => toStage(e, x.href)}><span class="band {x.band}"></span><span class="lb"><span class="mono">{String(x.stage.index).padStart(2, '0')}</span><span class="nm">{x.stage.name}</span></span><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">{x.stage.count}</span><span class="units" aria-hidden="true">{#each x.units as u, i (i)}<span class="u {u}"></span>{/each}</span>{#if x.gate}<span class="gate">{x.gate}</span>{/if}<span class="who">{x.stage.ownerLong}</span><span class="note">{x.note.text}{#if x.note.fn}<sup class="fn">{x.note.fn}</sup>{/if}</span></a>
        {/each}
      </div>
    </section>

    {#if share.parts.length}
      <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="bd-st-h">
        <div class="hd"><span class="no">03</span><h2 id="bd-st-h">What state they are in</h2><span class="r">share of {model.counts.all} {model.counts.all === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}</span></div>
        <div class="ar-share" role="img" aria-label={share.aria} style="grid-template-columns: {share.cols};">
          {#each share.parts as p (p.bar)}<span class="lab" class:s={p.signal}><b>{p.n}</b>{p.label}</span>{/each}
          {#each share.parts as p (p.bar)}<i class={p.bar}></i>{/each}
        </div>
      </section>
    {/if}

    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="bd-tb-h">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">04</span><h2 id="bd-tb-h">Every card, people needed first</h2><span class="r"><span><span class="kbd">↑</span> <span class="kbd">↓</span> row</span><span><span class="kbd">Enter</span> open</span><span><span class="kbd">M</span> move</span><span><span class="kbd">Alt</span> + <span class="kbd">←</span> <span class="kbd">→</span> stage</span></span></div>
      <table class="ar-tbl">
        <caption class="sr">{model.counts.all} {model.counts.all === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}, people needed first</caption>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col" style="width: 32px;">No.</th><th scope="col">Card</th><th scope="col" style="width: 116px;">Stage</th><th scope="col" style="width: 112px;">Agent</th><th scope="col" style="width: 44px;">Tries</th><th scope="col" style="width: 44px;">Age</th><th scope="col" style="width: 92px;">Due</th><th scope="col" style="width: 140px;">State</th><th scope="col" style="width: 84px;"><span class="sr">Move</span></th></tr></thead>
        <tbody bind:this={tbody} onkeydown={rowKeys}>
          {#each rows as s, i (s.id)}
            <StudioRow {s} stages={model.stageDefs} {stageNames} selected={sel === i} anchor={anchors.get(s.id)} onSelect={() => (sel = i)} />
          {/each}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section aria-labelledby="bd-fn-h">
      <h2 id="bd-fn-h" class="sr">Notes</h2>
      <ol class="ar-notes">
        {#each studioNotes(model) as note (note.n)}
          <li><span class="k">{note.n}</span><span>{#each note.parts as p, i (i)}{#if typeof p === 'string'}{p}{:else}<i>{p.i}</i>{/if}{/each}</span></li>
        {/each}
      </ol>
    </section>
  </main>
  <StudioNeedsPanel cards={panel} stages={model.stageDefs} boardId={model.boardId} />
</div>
```

### Task 17: The Quiet desktop board

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

The board as one plain reading column (`SP-Board-Quiet`, Agent Onboarding: nothing needs you, 20
done cards). Header (h1, "Superpipeline · 20 cards", the lede, "Write a new card"), the urgency groups
with empty ones folded into `.qt-zero` lists, the Done group showing the newest five and a "Show all
20 done cards" toggle, Closed, and the stages table. `SP-Board-Quiet·light` and `·dark` turn green.
Applies: groups in urgency order (needs, in progress, waiting to start, done, closed), done/closed
newest `stateSince` first, Resident and Credentialed read "a person" + "Approval gate" (gate in its
own column), every item plain text with underlined actions, no signal colour when nothing needs you.

```ts
// ── Quiet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const quietSub = (all: number, needs: number): string =>
  `Superpipeline · ${plural(all, 'card', 'cards')}${needs > 0 ? ` · ${needs} need your decision` : ''}`;
export function quietLede(m: BoardModel): string {
  const { all, needs, done } = m.counts;
  if (needs > 0) return `${needs} ${needs === 1 ? 'card needs' : 'cards need'} your decision.`;
  return all > 0 && done === all ? `Nothing needs you. All ${all} cards are done.` : 'Nothing needs you.';
}
export const QUIET_GROUPS = [
  { urgency: 'needs', label: 'Needs your decision', more: 'cards that need your decision' },
  { urgency: 'working', label: 'In progress', more: 'cards in progress' },
  { urgency: 'queued', label: 'Waiting to start', more: 'cards waiting to start' },
  { urgency: 'done', label: 'Done', more: 'done cards' },
  { urgency: 'closed', label: 'Closed', more: 'closed cards' },
] as const;
type QuietUrgency = (typeof QUIET_GROUPS)[number]['urgency'];
export type QuietBlock =
  | { kind: 'zero'; aria: string; labels: string[] }
  | { kind: 'group'; urgency: QuietUrgency; label: string; total: number; cards: CardSummary[]; shown: CardSummary[]; truncated: boolean; moreLabel: string };
/** History groups (done, closed) list the newest first and fold after five. */
const HISTORY = new Set<QuietUrgency>(['done', 'closed']);
export function quietBlocks(m: BoardModel): QuietBlock[] {
  const out: QuietBlock[] = [];
  let seenFull = false;
  let leading: string[] = [];
  for (const g of QUIET_GROUPS) {
    let cards = m.ordered.filter((s) => s.urgency === g.urgency);
    if (cards.length === 0) {
      if (seenFull) out.push({ kind: 'zero', aria: g.label, labels: [g.label] });
      else leading.push(g.label);
      continue;
    }
    if (!seenFull && leading.length) out.push({ kind: 'zero', aria: 'Empty groups', labels: leading });
    leading = [];
    seenFull = true;
    if (HISTORY.has(g.urgency)) cards = [...cards].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.stateSince ?? '') - Date.parse(a.stateSince ?? ''));
    const truncated = HISTORY.has(g.urgency) && cards.length > 5;
    out.push({ kind: 'group', urgency: g.urgency, label: g.label, total: cards.length, cards, shown: truncated ? cards.slice(0, 5) : cards, truncated, moreLabel: `Show all ${cards.length} ${g.more}` });
  }
  if (!seenFull && leading.length) out.push({ kind: 'zero', aria: 'Empty groups', labels: leading });
  return out;
}
const agentOf = (s: CardSummary) => (s.urgency === 'working' ? (s.delegate ?? s.lastAgent) : (s.lastAgent ?? s.delegate));
export function quietMeta(s: CardSummary): string {
  const a = agentOf(s);
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return a ? `Ran by ${a.name} · ${s.stageName} · done ${s.agoWords}` : `${s.stageName} · done ${s.agoWords}`;
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return `Closed · ${s.stageName} · ${s.agoWords}`;
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return `Not picked up yet · ${s.stageName}`;
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return `${a?.name ?? 'An agent'} · ${s.stageName} · working`;
  return `${s.kind !== 'no-owner' && a ? a.name : s.owner.isMe ? 'You' : s.owner.name} · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}`;
}
/** The face beside the meta line (grey in Quiet); null when nobody ran the card. */
export function quietMood(s: CardSummary): Mood | null {
  if (!agentOf(s) || s.urgency === 'queued' || (s.urgency === 'needs' && s.kind === 'no-owner')) return null;
  return s.urgency === 'done' ? 'done' : s.urgency === 'needs' ? 'needs' : s.urgency === 'working' ? 'working' : 'resting';
}
const QUIET_HEAD: Record<QuietUrgency, string> = { needs: 'Needs your decision.', working: 'In progress.', queued: 'Waiting to start.', done: 'Done.', closed: 'Closed.' };
export function quietFacts(s: CardSummary): string {
  const parts: string[] = [QUIET_HEAD[s.urgency]];
  if (s.priority > 0) parts.push(`Priority ${s.priority}.`);
  if (s.labelsAll > 0) parts.push(`Labels: ${s.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ')}${s.moreLabels > 0 ? ` and ${s.moreLabels} more` : ''}.`);
  if (s.blocked) parts.push('Blocked by another card.');
  if (s.firstRef) parts.push(`Reference: ${s.firstRef.title ?? s.firstRef.url}.`);
  if (s.queuedBy) parts.push(`Asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}.`);
  if (s.dueAt) parts.push(`Due ${dueLong(s.dueAt)}${s.overdue ? ', overdue' : ''}.`);
  parts.push(`${plural(s.attemptCount, 'attempt', 'attempts')}.`);
  return parts.join(' ');
}
/** The decision a needs item offers; an unowned stage needs only "Move to another stage", which every item has. */
export const quietAction = (s: CardSummary): CardAction | null => (s.urgency === 'needs' && s.kind !== 'no-owner' ? needsAction(s.kind) : null);
export function quietStageRow(st: BoardStage): { name: string; cards: string; who: string; gate: string } {
  return {
    name: st.name,
    cards: st.count === 0 ? '0 (empty)' : st.blocked > 0 ? `${st.count}, ${st.blocked} blocked` : String(st.count),
    who: st.gate ? st.ownerLong.replace(/ · approval$/, '') : st.ownerLong,
    gate: st.gate ? 'Approval gate' : '—',
  };
}
```

```svelte
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';

  <div class="qt-meta">{#if mood && speaker}<Face id={speaker.name} label={speaker.name} {mood} size={20} />{/if}{quietMeta(s)}</div>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The empty-board words** — append to `board-words.ts` (import `numWord` beside `plural` from `$lib/words`, and `type BoardSnapshot, type Stage` from `$lib/api`):

```ts
// ── Empty board ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const escapeHtml = (s: string): string =>
  s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
/** The board's lede as HTML: only `**bold**` becomes markup; the rest is the board owner's text, escaped. */
export function emptyLedeHtml(intro: BoardSnapshot['intro'], stageCount: number): string {
  if (!intro?.lede) return escapeHtml(`This board has ${numWord(stageCount)} stages.`);
  return escapeHtml(intro.lede).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<b>$1</b>');
}
export const emptyHint = (intro: BoardSnapshot['intro']): string => intro?.composeHint || 'Say what you want in a sentence; an agent drafts the brief.';
export type EmptyWho =
  | { kind: 'initials'; text: string; label: string; name: string }
  | { kind: 'face'; face: string; name: string }
  | { kind: 'none'; name: string };
export function emptyWho(st: StageSummary, me: { name: string; initials: string } | null): EmptyWho {
  if (st.owner.kind === 'human') {
    if (st.gate) return { kind: 'initials', text: me?.initials ?? 'P', label: me?.name ?? 'A person', name: 'you decide' };
    return { kind: 'initials', text: 'P', label: 'A person', name: 'a person' };
  }
  if (st.owner.kind === 'agent') return { kind: 'face', face: st.owner.label, name: st.owner.label };
  const d = st.declaredBy;
  if (d.length === 0) return { kind: 'none', name: 'nobody yet' };
  return { kind: 'face', face: d[0]!, name: d.length === 1 ? d[0]! : plural(d.length, 'agent', 'agents') };
}
export function emptyTags(st: StageSummary, def: Stage): Array<{ text: string; g: boolean }> {
  const out: Array<{ text: string; g: boolean }> = [];
  if (st.owner.kind === 'capability' && def.owner) out.push({ text: def.owner, g: false });
  if (st.gate) out.push({ text: 'Approval gate', g: true });
  if (st.wipLimit !== null) out.push({ text: `limit ${st.wipLimit}`, g: false });
  if (st.count === 0) out.push({ text: 'empty', g: false });
  return out;
}
```

```ts
/** What differs between the four empty boards besides CSS (SP-Board-Empty-*). */
export interface EmptyForm {
  /** Paper's masthead already holds the page h1, so its heading is an h2 (`.em-h`). */
  heading: 'h1' | 'h2';
  /** A product pill, or Studio's kicker line. */
  eyebrow: 'pill' | 'kick';
  /** `vk-button vk-button--primary`, or Studio's `.ar-btn`. */
  button: 'vk' | 'ar';
  /** Quiet's skip link targets `#content`. */
  mainId: 'main' | 'content';
}
export const BOARD_EMPTY_FORMS: Readonly<Record<Vibe, EmptyForm>> = {

  paper: { heading: 'h2', eyebrow: 'pill', button: 'vk', mainId: 'main' },
```

```svelte
          </div>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/testing/mount-model.svelte.ts
/** Build a CardModel inside an effect root, the way a component would. Test-only. */
import { flushSync } from 'svelte';
import { CardModel, type CardSource, type CardSurface } from '../card-model.svelte';
import { BOARD_DX, CARD_4605 } from './card-4605';

export function mountModel(o: { surface?: CardSurface; boardId?: string; cardId?: string; holdDetail?: boolean; source?: CardSource } = {}): { model: CardModel; dispose: () => void } {
  let model!: CardModel;
  const dispose = $effect.root(() => {
    model = new CardModel(() => ({ boardId: o.boardId ?? BOARD_DX.boardId, cardId: o.cardId ?? CARD_4605.id, surface: o.surface ?? 'drawer' }), { holdDetail: o.holdDetail, source: o.source });
  });
  flushSync();
  return { model, dispose };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { clockHM, dayMonth, dayMonthLong, weekdayDayMonth, whenLabel, whenLabelLong } from './when';

const NOW = new Date('2026-10-11T08:21:00Z');
const TZ = 'Asia/Kolkata';

describe('when', () => {
  it('says Today for the same local day, else the weekday, day and month', () => {
    expect(whenLabel('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe('Thu 8 Oct, 19:41');
    expect(whenLabel('2026-10-11T07:18:00Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe('Today, 12:48');
    expect(whenLabel('2026-10-11T02:10:00Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe('Today, 07:40');
    expect(whenLabel('2026-10-08T13:56:34.688Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe('Thu 8 Oct, 19:26');
  });
  it('uses the viewer’s day, not UTC’s: 20:00Z on the 10th is already the 11th in Kolkata', () => {
    expect(whenLabel('2026-10-10T20:00:00Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe('Today, 01:30');
  });
  it('has a long form for phones', () => expect(whenLabelLong('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z', TZ)).toBe('Thursday 8 October, 19:41'));
  it('has day-month forms and a 24-hour clock', () => {
    expect(dayMonth('2026-10-09T05:30:00Z', TZ)).toBe('9 Oct');
    expect(dayMonth('2026-10-08T17:55:00.000Z', TZ)).toBe('8 Oct');
    expect(dayMonthLong('2026-10-08T06:04:57.202Z', TZ)).toBe('8 October');
    expect(weekdayDayMonth('2026-10-08T14:11:43Z', TZ)).toBe('Thu 8 Oct');
    expect(clockHM('2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', TZ)).toBe('13:02');
```

```ts
describe('splitTokens', () => {
  it('finds exactly the four id-like tokens in 4605’s detail and never changes the text', () => {
    const parts = splitTokens(DETAIL_4605);
    expect(parts.filter((p) => p.token).map((p) => p.text)).toEqual([
      'acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023',
      'event_id/room_id/timestamp',
      'matrix-inbound/control-pair/ACP/matrix-outbound',
      'matrix_rooms',
    ]);
    expect(parts.map((p) => p.text).join('')).toBe(DETAIL_4605);
  });
  it('the Quiet rule styles only the session id', () => {
    expect(splitTokens(DETAIL_4605, QUIET_TOKEN_RE).filter((p) => p.token).map((p) => p.text)).toEqual(['acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023']);
  });
  it('plain text is one plain part', () => expect(splitTokens('All done, ready for your review.')).toEqual([{ text: 'All done, ready for your review.', token: false }]));
});

describe('sessionIdOf', () => {
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/spec-groups.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { firstParagraph, humanizeKey, specGroups, specRowCount } from './spec-groups';
import { SPEC_4605, VISIBLE } from './testing/card-4605';

describe('humanizeKey', () => {
  it('splits camelCase, capitalises the first word only', () => {
    expect(humanizeKey('latestConfirmedGrant')).toBe('Latest confirmed grant');
    expect(humanizeKey('accountsIssues')).toBe('Accounts issues');
    expect(humanizeKey('requiredEvidence')).toBe('Required evidence');
    expect(humanizeKey('routingRule')).toBe('Routing rule');
    expect(humanizeKey('kind')).toBe('Kind');
  });
  it('a card's own spec.fieldLabels override keys whose label is not mechanical (no names in shipped code)', () => {
    const labels = { messageMelissa: 'Message Melissa' };
    expect(humanizeKey('messageMelissa', labels)).toBe('Message Melissa');
    expect(humanizeKey('messageMelissa')).toBe('Message melissa');
  });
});

describe('firstParagraph', () => {
  it('shows the first paragraph; the rest is behind Show more', () => {
    expect(firstParagraph('One.\n\nTwo.\n\nThree.')).toEqual({ shown: 'One.', more: 'Two.\n\nThree.' });
    expect(firstParagraph('Only one.')).toEqual({ shown: 'Only one.', more: null });
  });
});

describe('specGroups (4605)', () => {
  const groups = specGroups(SPEC_4605, { criteriaHeading: 'Acceptance criteria' });
  it('has the five groups and ten rows, in the card’s own order, and no description/criteria/groups/project rows', () => {
    expect(groups.map((g) => g.label)).toEqual(['What to do', 'Who it is about', 'Background', 'Rules', 'Where work goes']);
    expect(groups.map((g) => g.rows.map((r) => r.label))).toEqual([
      ['Rework', 'Required evidence'], ['Message Melissa', 'Audience Anna'], ['Context', 'Latest confirmed grant'],
      ['Scope', 'Accounts issues'], ['Repository', 'Routing rule'],
    ]);
    expect(specRowCount(groups)).toBe(10);
  });
  it('puts Show more on exactly the five values stored with a continuation', () => {
    const more = groups.flatMap((g) => g.rows).filter((r) => r.value.kind === 'text' && r.value.more !== null).map((r) => r.key);
    expect(more).toEqual(['rework', 'context', 'scope', 'accountsIssues', 'routingRule']);
    const rework = groups[0]!.rows[0]!.value;
    expect(rework).toMatchObject({ kind: 'text', shown: VISIBLE.rework });
    expect(groups[2]!.rows[1]!.value).toEqual({ kind: 'text', shown: VISIBLE.latestConfirmedGrant, more: null });
  });
  it('says where the required evidence is listed, per surface', () => {
    expect(groups[0]!.rows[1]!.value).toEqual({ kind: 'evidence', text: '5 items, listed under Acceptance criteria.' });
    const page = specGroups(SPEC_4605, { criteriaHeading: 'Things to prove' });
    expect(page[0]!.rows[1]!.value).toEqual({ kind: 'evidence', text: '5 items, listed under Things to prove.' });
  });
  it('recognises the matrix-id and repository shapes', () => {
    expect(groups[1]!.rows[0]!.value).toEqual({ kind: 'matrix', matrixId: '@agent_message-melissa:id.agentpod.dev', cardId: 'card_f180b1627c594b41' });
    expect(groups[4]!.rows[0]!.value).toEqual({ kind: 'repo', repo: 'SuperJackfruitLabs/atelier', visibility: 'private', policyUrl: 'https://github.com/SuperJackfruitLabs/atelier/blob/main/AGENTS.md' });
  });
  it('a spec with no groups puts everything under Other details; empty values are dropped', () => {
    expect(specGroups({ description: 'x', role: 'Reviewer', empty: '', nested: { a: 1 } }, { criteriaHeading: 'Acceptance criteria' })).toEqual([
      { label: 'Other details', rows: [
        { key: 'role', label: 'Role', value: { kind: 'text', shown: 'Reviewer', more: null } },
        { key: 'nested', label: 'Nested', value: { kind: 'structured', value: { a: 1 } } },
      ] },
    ]);
    expect(specGroups(null, { criteriaHeading: 'Acceptance criteria' })).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/state-words.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { attemptWord, eventSentence, eventVerb, pillTone, STOP_SENTENCE, stateWord, stopLine, stripAria, stripKind, waitingWord } from './state-words';
import { cardLead } from './card-lead';
import { ACTIVITIES_4605, ATTEMPTS_4605, CARD_4605, STAGES_DX } from './testing/card-4605';

const lead4605 = cardLead({ card: CARD_4605 });
const AGE_4605 = (Date.parse('2026-10-11T08:21:00Z') - Date.parse(CARD_4605.stateSince!)) / 3_600_000;

describe('state words', () => {
  it('4605 waits on you, for two days on desktop', () => {
    expect(stateWord(CARD_4605, lead4605)).toBe('Waiting on you');
    expect(waitingWord(CARD_4605, lead4605, AGE_4605, 'desktop')).toBe('Waiting on you · 2 days');
    expect(waitingWord(CARD_4605, lead4605, AGE_4605, 'phone')).toBe('Waiting on you');
    expect(pillTone(CARD_4605, lead4605)).toBe('needs');
  });
  it('an archived card says Archived and carries no signal', () => {
    const c = { ...CARD_4605, archivedAt: '2026-10-09T05:30:00Z' };
    expect(stateWord(c, lead4605)).toBe('Archived');
    expect(waitingWord(c, lead4605, AGE_4605, 'desktop')).toBe('Archived');
    expect(pillTone(c, lead4605)).toBe('off');
    expect(stripKind(lead4605, true)).toBe('archived');
  });
  it('other states name the state, never the raw value', () => {
    const idle = cardLead({ card: { ...CARD_4605, state: 'submitted', needsHuman: undefined } });
    expect(stateWord({ ...CARD_4605, state: 'submitted' }, idle)).toBe('Queued');
    const done = cardLead({ card: { ...CARD_4605, state: 'completed', needsHuman: undefined } });
    expect(stateWord({ ...CARD_4605, state: 'completed' }, done)).toBe('Done');
    expect(pillTone({ ...CARD_4605, state: 'completed' }, done)).toBe('done');
  });
});

describe('strip aria and the stop line', () => {
  it('drawer, cell and phone forms', () => {
    expect(stripAria(1, 7, 'Reproduce', 'stopped', 'drawer')).toBe('Stages: stage 2 of 7, Reproduce, stopped');
    expect(stripAria(1, 7, 'Reproduce', 'stopped', 'phone')).toBe('Stage 2 of 7, Reproduce, stopped here');
    expect(stripAria(4, 6, 'Recommendation', 'review', 'cell')).toBe('Stage 5 of 6, Recommendation, awaiting review');
    expect(stripAria(2, 5, 'Build', 'question', 'cell')).toBe('Stage 3 of 5, Build, question pending');
    expect(stripAria(2, 8, 'Messaging approval', 'archived', 'cell')).toBe('Stopped at stage 3 of 8, Messaging approval, archived');
  });
  it('says the verb, where, and what comes next', () => {
    expect(stopLine(lead4605, 1, STAGES_DX)).toBe('Stopped in stage 2 of 7. Next: Failing test.');
    expect(stopLine(lead4605, 6, STAGES_DX)).toBe('Stopped in stage 7 of 7.');
  });
});

describe('attempts and events', () => {
  it('derives sent back from a refused completion (plan ruling)', () => {
    expect(ATTEMPTS_4605.map(attemptWord)).toEqual(['sent back', 'stopped']);
    expect(attemptWord({ ...ATTEMPTS_4605[0]!, completion: { ok: true } })).toBe('done');
    expect(attemptWord({ ...ATTEMPTS_4605[0]!, outcome: 'failed', completion: null })).toBe('failed');
    expect(attemptWord({ ...ATTEMPTS_4605[0]!, outcome: null, completion: null })).toBe('working');
  });
  it('names an event by its action, its stop signal, or its type', () => {
    const run1 = ACTIVITIES_4605.find((a) => a.runId === 'run_fx_4605_1' && a.seq === 1)!;
    const first = ACTIVITIES_4605.find((a) => a.runId === 'run_fx_4605_2' && a.seq === 1)!;
    const stop = ACTIVITIES_4605.find((a) => a.runId === 'run_fx_4605_2' && a.seq === 14)!;
    expect([eventVerb(run1), eventVerb(first), eventVerb(stop)]).toEqual(['Sent back', 'Started', 'Stopped']);
    expect(eventVerb({ ...first, action: null, type: 'prompt' })).toBe('You said');
    expect(eventSentence(stop)).toBe(STOP_SENTENCE);
    expect(STOP_SENTENCE).toBe('Blocked. Waiting on you; the reason is shown at the top of this card.');
    expect(eventSentence(first)).toBe('Rework run on this card session; read prior persisted evidence first.');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/card-words.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  agentRole, archivedReason, archivedTitle, askedByTitle, attemptsLine, briefMeta, briefSummary, costSummary, criteriaCount,
  doneLine, emptyNoteCaption, emptyNoteError, factItems, gateConflictSentence, grantLine, handoffLine, initials, linksSummary,
  loadingBars, loadingNote, noteHint, ownerChip, pageSmall, planNone, planProgress, projectLine, provenanceLine, relatedLine,
  replySub, restoreNote, RESUME_PLACEHOLDER, subtasksLine, talkSummary, unclaimedChip, usd, whatHappenedSummary,
} from './card-words';
import { cardLead } from './card-lead';
import { ATTEMPTS_4605, CARD_4605, STAGES_DX, TZ } from './testing/card-4605';

const names = (id: string) => ({ agt_fx_error_eric: 'error-eric' } as Record<string, string>)[id] ?? id;

describe('people and provenance', () => {
  it('chips', () => {
    expect(unclaimedChip({ delegateName: null, lastAgentName: 'error-eric', attemptCount: 2 })).toBe('Unclaimed · error-eric ran attempt 2');
    expect(unclaimedChip({ delegateName: 'coder-kai', lastAgentName: 'error-eric', attemptCount: 2 })).toBe('coder-kai · working it');
    expect(unclaimedChip({ delegateName: null, lastAgentName: null, attemptCount: 0 })).toBe('Unclaimed');
    expect(ownerChip('Rakesh Gangwar')).toBe('Owner · Rakesh Gangwar');
    expect(initials('Rakesh Gangwar')).toBe('RG');
    expect(initials('super-chotu')).toBe('S');
    expect(askedByTitle('super-chotu', true, 32)).toBe('super-chotu, an agent, with dispatch authority on this board');
    expect(askedByTitle('Rakesh Gangwar', false, 32)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('provenance and grant sentences', () => {
    expect(provenanceLine({ queuedByName: 'super-chotu', byAgent: true, covers: true }, null)).toBe('Asked by super-chotu (an agent, allowed to dispatch the one working it). Unclaimed now.');
    expect(provenanceLine({ queuedByName: 'Rakesh Gangwar', byAgent: false, covers: null }, 'error-eric')).toBe('Asked by Rakesh Gangwar (a person). error-eric is working it.');
    expect(grantLine('super-chotu', 'Rakesh Gangwar', 32)).toBe('Queued by super-chotu on Rakesh Gangwar\'s grant · 32 agents may be dispatched.');
    expect(grantLine('super-chotu', 'Rakesh Gangwar', 1)).toBe('Queued by super-chotu on Rakesh Gangwar\'s grant · 1 agent may be dispatched.');
  });
  it('roles on the page', () => {
    expect(agentRole({ stageName: 'Reproduce', attempt: 2, delegated: false })).toBe('Agent for Reproduce · ran attempt 2 · Unclaimed now');
    expect(agentRole({ stageName: 'Reproduce', attempt: 2, delegated: true })).toBe('Agent for Reproduce · ran attempt 2 · working it now');
    expect(pageSmall(cardLead({ card: CARD_4605 }), 'error-eric')).toBe('error-eric is waiting for your reply');
  });
});

describe('facts, brief, plan, project', () => {
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/when.ts
/**
 * Times as the card surfaces print them: en-GB, 24-hour, in the viewer's zone. `tz` is for tests
 * and the harness; the app passes nothing and gets the browser's zone.
 */
function parts(iso: string, tz: string | undefined, opts: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): Record<string, string> {
  const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, hourCycle: 'h23', ...opts });
  return Object.fromEntries(f.formatToParts(new Date(iso)).map((p) => [p.type, p.value]));
}
const dayKey = (iso: string, tz?: string): string => {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
  return `${p.year}-${p.month}-${p.day}`;
};
export function clockHM(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  return `${p.hour}:${p.minute}`;
}
export function dayMonth(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  return `${p.day} ${p.month}`;
}
export function dayMonthLong(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  return `${p.day} ${p.month}`;
}
export function weekdayDayMonth(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  return `${p.weekday} ${p.day} ${p.month}`;
}
/** "Today, 12:48" on the viewer's own day, else "Thu 8 Oct, 19:41". */
export function whenLabel(iso: string, now: Date, tz?: string): string {
  const hm = clockHM(iso, tz);
  return dayKey(iso, tz) === dayKey(now.toISOString(), tz) ? `Today, ${hm}` : `${weekdayDayMonth(iso, tz)}, ${hm}`;
}
/** "Thursday 8 October, 19:41". */
export function whenLabelLong(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = parts(iso, tz, { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  return `${p.weekday} ${p.day} ${p.month}, ${clockHM(iso, tz)}`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/tokens.ts
/**
 * Id-like spans in an agent's own words (G-3), styled for reading, never rewritten. The order of
 * the alternatives matters: prefixed ids first, then slash paths, then snake_case words. The
 * spec's original regex split `event_id/room_id/timestamp` into three; this one is verified
 * against card 4605's detail (exactly four tokens).
 */
export interface TextToken { text: string; token: boolean }
export const TOKEN_RE = /\b(?:acps|evt|run|card|brd|agt)_[\w-]+|\b[a-z][\w-]*(?:\/[\w-]+)*\/[a-z][\w-]*\b|\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+\b/g;
/** Quiet styles only hex-tailed ids (Q-3). */
export const QUIET_TOKEN_RE = /\b[a-z]+_[0-9a-f-]{8,}\b/g;

export function splitTokens(text: string, re: RegExp = TOKEN_RE): TextToken[] {
  const out: TextToken[] = [];
  const g = new RegExp(re.source, re.flags.includes('g') ? re.flags : `${re.flags}g`);
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(g)) {
    if (m.index! > last) out.push({ text: text.slice(last, m.index), token: false });
    out.push({ text: m[0], token: true });
    last = m.index! + m[0].length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) out.push({ text: text.slice(last), token: false });
  return out;
}

/** The ACP session an agent's words name, for "Copy session id" (G-4). */
export function sessionIdOf(text: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  return text?.match(/\bacps_[0-9a-f-]{36}\b/)?.[0] ?? null;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/references.ts
/** What a reference is, in words. `refLabel`/`subStateLabel` moved here verbatim from CardDrawer. */
import type { Reference } from '$lib/api';

export const SUB_STATE_LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  draft_pr_open: 'draft', pr_open: 'open', agent_iterating: 'iterating', awaiting_review: 'review', merged: 'merged',
  closed: 'closed', agent_working: 'working', issue_open: 'open', issue_closed: 'closed',
};

export function subStateLabel(ref: Reference): string | null {
  const s = ref.metadata?.subState;
  return typeof s === 'string' ? (SUB_STATE_LABELS[s] ?? s) : null;
}

export function refLabel(ref: Reference): string {
  if (ref.sourceType === 'pull_request') return `PR ${ref.externalId?.split('#')[1] ? `#${ref.externalId.split('#')[1]}` : ''}`.trim();
  if (ref.sourceType === 'issue') return `Issue ${ref.externalId?.split('#')[1] ? `#${ref.externalId.split('#')[1]}` : ''}`.trim();
  if (ref.sourceType === 'repo') return ref.externalId ?? 'repo';
  return ref.title ?? ref.sourceType;
}

/** "github · agentpod · inbound.ts lines 379–786" for a GitHub blob URL; else the host (D-24). */
export function referenceSource(ref: Pick<Reference, 'url'>): string {
  let u: URL;
  try {
    u = new URL(ref.url);
  } catch {
    return ref.url;
  }
  const blob = u.hostname === 'github.com' ? /^\/[^/]+\/([^/]+)\/blob\/[^/]+\/(.+)$/.exec(u.pathname) : null;
  if (!blob) return u.hostname;
  const file = blob[2]!.split('/').at(-1)!;
  const lines = /^#L(\d+)(?:-L(\d+))?$/.exec(u.hash);
  const where = !lines ? '' : lines[2] ? ` lines ${lines[1]}–${lines[2]}` : ` line ${lines[1]}`;
  return `github · ${blob[1]} · ${file}${where}`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/spec-groups.ts
/**
 * A card's brief, grouped (D-21, D-22, D-26). Rows come from `spec.groups` when the card names its
 * groups, else everything goes under "Other details". Labels: `humanizeKey` (split camelCase,
 * first word capitalised, the rest lower case) unless the card's `spec.fieldLabels` names the key
 * (keys whose label is not mechanical). A long value is stored as its first paragraph and
 * a continuation; the surface shows the first paragraph and "Show more" iff more paragraphs exist.
 */
import { humaniseKey, isEmptyValue, isPlainObject } from './spec-details';

/** Labels come from the card itself (`spec.fieldLabels`), so no person's or agent's name is shipped here. */
export const humanizeKey = (key: string, fieldLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>): string => fieldLabels?.[key] ?? humaniseKey(key);

/** Keys the card surfaces render elsewhere (description, criteria, plan, labels, due, project) or are structure. */
export const SPEC_OWNED_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['description', 'acceptanceCriteria', 'labels', 'due', 'plan', 'groups', 'project', 'fieldLabels']);

export type SpecValue =
  | { kind: 'text'; shown: string; more: string | null }
  | { kind: 'evidence'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'matrix'; matrixId: string; cardId: string }
  | { kind: 'repo'; repo: string; visibility: string; policyUrl: string | null }
  | { kind: 'structured'; value: unknown };
export interface SpecRow { key: string; label: string; value: SpecValue }
export interface SpecGroup { label: string; rows: SpecRow[] }

export function firstParagraph(s: string): { shown: string; more: string | null } {
  const paras = s.split(/\n\s*\n/).map((p) => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return { shown: paras[0] ?? '', more: paras.length > 1 ? paras.slice(1).join('\n\n') : null };
}

function specValue(v: unknown, criteria: unknown, heading: string): SpecValue {
  if (Array.isArray(v) && Array.isArray(criteria) && JSON.stringify(v) === JSON.stringify(criteria)) {
    return { kind: 'evidence', text: `${v.length} items, listed under ${heading}.` };
  }
  if (typeof v === 'string') return { kind: 'text', ...firstParagraph(v) };
  if (isPlainObject(v) && typeof v.matrixId === 'string' && typeof v.card === 'string') return { kind: 'matrix', matrixId: v.matrixId, cardId: v.card };
  if (isPlainObject(v) && typeof v.repo === 'string' && typeof v.visibility === 'string') {
    return { kind: 'repo', repo: v.repo, visibility: v.visibility, policyUrl: typeof v.policyUrl === 'string' ? v.policyUrl : null };
  }
  return { kind: 'structured', value: v };
}

export function specGroups(spec: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, opts: { criteriaHeading: string }): SpecGroup[] {
  if (!spec) return [];
  const usable = (k: string) => !SPEC_OWNED_KEYS.has(k) && k in spec && !isEmptyValue(spec[k]);
  const row = (k: string): SpecRow => ({ key: k, label: humanizeKey(k, (spec.fieldLabels ?? undefined) as Record<string, string> | undefined), value: specValue(spec[k], spec.acceptanceCriteria, opts.criteriaHeading) });
  const declared = Array.isArray(spec.groups)
    ? (spec.groups as Array<{ label?: unknown; keys?: unknown }>).filter((g) => typeof g.label === 'string' && Array.isArray(g.keys))
    : [];
  const placed = new Set<string>();
  const out: SpecGroup[] = [];
  for (const g of declared) {
    const keys = (g.keys as unknown[]).filter((k): k is string => typeof k === 'string' && usable(k));
    keys.forEach((k) => placed.add(k));
    if (keys.length) out.push({ label: g.label as string, rows: keys.map(row) });
  }
  const rest = Object.keys(spec).filter((k) => usable(k) && !placed.has(k));
  if (rest.length) out.push({ label: 'Other details', rows: rest.map(row) });
  return out;
}

export const specRowCount = (groups: SpecGroup[]): number => groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0);
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/state-words.ts
/** One word, or one short sentence, for where a card stands. Never the raw state value. */
import type { Activity, Attempt, Card, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import type { CardLead, LeadKind } from './card-lead';

export type StripKind = LeadKind | 'archived';
export const STRIP_WORD: Readonly<Record<StripKind, string>> = {
  stopped: 'stopped', failed: 'stopped', budget: 'stopped', review: 'awaiting review', question: 'question pending',
  working: 'working', done: 'done', idle: 'queued', archived: 'archived',
};
export const stripKind = (lead: Pick<CardLead, 'kind'>, archived: boolean): StripKind => (archived ? 'archived' : lead.kind);

/** The stage strip's accessible name (D-5). */
export function stripAria(i: number, n: number, name: string, kind: StripKind, form: 'drawer' | 'cell' | 'phone'): string {
  if (kind === 'archived') return `${form === 'drawer' ? 'Stages: stopped' : 'Stopped'} at stage ${i + 1} of ${n}, ${name}, archived`;
  const word = STRIP_WORD[kind] + (form === 'phone' && STRIP_WORD[kind] === 'stopped' ? ' here' : '');
  return `${form === 'drawer' ? 'Stages: stage' : 'Stage'} ${i + 1} of ${n}, ${name}, ${word}`;
}

export function stateWord(card: Pick<Card, 'state' | 'archivedAt'>, lead: Pick<CardLead, 'kind' | 'needsYou'>): string {
  if (card.archivedAt) return 'Archived';
  if (lead.kind === 'failed') return 'Failed';
  if (lead.needsYou) return 'Waiting on you';
  if (card.state === 'working') return 'Working';
  if (card.state === 'completed') return 'Done';
  if (card.state === 'rejected') return 'Rejected';
  return 'Queued';
}

/** The state pill: "Waiting on you · 2 days" on desktop, the word alone on phones. */
export function waitingWord(card: Pick<Card, 'state' | 'archivedAt'>, lead: Pick<CardLead, 'kind' | 'needsYou'>, ageHours: number | null, form: 'desktop' | 'phone'): string {
  const word = stateWord(card, lead);
  return word === 'Waiting on you' && form === 'desktop' && ageHours !== null ? `${word} · ${ageWords(ageHours)}` : word;
}

/** Signal only for "needs you"; archived is never signal (§8.2-3). */
export function pillTone(card: Pick<Card, 'state' | 'archivedAt'>, lead: Pick<CardLead, 'needsYou'>): 'needs' | 'working' | 'done' | 'off' {
  if (card.archivedAt) return 'off';
  if (lead.needsYou) return 'needs';
  if (card.state === 'working') return 'working';
  if (card.state === 'completed') return 'done';
  return 'off';
}

const STOP_VERB: Readonly<Record<LeadKind, string>> = {
  stopped: 'Stopped', failed: 'Stopped', budget: 'Stopped', review: 'Waiting for review', question: 'Asked a question',
  working: 'Working', done: 'Finished', idle: 'Queued',
};
/** "Stopped in stage 2 of 7. Next: Failing test." (G-8). */
export function stopLine(lead: Pick<CardLead, 'kind'>, i: number, stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[]): string {
  const next = stages[i + 1];
  return `${STOP_VERB[lead.kind]} in stage ${i + 1} of ${stages.length}.${next ? ` Next: ${next.name}.` : ''}`;
}

/** How a run ended, lower case. "Sent back" is derived: completed, but the board refused the completion. */
export function attemptWord(a: Pick<Attempt, 'outcome' | 'completion'>): string {
  if (a.outcome === 'blocked') return 'stopped';
  if (a.outcome === 'sent_back' || (a.outcome === 'completed' && a.completion?.ok === false)) return 'sent back';
  if (a.outcome === 'completed') return 'done';
  if (a.outcome === 'failed') return 'failed';
  return a.outcome ?? 'working';
}

const TYPE_WORD: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = { action: 'Did', response: 'Said', thought: 'Thought', prompt: 'You said', elicitation: 'Asked', error: 'Error' };
/** The bold word in front of an event (G-5, §7.5). */
export const eventVerb = (a: Pick<Activity, 'signal' | 'action' | 'type'>): string =>
  a.signal === 'stop' ? 'Stopped' : (a.action ?? TYPE_WORD[a.type] ?? a.type);

/** The stop row repeats nothing: the reason is already at the top of the card (P-26). */
export const STOP_SENTENCE = 'Blocked. Waiting on you; the reason is shown at the top of this card.';
export const eventSentence = (a: Pick<Activity, 'signal' | 'body'>): string => (a.signal === 'stop' ? STOP_SENTENCE : (a.body ?? ''));
```
