```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/card-words.ts
/** The sentences every card surface prints (shared spec §4 and 05-amendments). Pure. */
import type { Attempt, Card, GateConflict, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import { dayMonth, clockHM, whenLabel } from '$lib/when';
import type { CardLead } from './card-lead';
import { attemptWord } from './state-words';

export const usd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
const s = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '' : 's');

export function initials(name: string): string {
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return words.length === 0 ? '' : words.length === 1 ? words[0]!.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : `${words[0]!.charAt(0)}${words.at(-1)!.charAt(0)}`.toUpperCase();
}

export function unclaimedChip(i: { delegateName: string | null; lastAgentName: string | null; attemptCount: number }): string {
  if (i.delegateName) return `${i.delegateName} · working it`;
  return i.lastAgentName ? `Unclaimed · ${i.lastAgentName} ran attempt ${i.attemptCount}` : 'Unclaimed';
}
export const ownerChip = (name: string): string => `Owner · ${name}`;
export const askedByTitle = (name: string, byAgent: boolean, grantSize: number | null): string | null =>
  byAgent && (grantSize ?? 0) > 0 ? `${name}, an agent, with dispatch authority on this board` : null;

export function provenanceLine(p: { queuedByName: string; byAgent: boolean; covers: boolean | null }, delegateName: string | null): string {
  const who = `${p.byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'}${p.covers ? ', allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''}`;
  return `Asked by ${p.queuedByName} (${who}).${delegateName ? ` ${delegateName} is working it.` : ' Unclaimed now.'}`;
}
/** API-3; the count is every principal in the grant (all `prn_…`). */
export const grantLine = (queuedByName: string, ownerName: string, n: number): string =>
  `Queued by ${queuedByName} on ${ownerName}'s grant · ${n} agent${s(n)} may be dispatched.`;

export function replySub(card: Pick<Card, 'attemptCount' | 'needsHuman'>, agent: string): string {
  const reason = card.needsHuman?.reason;
  if (reason === 'not-authorised') return 'Not dispatched: nobody with permission asked for it. Say who should pick it up.';
  if (reason === 'repeated-failure') return `Failed ${card.needsHuman?.failureCount ?? card.attemptCount} times; the board stopped retrying. Tell ${agent} what to do differently.`;
  return `Stopped after ${card.attemptCount} attempt${s(card.attemptCount)}. Tell ${agent} what to do differently.`;
}

export function agentRole(i: { stageName: string; attempt: number; delegated: boolean }): string {
  return `Agent for ${i.stageName} · ran attempt ${i.attempt} · ${i.delegated ? 'working it now' : 'Unclaimed now'}`;
}
export function pageSmall(lead: Pick<CardLead, 'kind' | 'needsYou'>, agent: string): string {
  if (lead.needsYou) return `${agent} is waiting for your reply`;
  return lead.kind === 'done' ? `Finished by ${agent}` : `${agent} is working`;
}

export interface FactInput { card: Pick<Card, 'priority' | 'dueAt' | 'attemptCount'>; stageName: string; ageHours: number | null; labelNames: string[]; projectName: string | null; tz?: string }
/** The fact line under the title; the page adds Project (pass `projectName`). */
export function factItems(i: FactInput): Array<{ term: string; value: string }> {
  const out = [
    { term: 'Priority', value: i.card.priority > 0 ? `P${i.card.priority}` : 'none' },
    { term: 'Due', value: i.card.dueAt ? dayMonth(i.card.dueAt, i.tz) : 'none' },
    { term: 'Labels', value: i.labelNames.length ? i.labelNames.join(', ') : 'none' },
  ];
  if (i.ageHours !== null) out.push({ term: `In ${i.stageName} for`, value: ageWords(i.ageHours) });
  if (i.card.attemptCount > 1) out.push({ term: 'Attempt', value: String(i.card.attemptCount) });
  if (i.projectName) out.push({ term: 'Project', value: i.projectName });
  return out;
}

export function briefMeta(hasDescription: boolean, criteria: number, open: boolean): string {
  const what = [hasDescription ? 'Description' : null, criteria ? `${criteria} criteri${criteria === 1 ? 'on' : 'a'}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' and ');
  return `${what || 'Nothing written'} · ${open ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}`;
}
export function briefSummary(rows: number, hasPlan: boolean, hasProject: boolean, surface: 'drawer' | 'page' | 'phone'): string {
  if (surface === 'page') return `${rows} details`;
  if (surface === 'phone') return `${rows} fields`;
  return `Details · ${rows} fields${hasPlan ? ', plan' : ''}${hasProject ? ', project' : ''}`;
}
export const criteriaCount = (n: number): string => `${n} acceptance criteri${n === 1 ? 'on' : 'a'}`;
export const planNone = (agent: string): string => `${agent || 'The agent'} did not post a plan for this card.`;
export const planProgress = (done: number, n: number): string => `${done} / ${n} steps · ${Math.round((100 * done) / n)}%`;
export const projectLine = (project: string, milestone: string | null): string => `${project} · ${milestone ?? 'no milestone'}`;

export const whatHappenedSummary = (runs: number, decisions: number): string =>
  `${runs} run${s(runs)} · ${decisions ? `${decisions} decision${s(decisions)}` : 'no decisions yet'}`;
export function linksSummary(c: { links: number; children: number; openChildren: number; refs: number; related: number }, surface: 'drawer' | 'page'): string {
  const parts = [
    c.links ? `${c.links} link${s(c.links)}` : surface === 'drawer' ? 'no links' : null,
    c.children ? `${c.openChildren} of ${c.children} sub-tasks open` : surface === 'drawer' ? 'no sub-tasks' : null,
    c.refs || surface === 'drawer' ? `${c.refs} reference${s(c.refs)}` : null,
    c.related ? `${c.related} related` : surface === 'drawer' ? 'no related work' : null,
  ];
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
}
export const subtasksLine = (open: number, n: number): string => `${open} open of ${n}`;
export const talkSummary = (n: number): string => (n ? `${n} comment${s(n)}` : 'No comments yet');
export function relatedLine(phase: 'loading' | 'ok' | 'unavailable' | 'absent', n: number): string {
  if (phase === 'unavailable') return 'Related prior work could not be loaded from Superlibrary.';
  if (phase === 'loading') return 'Looking for related prior work…';
  return n ? `${n} related piece${s(n)} of prior work in Superlibrary.` : 'No related prior work found in Superlibrary.';
}
export function costSummary(cost: number, estimate: number | null, deliveryMode: string | null): string {
  return `${usd(cost)} · ${estimate ? `est. ${usd(estimate)}` : 'no estimate'} · ${deliveryMode ? `${deliveryMode} delivery` : 'no delivery'}`;
}

/** D-8: the carried handoff in one line, or what stands in for it before the first stage output. */
export function handoffLine(i: { handoff: Record<string, unknown> | null; stageIndex: number; stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[]; queuedByName: string; createdAt: string | undefined; tz?: string }): string {
  const prev = i.stages[i.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? null;
  if (i.handoff && Object.keys(i.handoff).length) {
    const first = typeof i.handoff.summary === 'string' ? i.handoff.summary : Object.values(i.handoff).find((v): v is string => typeof v === 'string') ?? '';
    return `Handoff from ${prev ?? 'the last stage'}: “${first}”`;
  }
  const when = i.createdAt ? ` on ${dayMonth(i.createdAt, i.tz)}` : '';
  if (!prev) return `Queued by ${i.queuedByName}${when} with the brief above.`;
  return `From ${prev}: queued by ${i.queuedByName}${when} with the brief above. No earlier stage output.`;
}
export const attemptsLine = (attempts: Attempt[], name: (agentId: string) => string): string =>
  `Attempts: ${attempts.map((a, i) => `${i + 1} · ${name(a.agentId)} · ${usd(a.costUsd)} · ${attemptWord(a)}`).join('; ')}`;

export const noteHint = (len: number): string => `Needed before you send. ${len} / 8000`;
export const emptyNoteError = (agent: string): string => `Add a note for ${agent || 'the agent'} first.`;
export const emptyNoteCaption = (agent: string): string => `Pressing it with no note says “Add a note for ${agent || 'the agent'} first.”`;
/** §8.2-6: never names a card's specifics. */
export const RESUME_PLACEHOLDER = 'For example: what you checked, and what the agent should look at next.';

export const archivedTitle = (archivedAt: string, tz?: string): string => `Archived ${dayMonth(archivedAt, tz)}`;
/** API-2: a review cancelled within 5 s of the archive was cancelled by it. */
export function archivedReason(archivedAt: string, gates: Array<{ status: string; resolvedAt?: string | null }>): string {
  const at = Date.parse(archivedAt);
  const byArchive = gates.some((g) => (g.status === 'cancelled' || g.status === 'canceled') && g.resolvedAt && Math.abs(Date.parse(g.resolvedAt) - at) <= 5000);
  return byArchive ? 'Its pending review was cancelled when the card was archived.' : 'It is off the board. Restore puts it back.';
}
export const restoreNote = (stageName: string): string => `Puts it back on the board at ${stageName}.`;
export const doneLine = (lastStage: string, finishedAt: string, attempts: number, now: Date, tz?: string): string =>
  `Reached ${lastStage} on ${whenLabel(finishedAt, now, tz)} · ${attempts} attempt${s(attempts)}`;

const VIA: Readonly<Record<GateConflict['via'], string>> = { matrix: 'Matrix', web: 'the web app', api: 'the API' };
/** API-1: who already decided, where, and when. The bold "Not recorded." is drawn by the layout. */
export const gateConflictSentence = (c: GateConflict, deciderName: string, tz?: string): string =>
  `This gate was already decided from ${VIA[c.via]} by ${deciderName} at ${clockHM(c.decidedAt, tz)}.`;

export const loadingNote = (agent: string): string => `Loading what ${agent || 'the agent'} said and the card’s history…`;
/** D-14: at most five bars, the wide one at the current stage (first or second). */
export function loadingBars(stages: number, stageIndex: number): number[] {
  const n = Math.min(Math.max(stages, 1), 5);
  const wide = Math.min(stageIndex, 1, n - 1);
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => (i === wide ? 2.8 : 1));
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/resume-model.svelte.ts
/**
 * Sending a stopped card back to work (moved from CardResume.svelte + ResumeBox.svelte). The note
 * is required: it is the next attempt's feedback. The button is never disabled; an empty note is
 * a field error that names the agent, and no request is made.
 */
import { resumeCard, type Card, type Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { refusalOf } from '$lib/components/attention/refusal';
import { emptyNoteError, noteHint } from './card-words';

export interface ResumeTarget { key: string; n: number; name: string; current: boolean; allowed: boolean }
export const RESUME_NOTE_MAX = 8000;

export function resumeTargets(stages: Stage[], currentKey: string): ResumeTarget[] {
  const idx = stages.findIndex((s) => s.key === currentKey);
  return stages.map((s, i) => ({ key: s.key, n: i + 1, name: s.name, current: i === idx, allowed: idx >= 0 && i <= idx }));
}
export function resumeShows(card: Pick<Card, 'state' | 'openChildCount'>, gatePending: boolean, questionPending: boolean): boolean {
  return card.state === 'input-required' && !gatePending && !questionPending && card.openChildCount === 0;
}

export interface ResumeContext { boardId: string | null; card: Card | null; stages: Stage[]; gatePending: boolean; questionPending: boolean; agentName: string; after: () => Promise<void> }

export class ResumeModel {
  target = $state('');
  note = $state('');
  busy = $state(false);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  noteEl = $state<HTMLTextAreaElement | undefined>();
  #ctx: () => ResumeContext;
  #last: string | null = null;

  constructor(ctx: () => ResumeContext) {
    this.#ctx = ctx;
  }
  get show(): boolean {
    const { card, gatePending, questionPending } = this.#ctx();
    return !!card && resumeShows(card, gatePending, questionPending);
  }
  get targets(): ResumeTarget[] {
    const { card, stages } = this.#ctx();
    return card ? resumeTargets(stages, card.currentStageKey) : [];
  }
  get hint(): string {
    return noteHint(this.note.length);
  }
  /** Reset when the card changes; the target starts at the card's own stage. */
  follow(cardId: string | null): void {
    if (cardId === this.#last) return;
    this.#last = cardId;
    this.note = '';
    this.error = null;
    this.target = this.#ctx().card?.currentStageKey ?? '';
  }
  async submit(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, card, agentName, after } = this.#ctx();
    if (!boardId || !card || this.busy) return;
    const text = this.note.trim();
    if (text === '') {
      this.error = emptyNoteError(agentName);
      this.noteEl?.focus();
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const to = this.target && this.target !== card.currentStageKey ? this.target : undefined;
      const refused = await refusalOf(await resumeCard(boardId, card.id, text, to));
      if (refused) {
        this.error = refused;
        return;
      }
      this.note = '';
      await after();
    } finally {
      this.busy = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/comments-model.svelte.ts
/**
 * A card's comment thread (moved from CardComments.svelte). Bodies stay text; the components never
 * use {@html}. Nothing is fetched until a component calls `attach()` inside an `$effect`, so a
 * model that no surface draws costs nothing.
 */
import { deleteComment, getComments, postComment, type BoardFeedEvent, type CardComment } from '$lib/api';

export interface CommentsContext {
  boardId: string | null;
  cardId: string | null;
  onFeed: (fn: (e: BoardFeedEvent) => void) => () => void;
  coalesceMs?: number;
}

async function refusal(res: Response): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const body = (await res.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } | string };
    const msg = typeof body.error === 'string' ? body.error : body.error?.message;
    if (msg) return msg;
  } catch {
    // fall through to the status
  }
  return `the server answered ${res.status}`;
}

export class CommentsModel {
  comments = $state<CardComment[]>([]);
  loaded = $state(false);
  draft = $state('');
  posting = $state(false);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  #ctx: () => CommentsContext;

  constructor(ctx: () => CommentsContext) {
    this.#ctx = ctx;
  }
  get summary(): string {
    const n = this.comments.filter((c) => !c.deletedAt).length;
    return n ? `${n} comment${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'No comments yet';
  }
  async load(bid: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const got = await getComments(bid, id);
      const now = this.#ctx();
      if (bid === now.boardId && id === now.cardId) this.comments = got;
    } catch {
      // A failed read keeps what is on screen rather than blanking the thread.
    } finally {
      this.loaded = true;
    }
  }
  /** Call inside an `$effect`; re-runs when the card changes; returns the cleanup. */
  attach(): () => void {
    const { boardId: bid, cardId: id, onFeed, coalesceMs = 250 } = this.#ctx();
    this.comments = [];
    this.loaded = false;
    this.error = null;
    if (!bid || !id) return () => {};
    void this.load(bid, id);
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const stop = onFeed((event) => {
      if (!event.type.startsWith('card.comment.') || event.payload?.cardId !== id) return;
      if (timer !== undefined) return;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        timer = undefined;
        void this.load(bid, id);
      }, coalesceMs);
    });
    return () => {
      stop();
      if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }
  async submit(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId } = this.#ctx();
    const text = this.draft.trim();
    if (!boardId || !cardId || !text || this.posting) return;
    this.posting = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await postComment(boardId, cardId, text);
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.error = `Not posted: ${await refusal(res)}`;
        return;
      }
      this.draft = '';
      await this.load(boardId, cardId);
    } finally {
      this.posting = false;
    }
  }
  async remove(c: CardComment): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId } = this.#ctx();
    if (!boardId || !cardId) return;
    if (!confirm('Delete this comment? The thread will show that a comment was deleted.')) return;
    const res = await deleteComment(boardId, cardId, c.id);
    if (!res.ok) {
      this.error = `Not deleted: ${await refusal(res)}`;
      return;
    }
    await this.load(boardId, cardId);
  }
}
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /* (keep the existing doc comment) */
  import type { BoardFeedEvent, CardComment } from '$lib/api';
  import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
  import { CommentsModel } from './comments-model.svelte';

  let { boardId, cardId, currentUserId, onFeed, coalesceMs = 250 }: {
    boardId: string; cardId: string; currentUserId: string | null;
    onFeed: (fn: (e: BoardFeedEvent) => void) => () => void; coalesceMs?: number;
  } = $props();

  const model = new CommentsModel(() => ({ boardId, cardId, onFeed, coalesceMs }));
  $effect(() => model.attach());

  function when(ts: string): string {
    try {
      return new Date(ts).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch {
      return ts;
    }
  }
  const mine = (c: CardComment) => !c.deletedAt && c.author.kind === 'human' && !!currentUserId && c.author.id === currentUserId;
</script>
```

In the markup replace `comments` → `model.comments`, `loaded` → `model.loaded`, `bind:value={draft}` → `bind:value={model.draft}`, `draft.trim()` → `model.draft.trim()`, `posting` → `model.posting`, `error` → `model.error`, `void submit()` → `void model.submit()`, `void remove(c)` → `void model.remove(c)`, and the Delete condition `!c.deletedAt && c.author.kind === 'human' && currentUserId && c.author.id === currentUserId` → `mine(c)`. `CardComments.svelte.test.ts` stays as it is and must still pass.

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/card-forms.svelte.ts
/**
 * The card's small forms, moved verbatim from CardDrawer.svelte: edit, project, links, sub-tasks,
 * references, delivery. Each holds its own state and calls back into the model it belongs to.
 */
import { addLink, addReference, getBoard, getProject, removeLink, splitCard, updateApprovalDelivery, updateCard, type LinkKind, type Milestone } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { resolveCardLabelsForEdit } from '$lib/components/card-labels';
import { edgeKey, type RemoveArgs } from '$lib/components/link-groups';
import { crossBoardNotice, linkRefusalSentence, submitAddBlocker, type LinkKindChoice } from '$lib/components/add-blocker';
import { assignmentPatch, milestonesForProject } from '$lib/components/milestone-picker';
import type { CardModel } from './card-model.svelte';

type Refusal = { error?: { code?: string; message?: string } } | null;
const refusalBody = async (res: Response): Promise<Refusal> => (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as Refusal;

export class EditForm {
  editing = $state(false);
  title = $state('');
  priority = $state(0);
  desc = $state('');
  labels = $state('');
  /** See the original comment in CardDrawer: a blind catalogue must not be able to wipe labels. */
  labelsBlind = $state(false);
  ac = $state('');
  due = $state('');
  saving = $state(false);
  #m: CardModel;
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.editing = false;
  }
  start(): void {
    const card = this.#m.card;
    if (!card || this.editing) return;
    this.title = card.title;
    this.priority = card.priority;
    this.desc = (card.spec?.description as string | undefined) ?? '';
    const byName = new Map([...app.labelById()].map(([id, l]) => [id, l.name]));
    const resolved = resolveCardLabelsForEdit(card.labels, byName);
    this.labels = resolved.text;
    this.labelsBlind = resolved.blind;
    this.ac = (Array.isArray(card.spec?.acceptanceCriteria) ? (card.spec!.acceptanceCriteria as string[]) : []).join('\n');
    this.due = card.dueAt ?? '';
    this.editing = true;
  }
  cancel(): void {
    this.editing = false;
  }
  async save(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId, card } = this.#m;
    if (!boardId || !cardId || this.title.trim() === '') return;
    this.saving = true;
    try {
      const labelNames = this.labelsBlind ? undefined : this.labels.split(',').map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const ac = this.ac.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const res = await updateCard(boardId, cardId, {
        title: this.title.trim(),
        priority: Number(this.priority) || 0,
        spec: { ...(card?.spec ?? {}), description: this.desc, acceptanceCriteria: ac },
        ...(labelNames !== undefined ? { labelNames } : {}),
        dueAt: this.due.trim() === '' ? null : this.due.trim(),
      });
      if (!res.ok) this.#m.localError = `Couldn't save the card (${res.status})`;
      this.editing = false;
      await app.refresh();
      void this.#m.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }
}

export class ProjectPicker {
  editing = $state(false);
  projectId = $state('');
  milestoneId = $state('');
  milestones = $state<Milestone[]>([]);
  saving = $state(false);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  #m: CardModel;
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.editing = false;
    this.error = null;
  }
  start(): void {
    const card = this.#m.card;
    if (!card) return;
    this.projectId = card.projectId ?? '';
    this.milestoneId = card.milestoneId ?? '';
    const d = this.#m.projectDetail;
    this.milestones = d && d.project.id === this.projectId ? milestonesForProject(d.milestones, this.projectId) : [];
    this.error = null;
    this.editing = true;
  }
  cancel(): void {
    this.editing = false;
  }
  /** Clearing the milestone first is the chosen answer to MILESTONE_NOT_IN_PROJECT (see the original comment). */
  async onProjectChange(): Promise<void> {
    this.milestoneId = '';
    if (!this.projectId) {
      this.milestones = [];
      return;
    }
    const d = await getProject(this.projectId);
    this.milestones = d ? milestonesForProject(d.milestones, this.projectId) : [];
  }
  async save(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId, card } = this.#m;
    if (!boardId || !cardId || !card || this.saving) return;
    this.saving = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const patch = assignmentPatch(
        { projectId: card.projectId, milestoneId: card.milestoneId },
        { projectId: this.projectId === '' ? null : this.projectId, milestoneId: this.milestoneId === '' ? null : this.milestoneId },
      );
      if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) {
        this.editing = false;
        return;
      }
      const res = await updateCard(boardId, cardId, patch);
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.error = linkRefusalSentence((await refusalBody(res))?.error, res.status);
        return;
      }
      this.editing = false;
      await app.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }
}

export class LinkEditor {
  open = $state(false);
  boardId = $state('');
  cardId = $state('');
  kind = $state<LinkKindChoice>('blocks');
  boardCards = $state<{ id: string; title: string }[]>([]);
  adding = $state(false);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  listError = $state<string | null>(null);
  removing = $state(new Set<string>());
  #m: CardModel;
  readonly crossBoardNotice = $derived.by(() => (this.#m.boardId ? crossBoardNotice(this.boardId, this.#m.boardId) : null));
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.open = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.listError = null;
  }
  #sameBoardCards(): { id: string; title: string }[] {
    return (this.#m.board?.cards ?? []).filter((c) => c.id !== this.#m.cardId);
  }
  openAdd(): void {
    if (!this.#m.boardId || !this.#m.cardId) return;
    this.open = true;
    this.boardId = this.#m.boardId;
    this.cardId = '';
    this.kind = 'blocks';
    this.error = null;
    this.boardCards = this.#sameBoardCards();
  }
  cancel(): void {
    this.open = false;
  }
  async onBoardChange(): Promise<void> {
    this.cardId = '';
    if (!this.#m.boardId || !this.#m.cardId) return;
    if (this.boardId === this.#m.boardId) {
      this.boardCards = this.#sameBoardCards();
      return;
    }
    if (!this.boardId) {
      this.boardCards = [];
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.boardCards = (await getBoard(this.boardId)).cards;
    } catch {
      this.boardCards = [];
    }
  }
  async add(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId } = this.#m;
    if (!boardId || !cardId || !this.boardId || !this.cardId || this.adding) return;
    this.adding = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await submitAddBlocker(
        { blockerBoardId: this.boardId, blockerCardId: this.cardId, thisBoardId: boardId, thisCardId: cardId, kind: this.kind },
        { addLink: (bid, from, to, kind, toBoardId) => addLink(bid, from, to, kind as LinkKind, toBoardId), notify: () => {} },
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.error = linkRefusalSentence((await refusalBody(res))?.error, res.status);
        return;
      }
      this.open = false;
      await app.refresh();
      void this.#m.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.adding = false;
    }
  }
  async remove(args: RemoveArgs): Promise<void> {
    const key = edgeKey(args);
    if (this.removing.has(key)) return;
    this.removing = new Set(this.removing).add(key);
    this.listError = null;
    try {
      const res = await removeLink(args.boardId, args.fromCardId, args.toCardId, args.kind, args.toBoardId);
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.listError = linkRefusalSentence((await refusalBody(res))?.error, res.status);
        return;
      }
      await app.refresh();
      void this.#m.refresh();
    } finally {
      const next = new Set(this.removing);
      next.delete(key);
      this.removing = next;
    }
  }
}

export class SubtaskComposer {
  title = $state('');
  adding = $state(false);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  #m: CardModel;
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.title = '';
    this.error = null;
  }
  async add(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId } = this.#m;
    if (!boardId || !cardId || this.title.trim() === '' || this.adding) return;
    this.adding = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await splitCard(boardId, cardId, [this.title.trim()]);
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.error = linkRefusalSentence((await refusalBody(res))?.error, res.status);
        return;
      }
      this.title = '';
      await app.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.adding = false;
    }
  }
}

export class ReferenceComposer {
  url = $state('');
  #m: CardModel;
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.url = '';
  }
  async add(): Promise<void> {
    const { boardId, cardId } = this.#m;
    if (!boardId || !cardId || this.url.trim() === '') return;
    const res = await addReference(boardId, cardId, { url: this.url.trim() });
    if (res.ok) {
      this.url = '';
      await app.refresh();
    } else {
      this.#m.localError = `Couldn't add that link (${res.status})`;
    }
  }
}

export class DeliveryControls {
  liveUrl = $state('');
  saving = $state(false);
  copied = $state<number | null>(null);
  #m: CardModel;
  constructor(m: CardModel) {
    this.#m = m;
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.liveUrl = '';
    this.saving = false;
    this.copied = null;
  }
  async change(update: { mode: 'manual' | 'automatic' } | { liveUrl: string }): Promise<void> {
    const gate = this.#m.deliveryGate;
    const boardId = this.#m.boardId;
    if (!boardId || !gate || this.saving) return;
    this.saving = true;
    this.#m.gateError = null;
    try {
      const res = await updateApprovalDelivery(boardId, gate.id, update);
      if (!res.ok) {
        this.#m.gateError = (await refusalBody(res))?.error?.message ?? `Couldn't update delivery (${res.status})`;
        return;
      }
      if ('liveUrl' in update) this.liveUrl = '';
      await Promise.all([app.refresh(), this.#m.refresh()]);
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }
  async copy(index: number, text: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      this.copied = index;
    } catch {
      this.#m.gateError = 'Clipboard access was refused. Select the exact text manually.';
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/card-model.svelte.ts
/**
 * Everything a card surface knows and can do — the drawer, the standalone page and the dev
 * gallery each construct one. Moved out of CardDrawer.svelte's script (the long comments there
 * explaining each fetch and each guard move with the code they explain; keep them).
 *
 * Surface rule after a successful decision, archive or delete: drawer → `app.closeCard()`;
 * page → stay and `refresh()` (delete navigates to the board); gallery → nothing.
 */
import { untrack } from 'svelte';
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import {
  archiveCard, deleteCard, getAttempts, getCardActivities, getEstimate, getProject, listLinks, parseGateConflict, unarchiveCard, updateCard,
  type AgentSummary, type Attempt, type BoardSnapshot, type Card, type CardActivities, type CardLinks, type Estimate, type Gate,
  type GateConflict, type GateDecision, type Milestone, type Project, type Stage,
} from '$lib/api';
import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';
import { cardProvenance } from '$lib/components/board/card-provenance';
import { overdue } from '$lib/components/board/card-due';
import { groupActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
import { stageAccount } from '$lib/stage-account';
import { manualDeliveryItems } from '$lib/approval-delivery';
import { isAbsent, libraryRef, relatedForCard, type RelatedLite } from '$lib/superlibrary';
import { buildLinkGroups } from '$lib/components/link-groups';
import { resolveProjectName } from '$lib/components/plan/project-lookup';
import { normalisePlan } from './plan';
import { cardLead, moodFor, speakerOf } from './card-lead';
import { QuestionAnswer } from './question/question-answer.svelte';
import { CommentsModel } from './comments-model.svelte';
import { ResumeModel } from './resume-model.svelte';
import { DeliveryControls, EditForm, LinkEditor, ProjectPicker, ReferenceComposer, SubtaskComposer } from './card-forms.svelte';
import type { CardAgent, CardCounts, GateBinding, QuestionBinding } from './layouts/types';

export type CardSurface = 'drawer' | 'page' | 'gallery';
export interface CardSource { board: BoardSnapshot; agents: AgentSummary[] }
export interface CardModelContext { boardId: string | null; cardId: string | null; surface: CardSurface }
export interface CardModelOptions { holdDetail?: boolean; source?: CardSource }
export interface RelatedState { phase: 'loading' | 'ok' | 'unavailable' | 'absent'; items: RelatedLite[] }

/** A burst of feed events collapses into one refetch (see the original comment). */
const FEED_COALESCE_MS = 1000;
const COPIED_MS = 2000;

export class CardModel {
  readonly #ctx: () => CardModelContext;
  readonly #opts: CardModelOptions;
  #copiedTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  // ---- fetched for this card ----
  detail = $state<CardActivities | null>(null);
  attempts = $state<Attempt[]>([]);
  estimate = $state<Estimate | null>(null);
  edges = $state<CardLinks>({ links: [], externalLinks: [] });
  projectDetail = $state<{ project: Project; milestones: Milestone[] } | null>(null);
  related = $state<RelatedState>({ phase: 'loading', items: [] });

  // ---- local UI state ----
  showToolCalls = $state(false);
  localError = $state<string | null>(null);
  gateError = $state<string | null>(null);
  gateConflict = $state<GateConflict | null>(null);
  copied = $state<'id' | 'link' | 'session' | 'spec' | null>(null);
  assigning = $state(false);
  archiving = $state(false);

  readonly edit: EditForm;
  readonly project: ProjectPicker;
  readonly links: LinkEditor;
  readonly subtasks: SubtaskComposer;
  readonly refsForm: ReferenceComposer;
  readonly delivery: DeliveryControls;
  readonly comments: CommentsModel;
  readonly resume: ResumeModel;
  readonly question: QuestionAnswer;

  // ---- where it is ----
  readonly surface = $derived(this.#ctx().surface);
  readonly boardId = $derived(this.#ctx().boardId);
  readonly cardId = $derived(this.#ctx().cardId);
  readonly board = $derived<BoardSnapshot | null>(this.#opts.source?.board ?? app.board);
  readonly agents = $derived<AgentSummary[]>(this.#opts.source?.agents ?? app.agents);
  readonly card = $derived<Card | undefined>(this.cardId ? this.board?.cards.find((c) => c.id === this.cardId) : undefined);
  readonly boardName = $derived(this.board?.name ?? '');
  readonly stages = $derived<Stage[]>([...(this.board?.stages ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order));
  readonly stageIndex = $derived(Math.max(0, this.stages.findIndex((s) => s.key === this.card?.currentStageKey)));
  readonly stageName = $derived(this.card ? (this.stages.find((s) => s.key === this.card!.currentStageKey)?.name ?? this.card.currentStageKey) : '');
  readonly shortId = $derived(this.card ? this.card.id.slice(-4) : '');
  readonly pageHref = $derived(this.boardId && this.cardId ? `/b/${this.boardId}/c/${this.cardId}/page` : '');
  readonly boardHref = $derived(this.boardId ? `/b/${this.boardId}` : '/');
  readonly detailLoaded = $derived(this.detail !== null);
  readonly archived = $derived(!!this.card?.archivedAt);

  // ---- what is waiting ----
  /** The card's own record wins over the snapshot (see the original comment on `gate`). */
  readonly gate = $derived<Gate | undefined>(
    this.cardId
      ? (this.detail?.gates?.find((g) => g.status === 'pending') ?? (this.detail ? undefined : this.board?.gates.find((g) => g.cardId === this.cardId && g.status === 'pending')))
      : undefined,
  );
  readonly decidedGates = $derived((this.detail?.gates ?? []).filter((g) => g.status !== 'pending'));
  readonly elicitation = $derived(this.cardId ? this.board?.elicitations.find((e) => e.cardId === this.cardId && e.status === 'pending') : undefined);
  readonly deliveryGate = $derived([...this.decidedGates].reverse().find((g) => g.approvalSubject && (g.decision === 'approve_manual' || g.decision === 'approve_automatic')));
  readonly manualItems = $derived(this.deliveryGate?.decision === 'approve_manual' ? manualDeliveryItems(this.deliveryGate.approvalSubject!.canonical) : []);

  // ---- what it carries ----
  readonly refs = $derived(this.cardId ? (this.board?.references ?? []).filter((r) => r.cardId === this.cardId) : []);
  readonly libraryRefs = $derived(this.refs.flatMap((r) => { const l = libraryRef(r.url); return l ? [{ ref: r, ...l }] : []; }));
  readonly otherRefs = $derived(this.refs.filter((r) => libraryRef(r.url) === null));
  readonly children = $derived(this.card ? (this.board?.cards ?? []).filter((c) => c.parentCardId === this.card!.id) : []);
  readonly activityGroups = $derived(groupActivities(this.detail?.activities ?? [], this.attempts));
  readonly stageEntries = $derived(stageAccount(this.attempts, this.refs));
  readonly stageByRun = $derived(new Map(this.stageEntries.map((e) => [e.runId, e])));
  readonly linkGroups = $derived(
    this.card && this.boardId
      ? buildLinkGroups(this.boardId, this.card.id, this.card.blockedBy, this.edges.links, this.edges.externalLinks, (id) => this.board?.cards.find((c) => c.id === id)?.title ?? id)
      : { blockedBy: [], resolvedBlockedBy: [], blocks: [], relates: [], supersedes: [], advisory: [] },
  );
  readonly linkCount = $derived(
    this.linkGroups.blockedBy.length + this.linkGroups.resolvedBlockedBy.length + this.linkGroups.blocks.length +
      this.linkGroups.relates.length + this.linkGroups.supersedes.length + this.linkGroups.advisory.length,
  );
  readonly hasAnyLink = $derived(this.linkCount > 0);
  readonly projectName = $derived(resolveProjectName(this.card?.projectId ?? null, app.projects));
  readonly milestoneName = $derived(
    this.card?.milestoneId ? (this.projectDetail?.milestones.find((m) => m.id === this.card!.milestoneId)?.name ?? this.card.milestoneId) : null,
  );
  readonly acceptanceCriteria = $derived(Array.isArray(this.card?.spec?.acceptanceCriteria) ? (this.card!.spec!.acceptanceCriteria as string[]) : null);
  readonly plan = $derived(normalisePlan(this.card?.spec?.plan));
  readonly handoff = $derived(this.detail?.handoff ?? null);
  readonly overdue = $derived(this.card ? overdue(this.card.dueAt, this.card.state, new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)) : false);
  readonly labels = $derived(this.card ? this.card.labels.map((id) => ({ id, ...(app.labelById().get(id) ?? { name: id, colour: '' }) })) : []);
  readonly ageHours = $derived(this.card?.stateSince ? Math.max(0, (Date.now() - Date.parse(this.card.stateSince)) / 3_600_000) : null);
  readonly costPct = $derived(
    this.card && this.estimate?.estimatedUsd && this.estimate.estimatedUsd > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((this.card.costUsd / this.estimate.estimatedUsd) * 100)) : 0,
  );

  // ---- who ----
  readonly lead = $derived(
    this.card
      ? cardLead({ card: this.card, gate: this.gate, elicitation: this.elicitation, activities: this.detail?.activities ?? [], failureReason: this.stageEntries.at(-1)?.failureReason ?? null })
      : null,
  );
  /** The last run's agent; from the snapshot's `lastAgentId` until the attempts arrive (cell F). */
  readonly lastAgentId = $derived(this.attempts.at(-1)?.agentId ?? this.card?.lastAgentId ?? null);
  /** Who speaks for the card: delegate, gate producer, asker — else whoever ran it last (G-2). */
  readonly speakerId = $derived(
    speakerOf({ delegateId: this.card?.delegateAgentId ?? null, gate: this.gate, elicitation: this.elicitation }) ?? this.lastAgentId,
  );
  readonly agent = $derived<CardAgent>({
    id: this.speakerId,
    name: this.speakerId ? displayAgent(this.speakerId, this.agents) : '',
    iconUrl: this.agents.find((a) => a.id === this.speakerId)?.iconUrl ?? null,
    mood: this.lead ? moodFor(this.lead.kind, !!this.speakerId) : 'resting',
  });
  readonly delegate = $derived.by<CardAgent>(() => {
    const id = this.card?.delegateAgentId ?? null;
    return { id, name: displayAgent(id, this.agents), iconUrl: this.agents.find((a) => a.id === id)?.iconUrl ?? null, mood: this.lead ? moodFor(this.lead.kind, !!id) : 'resting' };
  });
  readonly provenance = $derived(this.card ? cardProvenance(this.card, app.members, this.agents) : null);
  /** Did the grant cover whoever works it — the delegate, or with nobody holding it, the last run's agent? */
  readonly grantCovers = $derived.by<boolean | null>(() => {
    const p = this.provenance;
    if (!p) return null;
    if (p.grantCoversDelegate !== null) return p.grantCoversDelegate;
    const principal = this.agents.find((a) => a.id === this.lastAgentId)?.externalId ?? null;
    const grant = this.card?.queuedGrant ?? null;
    return grant === null || principal === null ? null : grant.includes(principal);
  });
  /** The old drawer's grant phrase, still read by the legacy layouts. */
  readonly grantSummary = $derived.by(() => {
    const p = this.provenance;
    if (!p) return '';
    if (p.grantSize === null) return 'no dispatch authority was recorded';
    if (p.grantSize === 0) return 'authorised to dispatch nobody';
    const base = `authorised to dispatch ${p.grantSize} principal${p.grantSize === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    if (p.grantCoversDelegate === null) return base;
    return p.grantCoversDelegate ? `${base}, including the one working it` : `${base} — NOT including the one working it`;
  });

  readonly counts = $derived<CardCounts>({
    criteria: this.acceptanceCriteria?.length ?? 0,
    planSteps: this.plan?.length ?? 0,
    specFields: Object.keys(this.card?.spec ?? {}).filter((k) => !['description', 'acceptanceCriteria', 'labels', 'due'].includes(k)).length,
    runs: this.activityGroups.length,
    links: this.linkCount,
    children: this.children.length,
    openChildren: this.card?.openChildCount ?? 0,
    decisions: this.decidedGates.length,
    refs: this.refs.length,
    attempts: this.attempts.length,
    deliveryActive: !!this.deliveryGate?.approvalSubject,
    description: !!this.card?.spec?.description,
    handoff: !!this.handoff && Object.keys(this.handoff).length > 0,
    cost: !!this.card && (this.card.costUsd > 0 || !!this.estimate?.estimatedUsd),
  });

  readonly gateBinding = $derived<GateBinding | null>(
    this.gate && this.boardId
      ? { boardId: this.boardId, gate: this.gate, error: this.gateError, conflict: this.gateConflict, onResponse: (d, r) => this.onGateResponse(d, r), onRefresh: () => this.refreshGate() }
      : null,
  );
  readonly questionBinding = $derived<QuestionBinding | null>(
    this.elicitation
      ? { model: this.question, elicitation: this.elicitation, agent: { id: this.elicitation.agentId, name: displayAgent(this.elicitation.agentId, this.agents), iconUrl: this.agents.find((a) => a.id === this.elicitation!.agentId)?.iconUrl ?? null, mood: 'needs' } }
      : null,
  );

  constructor(ctx: () => CardModelContext, opts: CardModelOptions = {}) {
    this.#ctx = ctx;
    this.#opts = opts;
    this.edit = new EditForm(this);
    this.project = new ProjectPicker(this);
    this.links = new LinkEditor(this);
    this.subtasks = new SubtaskComposer(this);
    this.refsForm = new ReferenceComposer(this);
    this.delivery = new DeliveryControls(this);
    this.comments = new CommentsModel(() => ({ boardId: this.boardId, cardId: this.cardId, onFeed: (fn) => app.onFeed(fn) }));
    this.resume = new ResumeModel(() => ({
      boardId: this.boardId, card: this.card ?? null, stages: this.stages, gatePending: !!this.gate, questionPending: !!this.elicitation,
      agentName: this.agent.name, after: async () => { await Promise.all([app.refresh(), this.refresh()]); },
    }));
    this.question = new QuestionAnswer(() => ({
      boardId: this.boardId, elicitation: this.elicitation, after: async () => { await app.refresh(); await this.refresh(); },
    }));

    $effect(() => this.question.follow(this.elicitation?.id ?? null));
    $effect(() => this.resume.follow(this.cardId));

    // The open card changed: reset the forms, then fetch what the snapshot does not carry.
    $effect(() => {
      const id = this.cardId;
      const bid = this.boardId;
      untrack(() => this.#reset());
      if (!id || !bid) return;
      untrack(() => {
        if (this.surface === 'gallery') return;
        void app.loadBoards();
        void this.#loadRelated(id);
      });
      if (!this.#opts.holdDetail) void untrack(() => this.refresh());
    });

    // The project's own record, for the milestone's name; keyed off the id so a board refresh does not refetch it.
    $effect(() => {
      const pid = this.card?.projectId ?? null;
      if (!pid) {
        this.projectDetail = null;
        return;
      }
      void getProject(pid).then((d) => { this.projectDetail = d; });
    });

    // Follow the live feed for this card (see the original comment). A gallery card has no feed.
    $effect(() => {
      const id = this.cardId;
      const bid = this.boardId;
      if (!id || !bid || this.#opts.source || this.#opts.holdDetail) return;
      let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      const stop = app.onFeed((event) => {
        if (event.payload?.cardId && event.payload.cardId !== id) return;
        if (timer !== undefined) return;
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          timer = undefined;
          void this.refresh();
        }, FEED_COALESCE_MS);
      });
      return () => {
        stop();
        if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
      };
    });
  }

  #reset(): void {
    this.detail = null;
    this.attempts = [];
    this.estimate = null;
    this.edges = { links: [], externalLinks: [] };
    this.showToolCalls = false;
    this.localError = null;
    this.gateError = null;
    this.gateConflict = null;
    this.copied = null;
    this.edit.reset();
    this.project.reset();
    this.links.reset();
    this.subtasks.reset();
    this.refsForm.reset();
    this.delivery.reset();
  }

  /** The four fetches, each on its own terms (allSettled; see the original comment). */
  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.cardId;
    const bid = this.boardId;
    if (!id || !bid || this.#opts.holdDetail) return;
    const [acts, atts, est, links] = await Promise.allSettled([getCardActivities(bid, id), getAttempts(bid, id), getEstimate(bid, id), listLinks(bid, id)]);
    if (this.cardId !== id) return;
    if (acts.status === 'fulfilled') this.detail = acts.value;
    if (atts.status === 'fulfilled') this.attempts = atts.value;
    if (est.status === 'fulfilled') this.estimate = est.value;
    if (links.status === 'fulfilled') this.edges = links.value;
  }

  async #loadRelated(id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.related = { phase: 'loading', items: [] };
    try {
      const items = await relatedForCard(id);
      if (this.cardId === id) this.related = { phase: 'ok', items };
    } catch (e) {
      if (this.cardId === id) this.related = { phase: isAbsent(e) ? 'absent' : 'unavailable', items: [] };
    }
  }

  async #leave(after: 'decided' | 'archived' | 'deleted'): Promise<void> {
    if (this.surface === 'gallery') return;
    if (this.surface === 'drawer') {
      app.closeCard();
      await app.refresh();
      return;
    }
    if (after === 'deleted') {
      await goto(this.boardHref);
      return;
    }
    await Promise.all([app.refresh(), this.refresh()]);
  }

  /** A refusal stays beside the buttons; a 409 says who already decided (API-1). */
  async onGateResponse(decision: GateDecision, res: Response): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.boardId) return false;
    if (!res.ok) {
      const conflict = res.status === 409 ? await parseGateConflict(res.clone()) : null;
      if (conflict) {
        this.gateConflict = conflict;
        this.gateError = null;
      } else {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | null;
        this.gateError = body?.error?.message ? `${body.error.message} (${res.status})` : `Couldn't record that decision (${res.status})`;
      }
      if (this.surface !== 'gallery') await Promise.all([app.refresh(), this.refresh()]);
      return false;
    }
    this.gateError = null;
    this.gateConflict = null;
    this.localError = null;
    if (this.surface === 'gallery') return true;
    if (decision === 'approve_manual') {
      await Promise.all([app.refresh(), this.refresh()]);
      return true;
    }
    await this.#leave('decided');
    return true;
  }

  /** "Refresh to see it": re-read the card and the board, then drop the conflict notice. */
  async refreshGate(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all([this.surface === 'gallery' ? Promise.resolve() : app.refresh(), this.#opts.holdDetail ? Promise.resolve() : this.refresh()]);
    this.gateConflict = null;
  }

  async assignToMe(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.boardId || !this.cardId || !app.user) return;
    this.assigning = true;
    try {
      const res = await updateCard(this.boardId, this.cardId, { ownerUserId: app.user.userId });
      if (!res.ok) this.localError = `Couldn't reassign the card (${res.status})`;
      await app.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.assigning = false;
    }
  }

  async remove(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.boardId || !this.cardId) return;
    if (!confirm('Delete this card and its history? This cannot be undone.')) return;
    const res = await deleteCard(this.boardId, this.cardId);
    if (res.ok) await this.#leave('deleted');
    else this.localError = `Couldn't delete the card (${res.status})`;
  }

  async archive(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.boardId || !this.cardId) return;
    if (!confirm('Archive this card? It will drop off the board unless "show archived" is on.')) return;
    this.archiving = true;
    try {
      const res = await archiveCard(this.boardId, this.cardId);
      if (res.ok) await this.#leave('archived');
      else this.localError = `Couldn't archive the card (${res.status})`;
    } finally {
      this.archiving = false;
    }
  }

  /** Restore does not close anything: the card stays in view (see the original comment). */
  async restore(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.boardId || !this.cardId) return;
    this.archiving = true;
    try {
      const res = await unarchiveCard(this.boardId, this.cardId);
      if (res.ok) await Promise.all([this.surface === 'gallery' ? Promise.resolve() : app.refresh(), this.refresh()]);
      else this.localError = `Couldn't un-archive the card (${res.status})`;
    } finally {
      this.archiving = false;
    }
  }

  #flash(kind: 'id' | 'link' | 'session' | 'spec'): void {
    this.copied = kind;
    if (this.#copiedTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.#copiedTimer);
    this.#copiedTimer = setTimeout(() => { this.copied = null; }, COPIED_MS);
  }
  async #copy(text: string, kind: 'id' | 'link' | 'session' | 'spec', refused: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      this.#flash(kind);
    } catch {
      this.localError = refused;
    }
  }
  copyId(): Promise<void> {
    return this.#copy(this.card?.id ?? '', 'id', 'Clipboard access was refused. Select the card id and copy it.');
  }
  copyLink(): Promise<void> {
    return this.#copy(`${location.origin}${this.pageHref}`, 'link', 'Clipboard access was refused. Select the address bar and copy it.');
  }
  copySessionId(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.#copy(sessionId, 'session', 'Clipboard access was refused. Select the session id and copy it.');
  }
  copySpec(): Promise<void> {
    return this.#copy(JSON.stringify(this.card?.spec ?? {}, null, 2), 'spec', 'Clipboard access was refused. Open View raw JSON and copy it.');
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/types.ts
/**
 * What a card surface is handed (spec §7.5, amendments §7.3–§7.4). The model owns the data and
 * every control; a layout only draws it. Every element a layout draws for one of the 23 sections
 * carries `data-section="<key>"` (an empty one is `<span hidden data-section>`), and
 * `card-layouts.svelte.test.ts` holds every layout to each key exactly once.
 */
import type { Mood, Phase, Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { Elicitation, Gate, GateConflict, GateDecision } from '$lib/api';
import type { CardModel } from '../card-model.svelte';
import type { QuestionAnswer } from '../question/question-answer.svelte';

export const CARD_SECTION_KEYS = [
  'error', 'status', 'facts', 'editButton', 'editForm', 'description', 'delivery', 'resume', 'plan', 'criteria',
  'details', 'project', 'links', 'subtasks', 'activity', 'decisions', 'comments', 'handoff', 'cost', 'attempts',
  'related', 'references', 'cardActions',
] as const;
export type CardSectionKey = (typeof CARD_SECTION_KEYS)[number];

/** `description`, `handoff`, `cost`: whether that section has anything to show. */
export interface CardCounts { criteria: number; planSteps: number; specFields: number; runs: number; links: number; children: number; openChildren: number; decisions: number; refs: number; attempts: number; deliveryActive: boolean; description: boolean; handoff: boolean; cost: boolean }
export interface CardAgent { id: string | null; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood }
export interface GateBinding {
  boardId: string; gate: Gate; error: string | null; conflict: GateConflict | null;
  onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>;
  onRefresh: () => Promise<void>;
}
export interface QuestionBinding { model: QuestionAnswer; elicitation: Elicitation; agent: CardAgent }

export interface CardLayoutProps {
  model: CardModel;
  vibe: Vibe;
  phase: Phase;
  /** `app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? 'there'` */
  personName: string;
  gate: GateBinding | null;
  question: QuestionBinding | null;
  /** `/b/{boardId}/c/{cardId}/page` */
  pageHref: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}
export type CardPageProps = Omit<CardLayoutProps, 'onClose'> & { boardHref: string };
export type CardStateCellKey = 'gate' | 'question' | 'archived' | 'done' | 'error' | 'loading';
export interface CardStateCell { model: CardModel; gate: GateBinding | null; question: QuestionBinding | null }
export interface CardStatesProps { cells: Record<CardStateCellKey, CardStateCell>; vibe: Vibe; phase: Phase }
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/legacy/LegacyCard.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The bridge from a CardModel to a pre-sweep layout: the drawer's 23 section snippets, moved
   * here from CardDrawer.svelte and rewritten against the model, each opened with a hidden
   * `data-section` marker so the DOM parity test can count it. Deleted with `card/legacy/`.
   */
  import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { FACE_VARIANT } from '$lib/face-variant';
  import { defaultOpen, isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import { edgeKey } from '$lib/components/link-groups';
  import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
  import AgentFace from '$lib/components/AgentFace.svelte';
  import SpecDetails from '../SpecDetails.svelte';
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import PlanChecklist from '../PlanChecklist.svelte';
  import CardComments from '../CardComments.svelte';
  import CardResume from '../CardResume.svelte';
  import RelatedWork from '../RelatedWork.svelte';
  import LibraryArtifact from '../LibraryArtifact.svelte';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import { ageLabel } from '$lib/age';
  import { isEmptyValue, safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { refLabel, subStateLabel } from '../references';
  import { LEGACY_LAYOUTS } from './legacy-layouts';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from '../layouts/types';

  let { model: m, vibe, phase, personName, gate, question, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();
  const Layout = $derived(LEGACY_LAYOUTS[vibe]!);
  const faceVariant = $derived(FACE_VARIANT[vibe]);

  function statePillClass(state: string): string {
    if (state === 'working') return 'statepill statepill-working';
    if (state === 'gate' || m.gate) return 'statepill statepill-gate';
    if (state === 'done') return 'statepill statepill-done';
    return 'statepill statepill-ready';
  }
  function statePillLabel(state: string): string {
    if (state === 'working') return 'working';
    if (m.gate) return 'input-required';
    if (state === 'done') return 'completed';
    return 'ready';
  }
  function activityMarker(type: string): { glyph: string; cssClass: string } {
    if (type === 'action') return { glyph: '▸', cssClass: 'act-action' };
    if (type === 'response') return { glyph: '◆', cssClass: 'act-response' };
    if (type === 'error') return { glyph: '✕', cssClass: 'act-error' };
    if (type === 'elicitation') return { glyph: '⚑', cssClass: 'act-elicitation' };
    if (type === 'prompt') return { glyph: '✎', cssClass: 'act-response' };
    return { glyph: '◇', cssClass: 'act-thought' };
  }
  function fmtTime(ts: string): string {
    try {
      return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
    } catch {
      return ts;
    }
  }
  const fmtUsd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
</script>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/CardDrawer.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The card drawer: a real modal dialog around whichever layout the vibe picks (CARD_LAYOUTS).
   * It owns focus (on open, trapped, restored on close) and the scrim; the CardModel owns the
   * card; the layout draws it, its Close button included.
   */
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { viewport } from '$lib/viewport.svelte';
  import { CARD_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import { CardModel } from '$lib/components/card/card-model.svelte';

  const model = new CardModel(() => ({ boardId: app.boardId, cardId: app.openCardId, surface: 'drawer' }));
  const vibe = $derived(appearance.value.vibe);
  const L = $derived(CARD_LAYOUTS[vibe]);
  const Layout = $derived(viewport.narrow ? L.phone : L.drawer);
  const close = (): void => app.closeCard();

  // Focus: the panel on open, the opening tile on close (see the original comments, moved here unchanged).
  let panelEl = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  let openerCardId: string | null = null;
  $effect(() => {
    if (model.card && panelEl) {
      openerCardId ??= model.card.id;
      panelEl.focus();
    }
  });
  onDestroy(() => {
    const id = openerCardId;
    openerCardId = null;
    if (!id || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    queueMicrotask(() => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-card-open="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`)?.focus());
  });

  // While the Daylight card is open beside the board (placement 'reserve', ≥1280px), the board keeps the room (D-1).
  $effect(() => {
    if (L.placement !== 'reserve' || viewport.narrow || typeof window === 'undefined' || window.innerWidth < 1280) return;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-drawer-reserve', L.width);
    return () => document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--card-drawer-reserve');
  });

  const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),summary,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
  function trapTab(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab' || !panelEl) return;
    const items = [...panelEl.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)].filter(
      (el) => (el.offsetParent !== null && el.getClientRects().length > 0) || el === document.activeElement,
    );
    if (items.length === 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      panelEl.focus();
      return;
    }
    const first = items[0]!;
    const last = items[items.length - 1]!;
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (e.shiftKey && (active === first || active === panelEl)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && active === last) {
      e.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  }
</script>

{#if model.card}
  <div class="fixed inset-0 z-30 flex {L.align === 'center' && !viewport.narrow ? 'justify-center' : 'justify-end'}">
    <button class="absolute inset-0" style="background:var(--card-scrim, var(--sp-scrim))" onclick={close} aria-label="Close drawer" tabindex="-1"></button>
    <div
      bind:this={panelEl}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="drawer-title"
      tabindex="-1"
      onkeydown={trapTab}
      class="drawer-in safe-top safe-bottom safe-x relative flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col"
      style="width:{viewport.narrow ? '100%' : L.width}">
      <Layout
        {model}
        {vibe}
        phase={appearance.phase}
        personName={app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? 'there'}
        gate={model.gateBinding}
        question={model.questionBinding}
        pageHref={model.pageHref}
        onClose={close}
      />
    </div>
  </div>
{/if}
```

```ts
import LegacyCard from '$lib/components/card/legacy/LegacyCard.svelte';
import type { CardLayoutProps } from '$lib/components/card/layouts/types';

/**
 * A vibe's card: the drawer layout, the phone layout (below 640px), the panel width and where it
 * sits (amendments §7.3). `reserve` keeps the board in view beside the card at ≥1280px.
 */
export interface CardLayout {
  drawer: Component<CardLayoutProps>;
  phone: Component<CardLayoutProps>;
  width: string;
  align: 'end' | 'center';
  placement: 'overlay' | 'reserve' | 'sheet';
}
/** Widths stay what each vibe drew before the sweep until its own card task replaces the entry. */
export const CARD_LAYOUTS: Readonly<Record<Vibe, CardLayout>> = {
  daylight: { drawer: LegacyCard, phone: LegacyCard, width: 'min(520px, 100%)', align: 'end', placement: 'overlay' },
  paper: { drawer: LegacyCard, phone: LegacyCard, width: 'min(680px, 100%)', align: 'center', placement: 'overlay' },
  studio: { drawer: LegacyCard, phone: LegacyCard, width: 'min(760px, 100%)', align: 'end', placement: 'overlay' },
  quiet: { drawer: LegacyCard, phone: LegacyCard, width: 'min(640px, 100%)', align: 'end', placement: 'overlay' },
};
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/card-layouts.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
/**
 * Every card surface shows everything (spec §7.5): each of the 23 sections exactly once, counted
 * by `[data-section]` in the rendered DOM. A layout with tabs is counted tab by tab and the union
 * must cover every key; the edit form is counted while editing. The dev gallery is exempt.
 * Later tasks add their page and phone components to SURFACES.
 */
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, render } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import { flushSync, type Component } from 'svelte';
import { VIBES, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { CARD_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
import { CARD_SECTION_KEYS, type CardLayoutProps } from './types';
import { mountModel } from '../testing/mount-model.svelte';

vi.mock('$lib/stores/app.svelte', async () => ({ app: (await import('../testing/fakes')).fakeApp }));
vi.mock('$lib/api', async (orig) => ({ ...(await orig<typeof import('$lib/api')>()), ...(await import('../testing/fakes')).fakeApi }));
vi.mock('$lib/superlibrary', async (orig) => ({ ...(await orig<typeof import('$lib/superlibrary')>()), relatedForCard: vi.fn(async () => []) }));
vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ goto: vi.fn() }));
globalThis.ResizeObserver ??= class { observe() {} unobserve() {} disconnect() {} } as never;
afterEach(() => cleanup());

type Surface = { name: string; vibe: Vibe; component: Component<CardLayoutProps> };
export const SURFACES: Surface[] = VIBES.flatMap((v) => {
  const L = CARD_LAYOUTS[v];
  const out: Surface[] = [{ name: `${v} drawer`, vibe: v, component: L.drawer }];
  if (L.phone !== L.drawer) out.push({ name: `${v} phone`, vibe: v, component: L.phone });
  return out;
});

function counts(root: HTMLElement): Map<string, number> {
  const m = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('[data-section]')) m.set(el.getAttribute('data-section')!, (m.get(el.getAttribute('data-section')!) ?? 0) + 1);
  return m;
}

describe.each(SURFACES)('$name', ({ vibe, component }) => {
  it('renders each of the 23 sections exactly once', async () => {
    const { model, dispose } = mountModel();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(model.detailLoaded).toBe(true));
    const { container } = render(component, { model, vibe, phase: 'noon', personName: 'Rakesh', gate: model.gateBinding, question: model.questionBinding, pageHref: model.pageHref, onClose: () => {} });
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const check = () => {
      for (const [k, n] of counts(container)) {
        expect(n, `${k} rendered ${n} times`).toBe(1);
        seen.add(k);
      }
    };
    check();
    for (const tab of [...container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="tab"]')]) {
      tab.click();
      flushSync();
      check();
    }
    model.edit.start();
    flushSync();
    check();
    expect([...CARD_SECTION_KEYS].filter((k) => !seen.has(k))).toEqual([]);
    dispose();
  });
});
```

- Produces: `Icon` (`{ name: IconName; size?: number; stroke?: number }`) and `ICONS`/`IconName` in `parts/icons.ts` (later tasks add names, never rename); `TokenText` (`{ text: string; cls: string; re?: RegExp; tokens?: boolean }`); `SpecValueView` (`{ value: SpecValue; v: { clamp?: string; more: string; id?: string; link?: string; matrixLinks: boolean } }`); `DeliveryPanel` (`{ model }`), `LinkAddForm` (`{ model }`); `openCardAnywhere(cardId, deps?)` in `card/open-card.ts`; `CardStateDaylight` (`{ kind: 'archived' | 'restore' | 'done' | 'loading'; model: CardModel }`); `CardStatesGallery` (`{ specs: Record<CardStateCellKey, GalleryCellSpec>; sources: Record<string, CardSource> }`, `GalleryCellSpec { boardId: string; cardId: string; holdDetail?: boolean }`); `CARD_STATES_LAYOUTS: Readonly<Record<Vibe, Component<CardStatesProps>>>` (Daylight for every vibe until Tasks 25–27 replace theirs); `GateDaylight` props `{ boardId, gate, error, onResponse, agent, lead, vibe, conflict?, onRefresh?, part?: 'all' | 'controls' }` (a `GateBinding` spreads straight in); the root layout renders only the page (plus palette and appearance dialog) when `page.data.shell === 'bare'`; `gatePanelContract(C, { decision, submit?, words?: GateWords })`, `questionPanelContract(C, { decision, submit?, noteLabel?, words?: QuestionWords })`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Port the reference CSS**

```bash
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Card-Daylight --prefix dl- --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/card-daylight.css
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Card-States-Daylight --prefix ds --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/daylight-states.css
```

`--prefix ds` (no dash) also keeps the gallery root rules `.ds { … }`, `.ds *` and
`.ds textarea.vk-field__input`. The board-backdrop rules `.dl-board/.dl-lane/.dl-tile/.dl-greet/.dl-lanes/.dl-scrim`
come along and stay unused (the real board is behind the drawer). Append these hand-written deltas to
`card-daylight.css` (the reference draws the drawer as a grid cell under a `.dl` canvas root the app
does not have):

```css
/* ---- deltas: not in the reference ---- */
.dl-drawer { height: 100%; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; container: card / inline-size; }
/* the reference scopes these under its `.dl` canvas root */
.dl-drawer select.vk-field__input { padding-right: var(--vk-space-6); }
.dl-drawer textarea.vk-field__input { min-height: 96px; padding: var(--vk-space-3) var(--vk-space-4); resize: vertical; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; }
/* the plan/project pair, an inline grid in the reference, gets a class so it can stack */
.dl-twocol { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--vk-space-5); }
/* signal only while a person is needed now: a working card's current stage is ink, an archived one muted */
.dl-track li.cur.quiet { color: var(--vk-color-text); }
.dl-track li.cur.quiet .bar { background: var(--vk-color-primary); outline-color: var(--vk-color-text); }
.dl-track li.cur.off { color: var(--vk-color-muted); }
.dl-track li.cur.off .bar { background: var(--vk-color-muted); outline: 0; }
.dl-bubble.plain { background: var(--vk-color-raised); }
.dl-bubble.plain .dl-who { color: var(--vk-color-muted); }
.dl-row .vk-button--quiet { min-height: 44px; }
@container card (max-width: 620px) {
  .dl-groups, .dl-grid2, .dl-twocol { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .dl-reply { margin-left: 0; }
}
:root[data-vibe='daylight'] { --card-scrim: color-mix(in oklch, var(--vk-color-text) 42%, transparent); }
```

and to `daylight-states.css`:

```css
/* ---- deltas: the reference root carries these inline ---- */
.ds { background: var(--vk-color-bg); color: var(--vk-color-text); font-family: var(--vk-font-body); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-load .ds-sk { animation: none; } }
```

Run `grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b' apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/card-daylight.css apps/web/src/lib/components/card/daylight-states.css` —
expected: no output (both references use tokens only).

```ts
const gate = { id: 'gate_fx_p4', cardId: CARD_4605.id, stageKey: 'reproduce', status: 'pending', options: [], producedBy: 'agt_fx_error_eric', summary: 'All done, ready for your review.' };
const board = { ...BOARD_DX, gates: [gate] } as never;
const CONFLICT = { error: { code: 'GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED', message: 'gate is already resolved', decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' } };

describe('decision error (cell E)', () => {
  it('shows the note error and the already-decided alert together, under the buttons', async () => {
    fakeApi.resolveGate.mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify(CONFLICT), { status: 409 }));
    const { model, dispose } = mountModel({ surface: 'gallery', holdDetail: true, source: { board, agents: fakeApp.agents } });
    const { container, rerender } = render(GateDaylight, { ...model.gateBinding!, agent: model.agent, lead: model.lead!, vibe: 'daylight', part: 'controls' });
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Request changes' }));
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(model.gateConflict).not.toBeNull());
    await rerender({ ...model.gateBinding!, agent: model.agent, lead: model.lead!, vibe: 'daylight', part: 'controls' });
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Say what needs to change').getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');
    expect(screen.getByText('Request changes needs a note: it threads into the agent’s next attempt.')).toBeTruthy();
    const alert = screen.getByRole('alert');
    expect(alert.textContent!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).toContain('Not recorded. This gate was already decided from Matrix by Rakesh Gangwar at 13:02.');
    const reject = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject' });
    expect(reject.compareDocumentPosition(alert) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING).toBeTruthy();
    expect(container.querySelector('.ds-msg'), 'part="controls" draws no quote').toBeNull();
    await fireEvent.click(within(alert).getByRole('button', { name: 'Refresh to see it' }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(model.gateConflict).toBeNull());
    dispose();
  });
});
```

```ts
/** The words a panel prints for the contract's fixture gate; pre-sweep panels use the defaults. */
export interface GateWords {
  heading: RegExp; subjectHeading: RegExp; subjectId: string | null; digest: string; canonical: RegExp;
  region: RegExp; noteId: string; errorBeforeControls: boolean;
}
export const OLD_GATE_WORDS: GateWords = {
  heading: /awaiting your review/, subjectHeading: /Immutable approval subject · revision 4/, subjectId: 'sub_1',
  digest: 'sha256:3f9ac21e77aa', canonical: /"post": "Hello"/, region: /canonical JSON/i, noteId: 'gate-note-gat_1', errorBeforeControls: true,
};
```

change the signature to `gatePanelContract(C, o: { decision: 'button' | 'radio'; submit?: string; words?: GateWords })`,
add `const w = o.words ?? OLD_GATE_WORDS;` at its top, and rewrite the three word-bearing tests:

```ts
    it('shows the heading, the lead, the subject, the seal and the note', () => {

      expect(screen.getByText(w.digest)).toBeTruthy();
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/open-card.ts
/**
 * A brief value can name a card on another board ("onboarding card") by its id alone. Find the
 * board that holds it and go there; the board list is the person's own, so this never reaches
 * a board they cannot see.
 */
import { goto as svelteGoto } from '$app/navigation';
import { getBoard as apiGetBoard } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

export interface OpenCardDeps {
  boards: () => Array<{ id: string }>;
  getBoard: (id: string) => Promise<{ cards: Array<{ id: string }> }>;
  goto: (href: string) => Promise<void>;
}
const DEFAULT_DEPS: OpenCardDeps = { boards: () => app.boards, getBoard: apiGetBoard, goto: (h) => svelteGoto(h) };

export async function openCardAnywhere(cardId: string, deps: OpenCardDeps = DEFAULT_DEPS): Promise<void> {
  for (const b of deps.boards()) {
    try {
      if ((await deps.getBoard(b.id)).cards.some((c) => c.id === cardId)) {
        await deps.goto(`/b/${b.id}/c/${cardId}`);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // A board that will not load is skipped, not an error the reader must handle.
    }
  }
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/GateDaylight.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * A pending approval in Daylight (SP-Card-States-Daylight A and E): the agent's line, the flag,
   * the subject before the buttons, the note, the three decisions, and any refusal UNDER them.
   * `part="controls"` draws only the note, the buttons and the alert (cell E).
   */
  import '../daylight-states.css';
  import { Face, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { Gate, GateConflict, GateDecision } from '$lib/api';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { whenLabel } from '$lib/when';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import StructuredValue from '../StructuredValue.svelte';
  import { humanizeKey } from '../spec-groups';
  import { gateConflictSentence } from '../card-words';
  import type { CardLead } from '../card-lead';
  import type { CardAgent } from '../layouts/types';
  import { GATE_NOTE_MAX, GateDecisionModel, roleOf, sealOf } from './gate-decision.svelte';

  let { boardId, gate, error, onResponse, agent, lead, conflict = null, onRefresh = async () => {}, part = 'all' }: {
    boardId: string; gate: Gate; error: string | null; onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>;
    agent: CardAgent; lead: CardLead; vibe: Vibe; conflict?: GateConflict | null; onRefresh?: () => Promise<void>; part?: 'all' | 'controls';
  } = $props();

  const model = new GateDecisionModel(() => ({ boardId, gate, onResponse }));
  $effect(() => model.follow(gate.id));
  const ORDER = ['approve', 'changes', 'reject'] as const;
  const ordered = $derived([...model.options].sort((a, b) => ORDER.indexOf(roleOf(a.name)!) - ORDER.indexOf(roleOf(b.name)!)));
  const BUTTON = { approve: 'vk-button vk-button--primary', changes: 'vk-button vk-button--secondary', reject: 'vk-button vk-button--quiet' } as const;
  const subject = $derived(gate.approvalSubject ?? null);
  const rows = $derived(subject ? Object.entries(subject.canonical).map(([k, v]) => ({ k, label: humanizeKey(k), v })) : []);
  const noteId = $derived(`gate-note-${part === 'all' ? 'a' : 'e'}-${gate.id}`);
  const name = $derived(agent.name || 'The agent');
  let pressed = $state<string | null>(null);
  let copied = $state(false);

  async function copyDigest(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(subject!.digest);
      copied = true;
      setTimeout(() => (copied = false), 2000);
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
  }
  async function choose(optionName: string): Promise<void> {
    pressed = optionName;
    await model.decide(optionName);
    pressed = null;
  }
  const flat = (v: unknown): string | null => (typeof v === 'string' ? v : Array.isArray(v) && v.every((x) => typeof x === 'string') ? v.join(', ') : null);
</script>

{#if part === 'all'}
  <div class="ds-msg">
    <Face id={name} label={name} mood="needs" size={36} />
    <div class="ds-bubble ds-bubble--sig">
      <span class="ds-who">{name} · needs you</span>
      <p class="ds-say">{lead.sentence ?? gate.summary ?? 'Waiting for your review.'}</p>
      {#if lead.at}<span class="ds-time">{whenLabel(lead.at, new Date())}</span>{/if}
    </div>
  </div>
  <span class="ds-flag"><Icon name="flag" size={16} /> Awaiting your review</span>
  {#if subject}
    <div class="ds-post">
      <div class="ds-posthead">
        <b>Approval subject</b><span>· revision {subject.revision}</span>
        <span class="ds-mono" style="margin-left: auto;">digest {sealOf(subject.digest)} <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" aria-label="Copy the full digest" style="min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 4px;" onclick={copyDigest}><Icon name={copied ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /></button></span>
      </div>
      <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex: a scrollable region must be keyboard reachable -->
      <div class="ds-postbody" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="The approval subject">
        <dl class="ds-dl">
          {#each rows as r (r.k)}<div><dt>{r.label}</dt><dd>{#if flat(r.v) !== null}{flat(r.v)}{:else}<StructuredValue value={r.v} />{/if}</dd></div>{/each}
        </dl>
        <details class="ds-raw"><summary>View raw JSON</summary><RawJson value={subject.canonical} /></details>
      </div>
      <div class="ds-seal"><Icon name="seal" size={14} /> Approving exactly this version · sealed {sealOf(subject.digest)}</div>
    </div>
  {/if}
{/if}
<div class="vk-field" data-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined}>
  <label class="vk-field__label" for={noteId}>{model.needNote ? 'Say what needs to change' : 'Add a note (optional)'}</label>
  <textarea id={noteId} class="vk-field__input" maxlength={GATE_NOTE_MAX} bind:this={model.noteEl} bind:value={model.note}
    aria-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined} aria-describedby={model.needNote ? `${noteId}-err` : undefined}
    placeholder={model.needNote ? undefined : 'Recorded with your decision. Request changes needs one: it threads into the agent’s next attempt.'}></textarea>
  {#if model.needNote}
    <p id="{noteId}-err" class="vk-field__error">Request changes needs a note: it threads into the agent’s next attempt.</p>
  {:else}
    <span class="ds-count">{model.note.length} / {GATE_NOTE_MAX}</span>
  {/if}
</div>
<div class="ds-btns">
  {#each ordered as opt (opt.name)}
    {@const role = roleOf(opt.name)!}
    <button class={BUTTON[role]} type="button" disabled={model.busy} onclick={() => choose(opt.name)}>{#if role === 'approve'}<Icon name="check" size={18} /> {/if}{model.busy && pressed === opt.name ? 'Recording…' : opt.title}</button>
  {/each}
</div>
{#if conflict}
  <div class="ds-alert" role="alert"><Icon name="alert" size={18} /><div><b>Not recorded.</b> {gateConflictSentence(conflict, displayPrincipal(conflict.decidedBy, app.members))} <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="min-height: 44px; margin: -12px 0px; font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" onclick={() => onRefresh()}>Refresh to see it</button></div></div>
{:else if error}
  <div class="ds-alert" role="alert"><Icon name="alert" size={18} /><div><b>Not recorded.</b> {error}</div></div>
{/if}
```
