```svelte
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import LibraryArtifact from '../LibraryArtifact.svelte';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import DeliveryPanel from '../DeliveryPanel.svelte';
  import LinkAddForm from '../LinkAddForm.svelte';
  import TokenText from '../TokenText.svelte';
  import SpecValueView from '../SpecValueView.svelte';
  import GateDaylight from '../gate/GateDaylight.svelte';
  import QuestionDaylight from '../question/QuestionDaylight.svelte';
  import CardStateDaylight from '../state/CardStateDaylight.svelte';
  import { specGroups, specRowCount } from '../spec-groups';
  import { refLabel, referenceSource } from '../references';
  import { safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { sessionIdOf } from '../tokens';
  import { attemptWord, eventSentence, eventVerb, pillTone, stopLine, stripAria, stripKind, waitingWord } from '../state-words';
  import {
    askedByTitle, attemptsLine, briefMeta, briefSummary, costSummary, emptyNoteCaption, factItems, handoffLine, initials,
    linksSummary, ownerChip, planNone, planProgress, projectLine, provenanceLine, relatedLine, replySub, RESUME_PLACEHOLDER,
    subtasksLine, talkSummary, unclaimedChip, usd, whatHappenedSummary,
  } from '../card-words';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';

  let { model: m, vibe, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();

  const card = $derived(m.card!);
  const lead = $derived(m.lead!);
  const editing = $derived(m.edit.editing);
  const name = (id: string | null) => (id ? displayAgent(id, m.agents) : '');
  const agentName = $derived(m.agent.name || 'the agent');
  const lastName = $derived(name(m.lastAgentId));
  const ownerName = $derived(displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members));
  const q = $derived(m.provenance);
  const kind = $derived(stripKind(lead, m.archived));
  const tone = $derived(pillTone(card, lead));
  const groups = $derived(specGroups(card.spec, { criteriaHeading: 'Acceptance criteria' }));
  const rowCount = $derived(specRowCount(groups));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead.sentence));
  const runs = $derived([...m.activityGroups].reverse());
  const facts = $derived(factItems({ card, stageName: m.stageName, ageHours: m.ageHours, labelNames: m.labels.map((l) => l.name), projectName: null }));
  const attemptOf = (runId: string) => m.attempts.find((a) => a.runId === runId);
  const stageNameOf = (key: string | null) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)?.name ?? key ?? 'Unknown stage';
  const stopped = $derived(['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead.kind) && !m.archived);
  const planDone = $derived(m.plan?.filter((s) => s.done).length ?? 0);
  const LINK_LABEL = { blockedBy: 'Blocked by', resolvedBlockedBy: 'Blocked by (resolved)', blocks: 'Blocks', relates: 'Relates to', supersedes: 'Supersedes', advisory: 'On other boards (advisory)' } as const;

  // The pinned brief folds while the agent needs you; re-decided only when the card or that changes.
  let briefOpen = $state(false);
  let briefFor = '';
  $effect(() => {
    const k = `${card.id}:${lead.needsYou}`;
    if (k !== briefFor) { briefFor = k; briefOpen = !lead.needsYou; }
  });

  // Which sections are open, remembered per card for the tab's life.
  type Sec = 'brief' | 'happened' | 'links' | 'talk' | 'cost';
  const DEFAULT_OPEN: Record<Sec, boolean> = { brief: true, happened: false, links: false, talk: false, cost: false };
  let open = $state<Record<Sec, boolean>>({ ...DEFAULT_OPEN });
  let openFor = '';
  $effect(() => {
    const id = card.id;
    if (id === openFor) return;
    openFor = id;
    try {
      open = { ...DEFAULT_OPEN, ...(JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(`sp:card-open:${id}`) ?? '{}') as Partial<Record<Sec, boolean>>) };
    } catch {
      open = { ...DEFAULT_OPEN };
    }
  });
  function toggled(sec: Sec, e: Event): void {
    open[sec] = (e.currentTarget as HTMLDetailsElement).open;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(`sp:card-open:${card.id}`, JSON.stringify(open)); } catch { /* private window: forget it */ }
  }

  $effect(() => m.comments.attach());
  function commentKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void m.comments.submit(); }
  }
</script>

{#snippet hidden(key: string)}<span hidden data-section={key}></span>{/snippet}

{#snippet sec(id: Sec, title: string, sum: string, body: import('svelte').Snippet)}
  <details class="dl-sec" open={open[id]} ontoggle={(e) => toggled(id, e)}>
    <summary><h3>{title}</h3><span class="sum">{sum}</span><span class="tw"><Icon name="chevron-right" size={18} /></span></summary>
    <div class="dl-secbody">{@render body()}</div>
  </details>
{/snippet}

<section class="dl-drawer">
  <header class="dl-head">
    <div class="dl-row" style="justify-content: space-between;">
      <span class="dl-eyebrow">{m.boardName} · {m.stageName}</span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
        <a class="dl-icon" href={pageHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Open in new window" style="width: auto; padding: 0px 14px; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;"><Icon name="open-window" size={18} /><span>Open in new window</span></a>
        <button class="dl-icon" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" style="margin: -10px -10px -10px 0px;" onclick={onClose}><Icon name="close" size={20} /></button>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="dl-row" style="align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: nowrap;">
      <h2 id="drawer-title" class="dl-title" class:vk-visually-hidden={editing}>{card.title}</h2>
      {#if editing}{@render hidden('editButton')}{:else}<button class="dl-icon" type="button" aria-label="Edit card" aria-pressed={editing} style="margin-top: -6px;" data-section="editButton" onclick={() => m.edit.start()}><Icon name="edit" size={20} /></button>{/if}
    </div>
    {#if editing}
      <div data-section="editForm"><CardEditForm model={m} /></div>
      {@render hidden('status')}{@render hidden('facts')}
    {:else}
      {@render hidden('editForm')}
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;">
        <ol class="dl-track" aria-label={stripAria(m.stageIndex, m.stages.length, m.stageName, kind, 'drawer')}>
          {#each m.stages as s, i (s.key)}
            {#if i < m.stageIndex}
              <li class="done" title="Stage {i + 1} · {s.name}"><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab"><Icon name="check" size={14} /> {i + 1}<span class="vk-visually-hidden"> {s.name}, done</span></span></li>
            {:else if i === m.stageIndex}
              <li class="cur" class:quiet={!lead.needsYou && !m.archived} class:off={m.archived} aria-current="step"><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab">{i + 1} · {s.name}</span></li>
            {:else}
              <li title="Stage {i + 1} · {s.name}"><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab">{i + 1}<span class="vk-visually-hidden"> {s.name}</span></span></li>
            {/if}
          {/each}
        </ol>
        <span class="dl-small">{stopLine(lead, m.stageIndex, m.stages)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="dl-row" style="gap: var(--vk-space-2);" data-section="status">
        <span class="vk-pill vk-pill--{tone === 'off' ? 'resting' : tone}">{waitingWord(card, lead, m.ageHours, 'desktop')}</span>
        <span class="dl-chip" class:dl-chip--plain={!m.delegate.id && !lastName}>
          {#if m.delegate.id}<Face id={m.delegate.name} label={m.delegate.name} mood={m.delegate.mood} size={24} />{:else if lastName}<Face id={lastName} label={lastName} mood="resting" size={24} />{/if}
          <span>{unclaimedChip({ delegateName: m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : null, lastAgentName: lastName || null, attemptCount: card.attemptCount })}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="dl-chip"><span class="dl-initials" aria-hidden="true">{initials(ownerName)}</span><span>{ownerChip(ownerName)}</span></span>
        {#if q?.known}
          <span class="dl-chip" class:dl-chip--plain={!q.byAgent} title={askedByTitle(q.queuedByName, q.byAgent, q.grantSize)}>
            {#if q.byAgent}<Face id={q.queuedByName} label={q.queuedByName} mood="working" size={24} />{/if}<span>Asked by {q.queuedByName}</span>
          </span>
        {/if}
        {#if app.user && card.ownerUserId !== app.user.userId && !m.archived}
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" disabled={m.assigning} onclick={() => m.assignToMe()}>{m.assigning ? 'Assigning…' : 'Assign to me'}</button>
        {/if}
      </div>
      <div class="dl-facts" data-section="facts">
        {#each facts as f (f.term)}<span>{f.term} <b>{f.value}</b></span>{/each}
        <span class="dl-meta">card {m.shortId}<button class="dl-copy" type="button" aria-label="Copy card id {m.shortId}" onclick={() => m.copyId()}><Icon name={m.copied === 'id' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /></button></span>
      </div>
    {/if}
  </header>

  <!-- `dw-body` stays as the e2e suite's hook for "no sideways scroll". -->
  <div class="dl-body dw-body" style="overflow-wrap: anywhere">
    {#if m.localError}<div class="ds-alert" role="alert" data-section="error"><Icon name="alert" size={18} /><div>{m.localError}</div></div>{:else}{@render hidden('error')}{/if}
    {#if m.archived}<CardStateDaylight kind="archived" model={m} />{/if}

    <details class="dl-pinned" bind:open={briefOpen}>
      <summary aria-label="What {agentName} was asked"><Icon name="pin" size={18} /><span>What {agentName} was asked</span><span class="more">{briefMeta(!!card.spec?.description, m.counts.criteria, briefOpen)}</span></summary>
      <div style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-4) var(--vk-space-4); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-3);">
        {#if card.spec?.description}<p class="dl-p" data-section="description" style="white-space: pre-line">{String(card.spec.description)}</p>{:else}{@render hidden('description')}{/if}
        {#if m.acceptanceCriteria?.length}
          <b>Acceptance criteria</b>
          <ul class="dl-ul" data-section="criteria">{#each m.acceptanceCriteria as c, i (i)}<li>{c}</li>{/each}</ul>
        {:else}{@render hidden('criteria')}{/if}
      </div>
    </details>

    {#if !m.detailLoaded}
      <CardStateDaylight kind="loading" model={m} />
      {@render hidden('resume')}
    {:else if m.archived}
      <CardStateDaylight kind="restore" model={m} />
      {@render hidden('resume')}
    {:else if question}
      <QuestionDaylight model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} {vibe} />
      {@render hidden('resume')}
    {:else if gate}
      <GateDaylight {...gate} agent={m.agent} {lead} {vibe} />
      {@render hidden('resume')}
    {:else if lead.kind === 'done'}
      <CardStateDaylight kind="done" model={m} />
      {@render hidden('resume')}
    {:else}
      {#if lead.sentence}
        <div class="dl-msg">
          <Face id={agentName} label={agentName} mood={m.agent.mood} size={40} />
          <div class="dl-bubble" class:plain={!lead.needsYou}>
            <span class="dl-who">{agentName}{lead.needsYou ? ' · needs you' : ''}</span>
            <p class="dl-say"><TokenText text={lead.sentence} cls="dl-id" /></p>
            <div class="dl-time">
              {#if lead.at}<span>{whenLabel(lead.at, new Date())}</span>{/if}
              {#if sid}<button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="min-height: 44px; font-size: var(--vk-text-sm); margin: -10px 0px;" onclick={() => m.copySessionId(sid)}><Icon name={m.copied === 'session' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /> Copy session id</button>{/if}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      {/if}
      {#if stopped && m.resume.show}
        <form class="dl-reply" aria-labelledby="reply-h" data-section="resume" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void m.resume.submit(); }}>
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;">
            <h3 id="reply-h">Send it back to work</h3>
            <p class="dl-sub">{replySub(card, agentName)}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="dl-grid2">
            <div class="vk-field">
              <label class="vk-field__label" for="dl-resume-at">Resume at stage</label>
              <select id="dl-resume-at" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={m.resume.target}>
                {#each m.resume.targets.filter((t) => t.allowed) as t (t.key)}<option value={t.key}>{t.n} · {t.name}{t.current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}</option>{/each}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
              <label class="vk-field__label" for="dl-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
              <textarea id="dl-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" aria-describedby="dl-note-hint" aria-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} placeholder={RESUME_PLACEHOLDER} bind:this={m.resume.noteEl} bind:value={m.resume.note}></textarea>
              {#if m.resume.error}<p id="dl-note-hint" class="vk-field__error">{m.resume.error}</p>{:else}<p id="dl-note-hint" class="vk-field__hint">{m.resume.hint}</p>{/if}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="dl-actions">
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="submit" disabled={m.resume.busy}><Icon name="send" size={18} /> {m.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button>
            <span class="dl-small">{emptyNoteCaption(agentName)}</span>
          </div>
        </form>
      {:else}{@render hidden('resume')}{/if}
    {/if}

    <div>
      {#snippet briefBody()}
        {#if groups.length}
          <div class="dl-groups" data-section="details" data-testid="spec-details">
            {#each groups as g (g.label)}
              <div class="dl-group">
                <h4>{g.label}</h4>
                <dl class="dl-dl">
                  {#each g.rows as r (r.key)}<div><dt>{r.label}</dt><dd data-testid="spec-value-{r.key}"><SpecValueView value={r.value} v={{ more: 'dl-more', id: 'dl-id', link: 'dl-link', matrixLinks: true }} /></dd></div>{/each}
                </dl>
              </div>
            {/each}
          </div>
          <div class="dl-row" style="gap: var(--vk-space-5);">
            <details class="dl-raw"><summary>View raw JSON</summary><RawJson value={card.spec} /></details>
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" onclick={() => m.copySpec()}><Icon name={m.copied === 'spec' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={18} /> Copy</button>
          </div>
        {:else}<p class="dl-small" data-section="details" style="margin: 0px;">No other details.</p>{/if}
        <div class="dl-twocol">
          <div data-section="plan" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2);">
            <div class="dl-row" style="justify-content: space-between;"><b>Agent plan</b><span class="dl-small">{m.plan ? planProgress(planDone, m.plan.length) : 'none yet'}</span></div>
            {#if m.plan}
              <div class="dl-meter"><i style="width: {Math.round((100 * planDone) / m.plan.length)}%;"></i></div>
              <ul class="dl-plan">{#each m.plan as step, i (i)}<li class:done={step.done}><Icon name={step.done ? 'check' : 'chevron-right'} size={14} /><span>{step.text}</span></li>{/each}</ul>
            {:else}<p class="dl-small" style="margin: 0px;">{planNone(m.agent.name)}</p>{/if}
          </div>
          <div data-section="project" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2);">
            <b>Project</b>
            {#if m.project.editing}
              <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="dl-project">Project</label>
                <select id="dl-project" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={m.project.projectId} onchange={() => void m.project.onProjectChange()}>
                  <option value="">No project</option>{#each app.projects as p (p.id)}<option value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>{/each}
                </select></div>
              <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="dl-milestone">Milestone</label>
                <select id="dl-milestone" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={m.project.milestoneId} disabled={m.project.projectId === ''}>
                  <option value="">No milestone</option>{#each m.project.milestones as ms (ms.id)}<option value={ms.id}>{ms.name}</option>{/each}
                </select></div>
              {#if m.project.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.project.error}</p>{/if}
              <div class="dl-row"><button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="button" disabled={m.project.saving} onclick={() => m.project.save()}>{m.project.saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</button><button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.cancel()}>Cancel</button></div>
            {:else}
              <span style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm); line-height: 1.45;">{m.projectName ? projectLine(m.projectName, m.milestoneName) : 'No project.'}</span>
              <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={() => m.project.start()}>{m.projectName ? 'Change project' : 'Assign to a project'}</button>
            {/if}
          </div>
        </div>
      {/snippet}
      {@render sec('brief', 'The brief', briefSummary(rowCount, !!m.plan, !!m.projectName, 'drawer'), briefBody)}

      {#snippet happenedBody()}
        <div data-section="activity" style="display: contents">
          <div class="dl-row" style="justify-content: space-between;">
            {#if q?.known}<span class="dl-small">{provenanceLine({ queuedByName: q.queuedByName, byAgent: q.byAgent, covers: m.grantCovers }, m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : null)}</span>{/if}
            {#if runs.length}<button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" aria-pressed={m.showToolCalls} onclick={() => (m.showToolCalls = !m.showToolCalls)}>{m.showToolCalls ? 'Hide tool calls' : 'Show tool calls'}</button>{/if}
          </div>
          {#if runs.length === 0}<p class="dl-small" style="margin: 0px;">No recorded activity yet — this card hasn't been worked.</p>{/if}
          {#each runs as g, ri (g.runId)}
            {@const a = attemptOf(g.runId)}
            {@const who = name(g.agentId) || 'An agent'}
            {@const latestNeeds = ri === 0 && lead.needsYou}
            {@const view = visibleActivities(g.activities, isNarrative, m.showToolCalls, isControlRow)}
            {@const entry = m.stageByRun.get(g.runId)}
            <details class="dl-run" open={ri === 0}>
              <summary><Face id={who} label={who} mood={latestNeeds ? 'needs' : 'resting'} size={24} /><b>{stageNameOf(g.stageKey)} · {who}</b><span class:dl-who={latestNeeds}>{a ? attemptWord(a) : (g.outcome ?? 'working')}</span><span>attempt {(m.attempts.findIndex((x) => x.runId === g.runId) + 1) || runs.length - ri}</span><span class="dl-small">{g.counts.total} events · {g.counts.error} errors</span></summary>
              <ul class="dl-ev">
                {#each view.rows as ev (ev.seq)}
                  <li>
                    <Face id={who} label={who} mood={ev.signal === 'stop' ? 'needs' : 'working'} size={24} />
                    <span class:stop={ev.signal === 'stop'}><span class="k">{eventVerb(ev)}</span> {eventSentence(ev)}{#if ev.parameter !== null || ev.result !== null}<details class="dl-raw"><summary>Details</summary><RawJson value={{ parameter: ev.parameter, result: ev.result }} /></details>{/if}</span>
                    <span class="t">{clockHM(ev.ts)}</span>
                  </li>
                {/each}
              </ul>
              {#if entry?.failureReason}<p class="dl-small" style="margin: 0 var(--vk-space-4) var(--vk-space-3);">{entry.failureReason}</p>
              {:else if entry && entry.handoff && typeof entry.handoff === 'object' && Object.keys(entry.handoff).length}<div style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-4) var(--vk-space-3);"><HandoffView handoff={entry.handoff} testid="handed-on-{g.runId}" /></div>{/if}
            </details>
          {/each}
        </div>
        {#if m.decidedGates.length}
          <div data-section="decisions"><b>Decisions</b><ul class="dl-ul">{#each m.decidedGates as d (d.id)}<li>{d.decision ?? d.status} at {stageNameOf(d.stageKey)}{d.decidedBy ? ` by ${displayPrincipal(d.decidedBy, app.members)}` : ''}{d.comment ? ` — ${d.comment}` : ''}</li>{/each}</ul></div>
        {:else}{@render hidden('decisions')}{/if}
        {#if m.counts.handoff}
          <div data-section="handoff"><b>Handoff from {m.stages[m.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? 'the last stage'}</b><HandoffView handoff={m.handoff} testid="carried-handoff" /></div>
          {#if m.attempts.length}<div class="dl-small" data-section="attempts">{attemptsLine(m.attempts, name)}</div>{:else}{@render hidden('attempts')}{/if}
        {:else}
          <div class="dl-small"><span data-section="handoff">{handoffLine({ handoff: null, stageIndex: m.stageIndex, stages: m.stages, queuedByName: q?.queuedByName ?? 'someone', createdAt: card.createdAt })}</span>{#if m.attempts.length} · <span data-section="attempts">{attemptsLine(m.attempts, name)}</span>{:else}{@render hidden('attempts')}{/if}</div>
        {/if}
      {/snippet}
      {@render sec('happened', 'What happened', whatHappenedSummary(m.counts.runs, m.counts.decisions), happenedBody)}

      {#snippet linksBody()}
        <div data-section="links">
          {#if m.hasAnyLink}
            {#each Object.entries(LINK_LABEL) as [key, label] (key)}
              {@const rows = m.linkGroups[key as keyof typeof LINK_LABEL] as Array<{ title: string; remove: import('$lib/components/link-groups').RemoveArgs }>}
              {#if rows.length}<b>{label}</b><ul class="dl-ul">{#each rows as row (row.title + key)}<li>{row.title} <button class="dl-more" type="button" disabled={m.links.removing.size > 0} onclick={() => m.links.remove(row.remove)}>Remove</button></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
            {/each}
          {:else}
            <b>Relates to</b><p class="dl-small" style="margin: 4px 0px 0px;">Nothing blocks this card and it blocks nothing.</p>
          {/if}
          {#if m.links.listError}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.links.listError}</p>{/if}
        </div>
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={() => m.links.openAdd()}><Icon name="link" size={18} /> Add link</button>
        <LinkAddForm model={m} />
        <div data-section="subtasks"><b>Sub-tasks</b> <span class="dl-small">{subtasksLine(card.openChildCount, m.children.length)}</span>
          {#if m.children.length}<ul class="dl-ul">{#each m.children as c (c.id)}<li><button class="dl-more" type="button" onclick={() => app.openCard(c.id)}>{c.title}</button></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
        </div>
        <div data-section="references"><b>References</b>
          {#if m.refs.length}
            <ul class="dl-ul">
              {#each m.otherRefs as r (r.id)}<li>{#if safeHref(r.url)}<a class="dl-link" href={safeHref(r.url)!} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}</a>{:else}{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}{/if} <span class="dl-small">· {referenceSource(r)}</span></li>{/each}
              {#each m.libraryRefs as l, i (l.ref.id)}<li><LibraryArtifact itemId={l.itemId} version={l.version} title={l.ref.title || l.itemId} open={i === 0} /></li>{/each}
            </ul>
          {:else}<p class="dl-small" style="margin: 4px 0px 0px;">None yet.</p>{/if}
        </div>
        <div data-section="related"><b>Related prior work</b><p class="dl-p dl-small">{relatedLine(m.related.phase, m.related.items.length)}</p>
          {#if m.related.items.length}<ul class="dl-ul">{#each m.related.items as r (r.itemId)}<li>{#if safeHref(r.url)}<a class="dl-link" href={safeHref(r.url)!}>{r.title}</a>{:else}{r.title}{/if} <span class="dl-small">· {r.snippet}</span></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
        </div>
      {/snippet}
      {@render sec('links', 'Links and references', linksSummary({ links: m.counts.links, children: m.counts.children, openChildren: m.counts.openChildren, refs: m.counts.refs, related: m.related.items.length }, 'drawer'), linksBody)}

      {#snippet talkBody()}
        <div data-section="comments" style="display: contents">
          {#if m.comments.comments.length}
            <ul class="dl-ul">{#each m.comments.comments as c (c.id)}<li><b>{c.author.name ?? c.author.id}</b> <span style="white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere">{c.deletedAt ? 'Comment deleted' : c.body}</span></li>{/each}</ul>
          {:else}<p class="dl-small" style="margin: 0px;">No comments yet. The agent that works this card reads them.</p>{/if}
          <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="dl-comment">Add a comment</label><textarea id="dl-comment" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8192" placeholder="⌘ or Ctrl + Enter posts it" bind:value={m.comments.draft} onkeydown={commentKey}></textarea></div>
          {#if m.comments.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.comments.error}</p>{/if}
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" disabled={m.comments.posting || m.comments.draft.trim() === ''} onclick={() => m.comments.submit()}>{m.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button>
        </div>
      {/snippet}
      {@render sec('talk', 'Talk', talkSummary(m.comments.comments.length), talkBody)}

      {#snippet costBody()}
        <div data-section="cost" style="display: contents">
          <div><span style="font: 700 2rem/1 var(--vk-font-display);">{usd(card.costUsd)}</span> <span class="dl-small">· {m.estimate?.estimatedUsd ? `of ${usd(m.estimate.estimatedUsd)} estimated` : 'no estimate yet'}</span></div>
          <div class="dl-meter"><i style="width: {m.costPct}%;"></i></div>
        </div>
        {#if m.counts.deliveryActive}<div data-section="delivery"><DeliveryPanel model={m} /></div>{:else}<p class="dl-small" data-section="delivery" style="margin: 0px;">No approved delivery on this card.</p>{/if}
      {/snippet}
      {@render sec('cost', 'Cost and delivery', costSummary(card.costUsd, m.estimate?.estimatedUsd ?? null, m.deliveryGate?.delivery?.mode ?? null), costBody)}
    </div>

    <div class="dl-foot" data-section="cardActions">
      {#if !m.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" disabled={m.archiving} onclick={() => m.archive()}><Icon name="archive" size={18} /> {m.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
      <button class="vk-button dl-danger" type="button" onclick={() => m.remove()}><Icon name="trash" size={18} /> Delete card</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

Snippets declared inside the `<div>` (`briefBody` …) are passed to `sec` by name; they read the
component's state, which is why they are not top-level. Svelte allows a snippet to be rendered by
another snippet it is passed to.

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/states/CardStatesGallery.svelte -->
<script module lang="ts">
  export interface GalleryCellSpec { boardId: string; cardId: string; holdDetail?: boolean }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Builds the six gallery CardModels from snapshots the route fetched (CardSource) and hands them
   * to the vibe's states layout. `specs` and `sources` are read once: the gallery does not change.
   */
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { CARD_STATES_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import { CardModel, type CardSource } from '../card-model.svelte';
  import type { CardStateCell, CardStateCellKey } from '../layouts/types';

  let { specs, sources }: { specs: Record<CardStateCellKey, GalleryCellSpec>; sources: Record<string, CardSource> } = $props();
  const KEYS: CardStateCellKey[] = ['gate', 'question', 'archived', 'done', 'error', 'loading'];
  const models = untrack(() => Object.fromEntries(KEYS.map((k) => {
    const s = specs[k];
    return [k, new CardModel(() => ({ boardId: s.boardId, cardId: s.cardId, surface: 'gallery' }), { holdDetail: s.holdDetail, source: sources[s.boardId] })];
  })) as Record<CardStateCellKey, CardModel>);
  const cells = $derived(Object.fromEntries(KEYS.map((k) => [k, { model: models[k], gate: models[k].gateBinding, question: models[k].questionBinding }])) as Record<CardStateCellKey, CardStateCell>);
  const Layout = $derived(CARD_STATES_LAYOUTS[appearance.value.vibe]);
</script>

<Layout {cells} vibe={appearance.value.vibe} phase={appearance.phase} />
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** Dev-only: every card state on one page, for the pixel harness (SP-Card-States-<Vibe>). */
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { getAgents, getBoard } from '$lib/api';
  import type { CardSource } from '$lib/components/card/card-model.svelte';
  import CardStatesGallery from '$lib/components/card/states/CardStatesGallery.svelte';
  import { GALLERY_BOARD_IDS, GALLERY_CELLS } from './cells';

  let sources = $state<Record<string, CardSource> | null>(null);
  let failed = $state<string | null>(null);
  let started = false;
  $effect(() => {
    if (app.authState !== 'ready' || started) return;
    started = true;
    void app.markBusy((async () => {
      try {
        const [agents, ...boards] = await Promise.all([getAgents(), ...GALLERY_BOARD_IDS.map((id) => getBoard(id))]);
        sources = Object.fromEntries(boards.map((b) => [b.boardId!, { board: b, agents }]));
      } catch (e) {
        failed = String(e);
      }
    })());
  });
</script>

<svelte:head><title>Card states</title></svelte:head>
{#if sources}
  <CardStatesGallery specs={GALLERY_CELLS} {sources} />
{:else if failed}
  <p role="alert">{failed}</p>
{:else}
  <p role="status">Loading the card states…</p>
{/if}
```

```ts
/** The Daylight desktop drawer has no sub-task composer (the reference drops it; the phone keeps it). */
const SUBTASK_COMPOSER = (vibe: string) => vibe !== 'daylight';
```

### Task 21: The standalone card page, and the Daylight page

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

A card gets its own address, `/b/{boardId}/c/{cardId}/page`, drawn in the root layout's `bare` slot
(no rail, no top bar, no tabs; the palette and the appearance dialog stay). The route opens the board
itself and builds a `CardModel` with `surface: 'page'`; below 640px it renders the vibe's phone card
(§7.7, Quiet included). `CARD_PAGE_LAYOUTS` is the registry; this task ships `CardPageDaylight`
(ported `.dp-*` from `SP-CardPage-Daylight.html`) and points the other three vibes at it until
Tasks 22–24. The drawer's "Open in new window" (Task 20) now lands somewhere. The three page
references that still carry the old resume placeholder (CardPage-Daylight, -Paper, -Studio) are
corrected to the shipped sentence and logged, and the reference lock is refreshed.
**SP-CardPage-Daylight** turns green.

page and touch only their own files plus one line of `layouts.ts`.)

```ts
type Surface = { name: string; vibe: Vibe; component: Component<any> };
const all: Surface[] = VIBES.flatMap((v) => [
  { name: `${v} drawer`, vibe: v, component: CARD_LAYOUTS[v].drawer },

]);
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/card-page.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT } from './support/seed';

async function boardWithCard(request: import('@playwright/test').APIRequestContext) {
  const board = (await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name: 'Card page board', stages: [{ key: 'todo', name: 'To do', order: 0 }] } })).json()) as { boardId: string };
  const card = (await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${board.boardId}/cards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { title: 'A card with its own page', ownerUserId: 'usr_a' } })).json()) as { card: { id: string } };
  return { boardId: board.boardId, cardId: card.card.id };
}

test('the drawer opens the card as a page in a new window, and the page leads back to the board', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const { boardId, cardId } = await boardWithCard(request);
  await page.goto(`/b/${boardId}/c/${cardId}`);
  const open = page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('link', { name: 'Open in new window' });
  await expect(open).toHaveAttribute('href', `/b/${boardId}/c/${cardId}/page`);
  await expect(open).toHaveAttribute('target', '_blank');

  await page.goto(`/b/${boardId}/c/${cardId}/page`);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'A card with its own page' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle('A card with its own page · Card page board');
  await expect(page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' })).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to the board' }).first().click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/b/${boardId}$`));
});

test('a card the board does not hold says so, with the way back', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const { boardId } = await boardWithCard(request);
  await page.goto(`/b/${boardId}/c/card_not_here/page`);
  await expect(page.getByText('This card is not on Card page board any more.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to the board' })).toHaveAttribute('href', `/b/${boardId}`);
});
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** The page's account control: one menu item, Sign out. */

  let { triggerClass, label, initials, menuClass = 'dp-menu', wrapClass = 'dp-acctwrap' }: { triggerClass: string; label: string; initials: string; menuClass?: string; wrapClass?: string } = $props();
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/routes/b/[boardId]/c/[cardId]/page/+page@.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * A card on its own page (amendments §7.4). `@` resets to the root layout, whose bare slot
   * draws no shell. The page opens the board itself; links to it are shared, so it must stand alone.
   */
  import { page } from '$app/state';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { viewport } from '$lib/viewport.svelte';
  import { CARD_LAYOUTS, CARD_PAGE_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import { CardModel } from '$lib/components/card/card-model.svelte';
  import CardPageMissing from '$lib/components/card/page/CardPageMissing.svelte';

  const boardId = $derived(page.params.boardId!);
  const cardId = $derived(page.params.cardId!);
  $effect(() => {
    if (app.authState === 'ready' && app.boardId !== boardId) void app.openBoard(boardId);
  });
  const model = new CardModel(() => ({ boardId, cardId, surface: 'page' }));
  const vibe = $derived(appearance.value.vibe);
  const Page = $derived(CARD_PAGE_LAYOUTS[vibe]);
  const Phone = $derived(CARD_LAYOUTS[vibe].phone);
  const ready = $derived(app.board?.boardId === boardId);
  const personName = $derived(app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? 'there');
</script>

<svelte:head><title>{model.card ? `${model.card.title} · ${model.boardName}` : 'Card · Superpipeline'}</title></svelte:head>

{#if !ready}
  <CardPageMissing kind="loading" boardName="" boardHref="/b/{boardId}" />
{:else if !model.card}
  <CardPageMissing kind="missing" boardName={model.boardName} boardHref={model.boardHref} />
{:else if viewport.narrow}
  <!-- Below 640px every vibe's page is its phone card (§7.7), here with no Close: back goes to the board. -->
  <div role="region" aria-labelledby="drawer-title" style="min-height: 100dvh">
    <Phone {model} {vibe} phase={appearance.phase} {personName} gate={model.gateBinding} question={model.questionBinding} pageHref={model.pageHref} onClose={() => void goto(model.boardHref)} />
  </div>
{:else}
  <Page {model} {vibe} phase={appearance.phase} {personName} gate={model.gateBinding} question={model.questionBinding} pageHref={model.pageHref} boardHref={model.boardHref} />
{/if}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/page/CardPageDaylight.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Daylight's card page (SP-CardPage-Daylight): a window bar on the sky, the head with people and
   * facts, then three columns — the conversation and Talk; what was asked, the brief and the links;
   * what happened and cost — and a foot with the card's actions.
   */
  import './card-page-daylight.css';
  import '../daylight-states.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { clockHM, weekdayDayMonth, whenLabel } from '$lib/when';
  import { isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import DeliveryPanel from '../DeliveryPanel.svelte';
  import LinkAddForm from '../LinkAddForm.svelte';
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import TokenText from '../TokenText.svelte';
  import SpecValueView from '../SpecValueView.svelte';
  import GateDaylight from '../gate/GateDaylight.svelte';
  import QuestionDaylight from '../question/QuestionDaylight.svelte';
  import CardStateDaylight from '../state/CardStateDaylight.svelte';
  import { specGroups, specRowCount } from '../spec-groups';
  import { referenceSource, refLabel } from '../references';
  import { safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { sessionIdOf } from '../tokens';
  import { attemptWord, eventSentence, eventVerb, pillTone, STRIP_WORD, stopLine, stripAria, stripKind, waitingWord } from '../state-words';
  import {
    agentRole, briefSummary, criteriaCount, emptyNoteCaption, factItems, handoffLine, initials, linksSummary, pageSmall, planNone,
    planProgress, projectLine, provenanceLine, relatedLine, replySub, RESUME_PLACEHOLDER, subtasksLine, talkSummary, usd, whatHappenedSummary,
  } from '../card-words';
  import AccountMenu from './AccountMenu.svelte';
  import type { CardPageProps } from '../layouts/types';

  let { model: m, vibe, phase, gate, question, boardHref }: CardPageProps = $props();
  const card = $derived(m.card!);
  const lead = $derived(m.lead!);
  const editing = $derived(m.edit.editing);
  const name = (id: string | null) => (id ? displayAgent(id, m.agents) : '');
  const agentName = $derived(m.agent.name || 'the agent');
  const lastName = $derived(name(m.lastAgentId));
  const ownerName = $derived(displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members));
  const userName = $derived(app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? '');
  const q = $derived(m.provenance);
  const kind = $derived(stripKind(lead, m.archived));
  const tone = $derived(pillTone(card, lead));
  const groups = $derived(specGroups(card.spec, { criteriaHeading: 'Things to prove' }));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead.sentence));
  const runs = $derived([...m.activityGroups].reverse());
  const facts = $derived(factItems({ card, stageName: m.stageName, ageHours: m.ageHours, labelNames: m.labels.map((l) => l.name), projectName: m.projectName }));
  const stageNameOf = (key: string | null) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)?.name ?? key ?? 'Unknown stage';
  const attemptOf = (runId: string) => m.attempts.find((a) => a.runId === runId);
  const attemptNo = (runId: string) => m.attempts.findIndex((a) => a.runId === runId) + 1;
  const stopped = $derived(['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead.kind) && !m.archived);
  const planDone = $derived(m.plan?.filter((s) => s.done).length ?? 0);
  const night = $derived(phase === 'night');
  let copiedLink = $derived(m.copied === 'link');
  $effect(() => m.comments.attach());
  function commentKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void m.comments.submit(); }
  }
</script>

            <ol class="dp-track" aria-label={stripAria(m.stageIndex, m.stages.length, m.stageName, kind, 'drawer')}>
              {#each m.stages as s, i (s.key)}
                {#if i < m.stageIndex}<li class="done"><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab"><Icon name="check" size={14} /> {s.name}</span></li>
                {:else if i === m.stageIndex}<li class="cur" aria-current="step"><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab">{s.name} · {STRIP_WORD[kind]}</span></li>
                {:else}<li><span class="bar"></span><span class="lab">{s.name}</span></li>{/if}
              {/each}
            </ol>
            <span style="font: 600 var(--vk-text-sm)/1.3 var(--vk-font-body);">{stopLine(lead, m.stageIndex, m.stages)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <aside class="dp-people" aria-label="People on this card" data-section="status">
          <div class="dp-row" style="justify-content: space-between;"><span class="vk-pill vk-pill--{tone === 'off' ? 'resting' : tone}">{waitingWord(card, lead, m.ageHours, 'desktop')}</span>{#if card.attemptCount > 1}<span class="dp-small">Attempt {card.attemptCount}</span>{/if}</div>
          {#if m.delegate.id || lastName}
            {@const who = m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : lastName}
            <div class="dp-person"><Face id={who} label={who} mood={m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.mood : 'resting'} size={32} /><span><b>{who}</b><span class="dp-muted">{agentRole({ stageName: stageNameOf(m.attempts.at(-1)?.stageKey ?? card.currentStageKey), attempt: card.attemptCount, delegated: !!m.delegate.id })}</span></span></div>
          {/if}
          <div class="dp-person"><span class="dp-initials" aria-hidden="true">{initials(ownerName)}</span><span><b>{ownerName}</b><span class="dp-muted">{app.user?.userId === card.ownerUserId ? 'Owner · you' : 'Owner'}</span></span></div>
          {#if q?.known}
            <div class="dp-person" title={q.byAgent ? `${q.queuedByName}, an agent, with dispatch authority on this board` : undefined}>
              {#if q.byAgent}<Face id={q.queuedByName} label={q.queuedByName} mood="working" size={32} />{:else}<span class="dp-initials" aria-hidden="true">{initials(q.queuedByName)}</span>{/if}
              <span><b>{q.queuedByName}</b><span class="dp-muted">{q.byAgent ? 'Asked for this · an agent allowed to dispatch' : 'Asked for this'}</span></span>
            </div>
          {/if}
        </aside>

        <div class="dp-facts" data-section="facts">{#each facts as f (f.term)}<span>{f.term} <b>{f.value}</b></span>{/each}</div>
      </header>
    </div>
  </div>

  <main class="dp-main" id="content" aria-labelledby="card-title">
    <section class="dp-col" aria-labelledby="h-convo">
      <h2 id="h-convo" class="dp-h">The conversation <small>{pageSmall(lead, agentName)}</small></h2>
      {#if m.localError}<div class="ds-alert" role="alert" data-section="error"><Icon name="alert" size={18} /><div>{m.localError}</div></div>{:else}{@render hidden('error')}{/if}
      {#if m.archived}<CardStateDaylight kind="archived" model={m} /><CardStateDaylight kind="restore" model={m} />{@render hidden('resume')}
      {:else if question}<QuestionDaylight model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} {vibe} />{@render hidden('resume')}
      {:else if gate}<GateDaylight {...gate} agent={m.agent} {lead} {vibe} />{@render hidden('resume')}
      {:else if lead.kind === 'done'}<CardStateDaylight kind="done" model={m} />{@render hidden('resume')}
      {:else}
        {#if lead.sentence}
          <div class="dp-msg">
            <Face id={agentName} label={agentName} mood={m.agent.mood} size={48} />
            <div class="dp-bubble" style={lead.needsYou ? undefined : 'background: var(--vk-color-raised)'}>
              <span class="dp-who" style={lead.needsYou ? undefined : 'color: var(--vk-color-muted)'}>{agentName}{lead.needsYou ? ' · needs you' : ''}</span>
              <p class="dp-say"><TokenText text={lead.sentence} cls="dp-id" /></p>
              <div class="dp-time">{#if lead.at}<span>{whenLabel(lead.at, new Date())}</span>{/if}{#if sid}<button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="min-height: 44px; font-size: var(--vk-text-sm); margin: -10px 0px;" onclick={() => m.copySessionId(sid)}><Icon name={m.copied === 'session' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /> Copy session id</button>{/if}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        {/if}
        {#if stopped && m.resume.show}
          <form class="dp-reply" aria-labelledby="reply-h" data-section="resume" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void m.resume.submit(); }}>
            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;"><h3 id="reply-h">Send it back to work</h3><p class="dp-sub">{replySub(card, agentName)}</p></div>
            <div class="dp-grid2">
              <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="dp-resume-at">Resume at stage</label>
                <select id="dp-resume-at" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={m.resume.target}>{#each m.resume.targets.filter((t) => t.allowed) as t (t.key)}<option value={t.key}>{t.n} · {t.name}{t.current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}</option>{/each}</select></div>
              <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
                <label class="vk-field__label" for="dp-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
                <textarea id="dp-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" aria-describedby="dp-note-hint" aria-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} placeholder={RESUME_PLACEHOLDER} bind:this={m.resume.noteEl} bind:value={m.resume.note}></textarea>
                {#if m.resume.error}<p id="dp-note-hint" class="vk-field__error">{m.resume.error}</p>{:else}<p id="dp-note-hint" class="vk-field__hint">{m.resume.hint}</p>{/if}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="dp-actions"><button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="submit" disabled={m.resume.busy}><Icon name="send" size={18} /> {m.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button><span class="dp-small">{emptyNoteCaption(agentName)}</span></div>
          </form>
        {:else}{@render hidden('resume')}{/if}
      {/if}

      <section class="dp-card" aria-labelledby="h-talk" data-section="comments">
        <h2 id="h-talk" class="dp-h">Talk <small>{talkSummary(m.comments.comments.length)}</small></h2>
        {#if m.comments.comments.length}<ul class="dp-ul">{#each m.comments.comments as c (c.id)}<li><b>{c.author.name ?? c.author.id}</b> <span style="white-space: pre-wrap">{c.deletedAt ? 'Comment deleted' : c.body}</span></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
        <p class="dp-small" style="margin: 0px;">The agent that works this card reads every comment.</p>
        <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="dp-comment">Add a comment</label><textarea id="dp-comment" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8192" placeholder="⌘ or Ctrl + Enter posts it" style="min-height: 88px;" bind:value={m.comments.draft} onkeydown={commentKey}></textarea></div>
        {#if m.comments.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.comments.error}</p>{/if}
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" disabled={m.comments.posting} onclick={() => m.comments.submit()}><Icon name="comment" size={18} /> {m.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button>
      </section>
    </section>

    <section class="dp-col" aria-labelledby="h-brief">
      <div class="dp-card">
        <h2 id="h-brief" class="dp-h"><Icon name="pin" size={18} /> What {agentName} was asked</h2>
        {#if card.spec?.description}<p class="dp-p" data-section="description" style="white-space: pre-line">{String(card.spec.description)}</p>{:else}{@render hidden('description')}{/if}
        {#if m.acceptanceCriteria?.length}
          <h3 class="dp-h" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-md);">Done when <small>{criteriaCount(m.acceptanceCriteria.length)}</small></h3>
          <ol class="dp-crit" data-section="criteria">{#each m.acceptanceCriteria as c, i (i)}<li><span class="n">{i + 1}</span><span>{c}</span></li>{/each}</ol>
        {:else}{@render hidden('criteria')}{/if}
      </div>

      <div class="dp-card">
        <h2 class="dp-h">The brief <small>{briefSummary(specRowCount(groups), !!m.plan, !!m.projectName, 'page')}</small></h2>
        <div data-section="details" style="display: contents">
          {#each groups as g (g.label)}
            <div class="dp-group"><h4>{g.label}</h4>
              <dl class="dp-dl dp-dl--stack">{#each g.rows as r (r.key)}<dt>{r.label}</dt><dd data-testid="spec-value-{r.key}"><SpecValueView value={r.value} v={{ clamp: 'dp-clamp', more: 'vk-button vk-button--quiet dp-more', matrixLinks: false }} /></dd>{/each}</dl>
            </div>
          {/each}
          <div class="dp-row" style="gap: var(--vk-space-4);">
            <details class="dp-raw"><summary>View raw JSON</summary><RawJson value={card.spec} /></details>
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" onclick={() => m.copySpec()}><Icon name={m.copied === 'spec' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /> Copy</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div data-section="plan" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2);">
          <div class="dp-row" style="justify-content: space-between;"><b>Agent plan</b><span class="dp-small">{m.plan ? planProgress(planDone, m.plan.length) : 'none yet'}</span></div>
          {#if m.plan}<div class="dp-meter"><i style="width: {Math.round((100 * planDone) / m.plan.length)}%;"></i></div><ul class="dp-plan">{#each m.plan as st, i (i)}<li class:done={st.done}><Icon name={st.done ? 'check' : 'chevron-right'} size={14} /><span>{st.text}</span></li>{/each}</ul>
          {:else}<p class="dp-p dp-small">{planNone(m.agent.name)}</p>{/if}
        </div>
        <div class="dp-row" style="justify-content: space-between;" data-section="project">
          {#if m.project.editing}
            <span style="flex: 1 1 16rem; min-width: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2);">
              <select class="vk-field__input" aria-label="Project" bind:value={m.project.projectId} onchange={() => void m.project.onProjectChange()}><option value="">No project</option>{#each app.projects as p (p.id)}<option value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>{/each}</select>
              <select class="vk-field__input" aria-label="Milestone" bind:value={m.project.milestoneId} disabled={m.project.projectId === ''}><option value="">No milestone</option>{#each m.project.milestones as ms (ms.id)}<option value={ms.id}>{ms.name}</option>{/each}</select>
              {#if m.project.error}<span class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.project.error}</span>{/if}
            </span>
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="button" disabled={m.project.saving} onclick={() => m.project.save()}>{m.project.saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</button>
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.cancel()}>Cancel</button>
          {:else}
            <span style="flex: 1 1 16rem; min-width: 0px;"><b>Project</b> <span class="dp-small">· {m.projectName ? projectLine(m.projectName, m.milestoneName) : 'none'}</span></span>
            <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.start()}>{m.projectName ? 'Change project' : 'Assign to a project'}</button>
          {/if}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dp-card">
        <h2 class="dp-h">Links and references <small>{linksSummary({ links: m.counts.links, children: m.counts.children, openChildren: m.counts.openChildren, refs: m.counts.refs, related: m.related.items.length }, 'page')}</small></h2>
        <div data-section="links" style="display: contents">
          {#if m.hasAnyLink}
            <ul class="dp-links">{#each [...m.linkGroups.blockedBy, ...m.linkGroups.blocks, ...m.linkGroups.relates, ...m.linkGroups.resolvedBlockedBy] as row (row.title)}<li><span>{row.title}</span><button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" onclick={() => m.links.remove(row.remove)}>Remove</button></li>{/each}</ul>
          {:else}<p class="dp-p dp-small">Nothing blocks this card and it blocks nothing.</p>{/if}
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={() => m.links.openAdd()}><Icon name="link" size={18} /> Add link</button>
          <LinkAddForm model={m} />
        </div>
        <div data-section="subtasks"><b>Sub-tasks</b> <span class="dp-small">· {subtasksLine(card.openChildCount, m.children.length)}</span></div>
        <div data-section="references"><b>References</b>
          {#if m.refs.length}
            <ul class="dp-ul dp-refs" style="margin-top: 6px;">
              {#each m.otherRefs as r (r.id)}<li>{#if safeHref(r.url)}<a href={safeHref(r.url)!} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}</a>{:else}<span>{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}</span>{/if}{#if r.subtitle}<span class="dp-small">{r.subtitle}</span>{/if}<small class="dp-small" style="font-family: var(--vk-font-mono);">{referenceSource(r)}</small></li>{/each}
            </ul>
          {:else}<p class="dp-p dp-small" style="margin-top: 4px;">None yet.</p>{/if}
        </div>
        <div data-section="related"><b>Related prior work</b><p class="dp-p dp-small" style="margin-top: 4px;">{relatedLine(m.related.phase, m.related.items.length)}</p></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <aside class="dp-col" aria-labelledby="h-log">
      <div class="dp-card">
        <h2 id="h-log" class="dp-h">What happened <small>{whatHappenedSummary(m.counts.runs, m.counts.decisions)}</small></h2>
        <div data-section="activity" style="display: contents">
          {#if q?.known}<p class="dp-small" style="margin: 0px;">{provenanceLine({ queuedByName: q.queuedByName, byAgent: q.byAgent, covers: m.grantCovers }, m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : null)}</p>{/if}
          {#each runs as g, ri (g.runId)}
            {@const a = attemptOf(g.runId)}
            {@const who = name(g.agentId) || 'An agent'}
            {@const latestNeeds = ri === 0 && lead.needsYou}
            {@const view = visibleActivities(g.activities, isNarrative, m.showToolCalls, isControlRow)}
            {@const hiddenCount = g.activities.length - visibleActivities(g.activities, isNarrative, false, isControlRow).rows.length}
            <details class="dp-run" open={ri === 0}>
              <summary><Face id={who} label={who} mood={latestNeeds ? 'needs' : 'resting'} size={24} /><b>Attempt {attemptNo(g.runId) || runs.length - ri} · {stageNameOf(g.stageKey)}</b><span class:dp-who={latestNeeds}>{a ? attemptWord(a) : (g.outcome ?? 'working')}</span><span class="dp-small">{g.counts.total} events · {g.counts.error} errors{ri > 0 && a?.endedAt ? ` · ${clockHM(a.endedAt)}` : ''}</span></summary>
              <ol class="dp-tl" style="padding: var(--vk-space-2) var(--vk-space-4) 0;">
                {#each view.rows as ev, ei (ev.seq)}
                  <li><Face id={who} label={who} mood={ev.signal === 'stop' ? 'needs' : 'thinking'} size={24} /><span class:stop={ev.signal === 'stop'}><span class="k">{eventVerb(ev)}</span> {eventSentence(ev)}<br /><span class="t">{clockHM(ev.ts)}{ei === view.rows.length - 1 ? ` ${weekdayDayMonth(ev.ts)}` : ''}</span></span></li>
                {/each}
              </ol>
              {#if hiddenCount > 0 || m.showToolCalls}<div style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-4) var(--vk-space-3);"><button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" aria-pressed={m.showToolCalls} onclick={() => (m.showToolCalls = !m.showToolCalls)}>{m.showToolCalls ? 'Hide tool calls' : `Show tool calls · ${hiddenCount} more events`}</button></div>{/if}
            </details>
          {/each}
        </div>
        {#if m.counts.handoff}
          <div class="dp-small" data-section="handoff"><b style="color: var(--vk-color-text);">Handoff from {m.stages[m.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? 'the last stage'}</b><HandoffView handoff={m.handoff} testid="carried-handoff" /></div>
        {:else}
          <div class="dp-small" data-section="handoff"><b style="color: var(--vk-color-text);">Handoff from {m.stages[m.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? 'the queue'}</b><br />{handoffLine({ handoff: null, stageIndex: m.stageIndex, stages: m.stages, queuedByName: q?.queuedByName ?? 'someone', createdAt: card.createdAt })}</div>
        {/if}
        <div class="dp-small" data-section="decisions"><b style="color: var(--vk-color-text);">Decisions</b><br />{#if m.decidedGates.length}{#each m.decidedGates as d (d.id)}{d.decision ?? d.status} at {stageNameOf(d.stageKey)}{d.decidedBy ? ` by ${displayPrincipal(d.decidedBy, app.members)}` : ''}. {/each}{:else}None yet.{/if}</div>
      </div>

      <div class="dp-card">
        <h2 class="dp-h">Cost and delivery</h2>
        <div data-section="cost" style="display: contents">
          <div><span class="dp-big">{usd(card.costUsd)}</span> <span class="dp-small">· {m.estimate?.estimatedUsd ? `of ${usd(m.estimate.estimatedUsd)} estimated` : 'no estimate yet'}</span></div>
          <div class="dp-meter"><i style="width: {m.costPct}%;"></i></div>
        </div>
        <dl class="dp-dl">
          <div data-section="attempts" style="display: contents">{#each m.attempts as a, i (a.runId)}<dt>Attempt {i + 1}</dt><dd>{name(a.agentId)} · {usd(a.costUsd)} · {attemptWord(a)}</dd>{/each}</div>
          <div data-section="delivery" style="display: contents"><dt>Delivery</dt><dd>{#if m.counts.deliveryActive}<DeliveryPanel model={m} />{:else}None approved on this card.{/if}</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </main>

  <footer class="dp-foot" data-section="cardActions">
    <hr />
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" onclick={() => m.edit.start()}><Icon name="edit" size={18} /> Edit card</button>
    {#if !m.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" disabled={m.archiving} onclick={() => m.archive()}><Icon name="archive" size={18} /> {m.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
    <button class="vk-button" type="button" style="background: var(--vk-color-surface); color: var(--vk-color-text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--vk-color-text);" onclick={() => m.remove()}><Icon name="trash" size={18} /> Delete card</button>
    <span style="flex: 1 1 auto;"></span>
    <span class="dp-small">Opened from {m.boardName} · <a href={boardHref}>Back to the board</a></span>
  </footer>
</div>
```

```ts
  firstName, numberWord, paperAttempt, paperByline, paperCostLine, paperDateline, paperDeck, paperKicker, paperLinked, paperLogRow,
  paperLogTime, paperProvenance, paperReplySub, paperRole, paperStageNo, reTitle, roman,
} from './paper-words';
import { ACTIVITIES_4605, ATTEMPTS_4605, CARD_4605, NOW, TZ } from './testing/card-4605';

describe('Paper words (4605)', () => {
  it('dateline, numerals, number words', () => {
    expect(paperDateline(NOW, 'noon', TZ)).toBe('Sunday 11 October · in full daylight');
    expect([1, 2, 4, 7, 9, 12].map(roman)).toEqual(['I', 'II', 'IV', 'VII', 'IX', 'XII']);
    expect([2, 10, 11].map(numberWord)).toEqual(['two', 'ten', '11']);
    expect(firstName('Rakesh Gangwar')).toBe('Rakesh');
  });
  it('the head', () => {
    expect(reTitle(CARD_4605.title, false)).toBe('Re: Diagnose Melissa and Anna Supermessage silence — trace actual failing hop');
    expect(reTitle('P4 exit test', true)).toBe('Re: approval. P4 exit test');
    expect(paperKicker(true, null, 66.15, 'page')).toBe('A letter that needs your reply · 2 days');
    expect(paperKicker(true, null, 66.15, 'drawer')).toBe('A letter that needs a reply');
    expect(paperKicker(false, '2026-10-09T05:30:00Z', 1, 'page', TZ)).toBe('Archived on 9 October');
    expect(paperKicker(false, null, 1, 'page')).toBeNull();
    expect(paperDeck('stopped', 'error-eric', 'Reproduce', 2)).toBe('error-eric stopped in Reproduce after two attempts and has written to you. The brief, the record and the correspondence are enclosed below.');
    expect(paperReplySub(2)).toBe('I stopped after two attempts. Send me back with what changed.');
    expect(paperReplySub(1)).toBe('I stopped after one attempt. Send me back with what changed.');
  });
  it('the stage track and the byline', () => {
    expect([0, 1, 2, 3, 6].map((i) => paperStageNo(i, 1, true))).toEqual(['I · done', 'II · stopped here', 'III · next', 'IV', 'VII']);
    expect(paperStageNo(1, 1, false)).toBe('II · here');
    expect(paperByline('Reproduce', 2, false)).toBe(' · agent for Reproduce, ran attempt 2 · Unclaimed now');
    expect(paperRole('Diagnostics', 2)).toBe('Diagnostics, attempt 2');
    expect(paperRole(null, 2)).toBe('agent, attempt 2');
  });
  it('the record', () => {
    expect(paperProvenance('super-chotu', true, true, 'From Reported: queued by super-chotu on 8 Oct with the brief above. No earlier stage output.', 'page'))
      .toBe('Asked by super-chotu, an agent allowed to dispatch the one working it. From Reported: queued by super-chotu on 8 Oct with the brief above. No earlier stage output.');
    expect(paperAttempt(14, 0, 'stopped', null)).toBe('14 events, no errors · stopped');
    expect(paperAttempt(9, 0, 'sent back', '12:11')).toBe('9 events, no errors · sent back at 12:11');
    expect(paperAttempt(3, 1, 'failed', null)).toBe('3 events, 1 error · failed');
    const first = ACTIVITIES_4605.find((a) => a.runId === 'run_fx_4605_2' && a.seq === 1)!;
    const stop = ACTIVITIES_4605.find((a) => a.runId === 'run_fx_4605_2' && a.seq === 14)!;
    expect(paperLogRow(first)).toBe('Started Rework run on this card session; read prior persisted evidence first.');
    expect(paperLogRow(stop)).toBe('Stopped. Blocked. Waiting on you; the reason is shown at the top of this card.');
    expect(paperLogTime(first.ts, false, TZ)).toBe('18:50');
    expect(paperLogTime(stop.ts, true, TZ)).toBe('19:41 · Thu 8 Oct');
    expect(paperLinked({ links: 0, children: 0, openChildren: 0, refs: 5, related: 0 })).toBe('no related cards · no sub-tasks (0 open of 0) · 5 references · no related prior work');
    expect(paperCostLine(null, ATTEMPTS_4605)).toBe('No estimate yet · attempt 1, $0.00 · attempt 2, $0.00');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/paper-words.ts
/** Paper's words for a card (screens/card.parts/20-paper.md): a letter, enclosures, the record. */
import type { Activity, Attempt } from '$lib/api';
import type { Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import { clockHM, dayMonthLong, weekdayDayMonth } from '$lib/when';
import type { LeadKind } from './card-lead';
import { attemptWord, STOP_SENTENCE, eventVerb } from './state-words';
import { usd } from './card-words';

export const PAPER_LIGHT: Readonly<Record<Phase, string>> = {
  dawn: 'at first light', morning: 'in the morning light', noon: 'in full daylight', golden: 'in the golden hour', dusk: 'at dusk', night: 'after dark',
};
export function paperDateline(now: Date, phase: Phase, tz?: string): string {
  const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  const p = Object.fromEntries(f.formatToParts(now).map((x) => [x.type, x.value]));
  return `${p.weekday} ${p.day} ${p.month} · ${PAPER_LIGHT[phase]}`;
}
const ROMAN: Array<[number, string]> = [[10, 'X'], [9, 'IX'], [5, 'V'], [4, 'IV'], [1, 'I']];
export function roman(n: number): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const [v, s] of ROMAN) while (n >= v) { out += s; n -= v; }
  return out;
}
const WORDS = ['zero', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine', 'ten'];
export const numberWord = (n: number): string => WORDS[n] ?? String(n);
export const firstName = (name: string): string => name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? name;
const s = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '' : 's');

export const reTitle = (title: string, gatePending: boolean): string => `Re: ${gatePending ? 'approval. ' : ''}${title}`;
export function paperKicker(needsYou: boolean, archivedAt: string | null, ageHours: number | null, surface: 'drawer' | 'page', tz?: string): string | null {
  if (archivedAt) return `Archived on ${dayMonthLong(archivedAt, tz)}`;
  if (!needsYou) return null;
  return surface === 'page' && ageHours !== null ? `A letter that needs your reply · ${ageWords(ageHours)}` : 'A letter that needs a reply';
}
const ENCLOSED = 'The brief, the record and the correspondence are enclosed below.';
export function paperDeck(kind: LeadKind, agent: string, stage: string, attempts: number): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'stopped': case 'failed': case 'budget':
      return `${agent} stopped in ${stage} after ${numberWord(attempts)} attempt${s(attempts)} and has written to you. ${ENCLOSED}`;
    case 'review': return `${agent} finished ${stage} and asks for your review. ${ENCLOSED}`;
    case 'question': return `${agent} has a question in ${stage}. ${ENCLOSED}`;
    case 'working': return `${agent} is working on ${stage}. ${ENCLOSED}`;
    case 'done': return `This card is done. ${ENCLOSED}`;
    default: return `Nobody holds this card yet. ${ENCLOSED}`;
  }
}
export const paperReplySub = (n: number): string => `I stopped after ${numberWord(n)} attempt${s(n)}. Send me back with what changed.`;
export function paperStageNo(i: number, current: number, needsYou: boolean): string {
  const suffix = i < current ? ' · done' : i === current ? (needsYou ? ' · stopped here' : ' · here') : i === current + 1 ? ' · next' : '';
  return `${roman(i + 1)}${suffix}`;
}
export const paperByline = (stage: string, attempt: number, delegated: boolean): string =>
  ` · agent for ${stage}, ran attempt ${attempt}${delegated ? '' : ' · Unclaimed now'}`;
export const paperRole = (role: string | null, attempt: number): string => `${role ?? 'agent'}, attempt ${attempt}`;
export function paperProvenance(q: string, byAgent: boolean, covers: boolean | null, handoff: string, surface: 'drawer' | 'page'): string {
  const who = surface === 'page'
    ? `${byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'}${covers ? ' allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''}`
    : `(${byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'}${covers ? ', allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''})`;
  return `Asked by ${q}${surface === 'page' ? ', ' : ' '}${who}. ${handoff}`;
}
export const paperAttempt = (events: number, errors: number, word: string, endedHM: string | null): string =>
  `${events} events, ${errors ? `${errors} error${s(errors)}` : 'no errors'} · ${word}${endedHM ? ` at ${endedHM}` : ''}`;
export const paperLogRow = (a: Pick<Activity, 'signal' | 'action' | 'type' | 'body'>): string =>
  a.signal === 'stop' ? `Stopped. ${STOP_SENTENCE}` : `${eventVerb(a)} ${a.body ?? ''}`.trim();
export const paperLogTime = (ts: string, last: boolean, tz?: string): string => (last ? `${clockHM(ts, tz)} · ${weekdayDayMonth(ts, tz)}` : clockHM(ts, tz));
export function paperLinked(c: { links: number; children: number; openChildren: number; refs: number; related: number }): string {
  return [
    c.links ? `${c.links} related card${s(c.links)}` : 'no related cards',
    `${c.children ? `${c.children} sub-task${s(c.children)}` : 'no sub-tasks'} (${c.openChildren} open of ${c.children})`,
    `${c.refs} reference${s(c.refs)}`,
    c.related ? `${c.related} related prior work` : 'no related prior work',
  ].join(' · ');
}
export const paperCostLine = (estimate: number | null, attempts: Attempt[]): string =>
  [estimate ? `Estimate ${usd(estimate)}` : 'No estimate yet', ...attempts.map((a, i) => `attempt ${i + 1}, ${usd(a.costUsd)}`)].join(' · ');
export { attemptWord };
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/page/CardPagePaper.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Paper's card page (SP-CardPage-Paper): a letter from the agent, its enclosures, and the record. */
  import './card-page-paper.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { clockHM, whenLabelLong } from '$lib/when';
  import { isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import DeliveryPanel from '../DeliveryPanel.svelte';
  import LinkAddForm from '../LinkAddForm.svelte';
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import TokenText from '../TokenText.svelte';
  import SpecValueView from '../SpecValueView.svelte';
  import GatePaper from '../gate/GatePaper.svelte';
  import QuestionPaper from '../question/QuestionPaper.svelte';
  import { specGroups } from '../spec-groups';
  import { referenceSource, refLabel } from '../references';
  import { safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { sessionIdOf } from '../tokens';
  import { attemptWord, stripAria, stripKind, waitingWord } from '../state-words';
  import { emptyNoteError, handoffLine, initials, planNone, projectLine, relatedLine, RESUME_PLACEHOLDER, usd } from '../card-words';
  import {
    firstName, paperAttempt, paperByline, paperCostLine, paperDateline, paperDeck, paperKicker, paperLinked, paperLogRow, paperLogTime,
    paperProvenance, paperReplySub, paperRole, paperStageNo, reTitle, roman,
  } from '../paper-words';
  import AccountMenu from './AccountMenu.svelte';
  import type { CardPageProps } from '../layouts/types';

  let { model: m, vibe, phase, personName, gate, question, boardHref }: CardPageProps = $props();
  const card = $derived(m.card!);
  const lead = $derived(m.lead!);
  const editing = $derived(m.edit.editing);
  const name = (id: string | null) => (id ? displayAgent(id, m.agents) : '');
  const agentName = $derived(m.agent.name || 'the agent');
  const role = $derived(m.agents.find((a) => a.id === m.speakerId)?.role ?? null);
  const lastName = $derived(name(m.lastAgentId));
  const ownerName = $derived(displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members));
  const userName = $derived(app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? '');
  const q = $derived(m.provenance);
  const groups = $derived(specGroups(card.spec, { criteriaHeading: 'Things to prove' }));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead.sentence));
  const runs = $derived([...m.activityGroups].reverse());
  const stageNameOf = (key: string | null) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)?.name ?? key ?? 'Unknown stage';
  const attemptOf = (runId: string) => m.attempts.find((a) => a.runId === runId);
  const attemptNo = (runId: string) => m.attempts.findIndex((a) => a.runId === runId) + 1;
  const stopped = $derived(['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead.kind) && !m.archived);
  const kicker = $derived(paperKicker(lead.needsYou, card.archivedAt, m.ageHours, 'page'));
  const handoff = $derived(handoffLine({ handoff: null, stageIndex: m.stageIndex, stages: m.stages, queuedByName: q?.queuedByName ?? 'someone', createdAt: card.createdAt }));
  let rawOpen = $state(false);
  $effect(() => m.comments.attach());
  function commentKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void m.comments.submit(); }
  }
</script>

      <button class="pg-frame" type="button" onclick={() => m.copyLink()}><Icon name={m.copied === 'link' ? 'check' : 'link'} size={16} /> {m.copied === 'link' ? 'Link copied' : 'Copy link to this card'}</button>

        {#if q?.known}<span class="pg-by" title={q.byAgent ? 'An agent with dispatch authority on this board' : undefined}>{#if q.byAgent}<Face id={q.queuedByName} label={q.queuedByName} mood="working" size={32} />{:else}<span class="pg-initials" aria-hidden="true">{initials(q.queuedByName)}</span>{/if}<span><b>{q.queuedByName}</b> · asked for it{q.byAgent ? ', an agent' : ''}</span></span>{/if}
      </div>
      <p class="pg-line" data-section="facts">
        <span class:sig={lead.needsYou && !m.archived}>{waitingWord(card, lead, m.ageHours, 'desktop')}</span>

        {#if card.attemptCount > 1}<span>Attempt <b>{card.attemptCount}</b></span>{/if}
        <span>Priority <b>{card.priority > 0 ? `P${card.priority}` : 'none'}</b></span>
        {#if card.dueAt}<span>Due <b>{card.dueAt.slice(0, 10)}</b></span>{:else}<span>No due date</span>{/if}
        {#if m.labels.length}<span>Labels <b>{m.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ')}</b></span>{:else}<span>No labels</span>{/if}
        {#if m.projectName}<span>Project <b>{m.projectName}</b></span>{/if}

    </section>

        {#if gate}
          <GatePaper boardId={gate.boardId} gate={gate.gate} error={gate.error} onResponse={gate.onResponse} agent={m.agent} {lead} {vibe} />
          {@render hidden('resume')}

          {@render hidden('resume')}
        {:else}
          <p class="pg-dear">Dear {firstName(personName)},</p>

          <div class="pg-sign">
            <Face id={agentName} label={agentName} mood={m.agent.mood} size={40} />

          </div>

              <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;"><h3 id="reply-h" class="pg-h">Your reply</h3><p class="pg-small" style="margin: 0px;">{paperReplySub(card.attemptCount)}</p></div>
              <div class="pg-grid">
                <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="pg-resume-at">Resume at stage</label>

                <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
                  <label class="vk-field__label" for="pg-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
                  <textarea id="pg-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" aria-describedby="pg-note-hint" aria-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} placeholder={RESUME_PLACEHOLDER} bind:this={m.resume.noteEl} bind:value={m.resume.note}></textarea>
                  {#if m.resume.error}<p id="pg-note-hint" class="vk-field__error">{m.resume.error}</p>{:else}<p id="pg-note-hint" class="vk-field__hint">{m.resume.hint}</p>{/if}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="pg-foot"><button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="submit" disabled={m.resume.busy}>{m.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button><span class="pg-small">With no note: “{emptyNoteError(agentName)}”</span></div>
            </form>
          {:else}{@render hidden('resume')}{/if}
        {/if}
        <section class="pg-enc" aria-labelledby="pg-corr" data-section="comments">
          <h3 id="pg-corr"><span class="no">Enclosure V</span>Correspondence</h3>
          {#if m.comments.comments.length}<ul class="pg-ul">{#each m.comments.comments as c (c.id)}<li><b>{c.author.name ?? c.author.id}</b> <span style="white-space: pre-wrap">{c.deletedAt ? 'Comment deleted' : c.body}</span></li>{/each}</ul>
          {:else}<p class="pg-small" style="margin: 0px;">No letters yet. The agent that works this card reads them.</p>{/if}
          <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="pg-comment">Write to whoever works this card</label><textarea id="pg-comment" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8192" placeholder="⌘ or Ctrl + Enter posts it" style="min-height: 88px;" bind:value={m.comments.draft} onkeydown={commentKey}></textarea></div>
          {#if m.comments.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{m.comments.error}</p>{/if}
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" disabled={m.comments.posting} onclick={() => m.comments.submit()}>{m.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button>
        </section>
      </article>

      <section class="pg-col" aria-labelledby="pg-encl">
        <h2 id="pg-encl" class="pg-sc">Enclosed</h2>
        <section class="pg-enc">
          <h3><span class="no">Enclosure I</span>The brief</h3>
          {#if card.spec?.description}<p class="pg-p pg-serif" data-section="description" style="white-space: pre-line">{String(card.spec.description)}</p>{:else}{@render hidden('description')}{/if}
          <div data-section="details" style="display: contents">
            {#each groups as g (g.label)}
              <div class="pg-group"><h4>{g.label}</h4><dl class="pg-dl pg-dl--stack">{#each g.rows as r (r.key)}<dt>{r.label}</dt><dd data-testid="spec-value-{r.key}"><SpecValueView value={r.value} v={{ clamp: 'pg-clamp', more: 'pg-lnk', matrixLinks: false }} /></dd>{/each}</dl></div>
            {/each}
          </div>
          <div class="pg-foot" style="justify-content: space-between;">

                <button class="pg-lnk" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.save()}>Save</button> <button class="pg-lnk" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.cancel()}>Cancel</button>

'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /> Copy</button></span>
          </div>

'references' : undefined}>Reference: {#if safeHref(r.url)}<a href={safeHref(r.url)!} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}</a>{:else}{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}{/if}{r.subtitle ? ` · ${r.subtitle}` : ''} · <span class="pg-mono">{referenceSource(r)}</span></li>{/each}

          </div>
        </section>
      </section>

              {@const word = a ? attemptWord(a) : (g.outcome ?? 'working')}

'border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); padding-top: var(--vk-space-3);' : undefined}><b>Attempt {attemptNo(g.runId) || runs.length - ri}</b> · {who} · {paperAttempt(g.counts.total, g.counts.error, word, ri > 0 && a?.endedAt ? clockHM(a.endedAt) : null)}</p>

                <ol class="pg-log">
                  {#each rows as ev, ei (ev.seq)}<li><Face id={who} label={who} mood={ev.signal === 'stop' ? 'needs' : 'thinking'} size={24} /><span class:stop={ev.signal === 'stop' && lead.needsYou}>{paperLogRow(ev)}<span class="t">{paperLogTime(ev.ts, ei === rows.length - 1)}</span></span></li>{/each}
                </ol>
                <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start; font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" aria-pressed={m.showToolCalls} onclick={() => (m.showToolCalls = !m.showToolCalls)}>{m.showToolCalls ? 'Hide tool calls' : `Show tool calls · all ${g.counts.total} events`}</button>
              {/if}
            {/each}
          </div>
          <p class="pg-small" style="margin: 0px;" data-section="decisions">Decisions: {#if m.decidedGates.length}{m.decidedGates.map((d) => `${d.decision ?? d.status} at ${stageNameOf(d.stageKey)}`).join('; ')}.{:else}none yet.{/if}</p>
        </section>
        <section class="pg-enc">
          <h3><span class="no">Accounts</span>Cost and delivery</h3>
          <span class="pg-fig" data-section="cost">{usd(card.costUsd)}</span>

          <div class="pg-meter"><i style="width: {m.costPct}%;"></i></div>

        </section>
      </aside>
    </div>

    <footer class="pg-colophon" data-section="cardActions">
      {#if !m.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" disabled={m.archiving} onclick={() => m.archive()}><Icon name="archive" size={16} /> {m.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
      <button class="vk-button" type="button" style="background: var(--vk-color-surface); color: var(--vk-color-text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--vk-color-text);" onclick={() => m.remove()}>Delete card</button>
      <span style="flex: 1 1 auto;"></span>
      <span class="pg-small">Opened from {m.boardName} · <a href={boardHref}>Back to the board</a> · card {m.shortId}</span>
    </footer>
  </div>
</div>
```
