```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/studio/studio-format.ts
/** Studio ("Annual report") formatters for a card (screens/card.parts/30-studio.md §3, corrected). */
import type { Attempt } from '$lib/api';
import { ageLabel } from '$lib/age';
import { clockHM, weekdayDayMonth } from '$lib/when';
import { STRIP_WORD, type StripKind } from '../state-words';

export const stageNo = (i: number): string => String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
/** Floors (F §A.2): 48 hours and over in days, else hours. */
export function figAge(hours: number): { value: string; unit: string } {
  if (hours >= 48) { const n = Math.floor(hours / 24); return { value: String(n), unit: n === 1 ? 'day' : 'days' }; }
  return { value: String(Math.floor(hours)), unit: 'h' };
}
export const usdShort = (n: number): string => (Number.isInteger(n) ? `$${n}` : `$${n.toFixed(2)}`);
const dayKey = (iso: string, tz?: string) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: tz, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
export const quoteWhen = (iso: string, now: Date, tz?: string): string =>
  dayKey(iso, tz) === dayKey(now.toISOString(), tz) ? clockHM(iso, tz) : `${weekdayDayMonth(iso, tz)} ${clockHM(iso, tz)}`;
export function runEnded(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz, month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).formatToParts(new Date(iso)).map((x) => [x.type, x.value]));
  return `${p.month} ${p.day} ${clockHM(iso, tz)}`;
}
export const cpKicker = (shortId: string, i: number, stageName: string): string => `Card ${shortId} · stage ${stageNo(i)} ${stageName}`;
export function studioTrackLabel(i: number, name: string, current: boolean, kind: StripKind): string {
  const suffix = current ? ({ stopped: ' · stopped', failed: ' · stopped', budget: ' · stopped', review: ' · review', question: ' · question' } as Partial<Record<StripKind, string>>)[kind] ?? '' : '';
  return `${stageNo(i)} ${name}${suffix}`;
}
export function studioProvenance(q: string, byAgent: boolean, covers: boolean | null, delegated: boolean): string {
  const phrase = covers === null ? 'with no recorded dispatch authority' : covers ? 'allowed to dispatch the one working it' : 'not allowed to dispatch the one working it';
  return `Asked by ${q}, ${byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'} ${phrase}.${delegated ? '' : ' Unclaimed now.'}`;
}
export const stoppedAfter = (n: number): string => `stopped after ${n} attempt${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
export function studioNoteHint(len: number, who: string, page: boolean): string {
  const base = len === 0 ? `Note needed · ${len}/8000` : `${len}/8000`;
  return page && len === 0 ? `${base} · with no note: “Add a note for ${who} first.”` : base;
}
export const commentsCount = (n: number): string => `${n} comment${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
export const linksSentence = (open: number, n: number, related: number): string =>
  `Sub-tasks ${open} open of ${n} · ${related ? `Related prior work ${related}` : 'Related prior work: none. No related prior work found in Superlibrary.'}`;
export function whereWord(url: string): string {
  try {
    const h = new URL(url).hostname;
    return h === 'github.com' ? 'GitHub' : h;
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}
export function outcomeWord(a: Pick<Attempt, 'outcome' | 'completion'>): string {
  if (a.outcome === 'blocked') return 'Stopped';
  if (a.outcome === 'sent_back' || (a.outcome === 'completed' && a.completion?.ok === false)) return 'Sent back';
  if (a.outcome === 'completed') return 'Done';
  if (a.outcome === 'failed') return 'Failed';
  return 'Running';
}
export function statusItems(i: { shortId: string; i: number; n: number; stageName: string; needsYou: boolean; ageHours: number | null; syncedAt: string | null; tz?: string }): Array<{ text: string; signal?: boolean }> {
  const out: Array<{ text: string; signal?: boolean }> = [{ text: `card ${i.shortId}` }, { text: `stage ${i.i + 1}/${i.n} ${i.stageName}` }];
  if (i.needsYou) out.push({ text: `waiting on you ${ageLabel(i.ageHours) ?? ''}`.trim(), signal: true });
  if (i.syncedAt) out.push({ text: `synced ${clockHM(i.syncedAt, i.tz)}` });
  return out;
}
export { STRIP_WORD };
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/page/CardPageStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Studio's card page (SP-CardPage-Studio): an annual-report page for one card. */
  import './card-page-studio.css';
  import { faceSvg } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { clockHM } from '$lib/when';
  import { isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import Icon from '$lib/components/parts/Icon.svelte';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import DeliveryPanel from '../DeliveryPanel.svelte';
  import LinkAddForm from '../LinkAddForm.svelte';
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import SpecValueView from '../SpecValueView.svelte';
  import GateStudioFrame from '../gate/GateStudioFrame.svelte';
  import GateStudioBar from '../gate/GateStudioBar.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioFrame from '../question/QuestionStudioFrame.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioBar from '../question/QuestionStudioBar.svelte';
  import { specGroups, specRowCount } from '../spec-groups';
  import { referenceSource, refLabel } from '../references';
  import { safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { sessionIdOf, splitTokens } from '../tokens';
  import { eventVerb, STOP_SENTENCE, stripAria, stripKind } from '../state-words';
  import { handoffLine, initials, planNone, projectLine, RESUME_PLACEHOLDER, usd } from '../card-words';
  import {
    commentsCount, cpKicker, figAge, linksSentence, outcomeWord, quoteWhen, runEnded, stageNo, statusItems, stoppedAfter, studioNoteHint,
    studioProvenance, studioTrackLabel, whereWord,
  } from '../studio/studio-format';
  import AccountMenu from './AccountMenu.svelte';
  import type { CardPageProps } from '../layouts/types';

  let { model: m, vibe, gate, question, boardHref }: CardPageProps = $props();
  const card = $derived(m.card!);
  const lead = $derived(m.lead!);
  const editing = $derived(m.edit.editing);
  const name = (id: string | null) => (id ? displayAgent(id, m.agents) : '');
  const agentName = $derived(m.agent.name || 'the agent');
  const lastName = $derived(name(m.lastAgentId));
  const ownerName = $derived(displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members));
  const userName = $derived(app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? '');
  const q = $derived(m.provenance);
  const kind = $derived(stripKind(lead, m.archived));
  const groups = $derived(specGroups(card.spec, { criteriaHeading: 'Things to prove' }));
  const rows = $derived(groups.flatMap((g) => g.rows.map((r, i) => ({ ...r, group: g.label, first: i === 0, span: g.rows.length }))));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead.sentence));
  const runs = $derived([...m.activityGroups].reverse());
  const age = $derived(figAge(m.ageHours ?? 0));
  const face = (who: string, mood: 'needs' | 'resting' | 'working' | 'thinking' | 'done', size: number) => faceSvg(who, { mood, size, label: `${who}, ${mood === 'needs' ? 'needs you' : mood}` });
  const stopped = $derived(['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead.kind) && !m.archived);
  const latest = $derived(runs[0]);
  const latestRows = $derived(latest ? visibleActivities(latest.activities, isNarrative, m.showToolCalls, isControlRow).rows : []);
  let rawOpen = $state(false);
  $effect(() => m.comments.attach());

  // Keyboard (spec §30): Shift+C copy link, G B back, E edit, C comment, ⌘↵ submits a textarea's form.
  let pendingG = 0;
  function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'Enter' && t instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) { e.preventDefault(); t.form?.requestSubmit(); return; }
    if (t && (t.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]') || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey)) return;
    if (e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') { e.preventDefault(); void m.copyLink(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'g') { pendingG = Date.now(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'b' && Date.now() - pendingG < 1000) { pendingG = 0; void goto(boardHref); return; }
    if (e.key === 'e') { m.edit.start(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'c') { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('cp-comment')?.focus(); }
  }
</script>

            <table class="cd-dt">

              <tbody>{#each runs as g, ri (g.runId)}{@const a = m.attempts.find((x) => x.runId === g.runId)}{@const who = name(g.agentId) || 'An agent'}<tr><td class="m">#{(m.attempts.findIndex((x) => x.runId === g.runId) + 1) || runs.length - ri}</td><td><span class="ag">{@html face(who, ri === 0 && lead.needsYou ? 'needs' : 'resting', 20)}{who}</span></td><td class:sigt={ri === 0 && lead.needsYou}>{a ? outcomeWord(a) : 'Running'}</td><td class="m">{g.counts.total}</td><td class="m">{a?.endedAt ? runEnded(a.endedAt) : '—'}</td></tr>{/each}</tbody>

                <table class="cd-dt"><tbody>{#each latestRows as ev, ei (ev.seq)}<tr><td class="m" style={ei === 0 ? 'width: 52px;' : undefined}>{clockHM(ev.ts)}</td><td><span class:sigt={ev.signal === 'stop'}>{eventVerb(ev)}.</span> {ev.signal === 'stop' ? STOP_SENTENCE : ev.body}</td></tr>{/each}</tbody></table>
              </div>

          <p class="cd-p" data-section="decisions"><span class="kick">Decisions</span> {m.decidedGates.length ? m.decidedGates.map((d) => `${d.decision ?? d.status} at ${d.stageKey}`).join('; ') : 'None yet.'}</p>
        </section>

        <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="cp-s7">

            <div class="cd-meter" aria-hidden="true">{#each [0, 1, 2, 3] as i (i)}<i class:off={m.costPct <= i * 25}></i>{/each}</div>
          </div>

    <span class="r"><span>E edit</span><span>{gate ? 'C request changes' : 'C comment'}</span><span>⌘↵ send</span><span>G B back to the board</span></span>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/quiet-words.ts
/** Quiet's words for a card (screens/card.parts/40-quiet.md): whole sentences, no glyphs. */
import type { Activity, Attempt } from '$lib/api';
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import { clockHM, dayMonthLong } from '$lib/when';
import type { LeadKind } from './card-lead';
import { attemptWord, eventVerb, STOP_SENTENCE } from './state-words';
import { usd } from './card-words';

export function whenLong(iso: string, tz?: string): string {
  const p = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }).formatToParts(new Date(iso)).map((x) => [x.type, x.value]));
  return `${p.weekday} ${p.day} ${p.month} at ${clockHM(iso, tz)}`;
}
const VERB: Partial<Record<LeadKind, string>> = { failed: 'failed', budget: 'stopped at the budget' };
export const quietWho = (kind: LeadKind, agent: string, at: string, tz?: string): string => `${agent} ${VERB[kind] ?? 'stopped'} on ${whenLong(at, tz)} and wrote:`;

export function quietPageMeta(i: { state: string; ageHours: number | null; i: number; n: number; stage: string; attempt: number; priority: number; due: string | null; labels: string[] }): string {
  const state = i.state === 'Waiting on you' && i.ageHours !== null ? `Waiting on you for ${ageWords(i.ageHours)}` : i.state;
  return [
    state, `Stage ${i.i + 1} of ${i.n}: ${i.stage}`, ...(i.attempt > 1 ? [`Attempt ${i.attempt}`] : []),
    i.priority > 0 ? `Priority P${i.priority}` : 'No priority', i.due ? `Due ${i.due}` : 'No due date', i.labels.length ? `Labels: ${i.labels.join(', ')}` : 'No labels',
  ].join(' · ');
}
export function quietStageSuffix(i: number, current: number, kind: LeadKind | 'archived'): string {
  if (i < current) return ' (done)';
  if (i === current) return kind === 'archived' ? ' (archived here)' : kind === 'done' ? ' (finished)' : kind === 'working' ? ' (working here)' : ' (stopped here)';
  return i === current + 1 ? ' (next)' : '';
}
export const quietAgentPage = (last: string, attempt: number, stage: string, delegate: string | null): string =>
  delegate ? `${delegate} is working it.` : `None holding it. ${last} ran attempt ${attempt} of ${stage}.`;
export const quietAskedBy = (q: string, byAgent: boolean, covers: boolean | null): string =>
  `${q}${byAgent ? ', an agent' : ''}${covers ? ' allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''}`;
export const quietHistoryHead = (n: number, stage: string, agent: string): string => `Attempt ${n}, ${stage}, ${agent}`;
export function quietHistoryLine(word: string, endedAt: string | null, events: number, errors: number, tz?: string): string {
  const w = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);
  const when = endedAt ? ` at ${clockHM(endedAt, tz)} on ${dayMonthLong(endedAt, tz)}` : '';
  return `${w}${when}. ${events} events, ${errors ? `${errors} error${errors === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'no errors'}.`;
}
export const quietRow = (a: Pick<Activity, 'ts' | 'signal' | 'action' | 'type' | 'body'>, tz?: string): string =>
  a.signal === 'stop' ? `${clockHM(a.ts, tz)} Stopped: ${STOP_SENTENCE}` : `${clockHM(a.ts, tz)} ${eventVerb(a)} ${a.body ?? ''}`.trim();
export const quietAttempts = (attempts: Attempt[], name: (id: string) => string): string =>
  attempts.map((a, i) => `${i + 1}: ${name(a.agentId)}, ${usd(a.costUsd)}, ${attemptWord(a)}.`).join(' ');
export const quietCost = (cost: number, estimate: number | null): string => `${usd(cost)}, ${estimate ? `estimate ${usd(estimate)}` : 'no estimate yet'}`;
export const quietSubtasks = (open: number, n: number): string => (n === 0 ? `None (${open} open of ${n}).` : `${n} sub-task${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${open} open of ${n}).`);
export const quietResumeOption = (n: number, name: string, current: boolean): string => `Stage ${n}: ${name}${current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}`;
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** Quiet's card page (SP-CardPage-Quiet): plain sections, whole sentences, no motion. */
  import './card-page-quiet.css';
  import { faceSvg } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { logout } from '$lib/api';
  import { isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import CardEditForm from '../CardEditForm.svelte';
  import DeliveryPanel from '../DeliveryPanel.svelte';
  import LinkAddForm from '../LinkAddForm.svelte';
  import HandoffView from '../HandoffView.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import TokenText from '../TokenText.svelte';
  import SpecValueView from '../SpecValueView.svelte';
  import GateQuiet from '../gate/GateQuiet.svelte';
  import QuestionQuiet from '../question/QuestionQuiet.svelte';
  import { specGroups, specRowCount } from '../spec-groups';
  import { referenceSource, refLabel } from '../references';
  import { safeHref } from '../spec-details';
  import { QUIET_TOKEN_RE, sessionIdOf } from '../tokens';
  import { attemptWord, stateWord, stripKind } from '../state-words';
  import { handoffLine, initials, planNone, projectLine, relatedLine } from '../card-words';
  import {
    quietAgentPage, quietAskedBy, quietAttempts, quietCost, quietHistoryHead, quietHistoryLine, quietPageMeta, quietResumeOption, quietRow,
    quietStageSuffix, quietSubtasks, quietWho,
  } from '../quiet-words';
  import type { CardPageProps } from '../layouts/types';

  let { model: m, vibe, gate, question, boardHref }: CardPageProps = $props();
  const card = $derived(m.card!);
  const lead = $derived(m.lead!);
  const editing = $derived(m.edit.editing);
  const name = (id: string | null) => (id ? displayAgent(id, m.agents) : '');
  const agentName = $derived(m.agent.name || 'the agent');
  const lastName = $derived(name(m.lastAgentId));
  const ownerName = $derived(displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members));
  const userName = $derived(app.user?.name ?? app.user?.login ?? '');
  const q = $derived(m.provenance);
  const kind = $derived(stripKind(lead, m.archived));
  const groups = $derived(specGroups(card.spec, { criteriaHeading: 'Things to prove' }));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead.sentence));
  const runs = $derived([...m.activityGroups].reverse());
  const stageNameOf = (key: string | null) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)?.name ?? key ?? 'Unknown stage';
  const stopped = $derived(['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead.kind) && !m.archived);
  const face = (who: string, mood: 'needs' | 'resting' | 'working', size = 24) => faceSvg(who, { mood, size, label: who });
  let rawOpen = $state(false);
  const act = (fn: () => unknown) => (e: MouseEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); void fn(); };
  $effect(() => m.comments.attach());
</script>

      <span>Opened from {m.boardName} · <a href={boardHref}>Back to the board</a></span>
      <span>Card id <span class="qp-id">{m.shortId}</span> · <button class="qp-link" type="button" aria-label="Copy card id {m.shortId}" onclick={() => m.copyId()}>{m.copied === 'id' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button></span>
      <button class="qp-link" type="button" onclick={() => m.copyLink()}>{m.copied === 'link' ? 'Link copied' : 'Copy link to this card'}</button>
      <a href="#edit" role="button" data-section="editButton" onclick={act(() => m.edit.start())}>Edit card</a>
    </div>
    <h1>{card.title}</h1>
    {#if editing}<div data-section="editForm"><CardEditForm model={m} /></div>{:else}{@render hidden('editForm')}{/if}
    <p class="qp-meta" data-section="facts">{quietPageMeta({ state: stateWord(card, lead), ageHours: m.ageHours, i: m.stageIndex, n: m.stages.length, stage: m.stageName, attempt: card.attemptCount, priority: card.priority, due: card.dueAt, labels: m.labels.map((l) => l.name) })}</p>
    <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-stages-h">
      <h3 id="qp-stages-h">Stages</h3>
      <ol class="qp-stages">{#each m.stages as st, i (st.key)}<li aria-current={i === m.stageIndex ? 'step' : undefined}>{st.name}{quietStageSuffix(i, m.stageIndex, kind)}</li>{/each}</ol>
    </section>
    <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-people-h" data-section="status">
      <h3 id="qp-people-h">People</h3>
      <dl class="qp-dl">
        <dt>Agent</dt><dd><span class="qp-face">{@html face(m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : lastName, 'resting')}</span> {quietAgentPage(lastName, card.attemptCount, stageNameOf(m.attempts.at(-1)?.stageKey ?? card.currentStageKey), m.delegate.id ? m.delegate.name : null)}</dd>
        <dt>Owner</dt><dd><span class="qp-ini" aria-hidden="true">{initials(ownerName)}</span> {ownerName}</dd>
        {#if q?.known}<dt>Asked by</dt><dd>{#if q.byAgent}<span class="qp-face">{@html face(q.queuedByName, 'resting')}</span> {/if}{quietAskedBy(q.queuedByName, q.byAgent, m.grantCovers)}</dd>{/if}
      </dl>
    </section>
    <div class="qp-cols">
      <div class="qp-col">
        {#if m.localError}<p role="alert" data-section="error">{m.localError}</p>{:else}{@render hidden('error')}{/if}
        {#if gate}
          <GateQuiet boardId={gate.boardId} gate={gate.gate} error={gate.error} onResponse={gate.onResponse} agent={m.agent} {lead} {vibe} />{@render hidden('resume')}
        {:else if question}
          <QuestionQuiet model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} {vibe} />{@render hidden('resume')}
        {:else if stopped && m.resume.show}
          <fieldset data-section="resume">
            <legend>Your decision is needed</legend>
            {#if lead.at}<p class="qp-by"><span class="qp-face">{@html face(agentName, 'needs')}</span>{quietWho(lead.kind, agentName, lead.at)}</p>{/if}
            {#if lead.sentence}<p class="qp-said"><TokenText text={lead.sentence} cls="qp-id" re={QUIET_TOKEN_RE} /></p>{/if}
            {#if sid}<p><button class="qp-link" type="button" style="min-height: 44px;" onclick={() => m.copySessionId(sid)}>{m.copied === 'session' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy session id'}</button></p>{/if}
            <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="qp-resume-at">Resume at stage</label>
              <select id="qp-resume-at" class="vk-field__input" style="max-width: 360px;" bind:value={m.resume.target}>{#each m.resume.targets.filter((t) => t.allowed) as t (t.key)}<option value={t.key}>{quietResumeOption(t.n, t.name, t.current)}</option>{/each}</select></div>
            <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
              <label class="vk-field__label" for="qp-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
              <textarea id="qp-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" aria-describedby="qp-note-hint" aria-invalid={m.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} bind:this={m.resume.noteEl} bind:value={m.resume.note}></textarea>
              {#if m.resume.error}<p id="qp-note-hint" class="vk-field__error">{m.resume.error}</p>{:else}<p id="qp-note-hint" class="vk-field__hint">You must write a note before sending. Up to 8000 characters.</p>{/if}
            </div>
            <div class="qp-acts"><button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="button" aria-busy={m.resume.busy} disabled={m.resume.busy} onclick={() => m.resume.submit()}>{m.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button></div>
          </fieldset>
        {:else}
          {#if lead.sentence}<section class="qp-sec"><p class="qp-by">{agentName} wrote:</p><p class="qp-said">{lead.sentence}</p></section>{/if}
          {@render hidden('resume')}
        {/if}
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-desc"><h2 id="qp-desc">Description</h2>{#if card.spec?.description}<p data-section="description" style="white-space: pre-line">{String(card.spec.description)}</p>{:else}<p data-section="description">None.</p>{/if}</section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-ac"><h2 id="qp-ac">Acceptance criteria ({m.counts.criteria})</h2>{#if m.acceptanceCriteria?.length}<ol data-section="criteria">{#each m.acceptanceCriteria as c, i (i)}<li>{c}</li>{/each}</ol>{:else}<p data-section="criteria">None.</p>{/if}</section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-brief" data-section="details">
          <h2 id="qp-brief">Brief details ({specRowCount(groups)})</h2>
          {#each groups as g (g.label)}<h3>{g.label}</h3><dl class="qp-dl">{#each g.rows as r (r.key)}<dt>{r.label}</dt><dd data-testid="spec-value-{r.key}"><SpecValueView value={r.value} v={{ clamp: 'qp-clamp', more: 'qp-link', matrixLinks: false }} /></dd>{/each}</dl>{/each}
          <div class="qp-acts"><a href="#raw" role="button" aria-expanded={rawOpen} onclick={act(() => (rawOpen = !rawOpen))}>View raw JSON</a><button class="qp-link" type="button" style="min-height: 44px;" onclick={() => m.copySpec()}>{m.copied === 'spec' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button></div>
          {#if rawOpen}<RawJson value={card.spec} />{/if}
        </section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-plan" data-section="plan"><h2 id="qp-plan">Plan</h2>{#if m.plan}<ol>{#each m.plan as st, i (i)}<li>{st.text}{st.done ? ' (done)' : ''}</li>{/each}</ol>{:else}<p>{planNone(m.agent.name)}</p>{/if}</section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-links" data-section="links">
          <h2 id="qp-links">Links ({m.counts.links})</h2>
          {#if m.hasAnyLink}<ul>{#each [...m.linkGroups.blockedBy, ...m.linkGroups.blocks, ...m.linkGroups.relates] as row (row.title)}<li>{row.title} <button class="qp-link" type="button" onclick={() => m.links.remove(row.remove)}>Remove</button></li>{/each}</ul>{:else}<p>Nothing blocks this card and it blocks nothing.</p>{/if}
          <div class="qp-acts"><a href="#add-link" role="button" onclick={act(() => m.links.openAdd())}>Add link</a></div>
          <LinkAddForm model={m} />
        </section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-refs">
          <h2 id="qp-refs">References and related prior work</h2>
          <ul>
            {#each m.otherRefs as r, i (r.id)}<li data-section={i === 0 ? 'references' : undefined}>{#if safeHref(r.url)}<a href={safeHref(r.url)!}>{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}</a>{:else}{r.title ?? refLabel(r)}{/if} ({referenceSource(r)})</li>{/each}
            {#if m.otherRefs.length === 0}<li data-section="references">No references.</li>{/if}
            <li data-section="related">{relatedLine(m.related.phase, m.related.items.length)}</li>
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div class="qp-col">
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-hist">
          <h2 id="qp-hist">History ({m.counts.runs} run{m.counts.runs === 1 ? '' : 's'})</h2>
          {#if m.counts.handoff}<div data-section="handoff"><HandoffView handoff={m.handoff} testid="carried-handoff" /></div>
          {:else}<p data-section="handoff">{handoffLine({ handoff: null, stageIndex: m.stageIndex, stages: m.stages, queuedByName: q?.queuedByName ?? 'someone', createdAt: card.createdAt })}</p>{/if}
          <div data-section="activity" style="display: contents">
            {#each runs as g, ri (g.runId)}
              {@const a = m.attempts.find((x) => x.runId === g.runId)}
              <h3>{quietHistoryHead((m.attempts.findIndex((x) => x.runId === g.runId) + 1) || runs.length - ri, stageNameOf(g.stageKey), name(g.agentId) || 'an agent')}</h3>
              <p>{quietHistoryLine(a ? attemptWord(a) : (g.outcome ?? 'working'), a?.endedAt ?? null, g.counts.total, g.counts.error)}</p>
              {#if ri === 0}
                <ol>{#each visibleActivities(g.activities, isNarrative, m.showToolCalls, isControlRow).rows as ev (ev.seq)}<li>{quietRow(ev)}</li>{/each}</ol>
                <div class="qp-acts"><a href="#tools" role="button" aria-pressed={m.showToolCalls} onclick={act(() => (m.showToolCalls = !m.showToolCalls))}>{m.showToolCalls ? 'Hide tool calls' : `Show tool calls (all ${g.counts.total} events)`}</a></div>
              {/if}
            {/each}
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-dec" data-section="decisions"><h2 id="qp-dec">Decisions</h2>{#if m.decidedGates.length}<ul>{#each m.decidedGates as d (d.id)}<li>{d.decision ?? d.status} at {stageNameOf(d.stageKey)}{d.decidedBy ? `, by ${displayPrincipal(d.decidedBy, app.members)}` : ''}.</li>{/each}</ul>{:else}<p>None yet.</p>{/if}</section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-com" data-section="comments">
          <h2 id="qp-com">Comments</h2>
          {#if m.comments.comments.length}<ul>{#each m.comments.comments as c (c.id)}<li><b>{c.author.name ?? c.author.id}:</b> <span style="white-space: pre-wrap">{c.deletedAt ? 'Comment deleted' : c.body}</span></li>{/each}</ul>{:else}<p>No comments yet. The agent that works this card reads them.</p>{/if}
          <div class="vk-field"><label class="vk-field__label" for="qp-comment">Add a comment</label><textarea id="qp-comment" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8192" style="min-height: 96px;" bind:value={m.comments.draft}></textarea></div>
          {#if m.comments.error}<p role="alert">{m.comments.error}</p>{/if}
          <div class="qp-acts"><button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" aria-busy={m.comments.posting} disabled={m.comments.posting} onclick={() => m.comments.submit()}>{m.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button></div>
        </section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-cost">
          <h2 id="qp-cost">Sub-tasks, project, cost and delivery</h2>
          <dl class="qp-dl">
            <div data-section="subtasks" style="display: contents"><dt>Sub-tasks</dt><dd>{quietSubtasks(card.openChildCount, m.children.length)} <a href="#subtask" role="button" onclick={act(() => document.getElementById('qp-sub')?.focus())}>Add a sub-task</a></dd></div>
            <div data-section="project" style="display: contents"><dt>Project</dt><dd>{#if m.project.editing}<select class="vk-field__input" aria-label="Project" bind:value={m.project.projectId} onchange={() => void m.project.onProjectChange()}><option value="">No project</option>{#each app.projects as p (p.id)}<option value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>{/each}</select> <button class="qp-link" type="button" onclick={() => m.project.save()}>Save</button>{:else}{m.projectName ? `${projectLine(m.projectName, m.milestoneName)}.` : 'None.'} <a href="#project" role="button" onclick={act(() => m.project.start())}>{m.projectName ? 'Change project' : 'Assign to a project'}</a>{/if}</dd></div>
            <div data-section="cost" style="display: contents"><dt>Cost</dt><dd>{quietCost(card.costUsd, m.estimate?.estimatedUsd ?? null)}</dd></div>
            <div data-section="attempts" style="display: contents"><dt>Attempts</dt><dd>{quietAttempts(m.attempts, name)}</dd></div>
            <div data-section="delivery" style="display: contents"><dt>Delivery</dt><dd>{#if m.counts.deliveryActive}<DeliveryPanel model={m} />{:else}None approved{/if}</dd></div>
          </dl>
          <p class="vk-visually-hidden"><label for="qp-sub">New sub-task title</label><input id="qp-sub" type="text" bind:value={m.subtasks.title} onkeydown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') void m.subtasks.add(); }} /></p>
        </section>
        <section class="qp-sec" aria-labelledby="qp-act" data-section="cardActions">
          <h2 id="qp-act">Card actions</h2>
          <div class="qp-acts">
            <a href="#edit" role="button" onclick={act(() => m.edit.start())}>Edit card</a>
            {#if !m.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" aria-busy={m.archiving} disabled={m.archiving} onclick={() => m.archive()}>{m.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
            <button class="vk-button" type="button" style="background: var(--vk-color-surface); color: var(--vk-color-text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--vk-color-text);" onclick={() => m.remove()}>Delete card</button>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p style="border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); padding-top: var(--vk-space-4);">Opened from {m.boardName} · <a href={boardHref}>Back to the board</a></p>
  </main>
</div>
```

The visually hidden sub-task input becomes visible on focus via `.vk-visually-hidden-focusable` if

when it exists. `GateQuiet`/`QuestionQuiet` are the pre-sweep Quiet panels (Task 27 rewrites them).

### Task 25: Paper card drawer and the Paper card-states gallery

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Paper's card becomes a letter on a centred sheet (`SP-Card-Paper`): kicker, `Re:` title, two small-caps fact lines, the agent's letter, the reply form and five enclosures, ported from the reference markup and CSS. The gate, the question and the archived/done/loading blocks are rewritten as letter parts (`GatePaper`, `QuestionPaper`, `CardStatePaper`) and the gallery `CardStatesPaper` lays out cells A–F for `/dev/card-states` (`SP-Card-States-Paper`). This task also lands the formatting shared by the Paper, Studio and Quiet layouts (`card/card-format.ts`), the card icon set, the 409 watcher every non-Daylight gate uses, the small editors (links, sub-tasks, references, project, edit form, comment thread, run events) and the fake `CardModel` the layout tests use. Rulings applied: C-08 Paper mask as two rectangles `{x:0,w:330}` + `{x:1110,w:330}`; "sent back" derived from `completion.ok === false`; first-paragraph Show more; the 409 alert lives in the gate component and survives a later local validation; `cancelled` and `canceled` both read as cancelled; Delete card is the ink outline.

```ts
import {
  ARCHIVE_CANCELLED_REVIEW, attemptWord, briefValue, cancelledAtArchive, capFirst, conflictSentence, dateParts, faceLabel,

const TZ = 'Asia/Kolkata';
const NOW = '2026-10-11T08:21:00Z';
const DETAIL_4605 =
  'not reproduced end-to-end: Melissa’s live ACP session acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023 reached Hermes and produced a model reply, while Anna has no local ACP dispatch; first failing hop cannot be identified without one fresh DM event_id/room_id/timestamp per agent plus AgentPod hub matrix-inbound/control-pair/ACP/matrix-outbound logs, matrix_rooms/ACP metadata, homeserver send-event metadata, and Supermessage sync ingestion for those event IDs. No Accounts defect established; no issue filed.';
const CRITERIA = ['Trace user DM ingress.', 'Check real current shared-profile servicing.'];
const attempt = (over: Record<string, unknown>) => ({ runId: 'r', agentId: 'agt_fx_error_eric', stageKey: 'reproduce', status: 'completed', outcome: 'completed', costUsd: 0, model: null, profileKey: null, handoff: null, failureReason: null, startedAt: '2026-10-08T06:05:10Z', endedAt: '2026-10-08T06:41:00Z', completion: null, ...over }) as never;

describe('dateParts and clock words', () => {
  it('reads 4605’s stop in Asia/Kolkata', () => {
    expect(dateParts('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z', TZ)).toMatchObject({ weekdayLong: 'Thursday', weekdayShort: 'Thu', day: 8, monthLong: 'October', monthShort: 'Oct', hh: '19', mm: '41' });
    expect(hhmm('2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', TZ)).toBe('13:02');
    expect(hhmm('2026-10-11T02:10:00Z', TZ)).toBe('07:40');
  });
  it('knows the local day', () => {
    expect(sameLocalDay('2026-10-11T07:18:00Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe(true);
    expect(sameLocalDay('2026-10-10T19:00:00Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe(true); // 00:30 on the 11th in Kolkata
    expect(sameLocalDay('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z', NOW, TZ)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('idTokens / sessionIdOf (G-3, G-4)', () => {
  it('marks exactly the four ids in 4605’s detail and leaves the text whole', () => {
    const parts = idTokens(DETAIL_4605);
    expect(parts.filter((p) => p.id).map((p) => p.text)).toEqual([
      'acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023', 'event_id/room_id/timestamp', 'matrix-inbound/control-pair/ACP/matrix-outbound', 'matrix_rooms',
    ]);
    expect(parts.map((p) => p.text).join('')).toBe(DETAIL_4605);
  });
  it('session mode marks only the session id (Quiet, Q-3)', () => {
    expect(idTokens(DETAIL_4605, 'session').filter((p) => p.id).map((p) => p.text)).toEqual(['acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023']);
  });
  it('finds the session id, or none', () => {
    expect(sessionIdOf(DETAIL_4605)).toBe('acps_8f86d4e4-1cf2-457b-beb8-0ffb529d9023');
    expect(sessionIdOf('All done, ready for your review.')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('archive and provenance', () => {

  it('a gate cancelled at the archive is the reason, either spelling, within 5 s', () => {

    expect(cancelledAtArchive('2026-10-09T05:30:00Z', [gate('cancelled', '2026-10-09T05:30:04Z')])).toBe(true);
    expect(cancelledAtArchive('2026-10-09T05:30:00Z', [gate('cancelled', '2026-10-09T05:31:00Z')])).toBe(false);
    expect(cancelledAtArchive(null, [gate('cancelled', '2026-10-09T05:30:00Z')])).toBe(false);
    expect(ARCHIVE_CANCELLED_REVIEW).toBe('Its pending review was cancelled when the card was archived.');

    expect(grantCovers(card, 'agt_fx_error_eric', agents)).toBe(true);

  });
  it('reads a handoff’s summary first, then its first sentence of text', () => {

    expect(handoffText({ note: 'Branch pushed.' })).toBe('Branch pushed.');

    expect(rows.map((r) => [r.label, r.title, r.where])).toEqual([['Relates to', 'Other', 'This board'], ['Blocked by', 'Far', 'Another board · advisory']]);
  });
  it('says what Superlibrary returned', () => {
    expect(relatedState({ phase: 'ok', items: [] })).toEqual({ sentence: 'No related prior work found in Superlibrary.', items: [] });
    expect(relatedState({ phase: 'absent', items: [] }).sentence).toBe('No related prior work found in Superlibrary.');
    expect(relatedState({ phase: 'loading', items: [] }).sentence).toBe('Looking in Superlibrary…');
    expect(relatedState({ phase: 'unavailable', items: [] }).sentence).toBe('Related prior work is not available right now.');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/gate-conflict.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { GateConflictWatch } from './gate-conflict.svelte';

const body409 = { error: { code: 'GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED', message: 'gate is already resolved', decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' } };

describe('GateConflictWatch', () => {
  it('keeps the 409 and still hands the response on', async () => {
    const w = new GateConflictWatch();
    const on = vi.fn(async () => false);
    const res = new Response(JSON.stringify(body409), { status: 409, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
    expect(await w.wrap(on)('approve', res)).toBe(false);
    expect(w.conflict).toEqual({ decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' });
    expect(on).toHaveBeenCalledWith('approve', res);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual(body409); // the caller can still read the body
  });
  it('a later answer that is not a conflict clears it', async () => {
    const w = new GateConflictWatch();
    await w.wrap(async () => false)('approve', new Response(JSON.stringify(body409), { status: 409 }));
    await w.wrap(async () => true)('approve', new Response('{}', { status: 200 }));
    expect(w.conflict).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/card-format.ts
/**
 * Formatting shared by the Paper, Studio and Quiet card layouts (Tasks 25–27) and their phones.
 * Pure functions of snapshot data. Times read in the viewer's zone unless a zone is passed; tests
 * pass `Asia/Kolkata`, the harness runs the browser in it.
 */
import type { AgentSummary, Attempt, Card, Gate, GateConflict } from '$lib/api';
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { edgeKey, type LinkGroups, type RemoveArgs } from '$lib/components/link-groups';
import type { RelatedLite } from '$lib/superlibrary';
import { humanizeKey } from './spec-groups';

export interface DateParts { weekdayLong: string; weekdayShort: string; day: number; monthLong: string; monthShort: string; hh: string; mm: string; dayKey: string }

export function dateParts(iso: string, tz?: string): DateParts {
  const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' });
  const p: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const x of f.formatToParts(new Date(iso))) p[x.type] = x.value;
  return {
    weekdayLong: p.weekday!, weekdayShort: p.weekday!.slice(0, 3), day: Number(p.day), monthLong: p.month!, monthShort: p.month!.slice(0, 3),
    hh: p.hour!, mm: p.minute!, dayKey: `${p.year}-${p.month}-${p.day}`,
  };
}
export const hhmm = (iso: string, tz?: string): string => {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return `${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
};
export const sameLocalDay = (a: string, b: string, tz?: string): boolean => dateParts(a, tz).dayKey === dateParts(b, tz).dayKey;

/** Display-only id spans (G-3). The text is never altered: joining the parts gives it back. */
const ID_ALL = /\b(?:acps|evt|run|card|brd|agt)_[\w-]+|\b[a-z][\w-]*(?:\/[\w-]+)*\/[a-z][\w-]*\b|\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+\b/g;
const ID_SESSION = /\b[a-z]+_[0-9a-f-]{8,}\b/g;
export function idTokens(text: string, mode: 'all' | 'session' = 'all'): Array<{ text: string; id: boolean }> {
  const re = new RegExp(mode === 'all' ? ID_ALL : ID_SESSION);
  const out: Array<{ text: string; id: boolean }> = [];
  let at = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
    if (m.index! > at) out.push({ text: text.slice(at, m.index), id: false });
    out.push({ text: m[0], id: true });
    at = m.index! + m[0].length;
  }
  if (at < text.length) out.push({ text: text.slice(at), id: false });
  return out;
}
export function sessionIdOf(text: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  return text?.match(/\bacps_[0-9a-f-]{36}\b/)?.[0] ?? null;
}

/** First-paragraph rule: a long value is stored as shown + "\n\n" + continuation. */
export function splitShowMore(value: string): { shown: string; more: string | null } {
  const i = value.indexOf('\n\n');
  return i === -1 ? { shown: value, more: null } : { shown: value.slice(0, i), more: value.slice(i + 2) };
}

export function refSourceLine(url: string): string {
  let u: URL;
  try {
    u = new URL(url);
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
  const blob = /^\/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)\/blob\/[^/]+\/(.+)$/.exec(u.pathname);
  if (u.hostname === 'github.com' && blob) {
    const lines = /^#L(\d+)-L(\d+)$/.exec(u.hash);
    return `github · ${blob[2]} · ${blob[3]!.split('/').at(-1)}${lines ? ` lines ${lines[1]}–${lines[2]}` : ''}`;
  }
  return u.hostname;
}

export type BriefValue =
  | { kind: 'text'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'identity'; matrixId: string; card: string; board: string | null }
  | { kind: 'repo'; repo: string; visibility: string; policyUrl: string };
const sameList = (a: unknown[], b: string[]) => a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => x === b[i]);
export function briefValue(value: unknown, criteria: string[] | null, criteriaHeading: string): BriefValue {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (criteria && criteria.length > 0 && sameList(value, criteria)) return { kind: 'text', text: `${criteria.length} items, listed under ${criteriaHeading}.` };
    return { kind: 'text', text: value.map(String).join(', ') };
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') return { kind: 'text', text: value };
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    const o = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof o.matrixId === 'string' && typeof o.card === 'string') return { kind: 'identity', matrixId: o.matrixId, card: o.card, board: typeof o.board === 'string' ? o.board : null };
    if (typeof o.repo === 'string' && typeof o.visibility === 'string' && typeof o.policyUrl === 'string') return { kind: 'repo', repo: o.repo, visibility: o.visibility, policyUrl: o.policyUrl };
  }
  return { kind: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(value) };
}

export function subjectRows(canonical: Record<string, unknown>): Array<{ key: string; label: string; value: string }> {
  return Object.entries(canonical).map(([key, v]) => ({
    key, label: humanizeKey(key), value: Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(String).join(', ') : typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v),
  }));
}

export type AttemptWord = 'stopped' | 'sent back' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'working';
export function attemptWord(a: Attempt): AttemptWord {
  const o = a.outcome ?? a.status;
  if (o === 'completed') return a.completion?.ok === false ? 'sent back' : 'done';
  if (o === 'blocked' || o === 'input-required') return 'stopped';
  if (o === 'failed' || o === 'rejected') return 'failed';
  return 'working';
}

export const capFirst = (s: string): string => (s ? s[0]!.toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s);
export const firstName = (name: string): string => name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? name;
export function initials(name: string): string {
  const w = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
  return ((w[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (w.length > 1 ? (w.at(-1)?.[0] ?? '') : '')).toUpperCase();
}
const MOOD_WORD: Partial<Record<Mood, string>> = { needs: 'needs you', done: 'done', resting: 'resting', working: 'working', thinking: 'thinking' };
export const faceLabel = (name: string, mood: Mood): string => `${name}, ${MOOD_WORD[mood] ?? mood}`;

export const VIA_WORD: Readonly<Record<GateConflict['via'], string>> = { matrix: 'Matrix', web: 'the web app', api: 'the API' };
export const conflictSentence = (c: GateConflict, who: string, tz?: string): string =>
  `This gate was already decided from ${VIA_WORD[c.via]} by ${who} at ${hhmm(c.decidedAt, tz)}.`;

export const ARCHIVE_CANCELLED_REVIEW = 'Its pending review was cancelled when the card was archived.';
/** API-2: archiving cancels the card's pending gates at the archive instant (±5 s). */
export function cancelledAtArchive(archivedAt: string | null, gates: Gate[]): boolean {
  if (!archivedAt) return false;
  const t = Date.parse(archivedAt);
  return gates.some((g) => (g.status === 'cancelled' || g.status === 'canceled') && !!g.resolvedAt && Math.abs(Date.parse(g.resolvedAt) - t) <= 5000);
}

/** Grant entries are principals (`prn_…`); an agent is covered through its `externalId`. */
export function grantCovers(card: Pick<Card, 'queuedGrant'>, agentId: string | null, agents: AgentSummary[]): boolean {
  if (!agentId || !card.queuedGrant) return false;
  const ext = agents.find((a) => a.id === agentId)?.externalId;
  return !!ext && card.queuedGrant.includes(ext);
}

export function handoffFallback(prevStage: string | null, queuedByName: string, createdAt: string, tz?: string): string {
  const d = dateParts(createdAt, tz);
  const on = `${d.day} ${d.monthShort}`;
  return prevStage
    ? `From ${prevStage}: queued by ${queuedByName} on ${on} with the brief above. No earlier stage output.`
    : `Queued by ${queuedByName} on ${on} with the brief above.`;
}
export function handoffText(handoff: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
  if (!handoff) return null;
  if (typeof handoff.summary === 'string') return handoff.summary;
  const first = Object.values(handoff).find((v) => typeof v === 'string');
  return typeof first === 'string' ? first : null;
}

export interface LinkRow { key: string; label: string; cardId: string; boardId: string | null; title: string; where: string; remove: RemoveArgs }
export function linkRows(g: LinkGroups): LinkRow[] {
  const here = (label: string) => (r: { cardId: string; title: string; remove: RemoveArgs }): LinkRow => ({ key: edgeKey(r.remove), label, cardId: r.cardId, boardId: null, title: r.title, where: 'This board', remove: r.remove });
  const ADVISORY = { 'blocked-by': 'Blocked by', blocks: 'Blocks', relates: 'Relates to' } as const;
  return [
    ...g.blockedBy.map(here('Blocked by')),
    ...g.resolvedBlockedBy.map(here('Was blocked by')),
    ...g.blocks.map(here('Blocks')),
    ...g.relates.map(here('Relates to')),
    ...g.supersedes.map((r) => here(r.direction === 'supersedes' ? 'Supersedes' : 'Superseded by')(r)),
    ...g.advisory.map((r): LinkRow => ({ key: edgeKey(r.remove), label: ADVISORY[r.relation], cardId: r.cardId, boardId: r.boardId, title: r.title, where: 'Another board · advisory', remove: r.remove })),
  ];
}

export function relatedState(related: { phase: 'loading' | 'ok' | 'unavailable' | 'absent'; items: RelatedLite[] }): { sentence: string | null; items: RelatedLite[] } {
  if (related.phase === 'loading') return { sentence: 'Looking in Superlibrary…', items: [] };
  if (related.phase === 'unavailable') return { sentence: 'Related prior work is not available right now.', items: [] };
  if (related.phase === 'absent' || related.items.length === 0) return { sentence: 'No related prior work found in Superlibrary.', items: [] };
  return { sentence: null, items: related.items };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/gate-conflict.svelte.ts
/**
 * The server's "already decided" answer (API-1), kept by the gate component itself so it survives
 * a later local validation (the Quiet and Studio E cells draw a field error and this alert at once).
 */
import { parseGateConflict, type GateConflict, type GateDecision } from '$lib/api';

export class GateConflictWatch {
  conflict = $state<GateConflict | null>(null);

  wrap(onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>): (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean> {
    return async (d, r) => {
      this.conflict = r.status === 409 ? await parseGateConflict(r.clone()) : null;
      return onResponse(d, r);
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/paper/paper-words.ts
/** Paper's card copy (P.0–P.8 with mockup-corrections). Pure; the fixture-world examples are in the test. */
import type { Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import { numWord } from '$lib/words';
import type { OptionRole } from '../gate/gate-decision.svelte';
import { dateParts, sameLocalDay, type AttemptWord } from '../card-format';

export const PAPER_LIGHT: Readonly<Record<Phase, string>> = {
  dawn: 'at first light', morning: 'in the morning light', noon: 'in full daylight', golden: 'in the golden hour', dusk: 'at dusk', night: 'after dark',
};
export const paperBack = (boardName: string, phase: Phase): string => `${boardName} · ${PAPER_LIGHT[phase]}`;

export function paperWhen(iso: string, now: string, tz?: string): string {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return sameLocalDay(iso, now, tz) ? `Today, ${d.hh}:${d.mm}` : `${d.weekdayLong} ${d.day} ${d.monthLong}, ${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
}
export const reTitle = (title: string, gatePending: boolean): string => (gatePending ? `Re: approval. ${title}` : `Re: ${title}`);
export const PAPER_KICKER = 'A letter that needs a reply';

const s = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '' : 's');
const STATE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { working: 'Working', completed: 'Done', submitted: 'Queued', queued: 'Queued', rejected: 'Rejected', failed: 'Failed', 'input-required': 'Waiting on you' };
export function paperStateWord(o: { archived: boolean; needsYou: boolean; state: string; ageHours: number | null }): string {
  if (o.archived) return 'Archived';
  if (o.needsYou) return `Waiting on you · ${ageWords(o.ageHours ?? 0)}`;
  return STATE_WORD[o.state] ?? 'Queued';
}

export const signatureLine = (role: string | null, attempt: number, when: string | null): string => {
  const r = `${role ?? 'agent'}, attempt ${attempt}`;
  return when ? `${r} · ${when}` : r;
};
export const replySub = (n: number): string => `I stopped after ${numWord(n)} attempt${s(n)}. Send me back with what changed.`;
export const resumeOptionLabel = (t: { n: number; name: string; current: boolean }): string => `${t.n} · ${t.name}${t.current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}`;

export function briefSummary(o: { criteria: number; rows: number; planSteps: number; project: boolean }): string {
  return [
    o.criteria > 0 ? `${o.criteria} thing${s(o.criteria)} to prove` : 'nothing to prove',
    `${o.rows} detail${s(o.rows)}`,
    ...(o.planSteps > 0 ? ['plan'] : []),
    o.project ? 'project' : 'no project',
  ].join(' · ');
}
export const happenedSummary = (o: { runs: number; decisions: number; costUsd: number }): string =>
  `${o.runs > 0 ? `${o.runs} run${s(o.runs)}` : 'no runs'} · ${o.decisions > 0 ? `${o.decisions} decision${s(o.decisions)}` : 'no decisions'} · $${o.costUsd.toFixed(2)}`;
export const waitingSummary = (o: { links: number; subtasks: number; open: number }): string =>
  `${o.links > 0 ? `${o.links} link${s(o.links)}` : 'no links'} · ${o.subtasks > 0 ? `${o.open} of ${o.subtasks} sub-tasks open` : 'no sub-tasks'}`;
export const attachedSummary = (o: { refs: number; related: number; delivery: boolean }): string =>
  `${o.refs > 0 ? `${o.refs} reference${s(o.refs)}` : 'no references'} · ${o.related > 0 ? `${o.related} related` : 'no related prior work'} · ${o.delivery ? 'delivery' : 'no delivery'}`;
export const correspondenceSummary = (n: number): string => (n === 0 ? 'No letters yet' : `${n} letter${s(n)}`);

export const paperProvenance = (o: { queuedByName: string; byAgent: boolean; covers: boolean; handoff: string }): string =>
  `Asked by ${o.queuedByName} (${o.byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'}${o.covers ? ', allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''}). ${o.handoff}`;

export function paperAttemptLine(o: { n: number; agent: string; events: number; word: AttemptWord; endedAt: string | null; newest: boolean }, tz?: string): { head: string; rest: string } {
  let at = '';
  if (o.newest && o.endedAt) {
    const d = dateParts(o.endedAt, tz);
    at = ` at ${d.hh}:${d.mm} ${d.weekdayShort} ${d.day} ${d.monthShort}`;
  }
  return { head: `Attempt ${o.n}`, rest: ` · ${o.agent} · ${o.events} events · ${o.word}${at}` };
}

export const paperCellLine = (o: { board: string; i: number; n: number; stage: string; kind: 'review' | 'question' }): string =>
  `${o.board} · Stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}, ${o.stage} · ${o.kind === 'review' ? 'Awaiting your review' : 'A question'}`;
export const archivedLine = (o: { board: string; i: number; n: number; stage: string; owner: string }): string =>
  `${o.board} · Was at stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}, ${o.stage} · Owner ${o.owner}`;
export const restoreNote = (stage: string): string => `Back to the board at ${stage}.`;
export const doneLine = (o: { board: string; stage: string; priority: number; owner: string }): string =>
  `${o.board} · Stage ${o.stage} · Priority P${o.priority} · Owner ${o.owner}`;
export const doneStatus = (stateSince: string, attempts: number, now: string, tz?: string): string =>
  `${paperWhen(stateSince, now, tz)} · after ${attempts} attempt${s(attempts)}`;
export const digestPaper = (digest: string): string => `${digest.slice(0, 15)}…`;

/** Radio hints when the option has no description (API-4); X-11 fallback for approve. */
export const PAPER_HINT: Readonly<Record<OptionRole, string>> = { approve: 'Move the card on as it is.', changes: 'Needs a note; it threads into the next attempt.', reject: 'Stop here.' };
export const PAPER_CAPTIONS = { gate: 'With nothing picked: “Pick a decision first.”', question: 'With no answer: “Type an answer first.”' } as const;
export const PAPER_LABELS = ['A · Approval gate', 'B · Agent question', 'C · Archived', 'D · Done', 'E · Decision error', 'F · Loading'] as const;
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
```

```ts
const resolveGate = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());

afterEach(() => cleanup());
const CONFLICT = { error: { code: 'GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED', message: 'gate is already resolved', decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' } };
const props = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  boardId: 'brd_fa33a0a0721d4d18', gate: FAKE_GATE as never, error: null, onResponse: vi.fn(async () => false),
  agent: { id: 'agt_fx_research_ray', name: 'research-ray', iconUrl: null, mood: 'needs' as const },
  lead: { kind: 'review', needsYou: true, agentId: 'agt_fx_research_ray', sentence: 'All done, ready for your review.', source: 'gate', at: '2026-10-11T07:18:00Z' } as never,
  vibe: 'paper' as const, personName: 'Rakesh Gangwar', onRefresh: vi.fn(), ...over,
});

describe('GatePaper', () => {
  it('encloses the subject: rows, digest, seal; hints come from the option or Paper’s copy', () => {
    render(GatePaper, props({ caption: 'With nothing picked: “Pick a decision first.”' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'The approval subject' }).getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('0');
    expect(screen.getByText('Recommendation, one paragraph')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Organization plane cutover record, 7 Oct')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/digest sha256:9f3ac2e1…/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Approving exactly this version, sealed 9f3a·c2e1.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('File the recommendation as it is.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Needs a note; it threads into the next attempt.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Stop here.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Add a note (optional)').getAttribute('maxlength')).toBe('8192');
    expect(screen.getByText('0 / 8192')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('With nothing picked: “Pick a decision first.”')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('sending with nothing picked asks for a pick and sends nothing', async () => {
    resolveGate.mockReset();
    render(GatePaper, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send reply' }));
    expect(screen.getByText('Pick a decision first.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(resolveGate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('Request changes with no note marks the field and focuses it', async () => {
    resolveGate.mockReset();
    render(GatePaper, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: /^Request changes/ }));
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send reply' }));
    await tick();
    const field = screen.getByLabelText('Say what needs to change');
    expect(field.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(field);
    expect(screen.getByText('Request changes needs a note: it threads into the agent’s next attempt.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(resolveGate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('a 409 says who decided it where, and Refresh asks for the new state', async () => {
    resolveGate.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Response(JSON.stringify(CONFLICT), { status: 409 }));
    const p = props({ part: 'reply' });
    render(GatePaper, p);
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Add a note (optional)')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Stop here.')).toBeNull();
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Approve' }));
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send reply' }));
    const alert = await screen.findByRole('alert');
    expect(alert.textContent).toMatch(/^Not recorded\. This gate was already decided from Matrix by Rakesh Gangwar at \d\d:\d\d\. Refresh to see it$/);
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Refresh to see it' }));
    expect(p.onRefresh).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect((screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Approve' }) as HTMLInputElement).checked).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

In `card-paper.css` delete the rules for the board drawn behind the sheet (the canvas only): `.pp-front`, `.pp-front .mh`, `.pp-front h1`, `.pp-cols`, `.pp-cols p`, `.pp-scrim` (the scrim is the drawer shell's `--card-scrim`). Then append the hand-written delta:

```css
/* Hand-written (Task 25). The canvas root `.pp` is not ported; its descendant rules move onto the sheet. */
.pp-sheet *, .pp-sheet *::before, .pp-sheet *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.pp-sheet textarea.vk-field__input { min-height: 100px; padding: var(--vk-space-3) var(--vk-space-4); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; resize: vertical; }
/* The drawer shell's panel already has the sheet's width (CARD_LAYOUTS.paper.width). */
.pp-sheet { width: 100%; justify-self: auto; }
/* The reference's inline style on "Open in new window". */
.pp-open { width: auto; padding: 0 12px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--vk-color-text); }
.pp-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-3); }
.pp-eyebrow--quiet { color: var(--vk-color-muted); }
.pp-encs > .pp-sc { margin-bottom: var(--vk-space-2); }
.pp-p--brief { font: 400 1.1rem/1.6 var(--vk-font-display); }
.pp-two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--vk-space-5); }
.pp-two > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2); }
.pp-foot--split { justify-content: space-between; }
.pp-foot--split > span:last-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vk-space-4); }
.pp-small--flush { margin: 0; }
.pp-block { display: block; }
/* A link-styled button drawn exactly like the reference's inline <a>: the padding makes a 44px hit box,
   the equal negative margin takes it back out of the layout (inline or flex item alike). */
.pp-linkbtn { display: inline; padding: 14px 8px; margin: -14px -8px; border: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; color: var(--vk-color-text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; }
/* The gate, question and state blocks (ps-*) at letter size inside the sheet (pp-* sizes). */
.pp-sheet .ps-dear { font: italic 400 1.35rem/1.3 var(--vk-font-display); }
.pp-sheet .ps-voice { font: 400 1.22rem/1.6 var(--vk-font-display); }
.pp-sheet .ps-sign .n { font: italic 500 1.15rem/1.2 var(--vk-font-display); }
.pp-sheet .ps-h { font: italic 500 1.5rem/1.2 var(--vk-font-display); }
@container (max-width: 620px) { .pp-grid, .pp-two, .pp-groups { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.pp-sheet { container-type: inline-size; }
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/editors/RunEvents.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import { isNarrative } from '$lib/activity-groups';
  import type { CardModel } from '../card-model.svelte';
  import './editors.css';
  /** One run's rows: what the agent said, or every tool call too when the person asks (G-5 verbs). */
  let { model, runId, time }: { model: CardModel; runId: string; time: (iso: string) => string } = $props();
  const group = $derived(model.activityGroups.find((g) => g.runId === runId));
  const rows = $derived((group?.activities ?? []).filter((a) => model.showToolCalls || isNarrative(a)));
  const TYPE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { action: 'Did', response: 'Said', thought: 'Thought', prompt: 'You said', elicitation: 'Asked' };
  const verb = (a: { type: string; action: string | null; signal: string | null }) => (a.type === 'error' || a.signal === 'stop' ? 'Stopped' : (a.action ?? TYPE_WORD[a.type] ?? a.type));
</script>

<ul class="card-events">
  {#each rows as a (a.seq)}<li><time datetime={a.ts}>{time(a.ts)}</time><p><b>{verb(a)}</b> {a.body ?? ''}</p></li>{/each}
</ul>
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Rewrite `GatePaper.svelte` and `QuestionPaper.svelte`**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/GatePaper.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Paper's gate: the agent's letter, the enclosed subject, the seal and the reply (P.5). Renders
   * siblings of the sheet it sits in, so the sheet's gap spaces them. `part="reply"`: the radios and
   * the send row alone (gallery cell E).
   */
  import { Face, type Mood, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { Gate, GateDecision } from '$lib/api';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import type { CardLead } from '../card-lead';
  import CardIcon from '../CardIcon.svelte';
  import { conflictSentence, faceLabel, firstName, subjectRows } from '../card-format';
  import { PAPER_HINT, digestPaper, paperWhen } from '../paper/paper-words';
  import { rawJson } from '../spec-details';
  import { GateConflictWatch } from './gate-conflict.svelte';
  import { GATE_NOTE_MAX, GateDecisionModel, roleOf, sealOf } from './gate-decision.svelte';
  import '../paper/card-states-paper.css';

  let { boardId, gate, error, onResponse, agent, lead, personName = 'there', part = 'all', caption = null, onRefresh = () => {} }: {
    boardId: string; gate: Gate; error: string | null;
    onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>;
    agent: { id: string | null; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood };
    lead: CardLead | null; vibe: Vibe; personName?: string; part?: 'all' | 'reply'; caption?: string | null;
    onRefresh?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  } = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  const watch = new GateConflictWatch();
  const model = new GateDecisionModel(() => ({ boardId, gate, onResponse: watch.wrap(onResponse) }));
  $effect(() => model.follow(gate.id));
  const subject = $derived(gate.approvalSubject);
  const who = $derived(watch.conflict ? displayPrincipal(watch.conflict.decidedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  let rawOpen = $state(false);
  let copied = $state(false);
  async function copyDigest(): Promise<void> {
    if (!subject) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(subject.digest);
      copied = true;
      setTimeout(() => (copied = false), 2000);
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
  }
  const sendLabel = $derived(model.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send reply');
</script>

{#if part === 'all'}
  <p class="ps-dear">Dear {firstName(personName)},</p>
  <p class="ps-voice">{gate.summary ?? lead?.sentence ?? 'Ready for your review.'}</p>
  <div class="ps-sign"><Face id={agent.id ?? agent.name} label={faceLabel(agent.name, 'needs')} mood="needs" size={32} /><div><span class="n">{agent.name}</span>{#if lead?.at}<p class="ps-small">{paperWhen(lead.at, new Date().toISOString())}</p>{/if}</div></div>
  {#if subject}
    <details class="ps-enc" open>
      <summary><span class="t">Enclosed: the approval subject</span><span class="ps-small">· revision {subject.revision}</span></summary>
      <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex: a scrolling region must be reachable by keyboard -->
      <div class="ps-encbody" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="The approval subject">
        <dl class="ps-dl">{#each subjectRows(subject.canonical) as r (r.key)}<div><dt>{r.label}</dt><dd>{r.value}</dd></div>{/each}</dl>
        <span class="ps-mono">digest {digestPaper(subject.digest)} · <button type="button" class="ps-link ps-linkbtn" aria-label="Copy the full digest" onclick={copyDigest}>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button> · <button type="button" class="ps-link ps-linkbtn" aria-expanded={rawOpen} onclick={() => (rawOpen = !rawOpen)}>{rawOpen ? 'Hide raw JSON' : 'View raw JSON'}</button></span>
        {#if rawOpen}<pre class="ps-mono">{rawJson(subject.canonical)}</pre>{/if}
      </div>
    </details>
    <p class="ps-seal"><CardIcon name="seal" size={16} /> Approving exactly this version, sealed {sealOf(subject.digest)}.</p>
  {/if}
{/if}
<form class="ps-reply" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.submit(); }}>
  <h3 class="ps-h">Your reply</h3>
  <fieldset class="ps-choices">
    <legend>Your decision</legend>
    {#each model.options as opt (opt.name)}
      <label class="ps-choice"><input type="radio" name="{uid}-decision" value={opt.name} bind:group={model.selected} /><span><b>{opt.title}</b>{#if part === 'all'}<span class="ps-small">{opt.description ?? PAPER_HINT[roleOf(opt.name)!]}</span>{/if}</span></label>
    {/each}
  </fieldset>
  {#if model.needPick}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">Pick a decision first.</p>{/if}
  {#if part === 'all'}
    <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined}>
      <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-note">{model.needNote ? 'Say what needs to change' : 'Add a note (optional)'}</label>
      <textarea id="{uid}-note" class="vk-field__input" bind:this={model.noteEl} bind:value={model.note} maxlength={GATE_NOTE_MAX} placeholder="Recorded with your decision." aria-invalid={model.needNote} aria-describedby={model.needNote ? `${uid}-note-e` : undefined}></textarea>
      {#if model.needNote}<p id="{uid}-note-e" class="vk-field__error">Request changes needs a note: it threads into the agent’s next attempt.</p>{/if}
      <span class="ps-count">{model.note.length} / {GATE_NOTE_MAX}</span>
    </div>
  {/if}
  {#if watch.conflict || error}
    <div class="ps-row ps-row--alert">
      <button class="vk-button" type="submit" disabled={model.busy}>{sendLabel}</button>
      <div class="ps-alert" role="alert"><CardIcon name="alert" size={16} /><div>{#if watch.conflict}<b>Not recorded.</b> {conflictSentence(watch.conflict, who)} <button type="button" class="ps-link ps-linkbtn" onclick={() => void onRefresh()}>Refresh to see it</button>{:else}{error}{/if}</div></div>
    </div>
  {:else}
    <div class="ps-row"><button class="vk-button" type="submit" disabled={model.busy}>{sendLabel}</button>{#if caption}<span class="ps-small">{caption}</span>{/if}</div>
  {/if}
</form>
```

```svelte
  /** Paper's question: the agent's letter and a reply box that goes straight back (P.5). Siblings of the sheet. */
  import { Face, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';

  } = $props();

</form>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/CardPaper.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Paper's card: a letter on a centred sheet (SP-Card-Paper, P.3). The reply comes before the
   * enclosures; the gate, the question and the archived/done/loading blocks take the letter's place.
   */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { dayMonth } from '$lib/when';
  import CardIcon from '../CardIcon.svelte';
  import {
    attemptWord, briefValue, faceLabel, firstName, grantCovers, handoffFallback, handoffText, hhmm, idTokens, linkRows, refSourceLine, relatedState, splitShowMore,
  } from '../card-format';
  import CardEditForm from '../editors/CardEditForm.svelte';
  import CommentThread from '../editors/CommentThread.svelte';
  import LinkAdder from '../editors/LinkAdder.svelte';
  import ProjectPicker from '../editors/ProjectPicker.svelte';
  import ReferenceAdder from '../editors/ReferenceAdder.svelte';
  import RunEvents from '../editors/RunEvents.svelte';
  import SubtaskAdder from '../editors/SubtaskAdder.svelte';
  import GatePaper from '../gate/GatePaper.svelte';
  import QuestionPaper from '../question/QuestionPaper.svelte';
  import { rawJson } from '../spec-details';
  import { specGroups } from '../spec-groups';
  import CardStatePaper from '../state/CardStatePaper.svelte';
  import {
    PAPER_KICKER, attachedSummary, briefSummary, correspondenceSummary, happenedSummary, paperAttemptLine, paperBack, paperProvenance,
    paperStateWord, paperWhen, reTitle, replySub, restoreNote, resumeOptionLabel, signatureLine, waitingSummary,
  } from '../paper/paper-words';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import '../paper/card-paper.css';

  let { model, phase, personName, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();
  const uid = $props.id();
  const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

  const card = $derived(model.card);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead);
  const needs = $derived(!!lead?.needsYou && !model.archived);
  const done = $derived(lead?.kind === 'done');
  const owner = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const queuedByName = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.queuedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const role = $derived(app.agents.find((a) => a.id === model.agent.id)?.role ?? null);
  const lastAgentId = $derived(model.attempts.at(-1)?.agentId ?? null);
  const next = $derived(model.stages[model.stageIndex + 1]?.name ?? null);
  const showResume = $derived(!!card && !model.archived && !gate && !question && card.state === 'input-required' && ['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead?.kind ?? ''));
  const groups = $derived(card ? specGroups(card.spec) : []);
  const detailRows = $derived(groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0));
  const description = $derived(typeof card?.spec?.description === 'string' ? card.spec.description : null);
  const handoff = $derived(handoffText(model.handoff) ?? (card ? handoffFallback(model.stages[model.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? null, queuedByName, card.createdAt) : ''));
  const links = $derived(linkRows(model.linkGroups));
  const related = $derived(relatedState(model.related));
  const newestFirst = $derived(model.attempts.map((a, i) => ({ a, n: i + 1 })).reverse());
  const eventsOf = (runId: string) => model.activityGroups.find((g) => g.runId === runId)?.counts.total ?? 0;

  let open = $state({ brief: true, happened: false, waiting: false, attached: false, letters: true });
  let expanded = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  let rawOpen = $state(false);

  function back(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onClose();
  }
  function postOnShortcut(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void model.comments.submit(); }
  }
  const refresh = async () => { await model.refresh(); await app.refresh(); };
</script>

{#if card}
<article class="pp-sheet">
  <div class="pp-top">
    <a class="pp-back" href="/b/{model.boardId}" onclick={back}><CardIcon name="back" /> {paperBack(model.boardName, phase)}</a>
    <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
      <a class="pp-icon pp-open" href={pageHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Open in new window"><CardIcon name="external" /><span>Open in new window</span></a>
      <button class="pp-icon" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" onclick={onClose}><CardIcon name="close" size={20} /></button>
    </span>
  </div>

  {#if model.archived}<CardStatePaper kind="archived" {model} />{/if}

  <div class="pp-head">
    {#if needs}<span class="pp-eyebrow"><span class="pp-dot"></span>{PAPER_KICKER}</span>
    {:else if model.archived && card.archivedAt}<span class="pp-eyebrow pp-eyebrow--quiet">Archived on {dayMonth(card.archivedAt)}</span>{/if}
    <h2 id="drawer-title" class="pp-title">{reTitle(card.title, !!gate)}</h2>
    <div>
      <p class="pp-line" data-section="status">
        <span class={needs ? 'sig' : undefined}>{paperStateWord({ archived: model.archived, needsYou: !!lead?.needsYou, state: card.state, ageHours: model.ageHours })}</span>
        <span>Stage <b>{model.stageIndex + 1} of {model.stages.length}, {model.stageName}</b></span>
        {#if next}<span>Next: {next}</span>{/if}
        {#if card.attemptCount > 0}<span>Attempt <b>{card.attemptCount}</b></span>{/if}
      </p>
      <p class="pp-line" data-section="facts">
        <span>Owner <b>{owner}</b></span>
        {#if card.queuedBy}<span>Asked by <b>{queuedByName}</b>{card.queuedByAgentId ? ', an agent' : ''}</span>{/if}
        {#if card.delegateAgentId}<span><b>{model.delegate.name}</b> working it</span>{:else}<span><b>Unclaimed</b></span>{/if}
        <span>Priority <b>P{card.priority}</b></span>
        {#if card.dueAt}<span>Due <b>{dayMonth(card.dueAt)}</b></span>{:else}<span>No due date</span>{/if}
        {#if model.labels.length > 0}<span>Labels <b>{model.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ')}</b></span>{:else}<span>No labels</span>{/if}
        <span class="pp-meta">card {model.shortId}<button class="pp-copy" type="button" aria-label="Copy card id {model.shortId}" onclick={() => void model.copyId()}><CardIcon name={model.copied === 'id' ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} /></button></span>
        {#if card.ownerUserId !== app.user?.userId}<button class="pp-more" type="button" disabled={model.assigning} onclick={() => void model.assignToMe()}>Assign to me</button>{/if}
      </p>
    </div>
    <div data-section="editForm" hidden={!model.edit.editing}>{#if model.edit.editing}<CardEditForm {model} />{/if}</div>
  </div>

  <hr class="pp-rule" />
  <div data-section="error" hidden={!model.localError}>{#if model.localError}<p class="pp-small" role="alert">{model.localError}</p>{/if}</div>

  {#if !model.detailLoaded}
    <CardStatePaper kind="loading" {model} />
  {:else if gate}
    <GatePaper {...gate} agent={model.agent} {lead} vibe="paper" {personName} onRefresh={refresh} />
  {:else if question}
    <QuestionPaper model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} vibe="paper" {personName} />
  {:else}
    {#if done}<CardStatePaper kind="done" {model} />{/if}
    {@const words = done ? (handoffText(model.handoff) ?? '') : (lead?.sentence ?? card.needsHuman?.detail ?? '')}
    {#if words}
      <div class="pp-letter">
        <p class="pp-dear">Dear {firstName(personName)},</p>
        <p class="pp-voice">{#each idTokens(words) as t, i (i)}{#if t.id}<span class="pp-id">{t.text}</span>{:else}{t.text}{/if}{/each}</p>
        <div class="pp-sign">
          <Face id={model.agent.id ?? model.agent.name} label={faceLabel(model.agent.name, model.agent.mood)} mood={model.agent.mood} size={36} />
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;"><span class="n">{model.agent.name}</span><span class="r">{signatureLine(role, card.attemptCount, lead?.at ? paperWhen(lead.at, now()) : null)}</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}
  {/if}

  {#if showResume}
    <form class="pp-reply" aria-labelledby="{uid}-reply-h" data-section="resume" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.resume.submit(); }}>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;">
        <h3 id="{uid}-reply-h" class="pp-h">Your reply</h3>
        <p class="pp-small pp-small--flush">{replySub(card.attemptCount)}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pp-grid">
        <div class="vk-field">
          <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-at">Resume at stage</label>
          <select id="{uid}-at" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={model.resume.target}>
            {#each model.resume.targets.filter((t) => t.allowed) as t (t.key)}<option value={t.key}>{resumeOptionLabel(t)}</option>{/each}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={model.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
          <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
          <textarea id="{uid}-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" bind:this={model.resume.noteEl} bind:value={model.resume.note} aria-invalid={!!model.resume.error} aria-describedby="{uid}-note-hint" placeholder="For example: what you checked, and what the agent should look at next."></textarea>
          {#if model.resume.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{model.resume.error}</p>{/if}
          <p id="{uid}-note-hint" class="vk-field__hint">Needed before you send. {model.resume.note.length} / 8000</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pp-foot">
        <button class="vk-button" type="submit" disabled={model.resume.busy}>{model.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button>
        <span class="pp-small">With no note: “Add a note for {model.agent.name} first.”</span>
      </div>
    </form>
  {:else}
    <div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
  {/if}

  {#if model.archived}
    <div class="pp-foot">

      <span class="pp-small">{restoreNote(model.stageName)}</span>

      <div class="pp-encbody">

            {#if model.acceptanceCriteria?.length}<ul class="pp-ul">{#each model.acceptanceCriteria as c, i (i)}<li>{c}</li>{/each}</ul>{:else}<p class="pp-small pp-small--flush">Nothing listed to prove.</p>{/if}
          </div>
          <div data-section="plan"><p class="pp-sc">Plan</p><p class="pp-small pp-small--flush">{model.agent.name} did not post a plan for this card.</p></div>

                  {:else}{@const sm = splitShowMore(v.text)}{sm.shown}{#if sm.more}{#if expanded[r.key]}{' '}{sm.more}{/if} <button class="pp-more" type="button" aria-expanded={!!expanded[r.key]} onclick={() => (expanded[r.key] = !expanded[r.key])}>{expanded[r.key] ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}</button>{/if}{/if}
                </dd></div>
              {/each}
            </dl></div>
          {/each}
        </div>
        <div class="pp-foot pp-foot--split">
          <span class="pp-small" data-section="project">{#if model.projectName}Project: {model.projectName} · {model.milestoneName ?? 'no milestone'} · <button class="pp-link pp-linkbtn" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>{:else}No project. <button class="pp-link pp-linkbtn" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}</span>
          <span><button class="pp-link pp-small pp-linkbtn" type="button" aria-expanded={rawOpen} onclick={() => (rawOpen = !rawOpen)}>{rawOpen ? 'Hide raw JSON' : 'View raw JSON'}</button><button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" style="font-size: var(--vk-text-sm);" onclick={() => void navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawJson(card.spec))}><CardIcon name="copy" /> Copy</button></span>
        </div>

      <div class="pp-encbody">

        <div data-section="attempts">

            <p class="pp-p"><b>{line.head}</b>{line.rest}</p>
```
