        </div>
        <p class="pp-small pp-small--flush" data-section="decisions">{model.decidedGates.length === 0 ? 'Decisions: none yet.' : model.decidedGates.map((g) => `${g.decision ?? g.status} by ${displayPrincipal(g.decidedBy, app.members, app.agents)}`).join(' · ')}</p>
        <p class="pp-small pp-small--flush" data-section="cost">Cost ${card.costUsd.toFixed(2)}, {model.estimate?.estimatedUsd ? `of an estimated $${model.estimate.estimatedUsd.toFixed(2)}` : 'no estimate yet'}.</p>

'Removing…' : 'Remove'}</button></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={() => model.links.openAdd()}>Add link</button>

        </div>

          {:else}<ul class="pp-ul">{#each model.children as c (c.id)}<li><a class="pp-link" href="/b/{model.boardId}/c/{c.id}">{c.title}</a></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
          <SubtaskAdder {model} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>

    <details class="pp-enc" bind:open={open.attached}>
      <summary><span class="t">Attached</span><span class="c">{attachedSummary({ refs: model.refs.length, related: related.items.length, delivery: model.counts.deliveryActive })}</span><span class="o" aria-hidden="true">{open.attached ? 'Close' : 'Open'}</span></summary>
      <div class="pp-encbody">

            <li data-section="related">{#if related.sentence}{related.sentence}{:else}{#each related.items as it (it.itemId)}<a class="pp-link" href={it.url}>{it.title || it.itemId}</a> {/each}{/if}</li>

          </div>
        {:else}<div data-section="delivery" hidden></div>{/if}

    </details>

      <div class="pp-encbody" data-section="comments">

The agent reads it.</label><textarea id="{uid}-comment" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8192" placeholder="⌘ or Ctrl + Enter posts it" bind:value={model.comments.draft} onkeydown={postOnShortcut}></textarea></div>
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" disabled={model.comments.posting} onclick={() => void model.comments.submit()}>{model.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>
  {:else}
    {#each ['description', 'criteria', 'plan', 'details', 'project', 'handoff', 'attempts', 'activity', 'decisions', 'cost', 'links', 'subtasks', 'references', 'related', 'delivery', 'comments'] as k (k)}<div data-section={k} hidden></div>{/each}
  {/if}

  <div class="pp-foot" data-section="cardActions">
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" data-section="editButton" onclick={() => model.edit.start()}><CardIcon name="edit" size={18} /> Edit card</button>
    {#if !model.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} onclick={() => void model.archive()}><CardIcon name="archive" size={18} /> {model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
    <button class="vk-button pp-danger" type="button" onclick={() => void model.remove()}>Delete card</button>
  </div>
</article>
{/if}
```

The identity value links to its card on the board the spec names (`board`), else on this board. While the detail loads, the `{:else}` branch keeps one hidden element per section, so the parity test holds in every state.

    expect(eventVerbStudio(act({ type: 'response', signal: 'stop' }))).toBe('Stopped');
    expect(eventVerbStudio(act({ type: 'response', action: 'Sent back' }))).toBe('Sent back');
    expect(eventVerbStudio(act({ type: 'action' }))).toBe('Action');
  });
  it('tab counts', () => {
    expect(tabCounts({ rows: 10, runs: 2, links: 0, subtasks: 0, refs: 5, comments: 0, costUsd: 0 }).map((t) => `${t.label} ${t.count}`)).toEqual(['Spec 10', 'Log 2', 'Links 5', 'Talk 0', 'Cost $0.00']);
  });
  it('gallery copy', () => {
    expect(studioConflict({ decidedBy: 'usr_b19776fac3c94df4', decidedAt: '2026-10-11T07:32:00Z', via: 'matrix' }, 'Rakesh Gangwar', TZ)).toBe('Already decided from Matrix by Rakesh Gangwar at 13:02.');
    expect(archivedBanner('2026-10-09T05:30:00Z', TZ)).toBe('Archived 9 Oct');
    expect(restoreHint(2, 'Messaging approval')).toBe('Returns it to 03 Messaging approval.');
    expect(STUDIO_LABELS).toEqual([['A', 'Approval gate'], ['B', 'Agent question'], ['C', 'Archived'], ['D', 'Done'], ['E', 'Decision error'], ['F', 'Loading']]);
    expect(STUDIO_NOTE_1).toBe('The full digest is copied by the button beside it; only its first eight characters are shown, and the seal repeats them.');
  });
});

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/studio/studio-format.ts
/** Studio's ("Annual report") card copy and figures (30-studio.md §3, corrected). Pure. */
import type { Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { Activity, GateConflict } from '$lib/api';
import type { LeadKind } from '../card-lead';
import { VIA_WORD, capFirst, dateParts, hhmm, sameLocalDay, type AttemptWord } from '../card-format';

export const stageNo = (i: number): string => String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
export const studioOption = (t: { n: number; name: string; current: boolean }, form: 'desktop' | 'phone'): string =>
  form === 'desktop' ? `${String(t.n).padStart(2, '0')} ${t.name}${t.current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}` : `${t.n} · ${t.name}${t.current ? ' (where it stopped)' : ''}`;

export function figAge(hours: number): { value: string; unit: string } {
  if (hours >= 48) {
    const n = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    return { value: String(n), unit: n === 1 ? 'day' : 'days' };
  }
  return { value: String(Math.floor(hours)), unit: 'h' };
}

export function quoteWhen(iso: string, now: string, tz?: string, padDay = false): string {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  if (sameLocalDay(iso, now, tz)) return `${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
  return `${d.weekdayShort} ${padDay ? String(d.day).padStart(2, '0') : d.day} ${d.monthShort} ${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
}
export const runEnded = (iso: string, tz?: string): string => {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return `${d.monthShort} ${d.day} ${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
};
export const PHASE_WORD: Readonly<Record<Phase, string>> = { dawn: 'dawn', morning: 'morning', noon: 'midday', golden: 'afternoon', dusk: 'evening', night: 'night' };
export function studioClock(now: string, phase: Phase, tz?: string): { text: string; aria: string; phoneAria: string } {
  const t = hhmm(now, tz);
  return { text: `${t} · ${PHASE_WORD[phase]}`, aria: `Local time ${t}, ${PHASE_WORD[phase]}`, phoneAria: `${t}, ${PHASE_WORD[phase]}` };
}
export const usd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
export const usdShort = (n: number): string => (Number.isInteger(n) ? `$${n}` : usd(n));
export const shortDigest = (d: string): string => `sha256:${d.slice(d.indexOf(':') + 1).slice(0, 8)}…`;
export function finishedFig(iso: string, tz?: string): { value: string; label: string } {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return { value: `${d.monthShort} ${d.day}`, label: `Finished ${d.hh}:${d.mm}` };
}

export function stageSuffix(kind: LeadKind | null | undefined): string {
  if (kind === 'stopped' || kind === 'failed' || kind === 'budget') return ' · stopped';
  if (kind === 'review') return ' · review';
  if (kind === 'question') return ' · question';
  return '';
}
const STATUS_WORD: Partial<Record<LeadKind, string>> = { stopped: 'stopped', failed: 'stopped', budget: 'stopped', review: 'awaiting review', question: 'question pending', working: 'working', done: 'done' };
export function trackAria(o: { form: 'drawer' | 'cell' | 'phone'; i: number; n: number; name: string; kind: LeadKind | null | undefined; archived: boolean }): string {
  if (o.archived) return `Was at stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}, ${o.name}`;
  const word = (o.kind && STATUS_WORD[o.kind]) ?? 'queued';
  return o.form === 'drawer' ? `Stages: stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}, ${o.name}, ${word}` : `Stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}, ${o.name}, ${word}`;
}
export function quoteHeader(who: string, kind: LeadKind | null | undefined, form: 'desktop' | 'phone'): string {
  if (kind === 'stopped' || kind === 'failed' || kind === 'budget') return `${who} · Stopped · ${form === 'desktop' ? 'needs you' : 'needs decision'}`;
  if (kind === 'review') return `${who} · awaiting review`;
  if (kind === 'question') return `${who} · question pending`;
  if (kind === 'done') return `${who} · finished it`;
  return who;
}
export const studioKicker = (o: { board: string; i: number; stage: string }): string => `${o.board} · stage ${stageNo(o.i)} ${o.stage}`;
export const costFigLabel = (est: { estimatedUsd?: number | null } | null | undefined): string => (est?.estimatedUsd ? `Cost · of ${usd(est.estimatedUsd)}` : 'Cost · no estimate');
export function whereWord(url: string, forgeHost?: string): string {
  try {
    const h = new URL(url).hostname;
    return forgeHost && h === forgeHost ? 'Forge' : h === 'github.com' ? 'GitHub' : h;
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}
export function studioProvenance(o: { queuedByName: string; byAgent: boolean; grant: 'covers' | 'excludes' | 'none'; unclaimed: boolean }): string {
  const phrase = o.grant === 'covers' ? 'allowed to dispatch the one working it' : o.grant === 'excludes' ? 'not allowed to dispatch the one working it' : 'with no recorded dispatch authority';
  return `Asked by ${o.queuedByName}, ${o.byAgent ? 'an agent' : 'a person'} ${phrase}.${o.unclaimed ? ' Unclaimed now.' : ''}`;
}
export const noteHint = (len: number, who?: string): string =>
  `${len === 0 ? 'Note needed · 0/8000' : `${len}/8000`}${who ? ` · with no note: “Add a note for ${who} first.”` : ''}`;
export const outcomeWordStudio = (w: AttemptWord): string => capFirst(w);
const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { action: 'Action', response: 'Response', thought: 'Thought', prompt: 'You', elicitation: 'Question' };
export const eventVerbStudio = (a: Activity): string => (a.type === 'error' || a.signal === 'stop' ? 'Stopped' : (a.action ?? TYPE_LABEL[a.type] ?? a.type));
export type StudioTab = 'spec' | 'log' | 'links' | 'talk' | 'cost';
export function tabCounts(o: { rows: number; runs: number; links: number; subtasks: number; refs: number; comments: number; costUsd: number }): Array<{ id: StudioTab; label: string; count: string }> {
  return [
    { id: 'spec', label: 'Spec', count: String(o.rows) },
    { id: 'log', label: 'Log', count: String(o.runs) },
    { id: 'links', label: 'Links', count: String(o.links + o.subtasks + o.refs) },
    { id: 'talk', label: 'Talk', count: String(o.comments) },
    { id: 'cost', label: 'Cost', count: usd(o.costUsd) },
  ];
}
export const studioConflict = (c: GateConflict, who: string, tz?: string): string => `Already decided from ${VIA_WORD[c.via]} by ${who} at ${hhmm(c.decidedAt, tz)}.`;
export const archivedBanner = (iso: string, tz?: string): string => {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return `Archived ${d.day} ${d.monthShort}`;
};
export const restoreHint = (i: number, stage: string): string => `Returns it to ${stageNo(i)} ${stage}.`;
export const STUDIO_LABELS = [['A', 'Approval gate'], ['B', 'Agent question'], ['C', 'Archived'], ['D', 'Done'], ['E', 'Decision error'], ['F', 'Loading']] as const;
export const STUDIO_NOTE_1 = 'The full digest is copied by the button beside it; only its first eight characters are shown, and the seal repeats them.';
```

// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/CardStudio.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import { fakeCardModel } from './fake-card-model';

vi.mock('$lib/stores/app.svelte', async () => ({ app: (await import('./fake-card-model')).APP_MOCK }));
import CardStudio from './CardStudio.svelte';
import { CARD_SECTION_KEYS } from './types';

afterEach(() => cleanup());
const props = (model = fakeCardModel(), over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  model, vibe: 'studio' as const, phase: 'noon' as const, personName: 'Rakesh Gangwar', gate: null, question: null,
  pageHref: '/b/brd_134a0ddb6d434478/c/card_05823a57e8224605/page', onClose: vi.fn(), ...over,
});

describe('CardStudio (SP-Card-Studio)', () => {
  it('the bar: crumb that closes, card id copy, clock, Open, Close', async () => {
    const p = props();
    render(CardStudio, p);
    const crumb = screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Developer Experience' });
    const ev = new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 });
    crumb.dispatchEvent(ev);
    expect(ev.defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    expect(p.onClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copy card id 4605' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Local time \d\d:\d\d, midday$/)).toBeTruthy();
    const open = screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open in new window, Shift O' });
    expect([open.getAttribute('href'), open.getAttribute('target'), open.getAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts')]).toEqual([p.pageHref, '_blank', 'Shift+O']);
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close (Esc)' }));
    expect(p.onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('figures, track and who-and-what read the fixture card', () => {
    const { container } = render(CardStudio, props());
    expect([...container.querySelectorAll('.ar-figs > div > span')].map((e) => e.textContent)).toEqual(['Stage', 'Attempts', 'Waiting on you', 'Cost · no estimate', 'Blocks', 'Sub-tasks open']);
    expect(container.querySelector('.ar-figs .sig b')!.textContent).toBe('2days');
    expect(screen.getByRole('list', { name: 'Stages: stage 2 of 7, Reproduce, stopped' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('02 Reproduce · stopped')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('(error-eric ran attempt 2)')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Developer Experience · stage 02 Reproduce')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('tabs: roving focus with arrows, names carry counts, and every section exists once across the tabs', async () => {
    const { container } = render(CardStudio, props());
    const names = screen.getAllByRole('tab').map((t) => t.textContent!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim());
    expect(names).toEqual(['Spec 3', 'Log 2', 'Links 1', 'Talk 0', 'Cost $0.00']);
    const PANEL = new Set(['description', 'plan', 'criteria', 'details', 'project', 'activity', 'decisions', 'handoff', 'links', 'subtasks', 'related', 'references', 'comments', 'cost', 'attempts', 'delivery']);
    const seen = new Map<string, number>();
    const tally = (panelOnly: boolean) => {
      for (const el of container.querySelectorAll('[data-section]')) {
        const k = el.getAttribute('data-section')!;
        if (PANEL.has(k) === panelOnly) seen.set(k, (seen.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
      }
    };
    tally(false); // everything outside the tab panel, once
    for (const name of ['Spec', 'Log', 'Links', 'Talk', 'Cost']) {
      await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: new RegExp(`^${name}`) }));
      tally(true); // the panel keys of each tab in turn
    }
    for (const k of CARD_SECTION_KEYS) expect(seen.get(k), k).toBe(1);
    const spec = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Spec/ });
    spec.focus();
    await fireEvent.click(spec);
    await fireEvent.keyDown(spec, { key: 'ArrowRight' });
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Log/ }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Log/ }).getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('true');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'ArrowLeft' });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'ArrowLeft' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Cost/ }).getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('true');
  });

  it('Log shows the runs newest first with derived outcomes', async () => {
    render(CardStudio, props());
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Log/ }));
    const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-section="activity"] table')[0]!.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((r) => [...r.querySelectorAll('td')].slice(2, 6).map((td) => td.textContent));
    expect(rows).toEqual([['Stopped', '2', '14', '0'], ['Sent back', '1', '9', '0']]);
    expect(screen.getByText('Asked by super-chotu, an agent allowed to dispatch the one working it. Unclaimed now.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Blocked. Waiting on you; the reason is shown at the top of this card.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('Shift+O opens the page and E starts editing; typing in a field does neither', async () => {
    const model = fakeCardModel();
    const open = vi.spyOn(window, 'open').mockReturnValue(null);
    const { container } = render(CardStudio, props(model));
    const root = container.querySelector('.cw-drawer')!;
    await fireEvent.keyDown(root, { key: 'O', shiftKey: true });
    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/b/brd_134a0ddb6d434478/c/card_05823a57e8224605/page', '_blank', 'noopener');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(root, { key: 'e' });
    expect(model.edit.start).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByLabelText(/^Note to error-eric/), { key: 'e' });
    expect(model.edit.start).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    open.mockRestore();
  });

  it('an empty note still submits, so the model can say what is missing', async () => {
    const model = fakeCardModel();
    render(CardStudio, props(model));
    expect(screen.getByText('Note needed · 0/8000')).toBeTruthy();
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Send back to work/ }));
    expect(model.resume.submit).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

        <tr><th scope="row">Digest</th><td><span class="mono">{shortDigest(subject.digest)}</span><sup class="fn">{footnote}</sup> <button class="ar-lk" type="button" aria-label="Copy the full digest" onclick={copy}><CardIcon name="copy-square" size={14} stroke={1.75} />{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button></td></tr>

'Hide raw JSON' : 'View raw JSON'}</button></div>

The `serif` class marks the long prose value (Synthesis); the reference draws only that row in Newsreader, and the rule "a subject value over 120 characters is prose" reproduces it from data rather than from the key name.

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/GateStudioBar.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Studio's decision bar (`.ss-cmd`): the note, one button per option, and the alert beside them.
   * Key hints and A/C shortcuts only when the host wires `registerKeys` (the drawer and cell A, not cell E).
   */
  import type { Gate, GateDecision } from '$lib/api';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import CardIcon from '../CardIcon.svelte';
  import { studioConflict } from '../studio/studio-format';
  import { GateConflictWatch } from './gate-conflict.svelte';
  import { GATE_NOTE_MAX, GateDecisionModel, roleOf } from './gate-decision.svelte';
  import '../studio/card-studio.css';
  import '../studio/card-states-studio.css';

  let { boardId, gate, error, onResponse, registerKeys, onRefresh = () => {} }: {
    boardId: string; gate: Gate; error: string | null;
    onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>;
    registerKeys?: (h: (e: KeyboardEvent) => boolean) => void; onRefresh?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  } = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  const watch = new GateConflictWatch();
  const model = new GateDecisionModel(() => ({ boardId, gate, onResponse: watch.wrap(onResponse) }));
  $effect(() => model.follow(gate.id));
  const keys = $derived(!!registerKeys);
  const who = $derived(watch.conflict ? displayPrincipal(watch.conflict.decidedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const KEY = { approve: 'A', changes: 'C' } as const;
  const CLS = { approve: 'ar-btn', changes: 'ar-btn2', reject: 'ar-lk quiet' } as const;
  $effect(() => {
    registerKeys?.((e) => {
      const role = e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a' ? 'approve' : e.key.toLowerCase() === 'c' ? 'changes' : null;
      const opt = role && model.options.find((o) => roleOf(o.name) === role);
      if (!opt) return false;
      void model.decide(opt.name);
      return true;
    });
  });
</script>

<div class="ss-cmd">
  <div class="ar-field" class:ss-field-bad={model.needNote}>
    <label for="{uid}-note">{#if model.needNote}Say what needs to change{:else}Add a note (optional) <span class="ar-hint">· {model.note.length}/{GATE_NOTE_MAX}</span>{/if}</label>
    <textarea id="{uid}-note" class="ar-ta" bind:this={model.noteEl} bind:value={model.note} maxlength={GATE_NOTE_MAX} aria-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined} aria-describedby={model.needNote ? `${uid}-e` : undefined} placeholder={model.needNote ? undefined : 'Recorded with your decision. Request changes needs one.'}></textarea>
    {#if model.needNote}<p id="{uid}-e" class="ss-err"><CardIcon name="alert" size={15} stroke={1.75} />Request changes needs a note.</p>{/if}
  </div>
  <div class="ss-row">
    {#each model.options as opt (opt.name)}
      {@const role = roleOf(opt.name)!}
      <button class={CLS[role]} type="button" disabled={model.busy} aria-keyshortcuts={keys && role !== 'reject' ? KEY[role] : undefined} onclick={() => void model.decide(opt.name)}>{opt.title}{#if keys && role !== 'reject'} <span class="kbd" aria-hidden="true">{KEY[role]}</span>{/if}</button>
    {/each}
    {#if watch.conflict}
      <div class="ss-alert" role="alert"><CardIcon name="alert" size={18} stroke={1.75} /><div><b>Not recorded.</b> {studioConflict(watch.conflict, who)} <button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => void onRefresh()}>Refresh</button></div></div>
    {:else if error}
      <div class="ss-alert" role="alert"><CardIcon name="alert" size={18} stroke={1.75} /><div>{error}</div></div>
    {/if}
  </div>
</div>
```

The reference draws `Refresh` as a link; it is a button here because it acts, and the `.ss-alert .ar-lk { min-height: 0 }` delta keeps its line box.

  const nameOf = (id: string | null) => app.agents.find((a) => a.id === id)?.name ?? id ?? '';
  const stageNameOf = (key: string) => model.stages.find((st) => st.key === key)?.name ?? key;
  const runs = $derived(model.attempts.map((a, i) => ({ a, n: i + 1 })).reverse());
  const counts = (runId: string) => model.activityGroups.find((g) => g.runId === runId)?.counts ?? { total: 0, error: 0 };
  const latest = $derived(runs[0] ? model.activityGroups.find((g) => g.runId === runs[0]!.a.runId) : undefined);
  const latestRows = $derived((latest?.activities ?? []).filter((a) => model.showToolCalls || isNarrative(a)));
  const needs = $derived(!!model.lead?.needsYou && !model.archived);
  const handoff = $derived(handoffText(model.handoff) ?? handoffFallback(model.stages[model.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? null, queuedByName, card.createdAt));
  const grant = $derived(card.queuedGrant === null ? 'none' : grantCovers(card, card.delegateAgentId ?? lastAgentId, app.agents) ? 'covers' : 'excludes');
  const links = $derived(linkRows(model.linkGroups));

  }
</script>

                {:else}{@const sm = splitShowMore(v.text)}{sm.shown}{#if sm.more}{#if expanded[r.key]}{' '}{sm.more}{/if} <button class="ar-lk ar-lk--inline" type="button" aria-expanded={!!expanded[r.key]} onclick={() => (expanded[r.key] = !expanded[r.key])}>{expanded[r.key] ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}</button>{/if}{/if}
              </td>
            </tr>
          {/each}
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div class="cd-acts" data-section="project">
    {#if model.projectName}<span><span class="kick">Project</span> {model.projectName} · {model.milestoneName ?? 'no milestone'}</span><button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>
    {:else}<span><span class="kick">Project</span> none</span><button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}
    <ProjectPicker {model} />
  </div>
{:else if panel === 'log'}
  <div data-section="activity">
    <p><span class="kick">Provenance</span> <span>{studioProvenance({ queuedByName, byAgent: !!card.queuedByAgentId, grant, unclaimed: !card.delegateAgentId })}</span></p>
    <div class="cd-acts cd-acts--split"><h3 class="cd-h cd-h--flush">Runs <span class="mono">{runs.length}</span></h3><button class="ar-lk" type="button" aria-pressed={model.showToolCalls} onclick={() => (model.showToolCalls = !model.showToolCalls)}>{model.showToolCalls ? 'Hide tool calls' : 'Show tool calls'}</button></div>
    <table class="cd-dt">
      <colgroup><col /><col /><col /><col style="width: 64px;" /><col style="width: 56px;" /><col style="width: 52px;" /><col style="width: 96px;" /></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Stage</th><th scope="col">Agent</th><th scope="col">Outcome</th><th scope="col">Attempt</th><th scope="col">Events</th><th scope="col">Errors</th><th scope="col">Ended</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {#each runs as { a, n }, i (a.runId)}
          {@const c = counts(a.runId)}
          <tr><td>{stageNameOf(a.stageKey)}</td><td><span class="ag">{nameOf(a.agentId)}</span></td><td class={i === 0 && needs ? 'sigt' : undefined}>{outcomeWordStudio(attemptWord(a))}</td><td class="m">{n}</td><td class="m">{c.total}</td><td class="m">{c.error}</td><td class="m">{a.endedAt ? runEnded(a.endedAt) : '—'}</td></tr>
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    {#if latest}
      <h3 class="cd-h">Latest run <span class="mono">{stageNameOf(latest.stageKey ?? '')} · {latest.counts.error} errors</span></h3>
      <table class="cd-dt">
        <colgroup><col style="width: 56px;" /><col style="width: 92px;" /><col /></colgroup>
        <tbody>{#each latestRows as a (a.seq)}{@const verb = eventVerbStudio(a)}<tr><td class="m">{hhmm(a.ts)}</td><td class={verb === 'Stopped' && needs ? 'sigt' : undefined}>{verb}</td><td>{eventBody(a, model.lead?.sentence)}</td></tr>{/each}</tbody>
      </table>
    {/if}
  </div>
  <div data-section="decisions"><h3 class="cd-h">Decisions</h3>{#if model.decidedGates.length === 0}<p class="cd-p">None yet.</p>{:else}<ol class="cd-ol">{#each model.decidedGates as g (g.id)}<li><span>{g.decision ?? g.status} · {displayPrincipal(g.decidedBy, app.members, app.agents)}{g.comment ? ` · ${g.comment}` : ''}</span></li>{/each}</ol>{/if}</div>
  <div data-section="handoff"><h3 class="cd-h">Handoff</h3><p class="cd-p">{handoff}</p></div>
{:else if panel === 'links'}
  <div data-section="links">
    {#if links.length === 0}<p class="cd-p">Nothing blocks this card and it blocks nothing.</p>{/if}
    <table class="cd-dt">
      <colgroup><col style="width: 96px;" /><col /><col style="width: 200px;" /><col style="width: 84px;" /></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Kind</th><th scope="col">Card or reference</th><th scope="col">Where</th><th scope="col"><span class="sr">Actions</span></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody data-section="references">
        {#each links as l (l.key)}<tr><td>{l.label}</td><td><a class="ttl" href="/b/{l.boardId ?? model.boardId}/c/{l.cardId}">{l.title}</a></td><td>{l.where}</td><td><button class="ar-lk quiet" type="button" disabled={model.links.removing.has(l.key)} onclick={() => void model.links.remove(l.remove)}>{model.links.removing.has(l.key) ? 'Removing…' : 'Remove'}</button></td></tr>{/each}
        {#each model.refs as r (r.id)}<tr><td>Reference</td><td><a class="ttl" href={r.url}>{r.title ?? r.url}</a></td><td>{whereWord(r.url)}</td><td></td></tr>{/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="cd-acts"><button class="ar-btn2" type="button" onclick={() => model.links.openAdd()}><CardIcon name="plus" size={15} stroke={1.75} />Add link</button><span class="muted" data-section="subtasks">Sub-tasks: {card.openChildCount} open of {model.children.length}</span></div>
    <LinkAdder {model} />
    <SubtaskAdder {model} />
    <ReferenceAdder {model} />
  </div>
  <div data-section="related"><span class="kick">Related prior work</span>{#if related.sentence}<p class="cd-p">{related.sentence}</p>{:else}<ul>{#each related.items as it (it.itemId)}<li><a class="ttl" href={it.url}>{it.title || it.itemId}</a></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}</div>
{:else if panel === 'talk'}
  <div data-section="comments">
    {#if model.comments.comments.length === 0}<p class="cd-p">No comments yet. The agent that works this card reads them.</p>{/if}
    <CommentThread {model} />
    <div class="ar-field"><label for="{uid}-c">Add a comment</label><textarea id="{uid}-c" class="ar-ta" maxlength="8192" placeholder="⌘ or Ctrl + Enter posts it" bind:value={model.comments.draft} onkeydown={postOnShortcut}></textarea></div>
    <div class="cd-acts"><button class="ar-btn2" type="button" disabled={model.comments.posting} onclick={() => void model.comments.submit()}>{model.comments.posting ? 'Posting…' : 'Comment'}</button></div>
  </div>
{:else}
  <div class="ar-figs cd-figs-solo" data-section="cost"><div><b class={card.costUsd === 0 ? 'z' : undefined}>{usd(card.costUsd)}</b><span>Spent · {model.estimate?.estimatedUsd ? `of ${usd(model.estimate.estimatedUsd)}` : 'no estimate yet'}</span></div></div>
  <div data-section="attempts">
    <h3 class="cd-h">Attempts</h3>
    <table class="cd-dt">
      <colgroup><col style="width: 64px;" /><col /><col style="width: 72px;" /><col /></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Attempt</th><th scope="col">Agent</th><th scope="col">Spent</th><th scope="col">Outcome</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{#each model.attempts as a, i (a.runId)}<tr><td class="m">{i + 1}</td><td><span class="ag"><Face id={a.agentId} label="" mood={i === model.attempts.length - 1 && needs ? 'needs' : 'resting'} size={20} />{nameOf(a.agentId)}</span></td><td class="m">{usd(a.costUsd)}</td><td>{outcomeWordStudio(attemptWord(a))}</td></tr>{/each}</tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <p class="cd-p" data-section="delivery">{model.counts.deliveryActive ? `Delivery: ${model.deliveryGate?.delivery?.mode ?? 'manual'}, ${model.deliveryGate?.delivery?.liveUrl ?? 'no live address yet'}.` : 'Delivery: none approved on this card.'}</p>
{/if}
```

The attempts table passes `label=""` to each face because the agent's name follows it (decorative, as the reference's `aria-hidden` faces).

- [ ] **Step 10: Rewrite `CardStudio.svelte`**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/CardStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Studio's card drawer (SP-Card-Studio): bar, head, figures, ramp, 01 why it stopped, 02 who and what,
   * 03 send it back, 04 the card in full (five tabs). The gate and the question replace 01 and 03.
   */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { dayMonth } from '$lib/when';
  import CardIcon from '../CardIcon.svelte';
  import { faceLabel, idTokens, initials, sessionIdOf } from '../card-format';
  import CardEditForm from '../editors/CardEditForm.svelte';
  import GateStudioBar from '../gate/GateStudioBar.svelte';
  import GateStudioFrame from '../gate/GateStudioFrame.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioBar from '../question/QuestionStudioBar.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioFrame from '../question/QuestionStudioFrame.svelte';
  import { specGroups } from '../spec-groups';
  import CardStateStudio from '../state/CardStateStudio.svelte';
  import StudioPanels from '../studio/StudioPanels.svelte';
  import StudioTrack from '../studio/StudioTrack.svelte';
  import { costFigLabel, figAge, noteHint, quoteHeader, quoteWhen, stageSuffix, studioClock, studioKicker, studioOption, tabCounts, trackAria, usd, type StudioTab } from '../studio/studio-format';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import '../studio/card-studio.css';

  let { model, phase, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();
  const uid = $props.id();
  let nowIso = $state(new Date().toISOString());
  $effect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => (nowIso = new Date().toISOString()), 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  });

  const card = $derived(model.card);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead);
  const needs = $derived(!!lead?.needsYou && !model.archived);
  const owner = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const queuedByName = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.queuedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const lastAgent = $derived(app.agents.find((a) => a.id === model.attempts.at(-1)?.agentId)?.name ?? model.agent.name);
  const clock = $derived(studioClock(nowIso, phase));
  const age = $derived(figAge(model.ageHours ?? 0));
  const rows = $derived(card ? specGroups(card.spec).reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0) : 0);
  const tabs = $derived(card ? tabCounts({ rows, runs: model.counts.runs, links: model.counts.links, subtasks: model.children.length, refs: model.refs.length, comments: model.comments.comments.length, costUsd: card.costUsd }) : []);
  const showResume = $derived(!!card && !model.archived && !gate && !question && card.state === 'input-required' && ['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead?.kind ?? ''));
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(lead?.sentence));
  const words = $derived(lead?.sentence ?? card?.needsHuman?.detail ?? '');
  const firstSession = $derived(idTokens(words).findIndex((p) => p.id && p.text === sid));

  let tab = $state<StudioTab>('spec');
  $effect(() => { void card?.id; tab = 'spec'; });
  const ORDER: StudioTab[] = ['spec', 'log', 'links', 'talk', 'cost'];
  function onTabKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const i = ORDER.indexOf(tab);
    const to = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (i + 1) % 5 : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (i + 4) % 5 : e.key === 'Home' ? 0 : e.key === 'End' ? 4 : -1;
    if (to < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    tab = ORDER[to]!;
    document.getElementById(`${uid}-${tab}`)?.focus();
  }

  let gateKeys: ((e: KeyboardEvent) => boolean) | null = null;
  function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (t.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && t.id === `${uid}-note`) { e.preventDefault(); void model.resume.submit(); }
      return;
    }
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
    if (e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'o') { e.preventDefault(); window.open(pageHref, '_blank', 'noopener'); return; }
    if (e.shiftKey) return;
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'e') { e.preventDefault(); model.edit.start(); return; }
    if (gateKeys?.(e)) e.preventDefault();
  }
  function back(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onClose();
  }
  const refresh = async () => { await model.refresh(); await app.refresh(); };
</script>

{#if card}
<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_static_element_interactions: the drawer's keyboard shortcuts; every action also has a button -->
<div class="ar cw-drawer" onkeydown={onKey}>
  <div class="cw-bar">
    <a class="crumb" href="/b/{model.boardId}" onclick={back}><CardIcon name="arrow-left" size={16} stroke={1.75} />{model.boardName}</a>
    <span class="id">Card {model.shortId}<button type="button" aria-label="Copy card id {model.shortId}" onclick={() => void model.copyId()}><CardIcon name={model.copied === 'id' ? 'check' : 'copy-square'} size={14} stroke={1.75} /></button></span>

    </div>

    <StudioTrack stages={model.stages.map((st) => st.name)} current={model.stageIndex} tone={needs ? 'needs' : 'plain'} labels="all"
      aria={trackAria({ form: 'drawer', i: model.stageIndex, n: model.stages.length, name: model.stageName, kind: lead?.kind, archived: model.archived })} suffix={stageSuffix(lead?.kind)} />

    {#if !model.detailLoaded}
      <CardStateStudio kind="loading" {model} />
      {#each ['status', 'resume', 'description', 'criteria', 'plan', 'details', 'project', 'activity', 'decisions', 'handoff', 'links', 'subtasks', 'related', 'references', 'comments', 'cost', 'attempts', 'delivery'] as k (k)}<div data-section={k} hidden></div>{/each}
    {:else}
    <div class="cw-cols">

        {:else if gate}
          <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="{uid}-s1"><div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="{uid}-s1">Waiting for your review</h2></div><GateStudioFrame gate={gate.gate} agent={model.agent} {lead} vibe="studio" /></section>
        {:else if question}
          <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="{uid}-s1"><div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="{uid}-s1">Question</h2></div><QuestionStudioFrame elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} /></section>
        {:else if words}
          <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="{uid}-s1">
            <div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="{uid}-s1">{needs ? 'Why it stopped' : 'What the agent said'}</h2><span class="r">attempt {card.attemptCount}</span></div>
            <div class="ar-q" role="status">
              <h3><Face id={model.agent.id ?? model.agent.name} label={faceLabel(model.agent.name, model.agent.mood)} mood={model.agent.mood} size={24} />{quoteHeader(model.agent.name, lead?.kind, 'desktop')}{#if lead?.at}<span class="mono">{quoteWhen(lead.at, nowIso)}</span>{/if}</h3>
              <blockquote>{#each idTokens(words) as t, i (i)}{#if t.id}<code>{t.text}</code>{#if i === firstSession}<sup class="fn">1</sup>{/if}{:else}{t.text}{/if}{/each}</blockquote>

      {:else}<button class="ar-btn2" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} onclick={() => void model.archive()}><CardIcon name="archive-square" size={15} stroke={1.75} />{model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}

```

`Copy session id` keeps its words; `model.copySessionId()` announces the copy (the model's `copied` is `'id' | 'link' | null`).

The test's tab names (`Spec 3`, `Links 1`) come from the fake model's three brief rows and one reference; on the fixture world they read `Spec 10 · Log 2 · Links 5 · Talk 0 · Cost $0.00`.

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  QUIET_ARCHIVED_TAIL, QUIET_CAPTIONS, QUIET_HINT, QUIET_LABELS, quietArchivedMeta, quietAskedBy, quietAttemptsDd, quietCost, quietDoneLine,
  quietDrawerMeta, quietGateMeta, quietHistoryLine, quietNoteLabel, quietProject, quietQuestionMeta, quietRestoreNote, quietResumeLabel,
  quietStateClause, quietStateDd, quietWho, whenLong,
} from './quiet-words';

const TZ = 'Asia/Kolkata';

describe('Quiet words, from the fixture world', () => {
  it('long dates and who said it', () => {
    expect(whenLong('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z', TZ)).toBe('Thursday 8 October at 19:41');
    expect(whenLong('2026-10-08T13:56:34.688Z', TZ)).toBe('Thursday 8 October at 19:26');
    expect(quietWho({ agent: 'error-eric', kind: 'stopped', at: '2026-10-08T14:11:45Z' }, TZ)).toBe('error-eric stopped on Thursday 8 October at 19:41 and wrote:');
    expect(quietWho({ agent: 'error-eric', kind: 'failed', at: '2026-10-08T14:11:45Z' }, TZ)).toBe('error-eric failed on Thursday 8 October at 19:41 and wrote:');
    expect(quietWho({ agent: 'error-eric', kind: 'budget', at: '2026-10-08T14:11:45Z' }, TZ)).toBe('error-eric stopped at the budget on Thursday 8 October at 19:41 and wrote:');
    expect(quietWho({ agent: 'error-eric', kind: 'working', at: null }, TZ)).toBe('error-eric wrote:');
  });
  it('the meta sentence and the State row', () => {
    const state = quietStateClause({ archived: false, needsYou: true, state: 'input-required', ageHours: 66.15 });
    expect(state).toBe('Waiting on you for 2 days');
    expect(quietDrawerMeta({ i: 1, n: 7, stage: 'Reproduce', delegate: null, lastAgent: 'error-eric', attempt: 2, state })).toBe('Stage 2 of 7: Reproduce · Agent: none holding it (error-eric ran attempt 2) · Waiting on you for 2 days');
    expect(quietDrawerMeta({ i: 0, n: 5, stage: 'Intake', delegate: 'coder-kai', lastAgent: 'coder-kai', attempt: 1, state: 'Working' })).toBe('Stage 1 of 5: Intake · Agent: coder-kai · Working');
    expect(quietStateDd({ archived: false, needsYou: true, state: 'input-required', ageHours: 66.15 })).toBe('Waiting on you, for 2 days');
    expect(quietStateClause({ archived: true, needsYou: false, state: 'input-required', ageHours: 1 })).toBe('Archived');
  });
  it('history, attempts, cost, project', () => {
    expect(quietHistoryLine({ n: 2, stage: 'Reproduce', agent: 'error-eric', word: 'stopped', endedAt: '2026-10-08T14:11:43Z', events: 14, errors: 0 }, TZ)).toBe('Attempt 2, Reproduce, error-eric: stopped at 19:41 on 8 October. 14 events, no errors.');
    expect(quietHistoryLine({ n: 1, stage: 'Reproduce', agent: 'error-eric', word: 'sent back', endedAt: '2026-10-08T06:41:00Z', events: 9, errors: 0 }, TZ)).toBe('Attempt 1, Reproduce, error-eric: sent back at 12:11 on 8 October. 9 events, no errors.');
    expect(quietHistoryLine({ n: 3, stage: 'Fix', agent: 'coder-kai', word: 'working', endedAt: null, events: 4, errors: 1 }, TZ)).toBe('Attempt 3, Fix, coder-kai: working. 4 events, 1 error.');
    expect(quietAttemptsDd([{ n: 1, agent: 'error-eric', costUsd: 0, word: 'sent back' }, { n: 2, agent: 'error-eric', costUsd: 0, word: 'stopped' }])).toBe('1: error-eric, $0.00, sent back. 2: error-eric, $0.00, stopped.');
    expect(quietCost(0, null)).toBe('$0.00, no estimate yet');
    expect(quietCost(1.2, 3)).toBe('$1.20, of an estimated $3.00');
    expect(quietProject('Marketing & Community — Melissa and Anna onboarding', null)).toBe('Marketing & Community — Melissa and Anna onboarding · no milestone.');
    expect(quietResumeLabel({ n: 1, name: 'Reported', current: false })).toBe('Stage 1: Reported');
    expect(quietResumeLabel({ n: 2, name: 'Reproduce', current: true })).toBe('Stage 2: Reproduce (this stage)');

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/quiet/quiet-words.ts
/** Quiet's card copy (Q.0–Q.7 with mockup-corrections). Plain sentences; no colour words. Pure. */
import { ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import type { LeadKind } from '../card-lead';
import type { OptionRole } from '../gate/gate-decision.svelte';
import { dateParts, hhmm, type AttemptWord } from '../card-format';

const s = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '' : 's');
export const whenLong = (iso: string, tz?: string): string => {
  const d = dateParts(iso, tz);
  return `${d.weekdayLong} ${d.day} ${d.monthLong} at ${d.hh}:${d.mm}`;
};
export function quietWho(o: { agent: string; kind: LeadKind | null | undefined; at: string | null }, tz?: string): string {
  if (!o.at) return `${o.agent} wrote:`;
  const verb = o.kind === 'stopped' ? 'stopped' : o.kind === 'failed' ? 'failed' : o.kind === 'budget' ? 'stopped at the budget' : null;
  return verb ? `${o.agent} ${verb} on ${whenLong(o.at, tz)} and wrote:` : `${o.agent} wrote:`;
}
const STATE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { working: 'Working', completed: 'Completed', submitted: 'Queued', queued: 'Queued', rejected: 'Rejected', failed: 'Failed', 'input-required': 'Waiting on you' };
type StateIn = { archived: boolean; needsYou: boolean; state: string; ageHours: number | null };
export const quietStateClause = (o: StateIn): string => (o.archived ? 'Archived' : o.needsYou ? `Waiting on you for ${ageWords(o.ageHours ?? 0)}` : (STATE_WORD[o.state] ?? 'Queued'));
export const quietStateDd = (o: StateIn): string => (o.archived ? 'Archived' : o.needsYou ? `Waiting on you, for ${ageWords(o.ageHours ?? 0)}` : (STATE_WORD[o.state] ?? 'Queued'));
export const quietDrawerMeta = (o: { i: number; n: number; stage: string; delegate: string | null; lastAgent: string | null; attempt: number; state: string }): string =>
  `Stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}: ${o.stage} · ${o.delegate ? `Agent: ${o.delegate}` : o.lastAgent ? `Agent: none holding it (${o.lastAgent} ran attempt ${o.attempt})` : 'Agent: none yet'} · ${o.state}`;
export function quietHistoryLine(o: { n: number; stage: string; agent: string; word: AttemptWord; endedAt: string | null; events: number; errors: number }, tz?: string): string {
  let at = '';
  if (o.endedAt) {
    const d = dateParts(o.endedAt, tz);
    at = ` at ${d.hh}:${d.mm} on ${d.day} ${d.monthLong}`;
  }
  return `Attempt ${o.n}, ${o.stage}, ${o.agent}: ${o.word}${at}. ${o.events} events, ${o.errors > 0 ? `${o.errors} error${s(o.errors)}` : 'no errors'}.`;
}
export const quietAttemptsDd = (list: Array<{ n: number; agent: string; costUsd: number; word: AttemptWord }>): string =>
  list.map((a) => `${a.n}: ${a.agent}, $${a.costUsd.toFixed(2)}, ${a.word}.`).join(' ');
export const quietCost = (cost: number, est: number | null | undefined): string => `$${cost.toFixed(2)}, ${est ? `of an estimated $${est.toFixed(2)}` : 'no estimate yet'}`;
export const quietProject = (name: string, milestone: string | null): string => `${name} · ${milestone ?? 'no milestone'}.`;
export const quietResumeLabel = (t: { n: number; name: string; current: boolean }): string => `Stage ${t.n}: ${t.name}${t.current ? ' (this stage)' : ''}`;
export const quietGateMeta = (o: { board: string; i: number; n: number; stage: string; agent: string; at: string | null }, tz?: string): string =>
  `${o.board} · Stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}: ${o.stage} · Agent: ${o.agent}${o.at ? ` · Waiting for your review since ${hhmm(o.at, tz)}` : ''}`;
export const quietQuestionMeta = (o: { board: string; i: number; n: number; stage: string; agent: string; at: string }, tz?: string): string =>
  `${o.board} · Stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}: ${o.stage} · Agent: ${o.agent} · Asked at ${hhmm(o.at, tz)}`;
export const quietArchivedMeta = (o: { board: string; i: number; n: number; stage: string; owner: string }): { before: string; after: string } =>
  ({ before: `${o.board} · Was at stage ${o.i + 1} of ${o.n}: ${o.stage} · Last agent: `, after: ` · Owner: ${o.owner}` });
export const quietDoneLine = (iso: string, n: number, tz?: string): string => `On ${whenLong(iso, tz)}, after ${n} attempt${s(n)}.`;
export const quietAskedBy = (o: { name: string; byAgent: boolean; covers: boolean }): string =>
  `${o.name}${o.byAgent ? ', an agent' : ''}${o.byAgent && o.covers ? ' allowed to dispatch the one working it' : ''}`;
export const quietNoteLabel = (speaker: string, needNote: boolean): string => (needNote ? 'Say what needs to change' : `Note for ${speaker} (optional)`);
export const quietRestoreNote = (stage: string): string => `Returns it to ${stage}.`;
export const QUIET_HINT: Readonly<Record<OptionRole, string>> = { approve: 'Move the card on as it is.', changes: 'Needs a note. The agent reads it on its next attempt.', reject: 'Stop the card here.' };
export const QUIET_CAPTIONS = { gate: 'If nothing is picked: “Pick a decision first.”', question: 'If empty: “Type an answer first.”' } as const;
export const QUIET_LABELS = ['A. Approval gate', 'B. Agent question', 'C. Archived', 'D. Done', 'E. Decision error', 'F. Loading'] as const;
export const QUIET_ARCHIVED_TAIL = ' Nothing on this card waits for you.';
```

.qs-face--inline { vertical-align: -4px; }
.qs-row--alert { align-items: flex-start; }
.qs-alert { flex: 1 1 220px; }
.qs-formwrap { display: contents; }
.qs-lb { display: inline; padding: 12px 8px; margin: -12px -8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--vk-color-text); font: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; }
```

Check: `grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b' apps/web/src/lib/components/card/quiet/*.css` prints nothing. The gallery root carries `class="qs"`; the gate and question fieldsets carry no root class, so inside the drawer they take `.qt fieldset` and inside the gallery `.qs fieldset` (the standalone `.qs-by`, `.qs-subject`, `.qs-radio`, `.qs-dl` rules work in both).

<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/gate/GateQuiet.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Quiet's gate: one fieldset, radios with plain descriptions, the note, Submit decision (Q.3).
   * `compact` (gallery cell E): no by-line, no subject, no descriptions. The 409 alert is kept by
   * GateConflictWatch, so a later "needs a note" error stands beside it.
   */
  import { Face, type Mood, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { Gate, GateDecision } from '$lib/api';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import type { CardLead } from '../card-lead';
  import { conflictSentence, subjectRows } from '../card-format';
  import { QUIET_HINT, quietNoteLabel } from '../quiet/quiet-words';
  import { rawJson } from '../spec-details';
  import { GateConflictWatch } from './gate-conflict.svelte';
  import { GATE_NOTE_MAX, GateDecisionModel, roleOf, sealOf } from './gate-decision.svelte';
  import '../quiet/card-states-quiet.css';

  let { boardId, gate, error, onResponse, agent, compact = false, caption = null, onRefresh = () => {} }: {
    boardId: string; gate: Gate; error: string | null;
    onResponse: (d: GateDecision, r: Response) => Promise<boolean>;
    agent: { id: string | null; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood };
    lead: CardLead | null; vibe: Vibe; compact?: boolean; caption?: string | null; onRefresh?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  } = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  const watch = new GateConflictWatch();
  const model = new GateDecisionModel(() => ({ boardId, gate, onResponse: watch.wrap(onResponse) }));
  $effect(() => model.follow(gate.id));
  const subject = $derived(gate.approvalSubject);
  const who = $derived(watch.conflict ? displayPrincipal(watch.conflict.decidedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  let rawOpen = $state(false);
  let copied = $state(false);
  async function copyDigest(): Promise<void> {
    if (!subject) return;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(subject.digest); copied = true; setTimeout(() => (copied = false), 2000); } catch { copied = false; }
  }
</script>

<fieldset>
  <legend>Your decision is needed</legend>
  {#if !compact}
    <p class="qs-by"><span class="qs-face"><Face id={agent.id ?? agent.name} label="" mood="needs" size={20} /></span>{gate.summary ? `${agent.name}: ${gate.summary}` : 'Waiting for your review.'}</p>
    {#if subject}
      <p class="qs-subhead">What you are approving (revision {subject.revision})</p>
      <div class="qs-subject">
        <dl class="qs-dl">{#each subjectRows(subject.canonical) as r (r.key)}<dt>{r.label}</dt><dd>{r.value}</dd>{/each}</dl>
        <p>Sealed: <span class="qs-mono">{sealOf(subject.digest)}</span>. You approve exactly this version. <button class="qs-lb" type="button" onclick={copyDigest}>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy digest'}</button> · <button class="qs-lb" type="button" aria-expanded={rawOpen} onclick={() => (rawOpen = !rawOpen)}>{rawOpen ? 'Hide raw JSON' : 'View raw JSON'}</button></p>
        {#if rawOpen}<pre class="qs-mono">{rawJson(subject.canonical)}</pre>{/if}
      </div>
    {/if}
  {/if}
  {#each model.options as opt (opt.name)}
    <label class="qs-radio"><input type="radio" name="{uid}-decision" value={opt.name} bind:group={model.selected} /><span><b>{opt.title}</b>{#if !compact}<br />{opt.description ?? QUIET_HINT[roleOf(opt.name)!]}{/if}</span></label>
  {/each}
  {#if model.needPick}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">Pick a decision first.</p>{/if}
  <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined}>
    <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-note">{quietNoteLabel(agent.name, model.needNote)}</label>
    <textarea id="{uid}-note" class="vk-field__input" bind:this={model.noteEl} bind:value={model.note} maxlength={GATE_NOTE_MAX} aria-invalid={model.needNote ? 'true' : undefined} aria-describedby={model.needNote ? `${uid}-e` : undefined}></textarea>
    {#if model.needNote}<p id="{uid}-e" class="vk-field__error">Request changes needs a note.</p>{:else}<p class="vk-field__hint">{model.note.length} of {GATE_NOTE_MAX} characters</p>{/if}
  </div>
  <div class="qs-row" class:qs-row--alert={!!(watch.conflict || error)}>
    <button class="vk-button" type="button" disabled={model.busy} aria-busy={model.busy || undefined} onclick={() => void model.submit()}>{model.busy ? 'Submitting…' : 'Submit decision'}</button>
    {#if watch.conflict}<div class="qs-alert" role="alert"><b>Not recorded.</b> {conflictSentence(watch.conflict, who)} <button class="qs-lb" type="button" onclick={() => void onRefresh()}>Refresh to see it</button>.</div>
    {:else if error}<div class="qs-alert" role="alert">{error}</div>{/if}
  </div>
  {#if caption}<p class="qs-meta">{caption}</p>{/if}
</fieldset>
```

The hint is drawn on every state but `needNote` (the reference's A shows it, E shows the error in its place).

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/CardQuiet.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * Quiet's card drawer (SP-Card-Quiet, Q.1): plain words, one fieldset for what needs you, then the
   * card's sections in two CSS columns. Every control has words; no icons except the two top buttons.
   */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { dayMonth } from '$lib/when';
  import CardIcon from '../CardIcon.svelte';
  import { attemptWord, briefValue, grantCovers, handoffFallback, handoffText, hhmm, idTokens, linkRows, refSourceLine, relatedState, sessionIdOf, splitShowMore } from '../card-format';
  import CardEditForm from '../editors/CardEditForm.svelte';
  import CommentThread from '../editors/CommentThread.svelte';
  import LinkAdder from '../editors/LinkAdder.svelte';
  import ProjectPicker from '../editors/ProjectPicker.svelte';
  import ReferenceAdder from '../editors/ReferenceAdder.svelte';
  import RunEvents from '../editors/RunEvents.svelte';
  import SubtaskAdder from '../editors/SubtaskAdder.svelte';
  import GateQuiet from '../gate/GateQuiet.svelte';
  import QuestionQuiet from '../question/QuestionQuiet.svelte';
  import { rawJson } from '../spec-details';
  import { specGroups } from '../spec-groups';
  import CardStateQuiet from '../state/CardStateQuiet.svelte';
  import { quietAskedBy, quietAttemptsDd, quietCost, quietDrawerMeta, quietHistoryLine, quietProject, quietResumeLabel, quietStateClause, quietStateDd, quietWho, quietRestoreNote } from '../quiet/quiet-words';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import '../quiet/card-quiet.css';
  import '../quiet/card-states-quiet.css';

  let { model, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();
  const uid = $props.id();

  const card = $derived(model.card);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead);
  const stateIn = $derived({ archived: model.archived, needsYou: !!lead?.needsYou, state: card?.state ?? '', ageHours: model.ageHours });
  const owner = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.ownerUserId, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const queuedByName = $derived(card ? displayPrincipal(card.queuedBy, app.members, app.agents) : '');
  const nameOf = (id: string | null | undefined) => app.agents.find((a) => a.id === id)?.name ?? id ?? '';
  const lastAgentId = $derived(model.attempts.at(-1)?.agentId ?? null);
  const stageNameOf = (key: string) => model.stages.find((st) => st.key === key)?.name ?? key;
  const showResume = $derived(!!card && !model.archived && !gate && !question && card.state === 'input-required' && ['stopped', 'failed', 'budget'].includes(lead?.kind ?? ''));
  const words = $derived(lead?.sentence ?? card?.needsHuman?.detail ?? '');
  const sid = $derived(sessionIdOf(words));
  const groups = $derived(card ? specGroups(card.spec) : []);
  const rows = $derived(groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0));
  const description = $derived(typeof card?.spec?.description === 'string' ? card.spec.description : null);
  const handoff = $derived(handoffText(model.handoff) ?? (card ? handoffFallback(model.stages[model.stageIndex - 1]?.name ?? null, queuedByName, card.createdAt) : ''));
  const runs = $derived(model.attempts.map((a, i) => ({ a, n: i + 1 })).reverse());
  const counts = (runId: string) => model.activityGroups.find((g) => g.runId === runId)?.counts ?? { total: 0, error: 0 };
  const links = $derived(linkRows(model.linkGroups));
  const related = $derived(relatedState(model.related));
  let expanded = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  let rawOpen = $state(false);

  function back(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onClose();
  }
  function postOnShortcut(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void model.comments.submit(); }
  }
  const refresh = async () => { await model.refresh(); await app.refresh(); };
</script>

{#if card}
<div class="qt">
<section class="qt-drawer">
  <div class="qt-top">
    <a href="/b/{model.boardId}" onclick={back}>← {model.boardName} board</a>
    <a class="qt-x qt-open" href={pageHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Open in new window"><CardIcon name="external" size={18} /><span>Open in new window</span></a><button class="qt-x" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" onclick={onClose}><CardIcon name="close" size={18} /> Close</button>
  </div>
  <h2 id="drawer-title">{card.title}</h2>
  <p class="qt-meta" data-section="status">{quietDrawerMeta({ i: model.stageIndex, n: model.stages.length, stage: model.stageName, delegate: card.delegateAgentId ? model.delegate.name : null, lastAgent: lastAgentId ? nameOf(lastAgentId) : null, attempt: card.attemptCount, state: quietStateClause(stateIn) })}</p>
  <div data-section="editForm" hidden={!model.edit.editing}>{#if model.edit.editing}<CardEditForm {model} />{/if}</div>
  <div data-section="error" hidden={!model.localError}>{#if model.localError}<p role="alert">{model.localError}</p>{/if}</div>

  {#if !model.detailLoaded}
    <CardStateQuiet kind="loading" {model} />
  {:else if model.archived}
    <CardStateQuiet kind="archived" {model} />
    <div class="qt-row"><button class="vk-button" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} aria-busy={model.archiving || undefined} onclick={() => void model.restore()}>{model.archiving ? 'Restoring…' : 'Restore'}</button><span class="qt-meta">{quietRestoreNote(model.stageName)}</span></div>
  {:else if lead?.kind === 'done'}
    <CardStateQuiet kind="done" {model} />
  {:else if gate}
    <GateQuiet {...gate} agent={model.agent} {lead} vibe="quiet" onRefresh={refresh} />
  {:else if question}
    <QuestionQuiet model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} vibe="quiet" />
  {/if}

  {#if model.detailLoaded && showResume}
    <fieldset class="qt-form" data-section="resume">
      <legend>Your decision is needed</legend>
      <p class="qt-by"><span class="qt-face"><Face id={model.agent.id ?? model.agent.name} label="" mood="needs" size={20} /></span>{quietWho({ agent: model.agent.name, kind: lead?.kind, at: lead?.at ?? null })}</p>
      <p class="qt-said">{#each idTokens(words, 'session') as t, i (i)}{#if t.id}<span class="qt-id">{t.text}</span>{:else}{t.text}{/if}{/each}</p>
      {#if sid}<div class="qt-row"><button class="qt-lb" type="button" onclick={() => void model.copySessionId()}>Copy session id</button></div>{/if}
      <form class="qs-formwrap" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.resume.submit(); }}>
        <div class="vk-field">
          <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-at">Resume at stage</label>
          <select id="{uid}-at" class="vk-field__input qt-select-narrow" bind:value={model.resume.target}>{#each model.resume.targets.filter((t) => t.allowed) as t (t.key)}<option value={t.key}>{quietResumeLabel(t)}</option>{/each}</select>
        </div>
        <div class="vk-field" data-invalid={model.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}>
          <label class="vk-field__label" for="{uid}-note">What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.</label>
          <textarea id="{uid}-note" class="vk-field__input" maxlength="8000" bind:this={model.resume.noteEl} bind:value={model.resume.note} aria-invalid={model.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} aria-describedby="{uid}-hint"></textarea>
          {#if model.resume.error}<p class="vk-field__error" role="alert">{model.resume.error}</p>{/if}
          <p id="{uid}-hint" class="vk-field__hint">You must write a note before sending. Up to 8000 characters.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="qt-row"><button class="vk-button" type="submit" aria-busy={model.resume.busy || undefined}>{model.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button></div>
      </form>
    </fieldset>
  {:else}
    <div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
  {/if}

  <div class="qt-cols">
    <section class="qt-sec">
      <h3>Details</h3>
      <dl class="qt-dl" data-section="facts">
        <dt>State</dt><dd>{quietStateDd(stateIn)}</dd>
        <dt>Agent</dt><dd>{#if card.delegateAgentId}{model.delegate.name}{:else if lastAgentId}None holding it. Last run: <span class="qt-face"><Face id={lastAgentId} label="" mood="resting" size={20} /></span> {nameOf(lastAgentId)}{:else}None yet.{/if}</dd>
        <dt>Owner</dt><dd>{owner}{#if card.ownerUserId !== app.user?.userId} <button class="qt-lb" type="button" disabled={model.assigning} onclick={() => void model.assignToMe()}>Assign to me</button>{/if}</dd>
        {#if card.queuedBy}<dt>Asked by</dt><dd>{#if card.queuedByAgentId}<span class="qt-face"><Face id={card.queuedByAgentId} label="" mood="resting" size={20} /></span> {/if}{quietAskedBy({ name: queuedByName, byAgent: !!card.queuedByAgentId, covers: grantCovers(card, card.delegateAgentId ?? lastAgentId, app.agents) })}</dd>{/if}
        <dt>Priority</dt><dd>P{card.priority}</dd>
        <dt>Due</dt><dd>{card.dueAt ? dayMonth(card.dueAt) : 'No due date'}</dd>
        <dt>Labels</dt><dd>{model.labels.length ? model.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ') : 'None'}</dd>
        <dt>Attempt</dt><dd>{card.attemptCount}</dd>
        <dt>Card id</dt><dd><span class="qt-id">{model.shortId}</span> · <button class="qt-lb" type="button" onclick={() => void model.copyId()}>{model.copied === 'id' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button></dd>

'Removing…' : 'Remove'}</button></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
      <div class="qt-row"><button class="qt-lk" type="button" onclick={() => model.links.openAdd()}>Add link</button></div>
      <LinkAdder {model} />
    </section>

    <section class="qt-sec">
      <h3>Sub-tasks, Project, Cost, Delivery</h3>
      <dl class="qt-dl">
        <div data-section="subtasks" style="display: contents;"><dt>Sub-tasks</dt><dd>{#if model.children.length === 0}None. {:else}{#each model.children as c, i (c.id)}{i > 0 ? ', ' : ''}<a href="/b/{model.boardId}/c/{c.id}">{c.title}</a>{/each}. {/if}<button class="qt-lb" type="button" onclick={() => document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`#${uid}-sub-wrap input`)?.focus()}>Add a sub-task</button></dd></div>
        <div data-section="project" style="display: contents;"><dt>Project</dt><dd>{#if model.projectName}{quietProject(model.projectName, model.milestoneName)} <button class="qt-lb" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>{:else}None. <button class="qt-lb" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}</dd></div>
        <div data-section="cost" style="display: contents;"><dt>Cost</dt><dd>{quietCost(card.costUsd, model.estimate?.estimatedUsd)}</dd></div>
        <div data-section="attempts" style="display: contents;"><dt>Attempts</dt><dd>{quietAttemptsDd(model.attempts.map((a, i) => ({ n: i + 1, agent: nameOf(a.agentId), costUsd: a.costUsd, word: attemptWord(a) })))}</dd></div>
        <div data-section="delivery" style="display: contents;"><dt>Delivery</dt><dd>{model.counts.deliveryActive ? `${model.deliveryGate?.delivery?.mode ?? 'manual'}, ${model.deliveryGate?.delivery?.liveUrl ?? 'no live address yet'}` : 'None approved'}</dd></div>
      </dl>
      <ProjectPicker {model} />
      <div id="{uid}-sub-wrap"><SubtaskAdder {model} /></div>
    </section>

    <section class="qt-sec">
      <h3>References and related prior work</h3>
      <ul data-section="references">
        {#each model.refs as r (r.id)}<li><a href={r.url}>{r.title ?? r.url}</a>{#if r.subtitle}, {r.subtitle}{/if}<br /><span class="qt-src">{refSourceLine(r.url)}</span></li>{/each}
        <li data-section="related">{#if related.sentence}{related.sentence}{:else}{#each related.items as it, i (it.itemId)}{i > 0 ? ', ' : ''}<a href={it.url}>{it.title || it.itemId}</a>{/each}{/if}</li>
      </ul>
      <ReferenceAdder {model} />
    </section>

    <section class="qt-sec" data-section="cardActions">
      <h3>Card actions</h3>
      <div class="qt-row">
        {#if !model.archived}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} aria-busy={model.archiving || undefined} onclick={() => void model.archive()}>{model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
        <button class="vk-button qt-danger" type="button" onclick={() => void model.remove()}>Delete card</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</section>
</div>
{/if}
```

`Add a sub-task` moves focus to the composer's input (the composer owns its id, so it is found through the wrapper). The `qt-id` span on the card id shows the short id, as the reference prints `4605`.

The reference prints the plan as `<p>None yet.</p>` on the drawer; the agent's name sentence ("… did not post a plan …") is the page's and phone's (Q.2), so the drawer keeps `None yet.` verbatim.

### Task 28: Phone boards ×4 (Daylight, Paper, Studio, Quiet)

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Below `viewport.phone` (899.98px) the board renders one phone layout per vibe inside the phone shells
from Task 13: Daylight's stage chips, "Needs you" lane and per-stage lanes, with `PdHello` in the sky
slot; Paper's letters and entries; Studio's numbered summary, cards and stages disclosure; Quiet's
five groups and stages table. All four list the cards that need a person in the **phone "wants" order**
(stopped cards by age, newest-stopped last; then no-owner; then other needs; then the rest in the
desktop `ordered` order), so DX reads 4605, 58f8, 1dfc, 63ac, f83f, 481f, 9ed9. Agent text is passed
through `sentenceCase` on every phone (C-06). This turns `SP-Phone-Board-{Daylight,Paper,Studio,Quiet}`
green in both themes, and applies the plan ruling on 4605's seeded `needsHuman.summary`: the
Studio phone reference row that still prints the first-sentence fallback is corrected to the summary.

The phone references use short unprefixed class names (`.tile`, `.chip`, `.btn`, `.ar`, `.it`…) that
collide with other screens (`.chip` and `.ar` are Studio's annual base). The ported CSS is therefore
scoped: `extract-css.mjs` gains a `--scope <selector>` option that prefixes every selector with
`:where(<selector>) ` (zero added specificity, so the cascade inside the board is the reference's own),
and each phone board renders inside a `display: contents` root carrying that class, so the reference's
flex layout under `.ph-root` is unchanged.

// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/phone/clamp.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { clampWatch } from './clamp';

globalThis.ResizeObserver ??= class { observe() {} unobserve() {} disconnect() {} } as never;

function el(scroll: number, client: number): HTMLElement {
  const p = document.createElement('p');
  Object.defineProperty(p, 'scrollHeight', { configurable: true, get: () => scroll });
  Object.defineProperty(p, 'clientHeight', { configurable: true, get: () => client });
  return p;
}

describe('clampWatch', () => {
  it('reports true when the text overflows its clamp', () => {
    const set = vi.fn();
    clampWatch(el(120, 66), set);
    expect(set).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(true);
  });
  it('reports false when it fits (1px of rounding allowed)', () => {
    const set = vi.fn();
    clampWatch(el(67, 66), set);
    expect(set).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(false);
  });
});

import { render, screen, within, cleanup, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import BoardStudioPhone from './BoardStudioPhone.svelte';
import { dxModel, DX_API_STAGES, OWNER_SHORT } from '../phone/dx-model.fixture';

vi.mock('$lib/stores/app.svelte', () => ({ app: { openCard: vi.fn(), moveCard: vi.fn(), error: null, board: { stages: DX_API_STAGES }, syncedAt: new Date('2026-10-11T08:21:00Z') } }));
vi.mock('$lib/components/board/stage-owner', async (orig) => ({
  ...(await orig<typeof import('$lib/components/board/stage-owner')>()),
  ownerShort: (s: { key: string }, sep = ' · ') => OWNER_SHORT[s.key].replace(' · ', sep),
}));
globalThis.ResizeObserver ??= class { observe() {} unobserve() {} disconnect() {} } as never;
afterEach(() => cleanup());

process.env.TZ = 'Asia/Kolkata';
const rows = () => screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: /Enter opens, M moves\.$/ }).map((b) => b.textContent?.slice(0, 12));

describe('BoardStudioPhone', () => {
  it('numbers the rows in the wants order and the multiples by stage', () => {
    render(BoardStudioPhone, { props: { model: dxModel(), vibe: 'studio', phase: 'noon', onCompose: vi.fn() } });
    expect(rows()).toEqual(['Diagnose Mel', 'AgentPod: co', 'Superpipelin', 'Fix the high', 'Integrate ed', 'agentpod-con', 'Build immuta']);
    expect(screen.getByText('13:51 · midday')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Stage 3, Failing test: 3 cards' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '#stage-3');
  });
  it('filters the rows with the quick filter and keeps their numbers', async () => {
    render(BoardStudioPhone, { props: { model: dxModel(), vibe: 'studio', phase: 'noon', onCompose: vi.fn() } });
    const qf = screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Quick filter' });
    await fireEvent.click(within(qf).getByRole('button', { name: 'Done 1' }));
    expect(within(qf).getByRole('button', { name: 'Done 1' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    expect(rows()).toEqual(['Build immuta']);
    const row = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Build immutable/ }).closest('article')!;
    expect(within(row as HTMLElement).getByText('07')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('flips the stages summary between show and hide', async () => {
    const { container } = render(BoardStudioPhone, { props: { model: dxModel(), vibe: 'studio', phase: 'noon', onCompose: vi.fn() } });
    const details = container.querySelector('details.pb-stages') as HTMLDetailsElement;
    expect(within(details).getByText('2 blocked · show')).toBeInTheDocument();
    details.open = true;
    await fireEvent(details, new Event('toggle'));
    expect(within(details).getByText('2 blocked · hide')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

```js
const scope = arg('--scope'); // e.g. ".pd-board": each selector becomes ":where(.pd-board) <selector>"

/** Split a selector list on top-level commas (commas inside :where()/:is() stay). */
function splitList(sel) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, start = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
    const c = sel[i];
    if (c === '(') depth++; else if (c === ')') depth--;
    else if (c === ',' && depth === 0) { out.push(sel.slice(start, i).trim()); start = i + 1; }
  }
  out.push(sel.slice(start).trim());
  return out;
}
/** Put one selector under the scope, with zero added specificity. A leading [data-theme] stays outside it. */
function scoped(sel) {
  if (!scope || sel.startsWith(scope)) return sel;
  const theme = sel.match(/^(\[data-theme[^\]]*\])\s+(.*)$/);
  return theme ? `${theme[1]} :where(${scope}) ${theme[2]}` : `:where(${scope}) ${sel}`;
}
const rescope = (prelude) => splitList(prelude).map((s) => (wanted(s) ? scoped(s) : s)).join(',');
