```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/phone/phone-words.ts
/**
 * Words, orders and lines for the four phone boards (shell-and-board §3.4, §3.6, §4.5 phone rows).
 * Pure. Phones pass agent text through sentenceCase (C-06); desktop prints it verbatim.
 */
import { greeting, type Mood, type Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AttentionKind } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import type { CardSummary, Urgency } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
import { dueLong, dueShort } from '$lib/components/board/board-words';
import { refLabel } from '$lib/components/board/ref-chip';
import { firstSentence, joinAnd, numWord, plural, remainder, sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';

/** Only what a phone row reads from a CardSummary (Task 14 adds lastAgent, age words, summaryLine, kind). */
export type PhoneSummary = Pick<
  CardSummary,
  | 'id' | 'title' | 'card' | 'stageKey' | 'stageName' | 'stageIndex' | 'stageCount' | 'priority' | 'labels' | 'moreLabels'
  | 'firstRef' | 'queuedBy' | 'cost' | 'dueAt' | 'overdue' | 'urgency' | 'attemptCount' | 'ageHours' | 'attention'
  | 'lastAgent' | 'ageShort' | 'ageLong' | 'agoWords' | 'summaryLine' | 'kind'
>;
type OrderRow = { urgency: Urgency; kind: AttentionKind | null; ageHours: number | null };
export interface FaceRef { id: string; name: string; mood: Mood }

export const STOPPED_KINDS: ReadonlySet<AttentionKind> = new Set<AttentionKind>(['blocked', 'repeated-failure', 'failed', 'budget', 'refused']);
export const isStopped = (s: Pick<OrderRow, 'urgency' | 'kind'>): boolean => s.urgency === 'needs' && !!s.kind && STOPPED_KINDS.has(s.kind);
export const usd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
const capFirst = (s: string): string => (s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s);
const saidOf = (s: PhoneSummary): string => s.card.needsHuman?.detail ?? s.attention?.detail ?? '';
const blockedCount = (s: PhoneSummary): number => s.card.blockedBy?.length ?? 0;
const queuer = (s: PhoneSummary): FaceRef | null => (s.queuedBy ? { id: s.queuedBy.agent?.id ?? s.queuedBy.name, name: s.queuedBy.name, mood: 'resting' } : null);
const agentFace = (s: PhoneSummary, mood: Mood): FaceRef | null => (s.lastAgent ? { id: s.lastAgent.id, name: s.lastAgent.name, mood } : null);
const agentName = (s: PhoneSummary): string => s.lastAgent?.name ?? 'The agent';
const attemptTail = (s: PhoneSummary): string => (s.attemptCount > 1 ? ` · attempt ${s.attemptCount}` : '');

/**
 * The phone "wants" order: stopped cards by how long they have waited (longest first), then cards in a
 * stage nobody works, then every other kind of need; then everything else in the desktop order.
 */
export function wantsOrder<T extends OrderRow>(ordered: readonly T[]): T[] {
  const rank = (s: T) => (s.kind && STOPPED_KINDS.has(s.kind) ? 0 : s.kind === 'no-owner' ? 1 : 2);
  const age = (s: T) => s.ageHours ?? -1;
  const needs = ordered
    .map((s, i) => ({ s, i }))
    .filter(({ s }) => s.urgency === 'needs')
    .sort((a, b) => rank(a.s) - rank(b.s) || age(b.s) - age(a.s) || a.i - b.i)
    .map(({ s }) => s);
  return [...needs, ...ordered.filter((s) => s.urgency !== 'needs')];
}

export interface NeedsCounts { needs: number; stopped: number; noOwner: number; questions: number; reviews: number }
export function needsCounts(rows: readonly Pick<OrderRow, 'urgency' | 'kind'>[]): NeedsCounts {
  const n = rows.filter((r) => r.urgency === 'needs');
  return {
    needs: n.length,
    stopped: n.filter(isStopped).length,
    noOwner: n.filter((r) => r.kind === 'no-owner').length,
    questions: n.filter((r) => r.kind === 'question').length,
    reviews: n.filter((r) => r.kind === 'review').length,
  };
}

export function phoneHello(phase: Phase, firstName: string): string {
  return `${greeting(phase, 'daylight').replace(/[.!]\s*$/, '')}, ${firstName}.`;
}

export function phoneHelloP(c: NeedsCounts): { strong: string; rest: string } {
  if (c.needs === 0) return { strong: 'Nothing needs you.', rest: '' };
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (c.stopped) parts.push(`${numWord(c.stopped)} ${c.stopped === 1 ? 'agent' : 'agents'} stopped`);
  if (c.noOwner) parts.push(`${numWord(c.noOwner)} ${c.noOwner === 1 ? 'card waits' : 'cards wait'} in a person's stage`);
  if (c.questions) parts.push(`${numWord(c.questions)} asked a question`);
  if (c.reviews) parts.push(`${numWord(c.reviews)} ${c.reviews === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} for your review`);
  return { strong: `${c.needs} ${c.needs === 1 ? 'card wants' : 'cards want'} you.`, rest: parts.length ? `${capFirst(joinAnd(parts))}.` : '' };
}

export const wantsIntro = (stages: number): string => `From ${numWord(stages)} ${stages === 1 ? 'stage' : 'stages'}, most urgent first.`;
export const phoneTitleLabel = (s: Pick<PhoneSummary, 'title' | 'stageName'>): string => `${s.title}. In ${s.stageName}. Enter opens, M moves.`;

// ── Daylight ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function pdStageLine(s: PhoneSummary): string {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') {
    return s.kind === 'no-owner'
      ? `${s.stageName} · a person's stage · ${s.ageShort}`
      : `${s.stageName} · stage ${s.stageIndex + 1} of ${s.stageCount} · ${s.ageShort}`;
  }
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return `Done · ${s.ageShort} ago · ${plural(s.attemptCount, 'attempt', 'attempts')}`;
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return `Closed · ${s.ageShort} ago`;
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return `Working · ${s.ageShort}`;
  return `Queued · ${s.ageShort}`;
}
export function actionWord(s: Pick<PhoneSummary, 'urgency' | 'kind'>): 'Resume' | 'Answer' | 'Review' | 'Open' {
  if (isStopped(s)) return 'Resume';
  if (s.kind === 'question') return 'Answer';
  if (s.kind === 'review') return 'Review';
  return 'Open';
}
export const personStageText = (stage: string): string => `${stage} is a person's stage. Waiting for you to pick it up or move it on.`;
export function pdDue(s: Pick<PhoneSummary, 'dueAt' | 'overdue'>): { text: string; overdue: boolean } | null {
  if (!s.dueAt) return null;
  return { text: s.overdue ? `Due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}, overdue` : `Due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}`, overdue: s.overdue };
}
export function laneNote(needsHere: number, queuedHere: number): string | null {
  if (needsHere === 0) return null;
  if (queuedHere === 0) return `${plural(needsHere, 'card', 'cards')}, waiting on you above.`;
  return `${needsHere} ${needsHere === 1 ? 'card is' : 'cards are'} waiting on you above. ${queuedHere} ${queuedHere === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} queued here.`;
}
export const blockedChip = (n: number): { text: string; title: string } => ({ text: `${n} blocked`, title: `${plural(n, 'card', 'cards')} ${n === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} on other cards` });
export function blockedByChip(titles: string[]): { text: string; title: string } {
  const n = titles.length;
  return { text: `Blocked by ${plural(n, 'card', 'cards')}`, title: n === 1 ? `Waits on ${titles[0]}` : `Waits on ${n} cards: ${titles.join('; ')}` };
}

// ── Paper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const paperWaitingHeading = (n: number): string => (n ? `Waiting on you · ${plural(n, 'letter', 'letters')}` : 'Waiting on you');
export function paperSig(s: PhoneSummary): { face: FaceRef | null; em: string; rest: string } {
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { face: queuer(s), em: s.queuedBy ? `asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}` : 'With you', rest: ` · ${s.stageName} · ${s.agoWords}` };
  return { face: agentFace(s, 'needs'), em: agentName(s), rest: ` · ${s.stageName} · ${s.agoWords}${attemptTail(s)}` };
}
export function paperQuote(s: PhoneSummary): string {
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return `“Waiting to be picked up.” ${s.stageName} is a person's stage.`;
  return `“${sentenceCase(saidOf(s))}”`;
}
export type Fact = { text: string; cls?: 'ref' | 'od'; title?: string };
const labelFacts = (s: PhoneSummary): Fact[] => [
  ...s.labels.map((l) => ({ text: l.name })),
  ...(s.moreLabels > 0 ? [{ text: `+${s.moreLabels}`, title: `${plural(s.moreLabels, 'more label', 'more labels')}` }] : []),
];
export function paperFacts(s: PhoneSummary): Fact[] {
  const out: Fact[] = [];
  if (s.priority > 0) out.push({ text: `P${s.priority}` });
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') {
    out.push(...labelFacts(s));
    if (s.dueAt) out.push(s.overdue ? { text: `Due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)} · overdue`, cls: 'od' } : { text: `Due ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}` });
    return out;
  }
  if (s.queuedBy) out.push({ text: `asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}` });
  out.push({ text: usd(s.cost) });
  if (s.firstRef) out.push({ text: refLabel(s.firstRef), cls: 'ref' });
  return out;
}
export function paperEntryBy(s: PhoneSummary): { em: string | null; rest: string } {
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { em: null, rest: `Done ${s.agoWords} · after ${plural(s.attemptCount, 'attempt', 'attempts')}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return { em: null, rest: `Closed ${s.agoWords}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return { em: agentName(s), rest: ` · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}` };
  return { em: 'Not picked up yet', rest: ` · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}` };
}
export function paperEntryFacts(s: PhoneSummary): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (s.priority > 0) out.push(`P${s.priority}`);
  if (s.urgency === 'done' || s.urgency === 'closed' || s.urgency === 'working') return [...out, usd(s.cost)];
  if (blockedCount(s)) out.push(`Blocked by ${plural(blockedCount(s), 'card', 'cards')}`);
  if (s.queuedBy) out.push(`asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}`);
  return out;
}
export const pipelineRest = (st: { count: number; blocked: number }, owner: string): string =>
  ` · ${st.count === 0 ? 'empty' : st.count}${st.blocked ? ` · ${st.blocked} blocked` : ''} · ${owner}`;

// ── Studio ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const NEEDS_WORD: Partial<Record<AttentionKind, string>> = { question: 'question', review: 'review', 'sub-tasks': 'waiting' };
export type Unit = 'needs' | 'blocked' | 'queued' | 'working' | 'done' | 'off';
export const rowIndex = (i: number): string => String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
export function unitOf(s: PhoneSummary): Unit {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') return 'needs';
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return blockedCount(s) ? 'blocked' : 'queued';
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return 'working';
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return 'done';
  return 'off';
}
export function studioRowLabel(s: PhoneSummary): { text: string; needs: boolean } {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') {
    if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { text: 'Needs you · your stage', needs: true };
    return { text: `Needs you · ${isStopped(s) ? 'stopped' : (s.kind && NEEDS_WORD[s.kind]) ?? 'waiting'}`, needs: true };
  }
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') return { text: blockedCount(s) ? `Queued · blocked by ${blockedCount(s)}` : 'Queued', needs: false };
  return { text: s.urgency === 'working' ? 'Working' : s.urgency === 'done' ? 'Done' : 'Closed', needs: false };
}
export function studioNext(s: PhoneSummary): { text: string; q: boolean } {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') {
    if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { text: `Pick it up or move it on.${s.overdue && s.dueAt ? ` Overdue since ${dueShort(s.dueAt)}.` : ''}`, q: false };
    return { text: s.summaryLine ?? firstSentence(sentenceCase(saidOf(s))), q: false };
  }
  if (s.urgency === 'queued') {
    const n = blockedCount(s);
    return { text: `auto · ${n ? `waits on ${plural(n, 'card', 'cards')} · ` : ''}not picked up yet · ${usd(s.cost)}`, q: true };
  }
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { text: `${s.attemptCount} ${s.attemptCount === 1 ? 'try' : 'tries'} · ${usd(s.cost)}`, q: true };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return { text: `${agentName(s)} · working · ${usd(s.cost)}`, q: true };
  return { text: `closed · ${usd(s.cost)}`, q: true };
}
export type StudioFact = { text: string; p?: boolean; title?: string };
export function studioFacts(s: PhoneSummary): StudioFact[] {
  const out: StudioFact[] = s.priority > 0 ? [{ text: `P${s.priority}`, p: true }] : [];
  if (s.urgency === 'done' || s.urgency === 'closed') return out;
  if (s.firstRef) out.push({ text: refLabel(s.firstRef) });
  out.push(...labelFacts(s).map(({ text, title }) => (title ? { text, title } : { text })));
  if (s.queuedBy) out.push({ text: `asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}` });
  return out;
}
export const studioDue = (s: Pick<PhoneSummary, 'dueAt' | 'overdue'>): { text: string; sig: boolean } =>
  s.dueAt ? { text: s.overdue ? `${dueShort(s.dueAt)}, overdue` : dueShort(s.dueAt), sig: s.overdue } : { text: '—', sig: false };
export function phoneLede(c: { stopped: number; noOwner: number; daysOverdue: number; queuedBlocked: number; done: number }): string {
  const one: string[] = [];
  if (c.stopped) one.push(`${numWord(c.stopped)} stopped and ${c.stopped === 1 ? 'needs' : 'need'} resuming`);
  if (c.noOwner) one.push(`${numWord(c.noOwner)} ${c.noOwner === 1 ? 'sits' : 'sit'} in your own stage${c.daysOverdue > 0 ? ` and ${c.noOwner === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} ${numWord(c.daysOverdue)} ${c.daysOverdue === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} overdue` : ''}`);
  const two: string[] = [];
  if (c.queuedBlocked) two.push(`${numWord(c.queuedBlocked)} ${c.queuedBlocked === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} queued behind a blocker`);
  if (c.done) two.push(`${numWord(c.done)} ${c.done === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} shipped`);
  const sentences = [one, two].filter((p) => p.length).map((p) => `${capFirst(p.join('; '))}.`);
  return sentences.length ? sentences.join(' ') : 'Nothing needs you.';
}
/** Whole days from a due date to today (UTC dates): due 2026-10-06 on 2026-10-11 → 5. */
export function daysOverdue(due: string, nowMs: number): number {
  const today = Date.parse(new Date(nowMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((today - Date.parse(due.slice(0, 10))) / 86_400_000));
}
export function studioFigs(c: { spend: number; overBudget: number; overdue: number; stages: number; blocked: number }) {
  return [
    { value: usd(c.spend), label: 'Spend · 7 days', z: c.spend === 0, sig: false },
    { value: String(c.overBudget), label: 'Over budget', z: c.overBudget === 0, sig: c.overBudget > 0 },
    { value: String(c.overdue), label: 'Overdue', z: c.overdue === 0, sig: c.overdue > 0 },
    { value: String(c.stages), small: 'stages', label: `${c.blocked} blocked`, z: false, sig: false },
  ] as Array<{ value: string; small?: string; label: string; z: boolean; sig: boolean }>;
}
export const smAria = (i: number, name: string, count: number): string => `Stage ${i}, ${name}: ${plural(count, 'card', 'cards')}`;
export function studioStageO(st: { count: number; blocked: number; gate: boolean }, owner: string): { gate: boolean; text: string } {
  const empty = st.count === 0 ? ' · empty' : '';
  if (st.gate) return { gate: true, text: ` ${owner.replace(/^gate · /, '')}${empty}` };
  return { gate: false, text: `${[st.blocked ? `${st.blocked} blocked` : '', owner].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}${empty}` };
}
export const stagesSummaryRight = (blocked: number, open: boolean): string => `${blocked ? `${blocked} blocked · ` : ''}${open ? 'hide' : 'show'}`;

// ── Quiet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const quietPhoneHeader = (all: number, needs: number): string => `Superpipeline · ${plural(all, 'card', 'cards')}${needs ? ` · ${needs} need your decision` : ''}`;
export function quietMeta(s: PhoneSummary): { face: FaceRef | null; text: string } {
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') {
    if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { face: queuer(s), text: `${s.queuedBy ? `asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}` : 'With you'} · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}` };
    return { face: agentFace(s, 'needs'), text: `${agentName(s)} · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}${attemptTail(s)}` };
  }
  if (s.urgency === 'done') return { face: null, text: `Completed ${s.agoWords} · ${s.stageName} · ${plural(s.attemptCount, 'attempt', 'attempts')}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'closed') return { face: null, text: `Closed ${s.agoWords} · ${s.stageName}` };
  if (s.urgency === 'working') return { face: agentFace(s, 'working'), text: `${agentName(s)} · ${s.stageName} · working for ${s.ageLong}` };
  return { face: null, text: `Not picked up yet · ${s.stageName} · ${s.ageLong}` };
}
export function quietReason(s: PhoneSummary): { lead: string; more: string | null } | null {
  if (s.urgency !== 'needs') return null;
  if (s.kind === 'no-owner') return { lead: `Not started. ${s.stageName} is a person's stage.`, more: null };
  const said = sentenceCase(saidOf(s));
  return { lead: `${isStopped(s) ? 'Stopped' : 'Waiting'}. ${firstSentence(said)}`, more: remainder(said) };
}
export function quietFacts(s: PhoneSummary): Array<{ text: string; od?: boolean }> {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let due: { text: string; od: boolean } | null = null;
  if (s.urgency === 'needs') {
    parts.push(s.priority > 0 ? `Priority ${s.priority}` : 'No priority');
    if (s.kind === 'no-owner') {
      if (s.labels.length) parts.push(`labels: ${s.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ')}${s.moreLabels ? `, and ${s.moreLabels} more` : ''}`);
      if (s.dueAt) due = { text: `Due ${dueLong(s.dueAt)}${s.overdue ? ', overdue' : ''}`, od: s.overdue };
    } else {
      if (s.queuedBy) parts.push(`asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}`);
      parts.push(usd(s.cost));
      if (s.firstRef) parts.push(refLabel(s.firstRef));
    }
  } else if (s.urgency === 'queued') {
    if (s.priority > 0) parts.push(`Priority ${s.priority}`);
    if (blockedCount(s)) parts.push(`blocked by ${plural(blockedCount(s), 'card', 'cards')}`);
    if (s.queuedBy) parts.push(`asked by ${s.queuedBy.name}`);
  } else {
    if (s.priority > 0) parts.push(`Priority ${s.priority}`);
    parts.push(usd(s.cost));
  }
  const head = capFirst(parts.join(' · '));
  if (!due) return [{ text: head }];
  return [{ text: head ? `${head} · ` : '' }, due];
}
export const quietAction = (s: Pick<PhoneSummary, 'urgency' | 'kind'>): 'Decide' | 'Open' => (isStopped(s) ? 'Decide' : 'Open');
export const quietCount = (st: { count: number; blocked: number }): string => (st.count === 0 ? 'empty' : st.blocked ? `${st.count}, ${st.blocked} blocked` : String(st.count));
```

`dueShort('2026-10-06')` is `6 Oct` and `dueLong` is `6 October` (Task 14 `board-words.ts`); `refLabel(ref)` returns the reference's title for the fixture refs (it is what the desktop chips print today).

- [ ] **Step 6: Write the clamp action and the test fixture**

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/phone/clamp.ts
/**
 * Reports whether a line-clamped element hides text, so "Read the rest" renders only when there is a
 * rest to read (shell-and-board §5). Re-measures on resize. 1px of rounding is "fits".
 */
export function clampWatch(node: HTMLElement, set: (clamped: boolean) => void): { update(next: (clamped: boolean) => void): void; destroy(): void } {
  let report = set;
  const measure = () => report(node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight + 1);
  measure();
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
  ro.observe(node);
  return { update(next) { report = next; measure(); }, destroy() { ro.disconnect(); } };
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/daylight/PdHello.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** The Daylight phone greeting, drawn in the shell's sky (shell-and-board §3.3 phone crew, §3.6). */
  import './pd-hello.css';
  import { Face, type Mood, type Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { BoardModel } from '../board-model';
  import { needsCounts, phoneHello, phoneHelloP } from '../phone/phone-words';
  import { joinAnd } from '$lib/words';

  let { model, phase, firstName }: { model: BoardModel; phase: Phase; firstName: string } = $props();

  const counts = $derived(needsCounts(model.ordered));
  const line = $derived(phoneHelloP(counts));
  /** Agents of needs cards (needs), then of working cards (working), then queuers (resting on phones, O-2). */
  const crew = $derived.by(() => {
    const seen = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood }>();
    for (const s of model.ordered) if (s.urgency === 'needs' && s.lastAgent && !seen.has(s.lastAgent.id)) seen.set(s.lastAgent.id, { ...s.lastAgent, mood: 'needs' });
    for (const s of model.ordered) if (s.urgency === 'working' && s.lastAgent && !seen.has(s.lastAgent.id)) seen.set(s.lastAgent.id, { ...s.lastAgent, mood: 'working' });
    for (const s of model.ordered) {
      const q = s.queuedBy?.agent;
      if (q && s.urgency !== 'done' && s.urgency !== 'closed' && !seen.has(q.id)) seen.set(q.id, { id: q.id, name: s.queuedBy!.name, iconUrl: q.iconUrl, mood: 'resting' });
    }
    return [...seen.values()];
  });
  const needNames = $derived(crew.filter((c) => c.mood === 'needs').map((c) => c.name));
  const workNames = $derived(crew.filter((c) => c.mood === 'working').map((c) => c.name));
  const small = $derived(
    needNames.length
      ? `${joinAnd(needNames)} ${needNames.length === 1 ? 'needs' : 'need'} you`
      : workNames.length ? `${joinAnd(workNames)} ${workNames.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} at work` : '',
  );
</script>

<section class="pd-hello" aria-label="Greeting">
  <h1>{phoneHello(phase, firstName)}</h1>
  <p><strong>{line.strong}</strong>{line.rest ? ` ${line.rest}` : ''}</p>
  {#if crew.length}
    <div class="crew">
      <ul aria-label="Agents on this board">
        {#each crew as c (c.id)}<li><Face id={c.id} label={c.name} mood={c.mood} size={32} src={c.iconUrl ?? undefined} /></li>{/each}
      </ul>
      {#if small}<small>{small}</small>{/if}
    </div>
  {/if}
</section>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** One Daylight phone tile (SP-Phone-Board-Daylight `article.tile`), in the wants lane or a stage lane. */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';

  import { sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { s, stages }: { s: PhoneSummary; stages: Stage[] } = $props();

  let moveOpen = $state(false);
  let clamped = $state(false);
  let expanded = $state(false);

  const needs = $derived(s.urgency === 'needs');
  const stopped = $derived(isStopped(s));
  const said = $derived(s.card.needsHuman?.detail ?? s.attention?.detail ?? null);
  const blockers = $derived(s.card.blockedBy ?? []);
  const chip = $derived(blockers.length ? blockedByChip(blockers.map((b) => b.title)) : null);
  const due = $derived(pdDue(s));
  const who = $derived(s.lastAgent?.name ?? 'The agent');

  function onTitleKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'm' || e.key === 'M') { e.preventDefault(); moveOpen = true; }
  }
</script>

<!-- `.tile` clips (overflow: hidden), so the move menu sits beside it in a positioned box of the same size. -->
<div class="pd-tilebox">
<article class="tile" class:p1={s.priority === 1} class:p2={s.priority === 2}>
  {#if s.priority > 0}<span class="sr">Priority {s.priority}</span>{/if}
  <div class="trow">
    <span class="stg">{pdStageLine(s)}</span>
    <button class="mv" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move card to another stage" aria-expanded={moveOpen} onclick={() => (moveOpen = !moveOpen)}><PhoneIcon name="move" />Move</button>
  </div>
  <h3><button class="tt" type="button" aria-label={phoneTitleLabel(s)} onclick={() => app.openCard(s.id)} onkeydown={onTitleKey}>{s.title}</button></h3>

  {#if needs && s.kind !== 'no-owner' && said}
    <div class="bub">
      <Face id={s.lastAgent?.id ?? s.id} label={who} mood="needs" size={24} src={s.lastAgent?.iconUrl ?? undefined} />
      <div class="say">
        <span class="who">{who} · needs you</span>
        <p class:open={expanded} use:clampWatch={(v) => (clamped = v)}>{sentenceCase(said)}</p>
        {#if clamped || expanded}
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={expanded} onclick={() => (expanded = !expanded)}>{expanded ? 'Show less' : 'Read the rest'}</button>
        {/if}
      </div>
    </div>
  {/if}

  {#if needs && (s.firstRef || s.labels.length)}
    <div class="chips">
      {#if s.firstRef}<a class="chip ref" href={safeHref(s.firstRef.url) ?? undefined} target="_blank" rel="noopener"><PhoneIcon name="doc" />{refLabel(s.firstRef)}</a>{/if}
      {#each s.labels as l (l.id)}<span class="chip">{l.name}</span>{/each}
      {#if s.moreLabels > 0}<span class="chip" title="{s.moreLabels} more label{s.moreLabels === 1 ? '' : 's'}">+{s.moreLabels}</span>{/if}
    </div>
  {:else if !needs && chip}
    <div class="chips"><span class="chip blk" title={chip.title}><PhoneIcon name="blocked" />{chip.text}</span></div>
  {/if}

  {#if needs && s.kind === 'no-owner'}<p style="font-size: 15px;">{personStageText(s.stageName)}</p>{/if}

  <div class="meta">
    {#if s.urgency === 'queued'}<span class="agent">— <span class="mood">not picked up yet</span></span>{/if}
    {#if s.urgency === 'working' && s.lastAgent}<span class="agent"><Face id={s.lastAgent.id} label={s.lastAgent.name} mood="working" size={16} />{s.lastAgent.name} <span class="mood">working</span></span>{/if}
    {#if s.urgency === 'done'}<span class="chip" style="background: var(--vk-mood-done); color: var(--vk-face-ink); border-color: transparent;"><PhoneIcon name="check" />Done</span>{/if}
    {#if (needs || s.urgency === 'queued') && s.queuedBy}
      <span class="chip"><Face id={s.queuedBy.agent?.id ?? s.queuedBy.name} label={s.queuedBy.name} mood="resting" size={16} src={s.queuedBy.agent?.iconUrl ?? undefined} /> asked by {s.queuedBy.name}</span>
    {/if}
    {#if (needs && s.kind !== 'no-owner') || s.urgency === 'done'}<span>{usd(s.cost)}</span>{/if}
    {#if stopped}<span>attempt {s.attemptCount}</span>{/if}
    {#if due && (needs || s.urgency === 'queued')}
      {#if due.overdue}<span class="due"><PhoneIcon name="warn" />{due.text}</span>{:else}<span>{due.text}</span>{/if}
    {/if}
  </div>

  {#if needs}
    <div class="act"><button class="btn go" type="button" onclick={() => app.openCard(s.id)}>{actionWord(s)}</button></div>
  {/if}
</article>
<CardMoveMenu card={s.card} {stages} bind:open={moveOpen} trigger={false} />
</div>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/layouts/BoardDaylightPhone.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Board-Daylight: stage chips, the wants lane, one lane per stage with cards, the empty stages. */
  import '../daylight/pd-phone.css';
  import type { BoardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import PdTile from '../daylight/PdTile.svelte';
  import PhoneIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PhoneIcon.svelte';
  import { blockedChip, laneNote, wantsIntro, wantsOrder } from '../phone/phone-words';
  import { ownerShort } from '../stage-owner';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { model }: BoardLayoutProps = $props();

  const apiStages = $derived([...(app.board?.stages ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order));
  const wants = $derived(wantsOrder(model.ordered).filter((s) => s.urgency === 'needs'));
  const wantStages = $derived(new Set(wants.map((s) => s.stageKey)).size);
  const lanes = $derived(model.stages.filter((st) => st.count > 0));
  const empties = $derived(model.stages.filter((st) => st.count === 0));
  let current = $state('wants');
</script>

<div class="pd-board">
  <nav class="step" aria-label="Stages">
    {#if wants.length}
      <a href="#wants" class="needs" aria-current={current === 'wants' ? 'true' : undefined} onclick={() => (current = 'wants')}>Needs you <b>{wants.length}</b></a>
    {/if}
    {#each model.stages as st (st.key)}
      <a href={st.count ? `#stage-${st.key}` : '#empty'} class:empty={st.count === 0} aria-current={current === st.key ? 'true' : undefined} onclick={() => (current = st.key)}>{st.name} <b>{st.count}</b></a>
    {/each}
  </nav>

  {#if wants.length}
    <section class="lane wants" id="wants" aria-labelledby="h-wants">
      <div class="lh">
        <h2 id="h-wants">Needs you <span class="n">{wants.length}</span></h2>
        <p>{wantsIntro(wantStages)}</p>
      </div>
      {#each wants as s (s.id)}<PdTile {s} stages={apiStages} />{/each}
    </section>
  {/if}

  {#each lanes as st, i (st.key)}
    {@const here = model.ordered.filter((s) => s.stageKey === st.key)}
    {@const note = laneNote(here.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'needs').length, here.filter((s) => s.urgency === 'queued').length)}
    {@const chip = st.blocked ? blockedChip(st.blocked) : null}
    {#if i > 0}<div class="sep"></div>{/if}
    <section class="lane" id="stage-{st.key}" aria-labelledby="h-{st.key}">
      <div class="lh">
        <h2 id="h-{st.key}">{st.name} <span class="n">{st.count}</span>{#if chip} <span class="chip blk" title={chip.title}><PhoneIcon name="blocked" />{chip.text}</span>{/if}</h2>
        <p>{ownerShort(st)}</p>
      </div>
      {#if note}<p class="note">{note}</p>{/if}
      {#each here.filter((s) => s.urgency !== 'needs') as s (s.id)}<PdTile {s} stages={apiStages} />{/each}
    </section>
  {/each}

  {#if empties.length}
    <section class="empties" id="empty" aria-labelledby="h-empty">
      <h2 id="h-empty">Empty stages · {empties.length}</h2>
      <ul>
        {#each empties as st (st.key)}<li><b>{st.name}</b> · {ownerShort(st)}</li>{/each}
      </ul>
    </section>
  {/if}
</div>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/board/layouts/BoardStudioPhone.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Board-Studio: hero, quick filter, figures, 01 where the cards are, 02 the rows, 03 the stages. */
  import '../studio/pb-phone.css';
  import { greeting } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { BoardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import StudioCardPhone from '../studio/StudioCardPhone.svelte';
  import { daysOverdue, needsCounts, phoneLede, smAria, stagesSummaryRight, studioFigs, studioStageO, unitOf, wantsOrder, rowIndex } from '../phone/phone-words';
  import { ownerShort } from '../stage-owner';
  import { clockHM } from '$lib/when';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { model, phase }: BoardLayoutProps = $props();
  type Q = 'all' | 'needs' | 'working' | 'queued' | 'done';
  let filter = $state<Q>('all');
  let stagesOpen = $state(false);

  const apiStages = $derived([...(app.board?.stages ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order));
  const rows = $derived(wantsOrder(model.ordered).map((s, i) => ({ s, i })));
  const shown = $derived(rows.filter(({ s }) => filter === 'all' || s.urgency === filter));
  const c = $derived(model.counts);
  const kick = $derived(`${clockHM((app.syncedAt ?? new Date()).toISOString())} · ${greeting(phase, 'studio').toLowerCase()}`);
  const noOwner = $derived(model.needs.filter((s) => s.kind === 'no-owner'));
  const overdueDays = $derived(noOwner.length === 1 && noOwner[0].overdue && noOwner[0].dueAt ? daysOverdue(noOwner[0].dueAt, Date.now()) : 0);
  const lede = $derived(phoneLede({ stopped: needsCounts(model.ordered).stopped, noOwner: noOwner.length, daysOverdue: overdueDays, queuedBlocked: c.queuedBlocked, done: c.done }));
  const figs = $derived(studioFigs({ spend: model.spend7d, overBudget: c.overBudget, overdue: c.overdue, stages: model.stages.length, blocked: c.blocked }));
  const QF: Array<{ key: Q; label: string; count: number; sig?: boolean }> = $derived([
    { key: 'all', label: 'All', count: c.all }, { key: 'needs', label: 'Needs', count: c.needs, sig: true },
    { key: 'working', label: 'Working', count: c.working }, { key: 'queued', label: 'Idle', count: c.queued }, { key: 'done', label: 'Done', count: c.done },
  ]);
</script>

<main class="pb-main">
  <section aria-label="Board summary" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;">
    <div class="pb-hero">
      <span class="big" aria-hidden="true">{c.needs}</span>
      <div>
        <span class="kick" style="display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">{kick}</span>
        {#if c.needs === 0}<h1>None of the {c.all} cards is waiting on a person</h1>
        {:else}<h1><span class="sr">{c.needs} </span>of {c.all} {c.all === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} {c.needs === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} waiting on a person</h1>{/if}
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="pb-lede">{lede}</p>
    <div class="pb-qf" role="group" aria-label="Quick filter">
      {#each QF as q (q.key)}<button type="button" aria-pressed={filter === q.key} class:sig={q.sig} onclick={() => (filter = q.key)}>{q.label} <b>{q.count}</b></button>{/each}
    </div>
    <div class="pb-figs">
      {#each figs as f (f.label)}<div class:sig={f.sig}><b class:z={f.z}>{f.value}{#if f.small}<small>{f.small}</small>{/if}</b><span>{f.label}</span></div>{/each}
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="pb-sm-h">
    <div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="pb-sm-h">Where the cards are</h2><span class="r">1 square = 1 card</span></div>
    <div class="pb-sm">
      {#each model.stages as st, i (st.key)}
        {@const units = rows.filter(({ s }) => s.stageKey === st.key).map(({ s }) => unitOf(s))}
        <a class:z={st.count === 0} href="#stage-{i + 1}" aria-label={smAria(i + 1, st.name, st.count)}>
          <span class="band c{i + 1}"></span><span class="no">{rowIndex(i)}</span><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">{st.count}</span>
          <span class="units" aria-hidden="true">{#each units as u, k (k)}<span class="u {u}"></span>{/each}</span>
        </a>
      {/each}
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="pb-c-h">
    <div class="hd"><span class="no">02</span><h2 id="pb-c-h">Cards, needs you first</h2><span class="r">{shown.length} {shown.length === 1 ? 'row' : 'rows'}</span></div>
    <span class="sr">Each row: status, card, agent, stage, attempts, age, next step, cost, due.</span>
    <div>
      {#each shown as { s, i } (s.id)}
        {@const firstInStage = rows.find((r) => r.s.stageKey === s.stageKey)?.s.id === s.id}
        <div id={firstInStage ? `stage-${s.stageIndex + 1}` : undefined} style="display: contents;"><StudioCardPhone {s} index={i} stages={apiStages} /></div>
      {/each}
    </div>
  </section>

  <details class="pb-stages" bind:open={stagesOpen}>

</main>
```

(`model.counts.blocked` counts cards blocked on another card — 2 on DX; the multiples' `href="#stage-{i}"` scrolls to the first row of that stage, shell-and-board §5. A `display: contents` anchor wrapper carries the id so the row's own box is untouched.)

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Board-Quiet: a header, five groups, the stages table. Plain text throughout. */
  import '../quiet/qb-phone.css';

    { id: 'g1', label: 'Needs your decision', cards: wantsOrder(model.ordered).filter((s) => s.urgency === 'needs') },
    { id: 'g2', label: 'In progress', cards: model.working },
    { id: 'g3', label: 'Waiting to start', cards: model.queued },
    { id: 'g4', label: 'Done', cards: model.done },

  ]);

<div class="qb-board">

          <tr><th scope="row">{i + 1}. {st.name}</th><td class="n">{quietCount(st)}</td><td>{ownerShort(st, ': ')}</td></tr>
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</div>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/phone-card-words.ts
/**
 * Words for the four phone cards (card digests §6, 05-amendments §7–§8). Pure: every string a phone
 * layout prints that is not the agent's own text. Agent text is sentence-cased here, never rewritten.
 */
import { greeting, type Mood, type Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, Attempt, Activity, Member, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { isControlRow, isNarrative, visibleActivities } from '$lib/activity-groups';
import type { LeadKind } from '$lib/components/card/card-lead';
import type { CardModel } from '$lib/components/card/card-model.svelte';
import { normalisePlan, type PlanStep } from '$lib/components/card/plan';
import { referenceSource } from '$lib/components/card/references';
import { specGroups } from '$lib/components/card/spec-groups';
import type { LinkGroups, RemoveArgs } from '$lib/components/link-groups';
import { PAPER_PHASE } from '$lib/components/board/board-words';
import { ageWords as ageWordsOf } from '$lib/age';
import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
import { clockHM, dayMonth } from '$lib/when';
import { plural, sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';

export const STOP_COPY = 'Blocked. Waiting on you; the reason is shown at the top of this card.';
export const RESUME_PLACEHOLDER = 'For example: what you checked, and what the agent should look at next.';
const usd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
export const usdShort = (n: number): string => (Number.isInteger(n) ? `$${n}` : usd(n));
export const triesWord = (n: number): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'try' : 'tries'}`;
const later = (stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number) => stages.slice(i + 1).map((s) => s.name);

export function stripWord(kind: LeadKind): string {
  if (kind === 'stopped' || kind === 'failed' || kind === 'budget') return 'stopped';
  if (kind === 'review') return 'awaiting review';
  if (kind === 'question') return 'question pending';
  if (kind === 'working') return 'working';
  if (kind === 'done') return 'done';
  return 'queued';
}
export function trackAria(stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number, kind: LeadKind, o: { archived?: boolean; here?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const name = stages[i]?.name ?? '';
  if (o.archived) return `Stopped at stage ${i + 1} of ${stages.length}, ${name}, archived`;
  return `Stage ${i + 1} of ${stages.length}, ${name}, ${stripWord(kind)}${o.here === false ? '' : ' here'}`;
}
export function daylightCaption(stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number, kind: LeadKind, archived: boolean): { lead: string; bold: string; tail: string } {
  const name = stages[i]?.name ?? '';
  const next = later(stages, i);
  return { lead: `Stage ${i + 1} of ${stages.length} · `, bold: archived ? `${name}, where it stopped` : `${name}, ${stripWord(kind)} here`, tail: next.length ? ` · next: ${next.join(', ')}` : '' };
}
export function paperCaption(stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number, needsYou: boolean): string {
  const next = later(stages, i)[0];
  return `Stage ${i + 1} of ${stages.length} · ${stages[i]?.name ?? ''}${needsYou ? ', where it stopped' : ', now'}${next ? ` · then ${next}` : ''}`;
}
export function studioCaption(stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number, kind: LeadKind): { bold: string; tail: string } {
  const next = later(stages, i)[0];
  return { bold: `${stages[i]?.name ?? ''} · ${stripWord(kind)} here`, tail: next ? ` · next ${next}` : '' };
}
export function dockHeading(kind: LeadKind, attempts: number): { title: string; small: string } {
  const title = kind === 'failed' ? 'Failed, waiting on you' : kind === 'budget' ? 'Over budget, waiting on you' : kind === 'stopped' ? 'Stopped, waiting on you' : 'Waiting on you';
  return { title, small: `${triesWord(attempts)} so far` };
}
export function resumeOptions(targets: { key: string; n: number; name: string; current: boolean; allowed: boolean }[]) {
  return targets.map((t) => ({ value: t.key, label: `${t.n} · ${t.name}${t.current ? ' (where it stopped)' : ''}`, disabled: !t.allowed }));
}

// ── runs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type AttemptWordInput = Pick<Attempt, 'status' | 'outcome'> & { completion?: { ok?: boolean } | null };
export function attemptWord(a: AttemptWordInput, latest: boolean, leadKind: LeadKind): string {
  if ((a.outcome === 'completed' && a.completion?.ok === false) || a.outcome === 'sent_back') return 'Sent back';
  if (latest && leadKind === 'stopped') return 'Stopped';
  if (a.outcome === 'blocked' || a.status === 'blocked' || a.status === 'input-required') return 'Stopped';
  if (a.outcome === 'failed' || a.status === 'failed') return 'Failed';
  if (a.outcome === 'completed') return 'Done';
  return 'Running';
}
export function attemptReason(a: Pick<Attempt, 'failureReason'>, word: string): string {
  if (a.failureReason) return `${word}: ${a.failureReason}`;
  return word === 'Stopped' ? 'Stopped: waiting on you' : word;
}
// Formatters are built per call, not at module load: a formatter fixes the viewer's time zone when it is
// constructed, and tests (and the harness) set the zone after imports have run.
const fmt = (locale: string, o: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, o);
const dayKey = (iso: string): string => fmt('en-CA', { year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
export const dayShort = (iso: string): string => fmt('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).format(new Date(iso)).replace(',', '');
export const studioWhen = (iso: string): string => `${fmt('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }).format(new Date(iso)).replace(',', '')} ${clockHM(iso)}`;
const TYPE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { action: 'Did', response: 'Said', thought: 'Thought', prompt: 'You said', elicitation: 'Asked' };
const TYPE_WORD_STUDIO: Record<string, string> = { action: 'Action', response: 'Response', thought: 'Thought', prompt: 'You', elicitation: 'Question' };
export type EventRow = { key: number; verb: string; body: string; time: string; stop: boolean };
export function eventRows(rows: Activity[], leadSentence: string | null, showToolCalls: boolean, form: 'plain' | 'studio' = 'plain'): EventRow[] {
  const { rows: shown } = visibleActivities(rows, isNarrative, showToolCalls, isControlRow);
  const words = form === 'studio' ? TYPE_WORD_STUDIO : TYPE_WORD;
  let prevDay: string | null = null;
  return shown.map((a, i) => {
    const day = dayKey(a.ts);
    const time = i === 0 || day !== prevDay ? dayShort(a.ts) : clockHM(a.ts);
    prevDay = day;
    const stop = a.signal === 'stop' || a.type === 'error';
    const body = leadSentence && a.body?.trim() === leadSentence.trim() ? STOP_COPY : (a.body ?? '');
    return { key: a.seq, verb: stop ? 'Stopped' : (a.action ?? words[a.type] ?? a.type), body, time, stop };
  });
}

// ── details ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type DetailValue =
  | { kind: 'text'; shown: string; more: string | null }
  | { kind: 'evidence'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'matrix'; id: string; card: string }
  | { kind: 'repo'; text: string; href: string }
  | { kind: 'raw'; text: string };
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
/** The first-paragraph rule (coordinator): a value stored as `shown\n\ncontinuation` shows `shown` and offers "Show more". */
export function detailValue(v: unknown, criteria: string[] | null, heading: string): DetailValue {
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    const i = v.indexOf('\n\n');
    return i < 0 ? { kind: 'text', shown: v, more: null } : { kind: 'text', shown: v.slice(0, i), more: v.slice(i + 2) };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v) && criteria && v.length === criteria.length && v.every((x, i) => x === criteria[i])) {
    return { kind: 'evidence', text: `${v.length} items, listed under ${heading}.` };
  }
  if (isObj(v) && typeof v.matrixId === 'string' && typeof v.card === 'string') return { kind: 'matrix', id: v.matrixId, card: v.card };
  if (isObj(v) && typeof v.repo === 'string' && typeof v.visibility === 'string' && typeof v.policyUrl === 'string') {
    return { kind: 'repo', text: `${v.repo} · ${v.visibility} · `, href: v.policyUrl };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return { kind: 'raw', text: v.map((x) => (typeof x === 'string' ? x : JSON.stringify(x))).join(', ') };
  return { kind: 'raw', text: isObj(v) ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v) };
}
const SHORT_HEADING: Record<string, string> = { 'Who it is about': 'who' };
export const studioDetailsSummary = (labels: string[], rows: number): string =>
  `${plural(rows, 'field', 'fields')} · ${labels.map((l) => SHORT_HEADING[l] ?? l.toLowerCase()).join(', ')}`;

// ── links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type LinkRow = { key: string; label: string; title: string; href: string; remove: RemoveArgs };
export function linkRows(g: LinkGroups, boardId: string): LinkRow[] {
  const row = (group: string, label: string, r: { cardId: string; title: string; remove: RemoveArgs }, board = boardId): LinkRow =>
    ({ key: `${group}:${r.cardId}`, label, title: r.title, href: `/b/${board}/c/${r.cardId}`, remove: r.remove });
  return [
    ...g.blockedBy.map((r) => row('blockedBy', 'Blocked by', r)),
    ...g.resolvedBlockedBy.map((r) => row('resolvedBlockedBy', 'Was blocked by', r)),
    ...g.blocks.map((r) => row('blocks', 'Blocks', r)),
    ...g.relates.map((r) => row('relates', 'Relates to', r)),
    ...g.supersedes.map((r) => row('supersedes', r.direction === 'supersedes' ? 'Supersedes' : 'Superseded by', r)),
    ...g.advisory.map((r) => row('advisory', `${r.relation === 'blocked-by' ? 'Blocked by' : r.relation === 'blocks' ? 'Blocks' : 'Relates to'} · advisory`, r, r.boardId)),
  ];
}

// ── the view every phone layout reads ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type PhoneCardInput = Pick<
  CardModel,
  | 'card' | 'boardId' | 'stages' | 'stageIndex' | 'stageName' | 'lead' | 'agent' | 'delegate' | 'provenance' | 'attempts' | 'activityGroups'
  | 'estimate' | 'projectName' | 'milestoneName' | 'acceptanceCriteria' | 'labels' | 'ageHours' | 'counts' | 'handoff' | 'archived'
  | 'related' | 'refs' | 'linkGroups' | 'decidedGates' | 'showToolCalls' | 'comments'
>;
export interface PhoneCardCtx { members: Member[]; agents: AgentSummary[]; cardCap: number | null; nowMs: number }

export function phoneCardView(m: PhoneCardInput, ctx: PhoneCardCtx) {
  const c = m.card;
  const lastAttempt = m.attempts.at(-1) ?? null;
  const lastAgent = lastAttempt ? { id: lastAttempt.agentId, name: displayAgent(lastAttempt.agentId, ctx.agents) } : null;
  const ownerName = displayPrincipal(c.ownerUserId, ctx.members, ctx.agents);
  const grantOwnerName = c.queuedGrantOwner ? displayPrincipal(c.queuedGrantOwner, ctx.members, ctx.agents) : null;
  const p = m.provenance;
  const queuer = p.known ? { id: p.agent?.id ?? p.queuedByName, name: p.queuedByName, byAgent: p.byAgent } : null;
  const grantSize = c.queuedGrant?.length ?? 0;
  const kind = m.lead.kind;
  const stageOf = (key: string | null) => m.stages.find((s) => s.key === key)?.name ?? key ?? '';
  const attemptNo = new Map(m.attempts.map((a, i) => [a.runId, i + 1]));
  const wordOf = (a: Attempt) => attemptWord(a, a === lastAttempt, kind);
  const runs = [...m.activityGroups].reverse().map((g, i) => {
    const a = m.attempts.find((x) => x.runId === g.runId);
    const n = attemptNo.get(g.runId) ?? m.activityGroups.indexOf(g) + 1;
    const agentName = displayAgent(g.agentId ?? a?.agentId ?? null, ctx.agents);
    return {
      key: g.runId, title: `Run ${n} · ${stageOf(g.stageKey)}`, meta: `${agentName} · ${a ? wordOf(a) : 'Running'} · attempt ${n}`, open: i === 0,
      rows: eventRows(g.activities, m.lead.sentence, m.showToolCalls),
    };
  });
  const plan: PlanStep[] | null = normalisePlan(c.spec?.plan);
  const groups = specGroups(c.spec ?? null);
  const i = m.stageIndex;
  const prev = i > 0 ? m.stages[i - 1].name : null;
  const handoffSummary = m.handoff && typeof m.handoff.summary === 'string' ? m.handoff.summary : m.handoff ? String(Object.values(m.handoff).find((v) => typeof v === 'string') ?? '') : null;
  const needsCap = ctx.cardCap && ctx.cardCap > 0 ? `card cap ${usd(ctx.cardCap)}` : 'no card cap set';
  const est = m.estimate?.estimatedUsd ?? null;
  return {
    ownerName, grantOwnerName, queuer, lastAgent,
    grantLine: queuer && grantOwnerName ? `Queued by ${queuer.name} on ${grantOwnerName}'s grant · ${grantSize} agents may be dispatched.` : null,
    grantTitle: grantOwnerName ? `Queued on ${grantOwnerName}'s grant` : null,
    speaker: m.agent.name || lastAgent?.name || 'the agent',
    live: !m.archived && m.lead.needsYou && (kind === 'stopped' || kind === 'failed' || kind === 'budget'),
    stateWord: m.archived ? 'Archived' : m.lead.needsYou ? 'Waiting on you' : kind === 'working' ? 'Working' : kind === 'done' ? 'Done' : 'Queued',
    claim: m.delegate.id ? `${m.delegate.name} · working it` : 'Unclaimed',
    priorityWord: c.priority > 0 ? `P${c.priority}` : 'none',
    dueWord: c.dueAt ? dayMonth(c.dueAt) : null,
    labelsWord: m.labels.length ? m.labels.map((l) => l.name).join(', ') : null,
    ageWords: ageWordsOf(m.ageHours ?? 0),
    runs,
    attemptRows: m.attempts.map((a, k) => ({
      n: k + 1, agentId: a.agentId, agentName: displayAgent(a.agentId, ctx.agents), usd: usd(a.costUsd),
      mood: (a === lastAttempt && m.lead.needsYou ? 'needs' : 'resting') as Mood, text: attemptReason(a, wordOf(a)),
    })),
    cost: { amount: usd(c.costUsd), rest: ` spent · ${est ? `of ${usd(est)}` : 'no estimate'} · ${needsCap}` },
    subtasks: { count: `${m.counts.openChildren}/${m.counts.children}`, line: `${m.counts.openChildren} of ${m.counts.children} open.${m.counts.children === 0 ? ' No sub-tasks yet.' : ''}` },
    project: m.projectName
      ? { summary: m.projectName.split(' — ').at(-1) ?? m.projectName, line: `${m.projectName} · ${m.milestoneName ?? 'no milestone'}` }
      : { summary: 'none', line: null },
    handoff: {
      summary: prev ? `from ${prev}` : 'none',
      text: handoffSummary
        ? `“${handoffSummary}”`
        : prev && queuer ? `From ${prev}: queued by ${queuer.name} on ${dayMonth(c.createdAt)} with the brief above. No earlier stage output.` : 'No handoff yet.',
    },
    plan, planSummary: plan?.length ? `${plan.filter((s) => s.done).length}/${plan.length}` : 'none yet',
    groups, fieldsCount: groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0),
    refs: m.refs.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, href: r.url, title: r.title ?? r.url, subtitle: r.subtitle ?? null, source: referenceSource(r) })),
    links: linkRows(m.linkGroups, m.boardId ?? ''),
    related: m.related.length,
    decisions: m.decidedGates.length,
    comments: m.comments.list.length,
  };
}
export type PhoneCardView = ReturnType<typeof phoneCardView>;

// ── Paper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const paperDay = (now: Date, phase: Phase): string => `${fmt('en-GB', { weekday: 'long' }).format(now)}, ${PAPER_PHASE[phase]}`;
export function paperEye(needsYou: boolean, archivedAt: string | null): string | null {
  if (archivedAt) return `Archived on ${fmt('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }).format(new Date(archivedAt))}`;
  return needsYou ? 'A letter that needs a reply' : null;
}
export function paperScFacts(v: PhoneCardView, m: Pick<CardModel, 'stageName' | 'card' | 'delegate'>): string[] {
  return [
    v.stateWord,
    v.priorityWord === 'none' ? 'no priority' : v.priorityWord,
    v.dueWord ? `due ${v.dueWord}` : 'no due date',
    v.labelsWord ?? 'no labels',
    `in ${m.stageName} ${v.ageWords}`,
    m.card.attemptCount > 1 ? `attempt ${m.card.attemptCount}` : null,
    `owner ${v.ownerName}`,
    v.queuer ? `asked by ${v.queuer.name}` : null,
    m.delegate.id ? `${m.delegate.name} working it` : 'unclaimed',
  ].filter((x): x is string => !!x);
}
export function paperEnclosures(v: PhoneCardView, m: Pick<CardModel, 'counts' | 'card'>) {
  const k = m.counts;
  return {
    brief: `${plural(k.criteria, 'thing', 'things')} to prove · ${plural(v.fieldsCount, 'detail', 'details')} · ${v.project.line ? 'project' : 'no project'}`,
    happened: `${plural(k.runs, 'run', 'runs')} · ${plural(k.attempts, 'attempt', 'attempts')} · ${v.decisions ? plural(v.decisions, 'decision', 'decisions') : 'no decisions'} · ${v.cost.amount}`,
    waiting: `${k.links ? plural(k.links, 'link', 'links') : 'no links'} · ${k.children ? `${k.openChildren} of ${k.children} sub-tasks open` : 'no sub-tasks'}`,
    attached: `${plural(k.refs, 'reference', 'references')} · ${v.related ? `${v.related} related` : 'no related prior work'}`,
    correspondence: v.comments ? plural(v.comments, 'comment', 'comments') : 'no comments yet',
  };
}

// ── Quiet ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LEAD_VERB: Partial<Record<LeadKind, string>> = { stopped: 'Stopped', failed: 'Failed', budget: 'Stopped at the budget', review: 'Waiting for review', question: 'Asked a question' };
export const quietLead = (kind: LeadKind, attempts: number): string => `${LEAD_VERB[kind] ?? 'Waiting'}. Waiting for you. ${triesWord(attempts)} so far.`;
export function quietMetaTail(kind: LeadKind, ageWords: string): string {
  if (kind === 'stopped' || kind === 'failed' || kind === 'budget') return `${kind === 'failed' ? 'Failed' : 'Stopped'} ${ageWords} ago`;
  if (kind === 'working') return 'Working';
  if (kind === 'done') return 'Done';
  if (kind === 'review') return 'Waiting for your review';
  if (kind === 'question') return 'Asked a question';
  return 'Queued';
}
export function quietState(kind: LeadKind, needsYou: boolean, archived: boolean): string {
  const live = needsYou
    ? kind === 'review' ? 'Waiting for your review' : kind === 'question' ? 'Waiting for your answer' : `${kind === 'failed' ? 'Failed' : 'Stopped'}, waiting on you`
    : kind === 'working' ? 'Working' : kind === 'done' ? 'Done' : 'Queued';
  return archived ? `Archived (was ${live.toLowerCase()})` : live;
}
export const quietAgent = (delegate: string | null, last: string | null): string => (delegate ? `${delegate}, working it.` : last ? `${last} (last run). Unclaimed.` : 'Unclaimed.');
export const quietAskedBy = (q: string, grantOwner: string | null): string => (grantOwner ? `${q}, on ${grantOwner}'s grant` : q);
export const quietInStage = (stage: string, ageWords: string, attempts: number): string => `${stage} for ${ageWords}${attempts > 0 ? `, attempt ${attempts}` : ''}`;
export const quietStages = (stages: Pick<Stage, 'name'>[], i: number): string =>
  stages.map((s, k) => `${k + 1} ${s.name}${k < i ? ' (done)' : k === i ? ' (here)' : ''}`).join(', ');

// ── Studio ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/** Display-only code spans (G-3, the verified regex); the text is never altered. */
const TOKEN = /\b(?:acps|evt|run|card|brd|agt)_[\w-]+|\b[a-z][\w-]*(?:\/[\w-]+)*\/[a-z][\w-]*\b|\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+\b/g;
export function codeTokens(text: string): Array<{ text: string; code: boolean }> {
  const out: Array<{ text: string; code: boolean }> = [];
  let at = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(TOKEN)) {
    if (m.index! > at) out.push({ text: text.slice(at, m.index), code: false });
    out.push({ text: m[0], code: true });
    at = m.index! + m[0].length;
  }
  if (at < text.length) out.push({ text: text.slice(at), code: false });
  return out;
}
export function studioClock(iso: string, phase: Phase): { text: string; aria: string } {
  const word = greeting(phase, 'studio').toLowerCase().replace(/[.!]$/, '');
  return { text: `${clockHM(iso)} · ${word}`, aria: `${clockHM(iso)}, ${word}` };
}
export function studioFigs(c: { stageIndex: number; stageCount: number; attempts: number; kind: LeadKind; ageHours: number | null; cost: number; estimateUsd: number | null; blocks: number; openSub: number; totalSub: number }) {
  const h = c.ageHours ?? 0;
  const days = Math.floor(h / 24);
  const age = h >= 48 ? { value: String(days), small: days === 1 ? 'day' : 'days' } : { value: String(Math.floor(h)), small: 'h' };
  const stopped = c.kind === 'stopped' || c.kind === 'failed' || c.kind === 'budget';
  return [
    { dt: 'Stage', value: String(c.stageIndex + 1), small: `/${c.stageCount}`, z: false },
    { dt: 'Tries', value: String(c.attempts), z: c.attempts === 0 },
    { dt: stopped ? 'Stopped for' : 'In stage for', ...age, z: false },
    { dt: c.estimateUsd ? `Cost · of ${usd(c.estimateUsd)}` : 'Cost · no est.', value: usd(c.cost), z: c.cost === 0 },
    { dt: 'Blocks', value: String(c.blocks), z: c.blocks === 0 },
    { dt: 'Sub-tasks', value: String(c.openSub), small: `/${c.totalSub}`, z: c.totalSub === 0 },
  ] as Array<{ dt: string; value: string; small?: string; z: boolean }>;
}
```

Notes for the implementer: `ageWords(66.15)` is `2 days` (Task 11 floors); `dayMonth('2026-10-08T06:04:57.202Z')` is `8 Oct` (Task 19); `greeting('noon', 'studio')` reads "Midday" (the board's `studioSubRight` lower-cases the same call — Task 11). `normalisePlan(undefined)` returns `null`.

```bash
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Phone-Card-Daylight --prefix small,id,kvg,gh,kv,more,lnk,rawrow,nl,addrow,inp,ta,lab,sbtn,runs,run,rt,rm,ev,evt,tm,att,refs,rf,cact --scope .pcard --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/phone-card-shared.css
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Phone-Card-Daylight --prefix sh,eb,tl,trk,bars,st,pill,chip,atm,fct,body,pin,msg,bwrap,blab,bub,btime,dock,fld,sel,go,hint,arch,secs,sec,foot --scope .pcard--daylight --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/pc-daylight.css
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Phone-Card-Paper --prefix serif,sh,back,head,light,eye,ed,trk,bars,paper,dear,voice,sigb,sc,reply,fld,sel,send,arch,encl,en,foot --scope .pcard--paper --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/pc-paper.css
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Phone-Card-Quiet --prefix top,back,hd,meta,fs,fld,sel,go,sx,facts,dsc,foot --scope .pcard--quiet --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/pc-quiet.css
node apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Phone-Card-Studio --prefix pc-,cd-pill --out apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/pc-studio.css
```

The forty shared rules (`.small` … `.cact`) are byte-identical in the Daylight, Paper and Quiet
references, so they are ported once under `.pcard`. The reference's base block (`.r`, `.wrap`, `.mono`,
`.muted`, `.ico`, `.ib`, `.face`, `.sr`) is the phone base Task 13 put in `app.css` as `.ph-root …`, so each
card root carries `ph-root`. The reference's "shell" block in the card files (`.bh .sw .nc .tb .vt .fb .nav`)
is the board behind the sheet and is not ported. Studio's `pc-*` classes are unique, so that file is not
scoped; the Annual base (`.ar-*`, `.chip.cN`, `.u.*`, `.kick`) is Task 12's `annual.css`.

Hand-written deltas:

```css
/* phone-card-shared.css — delta: wrappers that only carry a data-section take no box. */
:where(.pcard) .sec-k { display: contents; }
```

```css
/* pc-quiet.css — delta: the reference's `.r`-rooted rules, re-rooted on the card root (same specificity). */
.pcard--quiet { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; }
.pcard--quiet .ta { border: 2px solid var(--vk-color-text); font-size: 17px; }
.pcard--quiet .run, .pcard--quiet .rf { border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 0; }
.pcard--quiet .rf { padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); }
.pcard--quiet .run { border-left: 3px solid var(--vk-color-line); padding-left: 4px; }
/* from `.face svg{filter:saturate(0.4)}` (Q-2): phone faces are muted, desktop faces use grayscale. */
.pcard--quiet .face svg { filter: saturate(0.4); }
```

```css
/* pc-studio.css — delta: the reference's `.ph`-rooted rules (prefix `ph` would also take the shell's `.ph-*`). */
.pcard--studio .ar-track li { font-size: 0; }
.pcard--studio .ar-q blockquote { font-size: 17px; }
```

```css
/* phone-card-shared.css — delta: the sheet host is in normal flow so the page is as tall as the card. */
.pcard-host { display: block; min-height: 100dvh; background: var(--vk-color-bg); outline: none; }
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/PhoneDetails.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** The brief's grouped fields (`.kvg` groups) and the raw JSON row, as the D/P/Q phones draw them. */
  import PhoneIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PhoneIcon.svelte';
  import RawJson from '../RawJson.svelte';
  import { rawJson } from '../spec-details';
  import { detailValue, type PhoneCardView } from './phone-card-words';

  let { view, spec, criteria, heading, boardId }: { view: PhoneCardView; spec: unknown; criteria: string[] | null; heading: string; boardId: string } = $props();
  let open = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  let raw = $state(false);
  async function copy(): Promise<void> {
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawJson(spec)); } catch { /* refused: the raw view is one click away */ }
  }
</script>

{#each view.groups as g (g.label)}
  <div class="kvg">
    <h4 class="gh">{g.label}</h4>
    <dl class="kv">
      {#each g.rows as r (r.key)}
        {@const v = detailValue(r.value, criteria, heading)}
        <div>
          <dt>{r.label}</dt>
          <dd>
            {#if v.kind === 'text'}{open[r.key] && v.more ? `${v.shown} ${v.more}` : v.shown}{#if v.more}{' '}<button class="more" type="button" aria-expanded={!!open[r.key]} onclick={() => (open[r.key] = !open[r.key])}>{open[r.key] ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}</button>{/if}
            {:else if v.kind === 'evidence'}{v.text}
            {:else if v.kind === 'matrix'}<span class="mono id">{v.id}</span> · <a href="/b/{boardId}/c/{v.card}">onboarding card</a>
            {:else if v.kind === 'repo'}{v.text}<a href={v.href}>policy</a>
            {:else}{v.text}{/if}
          </dd>
        </div>
      {/each}
    </dl>
  </div>
{/each}
<div class="rawrow">
  <button class="lnk" type="button" aria-expanded={raw} onclick={() => (raw = !raw)}>View raw JSON</button>
  <button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={copy}><PhoneIcon name="copy" />Copy</button>
</div>
{#if raw}<RawJson value={spec} />{/if}
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Card-Daylight: sticky head, pinned brief, the agent's bubble, the resume dock, 13 sections. */
  import '../phone/phone-card-shared.css';
  import '../phone/pc-daylight.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import PhoneIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PhoneIcon.svelte';
  import PhoneDetails from '../phone/PhoneDetails.svelte';
  import PhoneRuns from '../phone/PhoneRuns.svelte';
  import PhoneAttempts from '../phone/PhoneAttempts.svelte';
  import PhoneRefs from '../phone/PhoneRefs.svelte';
  import PhoneLinks from '../phone/PhoneLinks.svelte';
  import PhoneSubtasks from '../phone/PhoneSubtasks.svelte';
  import PhoneComments from '../phone/PhoneComments.svelte';
  import PhonePlan from '../phone/PhonePlan.svelte';
  import PhoneEditForm from '../phone/PhoneEditForm.svelte';
  import GateDaylight from '../gate/GateDaylight.svelte';
  import QuestionDaylight from '../question/QuestionDaylight.svelte';
  import CardStateDaylight from '../state/CardStateDaylight.svelte';
  import { RESUME_PLACEHOLDER, daylightCaption, dockHeading, phoneCardView, resumeOptions, trackAria } from '../phone/phone-card-words';
  import { whenLabelLong } from '$lib/when';
  import { sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { model, vibe, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();

  const v = $derived(phoneCardView(model, { members: app.members, agents: app.agents, cardCap: app.board?.usage?.cardUsdCap ?? null, nowMs: Date.now() }));
  const c = $derived(model.card!);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead!);
  const cap = $derived(daylightCaption(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.kind, model.archived));
  const dock = $derived(dockHeading(lead.kind, c.attemptCount));
  let pinOpen = $state(false);
</script>

<div class="ph-root pcard pcard--daylight">
  <header class="sh">
    <div class="sh1">
      <span class="eb">{model.boardName} · {model.stageName}</span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
        <a class="ib" href={pageHref} aria-label="Open as a page" style="width: auto; padding: 0px 12px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;"><PhoneIcon name="open" form="plain" size={16} stroke={2} /><span>Open as a page</span></a>
        <button class="ib" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" onclick={onClose}><PhoneIcon name="close" /></button>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="tl">
      <h2 id="drawer-title" class:sr={model.edit.editing}>{c.title}</h2>
      <button class="ib" type="button" aria-label="Edit card" data-section="editButton" onclick={() => model.edit.start()}><PhoneIcon name="pen" /></button>
    </div>
    <div class="trk">
      <div class="bars" role="img" aria-label={trackAria(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.kind, { archived: model.archived })}>
        {#each model.stages as s, i (s.key)}<i class={i < model.stageIndex ? 'd' : i === model.stageIndex ? (lead.needsYou && !model.archived ? 's' : 'd') : undefined}></i>{/each}
      </div>
      <p>{cap.lead}<b>{cap.bold}</b>{cap.tail}</p>
    </div>
    <div class="st" data-section="status">
      <span class="pill" class:nd={lead.needsYou && !model.archived} class:ar={model.archived}>{v.stateWord}</span>
      <span>{v.claim}</span>
      <span class="muted">owner · {v.ownerName}</span>
      {#if v.queuer?.byAgent}<span class="chip" title={v.grantTitle}><Face id={v.queuer.id} label={v.queuer.name} mood="resting" size={16} /> asked by {v.queuer.name}</span>{/if}
    </div>
    <p class="fct" data-section="facts">
      <span>Priority <b>{v.priorityWord}</b></span>
      <span>Due <b>{v.dueWord ?? 'none'}</b></span>
      <span>Labels <b>{v.labelsWord ?? 'none'}</b></span>
      <span>In {model.stageName} for <b>{v.ageWords}</b></span>
      {#if c.attemptCount > 1}<span><b>Attempt {c.attemptCount}</b></span>{/if}
    </p>
  </header>

  <div class="body">
    {#if model.localError}<p class="hint" role="alert" data-section="error">{model.localError}</p>{:else}<div data-section="error" hidden></div>{/if}
    {#if model.edit.editing}<PhoneEditForm {model} />{:else}<div data-section="editForm" hidden></div>{/if}
    {#if model.archived}<CardStateDaylight kind="archived" {model} {vibe} />{/if}

    <details class="pin" bind:open={pinOpen}>
      <summary><PhoneIcon name="pin" /><span>What {v.speaker} was asked</span><span class="s">{pinOpen ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</span></summary>
      <div class="in">
        <p class="wrap" data-section="description">{c.spec?.description ?? 'No description.'}</p>
        <h4>Things to prove · {model.counts.criteria}</h4>
        <ol class="nl" data-section="criteria">{#each model.acceptanceCriteria ?? [] as a, i (i)}<li>{a}</li>{/each}</ol>
      </div>
    </details>

    {#if !model.detailLoaded}
      <CardStateDaylight kind="loading" {model} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if gate}
      <GateDaylight boardId={gate.boardId} gate={gate.gate} error={gate.error} onResponse={gate.onResponse} agent={model.agent} {lead} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if question}
      <QuestionDaylight model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if lead.kind === 'done'}
      <CardStateDaylight kind="done" {model} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else}
      {#if lead.sentence}
        <div class="msg">
          <span class="face"><Face id={model.agent.id ?? v.lastAgent?.id ?? c.id} label={v.speaker} mood={lead.needsYou ? 'needs' : model.agent.mood} size={36} /></span>
          <div class="bwrap">
            <span class="blab">{v.speaker}{lead.needsYou ? ' · needs you' : ''}</span>
            <p class="bub">{sentenceCase(lead.sentence)}</p>
            {#if lead.at}<span class="btime">{whenLabelLong(lead.at)}</span>{/if}
          </div>
        </div>
      {/if}
      {#if v.live}
        <section class="dock" aria-labelledby="dock-h" data-section="resume">
          <h3 id="dock-h">{dock.title} <small>{dock.small}</small></h3>
          <div class="fld">
            <label for="resume-at">Resume at stage</label>
            <select id="resume-at" class="sel" bind:value={model.resume.stageKey}>
              {#each resumeOptions(model.resume.targets) as o (o.value)}<option value={o.value} disabled={o.disabled}>{o.label}</option>{/each}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="fld">
            <label for="resume-note">What changed, or what should {v.speaker} do differently? It reads this.</label>
            <textarea id="resume-note" class="ta" rows="2" maxlength="8000" placeholder={RESUME_PLACEHOLDER} bind:value={model.resume.note} aria-invalid={model.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined}></textarea>
            {#if model.resume.error}<p class="hint" role="alert">{model.resume.error}</p>{/if}
          </div>
          <button class="go" type="button" disabled={model.resume.busy} onclick={() => model.resume.submit()}><PhoneIcon name="send" />{model.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button>
        </section>
      {:else}<div data-section="resume" hidden></div>{/if}
    {/if}

    <div class="secs">
      <details class="sec" data-section="plan"><summary>Plan <span class="c">{v.planSummary}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhonePlan view={v} speaker={v.speaker} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="details"><summary>Details <span class="c">{v.fieldsCount} fields</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneDetails view={v} spec={c.spec} criteria={model.acceptanceCriteria} heading="Things to prove" boardId={model.boardId ?? ''} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="project"><summary>Project <span class="c">{v.project.summary}</span></summary><div class="in">
        {#if v.project.line}<p>{v.project.line}</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>
        {:else}<p class="muted">No project.</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}
      </div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="links"><summary>Links <span class="c">{model.counts.links}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneLinks view={v} {model} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="subtasks"><summary>Sub-tasks <span class="c">{v.subtasks.count}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneSubtasks view={v} {model} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="activity" open><summary>Session activity <span class="c">{model.counts.runs} {model.counts.runs === 1 ? 'run' : 'runs'}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneRuns view={v} {model} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="decisions"><summary>Decisions <span class="c">{v.decisions}</span></summary><div class="in">
        {#if v.decisions === 0}<p class="muted">No decisions on this card yet.</p>{:else}<ul class="refs">{#each model.decidedGates as g (g.id)}<li class="rf"><b>{g.decision ?? g.status}</b></li>{/each}</ul>{/if}
      </div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="comments"><summary>Comments <span class="c">{v.comments}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneComments {model} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="handoff"><summary>Handoff <span class="c">{v.handoff.summary}</span></summary><div class="in"><p>{v.handoff.text}</p></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="cost"><summary>Cost <span class="c">{v.cost.amount}</span></summary><div class="in"><p><strong class="mono">{v.cost.amount}</strong>{v.cost.rest}</p></div></details>
      {#if model.counts.deliveryActive}
        <details class="sec" data-section="delivery"><summary>Delivery <span class="c">active</span></summary><div class="in"><p>Delivery is active on this card; approve or change it on the card page.</p><a class="lnk" href={pageHref}>Open as a page</a></div></details>
      {:else}<div data-section="delivery" hidden></div>{/if}
      <details class="sec" data-section="attempts"><summary>Attempts <span class="c">{model.counts.attempts}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneAttempts view={v} /></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="related"><summary>Related prior work <span class="c">{v.related || 'none'}</span></summary><div class="in"><p class="muted">{v.related ? `${v.related} related` : 'No related prior work found in Superlibrary.'}</p></div></details>
      <details class="sec" data-section="references"><summary>References <span class="c">{model.counts.refs}</span></summary><div class="in"><PhoneRefs view={v} {model} /></div></details>
    </div>
  </div>

  <footer class="foot" aria-label="Card actions" data-section="cardActions">
    <div class="cact">
      {#if model.archived}
        <button class="sbtn" type="button" onclick={() => model.restore()}>Archived — restore</button>
      {:else}
        <button class="sbtn" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} onclick={() => model.archive()}><PhoneIcon name="archive" />{model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>
      {/if}
      <button class="sbtn danger" type="button" onclick={() => model.remove()}>Delete card…</button>
    </div>
  </footer>
</div>
```

The "Open as a page" glyph is a `plain` icon at 16px with stroke 2 — the reference draws that one SVG
without the `ico` class. `.tl h2` keeps `id="drawer-title"` while editing (visually hidden), so the sheet
stays named. Delivery is not in the 4605 artboard; the active form points to the card page, which owns the
delivery controls (Task 21).

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Card-Paper: a letter, your reply, and five enclosures. */
  import '../phone/phone-card-shared.css';
  import '../phone/pc-paper.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import PhoneIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PhoneIcon.svelte';
  import PhoneDetails from '../phone/PhoneDetails.svelte';
  import PhoneRuns from '../phone/PhoneRuns.svelte';
  import PhoneAttempts from '../phone/PhoneAttempts.svelte';
  import PhoneRefs from '../phone/PhoneRefs.svelte';
  import PhoneLinks from '../phone/PhoneLinks.svelte';
  import PhoneSubtasks from '../phone/PhoneSubtasks.svelte';
  import PhoneComments from '../phone/PhoneComments.svelte';
  import PhonePlan from '../phone/PhonePlan.svelte';
  import PhoneEditForm from '../phone/PhoneEditForm.svelte';
  import GatePaper from '../gate/GatePaper.svelte';
  import QuestionPaper from '../question/QuestionPaper.svelte';
  import CardStatePaper from '../state/CardStatePaper.svelte';
  import { paperCaption, paperDay, paperEnclosures, paperEye, paperScFacts, phoneCardView, resumeOptions, trackAria, triesWord, stripWord } from '../phone/phone-card-words';
  import { whenLabelLong } from '$lib/when';
  import { sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { model, vibe, phase, personName, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();

  const v = $derived(phoneCardView(model, { members: app.members, agents: app.agents, cardCap: app.board?.usage?.cardUsdCap ?? null, nowMs: Date.now() }));
  const c = $derived(model.card!);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead!);
  const enc = $derived(paperEnclosures(v, model));
  const eye = $derived(paperEye(lead.needsYou && !model.archived, c.archivedAt));
  const role = $derived((app.agents.find((a) => a.id === model.agent.id)?.role ?? 'agent').toLowerCase());
  const firstName = $derived(personName.split(' ')[0] ?? personName);
</script>

<div class="ph-root pcard pcard--paper">
  <div class="sh">
    <button class="back" type="button" onclick={onClose}><PhoneIcon name="back" /><span>{model.boardName}</span></button>
    <span style="display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
      <a class="ib" href={pageHref} aria-label="Open as a page" style="width: auto; padding: 0px 12px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;"><PhoneIcon name="open" form="plain" size={16} stroke={2} /><span>Open as a page</span></a>
      <button class="ib" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" onclick={onClose}><PhoneIcon name="close" size={16} /><span aria-hidden="true">Close</span></button>
    </span>
  </div>
  <header class="head">
    <p class="light">{paperDay(new Date(), phase)}</p>
    {#if eye}<p class="eye" class:ar={model.archived}>{eye}</p>{/if}
    <h2 id="drawer-title" class:sr={model.edit.editing}>Re: {c.title}</h2>
    <div class="trk">
      <div class="bars" role="img" aria-label={trackAria(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.kind, { archived: model.archived })}>
        {#each model.stages as s, i (s.key)}<i class={i < model.stageIndex ? 'd' : i === model.stageIndex ? (lead.needsYou && !model.archived ? 's' : 'd') : undefined}></i>{/each}
      </div>
      <p>{paperCaption(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.needsYou)}</p>
    </div>
  </header>

  {#if model.localError}<p class="hint" role="alert" data-section="error">{model.localError}</p>{:else}<div data-section="error" hidden></div>{/if}
  {#if model.edit.editing}<PhoneEditForm {model} />{:else}<div data-section="editForm" hidden></div>{/if}
  {#if model.archived}<CardStatePaper kind="archived" {model} {vibe} size="phone" />{/if}

  {#if !model.detailLoaded}
    <CardStatePaper kind="loading" {model} {vibe} size="phone" /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
  {:else if gate}
    <GatePaper boardId={gate.boardId} gate={gate.gate} error={gate.error} onResponse={gate.onResponse} agent={model.agent} {lead} {vibe} size="phone" /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>

    <CardStatePaper kind="done" {model} {vibe} size="phone" /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
  {:else}
    <article class="paper" aria-label="Letter from {v.speaker}">
      <p class="dear">Dear {firstName},</p>
      {#if lead.sentence}<p class="voice">{sentenceCase(lead.sentence)}</p>{/if}
      <div class="sigb">
        <span class="portrait"><Face id={model.agent.id ?? v.lastAgent?.id ?? c.id} label={v.speaker} mood={lead.needsYou ? 'needs' : model.agent.mood} size={32} /></span>
        <p><em>{v.speaker}</em><small>{role}, on {model.stageName}{lead.at ? ` · ${whenLabelLong(lead.at)}` : ''}</small></p>
      </div>
      <p class="sc" data-section="facts">{#each paperScFacts(v, model) as f, i (i)}<span data-section={i === 0 ? 'status' : undefined}>{f}</span>{/each}</p>
    </article>
    {#if v.live}
      <section class="reply" aria-labelledby="reply-h" data-section="resume">
        <h3 id="reply-h">Your reply <small>{stripWord(lead.kind)} · {triesWord(c.attemptCount)}</small></h3>

        </div>
        <div class="fld">
```
