```svelte
          {#if model.resume.error}<p class="hint" role="alert">{model.resume.error}</p>{/if}
        </div>
        <button class="send" type="button" disabled={model.resume.busy} onclick={() => model.resume.submit()}><PhoneIcon name="send" />{model.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button>
      </section>
    {:else}<div data-section="resume" hidden></div>{/if}
  {/if}

  <section class="encl" aria-labelledby="encl-h">
    <h3 id="encl-h">Enclosed</h3>
    <details class="en"><summary><b>The brief</b><span>{enc.brief}</span></summary><div class="in">
      <h4>What was asked</h4><p class="wrap" data-section="description">{c.spec?.description ?? 'No description.'}</p>
      <h4>Things to prove</h4><ol class="nl" data-section="criteria">{#each model.acceptanceCriteria ?? [] as a, i (i)}<li>{a}</li>{/each}</ol>
      <h4>Plan</h4><div class="sec-k" data-section="plan"><PhonePlan view={v} speaker={v.speaker} /></div>
      <h4>Details</h4><div class="sec-k" data-section="details"><PhoneDetails view={v} spec={c.spec} criteria={model.acceptanceCriteria} heading="Things to prove" boardId={model.boardId ?? ''} /></div>
      <h4>Project</h4><div class="sec-k" data-section="project">
        {#if v.project.line}<p>{v.project.line}</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>
        {:else}<p class="muted">No project.</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}
      </div>
    </div></details>
    <details class="en"><summary><b>What happened</b><span>{enc.happened}</span></summary><div class="in">
      <h4>Session activity</h4><div class="sec-k" data-section="activity"><PhoneRuns view={v} {model} /></div>
      <h4>Decisions</h4><p class="muted" data-section="decisions">{v.decisions ? `${v.decisions} decided` : 'No decisions on this card yet.'}</p>
      <h4>Handoff</h4><p data-section="handoff">{v.handoff.text}</p>
      <h4>Attempts</h4><div class="sec-k" data-section="attempts"><PhoneAttempts view={v} /></div>
      <h4>Cost</h4><p data-section="cost"><strong class="mono">{v.cost.amount}</strong>{v.cost.rest}</p>
      {#if model.counts.deliveryActive}<h4>Delivery</h4><p data-section="delivery">Delivery is active on this card; approve or change it on the card page.</p>{:else}<div data-section="delivery" hidden></div>{/if}
    </div></details>
    <details class="en"><summary><b>Who is waiting</b><span>{enc.waiting}</span></summary><div class="in">
```

`whenLabelLong('2026-10-08T14:11:45Z')` is `Thursday 8 October, 19:41` — the Paper phone signature's
`paperWhen` for a day that is not today (card-paper-quiet §3). `agents.role` is `Diagnostics` for
error-eric (API-5, Task 8), lower-cased here.

'needs' : model.agent.mood} size={20} /></span> {v.speaker} · {model.archived ? paperEye(false, c.archivedAt) : quietMetaTail(lead.kind, v.ageWords)}</p>

```svelte
    </dl>
    <button class="lnk" type="button" data-section="editButton" onclick={() => model.edit.start()}><PhoneIcon name="pen" />Edit card</button>
    <details class="dsc" data-section="details"><summary>Show the {v.fieldsCount} fields of the brief</summary><div class="in"><PhoneDetails view={v} spec={c.spec} criteria={model.acceptanceCriteria} heading="Things to prove" boardId={model.boardId ?? ''} /></div></details>
  </section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-desc" data-section="description"><h3 id="s-desc">Description</h3><p class="wrap">{c.spec?.description ?? 'None.'}</p></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-cri" data-section="criteria"><h3 id="s-cri">Acceptance criteria ({model.counts.criteria} things to prove)</h3>
    <details class="dsc"><summary>Show the {model.counts.criteria} things to prove</summary><div class="in"><ol class="nl">{#each model.acceptanceCriteria ?? [] as a, i (i)}<li>{a}</li>{/each}</ol></div></details>
  </section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-plan" data-section="plan"><h3 id="s-plan">Plan</h3><PhonePlan view={v} speaker={v.speaker} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-his" data-section="activity"><h3 id="s-his">History ({model.counts.runs} {model.counts.runs === 1 ? 'run' : 'runs'})</h3><PhoneRuns view={v} {model} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-dec" data-section="decisions"><h3 id="s-dec">Decisions</h3><p class="muted">{v.decisions ? `${v.decisions} decided.` : 'No decisions on this card yet.'}</p></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-com" data-section="comments"><h3 id="s-com">Comments</h3><PhoneComments {model} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-lnk" data-section="links"><h3 id="s-lnk">Links</h3><PhoneLinks view={v} {model} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-sub" data-section="subtasks"><h3 id="s-sub">Sub-tasks</h3><PhoneSubtasks view={v} {model} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-prj" data-section="project"><h3 id="s-prj">Project</h3>
    {#if v.project.line}<p>{v.project.line}</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Change project</button>
    {:else}<p class="muted">None.</p><button class="lnk" type="button" onclick={() => model.project.start()}>Assign to a project</button>{/if}
  </section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-hand" data-section="handoff"><h3 id="s-hand">Handoff</h3><p>{v.handoff.text}</p></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-cost" data-section="cost"><h3 id="s-cost">Cost</h3><p><strong class="mono">{v.cost.amount}</strong>{v.cost.rest}</p></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-att" data-section="attempts"><h3 id="s-att">Attempts ({model.counts.attempts})</h3><PhoneAttempts view={v} /></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-del" data-section="delivery"><h3 id="s-del">Delivery</h3><p class="muted">{model.counts.deliveryActive ? 'Delivery is active on this card; approve or change it on the card page.' : 'No approved delivery on this card.'}</p></section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-ref" data-section="references"><h3 id="s-ref">References ({model.counts.refs})</h3>
    <details class="dsc"><summary>Show the {model.counts.refs} references</summary><div class="in"><PhoneRefs view={v} {model} /></div></details>
  </section>
  <section class="sx" aria-labelledby="s-rel" data-section="related"><h3 id="s-rel">Related prior work</h3><p class="muted">{v.related ? `${v.related} related.` : 'No related prior work found in Superlibrary.'}</p></section>
  <footer class="foot" aria-labelledby="s-act" data-section="cardActions">
    <h3 id="s-act">Card actions</h3>
    <div class="cact">
      {#if model.archived}<button class="sbtn" type="button" onclick={() => model.restore()}>Restore</button>
      {:else}<button class="sbtn" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} aria-busy={model.archiving} onclick={() => model.archive()}><PhoneIcon name="archive" />{model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
      <button class="sbtn danger" type="button" onclick={() => model.remove()}>Delete card…</button>
    </div>
  </footer>
</div>
```

The State row's `data-section="status"` wrapper is `display: contents` (Q-7), so the `dl` grid is the
reference's. The archived meta clause (`… · Archived on 8 October`, card-paper-quiet §6) reuses `paperEye`.

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/layouts/CardPhoneStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Phone-Card-Studio: bar, figures, track, readout, command box, five tabs. */
  import '../phone/pc-studio.css';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from './types';
  import PhoneIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PhoneIcon.svelte';
  import StudioPhonePanes from '../phone/StudioPhonePanes.svelte';
  import PhoneEditForm from '../phone/PhoneEditForm.svelte';
  import GateStudioFrame from '../gate/GateStudioFrame.svelte';
  import GateStudioBar from '../gate/GateStudioBar.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioFrame from '../question/QuestionStudioFrame.svelte';
  import QuestionStudioBar from '../question/QuestionStudioBar.svelte';
  import CardStateStudio from '../state/CardStateStudio.svelte';
  import { codeTokens, phoneCardView, resumeOptions, studioCaption, studioClock, studioFigs, studioWhen, trackAria, triesWord, usdShort } from '../phone/phone-card-words';
  import { sentenceCase } from '$lib/words';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  let { model, vibe, phase, gate, question, pageHref, onClose }: CardLayoutProps = $props();

  type Tab = 'spec' | 'log' | 'links' | 'talk' | 'cost';
  const TABS: Tab[] = ['spec', 'log', 'links', 'talk', 'cost'];
  const TAB_NAME: Record<Tab, string> = { spec: 'Spec', log: 'Log', links: 'Links', talk: 'Talk', cost: 'Cost' };
  let tab = $state<Tab>('spec');
  let lastCard = '';
  $effect(() => { if (model.card && model.card.id !== lastCard) { lastCard = model.card.id; tab = 'spec'; } });

  const v = $derived(phoneCardView(model, { members: app.members, agents: app.agents, cardCap: app.board?.usage?.cardUsdCap ?? null, nowMs: Date.now() }));
  const c = $derived(model.card!);
  const lead = $derived(model.lead!);
  const clock = $derived(studioClock(new Date().toISOString(), phase));
  const cap = $derived(studioCaption(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.kind));
  const figs = $derived(studioFigs({ stageIndex: model.stageIndex, stageCount: model.stages.length, attempts: c.attemptCount, kind: lead.kind, ageHours: model.ageHours, cost: c.costUsd, estimateUsd: model.estimate?.estimatedUsd ?? null, blocks: model.linkGroups.blocks.length, openSub: model.counts.openChildren, totalSub: model.counts.children }));
  const counts = $derived<Record<Tab, string>>({ spec: String(v.fieldsCount), log: `${model.counts.runs} ${model.counts.runs === 1 ? 'run' : 'runs'}`, links: String(model.counts.links + model.counts.children + model.counts.refs), talk: String(v.comments), cost: usdShort(c.costUsd) });
  const no = (i: number) => String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');

  function onTabKey(e: KeyboardEvent, i: number): void {
    const to = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (i + 1) % TABS.length : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (i + TABS.length - 1) % TABS.length : e.key === 'Home' ? 0 : e.key === 'End' ? TABS.length - 1 : -1;
    if (to < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    tab = TABS[to];
    (document.getElementById(`t-${TABS[to]}`) as HTMLButtonElement | null)?.focus();
  }
  async function copyId(): Promise<void> { await model.copyId(); }
</script>

<div class="ar ph pcard pcard--studio" data-vibe="studio">
  <div class="pc-bar">
    <button class="back" type="button" onclick={onClose}><PhoneIcon name="back-studio" form="plain" size={16} />{model.boardName}</button>
    <button class="sid" type="button" aria-label="Copy card id {c.id}" onclick={copyId}>{model.shortId} <PhoneIcon name="copy-studio" form="plain" size={13} /></button>
    <span class="clk" aria-label={clock.aria}>{clock.text}</span>
    <a class="ph-ib" href={pageHref} aria-label="Open as a page" title="Open as a page"><PhoneIcon name="open-studio" form="plain" size={18} /></a>
    <button class="ph-ib" type="button" aria-label="Close (Esc)" onclick={onClose}><PhoneIcon name="close" form="plain" size={18} /></button>
  </div>
  <div class="pc-in">
    <header class="pc-hd">
      <span class="kick" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span class="chip c{model.stageIndex + 1}"></span>Stage {no(model.stageIndex)} · {model.stageName}</span>
      <div class="tl">
        <h2 id="drawer-title" class:sr={model.edit.editing}>{c.title}</h2>
        <button class="ar-ib" type="button" aria-label="Edit card" data-section="editButton" onclick={() => model.edit.start()}><PhoneIcon name="pen" form="plain" size={16} /></button>
      </div>
    </header>
    {#if model.localError}<p class="note" role="alert" data-section="error">{model.localError}</p>{:else}<div data-section="error" hidden></div>{/if}
    {#if model.edit.editing}<PhoneEditForm {model} />{:else}<div data-section="editForm" hidden></div>{/if}

    <dl class="pc-figs" data-section="facts">
      {#each figs as f (f.dt)}<div><dt>{f.dt}</dt><dd class:z={f.z}>{f.value}{#if f.small}<small>{f.small}</small>{/if}</dd></div>{/each}
    </dl>
    <div class="pc-trk">
      <ol class="ar-track" role="img" aria-label={trackAria(model.stages, model.stageIndex, lead.kind, { here: false, archived: model.archived })}>
        {#each model.stages as s, i (s.key)}
          {#if i < model.stageIndex}<li class="done"><span class="b c{i + 1}"></span><span>{no(i)} {s.name}<span class="sr">, done</span></span></li>
          {:else if i === model.stageIndex}<li class="cur" class:sig={lead.needsYou && !model.archived} aria-current="step"><span class="b c{i + 1}"></span><span>{no(i)} {s.name}{lead.needsYou ? ' · stopped' : ''}</span></li>
          {:else}<li><span class="b c{i + 1}"></span><span>{no(i)} {s.name}</span></li>{/if}
        {/each}
      </ol>
      <p><b>{cap.bold}</b>{cap.tail}</p>
    </div>

    {#if model.archived}
      <CardStateStudio kind="archived" {model} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if !model.detailLoaded}
      <CardStateStudio kind="loading" {model} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if gate}
      <GateStudioFrame gate={gate.gate} agent={model.agent} {lead} {vibe} footnote={1} />
      <GateStudioBar boardId={gate.boardId} gate={gate.gate} error={gate.error} onResponse={gate.onResponse} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if question}
      <QuestionStudioFrame elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} />
      <QuestionStudioBar model={question.model} elicitation={question.elicitation} agent={question.agent} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else if lead.kind === 'done'}
      <CardStateStudio kind="done" {model} {vibe} /><div data-section="resume" hidden></div>
    {:else}
      {#if lead.sentence}
        <section class="ar-q" aria-label="Readout">
          <h3><Face id={model.agent.id ?? v.lastAgent?.id ?? c.id} label={v.speaker} mood={lead.needsYou ? 'needs' : model.agent.mood} size={24} />{v.speaker}{lead.needsYou ? ' · Stopped · needs decision' : ''}{#if lead.at}<span class="mono">{studioWhen(lead.at)}</span>{/if}</h3>
          <blockquote>{#each codeTokens(sentenceCase(lead.sentence)) as p, i (i)}{#if p.code}<code>{p.text}</code>{:else}{p.text}{/if}{/each}</blockquote>
        </section>
      {/if}
      {#if v.live}
        <section class="pc-cmd" aria-labelledby="cmd-h" data-section="resume">
          <p class="h"><span id="cmd-h">Resume · blocked</span><span class="mono">{triesWord(c.attemptCount)}</span></p>
          <div class="ar-field">
            <label for="resume-at">Resume at stage</label>
            <select id="resume-at" class="ar-sel" bind:value={model.resume.stageKey}>{#each resumeOptions(model.resume.targets) as o (o.value)}<option value={o.value} disabled={o.disabled}>{o.label}</option>{/each}</select>
          </div>
          <div class="ar-field">
            <label for="resume-note">Note to {v.speaker}: what changed? It reads this.</label>
            <input id="resume-note" class="ar-in" type="text" maxlength="8000" bind:value={model.resume.note} aria-invalid={model.resume.error ? 'true' : undefined} />
            {#if model.resume.error}<p class="note" role="alert">{model.resume.error}</p>{/if}
          </div>
          <button class="ar-btn" type="button" disabled={model.resume.busy} onclick={() => model.resume.submit()}><PhoneIcon name="send" form="plain" size={15} />{model.resume.busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Send back to work'}</button>
        </section>
      {:else}<div data-section="resume" hidden></div>{/if}
    {/if}

    <div class="pc-srow" data-section="status">
      <span class="cd-pill" class:needs={lead.needsYou && !model.archived}><span class="u" class:needs={lead.needsYou && !model.archived}></span>{v.stateWord}</span>
      <span>{v.claim}</span>
      <span class="muted">owner · {v.ownerName}</span>
      {#if v.queuer?.byAgent}<span class="chipx" title={v.grantTitle}><Face id={v.queuer.id} label={v.queuer.name} mood="resting" size={20} /> asked by {v.queuer.name}</span>{/if}
    </div>

    <div>
      <div class="pc-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Card sections">
        {#each TABS as t, i (t)}
          <button class="ar-tab" type="button" role="tab" id="t-{t}" aria-controls="p-pane" aria-selected={tab === t} tabindex={tab === t ? 0 : -1} onclick={() => (tab = t)} onkeydown={(e) => onTabKey(e, i)}>{TAB_NAME[t]}<b>{counts[t]}</b></button>
        {/each}
      </div>
      <div class="pc-pane" id="p-pane" role="tabpanel" aria-label={TAB_NAME[tab]} style="padding-top: 16px;">
        <StudioPhonePanes {model} view={v} pane={tab} />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <footer class="pc-foot" aria-label="Card actions" data-section="cardActions">
    {#if model.archived}<button class="ar-btn2" type="button" onclick={() => model.restore()}>Archived — restore</button>
    {:else}<button class="ar-btn2" type="button" disabled={model.archiving} onclick={() => model.archive()}><PhoneIcon name="archive-studio" form="plain" size={15} />{model.archiving ? 'Archiving…' : 'Archive card'}</button>{/if}
    <button class="ar-btn2" type="button" style="background: transparent; border: 0px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--rule);" onclick={() => model.remove()}>Delete card…</button>
  </footer>
</div>
```

The tablist sits under a plain `div` exactly as the reference draws it; the pane's accessible name is the
tab's name (the reference labels it `aria-label="Spec"`, not by `aria-labelledby`).

- [ ] **Step 12: Mount the phone sheet below 640px**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/card/phone/CardPhoneSheet.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The card below 640px: one full-screen sheet in normal flow (the board layout hides the board), so the
   * page scrolls as one document and is as tall as the card. Named by the card title; focused and
   * scrolled to the top on open. Esc still closes (root layout `closeCardOnEscape`).
   */
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { CARD_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import type { CardLayoutProps } from '../layouts/types';
  import './phone-card-shared.css';

  let props: CardLayoutProps = $props();
  const Phone = $derived(CARD_LAYOUTS[props.vibe].phone);
  let root = $state<HTMLDivElement>();
  onMount(() => { window.scrollTo(0, 0); root?.focus(); });
</script>

<div class="pcard-host" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="drawer-title" tabindex="-1" bind:this={root}>
  <Phone {...props} />
</div>
```

document is the card alone (the references have no board, shell or tab bar behind the phone card):


(`display: contents` keeps the AppShell's own layout unchanged when the sheet is closed. Closing the sheet
restores the board; the board's scroll position resets to the top, which on a phone is where the step chips
are.)

### Task 30: Operate in four vibes

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Operate gets one data model and four layouts that reproduce `SP-Operate-{Daylight,Paper,Studio,Quiet}`
markup class for class. The work has four parts. `attention.ts` gains `stageName` (plus optional
`stageOrder`/`attemptCount`), the OP-G3 action sets, the "nothing claims the … stage" headline and

```ts
/** No-owner rows go last: nobody is waiting on an answer from them, only on a move. */
const sortRank = (i: AttentionItem): number => (i.kind === 'no-owner' ? 1 : 0);

/**
 * The order a list of needs is read in. `stage`: the board's own order (Daylight, Paper, Studio).
 * `urgency`: the card that has burned the most runs first (Quiet's "Most urgent first").
 * Ties: the card waiting longest, then the title. Returns a new array.
 */
export function sortAttention(items: AttentionItem[], mode: 'stage' | 'urgency'): AttentionItem[] {
  return [...items].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      sortRank(a) - sortRank(b) ||
      (mode === 'stage' ? (a.stageOrder ?? 0) - (b.stageOrder ?? 0) : (b.attemptCount ?? 0) - (a.attemptCount ?? 0)) ||
      (b.ageHours ?? -1) - (a.ageHours ?? -1) ||
      a.title.localeCompare(b.title),
  );
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/layouts/types.ts
import type { Phase } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, Card, Notification, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import type { AttentionAction, AttentionItem } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';

/** One card waiting on a person, with what every vibe needs to draw it. */
export interface NeedRow {
  item: AttentionItem;
  card: Card;
  stage: Stage;
  /** 1-based position of the stage on the board: Studio's chip colour `c{n}`. */
  stageIndex: number;
  /** The agent that last worked it (`delegateAgentId ?? lastAgentId`); null for an unclaimed card. */
  agentName: string | null;
  iconUrl: string | null;
  actions: AttentionAction[];
  overdue: boolean;
}

/** One card's notifications: the newest is shown, the rest sit behind "Earlier reminders". */
export interface ActivityGroup {
  cardId: string;
  title: string;
  agentName: string | null;
  iconUrl: string | null;
  latest: Notification;
  earlier: Notification[];
  /** The card's Needs row, when it has one: the group then offers Resume or Move and links to it. */
  need: NeedRow | null;
}

export interface RunningRow { cardId: string; title: string; stageName: string; agentName: string | null; iconUrl: string | null; costUsd: number }

export interface SpendView {
  /** Spend over the last 7 days, from `GET /v1/boards/:id/usage?window=7d` (OP-G8). */
  total: number;
  cap: number | null;
  cardCap: number | null;
  overBudget: boolean;
  /** Spend as a share of the board cap, 0–100; null without a cap. */
  pct: number | null;
  /** Up to five agents, most spent first. */
  top: Array<{ name: string; costUsd: number }>;
}

/** What a cap save says back: field errors, a refusal, or null when it saved. */
export type CapResult = { board: string | null; card: string | null; refused: string | null } | null;

export interface OperateModel {
  readonly boardId: string;
  readonly boardName: string;
  /** Non-archived cards on the board. */
  readonly cardCount: number;
  /** The board's stages in order. */
  readonly stages: Stage[];
  readonly agents: AgentSummary[];
  /** Needs rows in stage order (Daylight, Paper, Studio). */
  readonly needs: NeedRow[];
  /** Needs rows in urgency order (Quiet). */
  readonly needsUrgent: NeedRow[];
  readonly running: RunningRow[];
  readonly spend: SpendView;
  readonly usageError: string | null;
  readonly unread: number;
  /** Show read notifications too. */
  showRead: boolean;
  readonly groups: ActivityGroup[];
  readonly phase: Phase;
  readonly nowMs: number;
  readonly firstName: string;
  cardHref(cardId: string): string;
  /** Resolves to the refusal to show, or null when it worked. */
  resume(row: NeedRow, comment: string, toStageKey: string): Promise<string | null>;
  move(row: NeedRow, toStageKey: string): Promise<string | null>;
  markRead(seq: number): Promise<void>;
  setCaps(board: string, card: string): Promise<CapResult>;
  open(cardId: string): void;
  openLog(cardId: string): void;
}

export interface OperateLayoutProps { model: OperateModel }
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/operate-words.ts
/**
 * Every sentence Operate prints, per vibe, as pure functions of the board (spec Operate §3.2).
 * Times on the page are UTC (a card's notices are stamped by the server); the Studio op line and
 * the shell's "synced" are the reader's local clock.
 */
import { greeting, type Phase, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, Notification, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import type { AttentionItem, AttentionKind } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { stageOwner } from '$lib/components/board/stage-owner';
import { PAPER_PHASE, dueLong, dueShort } from '$lib/components/board/board-words';
import { ageShort, ageWords } from '$lib/age';
import { numWord } from '$lib/words';
import type { NeedRow } from './layouts/types';

export const RESUME_HINT = 'Fix what it says, then resume it with a note it will read.';
export const RESUME_LABEL = 'What changed, or what should the agent do differently? It reads this.';
export const CAP_ERROR = 'Enter an amount in dollars, like 25 or 25.50.';
export const QUIET_REFUSAL = 'Not done: ';
export const CUT = 140;

export const usd = (n: number): string => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
const cardsWord = (n: number): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}`;

export function cut140(text: string): string {
  return text.length > CUT ? `${text.slice(0, CUT).trimEnd()}…` : text;
}

/** Operate signals a card's attempts from three on (OP-G13); the List signals from two. */
export const attemptsSignalOperate = (n: number): boolean => n >= 3;

const KIND_WORD: Record<AttentionKind, string> = {
  review: 'Review', question: 'Asked', blocked: 'Stopped', 'repeated-failure': 'Stopped', refused: 'Refused',
  'sub-tasks': 'Waiting on sub-tasks', 'no-owner': 'No owner', failed: 'Failed', budget: 'Over budget',
};
export const kindWord = (k: AttentionKind): string => KIND_WORD[k];

/** The hint under a stopped card; any other kind says its own instruction (OP-G7). */
export function stopHint(item: AttentionItem): string {
  return item.kind === 'blocked' || item.kind === 'repeated-failure' ? RESUME_HINT : item.instruction;
}

/** "a day", "two days" … "ten days", then digits. Under a day it counts hours (gap G-T2). */
export function dayWords(h: number): string {
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
  if (d === 0) return `${h} ${h === 1 ? 'hour' : 'hours'}`;
  if (d === 1) return 'a day';
  return d <= 10 ? `${numWord(d)} days` : `${d} days`;
}

/** A notice's UTC time, HH:MM. */
export const when = (n: Notification): string => n.createdAt.slice(11, 16);

const STALE = /^Stuck (\d+)h in (.+?): /;

/**
 * A stale notice, retold. Whether it reads "stopped" or "unclaimed" follows the card's attention
 * kind, never the notice's wording (O-9). Null for any other notice, or one that does not parse:
 * the caller prints the body verbatim.
 */
export function staleLine(n: Notification, vibe: Vibe, needKind: AttentionKind | null): string | null {
  if (n.kind !== 'stale') return null;
  const m = STALE.exec(n.body);
  if (!m) return null;
  const h = Number(m[1]);
  const stage = m[2]!;
  const unclaimed = needKind === 'no-owner';
  switch (vibe) {
    case 'daylight':
      return unclaimed ? `Still unclaimed after ${dayWords(h)} in ${stage}.` : `Still stopped ${dayWords(h)} later in ${stage}.`;
    case 'paper':
      return unclaimed ? ` — still unclaimed after ${dayWords(h)} in ${stage}. ` : ` — still stopped ${dayWords(h)} later in ${stage}. `;
    case 'studio':
      return unclaimed ? `Still unclaimed ${h}h in ${stage}. ` : `Still stopped ${h}h later in ${stage}. `;
    case 'quiet':
      return unclaimed ? `${when(n)} UTC: still unclaimed after ${dayWords(h)} in ${stage}.` : `${when(n)} UTC: still stopped ${dayWords(h)} later in ${stage}.`;
  }
}

/** Quiet's one line per notice: time, what happened, and where the reason is. */
export function quietLine(n: Notification, needKind: AttentionKind | null, hasNeed: boolean): string {
  const line = staleLine(n, 'quiet', needKind);
  if (line === null) return `${when(n)} UTC: ${n.body}`;
  return hasNeed ? `${line} The reason is under Needs your decision.` : line;
}

/** Studio's kind cell: "Stale". */
export const kindCell = (n: Notification): string => n.kind.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + n.kind.slice(1);

/** Who works a stage: "code, 2 agents" (`full`) or "2 agents" (`agents`). */
export function stageOwnerText(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[], form: 'full' | 'agents'): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind !== 'capability') return o.label;
  const who = o.declaredBy.length === 1 ? o.declaredBy[0]! : `${o.declaredBy.length} agents`;
  return form === 'full' ? `${o.label}, ${who}` : who;
}

export function moveOptionLabel(vibe: Vibe, stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  if (vibe === 'quiet') return `${stage.name} (${stageOwnerText(stage, agents, 'agents')})`;
  if (vibe === 'paper') return `${stage.name} · ${stageOwnerText(stage, agents, 'agents')}`;
  return `${stage.name} · ${stageOwnerText(stage, agents, 'full')}`;
}

/** The Resume-at options: every stage in order, the current one "(where it stopped)". */
export function resumeOptions(stages: Stage[], currentKey: string): Array<{ key: string; label: string }> {
  return [...stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order).map((s) => ({ key: s.key, label: s.key === currentKey ? `${s.name} (where it stopped)` : s.name }));
}

export interface NeedCounts { s: number; o: number; other: number }
export function needCounts(rows: NeedRow[]): NeedCounts {
  const s = rows.filter((r) => r.item.kind === 'blocked' || r.item.kind === 'repeated-failure' || r.item.kind === 'failed').length;
  const o = rows.filter((r) => r.item.kind === 'no-owner').length;
  return { s, o, other: rows.length - s - o };
}

// ---- Daylight ----
export const greetingLabel = (phase: Phase): string => greeting(phase, 'daylight').replace(/\.$/, '');

export function daylightGreeting(phase: Phase, firstName: string, n: number): string {
  const tail = n === 0 ? 'Nothing needs you.' : n === 1 ? '1 card wants you.' : `${n} cards want you.`;
  return `${greetingLabel(phase)}, ${firstName}. ${tail}`;
}

export function summarySentenceDaylight(c: NeedCounts, r: number): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (c.s) parts.push(`${numWord(c.s, true)} agent${c.s === 1 ? '' : 's'} stopped and ${c.s === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} waiting on you`);
  if (c.o) parts.push(`${numWord(c.o, parts.length === 0)} card${c.o === 1 ? ' has' : 's have'} nobody to pick ${c.o === 1 ? 'it' : 'them'} up`);
  if (c.other) parts.push(`${numWord(c.other, parts.length === 0)} more need${c.other === 1 ? 's' : ''} you`);
  const run = r === 0 ? 'Nothing is running.' : `${numWord(r, true)} ${r === 1 ? 'agent is' : 'agents are'} working.`;
  return parts.length ? `${parts.join(', and ')}. ${run}` : run;
}

export function daylightMeta(row: NeedRow): string {
  const age = ageWords(row.item.ageHours ?? 0);
  if (row.item.kind === 'no-owner') {
    return `in ${row.stage.name} · ${age}${row.overdue && row.card.dueAt ? `, overdue since ${dueShort(row.card.dueAt)}` : ''}`;
  }
  return `${kindWord(row.item.kind).toLowerCase()} in ${row.stage.name} · ${age} ago · attempt ${row.card.attemptCount}`;
}

export const daylightCap = (cap: number | null): string => (cap === null ? 'No cap set' : `of ${usd(cap)} cap`);

// ---- Paper ----
export function longDate(nowMs: number, timeZone?: string): string {
  return new Date(nowMs).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', timeZone });
}

export function paperMastLine(nowMs: number, phase: Phase, n: number, r: number, timeZone?: string): string {
  const wait = n === 0 ? 'Nothing waits for you' : `${numWord(n, true)} letter${n === 1 ? ' waits' : 's wait'} for you`;
  const work = r === 0 ? 'no one is at work.' : `${numWord(r)} ${r === 1 ? 'agent is' : 'agents are'} at work.`;
  return `${longDate(nowMs, timeZone)}, ${PAPER_PHASE[phase]}. ${wait}; ${work}`;
}

export const paperMastEnd = (boardName: string, cardCount: number): string => `${boardName} · ${cardsWord(cardCount)}`;
export const letters = (n: number): string => `${n} letter${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;

export function paperMeta(row: NeedRow): string[] {
  const age = ageWords(row.item.ageHours ?? 0);
  if (row.item.kind === 'no-owner') {
    const due = row.card.dueAt ? `· due ${dueShort(row.card.dueAt)}${row.overdue ? ', overdue' : ''}` : null;
    return ['No owner', `· ${row.stage.name}`, `· ${age}`, ...(due ? [due] : [])];
  }
  return [kindWord(row.item.kind), `· ${row.stage.name}`, `· ${age} ago`, `· attempt ${row.card.attemptCount}`];
}

export const paperCap = (cap: number | null): string => (cap === null ? 'No cap set.' : `Capped at ${usd(cap)}.`);

// ---- Studio ----
export function localHM(ms: number, timeZone?: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23', timeZone }).format(ms);
}

/** The op line: the reader's local time (O-7), the phase word, and a reminder that rows are UTC. */
export function studioOpLine(nowMs: number, phase: Phase, timeZone?: string): string {
  return `${localHM(nowMs, timeZone)} · ${greeting(phase, 'studio').toLowerCase()} · times UTC`;
}

export function studioHeroTitle(n: number, r: number): { sr: string; text: string } {
  if (n === 0) return { sr: '', text: 'Nothing on this board needs you' };
  const head = n === 1 ? 'card on this board needs you' : 'cards on this board need you';
  return { sr: `${n} `, text: head + (r === 0 ? ', and nothing is running' : `, and ${r} ${r === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} running`) };
}

export function summarySentenceStudio(c: NeedCounts, r: number, spend7d: number): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (c.s) parts.push(`${numWord(c.s, true)} stopped and ${c.s === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} waiting to be resumed`);
  if (c.o) parts.push(`${numWord(c.o, parts.length === 0)} sit${c.o === 1 ? 's' : ''} in a stage no agent works and need${c.o === 1 ? 's' : ''} moving`);
  if (c.other) parts.push(`${numWord(c.other, parts.length === 0)} more need${c.other === 1 ? 's' : ''} you`);
  const work = r === 0 ? 'No agent is working anything' : `${numWord(r, true)} ${r === 1 ? 'agent is' : 'agents are'} working`;
  const spent = spend7d === 0 ? ', and nothing has been spent this week.' : `, and ${usd(spend7d)} has been spent this week.`;
  return `${parts.length ? `${parts.join('; ')}. ` : ''}${work}${spent}`;
}

export function studioSub(row: NeedRow): string {
  if (row.item.kind === 'no-owner' && row.card.dueAt) return `${row.stage.name} · due ${row.card.dueAt}${row.overdue ? ', overdue' : ''}`;
  return row.stage.name;
}

export const studioAge = (row: NeedRow): string => (row.item.ageHours === null ? '—' : ageShort(row.item.ageHours, false));

export function studioCapFigure(cap: number | null): { value: string; label: string; zero: boolean } {
  return cap === null ? { value: '—', label: 'Budget cap · none set', zero: true } : { value: usd(cap), label: 'Budget cap', zero: false };
}

// ---- Quiet ----
export function quietLede(boardName: string, n: number, r: number): string {
  const needs = n === 0 ? 'Nothing needs you.' : `${n} card${n === 1 ? ' needs' : 's need'} you.`;
  const work = r === 0 ? ' No agent is working.' : ` ${r} ${r === 1 ? 'agent is' : 'agents are'} working.`;
  return `${boardName}. ${needs}${work} Times are in UTC. `;
}

export function quietMeta(row: NeedRow): string {
  const age = ageWords(row.item.ageHours ?? 0);
  if (row.item.kind === 'no-owner') {
    const due = row.card.dueAt ? ` · due ${dueLong(row.card.dueAt)}${row.overdue ? ', overdue' : ''}` : '';
    return `No owner in ${row.stage.name} · ${age}${due} · `;
  }
  const n = row.card.attemptCount;
  return `${kindWord(row.item.kind)} in ${row.stage.name} · ${age} · ${n} attempt${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} · `;
}

/** Everything after the money figure in "$0.00. No budget cap is set. No agent has spent anything." */
export function quietSpend(cap: number | null, top: Array<{ name: string; costUsd: number }>): string {
  const capText = cap === null ? ' No budget cap is set.' : ` The budget cap is ${usd(cap)}.`;
  const spent = top.length === 0 ? ' No agent has spent anything.' : ` ${top[0]!.name} spent the most.`;
  return `.${capText}${spent}`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/operate-data.ts
/** The lists Operate draws, built from the board snapshot. Pure: every vibe reads the same rows. */
import type { AgentSummary, BoardSnapshot, BoardUsage, Notification, Stage, UsageSummary } from '$lib/api';
import type { AttentionItem } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { overdue } from '$lib/components/board/card-due';
import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';
import { CAP_ERROR } from './operate-words';
import type { ActivityGroup, NeedRow, RunningRow, SpendView } from './layouts/types';

const byOrder = (stages: Stage[]): Stage[] => [...stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);

export function needRows(board: BoardSnapshot, agents: AgentSummary[], items: AttentionItem[], nowMs: number): NeedRow[] {
  const stages = byOrder(board.stages);
  const today = new Date(nowMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  return items.flatMap((item) => {
    const card = board.cards.find((c) => c.id === item.cardId);
    const idx = stages.findIndex((s) => s.key === item.stageKey);
    if (!card || idx < 0) return [];
    // A card in a stage nothing claims is unclaimed, whoever last touched it.
    const agentId = item.kind === 'no-owner' ? null : (card.delegateAgentId ?? card.lastAgentId ?? null);
    return [{
      item, card, stage: stages[idx]!, stageIndex: idx + 1,
      agentName: agentId ? displayAgent(agentId, agents) : null,
      iconUrl: agentId ? (agents.find((a) => a.id === agentId)?.iconUrl ?? null) : null,
      actions: item.actions,
      overdue: overdue(card.dueAt, card.state, today),
    }];
  });
}

/** The agents waiting on you, once each, in row order (Daylight's crew). */
export function crewOf(rows: NeedRow[]): Array<{ name: string; iconUrl: string | null }> {
  const seen = new Map<string, { name: string; iconUrl: string | null }>();
  for (const r of rows) if (r.agentName && !seen.has(r.agentName)) seen.set(r.agentName, { name: r.agentName, iconUrl: r.iconUrl });
  return [...seen.values()];
}

export function activityGroups(notifications: Notification[], showRead: boolean, needs: NeedRow[], board: BoardSnapshot, agents: AgentSummary[]): ActivityGroup[] {
  const shown = showRead ? notifications : notifications.filter((n) => !n.read);
  const byCard = new Map<string, Notification[]>();
  for (const n of shown) {
    const list = byCard.get(n.cardId);
    if (list) list.push(n);
    else byCard.set(n.cardId, [n]);
  }
  const groups = [...byCard.entries()].map(([cardId, list]): ActivityGroup => {
    const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt) || b.seq - a.seq);
    const card = board.cards.find((c) => c.id === cardId);
    const need = needs.find((r) => r.item.cardId === cardId) ?? null;
    const agentId = need ? (need.agentName ? (card?.delegateAgentId ?? card?.lastAgentId ?? null) : null) : (card?.delegateAgentId ?? card?.lastAgentId ?? null);
    return {
      cardId, title: card?.title ?? cardId,
      agentName: agentId ? displayAgent(agentId, agents) : null,
      iconUrl: agentId ? (agents.find((a) => a.id === agentId)?.iconUrl ?? null) : null,
      latest: sorted[0]!, earlier: sorted.slice(1), need,
    };
  });
  return groups.sort((a, b) => b.latest.createdAt.localeCompare(a.latest.createdAt));
}

export function runningRows(board: BoardSnapshot, agents: AgentSummary[]): RunningRow[] {
  return board.cards
    .filter((c) => c.state === 'working' && !c.archivedAt)
    .map((c) => {
      const agentId = c.delegateAgentId ?? null;
      return {
        cardId: c.id, title: c.title,
        stageName: board.stages.find((s) => s.key === c.currentStageKey)?.name ?? c.currentStageKey,
        agentName: agentId ? displayAgent(agentId, agents) : null,
        iconUrl: agentId ? (agents.find((a) => a.id === agentId)?.iconUrl ?? null) : null,
        costUsd: c.costUsd,
      };
    });
}

export function spendView(usage: UsageSummary | null, caps: BoardUsage | null, agents: AgentSummary[]): SpendView {
  const total = usage?.totalCostUsd ?? 0;
  const cap = caps?.budgetUsd ?? null;
  return {
    total, cap, cardCap: caps?.cardUsdCap ?? null, overBudget: caps?.overBudget ?? false,
    pct: cap && cap > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((total / cap) * 100)) : null,
    top: (usage?.byAgent ?? [])
      .filter((a) => a.costUsd > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.costUsd - a.costUsd)
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map((a) => ({ name: displayAgent(a.agentId, agents), costUsd: a.costUsd })),
  };
}

/** Where an unclaimed card can go: stages an agent works, the current one left out (OP-G6). */
export function moveTargets(stages: Stage[], currentKey: string): Stage[] {
  return byOrder(stages).filter((s) => s.key !== currentKey && (s.ownerKind === 'capability' || s.ownerKind === 'agent'));
}

export function parseCap(text: string): { ok: true; value: number | null } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const t = text.trim();
  if (t === '') return { ok: true, value: null };
  const n = Number(t);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 ? { ok: true, value: n } : { ok: false, error: CAP_ERROR };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/operate-model.svelte.ts
/**
 * Operate's data, read from the app store. One instance per OperateView; the four layouts only
 * draw it. Spend comes from the 7-day usage route (OP-G8), loaded through `app.markBusy` so the
 * page is not "ready" before it lands.
 */
import { tick } from 'svelte';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
import { getUsage, markNotificationRead, moveCard, resumeCard, setBudget, type UsageSummary } from '$lib/api';
import { itemsFromBoard, sortAttention } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { refusalOf } from '$lib/components/attention/refusal';
import { activityGroups, needRows, parseCap, runningRows, spendView } from './operate-data';
import type { CapResult, NeedRow, OperateModel } from './layouts/types';

export class OperateStore implements OperateModel {
  showRead = $state(false);
  #usage = $state<UsageSummary | null>(null);
  #usageError = $state<string | null>(null);

  readonly #items = $derived(app.board ? itemsFromBoard(app.board, app.agents, Date.now()) : []);
  readonly needs = $derived(app.board ? needRows(app.board, app.agents, sortAttention(this.#items, 'stage'), Date.now()) : []);
  readonly needsUrgent = $derived(app.board ? needRows(app.board, app.agents, sortAttention(this.#items, 'urgency'), Date.now()) : []);
  readonly running = $derived(app.board ? runningRows(app.board, app.agents) : []);
  readonly spend = $derived(spendView(this.#usage, app.board?.usage ?? null, app.agents));
  readonly unread = $derived(app.notifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length);
  readonly groups = $derived(app.board ? activityGroups(app.notifications, this.showRead, this.needs, app.board, app.agents) : []);
  readonly cardCount = $derived((app.board?.cards ?? []).filter((c) => !c.archivedAt).length);
  readonly stages = $derived([...(app.board?.stages ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order));

  constructor() {
    $effect(() => {
      const id = app.boardId;
      if (id) this.#loadUsage(id);
    });
  }

  get boardId(): string { return app.boardId ?? ''; }
  get boardName(): string { return app.board?.name ?? ''; }
  get agents() { return app.agents; }
  get usageError(): string | null { return this.#usageError; }
  get phase() { return appearance.phase; }
  get nowMs(): number { return Date.now(); }
  get firstName(): string { return (app.user?.name ?? '').trim().split(' ')[0] ?? ''; }

  #loadUsage(id: string): void {
    this.#usageError = null;
    app.markBusy(
      getUsage(id, '7d')
        .then((u) => { this.#usage = u; })
        .catch((e: unknown) => { this.#usage = null; this.#usageError = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); }),
    );
  }

  cardHref(cardId: string): string { return `/b/${this.boardId}/c/${cardId}`; }

  async resume(row: NeedRow, comment: string, toStageKey: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const to = toStageKey === row.item.stageKey ? undefined : toStageKey;
    const refused = await refusalOf(await resumeCard(row.item.boardId, row.item.cardId, comment, to));
    if (!refused) await app.refresh();
    return refused;
  }

  async move(row: NeedRow, toStageKey: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const refused = await refusalOf(await moveCard(row.item.boardId, row.item.cardId, toStageKey));
    if (!refused) await app.refresh();
    return refused;
  }

  async markRead(seq: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!app.boardId) return;
    await markNotificationRead(app.boardId, seq);
    await app.refresh();
  }

  async setCaps(board: string, card: string): Promise<CapResult> {
    const b = parseCap(board);
    const c = parseCap(card);
    if (!b.ok || !c.ok) return { board: b.ok ? null : b.error, card: c.ok ? null : c.error, refused: null };
    const refused = await refusalOf(await setBudget(this.boardId, { boardUsdCap: b.value, cardUsdCap: c.value }));
    if (refused) return { board: null, card: null, refused };
    await app.refresh();
    this.#loadUsage(this.boardId);
    return null;
  }

  open(cardId: string): void { app.openCard(cardId); }

  /** Opens the card and brings its runs into view (OP-G11/G14). */
  openLog(cardId: string): void {
    app.openCard(cardId);
    void tick().then(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById('card-section-attempts')?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' })));
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/operate-ui.svelte.ts
/**
 * What a reader is doing on Operate right now — the row whose resume form is open, what they typed,
 * which texts are expanded — shared by the four layouts so each only draws it.
 */
import { tick } from 'svelte';
import type { NeedRow, OperateModel, SpendView } from './layouts/types';
import { moveTargets } from './operate-data';

export class OperateUi {
  expanded = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  earlierOpen = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  resuming = $state<string | null>(null);
  resumeAt = $state('');
  text = $state('');
  busy = $state(false);
  refusals = $state<Record<string, string>>({});
  moveTo = $state<Record<string, string>>({});
  readonly canSend = $derived(this.text.trim().length > 0 && !this.busy);
  readonly #model: () => OperateModel;

  constructor(model: () => OperateModel) { this.#model = model; }
  private model(): OperateModel { return this.#model(); }

  toggle(cardId: string): void { this.expanded[cardId] = !this.expanded[cardId]; }
  toggleEarlier(cardId: string): void { this.earlierOpen[cardId] = !this.earlierOpen[cardId]; }

  /** Opens the row's resume form and moves focus to its "Resume at" picker. */
  async openResume(row: NeedRow): Promise<void> {
    this.resuming = row.item.cardId;
    this.resumeAt = row.item.stageKey;
    this.text = '';
    delete this.refusals[row.item.cardId];
    await tick();
    document.getElementById(`resume-at-${row.item.cardId}`)?.focus();
  }

  cancel(): void { this.resuming = null; this.text = ''; }

  async send(row: NeedRow): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canSend) return;
    this.busy = true;
    try {
      const refused = await this.model().resume(row, this.text.trim(), this.resumeAt);
      if (refused) this.refusals[row.item.cardId] = refused;
      else this.cancel();
    } finally {
      this.busy = false;
    }
  }

  async move(row: NeedRow, toKey?: string): Promise<void> {
    const key = toKey ?? this.moveTo[row.item.cardId] ?? moveTargets(this.model().stages, row.item.stageKey)[0]?.key;
    if (!key) return;
    const refused = await this.model().move(row, key);
    if (refused) this.refusals[row.item.cardId] = refused;
    else delete this.refusals[row.item.cardId];
  }

  /** An activity group's Resume or Move: opens the Needs row's control and brings it into view. */
  async fromActivity(row: NeedRow, anchor: string): Promise<void> {
    document.getElementById(anchor)?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' });
    if (row.actions.includes('resume')) await this.openResume(row);
    else document.getElementById(`mv-${row.item.cardId}`)?.focus();
  }
}

export class CapsUi {
  editing = $state(false);
  board = $state('');
  card = $state('');
  boardError = $state<string | null>(null);
  cardError = $state<string | null>(null);
  refused = $state<string | null>(null);
  saving = $state(false);
  readonly #model: () => OperateModel;

  constructor(model: () => OperateModel) { this.#model = model; }
  private model(): OperateModel { return this.#model(); }

  start(spend: SpendView): void {
    this.board = spend.cap?.toString() ?? '';
    this.card = spend.cardCap?.toString() ?? '';
    this.boardError = this.cardError = this.refused = null;
    this.editing = true;
  }

  cancel(spend: SpendView): void { this.start(spend); this.editing = false; }

  async save(): Promise<void> {
    this.saving = true;
    try {
      const r = await this.model().setCaps(this.board, this.card);
      this.boardError = r?.board ?? null;
      this.cardError = r?.card ?? null;
      this.refused = r?.refused ?? null;
      if (r === null) this.editing = false;
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/parts/MoveMenu.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * "Move to…": every stage, the current one marked "here" and not choosable. Opens with focus on
   * the first choosable stage; arrows move, Escape or a click elsewhere closes. The caller owns the
   * trigger button and puts focus back on it.
   */
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  let {
    items, onpick, onclose, trigger, label = 'Move to', heading = 'Move to…', class: klass = 'menu',
  }: {
    items: Array<{ key: string; name: string; here: boolean }>;
    onpick: (key: string) => void;
    onclose: () => void;
    trigger?: HTMLElement;
    label?: string;
    heading?: string;
    class?: string;
  } = $props();

  let root: HTMLDivElement | undefined = $state();
  const buttons = (): HTMLButtonElement[] => [...(root?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="menuitem"]') ?? [])];

  onMount(() => {
    buttons().find((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true')?.focus();
    const away = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (root && !root.contains(t) && !trigger?.contains(t)) onclose();
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', away, true);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', away, true);
  });

  function onkeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const list = buttons();
    const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); onclose(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); list[(i + 1) % list.length]?.focus(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); list[(i - 1 + list.length) % list.length]?.focus(); }
  }
</script>

<div bind:this={root} class={klass} role="menu" aria-label={label} tabindex="-1" {onkeydown}>
  <p class="menu__h">{heading}</p>
  {#each items as it (it.key)}
    <button type="button" role="menuitem" aria-disabled={it.here ? 'true' : undefined} onclick={() => { if (!it.here) onpick(it.key); }}>{it.name}<small>{it.here ? 'here' : ''}</small></button>
  {/each}
</div>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/parts/MoveMenu.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import MoveMenu from './MoveMenu.svelte';

afterEach(cleanup);
const items = [
  { key: 'reported', name: 'Reported', here: true },
  { key: 'reproduce', name: 'Reproduce', here: false },
  { key: 'test', name: 'Failing test', here: false },
];

describe('MoveMenu', () => {
  it('opens on the first stage it can move to, the current one marked here', () => {
    render(MoveMenu, { items, onpick: vi.fn(), onclose: vi.fn() });
    expect(screen.getByRole('menu', { name: 'Move to' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.activeElement?.textContent).toBe('Reproduce');
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Reported/ }).getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Reported/ }).textContent).toBe('Reportedhere');
  });
  it('arrows move, the current stage cannot be picked, Escape closes', async () => {
    const onpick = vi.fn();
    const onclose = vi.fn();
    render(MoveMenu, { items, onpick, onclose });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    expect(document.activeElement?.textContent).toBe('Failing test');
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Reported/ }));
    expect(onpick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Failing test' }));
    expect(onpick).toHaveBeenCalledWith('test');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(onclose).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('a click outside closes it', async () => {
    const onclose = vi.fn();
    render(MoveMenu, { items, onpick: vi.fn(), onclose });
    await fireEvent.pointerDown(document.body);
    expect(onclose).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 13: Port the CSS**

Add the scoping helper. The references use generic class names (`.panel`, `.acts`, `.select`, `.q`), so
each ported file is wrapped in `@scope` on its layout's root. Inside a scope the root itself matches,
and specificity is unchanged.

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/scope-css.mjs <file> <scope-selector> — wrap a ported stylesheet in @scope.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const [file, scope] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!file || !scope) { console.error('usage: scope-css.mjs <file> <scope-selector>'); process.exit(2); }
const css = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
const [head, ...rest] = css.split('\n');
writeFileSync(file, `${head}\n@scope (${scope}) {\n${rest.join('\n')}\n}\n`);
```

Then port, from `apps/web` (the `q\b` prefix is a regex fragment on purpose: `extract-css.mjs` builds
`\.${prefix}`, so `q\b` takes `.q`, `.q h1` and `.q a` but not the shell's `.qn-*`):

```bash
cd apps/web
L=src/lib/components/operate/layouts
node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Operate-Daylight --prefix noface,wrap-any,btn-sm,grid,panel,ph,count,ask,badge,bubble,hint,acts,resume,select,textarea,money,lbl,empty,spend,bar,seg,grp,ev,tick --out $L/operate-daylight.css
node scripts/pixel/scope-css.mjs $L/operate-daylight.css .op-dy
node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Operate-Daylight --prefix sky,crew --out $L/operate-daylight-sky.css
node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Operate-Paper --prefix noface,wrap-any,btn-sm,paper,mast,col,kick,lnk,letter,flag,quote,more,sig,hint,acts,select,dig,tick,toggle,prose,figure,small,box --out $L/operate-paper.css
node scripts/pixel/scope-css.mjs $L/operate-paper.css .op-pp
node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Operate-Studio --prefix op- --out $L/operate-studio.css
node scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs SP-Operate-Quiet --prefix 'noface,wrap-any,btn-sm,q\b,q__,item,meta,dl,acts,form,lbl,inp,plain,ev,toggle,textbtn,money' --out $L/operate-quiet.css
node scripts/pixel/scope-css.mjs $L/operate-quiet.css .op-q
```

Hand deltas, exactly:

1. `operate-daylight-sky.css` renders inside the shell's sky, which is outside the layout root. It is
   therefore not scoped; it is renamed instead. Delete the bare `.sky { margin: 0; border-radius: var(--vk-radius-lg); }`
   rule, because the shell owns the sky box. Then run
   `sed -i '' -e 's/\.sky /.op-greet /g' -e 's/^\.crew/.op-greet .crew/' $L/operate-daylight-sky.css`.
   The section carries `class="op-greet"`.
2. Append the Daylight responsive rules (OP-G10) inside the `@scope (.op-dy)` block of `operate-daylight.css`:
```css
@media (max-width: 1099.98px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
@media (max-width: 599.98px) { .ev { grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) 44px; padding-left: 0; } .ev__acts { padding-left: 0; } }
```
3. Append inside the `@scope (.op-pp)` block of `operate-paper.css`. These are the resume form and cap box,
   which are not drawn, plus the responsive rules:
```css

@media (max-width: 1099.98px) { .cols { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); } aside.col { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-left: 0; padding: var(--vk-space-5) 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); margin-top: var(--vk-space-5); } }
@media (max-width: 699.98px) { .cols { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .col { padding: var(--vk-space-5) 0 0; border-left: 0; } .col + .col { border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); } .paper { padding: var(--vk-space-5) 16px var(--vk-space-6); } .mast h1 { font-size: 2.5rem; } }
```

```ts
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import OperateStudio from './OperateStudio.svelte';
import { fakeModel } from './fake-model';
import { C4605, C58F8 } from '$lib/test/dx-snapshot';

afterEach(cleanup);
const selected = () => document.querySelector('tr.sel[aria-current="true"]');

describe('OperateStudio keyboard', () => {
  it('starts on the first row; J and K move; keys in a field are ignored', async () => {
    render(OperateStudio, { model: fakeModel() });
    expect(selected()?.textContent).toContain('Diagnose Melissa');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'j' });
    expect(selected()?.textContent).toContain('AgentPod');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'k' });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'k' });
    expect(selected()?.textContent).toContain('Diagnose Melissa');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByLabelText('Board cap $'), { key: 'j' });
    expect(selected()?.textContent).toContain('Diagnose Melissa');
  });

  it('O opens the selected card, R opens its resume row', async () => {
    const model = fakeModel();
    render(OperateStudio, { model });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'o' });
    expect(model.open).toHaveBeenCalledWith(C4605.id);
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'j' });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'r' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('form', { name: 'Resume tester-tim' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.activeElement?.id).toBe(`resume-at-${C58F8.id}`);
  });

  it('. marks the selected card’s newest notice read; a modifier does nothing', async () => {
    const model = fakeModel();
    render(OperateStudio, { model });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: '.', metaKey: true });
    expect(model.markRead).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: '.' });
    expect(model.markRead).toHaveBeenCalledWith(model.groups.find((g) => g.cardId === C4605.id)!.latest.seq);
  });

  it('M on the unclaimed row opens the stage menu', async () => {
    render(OperateStudio, { model: fakeModel() });
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'j' });
    await fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'm' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('menu', { name: 'Move to' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('a bad cap is refused beside its field and nothing is sent', async () => {
    const model = fakeModel({ setCaps: async () => ({ board: 'Enter an amount in dollars, like 25 or 25.50.', card: null, refused: null }) });
    render(OperateStudio, { model });
    await fireEvent.input(screen.getByLabelText('Board cap $'), { target: { value: 'lots' } });
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save caps' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Enter an amount in dollars, like 25 or 25.50.')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/layouts/OperateQuiet.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import OperateQuiet from './OperateQuiet.svelte';
import { fakeModel } from './fake-model';

afterEach(cleanup);

describe('OperateQuiet', () => {
  it('lists the needs most urgent first', () => {
    render(OperateQuiet, { model: fakeModel() });
    const titles = screen.getAllByRole('article').map((a) => a.querySelector('h3')!.textContent);
    expect(titles[0]).toMatch(/^Superpipeline: manual-delivery/);
    expect(titles[3]).toMatch(/^Fix the highest-severity/);
  });

  it('Show earlier reminders becomes Hide earlier reminders', async () => {
    render(OperateQuiet, { model: fakeModel() });
    const btn = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Show earlier reminders' })[0]!;
    await fireEvent.click(btn);
    expect(btn.textContent).toBe('Hide earlier reminders');
    expect(btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
  });

  it('a refusal reads "Not done: …"', async () => {
    render(OperateQuiet, { model: fakeModel({ resume: vi.fn(async () => 'card is not stopped') }) });
    const item = screen.getByRole('article', { name: /^AgentPod/ });
    await fireEvent.click(within(item).getByRole('button', { name: 'Resume', exact: true }));
    expect(within(item).getByRole('group', { name: 'Resume this card' })).toBeTruthy();
    await fireEvent.input(within(item).getByRole('textbox'), { target: { value: 'x' } });
    await fireEvent.click(within(item).getByRole('button', { name: 'Send back to work' }));
    expect((await screen.findByRole('alert')).textContent).toBe('Not done: card is not stopped');
  });
});
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Operate-Daylight: Needs you on the left; Running, Spend and Activity on the right. */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import LineIcon from '$lib/components/parts/LineIcon.svelte';
  import { moveTargets } from '../operate-data';
  import { CapsUi, OperateUi } from '../operate-ui.svelte';

  import type { NeedRow, OperateLayoutProps } from './types';
  import './operate-daylight.css';

  let { model }: OperateLayoutProps = $props();
  const ui = new OperateUi(() => model);
  const caps = new CapsUi(() => model);

  function go(e: MouseEvent, id: string, log = false): void {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (log) model.openLog(id);
    else model.open(id);
  }
  const events = (g: (typeof model.groups)[number]) => (ui.earlierOpen[g.cardId] ? [g.latest, ...g.earlier] : [g.latest]);

</script>

```

The `Send back to work` button uses `aria-disabled` rather than `disabled`. `ui.send` ignores it while
`canSend` is false. Quiet's reference draws the button at full strength over an empty note, and
vibekit dims only `:disabled`, so with `aria-disabled` both the pixels and the "unavailable" state are
right.

'false' : 'true'} onclick={() => (model.showRead = false)}>Unread only</button><button type="button" aria-pressed={model.showRead ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => (model.showRead = true)}>Show all</button></div>

```svelte
            {:else if g.need?.actions.includes('move')}<button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" onclick={() => ui.fromActivity(g.need!, 'letters')}>Move</button>{/if}
            {#if g.earlier.length > 0}<button class="more" type="button" aria-expanded={ui.earlierOpen[g.cardId] ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => ui.toggleEarlier(g.cardId)}>Earlier reminders</button>{/if}
          </div>
        </div>
      {/each}
    </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="k3">

        {:else}
          {#each model.running as r (r.cardId)}<p class="prose">{r.agentName ?? 'An agent'} on <a class="lnk" style="min-height: 0px; display: inline;" href={model.cardHref(r.cardId)} onclick={(e) => go(e, r.cardId)}>{r.title}</a>, in {r.stageName}{r.costUsd > 0 ? ` · ${usd(r.costUsd)}` : ''}.</p>{/each}

        {/if}
        <a class="lnk" href="/b/{model.boardId}/operate/telemetry">Details <LineIcon name="arrow" size={14} /></a>

</main>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/layouts/OperateStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-Operate-Studio: the annual-report spread, with J/K/R/M/O/. on the Needs table. */
  import { tick } from 'svelte';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import LineIcon from '$lib/components/parts/LineIcon.svelte';
  import MoveMenu from '$lib/components/parts/MoveMenu.svelte';
  import { moveTargets } from '../operate-data';
  import { CapsUi, OperateUi } from '../operate-ui.svelte';
  import { attemptsSignalOperate, kindCell, needCounts, resumeOptions, RESUME_LABEL, staleLine, studioAge, studioCapFigure, studioHeroTitle, studioOpLine, studioSub, summarySentenceStudio, usd, when } from '../operate-words';
  import type { NeedRow, OperateLayoutProps } from './types';
  import './operate-studio.css';

  let { model }: OperateLayoutProps = $props();
  const ui = new OperateUi(() => model);
  const caps = new CapsUi(() => model);
  caps.start(model.spend);

  let selected = $state(0);
  let menuFor = $state<string | null>(null);
  const triggers: Record<string, HTMLButtonElement> = {};
  const whys: Record<string, HTMLElement> = {};
  let clamped = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const hero = $derived(studioHeroTitle(model.needs.length, model.running.length));
  const capFig = $derived(studioCapFigure(model.spend.cap));
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const go = (e: MouseEvent, id: string, log = false) => { e.preventDefault(); if (log) model.openLog(id); else model.open(id); };
  const events = (g: (typeof model.groups)[number]) => (ui.earlierOpen[g.cardId] ? [g.latest, ...g.earlier] : [g.latest]);

  /** "Show all" only where the three-line clamp actually hides something. */
  function measure(): void {
    const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    for (const [id, el] of Object.entries(whys)) if (el) next[id] = el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1;
    clamped = next;
  }
  $effect(() => {
    void model.needs;
    void tick().then(measure);
    void document.fonts?.ready.then(measure);
  });

  function openMenu(row: NeedRow): void { menuFor = row.item.cardId; }
  function closeMenu(): void { const id = menuFor; menuFor = null; if (id) triggers[id]?.focus(); }
  async function pick(row: NeedRow, key: string): Promise<void> { menuFor = null; await ui.move(row, key); triggers[row.item.cardId]?.focus(); }

  function onkeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const t = e.target;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || (t instanceof Element && t.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"], [role="menu"]'))) return;
    const rows = model.needs;
    const row = rows[selected];
    switch (e.key.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'j': selected = Math.min(rows.length - 1, selected + 1); break;
      case 'k': selected = Math.max(0, selected - 1); break;
      case 'r': if (row?.actions.includes('resume')) void ui.openResume(row); else return; break;
      case 'm': if (row?.actions.includes('move')) openMenu(row); else return; break;
      case 'o': if (row) model.open(row.item.cardId); else return; break;
      case '.': {
        const g = row && model.groups.find((x) => x.cardId === row.item.cardId);
        if (g && !g.latest.read) void model.markRead(g.latest.seq); else return;
        break;
      }
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  }
</script>
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/test/list-props.ts
/** The DX board's List rows and layout props, as PlanView builds them, for unit tests. */
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { stageSummaries, summarize } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
import { buildRows, groupRows, quickCounts } from '$lib/components/plan/list/list-model';
import type { ListLayoutProps, ListSort } from '$lib/components/plan/list/types';
import type { ListGroupBy } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { DX_AGENTS, DX_BOARD, DX_ID, DX_LABELS, DX_MEMBERS, DX_NOW } from './dx-snapshot';

export const DX_STAGE_LIST = stageSummaries(DX_BOARD, DX_BOARD.cards, DX_AGENTS);
export function dxRows() {
  const labels = new Map(DX_LABELS.map((l) => [l.id, { name: l.name, colour: l.colour }]));
  return buildRows(summarize(DX_BOARD, DX_BOARD.cards, { agents: DX_AGENTS, members: DX_MEMBERS, labels, nowMs: DX_NOW }), { boardId: DX_ID, agents: DX_AGENTS });
}

export function listProps(over: Partial<ListLayoutProps> & { groupBy?: ListGroupBy; sort?: ListSort } = {}): ListLayoutProps {
  const rows = dxRows();
  const sort = over.sort ?? { key: 'priority', ascending: true };
  const groupBy = over.groupBy ?? 'stage';
  return {
    boardId: DX_ID, boardName: 'Developer Experience', stageCount: 7,
    groups: groupRows(rows, groupBy, sort, DX_STAGE_LIST, DX_MEMBERS, DX_AGENTS),
    emptyStages: groupBy === 'stage' ? ['Integrate', 'Signed off'] : [],
    cardCount: 7, needsCount: 4, quickCounts: quickCounts(rows), totalCostUsd: 0,
    groupBy, sort, filtersOn: false, hasCards: true,
    stages: DX_BOARD.stages.map((s) => ({ key: s.key, name: s.name })),
    onGroupBy: vi.fn(), onSort: vi.fn(), onSetSort: vi.fn(), onMove: vi.fn(async () => {}), onOpen: vi.fn(), onOpenMoveDialog: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/list/types.ts
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { ListGroupBy } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import type { CardSummary } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';

export type ListSortKey = 'priority' | 'title' | 'state' | 'agent' | 'due' | 'cost' | 'attempts' | 'age';
export interface ListSort { key: ListSortKey; ascending: boolean }
export type ListTone = 'needs' | 'working' | 'queued' | 'done' | 'closed';

export interface ListState {
  /** "Waiting on you" | "Working" | "Queued" | "Done" | "Canceled" | "Rejected" */
  word: string;
  needsYou: boolean;
  /** Quiet's qualifier after the comma ("stopped", "no owner"); null when none. */
  sub: string | null;
  tone: ListTone;
}

export interface ListAgent { id: string; name: string; iconUrl: string | null; mood: Mood; moodWord: string }

export interface ListRow {
  s: CardSummary;
  href: string;
  state: ListState;
  /** null → the unclaimed cell. */
  agent: ListAgent | null;
  unclaimedWord: 'Unclaimed' | 'Not claimed yet';
  priorityText: string | null;
  prioritySignal: boolean;
  dueIso: string | null;
  dueHuman: string | null;
  overdue: boolean;
  dueSignal: boolean;
  costText: string | null;
  costSignal: boolean;
  attempts: number;
  attemptsSignal: boolean;
  ageText: string | null;
  askedBy: { name: string; agentId: string | null; iconUrl: string | null } | null;
  blockedCount: number;
  /** Up to three resolved label names. */
  labelNames: string[];
  /** Labels beyond those shown, unresolved ids included ("+1"). */
  moreLabels: number;
}

export interface ListGroup {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Stage order for stage groups, else the group's position. */
  order: number;
  /** Stage groups only: "a person" | "testing · tester-tim" | "code · 2 agents". */
  owner: string | null;
  rows: ListRow[];
}

export type QuickFilter = 'all' | 'needs' | 'working' | 'idle' | 'done';

export interface ListLayoutProps {
  boardId: string;
  boardName: string;
  stageCount: number;
  groups: ListGroup[];
  /** Stage names with no card, board order; [] unless grouped by stage. */
  emptyStages: string[];
  cardCount: number;
  needsCount: number;
  quickCounts: Record<QuickFilter, number>;
  totalCostUsd: number;
  groupBy: ListGroupBy;
  sort: ListSort;
  filtersOn: boolean;
  /** The board has at least one non-archived card at all. */
  hasCards: boolean;
  stages: Array<{ key: string; name: string }>;
  onGroupBy: (g: ListGroupBy) => void;
  /** A header click: `nextSort(app.listSort, k)`. */
  onSort: (k: ListSortKey) => void;
  /** Quiet's Sort by picker sets a whole sort. */
  onSetSort: (s: ListSort) => void;
  onMove: (cardId: string, stageKey: string) => Promise<void>;
  onOpen: (cardId: string) => void;
  onOpenMoveDialog: (cardId: string) => void;
}
```
