```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/list/list-model.ts
/**
 * The List view as rows: what each cell says, which rows signal, how they sort and group — pure,
 * so every vibe prints the same facts (spec List §3.3). A row needs you exactly when the card has
 * an attention item; `card.state` alone never decides it.
 */
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, Card, Member } from '$lib/api';
import type { AttentionItem, AttentionKind } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import type { CardSummary, StageSummary } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
import type { StageOwnerLabel } from '$lib/components/board/stage-owner';
import { moodWord } from '$lib/components/card/card-lead';
import { ageShort } from '$lib/age';
import { joinAnd } from '$lib/words';
import { displayAgent, displayPrincipal } from '$lib/names';
import type { CardFilters, ListGroupBy } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import type { ListAgent, ListGroup, ListRow, ListSort, ListSortKey, ListState, ListTone, QuickFilter } from './types';

const SUB: Record<AttentionKind, string> = {
  review: 'review', question: 'question asked', blocked: 'stopped', 'repeated-failure': 'failing', refused: 'refused',
  'sub-tasks': 'waiting on sub-tasks', 'no-owner': 'no owner', failed: 'failed', budget: 'over budget',
};

export function listStateOf(card: Card, items: AttentionItem[]): ListState {
  const item = items.find((i) => i.cardId === card.id);
  if (item) return { word: 'Waiting on you', needsYou: true, tone: 'needs', sub: SUB[item.kind] };
  switch (card.state) {
    case 'working': return { word: 'Working', needsYou: false, tone: 'working', sub: null };
    case 'completed': return { word: 'Done', needsYou: false, tone: 'done', sub: null };
    case 'canceled': return { word: 'Canceled', needsYou: false, tone: 'closed', sub: null };
    case 'rejected': return { word: 'Rejected', needsYou: false, tone: 'closed', sub: null };
    default: return { word: 'Queued', needsYou: false, tone: 'queued', sub: null };
  }
}

function rowAgent(s: CardSummary, state: ListState, agents: AgentSummary[]): ListAgent | null {
  const id = s.card.delegateAgentId ?? s.card.lastAgentId ?? null;
  if (!id) return null;
  const mood: Mood = state.needsYou ? 'needs' : state.tone === 'working' ? 'working' : state.tone === 'done' ? 'done' : s.card.delegateAgentId ? 'thinking' : 'resting';
  return { id, name: displayAgent(id, agents), iconUrl: agents.find((a) => a.id === id)?.iconUrl ?? null, mood, moodWord: moodWord(mood) };
}

export function dueHuman(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
}

export function buildRows(summaries: CardSummary[], ctx: { boardId: string; agents: AgentSummary[] }): ListRow[] {
  return summaries.map((s) => {
    const state = listStateOf(s.card, s.attention ? [s.attention] : []);
    const needs = state.needsYou;
    const closed = state.tone === 'done' || state.tone === 'closed';
    const shown = s.labels.slice(0, 3);
    return {
      s, href: `/b/${ctx.boardId}/c/${s.id}`, state, agent: rowAgent(s, state, ctx.agents),
      unclaimedWord: s.attention?.kind === 'no-owner' ? 'Unclaimed' : 'Not claimed yet',
      priorityText: s.priority > 0 ? `P${s.priority}` : null,
      prioritySignal: s.priority === 1 && needs,
      dueIso: s.dueAt, dueHuman: s.dueAt ? dueHuman(s.dueAt) : null, overdue: s.overdue, dueSignal: s.overdue && needs,
      costText: s.cost > 0 ? `$${s.cost.toFixed(2)}` : null, costSignal: s.overBudget && needs,
      attempts: s.attemptCount, attemptsSignal: s.attemptCount >= 2 && needs,
      ageText: s.ageHours === null || closed ? null : ageShort(s.ageHours, false),
      askedBy: s.queuedBy?.agent ? { name: s.queuedBy.name, agentId: s.queuedBy.agent.id, iconUrl: s.queuedBy.agent.iconUrl } : null,
      blockedCount: s.card.blockedBy.length,
      labelNames: shown.map((l) => l.name),
      moreLabels: Math.max(0, s.card.labels.length - shown.length),
    };
  });
}

/** Daylight and Paper mark P1 in signal only when the row needs you; other priorities keep their class. */
export function priClass(r: ListRow): string {
  if (r.prioritySignal) return 'pri pri--1';
  return r.s.priority === 1 ? 'pri' : `pri pri--${r.s.priority}`;
}

// ---- sorting ----
const TONES: readonly ListTone[] = ['needs', 'working', 'queued', 'done', 'closed'];

function keyOf(r: ListRow, key: ListSortKey): number | string | null {
  switch (key) {
    case 'priority': return r.s.priority > 0 ? r.s.priority : null;
    case 'title': return r.s.title;
    case 'state': return TONES.indexOf(r.state.tone);
    case 'agent': return r.agent?.name ?? null;
    case 'due': return r.dueIso;
    case 'cost': return r.s.cost;
    case 'attempts': return r.attempts;
    case 'age': return r.s.ageHours;
  }
}

/** By the key (descending reverses only the key), missing values last; then needs-you, age, title. */
export function sortRows(rows: ListRow[], sort: ListSort): ListRow[] {
  return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const x = keyOf(a, sort.key);
    const y = keyOf(b, sort.key);
    if (x === null && y !== null) return 1;
    if (y === null && x !== null) return -1;
    if (x !== null && y !== null) {
      const c = typeof x === 'number' && typeof y === 'number' ? x - y : String(x).localeCompare(String(y));
      if (c !== 0) return sort.ascending ? c : -c;
    }
    return Number(b.state.needsYou) - Number(a.state.needsYou) || (b.s.ageHours ?? -1) - (a.s.ageHours ?? -1) || a.s.title.localeCompare(b.s.title);
  });
}

export function nextSort(cur: ListSort, k: ListSortKey): ListSort {
  if (cur.key === k) return { key: k, ascending: !cur.ascending };
  return { key: k, ascending: !(k === 'cost' || k === 'attempts' || k === 'age') };
}

export function sortHint(s: ListSort): string {
  switch (s.key) {
    case 'priority': return s.ascending ? 'highest first' : 'lowest first';
    case 'title': case 'agent': return s.ascending ? 'A to Z' : 'Z to A';
    case 'due': return s.ascending ? 'soonest first' : 'latest first';
    case 'state': return s.ascending ? 'most urgent first' : 'least urgent first';
    default: return s.ascending ? 'lowest first' : 'highest first';
  }
}

export const SORT_NOUN: Record<ListSortKey, string> = { priority: 'priority', title: 'card title', state: 'state', agent: 'agent', due: 'due date', cost: 'cost', attempts: 'attempts', age: 'age' };
export const STUDIO_HEADER: Record<ListSortKey, string> = { priority: 'Pri', title: 'Card', state: 'State', agent: 'Agent', attempts: 'Att', age: 'Age', due: 'Due', cost: 'Cost' };
export const GROUP_NOUN: Record<ListGroupBy, string> = { stage: 'stage', state: 'state', owner: 'owner', priority: 'priority' };
export const GROUPS: Array<{ id: ListGroupBy; label: string }> = [
  { id: 'stage', label: 'Stage' }, { id: 'state', label: 'State' }, { id: 'owner', label: 'Owner' }, { id: 'priority', label: 'Priority' },
];
export const STUDIO_SORT_CYCLE: ListSortKey[] = ['priority', 'title', 'state', 'agent', 'attempts', 'age', 'due', 'cost'];
export const GROUP_CYCLE: ListGroupBy[] = ['stage', 'state', 'owner', 'priority'];
export function nextInCycle<T>(cycle: readonly T[], cur: T): T {
  return cycle[(cycle.indexOf(cur) + 1) % cycle.length]!;
}

// ---- grouping ----
const TONE_LABEL: Record<ListTone, string> = { needs: 'Waiting on you', working: 'Working', queued: 'Queued', done: 'Done', closed: 'Closed' };

/** "diagnostics · error-eric", "code · 2 agents", "a person". */
export function ownerText(o: StageOwnerLabel): string {
  if (o.kind !== 'capability' || o.declaredBy.length === 0) return o.label;
  return o.declaredBy.length === 1 ? `${o.label} · ${o.declaredBy[0]}` : `${o.label} · ${o.declaredBy.length} agents`;
}

export function groupRows(rows: ListRow[], groupBy: ListGroupBy, sort: ListSort, stageList: StageSummary[], members: Member[], agents: AgentSummary[]): ListGroup[] {
  let groups: ListGroup[];
  if (groupBy === 'stage') {
    groups = stageList.map((st) => ({ key: st.key, label: st.name, order: st.order, owner: ownerText(st.owner), rows: rows.filter((r) => r.s.stageKey === st.key) }));
  } else if (groupBy === 'state') {
    groups = TONES.map((t, i) => ({ key: t, label: TONE_LABEL[t], order: i, owner: null, rows: rows.filter((r) => r.state.tone === t) }));
  } else if (groupBy === 'owner') {
    groups = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.s.card.ownerUserId))]
      .map((id) => ({ key: id, label: displayPrincipal(id, members, agents) || id, order: 0, owner: null, rows: rows.filter((r) => r.s.card.ownerUserId === id) }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label))
      .map((g, i) => ({ ...g, order: i }));
  } else {
    const rank = (p: number) => (p > 0 ? p : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    groups = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.s.priority))]
      .sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b))
      .map((p, i) => ({ key: p > 0 ? `P${p}` : 'none', label: p > 0 ? `P${p}` : 'No priority', order: i, owner: null, rows: rows.filter((r) => r.s.priority === p) }));
  }
  return groups.filter((g) => g.rows.length > 0).map((g) => ({ ...g, rows: sortRows(g.rows, sort) }));
}

export function quickCounts(rows: ListRow[]): Record<QuickFilter, number> {
  const n = (t: ListTone) => rows.filter((r) => r.state.tone === t).length;
  return { all: rows.length, needs: n('needs'), working: n('working'), idle: n('queued'), done: n('done') + n('closed') };
}

const QUICK_TONES: Record<QuickFilter, ListTone[] | null> = { all: null, needs: ['needs'], working: ['working'], idle: ['queued'], done: ['done', 'closed'] };
/** Studio's quick filter: rows by tone after grouping; groups left empty drop. */
export function filterQuick(groups: ListGroup[], quick: QuickFilter): ListGroup[] {
  const tones = QUICK_TONES[quick];
  if (!tones) return groups;
  return groups.map((g) => ({ ...g, rows: g.rows.filter((r) => tones.includes(r.state.tone)) })).filter((g) => g.rows.length > 0);
}

export function filtersActive(f: CardFilters): boolean {
  return f.states.length > 0 || f.owners.length > 0 || f.minPriority !== null || f.needsReview || f.live || f.overBudget || f.labels.length > 0 || f.showArchived || f.projectId !== null;
}

// ---- words ----
const WORDS = ['no', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine', 'ten', 'eleven', 'twelve'];
/** The List counts in words up to twelve (Operate stops at ten). */
export const listNumberWord = (n: number): string => WORDS[n] ?? String(n);
const capWord = (w: string): string => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);
const cardsText = (n: number): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}`;
const blockedText = (n: number): string => (n === 1 ? 'Blocked by another card' : `Blocked by ${listNumberWord(n)} other cards`);

export function daylightSum(cardCount: number, needs: number, sort: ListSort): string {
  return `${cardsText(cardCount)}${needs > 0 ? ` · ${needs} ${needs === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} on you` : ''} · sorted by ${SORT_NOUN[sort.key]}`;
}

export function listCaption(boardName: string, groupBy: ListGroupBy, sort: ListSort, withDirection = false): string {
  return `${boardName} cards, grouped by ${GROUP_NOUN[groupBy]}, sorted by ${SORT_NOUN[sort.key]}${withDirection ? (sort.ascending ? ' ascending' : ' descending') : ''}`;
}

export function paperMastLine(boardName: string, cardCount: number, needs: number): string {
  const head = `${boardName}, ${listNumberWord(cardCount)} ${cardCount === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}.`;
  return head + (needs === 0 ? ' Nothing waits on you.' : ` ${capWord(listNumberWord(needs))} ${needs === 1 ? 'waits' : 'wait'} on you.`);
}

export const paperGroupCount = (n: number): string => `— ${listNumberWord(n)} ${n === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}`;

export function paperFoot(sort: ListSort, empty: string[]): string {
  return `Sorted by ${SORT_NOUN[sort.key]}, ${sortHint(sort)}.${empty.length ? ` Stages with no cards are left out: ${joinAnd(empty)}.` : ''}`;
}

/** Paper's facts run, up to (and including the separator before) the asked-by span. */
export function paperFacts(r: ListRow): string {
  const parts = [...r.labelNames, ...(r.moreLabels ? [`+${r.moreLabels} more`] : []), ...(r.blockedCount ? [blockedText(r.blockedCount)] : [])];
  return parts.join(' · ') + (r.askedBy && parts.length ? ' · ' : '');
}

const QUICK_WORD: Record<Exclude<QuickFilter, 'all'>, string> = { needs: 'Waiting', working: 'Working', idle: 'Idle', done: 'Done' };
export function studioKicker(groupBy: ListGroupBy, quick: QuickFilter): string {
  return quick === 'all' ? `Every card, by ${GROUP_NOUN[groupBy]}` : `${QUICK_WORD[quick]} cards, by ${GROUP_NOUN[groupBy]}`;
}

export function studioHeadline(visible: number, groups: number, stageCount: number, groupBy: ListGroupBy): { sr: string; text: string } {
  const text = groupBy === 'stage'
    ? `${visible === 1 ? 'card sits' : 'cards sit'} in ${groups} of the board’s ${stageCount} stages`
    : `${visible === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} in ${groups} ${GROUP_NOUN[groupBy]}${groups === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  return { sr: `${visible} `, text };
}

export function studioLede(sort: ListSort, empty: string[]): string {
  const k = empty.length;
  return `Sorted by ${SORT_NOUN[sort.key]}, ${sortHint(sort)}.` + (k ? ` The ${listNumberWord(k)} empty stage${k === 1 ? '' : 's'}, ${joinAnd(empty)}, ${k === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} left out of the list.` : '');
}

export function studioFoot(f: { visible: number; groups: number; groupBy: ListGroupBy; empty: number; sort: ListSort; total: number; selected: number | null }): string[] {
  return [
    cardsText(f.visible),
    `${f.groups} ${f.groups === 1 ? 'group' : 'groups'}${f.groupBy === 'stage' && f.empty ? ` · ${f.empty} empty ${f.empty === 1 ? 'stage' : 'stages'} hidden` : ''}`,
    `sort ${STUDIO_HEADER[f.sort.key]} ${f.sort.ascending ? '↑' : '↓'}`,
    `$${f.total.toFixed(2)} total`,
    ...(f.selected === null ? [] : [`row ${f.selected + 1} of ${f.visible}`]),
  ];
}

/** Studio's group number: the stage's own number, else the group's position. */
export function groupNo(g: ListGroup, index: number, groupBy: ListGroupBy): string {
  return String((groupBy === 'stage' ? g.order : index) + 1).padStart(2, '0');
}

export function quietLede(cardCount: number, needs: number): string {
  return `${cardsText(cardCount)}.` + (needs === 0 ? ' No card is waiting on you.' : needs === 1 ? ' 1 is waiting on you.' : ` ${needs} are waiting on you.`);
}

export function quietFacts(r: ListRow): string {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (r.labelNames.length) out.push(r.moreLabels ? `Labels: ${r.labelNames.join(', ')} and ${r.moreLabels} more.` : `Labels: ${joinAnd(r.labelNames)}.`);
  if (r.blockedCount) out.push(`${blockedText(r.blockedCount)}.`);
  if (r.askedBy) out.push(`Asked for by ${r.askedBy.name}.`);
  return out.join(' ');
}

export const quietState = (s: ListState): string => (s.needsYou && s.sub ? `${s.word}, ${s.sub}` : s.word);
export const quietEmptyFoot = (empty: string[]): string => `Stages with no cards are not shown: ${empty.join(', ')}.`;

export const QUIET_SORTS: Array<{ label: string; sort: ListSort }> = [
  { label: 'Priority, highest first', sort: { key: 'priority', ascending: true } },
  { label: 'Card title', sort: { key: 'title', ascending: true } },
  { label: 'State', sort: { key: 'state', ascending: true } },
  { label: 'Agent', sort: { key: 'agent', ascending: true } },
  { label: 'Due date', sort: { key: 'due', ascending: true } },
  { label: 'Cost', sort: { key: 'cost', ascending: false } },
];

/** The picker's options; a sort set by a header it does not list is shown first, selected (LI-G14). */
export function quietSortOptions(current: ListSort): Array<{ value: string; label: string; sort: ListSort; selected: boolean }> {
  const opts = QUIET_SORTS.map((o, i) => ({ value: String(i), label: o.label, sort: o.sort, selected: o.sort.key === current.key && o.sort.ascending === current.ascending }));
  if (opts.some((o) => o.selected)) return opts;
  return [{ value: 'current', label: capWord(`${SORT_NOUN[current.key]}, ${sortHint(current)}`), sort: current, selected: true }, ...opts];
}

export const emptyText = (p: { filtersOn: boolean; hasCards: boolean }): string => (p.hasCards ? 'No cards match these filters.' : 'No cards on this board');
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `RowMoveMenu.svelte`**

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/list/RowMoveMenu.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** Daylight's row "Move": a menu under the button, every stage, the card's own marked "here". */
  import LineIcon from '$lib/components/parts/LineIcon.svelte';
  import MoveMenu from '$lib/components/parts/MoveMenu.svelte';

  let { card, stages, onMove }: {
    card: { id: string; title: string; currentStageKey: string };
    stages: Array<{ key: string; name: string }>;
    onMove: (cardId: string, stageKey: string) => Promise<void>;
  } = $props();

  let open = $state(false);
  let trigger: HTMLButtonElement | undefined = $state();
  let said = $state('');

  function close(): void { open = false; trigger?.focus(); }
  async function pick(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const target = stages.find((s) => s.key === key);
    open = false;
    await onMove(card.id, key);
    said = target ? `${card.title} moved to ${target.name}` : '';
    trigger?.focus();
  }
</script>

<button bind:this={trigger} class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => (open ? close() : (open = true))}><LineIcon name="move" />Move</button>
{#if open}<MoveMenu {trigger} items={stages.map((s) => ({ key: s.key, name: s.name, here: s.key === card.currentStageKey }))} onpick={pick} onclose={close} />{/if}
<span class="vk-visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">{said}</span>
```

The live region is absolutely positioned (`vk-visually-hidden`), so it takes no place in the `.acts`
flex row. A refused move surfaces in `app.error` through `app.moveCard`.

```ts
    expect(screen.queryByRole('menu')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(move);

  it('Escape closes the menu and returns focus', async () => {
    render(ListDaylight, listProps());
    const move = within(row63()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Move', exact: true });
    await fireEvent.click(move);
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'Escape' });

    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(move);

    render(ListDaylight, listProps({ groups: [], cardCount: 0, filtersOn: true }));
    expect(screen.getByText('No cards match these filters.')).toBeTruthy();
    cleanup();
    render(ListDaylight, listProps({ groups: [], cardCount: 0, hasCards: false }));
    expect(screen.getByText('No cards on this board')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/list/ListStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-List-Studio: quick filter, hero, ruled table; J/K select, ↵ open, M move, S sort, G group. */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import LineIcon from '$lib/components/parts/LineIcon.svelte';
  import { emptyText, filterQuick, GROUP_CYCLE, GROUPS, groupNo, listCaption, nextInCycle, sortHint, STUDIO_SORT_CYCLE, studioFoot, studioHeadline, studioKicker, studioLede } from './list-model';
  import type { ListLayoutProps, ListRow, ListSortKey, ListTone, QuickFilter } from './types';
  import './list-studio.css';

  let p: ListLayoutProps = $props();
  let quick = $state<QuickFilter>('all');
  let selected = $state<number | null>(null);

  const QUICK: Array<{ id: QuickFilter; label: string }> = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'All' }, { id: 'needs', label: 'Needs' }, { id: 'working', label: 'Working' }, { id: 'idle', label: 'Idle' }, { id: 'done', label: 'Done' },
  ];
  const COLS: Array<{ key: ListSortKey; width: string }> = [
    { key: 'priority', width: '56px' }, { key: 'title', width: '' }, { key: 'state', width: '140px' }, { key: 'agent', width: '132px' },
    { key: 'attempts', width: '48px' }, { key: 'age', width: '52px' }, { key: 'due', width: '112px' }, { key: 'cost', width: '56px' },
  ];
  const LABEL: Record<ListSortKey, string> = { priority: 'Pri', title: 'Card', state: 'State', agent: 'Agent', attempts: 'Att', age: 'Age', due: 'Due', cost: 'Cost' };
  const UNIT: Record<ListTone, string> = { needs: 'needs', working: 'working', queued: 'queued', done: 'done', closed: 'off' };

  const groups = $derived(filterQuick(p.groups, quick));
  const flat = $derived(groups.flatMap((g) => g.rows));
  const visible = $derived(flat.length);
  const hero = $derived(studioHeadline(visible, groups.length, p.stageCount, p.groupBy));
  const foot = $derived(studioFoot({ visible, groups: groups.length, groupBy: p.groupBy, empty: p.emptyStages.length, sort: p.sort, total: p.totalCostUsd, selected }));

  $effect(() => {
    if (selected !== null && selected >= visible) selected = visible ? visible - 1 : null;
  });
  $effect(() => {
    if (selected !== null) document.querySelector('.ls-tbl tr.sel')?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest' });
  });

  function pickRow(e: MouseEvent, r: ListRow): void {
    if ((e.target as Element).closest('a, button')) return;
    selected = flat.indexOf(r);
  }

  function onkeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const t = e.target;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || (t instanceof Element && t.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]'))) return;
    const row = selected === null ? undefined : flat[selected];
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'j': case 'J': if (!visible) return; selected = selected === null ? 0 : Math.min(visible - 1, selected + 1); break;
      case 'k': case 'K': if (!visible) return; selected = selected === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, selected - 1); break;
      case 'Enter': if (!row) return; p.onOpen(row.s.id); break;
      case 'm': case 'M': if (!row) return; p.onOpenMoveDialog(row.s.id); break;
      case 's': case 'S': p.onSort(nextInCycle(STUDIO_SORT_CYCLE, p.sort.key)); break;
      case 'g': case 'G': p.onGroupBy(nextInCycle(GROUP_CYCLE, p.groupBy)); break;
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  }
</script>

<svelte:window {onkeydown} />

<main class="ls-main">
  <div class="ls-bar">
    <div class="ls-seg" role="group" aria-label="Quick filter">{#each QUICK as q (q.id)}<button type="button" aria-pressed={quick === q.id ? 'true' : 'false'} class:sig={q.id === 'needs' && p.quickCounts.needs > 0} onclick={() => { quick = q.id; selected = null; }}>{q.label} <span class="n">{p.quickCounts[q.id]}</span></button>{/each}</div>
    <span class="kick">Group</span>
    <div class="ls-seg" role="group" aria-label="Group by">{#each GROUPS as g (g.id)}<button type="button" aria-pressed={p.groupBy === g.id ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => p.onGroupBy(g.id)}>{g.label}</button>{/each}</div>
    <div class="keys" aria-label="Keyboard"><span><span class="kbd">J</span><span class="kbd">K</span> row</span><span><span class="kbd">↵</span> open</span><span><span class="kbd">M</span> move</span><span><span class="kbd">S</span> sort</span><span><span class="kbd">G</span> group</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ls-hero">
    <span class="big" aria-hidden="true">{visible}</span>
    <div><span class="kick">{studioKicker(p.groupBy, quick)}</span><h1><span class="sr">{hero.sr}</span>{hero.text}</h1><p>{studioLede(p.sort, p.emptyStages)}</p></div>
  </div>

  {#if visible === 0}
    <div class="ls-foot"><span>{p.hasCards ? 'No cards match these filters.' : emptyText(p)}</span></div>
  {:else}
    <section class="ar-sec" aria-label="Cards">
      <table class="ar-tbl ls-tbl">
        <caption class="sr">{listCaption(p.boardName, p.groupBy, p.sort, true)}</caption>
        <thead><tr>{#each COLS as c (c.key)}{@const on = p.sort.key === c.key}<th scope="col" aria-sort={on ? (p.sort.ascending ? 'ascending' : 'descending') : undefined} style={c.width ? `width: ${c.width};` : undefined}><button class="sort" type="button" data-on={on ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => p.onSort(c.key)}>{LABEL[c.key]}<LineIcon name="sort-studio" size={12} stroke={1.75} />{#if on}<span class="sr">, sorted {sortHint(p.sort)}</span>{/if}</button></th>{/each}<th scope="col" style="width: 176px;"><span class="sr">Actions</span></th></tr></thead>
        {#each groups as g, gi (g.key)}
          <tbody><tr class="g"><th colspan="9" scope="colgroup"><span class="in"><span class="no">{groupNo(g, gi, p.groupBy)}</span>{#if p.groupBy === 'stage'}<span class="band c{g.order + 1}"></span>{/if}<span class="nm">{g.label}</span><span class="ct">{g.rows.length}</span>{#if g.owner}<span class="own">{g.owner}</span>{/if}</span></th></tr>{#each g.rows as r (r.s.id)}{@const i = flat.indexOf(r)}<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_click_events_have_key_events a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interactions --><tr class:sel={selected === i} aria-current={selected === i ? 'true' : undefined} onclick={(e) => pickRow(e, r)}>
            <td data-label="Priority">{#if r.priorityText}<span class="ls-pri">{r.priorityText}</span>{:else}<span class="m" aria-label="No priority">—</span>{/if}</td>
            <td><a class="ttl" href={r.href}>{r.s.title}</a>{#if r.labelNames.length || r.moreLabels || r.blockedCount || r.askedBy}<div class="ar-facts">{#each r.labelNames as l (l)}<span>{l}</span>{/each}{#if r.moreLabels}<span title="{r.moreLabels} more label{r.moreLabels === 1 ? '' : 's'}">+{r.moreLabels}</span>{/if}{#if r.blockedCount}<span><LineIcon name="lock" size={12} stroke={1.75} />Blocked</span>{/if}{#if r.askedBy}<span><Face id={r.askedBy.name} label={r.askedBy.name} mood="working" size={14} src={r.askedBy.iconUrl ?? undefined} />asked by {r.askedBy.name}</span>{/if}</div>{/if}</td>
            <td data-label="State"><span class="ar-st" class:needs={r.state.needsYou}><span class="u {UNIT[r.state.tone]}"></span>{r.state.word}</span></td>
            <td data-label="Agent">{#if r.agent}<span class="ag"><Face id={r.agent.name} label={r.agent.name} mood={r.agent.mood} size={20} src={r.agent.iconUrl ?? undefined} />{r.agent.name}</span>{:else}<span class="m">{r.unclaimedWord}</span>{/if}</td>

            <td data-label="Due">{#if r.dueSignal}<span class="ls-over"><LineIcon name="calendar" size={12} stroke={1.75} />{r.dueIso}<span class="sr">, overdue</span></span>{:else}<span class="m">{r.dueIso ?? '—'}</span>{/if}</td>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** SP-List-Quiet: a heading and a table per group; Group by and Sort by are plain selects. */
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import type { ListGroupBy } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { emptyText, GROUPS, quietEmptyFoot, quietFacts, quietLede, quietSortOptions, quietState, sortHint } from './list-model';
  import type { ListLayoutProps, ListSortKey } from './types';
  import './list-quiet.css';

  let p: ListLayoutProps = $props();
  const COLS: Array<{ key: ListSortKey; label: string }> = [
    { key: 'priority', label: 'Priority' }, { key: 'title', label: 'Card' }, { key: 'state', label: 'State' },
    { key: 'agent', label: 'Agent' }, { key: 'due', label: 'Due' }, { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost' },
  ];
  const sorts = $derived(quietSortOptions(p.sort));
  function setSort(value: string): void {
    const o = sorts.find((x) => x.value === value);
    if (o) p.onSetSort(o.sort);
  }
</script>

<main class="q ls-q" id="content" tabindex="-1"><div class="q__col">
  <h1>{p.boardName}: list</h1>
  <p class="lede">{quietLede(p.cardCount, p.needsCount)}</p>
  <div class="controls">
    <label class="lbl">Group by<select class="inp" value={p.groupBy} onchange={(e) => p.onGroupBy(e.currentTarget.value as ListGroupBy)}>{#each GROUPS as g (g.id)}<option value={g.id}>{g.label}</option>{/each}</select></label>
    <label class="lbl">Sort by<select class="inp" value={sorts.find((o) => o.selected)?.value} onchange={(e) => setSort(e.currentTarget.value)}>{#each sorts as o (o.value)}<option value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>{/each}</select></label>
  </div>
  {#if p.groups.length === 0}<p class="empty">{emptyText(p)}</p>{/if}
  {#each p.groups as g (g.key)}
    <h2>{g.label} ({g.rows.length})</h2>{#if g.owner}<p class="own">Worked by {g.owner}.</p>{/if}<table><caption class="vk-visually-hidden">{g.label}</caption><thead><tr>{#each COLS as c (c.key)}{@const on = p.sort.key === c.key}<th scope="col" aria-sort={on ? (p.sort.ascending ? 'ascending' : 'descending') : undefined}><button class="sort" type="button" data-on={on ? 'true' : 'false'} onclick={() => p.onSort(c.key)}>{c.label}{#if on} <span class="sorted">(sorted, {sortHint(p.sort)})</span>{/if}</button></th>{/each}<th scope="col">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>{#each g.rows as r (r.s.id)}{@const facts = quietFacts(r)}<tr class:needs={r.state.needsYou}>
      <td style="width: 7rem;" data-label="Priority">{r.priorityText ?? 'None'}</td>
      <td><a href={r.href}>{r.s.title}</a>{#if facts}<div class="facts">{facts}</div>{/if}</td>
      <td style="width: 11rem;" data-label="State">{#if r.state.needsYou}<span class="st--needs">{quietState(r.state)}</span>{:else}<span>{r.state.word}</span>{/if}</td>
      <td style="width: 11rem;" data-label="Agent">{#if r.agent}<div class="who"><Face id={r.agent.name} label={r.agent.name} mood={r.agent.mood} size={20} src={r.agent.iconUrl ?? undefined} />{r.agent.name}</div>{:else}<div class="who"><span class="noface" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 20px; height: 20px;"></span>{r.unclaimedWord}</div>{/if}</td>
      <td style="width: 10rem;" data-label="Due">{#if r.overdue && r.dueHuman}<strong>Overdue.</strong> Was due {r.dueHuman}.{:else if r.dueHuman}Due {r.dueHuman}.{:else}None{/if}</td>
      <td style="width: 5rem;" data-label="Cost">{#if r.costText}<span class:st--needs={r.costSignal}>{r.costText}</span>{:else}None{/if}</td>
      <td style="width: 12rem;"><div class="acts"><a href={r.href}>Open</a><button class="textbtn" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick={() => p.onOpenMoveDialog(r.s.id)}>Move</button></div></td>
    </tr>{/each}</tbody></table>
  {/each}
  {#if p.emptyStages.length > 0}<p class="empty">{quietEmptyFoot(p.emptyStages)}</p>{/if}
</div></main>
```

```ts
  import { LIST_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

];

test('?view=list opens the List, and a row menu moves the card on the server', async ({ page, request }) => {

  const row = page.getByRole('row', { name: /Write the changelog/ });
  await row.getByRole('button', { name: 'Move', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menu', { name: 'Move to' }).getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Doing' }).click();

  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await (await request.get(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}`, { headers: TENANT })).json()).cards[0].currentStageKey)
    .toBe('doing');
  await expect(page.getByText('Write the changelog moved to Doing')).toBeAttached();
  await expect(page.getByRole('rowgroup').filter({ hasText: 'Doing' }).getByRole('link', { name: 'Write the changelog' })).toBeVisible();
});
```

### Task 32: Projects in every vibe, and the shared page stylesheet

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

The Projects view is rebuilt on the reference markup and turns `SP-Projects-Daylight`, `-Paper`, `-Studio` and `-Quiet` green in both themes. Daylight, Paper and Quiet share one component (`plan/projects/ProjectsPage.svelte`), whose DOM is identical in the three references; only the CSS differs, and the reference CSS already carries its own `[data-vibe="paper"]`/`[data-vibe="quiet"]` branches. Studio uses its own markup (`main.pj-main`, built from the Annual base), registered in `PROJECTS_LAYOUTS` (notes `pages.md` problem 1). This task also lands the pieces the other four page tasks (30–33) reuse: the shared `screen.css` (type scale, panel, chip, field, tabs…), `PageMain`, `PageIcon`, `pageStatus` and three new `extract-css.mjs` options (several artboards at once, `--match`, `--scope`). Rulings applied: the references are the loading state (rollups held); create panel and the first card's milestones are opened by the harness (PR-G2: the app defaults both closed); a failed rollup is muted, never signal (PR-G10); seed of every face is the agent name (WA-G7, used from Task 33).

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs` (comma-separated artboards with rule de-duplication; `--match <regex>`; `--scope <class>`)

- Produces (later tasks import these):
  - `extract-css.mjs <A1,A2,…> [--prefix p1,p2] [--match <regex>] [--scope <.class>] [--skip-vibekit] [--out f]` — rules of all named artboards, each distinct rule once, in first-seen order; `--match` keeps rules whose selector list matches the JS regex (in addition to `--prefix`); `--scope .x` rewrites every selector that does not already name `.x` to `<outer> :where(.x) <rest>`, where `<outer>` is any leading `[data-vibe=…]`, `[data-theme=…]` or `.ar` compound (zero added specificity); `--skip-vibekit` ignores the reference's `<style>` block that defines `--vk-color-bg` (tokens and vibekit's own component CSS, which the app already loads from the package).
  - `src/lib/styles/screen.css`: every rule shared by the five page references, scoped `:where(.page)`.
  - `PageIcon` `{ name: PageIconName; size?: number; stroke?: number; square?: boolean }` and `PAGE_ICONS` / `type PageIconName` (`plus chev-down chev-left chev-right trash check calendar person agent arrow-up arrow-down arrow-right home info github copy key dots pencil link refresh close`).
  - `PageMain` `{ vibe: Vibe; scope: string; children: Snippet }` → `main.page.{scope}` (`#main`; Paper adds `.pp-page`; Quiet `#content tabindex=-1`).
  - `pageStatus(lead: string[], needs: number, synced: string | null): PageStatus`, `syncedLabel(at: Date | null): string | null`, `STATUS_RIGHT`, `interface PageStatus { items: Array<{ text: string; signal?: boolean }>; right: string[] }` (`shell/page-status.ts`).
  - `PROJECTS_LAYOUTS: Record<Vibe, Component<ProjectsLayoutProps>>`, `ProjectsLayoutProps { model: ProjectsModel; vibe: Vibe }`, `class ProjectsModel`.
  - `project-rollup.ts`: `GROUP_ORDER`, `ProjectGroup`, `groupProjects`, `projectsSummary`, `fmtTarget`, `milestoneDate`, `milestonesMeta`, `STATE_LABEL`, `HEALTH_LABEL`, `STUDIO_UNIT`, `projectsShell`; `formatAsOf(r, timeZone?)`, `rollupSegments(r, timeZone?)`.

```js
const [artboardArg, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (k) => { const i = rest.indexOf(k); return i > -1 ? rest[i + 1] : undefined; };
const prefixes = (arg('--prefix') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const matchSrc = arg('--match');
const match = matchSrc ? new RegExp(matchSrc) : null;
const scope = arg('--scope');
/** Skip the reference's token + vibekit block (the app gets those rules from the package, per vibe). */
const skipVibekit = rest.includes('--skip-vibekit');
if (!artboardArg || (prefixes.length === 0 && !match)) {
  console.error('usage: extract-css.mjs <Artboard[,Artboard…]> [--prefix a-,b-] [--match <regex>] [--scope .cls] [--skip-vibekit] [--out file]');
  process.exit(2);
}
const artboards = artboardArg.split(',').filter(Boolean);
const css = artboards
  .map((a) => readFileSync(join(here, '../../e2e/reference/mockups', `${a}.html`), 'utf8'))
  .flatMap((html) => [...html.matchAll(/<style[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/g)].map((m) => m[1]))
  .filter((block) => !(skipVibekit && block.includes('--vk-color-bg:')))
  .join('\n');

/** Split top-level CSS into [prelude, body] blocks, keeping @media/@supports/@container groups. */
function blocks(src) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, start = 0, open = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const c = src[i];
    if (c === '/' && src[i + 1] === '*') { const e = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2); i = e < 0 ? src.length : e + 1; if (depth === 0) start = i + 1; continue; }
    if (c === '{') { if (depth === 0) open = i; depth++; }
    else if (c === '}') { depth--; if (depth === 0) { out.push([src.slice(start, open).trim(), src.slice(open + 1, i)]); start = i + 1; } }
  }
  return out;
}
const wanted = (sel) => !/\.sc-/.test(sel)
  && (prefixes.some((p) => new RegExp(`\\.${p.replace(/[-]/g, '\\-')}`).test(sel)) || (match !== null && match.test(sel)));

/** Split a selector list on top-level commas (not the ones inside :where(…) or [ … ]). */
function splitList(list) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, cur = '';
  for (const ch of list) {
    if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
    else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
    if (ch === ',' && depth === 0) { out.push(cur.trim()); cur = ''; } else cur += ch;
  }
  if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur.trim());
  return out;
}
const OUTER = /^(?:\[data-(?:vibe|theme)(?:="[^"]*")?\]|\.ar(?![\w-]))\s+/;
function scoped(list) {
  if (!scope) return list;
  const has = new RegExp(`${scope.replace(/[.-]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`)}(?![\\w-])`);
  return splitList(list).map((sel) => {
    if (has.test(sel)) return sel;
    let outer = '', restSel = sel;
    for (let m = OUTER.exec(restSel); m; m = OUTER.exec(restSel)) { outer += `${m[0].trim()} `; restSel = restSel.slice(m[0].length); }
    return `${outer}:where(${scope}) ${restSel}`;
  }).join(', ');
}

const seen = new Set();
const once = (rule) => { const k = rule.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); if (seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; };
const kept = [];
for (const [prelude, body] of blocks(css)) {
  if (/^@(media|supports|container)/.test(prelude)) {
    const inner = blocks(body).filter(([s]) => wanted(s)).map(([s, b]) => `  ${scoped(s)} {${b}}`).filter(once);
    if (inner.length) kept.push(`${prelude} {\n${inner.join('\n')}\n}`);
  } else if (/^@keyframes/.test(prelude)) {
    if (prefixes.some((p) => prelude.includes(p))) { const r = `${prelude} {${body}}`; if (once(r)) kept.push(r); }
  } else if (wanted(prelude)) { const r = `${scoped(prelude)} {${body}}`; if (once(r)) kept.push(r); }
}
const artboard = artboards.join(', ');
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/shell/page-status.ts
/** Studio's status bar for the pages that are not a board view: what the page is, who waits, when it synced. */
import { clockHM } from '$lib/when';

export interface PageStatus { items: Array<{ text: string; signal?: boolean }>; right: string[] }
export const STATUS_RIGHT: readonly string[] = ['⌘K commands', 'N new card'];

export function pageStatus(lead: string[], needs: number, synced: string | null): PageStatus {
  const items: PageStatus['items'] = lead.map((text) => ({ text }));
  if (needs > 0) items.push({ text: `${needs} need you`, signal: true });
  if (synced) items.push({ text: `synced ${synced}` });
  return { items, right: [...STATUS_RIGHT] };
}

export function syncedLabel(at: Date | null): string | null {
  return at ? clockHM(at.toISOString()) : null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Add the projects words to `project-rollup.ts`** — give `formatTime`, `formatAsOf` and `rollupSegments` an optional `timeZone` (the app passes none, so the browser zone stays in charge), and append the rest:

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/project-rollup.ts — changed signatures
function formatTime(iso: string, timeZone?: string): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
    return d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false, ...(timeZone ? { timeZone } : {}) });
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}
export function formatAsOf(rollup: Pick<ProjectRollup, 'computedAt' | 'partial' | 'boardsUnanswered'>, timeZone?: string): string {
  const time = formatTime(rollup.computedAt, timeZone);
  if (!rollup.partial) return `as of ${time}`;
  const n = rollup.boardsUnanswered;
  return `as of ${time} · incomplete (${n} board${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} did not answer)`;
}
export function rollupSegments(rollup: RollupSegmentsInput, timeZone?: string): RollupSegment[] {
  const overdue = rollup.cardsOverdue > 0 ? ` · ${rollup.cardsOverdue} overdue` : '';
  return [
    { kind: 'figure', text: `${rollup.cardsDone}/${rollup.cardsTotal} cards done` },
    { kind: 'figure', text: fmtUsd(rollup.costUsd) },
    { kind: 'provenance', text: `${formatAsOf(rollup, timeZone)}${overdue}` },
  ];
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/plan/project-rollup.ts — appended
import type { Project, ProjectHealth, ProjectState } from '$lib/api';
import { pageStatus, type PageStatus } from '$lib/components/shell/page-status';

export const STATE_LABEL: Record<ProjectState, string> = { planned: 'Planned', active: 'Active', paused: 'Paused', completed: 'Completed', canceled: 'Canceled' };
export const HEALTH_LABEL: Record<ProjectHealth, string> = { 'on-track': 'On track', 'at-risk': 'At risk', 'off-track': 'Off track' };
/** Studio's state square (`.u.<x>`) per project state. */
export const STUDIO_UNIT: Record<ProjectState, string> = { planned: 'queued', active: 'act', paused: 'off', completed: 'done', canceled: 'off' };

export const GROUP_ORDER = [
  { state: 'active', label: 'Active', id: 'g-act' },
  { state: 'planned', label: 'Planned', id: 'g-plan' },
  { state: 'paused', label: 'Paused', id: 'g-pause' },
  { state: 'completed', label: 'Completed', id: 'g-done' },
  { state: 'canceled', label: 'Canceled', id: 'g-cancel' },
] as const satisfies ReadonlyArray<{ state: ProjectState; label: string; id: string }>;

export interface ProjectGroup { state: ProjectState; label: string; id: string; projects: Project[] }

/** Non-empty groups in GROUP_ORDER; inside a group the server's order (name A–Z) is kept. */
export function groupProjects(ps: Project[]): ProjectGroup[] {
  return GROUP_ORDER.map((g) => ({ ...g, projects: ps.filter((p) => p.state === g.state) })).filter((g) => g.projects.length > 0);
}

export function projectsSummary(ps: Project[]): string {
  if (ps.length === 0) return 'No projects yet.';
  const parts = groupProjects(ps).map((g) => `${g.projects.length} ${g.label.toLowerCase()}`);
  return `${ps.length} project${ps.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${parts.join(', ')}.`;
}

function dateGB(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(`${iso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
}
export function fmtTarget(iso: string | null): string {
  return iso ? `Target ${dateGB(iso)}` : 'No target date';
}
export function milestoneDate(iso: string): string {
  return dateGB(iso);
}
export function milestonesMeta(n: number): string {
  return n === 0 ? '· none yet' : `· ${n}`;
}

export const PROJECTS_SHOWING = 'Projects group cards across boards. Filters don’t apply here.';
export function projectsShell(ps: Project[], cardCount: number, needs: number, synced: string | null): { showing: string; paperShowing: string; studioSubRight: null; status: PageStatus } {
  return {
    showing: PROJECTS_SHOWING,
    paperShowing: PROJECTS_SHOWING,
    studioSubRight: null,
    status: pageStatus([`${ps.length} project${ps.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`, `${cardCount} card${cardCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} on this board`], needs, synced),
  };
}
```

```ts
  addingFor = $state<string | null>(null);
  msError = $state<Record<string, string | null>>({});
  removingMs = $state<string | null>(null);

  groups: ProjectGroup[] = $derived(groupProjects(this.projects));
  /** Every project in the order the page draws them, so ids (`pj-0`…) count across groups. */
  ordered: Project[] = $derived(this.groups.flatMap((g) => g.projects));
  summary = $derived(projectsSummary(this.projects));
  boardName = $derived(app.board?.name ?? '');

  /** Projects and milestones gate the ready flag; rollups do not (the pixel harness holds them). */
  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = true;
    this.loadError = null;
    const listed = listProjects();
    app.markBusy(listed);
    try {
      this.projects = await listed;
      app.projects = this.projects;
    } catch (e) {
      this.loadError = message(e);
      this.loading = false;
      return;
    }
    for (const p of this.projects) void this.loadRollup(p.id);
    const details = Promise.all(this.projects.map((p) => this.loadDetail(p.id)));
    app.markBusy(details);
    await details;
    this.loading = false;
  }

  async loadDetail(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const detail = await getProject(id);
    if (detail) this.milestones = { ...this.milestones, [id]: detail.milestones };
  }

  async loadRollup(id: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const r = await getProjectRollup(id);
      this.rollups = { ...this.rollups, [id]: r };
      const { [id]: _gone, ...rest } = this.rollupErrors;
      this.rollupErrors = rest;
    } catch (e) {
      this.rollupErrors = { ...this.rollupErrors, [id]: message(e) };
    }
  }

  clearCreate(): void {
    this.newName = '';
    this.newTarget = '';
    this.createError = null;
  }

  async addProject(): Promise<void> {
    const name = this.newName.trim();
    if (name === '' || this.creating) return;
    this.creating = true;
    this.createError = null;
    try {
      const res = await createProject({ name, targetDate: this.newTarget.trim() || undefined });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
        this.createError = body?.error ?? `Couldn't create that project (${res.status})`;
        return;
      }
      this.clearCreate();
      await this.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.creating = false;
    }
  }

  async removeProject(p: Project): Promise<void> {
    if (!confirm(`Delete “${p.name}”? Its cards stay on their boards but will no longer show this project.`)) return;
    this.deleting = p.id;
    try {
      const res = await deleteProject(p.id);
      if (res.ok) await this.refresh();
      else this.loadError = `Couldn't delete “${p.name}” (${res.status})`;
    } finally {
      this.deleting = null;
    }
  }

  async addMilestone(projectId: string): Promise<void> {
    const name = (this.msName[projectId] ?? '').trim();
    if (name === '' || this.addingFor) return;
    this.addingFor = projectId;
    this.msError = { ...this.msError, [projectId]: null };
    try {
      const res = await createMilestone(projectId, { name, targetDate: (this.msTarget[projectId] ?? '').trim() || undefined });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
        this.msError = { ...this.msError, [projectId]: body?.error ?? `Couldn't add that milestone (${res.status})` };
        return;
      }
      this.msName = { ...this.msName, [projectId]: '' };
      this.msTarget = { ...this.msTarget, [projectId]: '' };
      await this.loadDetail(projectId);
    } finally {
      this.addingFor = null;
    }
  }

  async removeMilestone(projectId: string, m: Milestone): Promise<void> {
    this.removingMs = m.id;
    try {
      const res = await deleteMilestone(m.id);
      if (res.ok) await this.loadDetail(projectId);
      else this.msError = { ...this.msError, [projectId]: `Couldn't remove “${m.name}” (${res.status})` };
    } finally {
      this.removingMs = null;
    }
  }
}
```

```svelte
      </div>
      {#if model.createError}<p class="hint" role="alert" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.createError}</p>{/if}

  {#if model.loadError}

                <p class="t-meta">{#each rollupSegments(rollup) as s, k (k)}{#if k > 0}{' · '}{/if}{#if s.kind === 'figure'}<strong style="color: var(--vk-color-text);">{s.text}</strong>{:else}<span>{s.text}</span>{/if}{/each}</p>
              </div>
            {:else}

                <div class="skel"></div>
                <p class="t-meta">Loading rollup…</p>

            {/if}
            <div class="pfoot">

            </div>

  <p class="t-meta">If a rollup fails, the card says “Rollup unavailable” with the reason instead of showing a number. Deleting a project asks first.</p>
```

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

The workspace gets its frame (back link, title, the six tabs with their counts) and the Agents tab is rebuilt on the reference markup, turning `SP-Workspace-Agents-Daylight`, `-Paper`, `-Studio` and `-Quiet` green.
```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/agent-status.ts
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentScope, AgentSummary, CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';

export interface AgentStatus { mood: Mood; line: string }

export function agentStatus(a: Pick<AgentSummary, 'claimedCount' | 'workingCount'>): AgentStatus {
  if (a.workingCount > 0) return { mood: 'working', line: `Working · ${a.claimedCount} claimed` };
  if (a.claimedCount > 0) return { mood: 'thinking', line: `Holding ${a.claimedCount} ${a.claimedCount === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}` };
  return { mood: 'resting', line: 'Resting · nothing claimed' };
}

export function agentsPanelMeta(agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  const n = agents.length;
  const k = agents.filter((a) => a.externalId !== null).length;
  const linked = k === n ? 'All linked to AgentPod' : k === 0 ? 'None linked to AgentPod' : `${k} of ${n} linked to AgentPod`;
  const w = agents.filter((a) => a.workingCount > 0).length;
  return `${linked} · ${w === 0 ? 'none working right now' : `${w} working right now`}`;
}

export const agentsHeading = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'agent' : 'agents'}`;
export const tokensLabel = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'token' : 'tokens'}`;
export const tokensInUse = (n: number) => (n === 0 ? 'No tokens in use' : `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'token' : 'tokens'} in use`);

/** The menu lists two tokens, then "and N more · show all N". */
export function moreTokens(n: number): { more: string; link: string } | null {
  return n > 2 ? { more: `and ${n - 2} more · `, link: `show all ${n}` } : null;
}

export function bannerTitle(name: string, scopes?: AgentScope[]): string {
  return scopes && !scopes.includes('claim') ? `${name}'s run-only token.` : `${name}'s token.`;
}

/** Registry order (the API returns created order, A–Z in the fixture), then keys typed in, in the order added. */
export function chipKeys(registry: CapabilityRecord[], selected: string[]): string[] {
  const keys = registry.map((c) => c.key);
  return [...keys, ...selected.filter((k) => !keys.includes(k))];
}

/** No board stage asks for it (or nobody defined it): an agent holding only this claims nothing. */
export function isUnusedCap(key: string, registry: CapabilityRecord[]): boolean {
  const rec = registry.find((c) => c.key === key);
  return !rec || rec.boardCount === 0;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/workspace-counts.svelte.ts
import { getAgents, getCapabilities, getMembers, listAttention, listLabels } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

export const WORKSPACE_TAB_IDS = ['needs-you', 'agents', 'capabilities', 'labels', 'people', 'connections'] as const;
export type WorkspaceTab = (typeof WORKSPACE_TAB_IDS)[number];
export interface WorkspaceCounts { needsYou: number | null; agents: number | null; capabilities: number | null; labels: number | null; people: number | null }
export interface WorkspaceTabItem { id: WorkspaceTab; label: string; count: number | null; signal: boolean }

type Settled = [
  PromiseSettledResult<{ cards: unknown[] }>, PromiseSettledResult<unknown[]>, PromiseSettledResult<unknown[]>,
  PromiseSettledResult<unknown[]>, PromiseSettledResult<unknown[]>,
];
const len = (r: PromiseSettledResult<unknown[]>) => (r.status === 'fulfilled' ? r.value.length : null);

/** A count that failed to load is null — the pill is left out, never shown as 0. */
export function countsFrom([needs, agents, caps, labels, people]: Settled): WorkspaceCounts {
  return { needsYou: needs.status === 'fulfilled' ? needs.value.cards.length : null, agents: len(agents), capabilities: len(caps), labels: len(labels), people: len(people) };
}

export function workspaceTabs(c: WorkspaceCounts): WorkspaceTabItem[] {
  return [
    { id: 'needs-you', label: 'Needs you', count: c.needsYou !== null && c.needsYou > 0 ? c.needsYou : null, signal: true },
    { id: 'agents', label: 'Agents', count: c.agents, signal: false },
    { id: 'capabilities', label: 'Capabilities', count: c.capabilities, signal: false },
    { id: 'labels', label: 'Labels', count: c.labels, signal: false },
    { id: 'people', label: 'People', count: c.people, signal: false },
    { id: 'connections', label: 'Connections', count: null, signal: false },
  ];
}

class Counts {
  value = $state<WorkspaceCounts>({ needsYou: null, agents: null, capabilities: null, labels: null, people: null });
  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const all = Promise.allSettled([listAttention(), getAgents(), getCapabilities(), listLabels(), getMembers()]);
    app.markBusy(all);
    this.value = countsFrom((await all) as Settled);
  }
}
export const workspaceCounts = new Counts();
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/menu-state.svelte.ts
/** One action menu open at a time; Escape closes it and puts focus back on its summary; a click outside closes it. */
export class MenuState {
  open = $state<string | null>(null);
  toggle(id: string, isOpen: boolean): void {
    if (isOpen) this.open = id;
    else if (this.open === id) this.open = null;
  }
  close(): void { this.open = null; }
  onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' || this.open === null) return;
    const details = e.currentTarget as HTMLDetailsElement;
    this.open = null;
    details.open = false;
    details.querySelector('summary')?.focus();
  }
  onDocumentClick(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!(e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.('details.menu')) this.open = null;
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `AgentsModel`** (today's `AgentsTab.svelte` logic, plus load states, the copy button, the shown-once banner and the counts refresh)

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/agents-model.svelte.ts
import { tick } from 'svelte';
import { capabilityTag } from '@superpipeline/contract';
import {
  getAgents, getCapabilities, createAgent, updateAgent, deleteAgent, issueAgentToken, revokeAgentToken, setAgentPrincipal,
  type AgentScope, type AgentSummary, type CapabilityRecord,
} from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { workspaceCounts } from './workspace-counts.svelte';

export interface MintedToken { agentName: string; token: string; scopes?: AgentScope[] }
const message = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));

export class AgentsModel {
  agents = $state<AgentSummary[] | null>(null);
  capabilities = $state<CapabilityRecord[]>([]);
  loadError = $state<string | null>(null);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  minted = $state<MintedToken | null>(null);
  copied = $state(false);

  editingId = $state<string | null>(null);
  editName = $state('');
  editCaps = $state<string[]>([]);
  editConcurrency = $state(1);
  editIcon = $state('');
  editNewCap = $state('');
  saving = $state(false);

  newName = $state('');
  newCaps = $state<string[]>([]);
  newCap = $state('');
  minting = $state(false);

  /** Agents whose token list is expanded past the first two. */
  allTokens = $state<string[]>([]);

  canCreate = $derived(!this.minting && this.newName.trim() !== '' && this.newCaps.length > 0);

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const load = Promise.all([getAgents(), getCapabilities().catch(() => [] as CapabilityRecord[])]);
    app.markBusy(load);
    try {
      [this.agents, this.capabilities] = await load;
      this.loadError = null;
    } catch (e) {
      this.loadError = message(e);
    }
  }

  private async changed(): Promise<void> {
    await this.refresh();
    void workspaceCounts.refresh();
  }

  async startEdit(a: AgentSummary): Promise<void> {
    this.editingId = a.id;
    this.editName = a.name;
    this.editCaps = [...a.capabilities];
    this.editConcurrency = a.concurrency ?? 1;
    this.editIcon = a.iconUrl ?? '';
    this.editNewCap = '';
    this.error = null;
    await tick();
    document.getElementById('ed-name')?.focus();
  }

  async saveEdit(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.editingId || this.editName.trim() === '') return;
    this.saving = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await updateAgent(this.editingId, {
        name: this.editName.trim(), capabilities: [...this.editCaps], concurrency: this.editConcurrency,
        iconUrl: this.editIcon.trim() === '' ? null : this.editIcon.trim(),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
        this.error = body?.error ?? `Saving failed (${res.status})`;
        return;
      }
      this.editingId = null;
      await this.changed();
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }

  async onDelete(a: AgentSummary): Promise<void> {
    const loses = [
      a.tokenIds.length > 0 ? `${a.tokenIds.length} active token${a.tokenIds.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : null,
      a.externalId ? 'its link to AgentPod' : null,
    ].filter(Boolean);
    const detail = loses.length > 0 ? ` This also deletes ${loses.join(' and ')}.` : '';
    if (!confirm(`Delete ${a.name}?${detail} This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    if ((await deleteAgent(a.id)).ok) await this.changed();
  }

  async onIssue(a: AgentSummary, scopes?: AgentScope[]): Promise<void> {
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const t = await issueAgentToken(a.id, scopes);
      this.minted = { agentName: a.name, token: t.token, scopes: t.scopes ?? scopes };
      this.copied = false;
      await this.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      this.error = message(e);
    }
  }

  async onRevoke(a: AgentSummary, tokenId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!confirm('Revoke this token? The agent loses access immediately, and this cannot be undone.')) return;
    if ((await revokeAgentToken(a.id, tokenId)).ok) await this.refresh();
  }

  async onUnlink(a: AgentSummary): Promise<void> {
    if ((await setAgentPrincipal(a.id, null)).ok) await this.refresh();
  }

  async mint(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canCreate) return;
    this.minting = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const t = await createAgent(this.newName.trim(), [...this.newCaps]);
      this.minted = { agentName: t.agent.name, token: t.token };
      this.copied = false;
      this.newName = '';
      this.newCaps = [];
      await this.changed();
    } catch (e) {
      this.error = message(e);
    } finally {
      this.minting = false;
    }
  }

  async copyToken(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.minted) return;
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(this.minted.token);
    this.copied = true;
    setTimeout(() => (this.copied = false), 2000);
  }

  /** Enter in "Add a capability": the typed key, normalised, joins the selection pressed. */
  static addTyped(selected: string[], typed: string): string[] {
    const key = capabilityTag(typed);
    return key === '' || selected.includes(key) ? selected : [...selected, key];
  }
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/agents/CapabilityChips.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import type { CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';
  import { chipKeys, isUnusedCap } from '../agent-status';
  import { AgentsModel } from '../agents-model.svelte';

  let {
    selected = $bindable(), typed = $bindable(), registry, labelledBy, inputId, form, wrapInput,
  }: { selected: string[]; typed: string; registry: CapabilityRecord[]; labelledBy: string; inputId: string; form: 'page' | 'studio'; wrapInput: boolean } = $props();

  const keys = $derived(chipKeys(registry, selected));
  function flip(k: string): void {
    selected = selected.includes(k) ? selected.filter((x) => x !== k) : [...selected, k];
  }
  function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    e.preventDefault();
    selected = AgentsModel.addTyped(selected, typed);
    typed = '';
  }
</script>

{#snippet input()}
  <label class="sr" for={inputId}>New capability</label>
  <input class={form === 'studio' ? 'ar-in' : 'input'} id={inputId} placeholder="Add a capability" style="width: 200px; min-height: 36px;" bind:value={typed} onkeydown={onKey} />
{/snippet}

<div class={form === 'studio' ? 'wa-caps' : 'caps'} role="group" aria-labelledby={labelledBy}>
  {#each keys as k (k)}
    <button class={form === 'studio' ? 'wa-pick' : 'chip pick'} aria-pressed={selected.includes(k)} type="button" data-unused={isUnusedCap(k, registry) ? '' : undefined} onclick={() => flip(k)}>{#if selected.includes(k)}<PageIcon name="check" size={14} />{/if}{k}</button>
  {/each}
  {#if wrapInput}<span style="display: inline-flex; gap: 6px;">{@render input()}</span>{:else}{@render input()}{/if}
</div>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** The pop-up inside `details.menu`: the same items in both DOMs; Studio swaps the text classes. */
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import type { AgentScope, AgentSummary } from '$lib/api';
  import { moreTokens, tokensInUse } from '../agent-status';

  let { agent, form, showAll, onEdit, onIssue, onUnlink, onRevoke, onDelete, onShowAll }: {
    agent: AgentSummary; form: 'page' | 'studio'; showAll: boolean;
    onEdit: () => void; onIssue: (scopes?: AgentScope[]) => void; onUnlink: () => void; onRevoke: (tokenId: string) => void; onDelete: () => void; onShowAll: () => void;
  } = $props();

  const C = $derived(form === 'studio'
    ? { meta: 'wa-meta', eyebrow: 'kick', body: 'wa-body', revoke: 'ar-btn2 revoke' }
    : { meta: 't-meta', eyebrow: 't-eyebrow', body: 't-body', revoke: 'vk-button btn-sm revoke' });
  const n = $derived(agent.tokenIds.length);
  const shown = $derived(showAll ? agent.tokenIds : agent.tokenIds.slice(0, 2));
  const more = $derived(showAll ? null : moreTokens(n));
</script>

<div class="menu-pop" role="menu" aria-label="Actions for {agent.name}">
  <button class="mi" role="menuitem" type="button" onclick={onEdit}><PageIcon name="pencil" />Edit agent</button>
  <button class="mi" role="menuitem" type="button" onclick={() => onIssue()}><PageIcon name="key" />Issue a token</button>
  <button class="mi" role="menuitem" type="button" onclick={() => onIssue(['run'])}><PageIcon name="key" />Issue a run-only token<span class={C.meta} style="margin-left: auto;">can run cards, not change them</span></button>
  {#if agent.externalId}
    <button class="mi" role="menuitem" type="button" onclick={onUnlink}><PageIcon name="link" />Unlink from AgentPod</button>
  {/if}
  <div class="mi-group">
    <p class={C.eyebrow} style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-3);">{tokensInUse(n)}</p>
    {#each shown as t, i (t)}
      <div class="tokrow">
        <span class={C.body}>Token {i + 1}</span>
        <span class={C.meta}>issued to {agent.name}</span>
        <button class={C.revoke} aria-label="Revoke token {i + 1} of {agent.name}" title={t} type="button" onclick={() => onRevoke(t)}>Revoke</button>
      </div>
    {/each}
    {#if more}
      <p class={C.meta} style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-3);">{more.more}<a href="#show-all-{agent.id}" onclick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onShowAll(); }}>{more.link}</a></p>
    {/if}
  </div>
  <button class="mi mi-danger" role="menuitem" type="button" onclick={onDelete}><PageIcon name="trash" />Delete agent…</button>
</div>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { page } from '$app/state';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { WORKSPACE_LAYOUTS, WORKSPACE_TABS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import { WORKSPACE_TAB_IDS, type WorkspaceTab } from '$lib/components/workspace/workspace-counts.svelte';

  const tab = $derived((WORKSPACE_TAB_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(page.params.tab ?? '') ? (page.params.tab as WorkspaceTab) : null);
  // An unknown tab lands somewhere rather than on a blank page that looks like a failure.
  $effect(() => { if (tab === null) void goto('/workspace/agents', { replaceState: true }); });
  const vibe = $derived(appearance.value.vibe);
  const Frame = $derived(WORKSPACE_LAYOUTS[vibe]);
  const Tab = $derived(tab ? WORKSPACE_TABS[vibe][tab] : null);
</script>

{#if tab && Tab}
  <Frame {tab} {vibe}><Tab {vibe} /></Frame>
{/if}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write the e2e for the token round trip** (it crosses the API: the token is minted by the server and the row's count comes back from `GET /v1/agents`)

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/workspace-agents.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT } from './support/seed';

test('issuing a token shows it once and counts it on the row', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const name = `e2e-quill-${Date.now()}`;
  const res = await request.post(`${API}/v1/agents`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name, capabilities: ['research'] } });
  expect(res.ok()).toBe(true);

  await page.goto('/workspace/agents');
  const row = page.locator('li.arow, tr').filter({ hasText: name });
  await expect(row.getByText('1 token', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

  await page.locator(`summary[aria-label="Actions for ${name}"]`).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Issue a token', exact: true }).click();

  const banner = page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: `${name}'s token.` });
  await expect(banner).toBeVisible();
  await expect(banner.getByLabel(`New token for ${name}`)).toHaveText(/^spa_/);
  await expect(row.getByText('2 tokens', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('menu', { name: `Actions for ${name}` })).toBeHidden();
});
```

```ts
/** The workspace has no board in its URL; the reference's back link and need-you count are Developer Experience's. */
async function onDx(p: Page): Promise<void> {
  await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.setItem('superpipeline.boardId', 'brd_134a0ddb6d434478'));
  await p.reload();
  await p.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true');
}
/** writer-quill gets a fresh token (banner open, its count 2 → 3); analyst-echo opens for editing. super-chotu stays closed (MC #11). */
async function agentsMenus(p: Page): Promise<void> {
  await onDx(p);
  await p.locator('summary[aria-label="Actions for writer-quill"]').click();
  await p.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Issue a token', exact: true }).click();
  await p.locator('summary[aria-label="Actions for analyst-echo"]').click();
  await p.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Edit agent' }).click();
  await p.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true');
  await p.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur());
}
```

### Task 34: Workspace · the other five tabs, and the review route

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Needs you, Capabilities, Labels, People and Connections are rebuilt on the reference markup, each with a D/P/Q component and a Studio twin that share one model, and the dev-only route `/dev/workspace-review` draws all five together the way the artboard does. This turns `SP-Workspace-Other-Daylight`, `-Paper`, `-Studio` and `-Quiet` green (plan ruling: full-page compare against `/dev/workspace-review`, no panels mode; resume form open on the 1dfc row with the drawn text). Studio orders its sections needs-you, capabilities, labels + people (one column), connections; D/P/Q put needs-you beside labels/people/connections and capabilities across both columns — so the review body is a per-vibe layout too (`WORKSPACE_REVIEW_LAYOUTS`). Rulings applied: rows oldest first (WO-G2); `Unowned` stays a line chip, only blocked/failed/review/refused/budget are signal (WO-G4); the clip rule changes the formula, never the row (MC appendix); the no-owner headline names the stage (`nothing claims the Reported stage`); 19 capabilities, holders seeded by name, `command` is the one orphan; labels keep their stored `var(--vk-mood-…)` colours.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/needs-row.ts`, `needs-row.test.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/capability-notes.ts`, `capability-notes.test.ts`

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/capability-notes.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AgentSummary, CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';
import { agentCountText, capsHeading, holdersOf, orphanNote, unstaffedNote } from './capability-notes';

const C = (key: string, agentCount: number, boardCount: number): CapabilityRecord => ({ id: `cap_${key}`, key, name: key, description: null, tags: [], examples: [], origin: 'declared', externalId: null, externalSource: null, inputModes: [], outputModes: [], agentCount, boardCount });
const A = (name: string, capabilities: string[]) => ({ id: `agt_${name}`, name, capabilities }) as AgentSummary;

describe('capability notes', () => {
  it('names an orphan capability and links to the board settings', () => {
    expect(orphanNote(C('command', 1, 0), ['super-chotu'], 'brd_134a0ddb6d434478')).toEqual({
      key: 'command', text: 'is held by super-chotu but no board stage asks for it, so it lets that agent claim nothing.',
      link: { label: 'Add a stage that asks for it', href: '/b/brd_134a0ddb6d434478/settings' }, tail: ' or remove it.',
    });
    expect(orphanNote(C('x', 3, 0), ['a', 'b', 'c'], null).text).toBe('is held by a, b and c but no board stage asks for it, so it lets them claim nothing.');
    expect(orphanNote(C('x', 2, 0), ['a', 'b'], null).link.href).toBe('/');
  });
  it('names an unstaffed capability and links to the agents', () => {
    expect(unstaffedNote(C('design', 0, 2))).toEqual({ key: 'design', text: 'is asked for by 2 boards but no agent holds it, so cards there wait for ever.', link: { label: 'Give it to an agent', href: '/workspace/agents' }, tail: '.' });
    expect(unstaffedNote(C('design', 0, 1)).text).toBe('is asked for by 1 board but no agent holds it, so cards there wait for ever.');
  });
  it('counts', () => {
    expect(capsHeading(19)).toBe('19 capabilities');
    expect(capsHeading(1)).toBe('1 capability');
    expect([agentCountText(2), agentCountText(1), agentCountText(0)]).toEqual(['2 agents', '1 agent', 'No agent']);
  });
  it('lists holders in the agents’ own order', () => {
    const agents = [A('predictor-paul', ['analysis']), A('coder-kai', ['code']), A('analyst-echo', ['analysis', 'claim-check'])];
    expect(holdersOf(C('analysis', 2, 1), agents).map((a) => a.name)).toEqual(['predictor-paul', 'analyst-echo']);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Member } from '$lib/api';
import { FORGE_HOST_ERROR, initials, labelsHeading, lastOwner, peopleHeading, roleHelpTitle, roleHint, similarText } from './workspace-words';

const M = (userId: string, role: Member['role']): Member => ({ userId, email: `${userId}@example.com`, name: null, role, createdAt: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' });

describe('workspace words', () => {
  it('heads the panels', () => {
    expect([labelsHeading(3), labelsHeading(1), labelsHeading(0)]).toEqual(['3 labels', '1 label', 'No labels yet']);
    expect([peopleHeading(1), peopleHeading(2)]).toEqual(['1 person', '2 people']);
  });
  it('makes initials', () => {
    expect(initials('Rakesh Gangwar')).toBe('RG');
    expect(initials('Rakesh Kumar Gangwar')).toBe('RG');
    expect(initials('rakesh')).toBe('RA');
  });
  it('explains roles', () => {
    expect(roleHelpTitle('owner')).toBe('Owner: everything, including people and deleting boards');
    expect(roleHint('member')).toBe('Member: creates, moves and decides cards. No email is sent — they sign in and find this workspace waiting.');
  });
  it('protects the last owner', () => {
    const owner = M('usr_b19776fac3c94df4', 'owner');
    expect(lastOwner(owner, [owner])).toBe(true);
    expect(lastOwner(owner, [owner, M('usr_2', 'owner')])).toBe(false);
    expect(lastOwner(M('usr_3', 'member'), [owner])).toBe(false);
  });
  it('words the similar-name hint and the forge refusal', () => {
    expect(similarText(['code', 'coder'])).toBe('Similar to code, coder. Routing matches names exactly, so two spellings are two capabilities; remove the new one if you meant an existing one.');
    expect(FORGE_HOST_ERROR).toBe('That is a host, not a URL — forge.example.com.');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/needs-row.ts
import type { AttentionAction, AttentionItem, AttentionKind } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';

export const WS_KIND_LABEL: Record<AttentionKind, string> = {
  review: 'Review', question: 'Asked', blocked: 'Blocked', 'repeated-failure': 'Failing', refused: 'Refused',
  'sub-tasks': 'Waiting', 'no-owner': 'Unowned', failed: 'Failed', budget: 'Budget',
};
const SIGNAL: ReadonlySet<AttentionKind> = new Set(['review', 'failed', 'repeated-failure', 'blocked', 'refused', 'budget']);
/** Signal colour only for kinds a person must act on; unowned, asked and waiting stay a line chip. */
export const chipClass = (k: AttentionKind): 'chip-signal' | 'chip-line' => (SIGNAL.has(k) ? 'chip-signal' : 'chip-line');
/** Studio's state square: `needs` for the signal kinds, `off` otherwise. */
export const studioUnit = (k: AttentionKind): 'needs' | 'off' => (SIGNAL.has(k) ? 'needs' : 'off');

function age(h: number | null): string | null {
  if (h === null) return null;
  if (h < 1) return 'just now';
  if (h < 48) return `${Math.floor(h)}h`;
  return `${Math.floor(h / 24)}d`;
}

export function metaLine(item: AttentionItem): string {
  return [item.boardName, item.kind === 'no-owner' ? null : item.stageName, item.headline, age(item.ageHours)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
}

/** ≤140 characters: whole. Else the first sentence (40–240 characters) plus "…"; else the first 140 characters plus "…". */
export function clip(detail: string): { shown: string; long: boolean } {
  if (detail.length <= 140) return { shown: detail, long: false };
  const first = /^([\s\S]*?)\.(?=\s|$)/.exec(detail)?.[1];
  if (first !== undefined && first.length >= 40 && first.length <= 240) return { shown: `${first}…`, long: true };
  return { shown: `${detail.slice(0, 140).trimEnd()}…`, long: true };
}

export function sortOldestFirst(items: AttentionItem[]): AttentionItem[] {
  return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.ageHours === null && b.ageHours !== null) return 1;
    if (b.ageHours === null && a.ageHours !== null) return -1;
    const d = (b.ageHours ?? 0) - (a.ageHours ?? 0);
    return d !== 0 ? d : a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  });
}

const boards = (u: number) => `${u} ${u === 1 ? 'board' : 'boards'}`;
export const needsHeadMeta = (u: number) => `Oldest first. ${u === 0 ? 'Every board answered.' : `${boards(u)} did not answer.`}`;
export const unansweredFoot = (u: number) => `${boards(u)} did not answer; this list may be incomplete.`;

/** Every action except `resume` (a form) and `move` (board only) is a link. */
export function actionLink(item: AttentionItem, a: AttentionAction): { label: string; href: string; primary: boolean } | null {
  const card = `/b/${item.boardId}/c/${item.cardId}`;
  switch (a) {
    case 'open': return { label: 'Open', href: card, primary: false };
    case 'review': return { label: 'Review', href: card, primary: true };
    case 'answer': return { label: 'Answer', href: card, primary: true };
    case 'log': return { label: 'Open log', href: `${card}?tab=attempts`, primary: false };
    case 'staff': return { label: 'Staff an agent', href: '/workspace/capabilities', primary: false };
    default: return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/capability-notes.ts
import type { AgentSummary, CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';
import { joinAnd } from '$lib/words';

export interface CapNote { key: string; text: string; link: { label: string; href: string }; tail: string }
export const INFERRED_TITLE = 'Nobody defined this — it turned up in use';

export const holdersOf = (c: CapabilityRecord, agents: AgentSummary[]) => agents.filter((a) => a.capabilities.includes(c.key));

export function orphanNote(c: CapabilityRecord, holders: string[], boardId: string | null): CapNote {
  return {
    key: c.key,
    text: `is held by ${joinAnd(holders)} but no board stage asks for it, so it lets ${holders.length === 1 ? 'that agent' : 'them'} claim nothing.`,
    link: { label: 'Add a stage that asks for it', href: boardId ? `/b/${boardId}/settings` : '/' },
    tail: ' or remove it.',
  };
}

export function unstaffedNote(c: CapabilityRecord): CapNote {
  const n = c.boardCount;
  return { key: c.key, text: `is asked for by ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'board' : 'boards'} but no agent holds it, so cards there wait for ever.`, link: { label: 'Give it to an agent', href: '/workspace/agents' }, tail: '.' };
}

export const capsHeading = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'capability' : 'capabilities'}`;
export const agentCountText = (n: number) => (n === 0 ? 'No agent' : `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'agent' : 'agents'}`);
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/workspace-words.ts
import type { Member, Role } from '$lib/api';

export const labelsHeading = (n: number) => (n === 0 ? 'No labels yet' : `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'label' : 'labels'}`);
export const peopleHeading = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'person' : 'people'}`;

export function initials(name: string): string {
  const w = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (w.length === 0) return '';
  if (w.length === 1) return w[0]!.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${w[0]![0]}${w[w.length - 1]![0]}`.toUpperCase();
}

export const lastOwner = (m: Member, members: Member[]) => m.role === 'owner' && members.filter((o) => o.role === 'owner').length === 1;

export const ROLE_LABEL: Record<Role, string> = { owner: 'Owner', admin: 'Admin', member: 'Member', viewer: 'Viewer' };
export const ROLE_ORDER: Role[] = ['owner', 'admin', 'member', 'viewer'];
export const INVITE_ORDER: Role[] = ['member', 'viewer', 'admin', 'owner'];
export const ROLE_HELP: Record<Role, string> = {
  owner: 'everything, including people and deleting boards',
  admin: 'also manages boards, agents and connections',
  member: 'creates, moves and decides cards',
  viewer: 'reads boards and cards, changes nothing',
};
export const roleHelpTitle = (r: Role) => `${ROLE_LABEL[r]}: ${ROLE_HELP[r]}`;
export const roleHint = (r: Role) => `${ROLE_LABEL[r]}: ${ROLE_HELP[r]}. No email is sent — they sign in and find this workspace waiting.`;
export const similarText = (similar: string[]) => `Similar to ${similar.join(', ')}. Routing matches names exactly, so two spellings are two capabilities; remove the new one if you meant an existing one.`;
export const FORGE_HOST_ERROR = 'That is a host, not a URL — forge.example.com.';
/** Used when a new label is added before its swatch was picked; the swatch itself shows the needs mood. */
export const NEW_LABEL_COLOUR = '#ffd9c2';
```
