```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/needs-model.svelte.ts
import { tick } from 'svelte';
import { listAttention, resumeCard, type StaleCard } from '$lib/api';
import { itemsFromStale, type AttentionItem } from '$lib/components/attention/attention';
import { refusalOf } from '$lib/components/attention/refusal';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { sortOldestFirst } from './needs-row';
import { workspaceCounts } from './workspace-counts.svelte';
import type { WorkspaceTabProps } from './types';

export class NeedsModel {
  cards = $state<StaleCard[] | null>(null);
  unanswered = $state(0);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  refreshing = $state(false);
  /** Card id whose resume form is open — one at a time. */
  openId = $state<string | null>(null);
  drafts = $state<Record<string, string>>({});
  expanded = $state<string[]>([]);
  sending = $state(false);
  refusal = $state<string | null>(null);
  items: AttentionItem[] = $derived(this.cards ? sortOldestFirst(itemsFromStale(this.cards)) : []);

  constructor(initial?: WorkspaceTabProps['initial']) {
    if (initial?.expandedResume) {
      this.openId = initial.expandedResume;
      this.drafts = { [initial.expandedResume]: initial.resumeText ?? '' };
    }
  }

  async load(): Promise<void> {
    this.refreshing = true;
    const req = listAttention();
    app.markBusy(req);
    try {
      const res = await req;
      this.cards = res.cards;
      this.unanswered = res.boardsUnanswered;
      this.error = null;
    } catch (e) {
      this.error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    } finally {
      this.refreshing = false;
    }
  }

  async toggleResume(cardId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.refusal = null;
    this.openId = this.openId === cardId ? null : cardId;
    if (this.openId) {
      await tick();
      document.getElementById('rs-note')?.focus();
    }
  }

  toggleFull(id: string): void {
    this.expanded = this.expanded.includes(id) ? this.expanded.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...this.expanded, id];
  }

  async send(item: AttentionItem): Promise<void> {
    const text = (this.drafts[item.cardId] ?? '').trim();
    if (text === '' || this.sending) return;
    this.sending = true;
    this.refusal = null;
    try {
      const refused = await refusalOf(await resumeCard(item.boardId, item.cardId, text));
      if (refused) { this.refusal = refused; return; }
      this.openId = null;
      const { [item.cardId]: _sent, ...rest } = this.drafts;
      this.drafts = rest;
      await this.load();
      void workspaceCounts.refresh();
    } finally {
      this.sending = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/capabilities-model.svelte.ts
import { getAgents, getCapabilities, createCapability, updateCapability, deleteCapability, addImplication, removeImplication, type AgentSummary, type CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { holdersOf, orphanNote, unstaffedNote, type CapNote } from './capability-notes';
import { workspaceCounts } from './workspace-counts.svelte';

export class CapabilitiesModel {
  capabilities = $state<CapabilityRecord[] | null>(null);
  agents = $state<AgentSummary[]>([]);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  newKey = $state('');
  similar = $state<string[]>([]);
  implyingFor = $state<string | null>(null);
  implyTo = $state('');

  rows: CapabilityRecord[] = $derived(this.capabilities ? [...this.capabilities].sort((a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key)) : []);
  notes: CapNote[] = $derived([
    ...this.rows.filter((c) => c.boardCount === 0 && c.agentCount > 0).map((c) => orphanNote(c, holdersOf(c, this.agents).map((a) => a.name), app.boardId)),
    ...this.rows.filter((c) => c.agentCount === 0 && c.boardCount > 0).map(unstaffedNote),
  ]);

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const load = Promise.all([getCapabilities(), getAgents().catch(() => [] as AgentSummary[])]);
    app.markBusy(load);
    try { [this.capabilities, this.agents] = await load; } catch (e) { this.error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); this.capabilities ??= []; }
  }

  private async bodyError(res: Response, fallback: string): Promise<string> {
    const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
    return body?.error ?? `${fallback} (${res.status})`;
  }

  async add(): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.newKey.trim();
    if (key === '') return;
    this.error = null;
    this.similar = [];
    const res = await createCapability({ key });
    const body = (await res.clone().json().catch(() => null)) as { similar?: string[] } | null;
    if (!res.ok) { this.error = await this.bodyError(res, 'Adding failed'); return; }
    this.similar = body?.similar ?? [];
    this.newKey = '';
    await this.refresh();
    void workspaceCounts.refresh();
  }

  startImply(key: string): void { this.implyingFor = key; this.implyTo = ''; }

  async imply(from: string): Promise<void> {
    const to = this.implyTo.trim();
    if (to === '') return;
    this.error = null;
    const res = await addImplication(from, to);
    if (!res.ok) { this.error = await this.bodyError(res, 'Could not record that'); return; }
    this.implyingFor = null;
    this.implyTo = '';
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async unimply(from: string, to: string): Promise<void> { await removeImplication(from, to); await this.refresh(); }

  async describe(c: CapabilityRecord, description: string): Promise<void> {
    if (description.trim() === (c.description ?? '')) return;
    await updateCapability(c.id, { description: description.trim() });
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async remove(c: CapabilityRecord): Promise<void> {
    this.error = null;
    const res = await deleteCapability(c.id);
    if (!res.ok) this.error = await this.bodyError(res, 'Removing failed');
    await this.refresh();
    void workspaceCounts.refresh();
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/labels-model.svelte.ts
import { listLabels, createLabel, updateLabel, deleteLabel, type Label } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { recolourLabel, removeLabel, renameLabel } from './label-manager';
import { NEW_LABEL_COLOUR } from './workspace-words';
import { workspaceCounts } from './workspace-counts.svelte';

const deps = { updateLabel, deleteLabel };

export class LabelsModel {
  labels = $state<Label[] | null>(null);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  removing = $state<string | null>(null);
  newName = $state('');
  /** Null until a colour is picked: the swatch shows the needs mood, the request sends NEW_LABEL_COLOUR. */
  newColour = $state<string | null>(null);
  creating = $state(false);

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const req = listLabels();
    app.markBusy(req);
    try { this.labels = await req; } catch (e) { this.error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); this.labels ??= []; }
  }

  private async fail(res: Response, what: string): Promise<void> {
    const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
    this.error = body?.error ?? `Couldn't ${what} (${res.status})`;
  }

  async rename(l: Label, name: string): Promise<void> {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed === '' || trimmed === l.name) return;
    this.error = null;
    const res = await renameLabel(deps, l.id, trimmed);
    if (!res.ok) await this.fail(res, 'rename that label');
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async recolour(l: Label, colour: string): Promise<void> {
    if (colour === l.colour) return;
    const res = await recolourLabel(deps, l.id, colour);
    if (!res.ok) await this.fail(res, 'recolour that label');
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async remove(l: Label): Promise<void> {
    if (!confirm(`Delete the label "${l.name}"? Cards carrying it will drop it on their next edit.`)) return;
    this.removing = l.id;
    try {
      const res = await removeLabel(deps, l.id);
      if (!res.ok) await this.fail(res, 'remove that label');
      await this.refresh();
      void workspaceCounts.refresh();
    } finally { this.removing = null; }
  }

  async add(): Promise<void> {
    const name = this.newName.trim();
    if (name === '' || this.creating) return;
    this.creating = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await createLabel({ name, colour: this.newColour ?? NEW_LABEL_COLOUR });
      if (!res.ok) { await this.fail(res, 'add that label'); return; }
      this.newName = '';
      this.newColour = null;
      await this.refresh();
      void workspaceCounts.refresh();
    } finally { this.creating = false; }
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/people-model.svelte.ts
import { getMembers, addMember, setMemberRole, removeMember, type Member, type Role } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { workspaceCounts } from './workspace-counts.svelte';

export class PeopleModel {
  members = $state<Member[] | null>(null);
  email = $state('');
  role = $state<Role>('member');
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  busy = $state(false);

  isMe = (m: Member) => m.userId === app.user?.userId;

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const req = getMembers();
    app.markBusy(req);
    try { this.members = await req; } catch (e) { this.error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); this.members ??= []; }
  }

  private async fail(res: Response, fallback: string): Promise<void> {
    const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
    this.error = body?.error ?? `${fallback} (${res.status})`;
  }

  async invite(): Promise<void> {
    const addr = this.email.trim();
    if (addr === '' || this.busy) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await addMember(addr, this.role);
      if (!res.ok) { await this.fail(res, 'Inviting failed'); return; }
      this.email = '';
      await this.refresh();
      void workspaceCounts.refresh();
    } finally { this.busy = false; }
  }

  async change(m: Member, next: Role): Promise<void> {
    this.error = null;
    const res = await setMemberRole(m.userId, next);
    if (!res.ok) await this.fail(res, 'Changing that role failed');
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async remove(m: Member): Promise<void> {
    if (!confirm(`Remove ${m.name ?? m.email} from this workspace? They lose access on their next request.`)) return;
    this.error = null;
    const res = await removeMember(m.userId);
    if (!res.ok) await this.fail(res, 'Removing them failed');
    await this.refresh();
    void workspaceCounts.refresh();
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/connections-model.svelte.ts
import { getWorkspace, setWorkspaceFleet, getForgeHost, setForgeHost, getHubPrincipals, getAgents, getCapabilities, createAgent, type WorkspaceTenant, type HubPrincipal, type AgentSummary, type CapabilityRecord } from '$lib/api';
import { beginHubAuthorization, hubStatus } from '$lib/hub-token';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { FORGE_HOST_ERROR } from './workspace-words';

export class ConnectionsModel {
  loading = $state(true);
  workspace = $state<WorkspaceTenant | null>(null);
  agents = $state<AgentSummary[]>([]);
  capabilities = $state<CapabilityRecord[]>([]);
  principals = $state<HubPrincipal[] | null>(null);
  forgeHost = $state<string | null>(null);
  editingForge = $state(false);
  forgeInput = $state('');
  forgeError = $state<string | null>(null);
  editingFleet = $state(false);
  fleetInput = $state('');
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  saving = $state(false);
  connecting = $state(false);
  picked = $state<string[]>([]);
  importCaps = $state<string[]>([]);
  importTyped = $state('');
  importing = $state(false);
  importResult = $state<string | null>(null);

  /** Fleet agents with no workspace agent yet. A hub that is not connected counts as none. */
  linkable: HubPrincipal[] = $derived((this.principals ?? []).filter((p) => !this.agents.some((a) => a.externalId === p.id)));

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const load = (async () => {
      [this.workspace, this.agents, this.capabilities, this.forgeHost] = await Promise.all([
        getWorkspace().catch(() => null), getAgents().catch(() => []), getCapabilities().catch(() => []), getForgeHost().catch(() => null),
      ]);
      const status = await hubStatus().catch(() => ({ configured: false }));
      this.principals = status.configured ? await getHubPrincipals().catch(() => null) : null;
    })();
    app.markBusy(load);
    await load;
    this.loading = false;
  }

  startForge(): void { this.editingForge = true; this.forgeInput = this.forgeHost ?? ''; this.forgeError = null; }
  async saveForge(): Promise<void> {
    const next = this.forgeInput.trim();
    const res = await setForgeHost(next === '' ? null : next);
    if (!res.ok) { this.forgeError = next === '' ? `Could not clear the forge (${res.status}).` : FORGE_HOST_ERROR; return; }
    this.forgeHost = await getForgeHost();
    this.editingForge = false;
  }

  startFleet(): void { this.editingFleet = true; this.fleetInput = this.workspace?.externalId ?? ''; this.error = null; }
  async saveFleet(): Promise<void> {
    this.saving = true;
    try {
      const v = this.fleetInput.trim();
      const res = await setWorkspaceFleet(v === '' ? null : v);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
        this.error = body?.error ?? `Linking failed (${res.status})`;
        return;
      }
      this.editingFleet = false;
      await this.refresh();
    } finally { this.saving = false; }
  }

  async connect(): Promise<void> {
    this.connecting = true;
    try { await beginHubAuthorization(); } finally { this.connecting = false; }
  }

  togglePicked(id: string): void { this.picked = this.picked.includes(id) ? this.picked.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...this.picked, id]; }

  async addPicked(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.picked.length === 0 || this.importCaps.length === 0) return;
    this.importing = true;
    this.importResult = null;
    const failures: string[] = [];
    try {
      for (const id of this.picked) {
        const p = this.linkable.find((x) => x.id === id);
        if (!p) continue;
        try { await createAgent(p.handle, [...this.importCaps], p.id); } catch (e) { failures.push(`${p.handle}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
      }
      this.picked = [];
      this.importResult = failures.length === 0 ? null : failures.join('; ');
      await this.refresh();
    } finally { this.importing = false; }
  }
}
```

```svelte
      {#each model.labels as l (l.id)}
        <li class="lrow">
          <button class="swatch" aria-label="Colour of {l.name}" type="button" style="background: {l.colour};" onclick={() => picker.open((c) => void model.recolour(l, c))}></button>
          <span><label class="sr" for="lb-{l.name}">Name</label><input class="input" id="lb-{l.name}" value={l.name} style="min-height: 40px;" onblur={(e) => void model.rename(l, e.currentTarget.value)} onkeydown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur(); }} /></span>
          {#if showsInferredBadge(l.origin)}<span class="chip chip-line">inferred</span>{:else}<span></span>{/if}
          <button class="iconbtn" aria-label="Remove label {l.name}" type="button" disabled={model.removing === l.id} onclick={() => void model.remove(l)}><PageIcon name="trash" /></button>
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ul>
  {/if}
  <form class="panel-body" style="border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); display: flex; gap: var(--vk-space-2); align-items: flex-end;" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.add(); }}>
    <button class="swatch" aria-label="Colour of the new label" type="button" style="background: {model.newColour ?? 'var(--vk-mood-needs)'}; margin-bottom: 6px;" onclick={() => picker.open((c) => (model.newColour = c))}></button>
    <div class="field" style="flex: 1 1 0%;"><label for="lb-new">New label</label><input class="input" id="lb-new" placeholder="Name" bind:value={model.newName} /></div>
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="submit" disabled={model.creating}>Add</button>
  </form>
  {#if model.error}<p class="hint" role="alert" style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-5) var(--vk-space-4); color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.error}</p>{/if}
  <ColourPicker bind:this={picker} />
</section>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import type { Role } from '$lib/api';
  import { PeopleModel } from './people-model.svelte';
  import { initials, INVITE_ORDER, lastOwner, peopleHeading, ROLE_LABEL, ROLE_ORDER, roleHelpTitle, roleHint } from './workspace-words';
  import PanelTag from './PanelTag.svelte';
  import type { WorkspaceTabProps } from './types';

  let { review }: WorkspaceTabProps = $props();
  const model = new PeopleModel();
  $effect(() => { void model.refresh(); });
</script>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="pt-h">
  <div class="panel-head" style="flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;">
    {#if review}<PanelTag text={review.tag} />{/if}

  </div>
  {#if model.members === null}
    <p class="panel-body t-meta" role="status">Loading people…</p>
  {:else}
    {#each model.members as m, i (m.userId)}
      {@const locked = lastOwner(m, model.members)}
      <div class="lrow member" style="grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0px, 1fr) 150px 44px;{i === 0 ? ' border-top: 0px;' : ''}">

        <div class="field">
          <label class="sr" for="pr-{i + 1}">Role</label>
          <select class="input" id="pr-{i + 1}" title={roleHelpTitle(m.role)} value={m.role} onchange={(e) => void model.change(m, e.currentTarget.value as Role)}>
            {#each ROLE_ORDER as r (r)}<option value={r}>{ROLE_LABEL[r]}</option>{/each}
          </select>
        </div>
        <button class="iconbtn" aria-label="Remove {m.name ?? m.email}" type="button" disabled={locked} title={locked ? 'A workspace needs at least one owner' : undefined} onclick={() => void model.remove(m)}><PageIcon name="trash" /></button>
      </div>
    {/each}
  {/if}
  <form class="panel-body invite" style="border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) 150px auto; gap: var(--vk-space-2); align-items: end;" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.invite(); }}>
    <div class="field"><label for="inv-e">Invite by email</label><input class="input" id="inv-e" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com" bind:value={model.email} /></div>
    <div class="field"><label for="inv-r">Role</label><select class="input" id="inv-r" bind:value={model.role}>{#each INVITE_ORDER as r (r)}<option value={r}>{ROLE_LABEL[r]}</option>{/each}</select></div>
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="submit" disabled={model.busy}>Invite</button>
    <p class="hint" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">{roleHint(model.role)}</p>
    {#if model.error}<p class="hint" role="alert" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.error}</p>{/if}
  </form>
</section>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import CapabilityChips from './agents/CapabilityChips.svelte';
  import { ConnectionsModel } from './connections-model.svelte';
  import PanelTag from './PanelTag.svelte';
  import type { WorkspaceTabProps } from './types';

  let { review }: WorkspaceTabProps = $props();
  const model = new ConnectionsModel();
  $effect(() => { void model.refresh(); });
</script>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="cn-h">
  <div class="panel-head" style="flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;">
    {#if review}<PanelTag text={review.tag} />{/if}
    <h2 class="t-h2" id="cn-h">Connections</h2>
    <p class="t-meta">Where agents push code and where they come from.</p>
  </div>
  {#if model.loading}
    <p class="panel-body t-meta" role="status">Loading connections…</p>
  {:else}
    <div class="kv">
      <div><p class="t-h3">Forge host</p><p class="t-meta">Where agents push branches</p></div>
      {#if model.editingForge}
        <form style="display: flex; gap: var(--vk-space-2);" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.saveForge(); }}>
          <label class="sr" for="cn-forge">Forge host</label><input class="input" id="cn-forge" placeholder="forge.example.com" bind:value={model.forgeInput} />
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary btn-sm" type="submit">Save</button>
        </form>
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet btn-sm" type="button" onclick={() => (model.editingForge = false)}>Cancel</button>
      {:else}
        <p class="mono">{model.forgeHost ?? 'Not set'}</p>
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" onclick={() => model.startForge()}>Change</button>
      {/if}
    </div>
    {#if model.forgeError}<p class="hint" role="alert" style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-5); color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.forgeError}</p>{/if}
    <div class="kv">
      <div><p class="t-h3">AgentPod fleet</p><p class="t-meta">Where your agents run</p></div>
      {#if model.editingFleet}
        <form style="display: flex; gap: var(--vk-space-2);" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.saveFleet(); }}>
          <label class="sr" for="cn-fleet">Fleet id</label><input class="input" id="cn-fleet" placeholder="fleet_…" bind:value={model.fleetInput} />
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary btn-sm" type="submit" disabled={model.saving}>Save</button>
        </form>
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet btn-sm" type="button" onclick={() => (model.editingFleet = false)}>Cancel</button>
      {:else}
        {#if model.workspace?.externalId}
          <p class="t-body" title={model.workspace.externalId} style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--vk-color-success-text);"><PageIcon name="check" />Linked</p>
        {:else}
          <p class="t-body" style="color: var(--vk-color-muted);">Not linked</p>
        {/if}
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" onclick={() => model.startFleet()}>Change</button>
      {/if}
    </div>
    <div class="kv">
      <div><p class="t-h3">Add from AgentPod</p><p class="t-meta">Bring fleet agents in as workspace agents</p></div>
      {#if model.linkable.length === 0}
        <p class="t-body">Every agent in the fleet already has one here.</p>
      {:else}
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2); min-width: 0;" data-testid="hub-principal-list">
          <div class="caps">{#each model.linkable as p (p.id)}<button class="chip pick" type="button" aria-pressed={model.picked.includes(p.id)} title={p.id} onclick={() => model.togglePicked(p.id)}>{p.handle}</button>{/each}</div>
          <span class="lbl" id="cn-caps">Capabilities they can claim</span>
          <CapabilityChips bind:selected={model.importCaps} bind:typed={model.importTyped} registry={model.capabilities} labelledBy="cn-caps" inputId="cn-newcap" form="page" wrapInput />
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary btn-sm" type="button" data-testid="add-picked-agents" disabled={model.importing || model.picked.length === 0 || model.importCaps.length === 0} onclick={() => void model.addPicked()}>{model.importing ? 'Adding…' : `Add ${model.picked.length || ''}`.trim()}</button>
          {#if model.importResult}<p class="hint" role="alert" data-testid="import-failures">{model.importResult}</p>{/if}
        </div>
      {/if}
      <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" data-testid="connect-hub" disabled={model.connecting} onclick={() => void model.connect()}>{model.connecting ? 'Connecting…' : 'Connect to AgentPod'}</button>
    </div>
    {#if model.error}<p class="hint" role="alert" style="padding: 0 var(--vk-space-5); color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.error}</p>{/if}
  {/if}
  {#if review?.note}<p class="t-meta" style="padding: var(--vk-space-3) var(--vk-space-5); border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line);">{review.note}</p>{/if}
</section>
```

(`Connect to AgentPod` is shown in every state: the reference draws it beside "Every agent in the fleet already has one here.", so it is the way to (re)connect the hub, not only the first one.)

```svelte
            <label class="sr" for="cd-{c.key}">Description of {c.key}</label>

          </div>
          <div class="caps">
            {#each c.implies ?? [] as to (to)}

            {/each}
            {#if c.boardCount === 0}<span class="chip chip-line">no board asks</span>{/if}

            {#if model.implyingFor === c.key}

                <label class="sr" for="im-{c.key}">{c.key} implies</label>

              </form>

              <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet" aria-label="Add an implied capability to {c.key}" type="button" style="min-height: 44px; font-size: 0.875rem;" onclick={() => model.startImply(c.key)}><PageIcon name="plus" size={14} />Implies…</button>
            {/if}

          <button class="iconbtn" aria-label="Remove {c.key}" type="button" onclick={() => void model.remove(c)}><PageIcon name="trash" /></button>

    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="submit">Add</button>

</section>
```

```css
/* Hand deltas: the connections picker reuses the Agents chip look; narrow widths (notes `pages.md` §6). */
:where(.scr-ws) .pick { border: 0; cursor: pointer; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; }
:where(.scr-ws) .pick[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--vk-color-primary); color: var(--vk-color-primary-fg); }
@media (max-width: 1099.98px) { :where(.scr-ws) .grid2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
@media (max-width: 899.98px) { :where(.scr-ws) .crow { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 44px; } :where(.scr-ws) .crow > :not(.iconbtn) { grid-column: 1; } }
@media (max-width: 639.98px) {
  :where(.scr-ws) .nrow { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  :where(.scr-ws) .nacts, :where(.scr-ws) .resume { grid-column: 1; }
  :where(.scr-ws) .lrow.member, :where(.scr-ws) .invite, :where(.scr-ws) .kv { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; }
}
```

(The `!important` beats the reference's inline `grid-template-columns` on `.lrow.member` and `.invite`, which the artboard needs at 1440px.)

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/workspace/studio/NeedsYouStudio.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import { NeedsModel } from '../needs-model.svelte';
  import { actionLink, clip, metaLine, needsHeadMeta, studioUnit, unansweredFoot, WS_KIND_LABEL } from '../needs-row';
  import type { WorkspaceTabProps } from '../types';

  let { review, initial }: WorkspaceTabProps = $props();
  const model = new NeedsModel(initial);
  $effect(() => { void model.load(); });
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const foot = $derived(model.unanswered > 0 ? unansweredFoot(model.unanswered) : (review?.note ?? null));
</script>

<section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="nt-h">
  <div class="hd">
    <span class="no">{review?.no ?? '01'}</span>
    {#if review}<span class="kick">{review.tag}</span>{/if}
    <h2 id="nt-h">Waiting on you, across every board{#if model.items.length > 0}{' '}<span class="wo-ct">{model.items.length}</span>{/if}</h2>
    <span class="r">{#if model.cards !== null}{needsHeadMeta(model.unanswered)}{' '}{/if}<button class="ar-btn2" type="button" onclick={() => void model.load()}><PageIcon name="refresh" size={16} stroke={1.75} />{model.refreshing && model.cards !== null ? 'Refreshing…' : 'Refresh'}</button></span>
  </div>
  {#if model.error}
    <p class="ar-hint" role="alert">Could not load what is waiting: {model.error}</p>
  {:else if model.cards === null}
    <p class="ar-hint" role="status">Loading…</p>
  {:else if model.items.length === 0}
    <p class="wo-plain">Nothing on any board is waiting on you.</p>
  {:else}
    <table class="ar-tbl wo-tbl">
      <caption class="sr">Cards waiting on you across every board, oldest first</caption>
      <thead><tr>
        <th style="width: 34px;" scope="col">No.</th><th style="width: 96px;" scope="col">Kind</th><th style="width: 31%;" scope="col">Card · where</th><th scope="col">Why</th><th style="width: 168px;" scope="col">Actions</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {#each model.items as item, i (item.id)}
          {@const c = item.detail ? clip(item.detail) : null}
          {@const full = model.expanded.includes(item.id)}
          {@const open = model.openId === item.cardId}
          <tr class="wo-need">
            <td><span class="ix">{pad(i + 1)}</span></td>
            <td><span class="wo-kind{studioUnit(item.kind) === 'needs' ? ' needs' : ''}"><span class="u {studioUnit(item.kind)}" aria-hidden="true"></span>{WS_KIND_LABEL[item.kind]}</span></td>
            <td><a class="ttl" href="/b/{item.boardId}/c/{item.cardId}">{item.title}</a><p class="wo-sub">{metaLine(item)}</p></td>
            <td>
              {#if c}
                <div class="ar-q"><blockquote>{full ? item.detail : c.shown}</blockquote>{#if c.long}<button class="ar-lk" aria-expanded={full} type="button" onclick={() => model.toggleFull(item.id)}>{full ? 'Show less' : 'Show all'}</button>{/if}</div>
                <p class="wo-ins">{item.instruction}</p>
              {:else}
                <p class="wo-plain">{item.instruction}</p>
              {/if}
            </td>
            <td><div class="wo-acts">
              {#each item.actions as a (a)}
                {#if a === 'resume'}<button class="ar-btn" aria-expanded={open} type="button" onclick={() => void model.toggleResume(item.cardId)}>Resume</button>
                {:else}{@const l = actionLink(item, a)}{#if l}<a class={l.primary ? 'ar-btn' : 'ar-btn2'} href={l.href}>{l.label}</a>{/if}{/if}
              {/each}
            </div></td>
          </tr>
          {#if open}
            <tr class="wo-resume"><td></td><td></td><td colspan="3">
              <form aria-label="Resume this card" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.send(item); }}>
                <div class="ar-field"><label for="rs-note">Note for the agent</label><textarea class="ar-ta" id="rs-note" style="min-height: 72px;" maxlength="8000" bind:value={model.drafts[item.cardId]}></textarea></div>
                {#if model.refusal}<p class="ar-hint" role="alert">{model.refusal}</p>{/if}
                <div class="row">
                  <button class="ar-btn" type="submit" disabled={model.sending || (model.drafts[item.cardId] ?? '').trim() === ''}>Send back to work</button>
                  <button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => void model.toggleResume(item.cardId)}>Cancel</button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </td></tr>
          {/if}
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  {/if}
  {#if foot}<p class="wo-foot">{foot}</p>{/if}
</section>
```

```svelte
        {#each model.notes as n (n.key)}<p><strong>{n.key}</strong> {n.text} <a class="ar-lk" href={n.link.href}>{n.link.label}</a>{n.tail}</p>{/each}
        {#if review?.note}<p class="ar-hint">{review.note}</p>{/if}
      </div>
    {/if}
    <table class="ar-tbl wo-tbl">
      <caption class="sr">Capabilities, A to Z</caption>
      <thead><tr><th style="width: 26%;" scope="col">Capability · held by</th><th style="width: 36%;" scope="col">Description</th><th scope="col">Implies</th><th style="width: 54px;" scope="col"><span class="sr">Remove</span></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {#each model.rows as c (c.id)}
          <tr>
            <td><p class="wo-cap">{c.key}</p><p class="wo-who"><span class="wo-stack">{#each holdersOf(c, model.agents) as a (a.id)}{@html faceSvg(a.name, { label: a.name, mood: 'resting', size: 20 })}{/each}</span>{agentCountText(c.agentCount)}</p></td>
            <td><label class="sr" for="cd-{c.key}">Description of {c.key}</label><input class="ar-in" id="cd-{c.key}" placeholder="Add a description" value={c.description ?? ''} onblur={(e) => void model.describe(c, e.currentTarget.value)} /></td>
            <td><div class="wo-caps">
              {#each c.implies ?? [] as to (to)}<span class="wo-tag">implies {to}<button class="wo-x h44" aria-label="Remove implies {to}" type="button" onclick={() => void model.unimply(c.key, to)}><PageIcon name="close" size={14} stroke={1.75} /></button></span>{/each}
              {#if c.boardCount === 0}<span class="wo-tag">no board asks</span>{/if}
              {#if c.origin === 'inferred'}<span class="wo-tag" title={INFERRED_TITLE}>inferred</span>{/if}
              {#if model.implyingFor === c.key}
                <form style="display: inline-flex; gap: 6px;" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.imply(c.key); }}><label class="sr" for="im-{c.key}">{c.key} implies</label><input class="ar-in" id="im-{c.key}" placeholder="e.g. analysis" bind:value={model.implyTo} /><button class="ar-btn2" type="submit">Add</button></form>
              {:else}
                <button class="ar-lk" aria-label="Add an implied capability to {c.key}" type="button" onclick={() => model.startImply(c.key)}><PageIcon name="plus" size={14} stroke={1.75} />Implies…</button>
              {/if}
            </div></td>
            <td><button class="ar-ib wo-del" aria-label="Remove {c.key}" type="button" onclick={() => void model.remove(c)}><PageIcon name="trash" stroke={1.75} /></button></td>
          </tr>
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  {/if}
  <form class="wo-add" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.add(); }}>
    <div class="ar-field"><label for="cap-new">Add a capability</label><input class="ar-in" id="cap-new" placeholder="e.g. diagnostics" bind:value={model.newKey} /></div>
    <button class="ar-btn2" type="submit">Add</button>

    {#if model.error}<p class="ar-hint" role="alert">{model.error}</p>{/if}

</section>
```

```css
/* Hand delta: the AgentPod import picker on Connections uses the Agents chip look. */
:where(.wo-main) .wa-caps { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
:where(.wo-main) .wa-pick { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: transparent; }
:where(.wo-main) .wa-pick[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); }
@media (max-width: 1099.98px) { :where(.wo-main) .wo-split { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
```

- [ ] **Step 10: e2e — resume from the workspace crosses the API; and the renamed heading**

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/workspace-needs.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT } from './support/seed';

const AGENT = { ...TENANT, 'X-Agent-Id': 'agt_b' };
const PIPELINE = [
  { key: 'build', name: 'Build', order: 0, ownerKind: 'capability', owner: 'build' },
  { key: 'review', name: 'Review', order: 1, ownerKind: 'human', gate: 'approval' },
];

test('a person resumes a blocked card from the workspace, and the agent reads the note', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const title = `Rotate the keys ${Date.now()}`;
  const { boardId } = (await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name: 'Workspace resume', stages: PIPELINE } })).json()) as { boardId: string };
  await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/cards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { title, ownerUserId: 'usr_a' } });
  const claim = await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/claims`, { headers: AGENT, data: { capabilities: ['build'] } })).json();
  await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/runs/${claim.runId}/block`, { headers: AGENT, data: { leaseEpoch: claim.leaseEpoch, reason: 'the vault is sealed' } });

  await page.goto('/workspace/needs-you');
  const row = page.locator('li.nrow, tr.wo-need').filter({ hasText: title });
  await expect(row).toContainText('the vault is sealed');
  await row.getByRole('button', { name: 'Resume' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Note for the agent').fill('Unsealed it — go ahead.');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send back to work' }).click();

  await expect.poll(async () => (await (await request.get(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}`, { headers: TENANT })).json()).cards[0].state).toBe('submitted');
  const next = await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/claims`, { headers: AGENT, data: { capabilities: ['build'] } })).json();
  expect(next.handoff.feedback).toBe('Unsealed it — go ahead.');
  await expect(page.locator('li.nrow, tr.wo-need').filter({ hasText: title })).toHaveCount(0);
```

### Task 35: Board settings in every vibe

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

Board settings is rebuilt on the reference markup — name, pipeline editor with one `<details>` per stage, schedules, GitHub, agent profiles — turning `SP-Settings-Daylight`, `-Paper`, `-Studio` and `-Quiet` green. D/P/Q share `BoardSettings.svelte`; Studio (`st-main`, numbered `ar-sec` sections, stage swatches `c1…c7`) has `settings/BoardSettingsStudio.svelte`; both read one `SettingsModel`. Plan ruling on the clock: the screen starts at `2026-10-11T08:19:00Z`, the steps save the Reproduce rule twice (two real PATCHes), then `page.clock.fastForward('02:00')`, so the open stage reads exactly "Rule saved · 2 min ago" — the save time is kept per stage (`ruleSavedAt`, SE-G2) and `now` ticks every 30 s.     expect(ownerLabel({ key: 'x', name: 'X', order: 0, ownerKind: 'capability', requires: { all: ['a', 'b'] } }, [])).toBe('Agent with a and b');
```ts
    expect(ownerLabel({ key: 'x', name: 'X', order: 0, ownerKind: 'agent', owner: 'agt_fx_tester_tim' }, [{ id: 'agt_fx_tester_tim', name: 'tester-tim' } as AgentSummary])).toBe('Agent tester-tim');

    expect(worksBy(DX_STAGES[1]!)).toBe('agent');
  });

    const cards = [card('63ac', 'reported'), card('4605', 'reproduce'), card('4828', 'reproduce', true), card('58f8', 'test'), card('f83f', 'test'), card('481f', 'test'), card('1dfc', 'fix'), card('6281', 'integrate', true), card('9ed9', 'shipped')];
    expect(cardsPerStage(cards)).toEqual({ reported: 1, reproduce: 1, test: 3, fix: 1, shipped: 1 });

    expect(unsavedCount([DX_STAGES[1]!, DX_STAGES[0]!, ...DX_STAGES.slice(2)], DX_STAGES)).toBe(1);
    expect(unsavedCount(DX_STAGES.slice(0, 6), DX_STAGES)).toBe(1);

  });
  it('says how long ago a rule was saved', () => {
    const t = Date.parse('2026-10-11T08:19:00Z');
    expect(ago(t, t + 120_000)).toBe('2 min ago');

  it('says where GitHub stands', () => {

    expect(grantNote(null)).toBe('Saving carries your dispatch authority onto every card this trigger opens. Without it, no agent can claim those cards.');
    expect(grantNote(1)).toBe('Cards from this trigger may be dispatched to 1 agent. Save again to refresh that.');
  });
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/settings/settings-words.ts
import type { AgentSummary, BoardSnapshot, Card, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';

export type WorksBy = 'person' | 'agent';
export function worksBy(s: Stage): WorksBy {
  if (s.ownerKind === 'human') return 'person';
  if (s.ownerKind === 'agent' || s.ownerKind === 'capability') return 'agent';
  return s.owner || s.requires ? 'agent' : 'person';
}

export function ownerText(s: Stage): string {
  if (s.requires) return [...(s.requires.all ?? s.requires.any ?? [])].join(', ');
  return s.owner ?? '';
}

export function ownerLabel(s: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  if (worksBy(s) === 'person') return 'A person';
  if (s.ownerKind === 'agent') return `Agent ${displayAgent(s.owner ?? '', agents)}`;
  const parts = s.requires?.any ?? s.requires?.all ?? (s.owner ? [s.owner] : []);
  if (parts.length === 0) return 'Agent with no capability set';
  return `Agent with ${parts.join(s.requires?.any ? ' or ' : ' and ')}`;
}

export function ago(at: number, now: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor((now - at) / 60_000);
  return m < 1 ? 'just now' : m < 60 ? `${m} min ago` : `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h ago`;
}

export function cardsPerStage(cards: Pick<Card, 'currentStageKey' | 'archivedAt'>[]): Record<string, number> {
  return cards.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt).reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, c) => ({ ...acc, [c.currentStageKey]: (acc[c.currentStageKey] ?? 0) + 1 }), {});
}
export const stageCards = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}`;
export const cardsHere = (n: number) => `${stageCards(n)} here`;
export const wipLine = (limit: number | null | undefined) => (limit ? `WIP limit ${limit}` : 'no WIP limit');
export const ruleLine = (s: Stage) => (s.instructions?.trim() ? `Rule: ${s.instructions.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}` : 'No standing rule');
export const pipelineMeta = (n: number) => `${n} stages a card moves through, in order. Open a stage to edit it.`;

/** What "Save pipeline" sends; a stage's standing rule saves on its own and is not counted. */
export const STAGE_FIELDS = ['name', 'ownerKind', 'owner', 'requires', 'gate', 'wipLimit'] as const;
const norm = (s: Stage) => JSON.stringify(STAGE_FIELDS.map((f) => s[f] ?? null));

export function unsavedCount(draft: Stage[], saved: Stage[]): number {
  const byKey = new Map(saved.map((s) => [s.key, s]));
  const keys = new Set(draft.map((s) => s.key));
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of draft) { const o = byKey.get(s.key); if (!o || norm(o) !== norm(s)) n++; }
  for (const k of byKey.keys()) if (!keys.has(k)) n++;
  const sameKeys = draft.filter((s) => byKey.has(s.key)).map((s) => s.key);
  const savedOrder = saved.filter((s) => keys.has(s.key)).map((s) => s.key);
  if (sameKeys.join() !== savedOrder.join()) n++;
  return n;
}
export const saveState = (n: number) => (n === 0 ? 'Saved' : `${n} unsaved ${n === 1 ? 'change' : 'changes'}`);

export function ghState(g: BoardSnapshot['github']): { text: string; saved: boolean } {
  if (!g.webhookConfigured) return { text: 'Not set up', saved: false };
  return g.issueTrigger ? { text: 'Opening cards from issues', saved: true } : { text: 'Connected · trigger off', saved: false };
}
export function grantNote(n: number | null): string {
  return n === null
    ? 'Saving carries your dispatch authority onto every card this trigger opens. Without it, no agent can claim those cards.'
    : `Cards from this trigger may be dispatched to ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'agent' : 'agents'}. Save again to refresh that.`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/settings/settings-model.svelte.ts
import { capabilityTag } from '@superpipeline/contract';
import { renameBoard, setGithubConfig, setStages, patchStage, getProfiles, createProfile, type BoardSnapshot, type Profile, type Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { cardsPerStage, ownerText, unsavedCount, type WorksBy } from './settings-words';

export interface SettingsContext { board: BoardSnapshot; onChanged: () => void }
const parts = (raw: string) => [...new Set(raw.split(',').map(capabilityTag).filter((c) => c !== ''))];

export class SettingsModel {
  private ctx: () => SettingsContext;
  board: BoardSnapshot = $derived(this.ctx().board);
  agents = $derived(app.agents);

  nameInput = $state('');
  nameBusy = $state(false);
  nameError = $state<string | null>(null);
  draft = $state<Stage[]>([]);
  stagesError = $state<string | null>(null);
  newStageName = $state('');
  savingStages = $state(false);
  /** When each stage's standing rule was last saved here (ms); the line reads "Rule saved · {ago}". */
  ruleSavedAt = $state<Record<string, number>>({});
  now = $state(Date.now());
  githubSecret = $state('');
  issueTrigger = $state(false);
  ghBusy = $state(false);
  ghError = $state<string | null>(null);
  copied = $state<'url' | 'secret' | null>(null);
  profiles = $state<Profile[]>([]);
  pKey = $state('');
  pModel = $state('');
  profileBusy = $state(false);
  profileError = $state<string | null>(null);

  cardsPerStage = $derived(cardsPerStage(this.board.cards));
  unsaved = $derived(unsavedCount(this.draft, this.board.stages));
  nameDirty = $derived(this.nameInput.trim() !== '' && this.nameInput.trim() !== this.board.name);
  webhookUrl = $derived(this.board.github.webhookUrl || `${location.origin}/v1/boards/${this.board.boardId}/webhooks/github?tenant=${this.board.tenantId}`);

  constructor(ctx: () => SettingsContext) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    const b = ctx().board;
    this.nameInput = b.name ?? '';
    this.issueTrigger = b.github.issueTrigger;
    this.draft = b.stages.map((s) => ({ ...s }));
    void getProfiles(b.boardId!).then((p) => (this.profiles = p)).catch(() => (this.profiles = []));
  }

  /** Call from an $effect: ticks `now` every 30 s and returns the cleanup. */
  startClock(): () => void {
    const t = setInterval(() => (this.now = Date.now()), 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }

  private changed(): void { this.ctx().onChanged(); }

  async saveName(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.nameDirty) return;
    this.nameBusy = true;
    this.nameError = null;
    try {
      const res = await renameBoard(this.board.boardId!, this.nameInput.trim());
      if (!res.ok) { this.nameError = `Could not rename the board (${res.status}).`; return; }
      this.changed();
    } finally { this.nameBusy = false; }
  }

  setWorksBy(stage: Stage, by: WorksBy): void {
    if (by === 'person') { stage.ownerKind = 'human'; delete stage.owner; delete stage.requires; }
    else { stage.ownerKind = 'capability'; }
  }

  setOwner(stage: Stage, raw: string): void {
    const p = parts(raw);
    if (p.length > 1) { stage.requires = stage.requires?.any ? { any: p } : { all: p }; delete stage.owner; }
    else { delete stage.requires; stage.owner = p[0] ?? ''; }
  }

  setMatch(stage: Stage, match: 'all' | 'any'): void {
    const p = parts(ownerText(stage));
    stage.requires = match === 'any' ? { any: p } : { all: p };
  }

  addStage(): void {
    const name = this.newStageName.trim();
    if (name === '') return;
    let key = capabilityTag(name) || `stage-${this.draft.length + 1}`;
    let n = 2;
    while (this.draft.some((s) => s.key === key)) key = `${capabilityTag(name)}-${n++}`;
    this.draft = [...this.draft, { key, name, order: this.draft.length }];
    this.newStageName = '';
  }

  removeStage(key: string): void { this.draft = this.draft.filter((s) => s.key !== key).map((s, i) => ({ ...s, order: i })); }

  move(index: number, by: number): void {
    const to = index + by;
    if (to < 0 || to >= this.draft.length) return;
    const next = [...this.draft];
    [next[index], next[to]] = [next[to]!, next[index]!];
    this.draft = next.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, order: i }));
  }

  async saveRule(stage: Stage, text: string): Promise<void> {
    const next = text.trim();
    if (next === (stage.instructions ?? '').trim()) return;
    const res = await patchStage(this.board.boardId!, stage.key, { instructions: next === '' ? null : next });
    if (!res.ok) { this.stagesError = `Could not save the rule for ${stage.name} (${res.status}).`; return; }
    stage.instructions = next === '' ? undefined : next;
    this.ruleSavedAt = { ...this.ruleSavedAt, [stage.key]: Date.now() };
    this.now = Date.now();
    this.changed();
  }

  async saveStages(): Promise<void> {
    this.savingStages = true;
    this.stagesError = null;
    try {
      const res = await setStages(this.board.boardId!, this.draft);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | null;
        this.stagesError = body?.error?.message ?? `Saving the pipeline failed (${res.status})`;
        return;
      }
      this.changed();
      // SE-G17: re-seed from what was sent, so the editor reads "Saved" without waiting for the refresh.
      this.draft = this.draft.map((s) => ({ ...s }));
    } finally { this.savingStages = false; }
  }

  genSecret(): void {
    const b = new Uint8Array(24);
    crypto.getRandomValues(b);
    this.githubSecret = [...b].map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  }

  async copy(what: 'url' | 'secret'): Promise<void> {
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(what === 'url' ? this.webhookUrl : this.githubSecret);
    this.copied = what;
    setTimeout(() => (this.copied = this.copied === what ? null : this.copied), 1600);
  }

  async saveGithub(): Promise<void> {
    this.ghBusy = true;
    this.ghError = null;
    try {
      const res = await setGithubConfig(this.board.boardId!, { issueTrigger: this.issueTrigger, ...(this.githubSecret.trim() !== '' ? { secret: this.githubSecret.trim() } : {}) });
      if (!res.ok) { this.ghError = `Could not save the GitHub settings (${res.status}).`; return; }
      this.githubSecret = '';
      this.changed();
    } finally { this.ghBusy = false; }
  }

  async addProfile(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.pKey.trim() === '') { this.profileError = 'Give the profile a key.'; return; }
    this.profileBusy = true;
    this.profileError = null;
    try {
      const res = await createProfile(this.board.boardId!, { key: this.pKey.trim(), model: this.pModel.trim() || undefined });
      if (!res.ok) { this.profileError = `Could not add the profile (${res.status}).`; return; }
      this.pKey = '';
      this.pModel = '';
      this.profiles = await getProfiles(this.board.boardId!);
    } finally { this.profileBusy = false; }
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/board/schedule-model.svelte.ts
import { getSchedules, createSchedule, updateSchedule, deleteSchedule, type Schedule } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

export class ScheduleModel {
  schedules = $state<Schedule[]>([]);
  busy = $state('');
  formError = $state<string | null>(null);
  title = $state('');
  rule = $state('');
  timezone = $state('');
  stageKey = $state('');
  priority = $state('');
  overlap = $state<'skip' | 'allow'>('skip');

  constructor(private boardId: string) {}

  async load(): Promise<void> {
    const req = getSchedules(this.boardId);
    app.markBusy(req);
    this.schedules = await req.catch(() => []);
  }

  async add(): Promise<void> {
    this.formError = null;
    const [t, r, tz] = [this.title.trim(), this.rule.trim(), this.timezone.trim()];
    if (t === '' || r === '' || tz === '') { this.formError = 'Give the card a title, a cadence and a time zone.'; return; }
    this.busy = 'add';
    try {
      const res = await createSchedule(this.boardId, {
        title: t, rule: r, timezone: tz, overlap: this.overlap,
        ...(this.stageKey.trim() !== '' ? { stageKey: this.stageKey.trim() } : {}),
        ...(this.priority.trim() !== '' ? { priority: Number(this.priority) } : {}),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | null;
        this.formError = body?.error?.message ?? `Could not add the schedule (${res.status}).`;
        return;
      }
      this.title = ''; this.rule = ''; this.timezone = ''; this.stageKey = ''; this.priority = ''; this.overlap = 'skip';
      await this.load();
    } finally { this.busy = ''; }
  }

  async toggle(s: Schedule): Promise<void> {
    this.busy = s.id;
    try { await updateSchedule(this.boardId, s.id, { enabled: !s.enabled }); await this.load(); } finally { this.busy = ''; }
  }

  async remove(s: Schedule): Promise<void> {
    this.busy = s.id;
    try { await deleteSchedule(this.boardId, s.id); await this.load(); } finally { this.busy = ''; }
  }
}
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import type { Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { ago, cardsHere, ownerLabel, ownerText, ruleLine, stageCards, wipLine, worksBy } from './settings-words';

  let { stage, index, model }: { stage: Stage; index: number; model: SettingsModel } = $props();
  const k = $derived(stage.key);
  const cards = $derived(model.cardsPerStage[stage.key] ?? 0);
  const by = $derived(worksBy(stage));
  const caps = $derived(ownerText(stage).split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean));
  const saved = $derived(model.ruleSavedAt[stage.key]);
</script>

<details class="stage">
  <summary>
    <span class="num t-num">{index + 1}</span>

      <span class="t-h3">{stage.name}</span>
      <span class="chip chip-line"><PageIcon name={by === 'person' ? 'person' : 'agent'} size={14} />{ownerLabel(stage, model.agents)}</span>
      {#if stage.gate === 'approval'}<span class="chip"><PageIcon name="home" size={14} />Approval gate</span>{/if}
      <span class="sumrule">{ruleLine(stage)}</span>
    </span>
    <span class="t-meta t-num" style="text-align: right; white-space: nowrap;">{stageCards(cards)}<br />{wipLine(stage.wipLimit)}</span>
    <span class="disc-ico" aria-hidden="true"><PageIcon name="chev-down" size={20} /></span>
  </summary>
  <div class="stage-body">
    <div class="field"><label for="st-name-{k}">Stage name</label><input class="input" id="st-name-{k}" bind:value={stage.name} /></div>
    <div class="field">
      <span class="lbl">Key</span>
      <p class="t-body" style="min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span class="code" style="flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap;">{stage.key}</span><span class="t-meta">fixed — cards, runs and gates refer to it</span></p>
    </div>
    <div class="field full">
      <span class="lbl" id="st-own-{k}">Who works this stage</span>
      <div class="seg" role="group" aria-labelledby="st-own-{k}">
        <button aria-pressed={by === 'person'} type="button" onclick={() => model.setWorksBy(stage, 'person')}><PageIcon name="person" size={16} />A person</button>
        <button aria-pressed={by === 'agent'} type="button" onclick={() => model.setWorksBy(stage, 'agent')}><PageIcon name="agent" size={16} />An agent</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    {#if by === 'agent'}
      <div class="field">
        <label for="st-cap-{k}">Capability</label>
        <input class="input" id="st-cap-{k}" value={ownerText(stage)} onblur={(e) => model.setOwner(stage, e.currentTarget.value)} />
        <p class="hint">Comma-separated. Agents holding it claim cards here. Saves when you leave the field.</p>
      </div>
      {#if caps.length >= 2}
        <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="How the capabilities combine" style="align-self: end;">
          <button aria-pressed={!stage.requires?.any} type="button" onclick={() => model.setMatch(stage, 'all')}>Needs all</button>
          <button aria-pressed={!!stage.requires?.any} type="button" onclick={() => model.setMatch(stage, 'any')}>Any one</button>
        </div>
      {:else}
        <p class="hint" style="align-self: end;">With two or more capabilities, choose “needs all” or “any one” here.</p>
      {/if}
    {/if}
    <div class="field"><label for="st-wip-{k}">WIP limit</label><input class="input" id="st-wip-{k}" type="number" placeholder="No limit" min="0" value={stage.wipLimit ?? ''} oninput={(e) => (stage.wipLimit = e.currentTarget.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.currentTarget.value))} /></div>
    <div class="field">
      <span class="lbl">Approval</span>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked={stage.gate === 'approval'} onchange={(e) => (stage.gate = e.currentTarget.checked ? 'approval' : undefined)} /><span>Approval gate — a person approves before a card leaves this stage</span></label>
    </div>
    <div class="field full">
      <label for="st-rule-{k}">Standing rule for this stage</label>
      <textarea class="input" id="st-rule-{k}" value={stage.instructions ?? ''} onblur={(e) => void model.saveRule(stage, e.currentTarget.value)}></textarea>
      {#if saved !== undefined}<p class="saved"><PageIcon name="check" size={16} />Rule saved · {ago(saved, model.now)}</p>{/if}
    </div>
    <div class="stage-foot">
      <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" aria-label="Move {stage.name} earlier" disabled={index === 0} onclick={() => model.move(index, -1)}><PageIcon name="arrow-up" size={16} />Move earlier</button>
      <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" aria-label="Move {stage.name} later" disabled={index === model.draft.length - 1} onclick={() => model.move(index, 1)}><PageIcon name="arrow-down" size={16} />Move later</button>
      <span class="t-meta t-num" style="margin-left: auto;">{cardsHere(cards)}</span>
      <button class="vk-button btn-sm btn-destructive" type="button" aria-label="Remove stage {stage.name}" disabled={cards > 0 || model.draft.length <= 1} onclick={() => model.removeStage(stage.key)}><PageIcon name="trash" size={16} />Remove stage</button>
    </div>
    <p class="hint full">A stage holding cards cannot be removed until they are moved; the last stage cannot be removed.</p>
  </div>
</details>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import type { Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { formatFireTime } from './schedule-format';
  import { ScheduleModel } from './schedule-model.svelte';

  let { boardId, stages }: { boardId: string; stages: Stage[] } = $props();
  const model = new ScheduleModel(boardId);
  $effect(() => { void model.load(); });
</script>

<div class="panel-body" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-4);">
  {#if model.schedules.length === 0}
    <p class="empty">No recurring cards on this board yet. Each one you add lists its cadence, time zone, target stage, next and last run, and who set it up, with Pause and Remove.</p>
  {:else}
    <ul style="list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-3);">
      {#each model.schedules as s (s.id)}

            {#if s.skipCount > 0}<p class="t-meta">Skipped {s.skipCount} {s.skipCount === 1 ? 'time' : 'times'} — the previous card was still open when it came due.</p>{/if}
          </div>
          <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="button" disabled={model.busy === s.id} onclick={() => void model.toggle(s)}>{s.enabled ? 'Pause' : 'Resume'}</button>
          <button class="vk-button btn-sm btn-destructive" type="button" disabled={model.busy === s.id} onclick={() => void model.remove(s)}>Remove</button>
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ul>
  {/if}
  <form class="formgrid" aria-label="Add a recurring card" onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.add(); }}>

    <div class="field"><label for="sc-r">Cadence</label><input class="input" id="sc-r" placeholder="daily at 09:00" bind:value={model.rule} /></div>
    <div class="field"><label for="sc-z">Time zone</label><input class="input" id="sc-z" placeholder="e.g. Asia/Kolkata" bind:value={model.timezone} /></div>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="sc-s">Opens in stage</label>
      <select class="input" id="sc-s" bind:value={model.stageKey}>
        <option value="">First stage ({stages[0]?.name ?? '—'})</option>
        {#each stages.slice(1) as st (st.key)}<option value={st.key}>{st.name}</option>{/each}
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="field"><label for="sc-p">Priority</label><input class="input" id="sc-p" type="number" placeholder="e.g. 2" min="1" bind:value={model.priority} /></div>
    <div class="field full">
      <label for="sc-o">If the previous card is still open</label>
      <select class="input" id="sc-o" bind:value={model.overlap}><option value="skip">Skip this one</option><option value="allow">Open another anyway</option></select>
    </div>
    <details class="full">
      <summary class="t-meta" style="min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-decoration: underline;"><PageIcon name="info" size={16} />How to write a cadence</summary>
      <p class="t-meta">every 30 minutes · every 2 hours · every 3 days · daily at 09:00 · weekly on mon at 09:00 · monthly on 1 at 09:00 (day 1–28). Schedules are checked every five minutes, so a card may open up to five minutes late.</p>
    </details>
    {#if model.formError}<p class="hint full" role="alert" style="color: var(--vk-color-signal-text);">{model.formError}</p>{/if}
    <div class="full"><button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" type="submit" disabled={model.busy === 'add'}><PageIcon name="plus" size={16} />Add schedule</button></div>
  </form>
</div>
```

```svelte
            <div class="field" style="flex: 1 1 140px;"><label for="ap-k">Key</label><input class="input" id="ap-k" placeholder="e.g. opus-careful" bind:value={model.pKey} /></div>

```

(Write errors use the neutral `.note`, never signal colour — notes `pages.md` §5. `StageRow` mutates the draft stage object it is given; `draft` is `$state`, so the objects are reactive proxies and `unsaved` recomputes.)

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/settings.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT, seedBoard } from './support/seed';

test('a standing rule saves when the field is left, and the board keeps it', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const boardId = await seedBoard(request, 'Settings E2E');
  await page.goto(`/b/${boardId}/settings`);
  await page.locator('details.stage > summary, details.st-stage > summary').filter({ has: page.locator('.t-h3, .st-name', { hasText: /^Ready$/ }) }).click();
  const rule = page.locator('#st-rule-ready');
  await rule.fill('Only cards with a named owner wait here.');
  await rule.blur();
  await expect(page.getByText('Rule saved · just now')).toBeVisible();
  const board = await (await request.get(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}`, { headers: TENANT })).json();
  expect(board.stages.find((s: { key: string }) => s.key === 'ready').instructions).toBe('Only cards with a named owner wait here.');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove stage Ready' })).toBeEnabled();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Move Backlog earlier' })).toBeDisabled();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Edit the four screen entries** in `apps/web/e2e/pixel/screens.ts` (add `import { expect } from '@playwright/test'` if the file has no `expect` yet)

```ts
/**
 * Plan ruling: start at 08:19Z, save the Reproduce rule twice (append " x", blur, remove it, blur —
 * two real PATCHes, text back to the fixture's), let two minutes pass, refresh so "synced" reads 13:51.
 */
async function ruleSavedTwoMinutesAgo(p: Page): Promise<void> {
  const summary = p.locator('details.stage > summary, details.st-stage > summary').filter({ has: p.locator('.t-h3, .st-name', { hasText: /^Reproduce$/ }) });
  await summary.click();
  const rule = p.locator('#st-rule-reproduce');
  const patched = () => p.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/stages/reproduce') && r.request().method() === 'PATCH');
  const toEnd = () => rule.evaluate((el: HTMLTextAreaElement) => { el.focus(); el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length); });
  await toEnd();
  await p.keyboard.type(' x');
  await Promise.all([patched(), rule.blur()]);
  await toEnd();
  await p.keyboard.press('Backspace');
  await p.keyboard.press('Backspace');
  await Promise.all([patched(), rule.blur()]);
  await p.clock.fastForward('02:00');
  await p.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __spDev: { refresh: () => Promise<void> } }).__spDev.refresh());
  await p.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true');
  await expect(p.getByText('Rule saved · 2 min ago')).toBeVisible();
  await p.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur());
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/spend-format.ts
import type { BoardEvent, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { lcFirst } from '$lib/words';

export const usd = (n: number) => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
export const pctOf = (a: number, max: number) => (max > 0 ? Math.round((a / max) * 100) : 0);

export type CountUnit = '' | 'k' | 'M';
export const unitFor = (n: number): CountUnit => (n < 1000 ? '' : n < 1_000_000 ? 'k' : 'M');
export function compactCount(n: number, unit: CountUnit = unitFor(n)): string {
  if (unit === '') return String(n);
  return unit === 'k' ? `${(n / 1e3).toFixed(1)}k` : `${(n / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M`;
}
/** The in/out pair uses the unit chosen for the total, so 1.9M splits into 1.6M and 0.3M. */
export function tokenPair(input: number, output: number): string {
  const u = unitFor(input + output);
  return `${compactCount(input, u)} in · ${compactCount(output, u)} out`;
}
export const cardsWithSpend = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} with spend in this window`;
export const avgPerCard = (total: number, cards: number) => (cards > 0 ? usd(total / cards) : '—');

/** Daylight/Paper/Quiet bar: 170px for the busiest day, 2px floor (a zero day still draws a line). */
export const barHeight = (cost: number, max: number) => (cost === 0 || max === 0 ? 2 : Math.max(2, Math.round((cost / max) * 170)));
/** Studio bar: 160px column, nothing drawn for a zero day. */
export const barHeightStudio = (cost: number, max: number) => (cost === 0 || max === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(2, Math.round((cost / max) * 160)));

/** The seven UTC dates ending today (YYYY-MM-DD), oldest first. */
export function last7Days(nowMs: number): string[] {
  const d = new Date(nowMs);
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate() - (6 - i))).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
}
export function zeroFill(byDay: Array<{ day: string; costUsd: number }>, days: string[]): Array<{ day: string; costUsd: number }> {
  return days.map((day) => ({ day, costUsd: byDay.find((b) => b.day === day)?.costUsd ?? 0 }));
}
const utc = (day: string) => new Date(`${day}T00:00:00Z`);
export const dayLabel = (day: string) => `${utc(day).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' })} ${utc(day).getUTCDate()}`;
export function dayRange(days: string[]): string {
  const [a, b] = [utc(days[0]!), utc(days[days.length - 1]!)];
  const wd = (d: Date) => d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', timeZone: 'UTC' });
  const mo = (d: Date) => d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { month: 'long', timeZone: 'UTC' });
  const first = `${wd(a)} ${a.getUTCDate()}${mo(a) === mo(b) ? '' : ` ${mo(a)}`}`;
  return `${first} to ${wd(b)} ${b.getUTCDate()} ${mo(b)}`;
}
/** Index of the busiest day (ties: the latest), or -1 when nothing was spent. */
export function busiestIndex(days: Array<{ costUsd: number }>): number {
  let best = -1;
  days.forEach((d, i) => { if (d.costUsd > 0 && (best === -1 || d.costUsd >= days[best]!.costUsd)) best = i; });
  return best;
}
export function busiestLine(days: Array<{ day: string; costUsd: number }>): string {
  const i = busiestIndex(days);
  return i === -1 ? 'No spend recorded in these 7 days.' : `Busiest: ${dayLabel(days[i]!.day)} · ${usd(days[i]!.costUsd)}`;
}
export const chartLabel = (days: Array<{ day: string; costUsd: number }>) => `Spend per day, ${days.map((d) => `${dayLabel(d.day)} ${usd(d.costUsd)}`).join(', ')}`;

export const shortId = (cardId: string) => cardId.replace(/^card_/, '').slice(0, 6);
export function shortTitle(t: string): string {
  const w = t.split(' ');
  const n = w.slice(0, 3).join(' ').length < 25 ? 4 : 3;
  return w.slice(0, n).join(' ') + (w.length > n ? '…' : '');
}

const KIND: Record<string, string> = {
  stale: 'stuck', overdue: 'overdue', failed: 'failed', blocked: 'stopped', gate: 'review needed', input: 'question asked',
  rework: 'sent back', reclaimed: 'run reclaimed', 'control-pair': 'not dispatched',
};
const FIXED: Record<string, string> = { 'cards.stale_digest': 'Stale-card digest sent', 'link.added': 'Link added', 'card.updated': 'Card updated', 'card.created': 'Card created' };

export function eventLabel(e: BoardEvent, stages: Stage[]): string {
  const p = e.payload as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (FIXED[e.type]) return FIXED[e.type]!;
  if (e.type === 'notification') {
    const body = typeof p.body === 'string' ? p.body.trim() : '';
    if (body) return `Notification: ${lcFirst(body.split(':')[0]!.trim())}`;
    const kind = String(p.kind ?? '');
    return `Notification: ${KIND[kind] ?? kind}`;
  }
  if (e.type === 'card.moved') {
    const to = String(p.to ?? '');
    return `Moved to ${stages.find((s) => s.key === to)?.name ?? to}`;
  }
  const words = e.type.replace(/[._]/g, ' ');
  return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1);
}

export function eventSummary(e: BoardEvent): string {
  const p = e.payload as Record<string, unknown>;
  return ['cardId', 'agentId', 'to', 'from', 'name', 'reason', 'decision'].filter((k) => typeof p[k] === 'string').map((k) => `${k}=${p[k] as string}`).join(' · ');
}
export const rawLine = (e: BoardEvent) => { const s = eventSummary(e); return `${e.type}${s ? ` ${s}` : ''}`; };
export const logMeta = (n: number) => `last ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'event' : 'events'}, newest first · times in UTC`;

export function budgetLine(spend: number, budget: number | null, over: boolean): { text: string; setCap: boolean } {
  if (budget === null) return { text: 'No budget cap set · ', setCap: true };
  return { text: `of a ${usd(budget)} board cap · ${pctOf(spend, budget)}% used${over ? ' · over the cap' : ''}`, setCap: false };
}
export const capsStatus = (board: number | null, card: number | null) =>
  board === null && card === null ? 'No caps set' : `Board ${board === null ? 'none' : usd(board)} · card ${card === null ? 'none' : usd(card)}`;

export const CAP_HINT_INVALID = 'Enter an amount in dollars, like 25 or 12.50, or leave it empty for no cap.';
export function parseCap(v: string): number | null | 'invalid' {
  const t = v.trim();
  if (t === '') return null;
  if (!/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(t)) return 'invalid';
  const n = Number(t);
  return n > 0 ? n : 'invalid';
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/telemetry-model.svelte.ts
import { getUsage, getBoardEvents, type BoardEvent, type UsageSummary } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { last7Days, zeroFill } from './spend-format';

export type SpendWindow = '7d' | '5h';
export interface BoardTotal { id: string; name: string; costUsd: number }
const message = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));

export class TelemetryModel {
  window_ = $state<SpendWindow>('7d');
  usage = $state<UsageSummary | null>(null);
  usageError = $state<string | null>(null);
  loading = $state(false);
  boardTotals = $state<BoardTotal[] | null>(null);
  events = $state<BoardEvent[] | null>(null);
  eventsError = $state<string | null>(null);

  board = $derived(app.board);
  /** byDay is always the last seven UTC days, whatever the window. */
  days = $derived(zeroFill(this.usage?.byDay ?? [], last7Days(Date.now())));
  maxDay = $derived(Math.max(0, ...this.days.map((d) => d.costUsd)));
  spend = $derived(this.usage?.totalCostUsd ?? 0);
  budgetUsd = $derived(this.board?.usage.budgetUsd ?? null);
  overBudget = $derived(this.board?.usage.overBudget ?? false);

  async load(boardId: string, win: SpendWindow): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = true;
    this.usageError = null;
    const usage = getUsage(boardId, win);
    const totals = Promise.allSettled(app.boards.map((b) => getUsage(b.id, win).then((u) => ({ id: b.id, name: b.name, costUsd: u.totalCostUsd }))));
    const events = getBoardEvents(boardId, 60);
    app.markBusy(Promise.allSettled([usage, totals, events]));
    try { this.usage = await usage; } catch (e) { this.usage = null; this.usageError = message(e); } finally { this.loading = false; }
    this.boardTotals = (await totals).flatMap((r) => (r.status === 'fulfilled' ? [r.value] : [])).sort((a, b) => b.costUsd - a.costUsd);
    try { this.events = await events; this.eventsError = null; } catch (e) { this.events = []; this.eventsError = message(e); }
  }

  cardTitle(id: string): string | null { return this.board?.cards.find((c) => c.id === id)?.title ?? null; }
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/budget-caps.svelte.ts
import { setBudget } from '$lib/api';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { CAP_HINT_INVALID, capsStatus, parseCap } from './spend-format';

const asField = (n: number | null | undefined) => (n == null ? '' : n.toFixed(2));

export class BudgetCapsModel {
  boardCap = $state(asField(app.board?.usage.budgetUsd));
  cardCap = $state(asField(app.board?.usage.cardUsdCap));
  boardError = $state<string | null>(null);
  cardError = $state<string | null>(null);
  error = $state<string | null>(null);
  busy = $state(false);
  savedFlash = $state(false);

  status = $derived(this.savedFlash ? 'Caps saved' : capsStatus(app.board?.usage.budgetUsd ?? null, app.board?.usage.cardUsdCap ?? null));

  async save(): Promise<void> {
    const b = parseCap(this.boardCap);
    const c = parseCap(this.cardCap);
    this.boardError = b === 'invalid' ? CAP_HINT_INVALID : null;
    this.cardError = c === 'invalid' ? CAP_HINT_INVALID : null;
    if (b === 'invalid' || c === 'invalid' || !app.boardId) return;
    this.busy = true;
    this.error = null;
    try {
      const res = await setBudget(app.boardId, { boardUsdCap: b, cardUsdCap: c });
      if (!res.ok) { this.error = `Could not save the caps (${res.status}). Nothing changed.`; return; }
      this.savedFlash = true;
      setTimeout(() => (this.savedFlash = false), 4000);
      await app.refresh();
    } finally { this.busy = false; }
  }
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/operate/BoardLog.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { eventLabel, logMeta, rawLine, shortId, shortTitle } from './spend-format';
  import type { BoardLogProps } from './spend-types';

  let { events, error, collapsedRows, fullLogHref }: BoardLogProps = $props();
  let all = $state(false);
  let copied = $state<string | null>(null);
  const list = $derived(events ?? []);
  const shown = $derived(all ? list : list.slice(0, collapsedRows));
  const title = (id: string) => app.board?.cards.find((c) => c.id === id)?.title ?? null;
  async function copyId(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(id);
    copied = id;
    setTimeout(() => (copied = copied === id ? null : copied), 2000);
  }
</script>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="log-h">
  <div class="panel-head">
    <h2 class="t-h2" id="log-h">Board log</h2>
    {#if events !== null && list.length > 0}<span class="t-meta">{logMeta(list.length)}</span>{/if}
    {#if fullLogHref}<a class="vk-button vk-button--secondary btn-sm" href={fullLogHref} style="margin-left: auto; text-decoration: none;">Open the full board log <PageIcon name="chev-right" size={16} /></a>{/if}
  </div>
  {#if error}
    <div class="panel-body"><p class="t-body">Couldn't load the board log</p><p class="t-meta">{error}</p></div>
  {:else if events === null}
    <p class="panel-body t-meta" role="status">Loading the board log…</p>
  {:else if list.length === 0}
    <p class="panel-body t-meta">Nothing has happened on this board yet.</p>
  {:else}
    <ol class="log">
      {#each shown as e (e.seq)}
        {@const cardId = typeof e.payload.cardId === 'string' ? e.payload.cardId : null}
        <li class="lrow">
          <span class="time">{e.ts.slice(11, 19)}</span>
          <span class="t-body" style="font-size: 0.9375rem;">{eventLabel(e, app.board?.stages ?? [])}</span>
          {#if cardId}
            {@const t = title(cardId)}
            <span style="display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; min-width: 0px;">
              {#if t}<a class="t-meta" href="/b/{app.boardId}/c/{cardId}" title={t} style="overflow-wrap: anywhere;">{shortTitle(t)}</a>{/if}
              <button class="idchip" aria-label="Copy card id {shortId(cardId)}" type="button" onclick={() => void copyId(cardId)}>{copied === cardId ? 'Copied' : `#${shortId(cardId)}`}</button>
            </span>
          {:else}<span></span>{/if}
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ol>
    <span class="sr" aria-live="polite">{copied ? 'Card id copied' : ''}</span>
    <div class="panel-body" style="border-top: 1px solid var(--vk-color-line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--vk-space-2);">
      {#if list.length > collapsedRows}
        <button class="vk-button vk-button--quiet btn-sm" type="button" style="align-self: flex-start;" onclick={() => (all = !all)}>{all ? `Show the latest ${collapsedRows}` : `Show all ${list.length} events`}</button>
      {/if}
      <details>
        <summary class="t-meta" style="min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;"><span class="disc-ico"><PageIcon name="chev-down" size={16} /></span><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Show raw event names</span></summary>
        <ol class="log">{#each list as e (e.seq)}<li class="lrow"><span class="time">{e.ts.slice(11, 19)}</span><span class="raw">{rawLine(e)}</span></li>{/each}</ol>
      </details>
    </div>
  {/if}
</section>
```

```svelte
  <form class="sp-cap" aria-label="Budget caps" aria-busy={model.busy} onsubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void model.save(); }}>
    <div class="ar-field"><label for="cap-b{suffix}">Board cap</label><div class="sp-money"><span aria-hidden="true">$</span><input class="ar-in" id="cap-b{suffix}" type="text" placeholder="none" inputmode="decimal" bind:value={model.boardCap} /></div>{#if model.boardError}<p class="ar-hint" role="alert">{model.boardError}</p>{/if}</div>
    <div class="ar-field"><label for="cap-c{suffix}">Card cap</label><div class="sp-money"><span aria-hidden="true">$</span><input class="ar-in" id="cap-c{suffix}" type="text" placeholder="none" inputmode="decimal" bind:value={model.cardCap} /></div>{#if model.cardError}<p class="ar-hint" role="alert">{model.cardError}</p>{/if}</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="ar-btn" type="submit" disabled={model.busy}>{model.busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Save caps'}</button></div>
  </form>
  {#if model.error}<p class="ar-hint" role="alert">{model.error}</p>{/if}
  <p class="sp-note">The card cap draws the cost bar on each card. A card over its cap shows in Needs you. The same caps are editable from Operate → Spend.</p>
</section>
```
