```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { eventLabel, logMeta, rawLine, shortId, shortTitle } from './spend-format';
  import type { BoardLogProps } from './spend-types';

  let { events, error, collapsedRows, fullLogHref, no = '09' }: BoardLogProps & { no?: string } = $props();
  let all = $state(false);
  let copied = $state<string | null>(null);
  const list = $derived(events ?? []);
  const shown = $derived(all ? list : list.slice(0, collapsedRows));
  const title = (id: string) => app.board?.cards.find((c) => c.id === id)?.title ?? null;
  async function copyId(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(id);
    copied = id;
    setTimeout(() => (copied = copied === id ? null : copied), 2000);
  }
</script>

<section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="log-h">
  <div class="hd">
    <span class="no">{no}</span><h2 id="log-h">Board log</h2>
    <span class="r">{#if list.length > 0}{logMeta(list.length)}{' '}{/if}{#if fullLogHref}<a class="ar-btn2" href={fullLogHref}>Open the full board log <PageIcon name="arrow-right" size={14} stroke={1.75} /></a>{/if}</span>
  </div>
  {#if error}
    <p class="sp-empty"><span class="serif">Couldn't load the board log</span><span class="ar-hint">{error}</span></p>
  {:else if events === null}
    <p class="ar-hint" role="status">Loading the board log…</p>
  {:else if list.length === 0}
    <p class="sp-empty"><span class="serif">Nothing has happened on this board yet.</span></p>
  {:else}
    <table class="ar-tbl sp-log">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Time</th><th scope="col">Event</th><th scope="col">Card</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {#each shown as e (e.seq)}
          {@const cardId = typeof e.payload.cardId === 'string' ? e.payload.cardId : null}
          {@const t = cardId ? title(cardId) : null}
          <tr>
            <td class="m">{e.ts.slice(11, 19)}</td>
            <td>{eventLabel(e, app.board?.stages ?? [])}</td>
            <td><span class="sp-card">{#if cardId}{#if t}<a class="ttl sp-lt" href="/b/{app.boardId}/c/{cardId}" title={t}>{shortTitle(t)}</a>{/if}<button class="sp-id" aria-label="Copy card id {shortId(cardId)}" type="button" onclick={() => void copyId(cardId)}>{copied === cardId ? 'Copied' : `#${shortId(cardId)}`}</button>{/if}</span></td>
          </tr>
        {/each}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <span class="sr" aria-live="polite">{copied ? 'Card id copied' : ''}</span>
    <div class="sp-more">
      {#if list.length > collapsedRows}<button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => (all = !all)}>{all ? `Show the latest ${collapsedRows}` : `Show all ${list.length} events`}</button>{/if}
      <details>
        <summary class="ar-lk quiet"><span class="disc-ico"><PageIcon name="chev-down" size={16} /></span>Show raw event names</summary>
        <ol class="sp-raw">{#each list as e (e.seq)}<li><span class="m">{e.ts.slice(11, 19)}</span><span class="raw">{rawLine(e)}</span></li>{/each}</ol>
      </details>
    </div>
  {/if}
</section>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import './spend-studio.css';
  import PageIcon from '$lib/components/parts/PageIcon.svelte';
  import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import BoardLogStudio from './BoardLogStudio.svelte';
  import BudgetCapsStudio from './BudgetCapsStudio.svelte';
  import { avgPerCard, barHeightStudio, budgetLine, busiestIndex, busiestLine, cardsWithSpend, chartLabel, compactCount, dayLabel, dayRange, pctOf, tokenPair, usd } from './spend-format';
  import { TelemetryModel } from './telemetry-model.svelte';
  import type { SpendLayoutProps } from './spend-types';

  let props: SpendLayoutProps = $props();
  const model = new TelemetryModel();
  $effect(() => { if (app.boardId) void model.load(app.boardId, model.window_); });
  const u = $derived(model.usage);
  const budget = $derived(budgetLine(model.spend, model.budgetUsd, model.overBudget));
  const fill = $derived(model.budgetUsd ? Math.min(100, pctOf(model.spend, model.budgetUsd)) : 0);
  const peak = $derived(busiestIndex(model.days));
  const maxOf = (xs: number[]) => Math.max(0.000001, ...xs);
  function setCap(e: MouseEvent): void { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('cap-b1')?.focus(); }
  const windowWords = $derived(model.window_ === '7d' ? 'last 7 days' : 'last 5 hours');
</script>

{#snippet empty(title: string, body: string)}<p class="sp-empty"><span class="serif">{title}</span><span class="ar-hint">{body}</span></p>{/snippet}
{#snippet pending()}
  {#if model.usageError}<p class="sp-empty"><span class="serif">Couldn't load spend — {model.usageError}. <button class="ar-lk" type="button" onclick={() => app.boardId && void model.load(app.boardId, model.window_)}>Try again</button></span></p>
  {:else}<p class="ar-hint" role="status">Loading spend…</p>{/if}
{/snippet}
{#snippet rows(items: Array<{ key: string; label: string; href?: string; cost: number }>)}
  {@const max = maxOf(items.map((i) => i.cost))}
  <table class="ar-tbl sp-tbl"><tbody>
    {#each items as it (it.key)}
      <tr class={it.key === app.boardId ? 'here' : undefined}>
        <td class="ag">{#if it.href}<a class="ttl" href={it.href}>{it.label}</a>{:else}{it.label}{/if}</td>
        <td><span class="sp-rb"><i style="width: {pctOf(it.cost, max)}%;"></i></span></td>
        <td class="m r">{usd(it.cost)}</td>
      </tr>
    {/each}
  </tbody></table>
{/snippet}

<main class="sp-main" id="main">
  <div class="sp-line">
    <a class="ar-lk quiet" href="/b/{app.boardId}/operate"><PageIcon name="chev-left" size={16} />Back to Operate</a>
    <span class="kick">Operate · spend, in detail</span>
    <span class="sp-seg" role="group" aria-label="Time window">
      <button aria-pressed={model.window_ === '7d'} type="button" onclick={() => (model.window_ = '7d')}>Last 7 days</button>
      <button aria-pressed={model.window_ === '5h'} type="button" onclick={() => (model.window_ = '5h')}>Last 5 hours</button>
    </span>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-hero sp-hero">
    <span class="big ink{model.spend === 0 ? ' z' : ''}"><span class="sr">Spend vs budget:</span>{u ? usd(model.spend) : '—'}</span>
    <div class="txt">
      <h1>Agent spend</h1>
      <p>{model.board?.name ?? ''} · what agents cost, by day, agent, board, model and card.</p>
      <div class="sp-budget">
        <span class="kick">Spend vs budget</span>
        <span class="sp-rb lg" role="img" aria-label="{fill}% of budget used"><i style="width: {fill}%;{model.overBudget ? ' background: var(--vk-color-signal);' : ''}"></i></span>
        <span class="ar-hint">{budget.text}{#if budget.setCap}<a class="ar-lk" href="#caps1" style="min-height: 0px;" onclick={setCap}>Set a cap</a>{/if}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-f1">
    <div class="hd"><span class="no">01</span><h2 id="sp-f1">In figures</h2><span class="r">{windowWords}</span></div>
    <div class="ar-figs">
      <div><b class={!u || u.byCard.length === 0 ? 'z' : undefined}>{u ? avgPerCard(u.totalCostUsd, u.byCard.length) : '—'}</b><span>Average cost per card</span><span class="ar-hint">{u ? cardsWithSpend(u.byCard.length) : 'Loading spend…'}</span></div>
      <div><b class={!u || u.totalInputTokens + u.totalOutputTokens === 0 ? 'z' : undefined}>{u ? compactCount(u.totalInputTokens + u.totalOutputTokens) : '—'}</b><span>Tokens</span><span class="ar-hint">{u ? tokenPair(u.totalInputTokens, u.totalOutputTokens) : 'Loading spend…'}</span></div>
      <div><b class={!u || u.unpricedRecords === 0 ? 'z' : undefined}>{u ? String(u.unpricedRecords) : '—'}</b><span>Unpriced records</span><span class="ar-hint">Usage records without cost data</span></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="day-h1">
    <div class="hd"><span class="no">02</span><h2 id="day-h1">Spend by day</h2><span class="r">{dayRange(model.days.map((d) => d.day))} · {u ? busiestLine(model.days) : 'Loading spend…'}</span></div>
    <ol class="sp-days" role="img" aria-label={chartLabel(model.days)}>
      {#each model.days as d, i (d.day)}
        <li class={i === peak ? 'pk' : undefined}><span class={d.costUsd === 0 ? 'amt z' : 'amt'}>{usd(d.costUsd)}</span><span class="col"><i style="height: {barHeightStudio(d.costUsd, model.maxDay)}px;"></i></span><span class="day">{dayLabel(d.day)}</span></li>
      {/each}
    </ol>
  </section>

  <div class="sp-grid">
    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-ag1">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">03</span><h2 id="sp-ag1">By agent</h2></div>
      {#if !u}{@render pending()}{:else if u.byAgent.length === 0}{@render empty('No agent cost data yet.', 'Agents on this board have not reported cost in this window. When they do, each shows with its face, a bar and its total.')}
      {:else}{@render rows(u.byAgent.map((a) => ({ key: a.agentId, label: displayAgent(a.agentId, app.agents), cost: a.costUsd })))}{/if}
    </section>
    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-bo1">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">04</span><h2 id="sp-bo1">By board</h2><span class="r">all your boards</span></div>
      {#if !u || model.boardTotals === null}{@render pending()}{:else if model.boardTotals.every((b) => b.costUsd === 0)}{@render empty('No board recorded spend.', 'Your boards side by side, this one highlighted, once any of them records cost.')}
      {:else}{@render rows(model.boardTotals.map((b) => ({ key: b.id, label: b.name, cost: b.costUsd })))}{/if}
    </section>
    <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-mo1">
      <div class="hd"><span class="no">05</span><h2 id="sp-mo1">By model</h2></div>
      {#if !u}{@render pending()}{:else if u.byModel.length === 0}{@render empty('No model cost data yet.', 'Each model the agents used, with its total.')}
      {:else}{@render rows(u.byModel.map((m) => ({ key: m.model, label: m.model, cost: m.costUsd })))}{/if}
    </section>
    <div class="sp-wide">
      <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-ca1">
        <div class="hd"><span class="no">06</span><h2 id="sp-ca1">Top spenders · by card</h2></div>
        {#if !u}{@render pending()}{:else if u.byCard.length === 0}{@render empty('No card cost data yet.', 'The eight cards that cost the most, linked to the card.')}
        {:else}{@render rows([...u.byCard].sort((a, b) => b.costUsd - a.costUsd).slice(0, 8).map((c) => ({ key: c.cardId, label: model.cardTitle(c.cardId) ?? c.cardId, href: `/b/${app.boardId}/c/${c.cardId}`, cost: c.costUsd })))}{/if}
      </section>
    </div>
    <div class="sp-side">
      <BudgetCapsStudio suffix="1" no="07" />
      <section class="ar-sec" aria-labelledby="sp-next">
        <div class="hd"><span class="no">08</span><h2 id="sp-next">Coming next</h2></div>
        <p class="sp-note">Success rate, time in stage, throughput and gate rejections arrive with telemetry aggregation (tier 2).</p>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>

  <BoardLogStudio events={model.events} error={model.eventsError} collapsedRows={8} fullLogHref="/b/{app.boardId}/operate/log" />
</main>
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/routes/b/[boardId]/operate/log/+page.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** The whole board log (up to 500 events), opened from Spend. */
  import { page } from '$app/state';
  import { getBoardEvents, type BoardEvent } from '$lib/api';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { BOARD_LOG_LAYOUTS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import AppShell from '$lib/components/shell/AppShell.svelte';
  import { pageStatus, syncedLabel } from '$lib/components/shell/page-status';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';

  const boardId = $derived(page.params.boardId ?? '');
  let events = $state<BoardEvent[] | null>(null);
  let error = $state<string | null>(null);
  $effect(() => {
    const req = getBoardEvents(boardId, 500);
    app.markBusy(req);
    req.then((e) => { events = e; error = null; }).catch((e: unknown) => { events = []; error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); });
  });
  const vibe = $derived(appearance.value.vibe);
  const Layout = $derived(BOARD_LOG_LAYOUTS[vibe]);
  const status = $derived(pageStatus(['Board log'], app.board ? app.needsYou().length : 0, syncedLabel(app.syncedAt)));
</script>

<AppShell here="operate" section="spend" boardName={app.board?.name ?? null} view={null} showing={null} {status}>
  <Layout {vibe} {boardId} {events} {error} />
</AppShell>
```

```ts
  totalCostUsd: 14.2, estimatedCostUsd: 0, totalInputTokens: 1_600_000, totalOutputTokens: 300_000, unpricedRecords: 2,
  byModel: [{ model: 'gpt-5-codex', costUsd: 10.9, inputTokens: 1_300_000, outputTokens: 240_000 }, { model: 'kimi-k2', costUsd: 3.3, inputTokens: 300_000, outputTokens: 60_000 }],
  byAgent: [{ agentId: 'agt_fx_coder_kai', costUsd: 6.1 }, { agentId: 'agt_fx_tester_tim', costUsd: 4.05 }, { agentId: 'agt_fx_optimizer_ollie', costUsd: 2.4 }, { agentId: 'agt_fx_error_eric', costUsd: 1.65 }],
  byCard: [{ cardId: 'card_9ac2116a050858f8', costUsd: 6.35 }, { cardId: 'card_e10fb4fe39a91dfc', costUsd: 4.9 }, { cardId: 'card_691a65ff9894f83f', costUsd: 1.8 }, { cardId: 'card_ace250c9c25363ac', costUsd: 1.15 }],
  byDay: [
    { day: '2026-10-05', costUsd: 1.2 }, { day: '2026-10-06', costUsd: 3.4 }, { day: '2026-10-07', costUsd: 0.8 }, { day: '2026-10-08', costUsd: 2.9 },
    { day: '2026-10-09', costUsd: 4.1 }, { day: '2026-10-10', costUsd: 1.0 }, { day: '2026-10-11', costUsd: 0.8 },
  ],
};

test('with spend, the detail view adds it up against the cap', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const boardId = await seedBoard(request, 'Spend E2E');
  expect((await request.put(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/budget`, { headers: TENANT, data: { boardUsdCap: 25, cardUsdCap: null } })).ok()).toBe(true);
  await setAppearance(page, 'daylight.light.strong.0');
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date('2026-10-11T08:21:00Z'));
  await page.route('**/v1/boards/*/usage*', (route) => route.fulfill({ json: route.request().url().includes(`/boards/${boardId}/`) ? WITH_SPEND : ZERO }));
  await page.goto(`/b/${boardId}/operate/telemetry`);

  const tiles = page.locator('.tile');
  await expect(tiles.nth(0).locator('.big')).toHaveText('$14.20');
  await expect(tiles.nth(0)).toContainText('of a $25.00 board cap · 57% used');
  await expect(tiles.nth(1).locator('.big')).toHaveText('$3.55');
  await expect(tiles.nth(1)).toContainText('4 cards with spend in this window');
  await expect(tiles.nth(2).locator('.big')).toHaveText('1.9M');
  await expect(tiles.nth(2)).toContainText('1.6M in · 0.3M out');
  await expect(tiles.nth(3).locator('.big')).toHaveText('2');
  await expect(page.getByText('Busiest: Fri 9 · $4.10')).toBeVisible();
  expect(await page.locator('.chart .b').evaluateAll((bs) => bs.map((b) => (b as HTMLElement).style.height))).toEqual(['50px', '141px', '33px', '120px', '170px', '41px', '33px']);
  await expect(page.locator('#caps1')).toContainText('Board $25.00 · card none');
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Spend by model')).toContainText('gpt-5-codex');
});
```

### Task 37: New card composer and Move dialog, on a shared dialog frame

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

This lands the dialog groundwork that Tasks 38–40 reuse, and two dialogs on it. The groundwork is `DialogFrame`, the REF-markup `Segmented`, `Icon`, the hand-written layer CSS, and a root-scoped mode for `extract-css.mjs`. The two dialogs are the new card composer (`SP-Dlg-NewCard-{Daylight,Paper,Studio,Quiet}`) and the Move dialog (`SP-Dlg-Move-*`). Both turn green in light and dark. Rulings applied:
- D-1 out of scope: the composer has no draft button, no "drafted" note and no brief tag. The NewCard `refPatch` deletes `.nc-draftrow` and `.nc-brief-tag` from the reference. The follow-up note `docs/follow-ups/agent-drafted-new-card.md` records what drafting needs.
- `createCard` takes `stageKey`/`labelIds`/`projectId` (Task 10).
- The LabelPicker's Escape stops propagation, so the harness's final Escape closes only the picker.
- Dialogs are compared by `parts` = `section.dlg`, and the harness blurs after the steps.
- The Move owner face uses the reference's mood rule. The moved card's last agent shows its mood, and every other sole owner shows `resting`.

**How the reference CSS is ported for every dialog (Tasks 37–40).** In each dialog reference, all rules sit under `:where(.fg)`. Every vibe file also carries the mockup's own vibe-neutral `vk-button`/`vk-segmented`/`vk-field` rules, and these differ from vibekit 0.1.0's per-vibe forms. So each dialog's four vibe files are extracted separately. Each file is re-rooted under `.fg[data-dlg="<id>"][data-vibe="<vibe>"]`, with those vk rules scoped under the same root. The app's dialog layer is a real `div.fg` that carries `data-dlg`, `data-vibe`, `data-theme` (and `data-accent` for Appearance). Two consequences:
- The reference CSS applies verbatim, one vibe at a time, including per-vibe positions such as `.bs` left/top and the toast top.
- Every rule gains the same `(0,2,0)`, so the reference's internal cascade is unchanged and the ported rules beat vibekit 0.1.0's global component rules inside dialogs only.

The artboard's absolute `left/top` is undone by one hand-written layer delta (`dialog-layer.css`, spec dialogs.md §0.3).

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/who-picks-up.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { AGENTS, DX_STAGES } from '../../../../e2e/pixel/fixture/dialog-cases';
import { dispatchFoot, joinCaps, ownerLine, ownerShort, pickupSentence, soleAgent } from './who-picks-up';

const at = (key: string) => DX_STAGES.find((s) => s.key === key)!;
const KEYS = ['reported', 'reproduce', 'test', 'fix', 'integrate', 'signed-off', 'shipped'];

describe('who picks a stage up', () => {
  it('names the owner briefly, as the stage picker options print it', () => {
    expect(DX_STAGES.map((s) => `${s.name} · ${ownerShort(s, AGENTS)}`)).toEqual([
      'Reported · a person', 'Reproduce · error-eric', 'Failing test · tester-tim', 'Fix · 2 agents',
      'Integrate · 3 agents', 'Signed off · approval gate', 'Shipped · a person',
    ]);
  });
  it('names the owner in full, as the Move rows print it', () => {
    expect(KEYS.map((k) => ownerLine(at(k), AGENTS))).toEqual([
      'a person', 'diagnostics · error-eric', 'testing · tester-tim', 'code · 2 agents',
      'integration or api or testing · 3 agents', 'a person · approval', 'a person',
    ]);
    expect(ownerLine({ key: 'x', name: 'X', order: 9, ownerKind: 'capability', owner: 'nobody-has-this' }, AGENTS)).toBe('nobody-has-this · no agent yet');
  });
  it('says what happens after a move, one sentence per kind of stage', () => {
    expect(KEYS.map((k) => pickupSentence(at(k), DX_STAGES, AGENTS))).toEqual([
      'A person picks it up here; no agent works this stage.',
      'error-eric picks it up.',
      'tester-tim picks it up.',
      'One of the 2 agents with code picks it up.',
      'One of the 3 agents with integration, api or testing picks it up.',
      'It waits here for a person to approve before it can ship.',
      'It lands with the finished work.',
    ]);
    expect(pickupSentence({ key: 'x', name: 'X', order: 3, ownerKind: 'capability', owner: 'nobody-has-this' }, DX_STAGES, AGENTS))
      .toBe('No agent declares nobody-has-this yet, so it waits here.');
  });
  it('writes the composer foot, with the stage name separable for <strong>', () => {
    const text = (k: string) => { const f = dispatchFoot(at(k), 'Developer Experience', AGENTS); return f.before + f.stage + f.after; };
    expect(text('reported')).toBe('Goes to Reported on Developer Experience, where a person picks it up.');
    expect(text('reproduce')).toBe('Goes to Reproduce on Developer Experience, where error-eric picks it up.');
    expect(text('fix')).toBe('Goes to Fix on Developer Experience, where one of the 2 agents with code picks it up.');
    expect(text('signed-off')).toBe('Goes to Signed off on Developer Experience, where a person approves it.');
    expect(dispatchFoot(at('reported'), 'Developer Experience', AGENTS)).toEqual({ before: 'Goes to ', stage: 'Reported', after: ' on Developer Experience, where a person picks it up.' });
  });
  it('finds the one agent that alone works a stage', () => {
    expect(soleAgent(at('reproduce'), AGENTS)?.name).toBe('error-eric');
    expect(soleAgent(at('fix'), AGENTS)).toBeNull();
    expect(soleAgent(at('reported'), AGENTS)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('joins capabilities the way a sentence does', () => {
    expect(joinCaps(['integration', 'api', 'testing'], 'any')).toBe('integration, api or testing');
    expect(joinCaps(['code', 'review'], 'all')).toBe('code and review');
    expect(joinCaps(['code'], 'any')).toBe('code');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/move-model.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { AGENTS, DX_STAGES } from '../../../../e2e/pixel/fixture/dialog-cases';
import { dirLabel, initialPick, moveNowLead, moveThen, ownerFace, primaryLabel, stageCountText } from './move-model';

describe('move dialog model', () => {
  it('starts on the next stage, or the previous one at the end', () => {
    expect(initialPick(DX_STAGES, 'test')).toBe('fix');
    expect(initialPick(DX_STAGES, 'shipped')).toBe('signed-off');
  });
  it('counts each stage as the rows print it', () => {
    expect([[1, 0], [1, 0], [3, 2], [1, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0], [1, 0]].map(([c, b]) => stageCountText(c!, b!)))
      .toEqual(['1 card', '1 card', '3 cards · 2 blocked', '1 card', 'Empty', 'Empty', '1 card']);
  });
  it('labels direction from where the card is now', () => {
    expect([0, 1, 2, 3, 6].map((i) => dirLabel(i, 2))).toEqual(['back', 'back', '', 'forward', 'forward']);
  });
  it('says what the card is doing now', () => {
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'stopped', ageHours: 33.4, agentName: 'tester-tim' })).toBe('tester-tim stopped 33h ago');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'stopped', ageHours: 66, agentName: 'error-eric' })).toBe('error-eric stopped 2d ago');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'working', ageHours: 1, agentName: 'coder-kai' })).toBe('coder-kai is working');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'question', ageHours: 1, agentName: 'research-ray' })).toBe('research-ray asked a question');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'review', ageHours: 1, agentName: null })).toBe('waiting for your review');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'done', ageHours: 1, agentName: null })).toBe('Done');
    expect(moveNowLead({ kind: 'idle', ageHours: null, agentName: null })).toBe('Queued');
  });
  it('says what happens in the picked stage, and names the button after it', () => {
    expect(moveThen(DX_STAGES.find((s) => s.key === 'fix')!, DX_STAGES, AGENTS)).toBe('In Fix: One of the 2 agents with code picks it up.');
    expect(primaryLabel('Fix', false)).toBe('Move to Fix');
    expect(primaryLabel('Fix', true)).toBe('Moving…');
  });
  it('draws a sole owner’s face, in the moved card’s mood only when it is that card’s agent', () => {
    const moved = { agentId: 'agt_fx_tester_tim', mood: 'needs' as const };
    expect(ownerFace(DX_STAGES[1]!, AGENTS, moved)).toEqual({ id: 'agt_fx_error_eric', name: 'error-eric', mood: 'resting' });
    expect(ownerFace(DX_STAGES[2]!, AGENTS, moved)).toEqual({ id: 'agt_fx_tester_tim', name: 'tester-tim', mood: 'needs' });
    expect(ownerFace(DX_STAGES[3]!, AGENTS, moved)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/DialogFrame.svelte.test.ts
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import { createRawSnippet, tick } from 'svelte';
import DialogFrame from './DialogFrame.svelte';

const body = createRawSnippet(() => ({ render: () => '<div><button id="one">One</button><button id="two">Two</button></div>' }));

describe('DialogFrame', () => {
  let root: HTMLElement;
  beforeEach(() => { root = document.createElement('div'); root.className = 'app-root'; root.innerHTML = '<button id="opener">Open</button>'; document.body.append(root); });
  afterEach(() => { cleanup(); root.remove(); });

  it('is a labelled modal that makes the app inert, and focuses the first control', async () => {
    render(DialogFrame, { open: true, dlg: 'mv', label: 'Move card', width: 640, top: 36, onClose: vi.fn(), children: body });
    await tick(); await tick();
    const d = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Move card' });
    expect(d.getAttribute('aria-modal')).toBe('true');
    expect(d.className).toBe('dlg mv');
    expect(d.closest('.fg')?.getAttribute('data-dlg')).toBe('mv');
    expect(root.hasAttribute('inert')).toBe(true);
    expect(document.activeElement?.id).toBe('one');
  });
  it('closes on Escape without letting the key reach the page, and on the scrim', async () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn(); const page = vi.fn();
    window.addEventListener('keydown', page);
    render(DialogFrame, { open: true, dlg: 'mv', label: 'Move card', width: 640, top: 36, onClose, children: body });
    await tick();
    await fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'One' }), { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(page).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await fireEvent.click(document.querySelector('.scrim')!);
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', page);
  });
  it('without onClose, Escape and the scrim do nothing (Reconnect)', async () => {
    render(DialogFrame, { open: true, dlg: 'rc', role: 'alertdialog', label: 'Sign in again', width: 540, top: 190, children: body });
    await tick();
    await fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'One' }), { key: 'Escape' });
    await fireEvent.click(document.querySelector('.scrim')!);
    expect(screen.getByRole('alertdialog')).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('traps Tab, and gives focus back to the opener on close', async () => {
    const opener = document.getElementById('opener')!; opener.focus();
    const r = render(DialogFrame, { open: true, dlg: 'mv', label: 'Move card', width: 640, top: 36, onClose: vi.fn(), children: body });
    await tick(); await tick();
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Two' }).focus();
    await fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'Tab' });
    expect(document.activeElement?.id).toBe('one');
    await r.rerender({ open: false });
    await tick();
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(opener);
    expect(root.hasAttribute('inert')).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// apps/web/scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs — port a reference's CSS verbatim.
//   By class prefix:  extract-css.mjs SP-Board-Daylight --prefix dy-,vk-sky [--out file]
//   By root (dialogs): extract-css.mjs SP-Dlg-Move-Paper --root ':where(.fg)' --as '.fg[data-dlg="mv"][data-vibe="paper"]'
//                      [--with vk-button,vk-field] [--out file]
//   --root keeps every rule whose selector contains the root text and --as rewrites that text;
//   --with also keeps the reference's own (mockup vk.css) rules for those class prefixes, each selector
//   scoped under --as, so they win over vibekit's global component rules inside that root only.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const [artboard, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (k) => { const i = rest.indexOf(k); return i > -1 ? rest[i + 1] : undefined; };
const list = (k) => (arg(k) ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const prefixes = list('--prefix');
const root = arg('--root');
const as = arg('--as');
const withs = list('--with');
const usage = 'usage: extract-css.mjs <Artboard> (--prefix a-,b- | --root <text> [--as <selector>] [--with vk-a,vk-b]) [--out file]';
if (!artboard || (prefixes.length === 0 && !root)) { console.error(usage); process.exit(2); }
if (withs.length && (!root || !as)) { console.error('--with needs --root and --as'); process.exit(2); }
const html = readFileSync(join(here, '../../e2e/reference/mockups', `${artboard}.html`), 'utf8');
const css = [...html.matchAll(/<style[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/g)].map((m) => m[1]).join('\n');

/** Split top-level CSS into [prelude, body] blocks, keeping @media/@supports/@container groups. */
function blocks(src) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, start = 0, open = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const c = src[i];
    if (c === '/' && src[i + 1] === '*') { const e = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2); i = e < 0 ? src.length : e + 1; continue; }
    if (c === '{') { if (depth === 0) open = i; depth++; }
    else if (c === '}') { depth--; if (depth === 0) { out.push([src.slice(start, open).trim(), src.slice(open + 1, i)]); start = i + 1; } }
  }
  return out;
}
/** A selector list split on its top-level commas (not those inside :is(), [attr] or :where()). */
function parts(sel) {
  const out = []; let depth = 0, cur = '';
  for (const ch of sel) {
    if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
    else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
    if (ch === ',' && depth === 0) { out.push(cur.trim()); cur = ''; } else cur += ch;
  }
  if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur.trim());
  return out;
}
const mentions = (sel, ps) => ps.some((p) => new RegExp(`\\.${p.replace(/[-]/g, '\\-')}`).test(sel));

/** The selector to write for a rule, or null to drop it. */
function select(sel) {
  if (/\.sc-/.test(sel)) return null;
  if (root) {
    if (sel.includes(root)) return as ? sel.split(root).join(as) : sel;
    if (withs.length && !sel.includes(':where(.backdrop)') && mentions(sel, withs)) return parts(sel).map((s) => `${as} ${s}`).join(', ');
    return null;
  }
  return mentions(sel, prefixes) ? sel : null;
}

const kept = [];
const frames = [];
for (const [prelude, body] of blocks(css)) {
  if (/^@(media|supports|container)/.test(prelude)) {
    const inner = blocks(body).map(([s, b]) => [select(s), b]).filter(([s]) => s).map(([s, b]) => `  ${s} {${b}}`);
    if (inner.length) kept.push(`${prelude} {\n${inner.join('\n')}\n}`);
  } else if (/^@keyframes/.test(prelude)) {
    frames.push([prelude, body]);
  } else {
    const s = select(prelude);
    if (s) kept.push(`${s} {${body}}`);
  }
}
// A keyframes block is global, so it comes along only when a kept rule animates with it (or, in
// prefix mode, when its own name carries a prefix, as before).
const animated = new Set([...kept.join('\n').matchAll(/animation(?:-name)?\s*:\s*([^;}]+)/g)].flatMap((m) => m[1].split(/[\s,]+/)));
for (const [prelude, body] of frames) {
  const name = prelude.replace(/^@keyframes\s+/, '').trim();
  if (animated.has(name) || (!root && prefixes.some((p) => prelude.includes(p)))) kept.push(`${prelude} {${body}}`);
}
const what = root ? `root ${root}${as ? ` as ${as}` : ''}${withs.length ? `, with ${withs.join(', ')}` : ''}` : `prefixes ${prefixes.join(', ')}`;
const text = `/* Ported verbatim from e2e/reference/mockups/${artboard}.html (${what}) by scripts/pixel/extract-css.mjs. */\n${kept.join('\n')}\n`;
const out = arg('--out');
if (out) writeFileSync(out, text); else process.stdout.write(text);
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/who-picks-up.ts
/**
 * Who picks a card up in a stage, as the new-card composer and the Move dialog say it. Built on
 * `stageOwner()`: it reports who DECLARES a capability, never who can claim it.
 */
import type { AgentSummary, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { stageOwner } from '$lib/components/board/stage-owner';

function requirement(stage: Stage): { caps: string[]; mode: 'all' | 'any' } {
  if (stage.requires?.all?.length) return { caps: stage.requires.all, mode: 'all' };
  if (stage.requires?.any?.length) return { caps: stage.requires.any, mode: 'any' };
  return { caps: stage.owner ? [stage.owner] : [], mode: 'any' };
}

/** "integration, api or testing" (any) · "code and review" (all). */
export function joinCaps(caps: string[], mode: 'all' | 'any'): string {
  if (caps.length <= 1) return caps.join('');
  return `${caps.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}${mode === 'all' ? ' and ' : ' or '}${caps[caps.length - 1]}`;
}

/** The one agent that alone works this stage: a stage pinned to an agent, or a capability one agent declares. */
export function soleAgent(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): AgentSummary | null {
  if (stage.ownerKind === 'agent') return agents.find((a) => a.id === stage.owner) ?? null;
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind !== 'capability' || o.declaredBy.length !== 1) return null;
  return agents.find((a) => a.name === o.declaredBy[0]) ?? null;
}

/** The stage picker's option suffix: "a person", "approval gate", "error-eric", "2 agents". */
export function ownerShort(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind === 'human') return stage.gate === 'approval' ? 'approval gate' : 'a person';
  if (o.kind === 'agent') return o.label;
  const n = o.declaredBy.length;
  return n === 0 ? 'no agent yet' : n === 1 ? o.declaredBy[0]! : `${n} agents`;
}

/** The Move row's owner line: "diagnostics · error-eric", "code · 2 agents", "a person · approval". */
export function ownerLine(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind !== 'capability') return o.label;
  const n = o.declaredBy.length;
  return `${o.label} · ${n === 0 ? 'no agent yet' : n === 1 ? o.declaredBy[0] : `${n} agents`}`;
}

/** What happens to a card that lands here (D-13). */
export function pickupSentence(stage: Stage, stages: Stage[], agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  if (o.kind === 'human') {
    if (stage.gate === 'approval') return 'It waits here for a person to approve before it can ship.';
    const last = [...stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order).at(-1);
    return last?.key === stage.key ? 'It lands with the finished work.' : 'A person picks it up here; no agent works this stage.';
  }
  if (o.kind === 'agent') return `${o.label} picks it up.`;
  const n = o.declaredBy.length;
  if (n === 0) return `No agent declares ${o.label} yet, so it waits here.`;
  if (n === 1) return `${o.declaredBy[0]} picks it up.`;
  const r = requirement(stage);
  return `One of the ${n} agents with ${joinCaps(r.caps, r.mode)} picks it up.`;
}

/** The composer foot, split so the stage name can be <strong>. */
export function dispatchFoot(stage: Stage, boardName: string, agents: AgentSummary[]): { before: string; stage: string; after: string } {
  const o = stageOwner(stage, agents);
  let where: string;
  if (o.kind === 'human') where = stage.gate === 'approval' ? 'a person approves it.' : 'a person picks it up.';
  else if (o.kind === 'agent') where = `${o.label} picks it up.`;
  else if (o.declaredBy.length === 0) where = `it waits: no agent declares ${o.label} yet.`;
  else if (o.declaredBy.length === 1) where = `${o.declaredBy[0]} picks it up.`;
  else { const r = requirement(stage); where = `one of the ${o.declaredBy.length} agents with ${joinCaps(r.caps, r.mode)} picks it up.`; }
  return { before: 'Goes to ', stage: stage.name, after: ` on ${boardName}, where ${where}` };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/move-model.ts
import type { Mood } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { AgentSummary, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import { ageLabel } from '$lib/age';
import { pickupSentence, soleAgent } from './who-picks-up';

/** The next stage, or the previous one when the card is in the last. */
export function initialPick(stages: Stage[], hereKey: string): string | null {
  const ordered = [...stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  const i = ordered.findIndex((s) => s.key === hereKey);
  return ordered[i + 1]?.key ?? ordered[i - 1]?.key ?? null;
}

export function stageCountText(count: number, blocked: number): string {
  return (count === 0 ? 'Empty' : `${count} card${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`) + (blocked > 0 ? ` · ${blocked} blocked` : '');
}

export function dirLabel(i: number, here: number): 'back' | 'forward' | '' {
  return i < here ? 'back' : i > here ? 'forward' : '';
}

/** "tester-tim stopped 33h ago": what the card is doing now (ages follow F §A.2 through ageLabel). */
export function moveNowLead(x: { kind: string; ageHours: number | null; agentName: string | null }): string {
  const who = x.agentName ?? 'The agent';
  switch (x.kind) {
    case 'stopped': return `${who} stopped ${ageLabel(x.ageHours) ?? 'a while'} ago`;
    case 'working': return `${who} is working`;
    case 'question': return `${who} asked a question`;
    case 'review': return 'waiting for your review';
    case 'done': return 'Done';
    default: return 'Queued';
  }
}

export function moveThen(pick: Stage, stages: Stage[], agents: AgentSummary[]): string {
  return `In ${pick.name}: ${pickupSentence(pick, stages, agents)}`;
}

export function primaryLabel(pickName: string, pending: boolean): string {
  return pending ? 'Moving…' : `Move to ${pickName}`;
}

/** A 20px face beside a stage owned by one agent: the moved card's mood when it is that card's agent, else resting. */
export function ownerFace(stage: Stage, agents: AgentSummary[], moved: { agentId: string | null; mood: Mood }): { id: string; name: string; mood: Mood } | null {
  const a = soleAgent(stage, agents);
  return a ? { id: a.id, name: a.name, mood: a.id === moved.agentId ? moved.mood : 'resting' } : null;
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/Segmented.svelte -->
<script lang="ts" generics="T extends string">
  /**
   * The reference's segmented control, as markup: a radiogroup of role=radio buttons with one tab
   * stop (roving tabindex). The dialog references draw this form in every vibe, so dialogs use it
   * rather than vibekit's <Segmented>, whose Paper/Studio/Quiet forms the references do not show.
   */
  let { label, options, value, onchange }: { label: string; options: ReadonlyArray<{ value: T; label: string }>; value: T; onchange: (v: T) => void } = $props();
  let group = $state<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  function key(e: KeyboardEvent, i: number): void {
    const d = e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0;
    if (d === 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const j = (i + d + options.length) % options.length;
    onchange(options[j]!.value);
    queueMicrotask(() => group?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="radio"]')[j]?.focus());
  }
</script>

<div class="vk-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label={label} bind:this={group}>
  {#each options as o, i (o.value)}
    <button class="vk-segmented__item" type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={o.value === value} data-state={o.value === value ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
      tabindex={o.value === value ? 0 : -1} onclick={() => onchange(o.value)} onkeydown={(e) => key(e, i)}>{o.label}</button>
  {/each}
</div>
```

```css
/* apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/dialog-layer.css
 * Hand-written (dialogs.md §0.3, §0.4). The artboards place each dialog absolutely on a 1440-wide
 * canvas (`left` = (1440 − width) / 2). The app instead centres it in a fixed layer whose top
 * padding is the artboard's `top`, which reproduces the artboard exactly at 1440 wide. The
 * !important overrides the ported `.fg[…] .nc { left; top }` rules, which carry the re-root's
 * extra specificity. The Board switcher keeps an absolute box, measured from its trigger. */
.fg.sp-dlg-layer { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: var(--dlg-top) 16px 16px; overflow-y: auto; }
.fg.sp-dlg-layer > .scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
.fg.sp-dlg-layer > .dlg { position: relative !important; left: auto !important; top: auto !important; width: min(var(--dlg-w), 100%) !important; flex: none; }
.fg.sp-dlg-layer > .dlg.bs { position: absolute !important; left: var(--bs-left, 16px) !important; top: var(--bs-top, 16px) !important; }
@media (max-height: 899px) { .fg.sp-dlg-layer:not([data-dlg="bs"]) { padding-top: 16px; } }
@media (max-width: 599.98px) {
  .fg.sp-dlg-layer:not([data-dlg="rc"]) { align-items: flex-end; padding: 0; }
  .fg.sp-dlg-layer:not([data-dlg="rc"]) > .dlg { width: 100% !important; max-height: 100dvh; overflow-y: auto; border-radius: var(--vk-radius-lg) var(--vk-radius-lg) 0 0 !important; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); }
  .fg.sp-dlg-layer[data-vibe="studio"]:not([data-dlg="rc"]) > .dlg { border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0 !important; }
  .fg.sp-dlg-layer > .dlg.bs { position: relative !important; left: auto !important; top: auto !important; }
  .fg.sp-dlg-layer > .bs-anchor { display: none; }
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/DialogFrame.svelte -->
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** Open frames, so the app root stays inert until the last one closes. */
  let openFrames = 0;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The frame every dialog uses: the reference's `.fg` layer (scrim + `section.dlg`), carrying
   * data-dlg/data-vibe/data-theme so each dialog's ported, re-rooted CSS applies as drawn.
   * aria-modal, Tab trapped, `.app-root` inert while open, focus back to the opener on close.
   * Escape and the scrim close only when `onClose` is given (Reconnect gives none).
   */
  import { tick, type Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { resolveAccent } from '$lib/accent';
  import './dialog-layer.css';

  let {
    open, dlg, role = 'dialog', labelledby, describedby, label, width, top,
    onClose, onkeydown, initialFocus, accent = false, z = 50, box = null, before, children,
  }: {
    open: boolean;
    dlg: 'nc' | 'pal' | 'ap' | 'mv' | 'bs' | 'rc';
    role?: 'dialog' | 'alertdialog';
    labelledby?: string;
    describedby?: string;
    label?: string;
    width: number;
    top: number;
    onClose?: () => void;
    onkeydown?: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void;
    initialFocus?: string;
    accent?: boolean;
    z?: number;
    box?: { left: number; top: number } | null;
    before?: Snippet;
    children: Snippet;
  } = $props();

  let panel = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),summary,[tabindex]';

  /** The Tab order: a native radio group is one stop (its checked member, else its first). */
  function tabStops(): HTMLElement[] {
    if (!panel) return [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const out: HTMLElement[] = [];
    for (const el of panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)) {
      if (el.tabIndex < 0) continue;
      if (el instanceof HTMLInputElement && el.type === 'radio') {
        if (seen.has(el.name)) continue;
        seen.add(el.name);
        out.push(panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`input[type="radio"][name="${el.name}"]:checked:not([disabled])`) ?? el);
      } else out.push(el);
    }
    return out;
  }

  $effect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const opener = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    openFrames += 1;
    document.querySelector('.app-root')?.setAttribute('inert', '');
    void tick().then(() => {
      const first = (initialFocus ? panel?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(initialFocus) : null) ?? tabStops()[0] ?? panel;
      first?.focus();
    });
    return () => {
      openFrames -= 1;
      if (openFrames === 0) document.querySelector('.app-root')?.removeAttribute('inert');
      if (opener && document.contains(opener)) opener.focus();
    };
  });

  function keydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    onkeydown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      // Stopped even without onClose: Escape behind a dialog must not also close the card drawer.
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      onClose?.();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const f = tabStops();
    if (f.length === 0) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    const first = f[0]!, last = f[f.length - 1]!;
    const here = document.activeElement;
    if (e.shiftKey && (here === first || here === panel)) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && here === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }
</script>

{#if open}
  <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_static_element_interactions -->
  <div class="fg sp-dlg-layer" class:acc={accent} data-dlg={dlg} data-vibe={appearance.value.vibe} data-theme={appearance.theme}
    data-accent={accent ? resolveAccent(appearance.accent) : undefined}
    style:--dlg-top="{top}px" style:--dlg-w="{width}px" style:z-index={z} onkeydown={keydown}>
    <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_click_events_have_key_events, a11y_no_static_element_interactions -->
    <div class="scrim" aria-hidden="true" onclick={() => onClose?.()}></div>
    {@render before?.()}
    <section bind:this={panel} class="dlg {dlg}" {role} aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={labelledby} aria-describedby={describedby} aria-label={label} tabindex="-1"
      style:--bs-left={box ? `${box.left}px` : undefined} style:--bs-top={box ? `${box.top}px` : undefined}>
      {@render children()}
    </section>
  </div>
{/if}
```

In `apps/web/src/lib/stores/app.svelte.ts`, replace `requestCompose()` and `dispatchCard`. Do not add Move state: `app.moveCardId`, `app.openMoveDialog(cardId)` and `app.closeMoveDialog()` already exist from Task 31.

```ts
  /** The sentence the composer opens with (the palette's "Dispatch a card called …" passes one). */
  composeSentence = $state('');

  requestCompose(sentence = ''): void {
    this.composeSentence = sentence;
    this.composeRequest += 1;
  }

  /**
   * Queue a card, with everything the composer holds (Task 10's createCard fields). `boardId`
   * may name another board: the card goes there and this board does not navigate. True when the
   * card was created; on failure `error` says why and the composer stays open.
   */
  async dispatchCard(
    title: string,
    detail: { priority?: number; description?: string; due?: string; stageKey?: string; labelIds?: string[]; projectId?: string | null; boardId?: string | null } = {},
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const boardId = detail.boardId ?? this.boardId;
    if (!boardId || title.trim() === '') return false;
    try {
      await createCard(boardId, {
        title: title.trim(),
        priority: detail.priority,
        description: detail.description?.trim() ? detail.description.trim() : undefined,
        due: detail.due?.trim() ? detail.due.trim() : undefined,
        stageKey: detail.stageKey,
        labelIds: detail.labelIds?.length ? detail.labelIds : undefined,
        projectId: detail.projectId ?? undefined,
      });
      this.error = null;
      if (boardId === this.boardId) await this.refresh();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.error = String(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e);
      return false;
    }
  }
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/LabelPicker.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * "Add label": a plain listbox popover (D-21). It stays open while you pick several and closes
   * on Escape. That Escape stops here, so it never reaches the dialog and closes only the picker.
   */
  import { tick } from 'svelte';
  import type { Label } from '$lib/api';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';

  let { labels, chosen, onadd }: { labels: Label[]; chosen: string[]; onadd: (id: string) => void } = $props();
  let open = $state(false);
  let active = $state(0);
  let list = $state<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  let trigger = $state<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const options = $derived(labels.filter((l) => !chosen.includes(l.id)).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)));

  async function show(): Promise<void> {
    open = true;
    active = 0;
    await tick();
    list?.focus();
  }
  async function pick(id: string): Promise<void> {
    onadd(id);
    active = 0;
    await tick();
    list?.focus(); // the picked option is gone; keep focus (and Escape) inside the picker
  }
  function onkey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); open = false; trigger?.focus(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); active = Math.min(active + 1, options.length - 1); return; }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); active = Math.max(active - 1, 0); return; }
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && options[active]) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); void pick(options[active]!.id); }
  }
</script>

<button class="nc-addlabel" type="button" bind:this={trigger} aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded={open} onclick={() => void show()}><Icon name="plus" size={14} /> Add label</button>
{#if open}
  <div class="nc-picker" role="listbox" aria-label="Labels" tabindex="-1" bind:this={list} onkeydown={onkey}
    aria-activedescendant={options[active] ? `nc-lbl-${options[active]!.id}` : undefined}>
    {#each options as l, i (l.id)}
      <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_click_events_have_key_events -->
      <div id="nc-lbl-{l.id}" role="option" aria-selected={i === active} tabindex="-1" onclick={() => void pick(l.id)}>{l.name}</div>
    {:else}
      <p class="nc-picker__empty">No more labels.</p>
    {/each}
  </div>
{/if}
```

```svelte
  import { tick } from 'svelte';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';

  let { boardId, boardName, onpick }: { boardId: string | null; boardName: string; onpick: (id: string) => void } = $props();
  let open = $state(false);
  let list = $state<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  let trigger = $state<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  async function show(): Promise<void> {
    open = !open;
    await tick();
    list?.focus();
  }
  function choose(id: string): void {
    open = false;
    trigger?.focus();
    if (id !== boardId) onpick(id);
  }
  function onkey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); open = false; trigger?.focus(); }
  }
</script>

<button class="nc-board" type="button" bind:this={trigger} aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-label="Board: {boardName}. Change board" onclick={() => void show()}>on {boardName} <Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} /></button>
{#if open}
  <div class="nc-picker" role="listbox" aria-label="Boards" tabindex="-1" bind:this={list} onkeydown={onkey}>
    {#each app.boards as b (b.id)}
      <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_click_events_have_key_events -->
      <div role="option" aria-selected={b.id === boardId} tabindex="-1" onclick={() => choose(b.id)}>{b.name}</div>
    {/each}
  </div>
{/if}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/NewCardDialog.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The new card composer (SP-Dlg-NewCard). Title and brief are written by hand: agent drafting
   * (D-1) is a follow-up, so there is no draft button, no "drafted" note and no brief tag
   * (docs/follow-ups/agent-drafted-new-card.md). It opens on `app.requestCompose()`, from the N key,
   * the shell's New card button and the palette.
   */
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { getBoard, type Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import DialogFrame from './DialogFrame.svelte';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';
  import Segmented from './Segmented.svelte';
  import LabelPicker from './LabelPicker.svelte';
  import BoardPickButton from './BoardPickButton.svelte';
  import { MOD_KEY, NC_LEAD, PRIORITY_OPTIONS } from './dialog-copy';
  import { dispatchFoot, ownerShort } from './who-picks-up';
  import './css/nc.daylight.css';
  import './css/nc.paper.css';
  import './css/nc.studio.css';
  import './css/nc.quiet.css';
  import './pickers.css';

  let open = $state(false);
  let sentence = $state('');
  let title = $state('');
  let brief = $state('');
  let stageKey = $state('');
  let projectId = $state('');
  let due = $state('');
  let priority = $state('0');
  let labelIds = $state<string[]>([]);
  let saving = $state(false);
  let failed = $state(false);
  let boardId = $state<string | null>(null);
  let boardName = $state('');
  let stages = $state<Stage[]>([]);

  const byOrder = (a: Stage, b: Stage) => a.order - b.order;
  const labelById = $derived(new Map(app.labels.map((l) => [l.id, l])));
  const projects = $derived([...app.projects].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)));
  const stage = $derived(stages.find((s) => s.key === stageKey) ?? null);
  const foot = $derived(stage ? dispatchFoot(stage, boardName, app.agents) : null);

  let seen = app.composeRequest;
  $effect(() => {
    const n = app.composeRequest;
    if (n === seen) return;
    seen = n;
    untrack(() => openWith(app.composeSentence));
  });

  function openWith(s: string): void {
    if (!app.board || !app.boardId) return;
    sentence = s; title = ''; brief = ''; projectId = ''; due = ''; priority = '0'; labelIds = [];
    failed = false; saving = false;
    boardId = app.boardId;
    boardName = app.board.name ?? '';
    stages = [...app.board.stages].sort(byOrder);
    stageKey = stages[0]?.key ?? '';
    open = true;
  }
  function close(): void { open = false; }

  /** Changing the board reloads its stages and starts at its first; labels and project are kept. */
  async function pickBoard(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const b = await getBoard(id);
    boardId = id;
    boardName = b.name ?? '';
    stages = [...b.stages].sort(byOrder);
    stageKey = stages[0]?.key ?? '';
  }

  async function dispatch(): Promise<void> {
    if (title.trim() === '' || saving) return;
    saving = true;
    failed = false;
    const ok = await app.dispatchCard(title.trim(), {
      priority: Number(priority), description: brief, due, stageKey, labelIds: [...labelIds], projectId: projectId || null, boardId,
    });
    saving = false;
    if (ok) close(); else failed = true;
  }
  function onkey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); void dispatch(); }
  }
</script>

<DialogFrame {open} dlg="nc" labelledby="nc-title" width={800} top={44} onClose={close} onkeydown={onkey} initialFocus="#nc-sentence">

      </div>
      <div class="nc-col">
        <div class="vk-field">
          <label class="vk-field__label" for="nc-s">Starts in stage</label>
          <div class="nc-selwrap"><select class="vk-field__input nc-select" id="nc-s" bind:value={stageKey}>{#each stages as s (s.key)}<option value={s.key}>{s.name} · {ownerShort(s, app.agents)}</option>{/each}</select><Icon name="chevronDown" size={16} /></div>

          </div>
          <div class="vk-field">
            <label class="vk-field__label" for="nc-d">Due <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label>
            <div class="nc-due"><input class="vk-field__input" id="nc-d" type="date" bind:value={due} />{#if due !== ''}<button class="link small" type="button" onclick={() => (due = '')}>Clear</button>{/if}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <fieldset class="vk-field" style="border: 0px; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">
          <legend class="vk-field__label" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Priority</legend>

        </fieldset>
        <div class="vk-field">
          <span class="vk-field__label" id="nc-l">Labels</span>
          <div class="nc-labels" role="group" aria-labelledby="nc-l">
            {#each labelIds as id (id)}
              {@const l = labelById.get(id)}
              <span class="nc-label">{l?.name ?? id}<button type="button" aria-label="Remove label {l?.name ?? id}" onclick={() => (labelIds = labelIds.filter((x) => x !== id))}><Icon name="close" size={14} /></button></span>
            {/each}
            <LabelPicker labels={app.labels} chosen={labelIds} onadd={(id) => (labelIds = [...labelIds, id])} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    {#if failed && app.error}<p role="alert" class="nc-where">{app.error}</p>{/if}
  </div>
  <div class="nc-foot">
    <div class="grow small muted" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><Icon name="board" size={16} style="flex: 0 0 auto;" /><span>{#if foot}{foot.before}<strong style="color: var(--vk-color-text);">{foot.stage}</strong>{foot.after}{/if}</span></div>
    <span class="small muted"><span class="kbd">{MOD_KEY}</span> <span class="kbd">↵</span> to dispatch</span>
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" onclick={close}>Cancel</button>
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--primary" type="button" disabled={saving || title.trim() === ''} onclick={() => void dispatch()}>{saving ? 'Dispatching…' : 'Dispatch'}</button>
  </div>
</DialogFrame>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  /** Move a card to another stage (SP-Dlg-Move). Opened by CardMoveMenu's ⇄ button and the M key. */
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { displayAgent } from '$lib/names';
  import { stageSummaries, summarize } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
  import DialogFrame from './DialogFrame.svelte';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';
  import { dirLabel, initialPick, moveNowLead, moveThen, ownerFace, primaryLabel, stageCountText } from './move-model';
  import { ownerLine } from './who-picks-up';
  import './css/mv.daylight.css';
  import './css/mv.paper.css';
  import './css/mv.studio.css';
  import './css/mv.quiet.css';

  let pick = $state<string | null>(null);
  let pending = $state(false);
  let refused = $state<string | null>(null);
  let announce = $state('');

  const card = $derived(app.moveCardId ? app.cardById(app.moveCardId) ?? null : null);
  const stages = $derived(app.board ? [...app.board.stages].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order) : []);
  const hereIndex = $derived(card ? stages.findIndex((s) => s.key === card.currentStageKey) : -1);
  const info = $derived(app.board ? stageSummaries(app.board, app.board.cards, app.agents) : []);
  const summary = $derived.by(() => {
    const b = app.board;
    if (!b || !card) return null;
    return summarize(b, [card], { agents: app.agents, members: app.members, labels: app.labelById(), nowMs: Date.now() })[0] ?? null;
  });
  const agentId = $derived(summary?.delegate?.id ?? card?.lastAgentId ?? null);
  const agentName = $derived(summary?.delegate?.name ?? (card?.lastAgentId ? displayAgent(card.lastAgentId, app.agents) : null));
  const picked = $derived(stages.find((s) => s.key === pick) ?? null);

  $effect(() => {
    const id = app.moveCardId;
    untrack(() => {
      refused = null;
      pending = false;
      const c = id ? app.cardById(id) : null;
      pick = c ? initialPick(stages, c.currentStageKey) : null;
    });
  });

  function close(): void { app.closeMoveDialog(); }
  async function move(): Promise<void> {
    if (!card || !picked || pending) return;
    pending = true;
    refused = null;
    await app.moveCard(card.id, picked.key);
    pending = false;
    if (app.error) { refused = app.error; return; }
    announce = `${card.title} moved to ${picked.name}`;
    close();
  }
</script>
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/new-card.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT, openBoard, seedBoard } from './support/seed';

test('the composer creates the card in the chosen stage, with labels and a project', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const tag = Date.now().toString(36);
  const boardId = await seedBoard(request, `Composer ${tag}`);
  const label = ((await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/labels`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name: `nc-${tag}`, colour: 'marigold' } })).json()) as { label: { id: string } }).label;
  const project = ((await (await request.post(`${API}/v1/projects`, { headers: TENANT, data: { name: `Composer project ${tag}` } })).json()) as { project: { id: string } }).project;

  await openBoard(page, boardId);
  await expect(page.getByText('Backlog', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('n');
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'What needs doing?' });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Card title' }).fill(`Composed ${tag}`);
  await dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Starts in stage' }).selectOption('ready');
  await dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Project (optional)' }).selectOption(project.id);
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add label' }).click();
  await dialog.getByRole('option', { name: `nc-${tag}` }).click();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible(); // Escape closed only the picker
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dispatch' }).click();
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();

  const snap = (await (await request.get(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}`, { headers: TENANT })).json()) as { cards: Array<{ title: string; currentStageKey: string; labels: string[]; projectId: string | null }> };
  const made = snap.cards.find((c) => c.title === `Composed ${tag}`)!;
  expect(made).toMatchObject({ currentStageKey: 'ready', projectId: project.id });
  expect(made.labels).toEqual([label.id]);
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/pixel/dialog-steps.ts — harness helpers shared by the SP-Dlg-* entries
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import type { Part } from './screens';

export const DX = '/b/brd_134a0ddb6d434478';
/** Dialogs compare the dialog element, not the page (plan ruling; DLG §0.5). */
export const DIALOG_PART: Part[] = [{ name: 'dialog', ref: 'section.dlg', app: 'section.dlg' }];
/** No reference draws a focus ring, so every dialog screen blurs after its steps. */
export const blurActive = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur());

const BRIEF = `Done looks like:
• The blocker is reproduced from a clean room and named in one sentence.
• A failing test lands first, with the red run attached as evidence.
• The fix turns that test green and changes nothing else.

Do not:
• Push to the Forge mirror or to GitHub without an approval.
• Close the card without the evidence link.`;

export async function fillNewCard(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.keyboard.press('n');
  const d = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'What needs doing?' });
  await d.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Describe it in a sentence' }).fill('Fix the highest-severity blocker found in the clean-room journey, with red-test evidence before any fix.');
  await d.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Card title' }).fill('Fix the highest-severity blocker found in the clean-room journey');
  await d.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Brief for the agent' }).fill(BRIEF);
  await d.getByLabel('Due (optional)').fill('2026-10-18');
  await d.getByRole('radio', { name: 'P1' }).click();
  for (const name of ['clean-room', 'evidence-required', 'superpipeline']) {
    await d.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add label' }).click();
    await d.getByRole('option', { name, exact: true }).click();
  }
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); // closes only the label picker
  await blurActive(page);
}

/** D-1 is out of scope: the reference's drafting row and brief tag are not in the app (plan ruling). */
export async function dropDraftRegion(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(() => { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.fg .nc-draftrow, .fg .nc-brief-tag')) el.remove(); });
}

export async function openMoveStep(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const btn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move AgentPod: connector interface/ }).first();
  await btn.hover();
  await btn.click();
  await page.getByRole('radio', { name: /^Fix/ }).check();
  await blurActive(page);
}
```

```markdown
# Follow-up: an agent drafts the new card (dialogs D-1)

The vibes sweep shipped the new card composer without drafting. The person writes the title and the
brief. The SP-Dlg-NewCard references draw the drafted state: a "Draft again" button and the note
"**super-chotu** drafted the title and brief from your sentence. Change anything.", plus a
"Drafted · not sent yet" tag on the brief. The pixel harness deletes `.nc-draftrow` and
`.nc-brief-tag` from those references until this lands. The composer's lead copy already promises
drafting ("An agent drafts the brief…"), so this is the gap between the copy and the product.

## What it needs

**API (apps/api)**
- `POST /v1/boards/:boardId/drafts` `{ sentence }` → `202 { draft: { id, status: 'drafting', drafter: { agentId, name } } }`.
  The drafter is the board's command agent: the agent holding the `command` capability that may
  dispatch on this board. If there is none, `409 { error: { code: 'NO_DRAFTER' } }`.
- `GET /v1/drafts/:id` → `{ draft: { id, status: 'drafting' | 'ready' | 'failed', sentence, title?, brief?, drafter } }`.
- `PUT /v1/drafts/:id` (agent-authenticated) `{ title, brief }` sets `status: 'ready'`. A draft is
  never a card. It is discarded on dispatch or after 24h.
- A board socket event `draft.ready` `{ draftId }` to the person who asked, so the composer updates
  without polling.

**MCP (agents)**
- Tool `draft_card` `{ draftId, title, brief }`, the drafter's write path. The drafter learns of a
  request through its normal dispatch, as a draft task. It must not create a card.

**Web (apps/web)**
- `api.ts`: `requestDraft(boardId, sentence)`, `getDraft(id)`.
- `NewCardDialog.svelte`: the `.nc-draftrow` button ("Draft brief", then "Draft again" once
  drafted), with the sparkle icon. States:
  - "Drafting…" (disabled);
  - `{drafter} is drafting…` with a 24px face, mood `thinking`;
  - drafted: face mood `done`, and `<strong>{drafter}</strong> drafted the title and brief from your sentence. Change anything.`;
  - failed: "No draft this time. Write the title and brief yourself, or try again.".
- `.nc-brief-tag` "Drafted · not sent yet", shown while the brief still equals the draft.
- Per-field dirty flags: a draft never overwrites a field the person has typed in.
- Remove `dropDraftRegion` from the SP-Dlg-NewCard screens and its mask reason `D-1` from `MASK_IDS`.
  The references then compare as exported.

**Tests**
- API: draft lifecycle, `NO_DRAFTER`, agent-only `PUT`, a draft never creates a card.
- Web: dirty flags, the four states' copy, and `draft.ready` arriving while the composer is closed.
```

### Task 38: Command palette and board switcher

**Model:** sonnet · **Review:** sonnet

This lands the command palette (`SP-Dlg-Palette-*`) and the anchored board switcher popover (`SP-Dlg-BoardSwitcher-*`), both green in light and dark. The palette indexes:
- Cards: current board, in urgency order, with `#` and the last 4 characters of the id (D-6).
- Boards: switcher order, using the `BoardSummary` counts from Task 10.
- Agents: at most 4, ranked (D-7).
- Actions and Account.

The switcher groups boards into "Needs you" and "Everything else, last used first". Its "last used" labels come from `lastActivityAt` read as calendar days in the viewer's time zone. It opens anchored under the shell's trigger, with a raised copy of that trigger above the scrim, exactly as the reference draws it.

Rulings applied:
- **Agents ranking (O-11)**, checked against the reference. The coordinator's literal rule took sole owners from every board in switcher order. That puts Agent Onboarding's onboarding-olivia and artistic-lyra (sole owners of `drafted`/`portrait`) before Production Releases, which does not match the drawn rows. The rule used here, which reproduces the reference, ranks match tiers name-starts > name-contains > capability-contains > group-only. Within a tier, in this order:
  1. agents that alone own a stage on the current board, in stage order;
  2. agents that alone own a stage on a board with no cards yet, those boards in switcher order. An empty board's stages are the only place its crew shows.
  3. the rest, by name.

  For DX with q=`agent` this gives error-eric, tester-tim, devops-dave, vulnerability-victor.
- **Reference correction**: the switcher's ink outline (`.bs-del`) moves from "Rename" to "Delete board…" in all four references, logged in `CORRECTIONS.md`. The app puts the outline on the destructive control.
- **Comparison parts**: `section.dlg` plus `.bs-trigger` for the switcher, then blur.

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/relative-day.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { relativeDay } from './relative-day';

const NOW = new Date('2026-10-11T08:21:00Z');
const day = (iso: string | null) => relativeDay(iso, NOW, 'Asia/Kolkata');

describe('relativeDay', () => {
  it('counts calendar days in the viewer’s time zone', () => {
    expect(day('2026-10-11T07:18:00Z')).toBe('Today');
    expect(day('2026-10-11T01:00:00Z')).toBe('Today');
    expect(day('2026-10-10T06:00:00Z')).toBe('Yesterday');
    expect(day('2026-10-08T06:00:00Z')).toBe('3 days ago');
    expect(day('2026-10-07T06:00:00Z')).toBe('4 days ago');
    expect(day('2026-10-03T06:00:00Z')).toBe('Last week');
    expect(day('2026-10-02T06:00:00Z')).toBe('Last week');
    expect(day('2026-09-26T06:00:00Z')).toBe('2 weeks ago');
    expect(day('2026-09-19T06:00:00Z')).toBe('3 weeks ago');
    expect(day('2026-09-01T06:00:00Z')).toBe('Last month');
    expect(day('2026-07-01T06:00:00Z')).toBe('3 months ago');
    expect(day(null)).toBe('');
  });
  it('a time late on the previous UTC day can still be today in Kolkata', () => {
    expect(relativeDay('2026-10-10T19:00:00Z', NOW, 'Asia/Kolkata')).toBe('Today'); // 00:30 IST on the 11th
    expect(relativeDay('2026-10-10T19:00:00Z', NOW, 'UTC')).toBe('Yesterday');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/palette-index.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { AGENTS, BOARDS, DX_STAGES, PR_STAGES } from '../../../../e2e/pixel/fixture/dialog-cases';
import { switcherOrder } from './switcher-model';
import { buildPaletteIndex, filterPalette, groupCount, paletteCount, soleOwnerOrder, splitMark, type PaletteCtx } from './palette-index';

const DX = 'brd_134a0ddb6d434478';
const summary = (id: string, title: string, stageName: string, o: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  ({ id, title, stageName, lead: { kind: 'idle' }, ageHours: null, blocked: null, urgency: 'queued', ...o }) as never;
/** DX in groupByUrgency order (needs first, then queued, done). */
const CARDS = [
  summary('card_fx_dx_63ac', 'Fix the highest-severity blocker found in the clean-room journey', 'Reported', { urgency: 'needs' }),
  summary('card_9ac2116a050858f8', 'AgentPod: connector interface and generic effects ledger, state machine and executor', 'Failing test', { urgency: 'needs', lead: { kind: 'stopped' }, ageHours: 33.2 }),
  summary('card_fx_dx_1dfc', 'Superpipeline: manual-delivery completion and approval-subject hardening', 'Fix', { urgency: 'needs', lead: { kind: 'stopped' }, ageHours: 33.2 }),
  summary('card_05823a57e8224605', 'Diagnose Melissa and Anna Supermessage silence — trace actual failing hop', 'Reproduce', { urgency: 'needs', lead: { kind: 'stopped' }, ageHours: 62.4 }),
  summary('card_fx_dx_f83f', 'Integrate editorial workflows and prove no-write publishing acceptance', 'Failing test', { blocked: { kind: 'enforced' } }),
  summary('card_fx_dx_481f', 'agentpod-connectors: X connector (connector x)', 'Failing test', { blocked: { kind: 'enforced' } }),
  summary('card_fx_dx_9ed9', 'Build immutable approval subjects and digest-bound gates', 'Shipped', { urgency: 'done' }),
];
const ctx: PaletteCtx = {
  board: { id: DX, name: 'Developer Experience' }, cards: CARDS, boards: switcherOrder(BOARDS, DX), currentBoardId: DX,
  agents: AGENTS, theme: 'light', personName: 'Rakesh Gangwar',
};
const sole = soleOwnerOrder([{ stages: DX_STAGES }, { stages: PR_STAGES }], AGENTS);

describe('palette index', () => {
  it('ranks agents that alone own a stage: this board first, then the empty boards', () => {
    expect(sole.map((id) => AGENTS.find((a) => a.id === id)!.name)).toEqual(['error-eric', 'tester-tim', 'devops-dave', 'vulnerability-victor']);
  });
  it('“agent” matches exactly the reference’s eight rows', () => {
    const r = filterPalette(buildPaletteIndex(ctx), 'agent', sole);
    expect(r.total).toBe(8);
    expect(paletteCount(r.total, 'agent', 'Developer Experience')).toBe('8 matches for “agent”');
    expect(r.groups.map((g) => [g.group, groupCount(g.items.length)])).toEqual([
      ['Cards', '2 results'], ['Boards', '1 result'], ['Agents', '4 results'], ['Actions', '1 result'],
    ]);
    expect(r.groups[0]!.items.map((i) => [i.sub, i.meta, i.needs])).toEqual([
      ['Developer Experience · Failing test · stopped 33h', '#58f8', true],
      ['Developer Experience · Failing test · Blocked', '#481f', false],
    ]);
    expect(r.groups[1]!.items.map((i) => [i.label, i.sub])).toEqual([['Agent Onboarding', '20 cards']]);
    expect(r.groups[2]!.items.map((i) => [i.label, i.sub])).toEqual([
      ['error-eric', 'diagnostics'], ['tester-tim', 'testing'], ['devops-dave', 'release'], ['vulnerability-victor', 'security-review'],
    ]);
    expect(r.groups[3]!.items.map((i) => [i.label, i.sub, i.verb])).toEqual([['Workspace', 'agents, capabilities, labels and people', 'Go']]);
    expect(r.flat[0]!.verb).toBe('Open card');
  });
  it('writes card and board subs as the reference does', () => {
    const items = buildPaletteIndex(ctx);
    expect(items.find((i) => i.meta === '#4605')!.sub).toBe('Developer Experience · Reproduce · stopped 2d');
    expect(items.find((i) => i.meta === '#9ed9')!.sub).toBe('Developer Experience · Shipped · Done');
    const board = (name: string) => items.find((i) => i.group === 'Boards' && i.label === name)!.sub;
    expect(board('Developer Experience')).toBe('You are here · 7 cards · 4 need you');
    expect(board('Research & Intelligence')).toBe('1 card · 1 needs you');
    expect(board('Production Releases')).toBe('No cards yet');
  });
  it('offers the account commands, and the opposite theme', () => {
    const acc = buildPaletteIndex(ctx).filter((i) => i.group === 'Account');
    expect(acc.map((i) => [i.label, i.sub, i.verb])).toEqual([
      ['Appearance…', 'vibe, light or dark, time of day', 'Open'], ['Dark theme', 'theme', 'Switch'], ['Sign out', 'Rakesh Gangwar', 'Sign out'],
    ]);
    expect(buildPaletteIndex({ ...ctx, theme: 'dark' }).find((i) => i.group === 'Account' && i.verb === 'Switch')!.label).toBe('Light theme');
  });
  it('without a board it says so and drops the board-bound actions', () => {
    const items = buildPaletteIndex({ ...ctx, board: null, cards: [], currentBoardId: null });
    expect(items.filter((i) => i.group === 'Actions').map((i) => i.label)).toEqual(['Workspace']);
    expect(paletteCount(items.length, '', null)).toBe('Everything in your workspace: boards, agents and actions');
    expect(paletteCount(items.length, '  ', 'Developer Experience')).toBe('Everything on Developer Experience, plus boards, agents and actions');
    expect(paletteCount(1, 'x', null)).toBe('1 match for “x”');
  });
  it('marks the first hit in a label, and never an empty mark', () => {
    expect(splitMark('AgentPod: connector', 'agent')).toEqual({ pre: '', hit: 'Agent', post: 'Pod: connector' });
    expect(splitMark('agentpod-connectors', 'AGENT')).toEqual({ pre: '', hit: 'agent', post: 'pod-connectors' });
    expect(splitMark('error-eric', 'agent')).toEqual({ pre: 'error-eric', hit: '', post: '' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/CommandPalette.svelte.test.ts (replaces components/CommandPalette.svelte.test.ts)
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import { tick } from 'svelte';

vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ goto: vi.fn() }));
const logout = vi.fn(async () => {});
vi.mock('$lib/api', async (orig) => ({ ...(await orig<typeof import('$lib/api')>()), logout: () => logout(), getBoard: vi.fn(async () => ({ stages: [] })) }));

import CommandPalette from './CommandPalette.svelte';
import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';

async function openWith(q: string) {
  render(CommandPalette);
  app.cmdkOpen = true;
  await tick(); await tick();
  await fireEvent.input(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Search cards, boards, agents and actions' }), { target: { value: q } });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  logout.mockClear();
  appearance.set({ theme: 'dark' });
  app.cmdkOpen = false; app.board = null; app.boardId = null; app.boards = []; app.agents = []; app.members = [];
  app.markBusy = ((p: Promise<unknown>) => p) as never;
  Object.defineProperty(window, 'location', { value: { ...window.location, reload: vi.fn() }, writable: true });
});
afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('CommandPalette', () => {
  it('signs out', async () => {
    await openWith('sign out');
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('option', { name: /^Sign out/ }));
    expect(logout).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('switches to the light theme from dark, and closes', async () => {
    await openWith('theme');
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('option', { name: /^Light theme/ }));
    expect(appearance.theme).toBe('light');
    expect(app.cmdkOpen).toBe(false);
  });
  it('Escape clears the query first, then closes', async () => {
    await openWith('theme');
    const input = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Search cards, boards, agents and actions' }) as HTMLInputElement;
    await fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(input.value).toBe('');
    expect(app.cmdkOpen).toBe(true);
    await fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(app.cmdkOpen).toBe(false);
  });
  it('arrows move the selection and Enter runs it', async () => {
    await openWith('theme');
    const options = screen.getAllByRole('option');
    expect(options[0]!.getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('true');
    expect(options[0]!.textContent).toContain('↵ Switch');
    await fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Search/ }), { key: 'Enter' });
    expect(appearance.theme).toBe('light');
  });
  it('offers to dispatch what it could not find', async () => {
    const compose = vi.spyOn(app, 'requestCompose');
    await openWith('write the launch post');
    expect(screen.getByText('No matches for “write the launch post”.')).toBeTruthy();
    await fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dispatch a card called “write the launch post”' }));
    expect(compose).toHaveBeenCalledWith('write the launch post');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/person.ts
import type { Member, User } from '$lib/api';

/** The signed-in person's display name: the workspace member row, else the session's name, else the login (D-4). */
export function personName(user: User | null, members: Member[]): string {
  if (!user) return '';
  const m = members.find((x) => x.userId === user.userId);
  return m?.name?.trim() || user.name?.trim() || user.login || m?.email || '';
}
export const firstName = (name: string): string => name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? '';
export function initials(name: string): string {
  const w = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return ((w[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (w.length > 1 ? w[w.length - 1]![0] : '')).toUpperCase();
}
```
