```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/relative-day.ts
/** The calendar day of `d` in `timeZone`, as a UTC midnight timestamp. */
function dayIn(d: Date, timeZone: string): number {
  const [y, m, day] = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(d).split('-').map(Number);
  return Date.UTC(y!, m! - 1, day!);
}

/** "Today", "Yesterday", "3 days ago", "Last week", "2 weeks ago", "Last month", "3 months ago": calendar days in `timeZone`. */
export function relativeDay(iso: string | null, now: Date, timeZone: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const d = Math.round((dayIn(now, timeZone) - dayIn(new Date(iso), timeZone)) / 86_400_000);
  if (d <= 0) return 'Today';
  if (d === 1) return 'Yesterday';
  if (d < 7) return `${d} days ago`;
  if (d < 14) return 'Last week';
  if (d < 28) return `${Math.floor(d / 7)} weeks ago`;
  if (d < 60) return 'Last month';
  return `${Math.floor(d / 30)} months ago`;
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/switcher-model.ts
import type { BoardSummary } from '$lib/api';

export interface SwitcherGroup { label: string; right: string; boards: BoardSummary[] }

const recent = (a: BoardSummary, b: BoardSummary) => (b.lastActivityAt ?? '').localeCompare(a.lastActivityAt ?? '');

/** "Needs you" (this board first, then last used) and the rest by last use; a query filters names. */
export function groupBoards(boards: BoardSummary[], currentId: string | null, q: string): SwitcherGroup[] {
  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const shown = needle === '' ? boards : boards.filter((b) => b.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  const needs = shown.filter((b) => b.needsYouCount > 0).sort((a, b) => (a.id === currentId ? -1 : b.id === currentId ? 1 : recent(a, b)));
  const rest = shown.filter((b) => b.needsYouCount === 0).sort(recent);
  const sum = needs.reduce((n, b) => n + b.needsYouCount, 0);
  const out: SwitcherGroup[] = [];
  if (needs.length) out.push({ label: 'Needs you', right: `${sum} card${sum === 1 ? '' : 's'}`, boards: needs });
  if (rest.length) out.push({ label: needle === '' ? 'Everything else, last used first' : 'Other boards', right: `${rest.length} board${rest.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`, boards: rest });
  return out;
}

/** The one board order the switcher and the palette share (D-18). */
export const switcherOrder = (boards: BoardSummary[], currentId: string | null): BoardSummary[] => groupBoards(boards, currentId, '').flatMap((g) => g.boards);

export const boardCountText = (n: number): string => (n === 0 ? 'No cards yet' : `${n} card${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);
export const needsChip = (k: number): string => (k === 1 ? '1 needs you' : `${k} need you`);
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/palette-index.ts
import type { AgentSummary, BoardSummary, Stage } from '$lib/api';
import type { CardSummary } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
import type { IconName } from './icons';
import { ageLabel } from '$lib/age';
import { otherThemeLabel } from '$lib/components/shell/account';
import { boardCountText } from './switcher-model';
import { soleAgent } from './who-picks-up';

export type PaletteGroup = 'Cards' | 'Boards' | 'Agents' | 'Actions' | 'Account';
const GROUPS: PaletteGroup[] = ['Cards', 'Boards', 'Agents', 'Actions', 'Account'];
export type PaletteAct =
  | { kind: 'goto'; href: string } | { kind: 'compose'; sentence?: string } | { kind: 'appearance' } | { kind: 'theme' } | { kind: 'signout' };
export interface PaletteItem {
  id: string; group: PaletteGroup; label: string; sub: string; needs: boolean; meta: string;
  icon: IconName | { agentId: string; name: string }; verb: string; act: PaletteAct;
}
export interface PaletteCtx {
  board: { id: string; name: string } | null;
  /** The current board's cards, already in groupByUrgency order. */
  cards: Pick<CardSummary, 'id' | 'title' | 'stageName' | 'lead' | 'ageHours' | 'blocked' | 'urgency'>[];
  /** Boards in switcher order. */
  boards: BoardSummary[];
  currentBoardId: string | null;
  agents: AgentSummary[];
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
  personName: string;
}
export const AGENT_CAP = 4;

export function buildPaletteIndex(ctx: PaletteCtx): PaletteItem[] {
  const items: PaletteItem[] = [];
  const b = ctx.board;
  if (b) {
    for (const c of ctx.cards) {
      let sub = `${b.name} · ${c.stageName}`;
      if (c.lead.kind === 'stopped' && c.ageHours !== null) sub += ` · stopped ${ageLabel(c.ageHours)}`;
      if (c.blocked) sub += ' · Blocked';
      if (c.urgency === 'done') sub += ' · Done';
      items.push({ id: `card:${c.id}`, group: 'Cards', label: c.title, sub, needs: c.urgency === 'needs', meta: `#${c.id.slice(-4)}`, icon: 'card', verb: 'Open card', act: { kind: 'goto', href: `/b/${b.id}/c/${c.id}` } });
    }
  }
  for (const x of ctx.boards) {
    const here = x.id === ctx.currentBoardId;
    const sub = (here ? 'You are here · ' : '') + boardCountText(x.cardCount)
      + (x.needsYouCount > 0 ? ` · ${x.needsYouCount} need${x.needsYouCount === 1 ? 's' : ''} you` : '');
    items.push({ id: `board:${x.id}`, group: 'Boards', label: x.name, sub, needs: false, meta: '', icon: 'board', verb: 'Go to board', act: { kind: 'goto', href: `/b/${x.id}` } });
  }
  for (const a of ctx.agents) {
    items.push({ id: `agent:${a.id}`, group: 'Agents', label: a.name, sub: a.capabilities.length ? a.capabilities.join(', ') : 'no capabilities', needs: false, meta: '', icon: { agentId: a.id, name: a.name }, verb: 'Show agent', act: { kind: 'goto', href: '/workspace/agents' } });
  }
  const action = (id: string, label: string, sub: string, icon: IconName, verb: string, act: PaletteAct): PaletteItem => ({ id, group: 'Actions', label, sub, needs: false, meta: '', icon, verb, act });
  if (b) {
    items.push(
      action('act:dispatch', 'Dispatch a card', `new card on ${b.name}`, 'plus', 'Open composer', { kind: 'compose' }),
      action('act:operate', 'Operate', 'what needs you, what is running, what it cost', 'pulse', 'Go', { kind: 'goto', href: `/b/${b.id}/operate` }),
      action('act:spend', 'Spend detail', 'by model, by card, and the board log', 'coin', 'Go', { kind: 'goto', href: `/b/${b.id}/operate/telemetry` }),
      action('act:settings', 'Board settings', `stages, gates and schedules for ${b.name}`, 'settings', 'Go', { kind: 'goto', href: `/b/${b.id}/settings` }),
    );
  }
  items.push(action('act:workspace', 'Workspace', 'agents, capabilities, labels and people', 'people', 'Go', { kind: 'goto', href: '/workspace' }));
  items.push(
    { id: 'acct:appearance', group: 'Account', label: 'Appearance…', sub: 'vibe, light or dark, time of day', needs: false, meta: '', icon: 'swatch', verb: 'Open', act: { kind: 'appearance' } },
    { id: 'acct:theme', group: 'Account', label: otherThemeLabel(ctx.theme), sub: 'theme', needs: false, meta: '', icon: ctx.theme === 'dark' ? 'sun' : 'moon', verb: 'Switch', act: { kind: 'theme' } },
    { id: 'acct:signout', group: 'Account', label: 'Sign out', sub: ctx.personName, needs: false, meta: '', icon: 'power', verb: 'Sign out', act: { kind: 'signout' } },
  );
  return items;
}

/**
 * The agents a person is most likely looking for, in order: those that alone own a stage on the
 * current board (stage order), then those that alone own a stage on a board with no cards yet,
 * those boards in switcher order. Pass the boards in that order.
 */
export function soleOwnerOrder(boards: Array<{ stages: Stage[] }>, agents: AgentSummary[]): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const b of boards) {
    for (const s of [...b.stages].sort((x, y) => x.order - y.order)) {
      const a = soleAgent(s, agents);
      if (a && !out.includes(a.id)) out.push(a.id);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function agentTier(item: PaletteItem, q: string): number {
  const name = item.label.toLowerCase();
  if (q === '') return 3;
  if (name.startsWith(q)) return 0;
  if (name.includes(q)) return 1;
  if (item.sub.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return 2;
  return 3;
}

export function filterPalette(items: PaletteItem[], q: string, soleOrder: string[]): { groups: Array<{ group: PaletteGroup; items: PaletteItem[] }>; flat: PaletteItem[]; total: number } {
  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const hit = needle === '' ? items : items.filter((i) => `${i.label} ${i.group} ${i.sub}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  const rank = (i: PaletteItem) => { const k = soleOrder.indexOf(i.id.slice('agent:'.length)); return k < 0 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : k; };
  const groups = GROUPS.map((group) => {
    let list = hit.filter((i) => i.group === group);
    if (group === 'Agents') {
      list = [...list].sort((a, b) => agentTier(a, needle) - agentTier(b, needle) || rank(a) - rank(b) || a.label.localeCompare(b.label)).slice(0, AGENT_CAP);
    }
    return { group, items: list };
  }).filter((g) => g.items.length > 0);
  const flat = groups.flatMap((g) => g.items);
  return { groups, flat, total: flat.length };
}

export function paletteCount(n: number, q: string, boardName: string | null): string {
  if (q.trim() === '') return boardName ? `Everything on ${boardName}, plus boards, agents and actions` : 'Everything in your workspace: boards, agents and actions';
  return `${n} match${n === 1 ? '' : 'es'} for “${q.trim()}”`;
}
export const groupCount = (k: number): string => (k === 1 ? '1 result' : `${k} results`);

/** The first hit in a label, for <mark>; `hit` is '' when there is none, so no empty mark renders (D-9). */
export function splitMark(label: string, q: string): { pre: string; hit: string; post: string } {
  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const at = needle ? label.toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) : -1;
  if (at < 0) return { pre: label, hit: '', post: '' };
  return { pre: label.slice(0, at), hit: label.slice(at, at + needle.length), post: label.slice(at + needle.length) };
}
```

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/CommandPalette.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /** The command palette (SP-Dlg-Palette). ⌘K/Ctrl+K opens it (AppShell's binding) and closes it from inside. */
  import { tick, untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { Face } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { getBoard, type Stage } from '$lib/api';
  import { signOut } from '$lib/components/shell/account';
  import { groupByUrgency, summarize } from '$lib/components/board/card-summary';
  import DialogFrame from './DialogFrame.svelte';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';
  import { buildPaletteIndex, filterPalette, groupCount, paletteCount, soleOwnerOrder, splitMark, type PaletteItem } from './palette-index';
  import { switcherOrder } from './switcher-model';
  import { personName } from './person';
  import './css/pal.daylight.css';
  import './css/pal.paper.css';
  import './css/pal.studio.css';
  import './css/pal.quiet.css';

  let q = $state('');
  let sel = $state(0);
  let input = $state<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  let emptyBoardStages = $state<Array<{ stages: Stage[] }>>([]);

  const ordered = $derived(switcherOrder(app.boards, app.boardId));
  const cards = $derived.by(() => {
    const b = app.board;
    if (!b) return [];
    const live = b.cards.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt);
    return groupByUrgency(summarize(b, live, { agents: app.agents, members: app.members, labels: app.labelById(), nowMs: Date.now() })).flatMap((g) => g.cards);
  });
  const items = $derived(buildPaletteIndex({
    board: app.board && app.boardId ? { id: app.boardId, name: app.board.name ?? '' } : null,
    cards, boards: ordered, currentBoardId: app.boardId, agents: app.agents, theme: appearance.theme, personName: personName(app.user, app.members),
  }));
  const sole = $derived(soleOwnerOrder([...(app.board ? [{ stages: app.board.stages }] : []), ...emptyBoardStages], app.agents));
  const result = $derived(filterPalette(items, q, sole));

  $effect(() => {
    if (!app.cmdkOpen) return;
    untrack(() => { q = ''; sel = 0; void loadEmptyBoards(); });
  });

  /** The stages of boards with no cards yet: their sole owners rank next (see soleOwnerOrder). */
  async function loadEmptyBoards(): Promise<void> {
    const empty = ordered.filter((b) => b.cardCount === 0 && b.id !== app.boardId);
    const p = Promise.all(empty.map((b) => getBoard(b.id).then((s) => ({ stages: s.stages })).catch(() => ({ stages: [] as Stage[] }))));
    app.markBusy(p);
    emptyBoardStages = await p;
  }

  function close(): void { app.cmdkOpen = false; }
  function run(item: PaletteItem): void {
    close();
    const a = item.act;
    if (a.kind === 'goto') void goto(a.href);
    else if (a.kind === 'compose') app.requestCompose(a.sentence ?? '');
    else if (a.kind === 'appearance') appearance.pickerOpen = true;
    else if (a.kind === 'theme') appearance.toggleTheme();
    else void signOut();
  }
  function onkey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const n = result.flat.length;
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); if (q !== '') { q = ''; sel = 0; } else close(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (n === 0) return;
      sel = (sel + (e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + n) % n;
      void tick().then(() => document.getElementById(`pal-opt-${sel}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }));
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); const it = result.flat[sel]; if (it) run(it); }
  }
</script>

<DialogFrame open={app.cmdkOpen} dlg="pal" label="Command palette" width={700} top={84} onClose={close} onkeydown={onkey} initialFocus="#pal-q">
  <div class="pal-in">
    <Icon name="search" size={20} />
    <label class="vk-visually-hidden" for="pal-q">Search cards, boards, agents and actions</label>
    <input id="pal-q" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="pal-list" aria-autocomplete="list" autocomplete="off"
      aria-activedescendant={result.total ? `pal-opt-${sel}` : undefined} placeholder="Jump to a card, board, agent, or action…"
      bind:this={input} bind:value={q} oninput={() => (sel = 0)} />
    {#if q !== ''}<button class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Clear the search" onclick={() => { q = ''; sel = 0; input?.focus(); }}><Icon name="close" size={18} /></button>{/if}
    <span class="kbd">esc</span>
  </div>
  <div class="pal-count" role="status">{paletteCount(result.total, q, app.board?.name ?? null)}</div>
  {#if result.total === 0}
    <div class="pal-empty">
      <p>No matches for “{q.trim()}”.</p>
      <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" onclick={() => { close(); app.requestCompose(q.trim()); }}><Icon name="plus" size={16} /> Dispatch a card called “{q.trim()}”</button>
    </div>
  {:else}
    <div class="pal-list" id="pal-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Results">
      {#each result.groups as g (g.group)}
        <div role="group" aria-label={g.group}>
          <div class="pal-gh"><span>{g.group}</span><span>{groupCount(g.items.length)}</span></div>
          {#each g.items as it (it.id)}
            {@const i = result.flat.indexOf(it)}
            {@const m = splitMark(it.label, q)}
            <!-- svelte-ignore a11y_click_events_have_key_events -->
            <div class="pal-item" id="pal-opt-{i}" role="option" aria-selected={i === sel} data-selected={i === sel} tabindex="-1" onmouseenter={() => (sel = i)} onclick={() => run(it)}>
              {#if typeof it.icon === 'string'}
                <span class="pal-ic"><Icon name={it.icon} size={16} /></span>
              {:else}
                <span class="pal-ic pal-ic--face"><Face id={it.icon.agentId} label={it.icon.name} mood="resting" size={28} /></span>
              {/if}
              <span class="pal-text"><span class="pal-label">{m.pre}{#if m.hit}<mark>{m.hit}</mark>{/if}{m.post}</span><span class="pal-sub">{it.sub}</span></span>
              {#if it.needs}<span class="chip chip--needs">Waiting on you</span>{/if}
              <span class="pal-meta mono">{it.meta}</span>
              {#if i === sel}<span class="pal-enter">↵ {it.verb}</span>{/if}
            </div>
          {/each}
        </div>
      {/each}
    </div>
  {/if}
  <div class="pal-foot">
    <span><span class="kbd">↑</span><span class="kbd">↓</span> move</span>
    <span><span class="kbd">↵</span> open</span>
    <span><span class="kbd">esc</span> close</span>
    <span class="grow"></span>
    <span><span class="kbd">⌘</span><span class="kbd">K</span> opens this anywhere</span>
  </div>
</DialogFrame>
```

`.pal-meta` renders on every row, even when empty, because the reference's empty flex item adds a gap.

```svelte
<!-- apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/BoardSwitcherPopover.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  /**
   * The board switcher (SP-Dlg-BoardSwitcher): a popover anchored under the shell's board control,
   * with a raised copy of that control above the scrim. It does not close on focusout (an outside
   * click is the scrim). Below 600px it is a bottom sheet with no anchor.
   */
  import { tick, untrack } from 'svelte';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { app } from '$lib/stores/app.svelte';
  import { appearance } from '$lib/appearance.svelte';
  import { renameBoard } from '$lib/api';
  import { SWITCHER_TRIGGERS } from '$lib/layouts';
  import NewBoardDialog from '$lib/components/NewBoardDialog.svelte';
  import DialogFrame from './DialogFrame.svelte';
  import Icon from './Icon.svelte';
  import { boardCountText, groupBoards, needsChip } from './switcher-model';
  import { relativeDay } from './relative-day';
  import './css/bs.daylight.css';
  import './css/bs.paper.css';
  import './css/bs.studio.css';
  import './css/bs.quiet.css';

  const ZONE = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
  let q = $state('');
  let sel = $state(0);
  let renaming = $state(false);
  let draft = $state('');
  let creating = $state(false);
  let anchor = $state<{ left: number; top: number } | null>(null);
  let box = $state<{ left: number; top: number } | null>(null);
  let copy = $state<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const groups = $derived(groupBoards(app.boards, app.boardId, q));
  const flat = $derived(groups.flatMap((g) => g.boards));
  const name = $derived(app.board?.name ?? 'Board');
  const trigger = $derived(SWITCHER_TRIGGERS[appearance.value.vibe]);
  const TriggerCopy = $derived(trigger.component);

  $effect(() => {
    if (!app.boardSwitcherOpen) return;
    untrack(() => { q = ''; sel = 0; renaming = false; void place(); });
  });

  /** Anchor to the shell element marked data-bs-anchor; the box sits 8px under the raised copy. */
  async function place(): Promise<void> {
    anchor = null;
    box = null;
    if (typeof matchMedia === 'function' && matchMedia('(max-width: 599.98px)').matches) return;
    const el = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-bs-anchor]');
    if (!el) return;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    anchor = { left: Math.round(r.left), top: Math.round(r.top) };
    await tick();
    const c = copy?.getBoundingClientRect() ?? r;
    box = { left: anchor.left, top: Math.round(c.bottom) + 8 };
  }

  function close(): void { app.boardSwitcherOpen = false; }
  function open(id: string): void {
    close();
    if (id !== app.boardId) void goto(`/b/${id}`);
  }
  function onkey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (renaming) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const n = flat.length;
      if (n) sel = (sel + (e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + n) % n;
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.id === 'bs-q') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const b = flat[sel];
      if (b) open(b.id);
    }
  }
  function startRename(): void { draft = app.board?.name ?? ''; renaming = true; void tick().then(() => document.getElementById('bs-rename')?.focus()); }
  async function saveRename(): Promise<void> {
    const next = draft.trim();
    if (!app.boardId || next === '' || next === app.board?.name) { renaming = false; return; }
    await renameBoard(app.boardId, next);
    await app.refresh();
    await app.loadBoards();
    renaming = false;
  }
  function renameKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); void saveRename(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); renaming = false; }
  }
  async function onDelete(): Promise<void> {
    const id = app.boardId;
    if (!id) return;
    const count = app.board?.cards.length ?? 0;
    const cards = count > 0 ? ` and its ${count} card${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : '';
    if (!confirm(`Delete "${app.board?.name}"${cards}? Its cards, runs and history go with it. This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    close();
    await app.deleteBoard(id);
    await goto('/');
  }
</script>

<DialogFrame open={app.boardSwitcherOpen} dlg="bs" label="Switch board" width={520} top={16} onClose={close} onkeydown={onkey} initialFocus="#bs-q" {box}>
  {#snippet before()}
    {#if anchor}<div bind:this={copy} class="bs-anchor {trigger.anchorClass}" style="left: {anchor.left}px; top: {anchor.top}px;"><TriggerCopy {name} onclick={close} /></div>{/if}
  {/snippet}
  <div class="bs-in">
    <Icon name="search" size={18} />
    <label class="vk-visually-hidden" for="bs-q">Find a board</label>
    <input id="bs-q" placeholder="Find a board" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-controls="bs-list" aria-expanded="true"
      aria-activedescendant={flat.length ? `bs-opt-${sel}` : undefined} bind:value={q} oninput={() => (sel = 0)} />
    <span class="kbd">esc</span>
  </div>
  <div class="bs-list" id="bs-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Boards">
    {#each groups as g (g.label)}
      <div role="group" aria-label={g.label}>
        <div class="bs-gh"><span>{g.label}</span><span>{g.right}</span></div>
        {#each g.boards as b (b.id)}
          {@const i = flat.indexOf(b)}
          {@const here = b.id === app.boardId}
          <a class="bs-row" id="bs-opt-{i}" role="option" href="/b/{b.id}" aria-selected={i === sel} data-sel={i === sel} aria-current={here ? 'page' : 'false'}
            onmouseenter={() => (sel = i)} onclick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); open(b.id); }}>
            <span class="bs-name"><b>{b.name}</b><span>{boardCountText(b.cardCount)}</span></span>
            <span>{#if b.needsYouCount > 0}<span class="chip chip--needs">{needsChip(b.needsYouCount)}</span>{/if}</span>
            <span class="bs-when">{#if here}<span class="bs-here">You are here</span>{:else}{relativeDay(b.lastActivityAt, new Date(), ZONE)}{/if}</span>
          </a>
        {/each}
      </div>
    {:else}
      <p class="bs-empty">No board matches “{q.trim()}”.</p>
    {/each}
  </div>
  {#if renaming}
    <div class="bs-acts" role="group" aria-label="This board">
      <label class="vk-visually-hidden" for="bs-rename">Board name</label>
      <input id="bs-rename" class="vk-field__input" bind:value={draft} onkeydown={renameKey} />
      <button class="link" type="button" onclick={() => void saveRename()}>Save</button>
      <button class="link" type="button" onclick={() => (renaming = false)}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  {:else}
    <div class="bs-acts" role="group" aria-label="This board">
      <span class="small muted" style="margin-right: 4px;">This board:</span>
      <button class="link" type="button" onclick={startRename}><Icon name="pencil" size={15} /> Rename</button>
      <a class="link" href="/b/{app.boardId}/settings" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center;" onclick={close}><Icon name="settings" size={15} />&nbsp;Board settings</a>
      <button class="bs-del" type="button" onclick={() => void onDelete()}><Icon name="bin" size={15} /> Delete board…</button>
    </div>
  {/if}
  <div class="bs-foot">
    <span class="grow"><span class="kbd">↑</span><span class="kbd">↓</span> move <span class="kbd">↵</span> open</span>
    <button class="vk-button vk-button--secondary" type="button" onclick={() => { close(); creating = true; }}><Icon name="plus" size={16} /> New board</button>
  </div>
</DialogFrame>

<NewBoardDialog open={creating} onClose={() => (creating = false)} onCreated={(id) => { creating = false; void goto(`/b/${id}`); }} />
```

```bash
const fs = require("fs");
for (const v of ["Daylight", "Paper", "Studio", "Quiet"]) {
```

```ts
    expect(VIBE_CARDS.find((v) => v.id === 'paper')!.swatches).toEqual(['--vk-color-bg', '--vk-color-surface', '--vk-color-primary', '--vk-color-accent', '--vk-color-signal']);
  });
  it('offers the product colour, then the eight accents, each with its sub', () => {
    expect(ACC_OPTIONS.map((o) => [o.value, o.name, o.sub])).toEqual([
      ['product', 'Product colour', 'Gold, Superpipeline’s own'], ['gold', 'Gold', 'Same as the product colour'], ['moss', 'Moss', 'Leaf green'],
      ['jade', 'Jade', 'Superwitness’s colour'], ['teal', 'Teal', 'Blue-green'], ['azure', 'Azure', 'Sea blue'],
      ['cobalt', 'Cobalt', 'AgentPod’s colour'], ['violet', 'Violet', 'Supermessage’s colour'], ['plum', 'Plum', 'Superlibrary’s colour'],
    ]);
    expect(OTHERS).toEqual([['Superlibrary', 'plum'], ['AgentPod', 'cobalt'], ['Superwitness', 'jade'], ['Supermessage', 'violet']]);
  });
  it('names the preview and warns of a clash with another product', () => {
    expect(accName('product')).toBe('Gold (the product colour)');
    expect(accName('teal')).toBe('Teal');
    expect(previewLabel('product')).toBe('Preview of the accent Gold (the product colour) on the product mark, the page you are on, the selected tab, a link and the focus ring. The orange for a person needed now does not change.');
    expect(clashNote('plum')).toBe('Plum is Superlibrary’s colour too, so the two will look alike side by side. You can still choose it.');
    expect(clashNote('cobalt')).toBe('Cobalt is AgentPod’s colour too, so the two will look alike side by side. You can still choose it.');
    expect(clashNote('teal')).toBeNull();
    expect(clashNote('product')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Pull the Appearance patch out of `applyDarkPatches` so it can be tested.** In `apps/web/e2e/pixel/reference.ts` (Task 4), move the radiogroup block into an exported function and call it inside the page:

```ts
/** SP-Dlg-Appearance-*: the canvas resolved the theme control at export, so dark checks "Dark" and changes its hint. */
export function appearanceDarkPatch(doc: Document): void {
  const group = doc.querySelector('[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Light or dark"]');
  if (!group) return;
  for (const b of group.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="radio"]')) {
    const on = b.textContent?.trim() === 'Dark';
    b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on));
    b.setAttribute('data-state', on ? 'checked' : 'unchecked');
  }
  const hint = group.parentElement?.querySelector('.ap-hint');
  if (hint) hint.textContent = 'Always dark: a lamp-lit room, not black.';
}
```

In `applyDarkPatches`, replace the inline radiogroup block with `await page.evaluate(\`(${appearanceDarkPatch.toString()})(document)\`);` after the existing `page.evaluate`. The function is self-contained, so its source runs as-is in the page. Add `jsdom` to the test's imports (it is already a devDependency of `apps/web` for component tests).

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/appearance-copy.ts
import { greeting, type Phase, type Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { Accent, AccentChoice } from '$lib/accent';

export const PHASE_NAMES: Readonly<Record<Phase, string>> = { dawn: 'Dawn', morning: 'Morning', noon: 'Midday', golden: 'Golden hour', dusk: 'Dusk', night: 'Night' };

export const THEME_OPTIONS = [{ value: 'sun', label: 'Follow the sun' }, { value: 'light', label: 'Light' }, { value: 'dark', label: 'Dark' }] as const;
export const STRENGTH_OPTIONS = [{ value: 'strong', label: 'Strong' }, { value: 'subtle', label: 'Subtle' }, { value: 'off', label: 'Off' }] as const;

export function themeHint(pref: 'sun' | 'light' | 'dark', phase: Phase, resolved: 'light' | 'dark'): string {
  if (pref === 'light') return 'Always light, whatever the hour.';
  if (pref === 'dark') return 'Always dark: a lamp-lit room, not black.';
  return `Light by day, dark after dusk. It is ${PHASE_NAMES[phase].toLowerCase()}, so it is ${resolved} now.`;
}

const TIME_HINT = {
  strong: 'Strong: the full sky and greeting where the vibe shows them.',
  subtle: 'Subtle: a light tint of the sky, no sun.',
  off: 'Off: no sky, no tint. Light or dark still applies.',
} as const;
export const timeHint = (s: keyof typeof TIME_HINT): string => `${TIME_HINT[s]} Quiet starts with this off.`;

/** vibekit's phaseAt day window without a location (no exported constant; documented 06:00–18:00). */
const DAY_WINDOW = '6:00 to 18:00';
export function locMeans(on: boolean, tz: string): string {
  return on
    ? 'On: sunrise and sunset are worked out from your rough location (about 11 km). It stays on this device and is never sent anywhere.'
    : `Off: the sun follows your time zone, ${tz}, and the day runs ${DAY_WINDOW}. Turn it on for real sunrise and sunset; your browser will ask first.`;
}
export const LOC_DENIED = 'Location was not shared, so the sun follows your time zone.';

/** The sky readout's line (D-11). `hhmm` is the local clock, for Studio. */
export function readout(vibe: Vibe, phase: Phase, strength: 'strong' | 'subtle' | 'off', first: string, hhmm: string): string {
  const P = PHASE_NAMES[phase];
  const line =
    vibe === 'daylight' ? `${P} · ${greeting(phase, 'daylight').replace(/\.$/, '')}, ${first}.`
    : vibe === 'paper' ? (phase === 'noon' ? `${P} · The light is high and even.` : `${P} · ${greeting(phase, 'paper')}`)
    : vibe === 'studio' ? `${P}, ${hhmm} · the board at a glance`
    : `${P}.`;
  return (strength === 'off' ? 'Time of day is off · ' : '') + line;
}

export const VIBE_CARDS: ReadonlyArray<{ id: Vibe; name: string; lead: string; board: string; card: string; swatches: string[] }> = [
  { id: 'daylight', name: 'Daylight', lead: 'Playful and sunlit.', board: 'columns with faces.', card: 'a conversation.', swatches: ['--vk-color-bg', '--vk-color-surface', '--vk-color-primary', '--vk-color-accent', '--vk-color-signal'] },
  { id: 'paper', name: 'Paper', lead: 'Calm and editorial.', board: 'a front page.', card: 'a letter.', swatches: ['--vk-color-bg', '--vk-color-surface', '--vk-color-primary', '--vk-color-accent', '--vk-color-signal'] },
  { id: 'studio', name: 'Studio', lead: 'An annual report: warm paper, ink and one blue.', board: 'a report led by one big figure.', card: 'a profile with footnotes.', swatches: ['--vk-color-bg', '--vk-color-primary', '--vk-stage-5', '--vk-color-accent', '--vk-color-signal'] },
  { id: 'quiet', name: 'Quiet', lead: 'Plain and focused.', board: 'one list by urgency.', card: 'a form.', swatches: ['--vk-color-bg', '--vk-color-surface', '--vk-color-primary', '--vk-color-accent', '--vk-color-signal'] },
];

export const ACC_NAMES: Readonly<Record<Accent, string>> = { gold: 'Gold', moss: 'Moss', jade: 'Jade', teal: 'Teal', azure: 'Azure', cobalt: 'Cobalt', violet: 'Violet', plum: 'Plum' };
const ACC_SUBS: Readonly<Record<Accent, string>> = {
  gold: 'Same as the product colour', moss: 'Leaf green', jade: 'Superwitness’s colour', teal: 'Blue-green',
  azure: 'Sea blue', cobalt: 'AgentPod’s colour', violet: 'Supermessage’s colour', plum: 'Superlibrary’s colour',
};
const ORDER: Accent[] = ['gold', 'moss', 'jade', 'teal', 'azure', 'cobalt', 'violet', 'plum'];
export const ACC_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<{ value: AccentChoice; name: string; sub: string }> = [
  { value: 'product', name: 'Product colour', sub: 'Gold, Superpipeline’s own' },
  ...ORDER.map((a) => ({ value: a, name: ACC_NAMES[a], sub: ACC_SUBS[a] })),
];
/** The other products and the colour each keeps. */
export const OTHERS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, Accent]> = [['Superlibrary', 'plum'], ['AgentPod', 'cobalt'], ['Superwitness', 'jade'], ['Supermessage', 'violet']];

export function accName(sel: AccentChoice): string {
  return sel === 'product' ? `${ACC_NAMES.gold} (the product colour)` : ACC_NAMES[sel];
}
export function previewLabel(sel: AccentChoice): string {
  return `Preview of the accent ${accName(sel)} on the product mark, the page you are on, the selected tab, a link and the focus ring. The orange for a person needed now does not change.`;
}
export function clashNote(sel: AccentChoice): string | null {
  if (sel === 'product') return null;
  const other = OTHERS.find(([, a]) => a === sel);
  return other ? `${ACC_NAMES[sel]} is ${other[0]}’s colour too, so the two will look alike side by side. You can still choose it.` : null;
}
```

```svelte
  import { firstName, personName } from './person';
  import './css/ap.daylight.css';
  import './css/ap.paper.css';
  import './css/ap.studio.css';
  import './css/ap.quiet.css';
  import './ap-extra.css';

  const ZONE = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
  let locNote = $state<string | null>(null);
  let locBusy = $state(false);

  const first = $derived(firstName(personName(app.user, app.members)));
  const counts = $derived.by(() => {
    const b = app.board;
    if (!b) return { needs: 0, working: 0, queued: 0 };
    const s = summarize(b, b.cards.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt), { agents: app.agents, members: app.members, labels: app.labelById(), nowMs: Date.now() });
    return { needs: s.filter((x) => x.urgency === 'needs').length, working: s.filter((x) => x.urgency === 'working').length, queued: s.filter((x) => x.urgency === 'queued').length };
  });
  const on = $derived(appearance.value.useLocation || locBusy);

  function close(): void { appearance.pickerOpen = false; }

  async function flipLocation(): Promise<void> {
    // Off wins: while a request is pending the switch reads on, and a second press cancels it.
    if (locBusy || appearance.value.useLocation) {
      appearance.stopUsingLocation();
      locBusy = false;
      locNote = null;
      return;
    }
    locBusy = true;
    locNote = null;
    const r = await appearance.useLocation();
    if (r === 'cancelled') return;
    locBusy = false;
    locNote = r === 'denied' ? LOC_DENIED : null;
  }
</script>

<DialogFrame open={appearance.pickerOpen} dlg="ap" labelledby="ap-title" describedby="ap-sub" width={1000} top={20} onClose={close} accent initialFocus={'input[name="vibe"]:checked'}>
```

### Task 40: Reconnect flow, `POST /hub/session` and the expired dialog

**Model:** opus · **Review:** opus

This task replaces "any 401 → signed out → Landing" with recovery.

When a request is refused with 401, the store first tries a silent renewal. While it runs, a toast reads "Signing you back in…" and you stay on the page. It calls `POST /hub/session`, which spends the plane refresh cookie and re-signs the session. If the renewal fails, the store mounts an alertdialog, "Sign in again to keep going". That dialog keeps the signed-in user, names the place you will come back to, and saves `returnTo` before it sends you to sign in. This turns `SP-Dlg-Reconnect-*` green in light and dark.

Rulings applied:
- **No fixture variant.** The harness loads the page signed in, then routes `**/hub/session` to `login_required` and `**/v1/**` to 401, calls `window.__spDev.refresh()` and waits for the alertdialog.
- **Display name (D-4).** A plane session's `name` becomes `claims.name ?? claims.email`. The dialog prints the workspace member name through `personName`.
- **The silent path has no reference.** It is covered by a behavioural e2e test instead.

Decision: there is no per-request replay. Once renewal succeeds, the store reloads the person and the board (`#restore`) and reconnects the socket. A second 401 during that reload ends in `expired` with `unauthorized_after_renew`.

```ts
// apps/api/test/plane-session.test.ts
import { env } from 'cloudflare:test';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import worker from '../src/index';
import type { Env } from '../src/env';
import { setupCatalog } from './helpers/catalog';
import { planeEnv, planeKeys, planeToken, PLANE, PLANE_JWKS, APP_AUD, ORG, HUMAN } from './helpers/org-plane';
import { handleSessionRenewal, displayName } from '../src/auth/plane-signin';
import { verifySession } from '../src/auth/session';
import { findTenantByExternal, findUserByExternal } from '../src/db/catalog';
import { __resetJwksCacheForTests } from '../src/auth/hub-jwt';

beforeAll(setupCatalog);
beforeEach(() => __resetJwksCacheForTests());

const SECRET = 'plane-session-secret';
const envOn = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => planeEnv({ APP_URL: APP_AUD, SESSION_SECRET: SECRET, HUB_ISSUER: undefined, ...over });
const post = (cookie?: string) => new Request('https://api.test/hub/session', { method: 'POST', headers: cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {} });

function plane(answer: () => Record<string, unknown> | null) {
  const tokenRequests: URLSearchParams[] = [];
  const impl = (async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const url = String(input);
    if (url === PLANE_JWKS) return new Response((await planeKeys()).jwksBody, { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
    if (url === `${PLANE}/api/auth/oauth2/token`) {
      tokenRequests.push(new URLSearchParams(String(init?.body)));
      const body = answer();
      return body ? Response.json(body) : Response.json({ error: 'invalid_grant' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    return new Response('unexpected', { status: 599 });
  }) as unknown as typeof fetch;
  return { impl, tokenRequests };
}
function cookies(res: Response): Map<string, string> {
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const c of (res.headers as unknown as { getSetCookie(): string[] }).getSetCookie()) {
    const [pair] = c.split(';');
    const [k, ...v] = pair!.trim().split('=');
    out.set(k!, v.join('='));
  }
  return out;
}

describe('POST /hub/session — renew a lapsed session in the background', () => {
  it('answers only POST', async () => {
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(new Request('https://api.test/hub/session'), envOn());
    expect(res.status).toBe(405);
  });

  it('spends the refresh cookie, re-signs the session and rotates the refresh token', async () => {
    const access = await planeToken({ name: 'Rakesh Gangwar' });
    const fake = plane(() => ({ access_token: access, refresh_token: 'r2', expires_in: 300 }));
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=r1'), envOn(), fake.impl);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(fake.tokenRequests[0]!.get('grant_type')).toBe('refresh_token');
    expect(fake.tokenRequests[0]!.get('refresh_token')).toBe('r1');
    const c = cookies(res);
    const session = await verifySession(c.get('superpipeline_session')!, SECRET);
    expect(session?.tenantId).toBe(await findTenantByExternal(env.DB, 'org-plane', ORG));
    expect(session?.userId).toBe((await findUserByExternal(env.DB, 'org-plane', HUMAN))?.id);
    expect(session?.name).toBe('Rakesh Gangwar');
    expect(c.get('superpipeline_hub_token')).toBe(access);
    expect(c.get('superpipeline_plane_refresh')).toBe('r2');
  });

  it('a refused grant is login_required, names the issuer, and leaves the refresh cookie alone', async () => {
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=spent'), envOn(), plane(() => null).impl);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: 'accounts.test', reauthorize: '/auth/login' });
    expect(cookies(res).has('superpipeline_plane_refresh')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('no refresh cookie is no_refresh', async () => {
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(post(), envOn(), plane(() => null).impl);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' });
  });

  it.each([
    ['a 5xx from the plane', (): Response => new Response('upstream', { status: 502 })],
    ['the plane unreachable', (): Response => { throw new TypeError('network'); }],
  ])('on %s, answers a retryable 503 and spends nothing', async (_n, answer) => {
    const impl = ((_i: RequestInfo | URL) => Promise.resolve(answer())) as unknown as typeof fetch;
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=still-good'), envOn(), impl);
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(res.headers.get('Retry-After')).toBe('5');
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'plane_unavailable', retryable: true });
    expect(cookies(res).has('superpipeline_plane_refresh')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a renewed token that is not a person present at sign-in renews nothing', async () => {
    const access = await planeToken({ principalKind: 'agent' });
    const res = await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=r1'), envOn(), plane(() => ({ access_token: access, refresh_token: 'r2' })).impl);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: 'accounts.test', reauthorize: '/auth/login' });
    expect(cookies(res).has('superpipeline_session')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('GitHub sign-in has no background renewal, and is wired through the router', async () => {
    const github = { ...env, DEV_AUTH: undefined, ORG_PLANE_ISSUER: undefined } as unknown as Env;
    const res = await worker.fetch(post(), github);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' });
  });

  it('under DEV_AUTH it is a stub the e2e suite can steer', async () => {
    const dev = { ...env, DEV_AUTH: 'true', ORG_PLANE_ISSUER: undefined } as unknown as Env;
    expect(await (await handleSessionRenewal(post(), dev)).json()).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(await (await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=refused'), dev)).json())
      .toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: 'accounts.superjackfruit.com', reauthorize: '/auth/login' });
    const sleep = vi.fn(async () => {});
    expect(await (await handleSessionRenewal(post('superpipeline_plane_refresh=slow'), dev, fetch, sleep)).json()).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(sleep).toHaveBeenCalledWith(10_000);
  });

  it('names the person by name, else by email (D-4)', () => {
    expect(displayName({ name: 'Rakesh Gangwar', email: 'r@example.com' })).toBe('Rakesh Gangwar');
    expect(displayName({ name: '  ', email: 'r@example.com' })).toBe('r@example.com');
    expect(displayName({})).toBe('Member');
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/auth-recovery.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { AuthRecovery, RETRY_MS } from './auth-recovery.svelte';
import type { RenewResult } from './api';

function make(renewals: RenewResult[], restore: () => Promise<boolean> = async () => true) {
  const renew = vi.fn(async () => renewals.shift() ?? { ok: false as const, reason: 'login_required' as const });
  const sleep = vi.fn(async () => {});
  const onExpired = vi.fn();
  return { a: new AuthRecovery({ renew, restore: vi.fn(restore), sleep, onExpired }), renew, sleep, onExpired };
}

describe('AuthRecovery', () => {
  it('concurrent 401s share one renewal', async () => {
    const { a, renew } = make([{ ok: true }]);
    const p1 = a.recover(); const p2 = a.recover();
    a.noteUnauthorized();
    expect(a.state).toBe('renewing');
    expect(await p1).toBe(true);
    expect(await p2).toBe(true);
    expect(renew).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(a.state).toBe('ok');
  });
  it('a renewal that succeeds restores once and stays ok', async () => {
    const restore = vi.fn(async () => true);
    const a = new AuthRecovery({ renew: async () => ({ ok: true }), restore, sleep: async () => {} });
    expect(await a.recover()).toBe(true);
    expect(restore).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect([a.state, a.reason]).toEqual(['ok', null]);
  });
  it('a second 401 while restoring ends expired: refused after renew', async () => {
    let a!: AuthRecovery;
    const made = make([{ ok: true }], async () => { a.noteUnauthorized(); return true; });
    a = made.a;
    expect(await a.recover()).toBe(false);
    expect([a.state, a.reason]).toEqual(['expired', 'unauthorized_after_renew']);
    expect(made.renew).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('login_required ends expired with the reason and the issuer', async () => {
    const { a, onExpired } = make([{ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: 'accounts.superjackfruit.com', reauthorize: '/auth/login' }]);
    expect(await a.recover()).toBe(false);
    expect([a.state, a.reason, a.issuer]).toEqual(['expired', 'login_required', 'accounts.superjackfruit.com']);
    expect(onExpired).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('an unavailable sign-in service is retried three times, five seconds apart, then expires', async () => {
    const down = { ok: false as const, reason: 'plane_unavailable' as const, retryable: true };
    const { a, renew, sleep } = make([down, down, down, down]);
    expect(await a.recover()).toBe(false);
    expect(renew).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
    expect(sleep.mock.calls).toEqual([[RETRY_MS], [RETRY_MS], [RETRY_MS]]);
    expect(RETRY_MS).toBe(5000);
    expect(a.reason).toBe('plane_unavailable');
  });
  it('once expired, further 401s do nothing until resolved', async () => {
    const { a, renew } = make([{ ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' }]);
    await a.recover();
    a.noteUnauthorized();
    expect(renew).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    a.resolved();
    expect([a.state, a.reason, a.issuer]).toEqual(['ok', null, null]);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The endpoint** — add to `apps/api/src/auth/plane-signin.ts`:

```ts
import type { OrgPlaneClaims } from './org-plane';

const DEV_ISSUER = 'accounts.superjackfruit.com';
const unavailable = () => Response.json({ ok: false, reason: 'plane_unavailable', retryable: true }, { status: 503, headers: { 'Retry-After': '5' } });

/** The session's display name (D-4): the plane's `name` claim, else the email, else "Member". */
export function displayName(claims: { name?: unknown; email?: string }): string {
  return typeof claims.name === 'string' && claims.name.trim() !== '' ? claims.name.trim() : claims.email ?? 'Member';
}

/** A signed session for a renewed token, or null when it is not a person who may sign in here. */
async function sessionFromClaims(env: Env, claims: OrgPlaneClaims): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!entitles(claims) || claims.principalKind !== 'human' || claims.act) return null;
  const tenantId = await ensureOrgTenant(env.DB, claims.org);
  const human = await provisionOrgHuman(env.DB, tenantId, claims);
  if (!human) return null;
  return signSession({ userId: human.userId, tenantId, name: displayName(claims), exp: Date.now() + SESSION_TTL_MS }, env.SESSION_SECRET!);
}

/**
 * POST /hub/session: renew a lapsed session without leaving the page. It lives under /hub/ because the
 * refresh cookie is Path=/hub. It spends the refresh cookie, re-signs the session and rotates the
 * cookies exactly as /hub/token does. A refused grant is NOT a sign-out, so the refresh cookie is
 * left for another tab that may already hold a newer one. GitHub sign-in has no refresh token.
 */
export async function handleSessionRenewal(
  request: Request,
  env: Env,
  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
  sleep: (ms: number) => Promise<void> = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)),
): Promise<Response> {
  if (request.method !== 'POST') return Response.json({ error: 'method not allowed' }, { status: 405 });
  const mode = orgPlaneMode(env);
  if (mode.kind === 'off') {
    if (env.DEV_AUTH === 'true') {
      // Dev stub, steered by the refresh cookie: `refused` and `slow` let e2e reach both outcomes.
      const v = readCookie(request, REFRESH_COOKIE);
      if (v === 'refused') return Response.json({ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: DEV_ISSUER, reauthorize: '/auth/login' });
      if (v === 'slow') await sleep(10_000);
      return Response.json({ ok: true });
    }
    return Response.json({ ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' });
  }
  if (mode.kind === 'invalid' || !env.SESSION_SECRET) return unavailable();
  const { cfg } = mode;
  const issuer = new URL(cfg.issuer).host;
  const refused = () => Response.json({ ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer, reauthorize: '/auth/login' });

  const refresh = readCookie(request, REFRESH_COOKIE);
  if (!refresh) return Response.json({ ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' });
  const grant = await tokenGrant(cfg, { grant_type: 'refresh_token', refresh_token: refresh }, fetchImpl);
  if (!grant.ok) return grant.refused ? refused() : unavailable();
  const tokens = grant.tokens;
  const claims = await verifyOrgPlaneToken(tokens.access_token!, cfg, cfg.audience, fetchImpl);
  const session = claims ? await sessionFromClaims(env, claims) : null;
  if (!session) return refused();

  const headers = new Headers();
  headers.append('Set-Cookie', sessionSetCookie(session, { secure: true }));
  headers.append('Set-Cookie', tokenCookie(tokens.access_token!, ttlOf(tokens)));
  let next: string | null = tokens.refresh_token ?? null;
  if (next) {
    const hub = await hubAudienceToken(cfg, env, next, fetchImpl);
    if (hub) {
      headers.append('Set-Cookie', hubAudCookie(hub.access_token!, ttlOf(hub)));
      if (hub.refresh_token) next = hub.refresh_token;
    }
  }
  headers.append('Set-Cookie', refreshCookie(next ?? '', next ? REFRESH_MAX_AGE_S : 0));
  return Response.json({ ok: true }, { headers });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The client and the recovery state**

Add to `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`, after `getMe`:

```ts
export type RenewReason = 'login_required' | 'no_refresh' | 'plane_unavailable' | 'unauthorized_after_renew';
export type RenewResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: RenewReason; issuer?: string; reauthorize?: string; retryable?: boolean };

/** Renew a lapsed session in the background (POST /hub/session). Never throws. */
export async function renewSession(): Promise<RenewResult> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch('/hub/session', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers });
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'plane_unavailable', retryable: true };
  }
  if (res.status === 503) return { ok: false, reason: 'plane_unavailable', retryable: true };
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { ok?: boolean; reason?: string; issuer?: string; reauthorize?: string } | null;
  if (body?.ok === true) return { ok: true };
  if (body?.reason === 'login_required') return { ok: false, reason: 'login_required', ...(body.issuer ? { issuer: body.issuer } : {}), ...(body.reauthorize ? { reauthorize: body.reauthorize } : {}) };
  return { ok: false, reason: 'no_refresh' };
}
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/auth-recovery.svelte.ts
/**
 * What happens when the server says the session is gone. It renews quietly first (POST /hub/session,
 * one renewal shared by every concurrent 401), then restores the page. Only when that fails does the
 * app ask the person to sign in again. The person stays signed in on screen throughout: Landing is
 * for people who were never signed in.
 */
import { renewSession, type RenewReason, type RenewResult } from './api';

export type AuthRecoveryState = 'ok' | 'renewing' | 'expired';
export const RETRY_MS = 5000;
export const RETRIES = 3;

export interface RecoveryDeps {
  renew: () => Promise<RenewResult>;
  /** Reload the person and the board after a renewal; false when the person cannot be read back. */
  restore: () => Promise<boolean>;
  sleep: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
  onExpired?: () => void;
}

export class AuthRecovery {
  state = $state<AuthRecoveryState>('ok');
  reason = $state<RenewReason | null>(null);
  issuer = $state<string | null>(null);
  #deps: RecoveryDeps;
  #inflight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
  #restoring = false;
  #refusedAgain = false;

  constructor(deps: RecoveryDeps) { this.#deps = deps; }
  configure(deps: Partial<RecoveryDeps>): void { this.#deps = { ...this.#deps, ...deps }; }

  noteUnauthorized(): void {
    if (this.state === 'expired') return;
    if (this.#restoring) { this.#refusedAgain = true; return; }
    void this.recover();
  }

  recover(): Promise<boolean> {
    this.#inflight ??= this.#run().finally(() => { this.#inflight = null; });
    return this.#inflight;
  }

  /** Signed in again elsewhere (another tab): nothing to recover any more. */
  resolved(): void {
    this.state = 'ok';
    this.reason = null;
    this.issuer = null;
  }

  async #run(): Promise<boolean> {
    this.state = 'renewing';
    let r = await this.#deps.renew();
    for (let i = 0; !r.ok && r.reason === 'plane_unavailable' && i < RETRIES; i++) {
      await this.#deps.sleep(RETRY_MS);
      r = await this.#deps.renew();
    }
    if (!r.ok) return this.#expire(r.reason, r.issuer ?? null);
    this.#restoring = true;
    this.#refusedAgain = false;
    let restored = false;
    try { restored = await this.#deps.restore(); } finally { this.#restoring = false; }
    if (!restored || this.#refusedAgain) return this.#expire('unauthorized_after_renew', null);
    this.resolved();
    return true;
  }

  #expire(reason: RenewReason, issuer: string | null): false {
    this.state = 'expired';
    this.reason = reason;
    this.issuer = issuer;
    this.#deps.onExpired?.();
    return false;
  }
}

export const auth = new AuthRecovery({
  renew: renewSession,
  restore: async () => false,
  sleep: (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)),
});
```

```ts
// apps/web/src/lib/components/dialogs/reconnect-copy.ts
import type { Vibe } from '@superjackfruit/vibekit';
import type { RenewReason } from '$lib/api';

export const RC_LEAD: Readonly<Record<Vibe, string>> = {
  daylight: 'Your sign-in ran out and we could not renew it quietly. Sign in and you will land right back on this card.',
  paper: 'Your sign-in has expired, and it could not be renewed in the background. Once you sign in, you return to this card.',
  studio: 'SESSION EXPIRED. Background renewal failed. Sign in to return to this card.',
  quiet: 'You are signed out. We could not renew your sign-in. After you sign in, this card opens again.',
};
export const rcLead = (vibe: Vibe, onCard: boolean): string => (onCard ? RC_LEAD[vibe] : RC_LEAD[vibe].replace('this card', 'this page'));

const TABS: Record<string, string> = { 'needs-you': 'Needs you', agents: 'Agents', capabilities: 'Capabilities', labels: 'Labels', people: 'People', connections: 'Connections' };

/** "You will come back to": the open card, else the board and the view, else the Workspace tab. */
export function returnBox(x: { card: { title: string; stageName: string } | null; boardName: string | null; pathname: string }): { title: string; sub: string } {
  if (x.card) return { title: x.card.title, sub: `${x.boardName ?? ''} · ${x.card.stageName}` };
  const ws = /^\/workspace(?:\/([a-z-]+))?/.exec(x.pathname);
  if (ws) return { title: 'Workspace', sub: TABS[ws[1] ?? 'needs-you'] ?? 'Workspace' };
  const view = /\/operate\/telemetry\/?$/.test(x.pathname) ? 'Spend detail' : /\/operate\/?$/.test(x.pathname) ? 'Operate' : /\/settings\/?$/.test(x.pathname) ? 'Board settings' : 'Board';
  return { title: x.boardName ?? 'Superpipeline', sub: view };
}

export const whatHappened = (issuer: string): string =>
  `Your sign-in with ${issuer} ended, so it could not be renewed in the background. Your place is saved: after you sign in, you come back here.`;

const REASON_TEXT: Readonly<Record<RenewReason, string>> = {
  login_required: 'refresh refused',
  no_refresh: 'no background renewal for this sign-in',
  plane_unavailable: 'sign-in service unavailable',
  unauthorized_after_renew: 'the session was refused after renewal',
};
export const reasonLine = (r: RenewReason): string => `Reason: ${REASON_TEXT[r]} (${r})`;
export const toastSub = (onCard: boolean): string => (onCard ? 'You stay on this card.' : 'You stay on this page.');
```

```ts
// apps/web/e2e/reconnect.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { API, TENANT, seedBoard } from './support/seed';

async function cardPage(page: import('@playwright/test').Page, request: import('@playwright/test').APIRequestContext, title: string) {
  const boardId = await seedBoard(request, `Reconnect ${Date.now().toString(36)}`);
  await request.post(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}/cards`, { headers: TENANT, data: { title } });
  const snap = (await (await request.get(`${API}/v1/boards/${boardId}`, { headers: TENANT })).json()) as { cards: Array<{ id: string; title: string }> };
  const path = `/b/${boardId}/c/${snap.cards.find((c) => c.title === title)!.id}`;
  await page.goto(path);
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-ready', 'true');
  return path;
}

test('a lapsed session renews quietly and keeps the open card', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const path = await cardPage(page, request, 'Keep me open');
  let refused = false;
  await page.route('**/v1/boards/*', (route) => {
    if (!refused && route.request().method() === 'GET') { refused = true; return route.fulfill({ status: 401, json: { error: 'unauthorized' } }); }
    return route.continue();
  });
  let release!: () => void;
  const held = new Promise<void>((r) => (release = r));
  await page.route('**/hub/session', async (route) => { await held; await route.continue(); }); // the DEV_AUTH stub answers ok

  await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __spDev: { refresh(): Promise<void> } }).__spDev.refresh());
  const toast = page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Signing you back in…' });
  await expect(toast).toBeVisible();
  await expect(toast).toContainText('You stay on this card.');
  release();
  await expect(toast).toBeHidden();
  await expect(page.getByRole('alertdialog')).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe(path);
  await expect(page.getByText('Keep me open').first()).toBeVisible();
});

test('a refused renewal asks to sign in again, keeps the person and remembers the card', async ({ page, request }) => {
  const path = await cardPage(page, request, 'Come back to me');
  await page.route('**/hub/session', (r) => r.fulfill({ status: 200, json: { ok: false, reason: 'login_required', issuer: 'accounts.superjackfruit.com', reauthorize: '/auth/login' } }));
  await page.route('**/v1/**', (r) => r.fulfill({ status: 401, json: { error: 'unauthorized' } }));
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __spDev: { refresh(): Promise<void> } }).__spDev.refresh());
  const dialog = page.getByRole('alertdialog', { name: 'Sign in again to keep going' });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog).toContainText('Come back to me');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('link', { name: 'Sign in again' }).click();
  await page.waitForURL('**/auth/login');
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.getItem('superpipeline.returnTo'))).toBe(path);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `apps/web/e2e/pixel/README.md`**

```markdown
# Pixel suite

Compares the running app with the approved Design-canvas references, one test per artboard per theme.

## Run it

    pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel                 # everything (starts wrangler dev:pixel and vite)
    pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel -g "SP-Board-Paper"   # one artboard, both themes
    pnpm --filter @superpipeline/web test:pixel:report          # open test-results/pixel/index.html

The report shows reference | app | diff and a slider. Failures sort first.

## What "pass" means

Per-pixel YIQ threshold 0.1, anti-aliasing excluded; at most 0.5% of unmasked pixels differ; no 8×8
block has more than 40% of its pixels differing; the page is exactly the artboard's size. Between 0.1%
and 0.5% is reported as a warning.

## The world

One fixture world (`fixture/world.ts`), seeded through `POST /v1/dev/fixture` into tenant `tnt_vibes`.
The route exists only when the API runs with `DEV_AUTH=true` and `FIXTURE_IMPORT=true`
(`pnpm --filter @superpipeline/api dev:pixel`). The browser clock is frozen at 2026-10-11 13:51
Asia/Kolkata. Bulky fields come from `fixture/source/after_brd_*.json`, scrubbed by
`scripts/pixel/scrub-snapshots.mjs`; `fixture/snapshots.test.ts` fails on anything token- or
email-shaped. Never add a per-screen fixture: change the world and say why.

## Both sides use the same fonts

References link Google Fonts; the harness blocks them and serves the app's own Fontsource files under
the mockup family names (`fonts.ts`). No stored screenshots: both sides render in the same Chromium in
the same run, so platforms cancel out.

## Refreshing a reference

1. `node apps/web/scripts/pixel/recv.mjs apps/web/e2e/reference/mockups`
2. In the canvas, for each changed artboard run
   `fetch('http://localhost:8977/?name=SP-<Screen>-<Vibe>', {method:'POST', body: document.querySelector('[data-artboard="SP-<Screen>-<Vibe>"] iframe').contentDocument.documentElement.outerHTML})`
   (a real dark export: `?name=SP-<Screen>-<Vibe>.dark`).
3. Update `manifest.json` (`w`, `h` from the export's size comment).
4. Run that artboard; commit the HTML and the manifest with the reason.
5. If the export applies a row of `CORRECTIONS.md`, delete the row in the same commit.

## Masks, patches and corrections

- A **mask** hides pixels and must cite an id in `masks.ts` `MASK_IDS`. Only three remain: `C-08`
  (the board behind a drawer), `live-dot`, `token-secret`.
- A **reference patch** (`refPatch` in `screens.ts`) edits the reference page before the screenshot:
  the New card draft row (agent drafting is out of scope) and the Appearance dark theme control.
- A **reference correction** edits a committed reference file where it contradicts a ruling; every one
  is a row in `../reference/mockups/CORRECTIONS.md` and must reach the canvas at the next export.
```
